tEn: Anthropic, PBC — Form S-1 Registration Statement (IPO Prospectus)
tZh: Anthropic, PBC —S-1 注册声明（IPO 招股说明书）
sEn: Anthropic files for IPO, citing Claude's rapid enterprise adoption and a mission-driven, safety-focused approach to capturing a multi-trillion-dollar AI opportunity.
sZh: Anthropic 提交 IPO 申请，强调 Claude 在企业市场的快速普及，以及以使命为导向、注重安全的方式把握数万亿美元的人工智能机遇。
absEn: This registration statement presents Anthropic, PBC, a research lab founded in 2021 with the mission of the responsible development of advanced AI for humanity's long-term benefit, as it seeks to go public. The company describes its frontier AI model Claude, which it says has achieved the fastest enterprise adoption of any technology, with revenue growing from zero at commercial launch in early 2023 to a substantial figure by the third quarter of 2026. Anthropic argues that its core advantages—mission focus, talent and culture, integrated frontier and safety research, a fungible multi-chip compute approach, and an enterprise-first strategy—create self-reinforcing improvement and investment loops that compound its lead. It contends that frontier AI will transform cognitive work and entire sectors, citing estimates of over $40 trillion in global economic value from knowledge work and $22.5 trillion in cumulative AI-driven economic impact by 2031. The company also stresses that safety, alignment, and ethical behavior are decisive criteria for enterprise adoption and essential to managing risks such as misuse, power concentration, and misaligned autonomous systems. For investors, the prospectus frames Anthropic as pursuing a large, expanding opportunity while committing substantial capital to compute and infrastructure.
absZh: 本注册声明介绍 Anthropic, PBC——一家成立于 2021 年、以负责任地开发先进人工智能、造福人类长远利益为使命的研究实验室——寻求上市。公司介绍了其前沿 AI 模型 Claude，称其实现了任何技术中最快的企业采用速度，收入从 2023 年初商业化推出时的零增长到 2026 年第三季度的可观数字。Anthropic 认为，其核心优势——使命专注、人才与文化、前沿研究与安全研究的融合、可互换的多芯片算力方案，以及企业优先战略——形成了自我强化的改进与投资循环，从而复合式地扩大其领先优势。公司主张，前沿 AI 将变革认知性工作和整个行业，并援引估计称，知识工作将带来超过 40 万亿美元的全球经济价值，到 2031 年 AI 驱动的累计经济影响将达到 22.5 万亿美元。公司还强调，安全、对齐和合乎伦理的行为是企业采用的决定性标准，对于管理滥用、权力集中和自主系统失准等风险至关重要。对投资者而言，招股说明书将 Anthropic 定位为在追逐一个巨大且不断扩大的机遇，同时将大量资本投入算力和基础设施。

contrib.en: Revenue grew from $0 at Q1 2023 launch to a substantial figure by Q3 2026.
contrib.zh: 营收从 2023 年第一季度商业化时的 0 增长至 2026 年第三季度的可观规模。

contrib.en: More than 11,900 customers spend $100,000+ TTM; about 250 spend $10 million+.
contrib.zh: TTM 支出超 10 万美元的客户逾 11,900 家，超 1,000 万美元的约 250 家。

contrib.en: Net Revenue Retention was approximately 900% as of September 30, 2026.
contrib.zh: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，净收入留存率约为 900%。

contrib.en: Revenue grew 1,368% year over year in Q2 2026; compute expenses grew 300%.
contrib.zh: 2026 年第二季度营收同比增长 1,368%，算力与基础设施费用增长 300%。

contrib.en: TTM revenue per employee exceeded $6.6 million, up from $1.4 million a year earlier.
contrib.zh: TTM 人均营收超 660 万美元，上年同期为 140 万美元。

contrib.en: Raised $141.1 billion aggregate capital; held $112.4 billion cash and $19.3 billion short-term investments.
contrib.zh: 累计融资 1,411 亿美元，持有现金 1,124 亿美元及短期投资 193 亿美元。

limits.en: Success depends on continuing to build the most advanced AI models; failure could hurt the business.
limits.zh: 成功取决于能否持续打造最先进的 AI 模型，失败将损害业务。

limits.en: Inability to secure adequate compute or direct it effectively could undermine model competitiveness.
limits.zh: 若无法获得充足算力或有效调配，可能削弱模型竞争力。

limits.en: Revenue and receivables are concentrated in a limited number of customers and distribution channels.
limits.zh: 营收与应收账款集中于少数客户和分销渠道。

limits.en: Novel multi-class structure concentrates voting power in the LTBT and Founder LLC, not proportionate to economics.
limits.zh: 新颖的多重股权结构使投票权集中于 LTBT 和创始人 LLC，与经济效益不成比例。

limits.en: PBC duty to balance stockholder, stakeholder, and mission interests may conflict with financial performance.
limits.zh: PBC 须平衡股东、利益相关方与使命，可能与财务表现冲突。

paras.en: The following are abbreviations, acronyms, and definitions of certain terms used in this prospectus:
paras.zh: 以下为本招股说明书中使用的缩写、首字母缩略词及特定术语的定义：

paras.en: “agent loop” refers to the iterative cycle in which an AI agent receives a task, takes an action, such as planning a project, running code, or calling a tool, observes the result, and decides its next step, with this cycle repeating until the task is complete. The agent loop is the core execution pattern underlying agentic AI behavior.
paras.zh: “智能体循环”指 AI 智能体接收任务、采取行动（例如规划项目、运行代码或调用工具）、观察结果并决定下一步骤的迭代循环，该循环重复进行直至任务完成。智能体循环是智能体式 AI 行为背后的核心执行模式。

paras.en: “agentic AI” refers to AI systems that, with varying degrees of autonomy, can plan, determine, and sequence actions and execute them to accomplish defined objectives, including through interaction with external tools, services, datasets, and environments on behalf of a user.
paras.zh: “智能体式 AI”指能够在不同程度上自主规划、确定并排序行动并执行这些行动以实现既定目标的 AI 系统，包括代表用户与外部工具、服务、数据集和环境进行交互。

paras.en: “AI” refers to artificial intelligence, a machine-based system that learns or is trained from data and, for explicit or implicit objectives and with varying levels of autonomy, processes that data to infer patterns, generate outputs—such as predictions, content, recommendations, and decisions—and act upon physical or virtual environments.
paras.zh: “AI”指人工智能，一种基于机器的系统，其从数据中学习或接受数据训练，并针对明确或隐含的目标、以不同程度的自主性处理该等数据以推断模式、生成输出（例如预测、内容、推荐和决策），并对物理或虚拟环境采取行动。

paras.en: “AI accelerators” refer to processors purpose-built or adapted for the large-scale computations required to pre-train, post-train, refine, and run AI models. These processors are significantly more efficient and faster than general-purpose processors for AI workloads.
paras.zh: “AI 加速器”指专为或经改造用于预训练、后训练、优化和运行 AI 模型所需大规模计算而构建的处理器。对于 AI 工作负载，该等处理器比通用处理器显著更高效、更快速。

paras.en: “API” refers to application programming interface, a standardized interface that allows external software to access a system’s capabilities programmatically. AI model providers may offer APIs that allow software developers to send inputs to an AI model and receive outputs, enabling integration into the software developers’ products and workflows.
paras.zh: “API”指应用程序编程接口，一种标准化接口，允许外部软件以编程方式访问系统的能力。AI 模型提供商可提供 API，允许软件开发者向 AI 模型发送输入并接收输出，从而实现与软件开发者产品和 workflows 的集成。

paras.en: “Applied AI” refers to a discipline and organizational function focused on embedding AI capabilities directly into production business environments to address specific customer requirements. Applied AI teams, which include forward-deployed engineers, work with enterprises to design and deploy custom solutions, specialized workflows, and domain-specific implementations tailored to a customer’s own systems and processes.
paras.zh: “应用 AI”指一门学科及组织职能，专注于将 AI 能力直接嵌入生产业务环境，以满足特定客户需求。应用 AI 团队（包括前置部署工程师）与企业合作，设计并部署定制解决方案、专门化工作流程以及针对客户自身系统和流程量身定制的领域特定实施方案。

paras.en: “closing the loop” refers to a development cycle in which successive versions of an AI model assist in building the next, with the goal of compounding capability gains over time.
paras.zh: “闭环”指一种开发循环，其中 AI 模型的 successive 版本协助构建下一版本，目标是在时间推移中实现能力的复利式提升。

paras.en: “compute” refers to the computational processing resources used to train and run AI models, including, without limitation, specialized AI accelerators, memory, networking, storage, and power systems that are deployed in data centers or other physical computing environments.
paras.zh: “算力”指用于训练和运行 AI 模型的计算处理资源，包括但不限于部署在数据中心或其他物理计算环境中的专用 AI 加速器、内存、网络、存储和电力系统。

paras.en: “compute multipliers” refer to algorithmic and methodological improvements in training and inference that increase the effective output of a given amount of compute.
paras.zh: “算力乘数”指训练和推理中的算法与方法学改进，其提高给定算力量的有效产出。

paras.en: “computer use” refers to an AI capability that allows a model to observe and interact with a graphical user interface, such as clicking, typing, and navigating applications, similar to how a human operator would.
paras.zh: “计算机使用”指一种 AI 能力，允许模型观察图形用户界面并与之交互，例如点击、键入和导航应用程序，类似于人类操作员的操作方式。

paras.en: “Constitutional AI” refers to an approach to training AI models using a set of written principles, which we refer to as Claude’s constitution, currently organized around four priorities: being broadly safe, broadly ethical, compliant with our guidelines, and genuinely helpful. Under Constitutional AI, our models evaluate, critique, and revise their own responses against these principles, enabling us to define and control model behavior through auditable principles, rather than relying solely on fixed rule-based instructions or human reviewers.
paras.zh: “宪法式 AI”是指使用一套书面原则来训练 AI 模型的方法，我们将这套原则称为 Claude 的宪法，目前围绕四项优先事项组织：广泛安全、广泛合乎伦理、符合我们的准则，以及真正有帮助。在宪法式 AI 下，我们的模型会依据这些原则对自身回答进行评估、批评和修订，使我们能够通过可审计的原则来定义和控制模型行为，而不是仅依赖固定的基于规则的指令或人工审核员。

paras.en: “context window” refers to the maximum amount of text, code, or other content, measured in tokens, that an AI model can process in a given request, encompassing instructions, prior conversation history, user input, and the model’s output.
paras.zh: “上下文窗口”是指 AI 模型在单次请求中能够处理的文本、代码或其他内容的最大量，以 token 计量，涵盖指令、先前对话历史、用户输入以及模型的输出。

paras.en: “CSP” refers to a cloud services provider, a technology company that owns and operates large-scale cloud computing infrastructure and provides on-demand compute, storage, and networking. CSPs may also serve as distribution channels through which AI products and services are made available to customers. The largest CSPs, sometimes referred to as hyperscalers, operate at global scale with significant infrastructure and market concentration.
paras.zh: “CSP”是指云服务商，即拥有并运营大规模云计算基础设施、按需提供算力、存储和网络的技术公司。CSP 还可作为分发渠道，通过其向客户提供 AI 产品和服务。最大的 CSP 有时被称为超大规模云服务商，其以全球规模运营，拥有大量基础设施且市场高度集中。

paras.en: “customer” refers to a prosumer or an organization that uses our models, platform, or applications.
paras.zh: “客户”是指使用我们的模型、平台或应用程序的专业消费者或组织。

paras.en: “customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis,” “customers with $1 million or more of revenue on a TTM basis,” and “customers with $10 million or more of revenue on a TTM basis” each refer to customers contributing revenue equal to or greater than the applicable dollar amount during the trailing twelve-month (“TTM”) period ending on the measurement date. For purposes of this metric, we define a customer as a distinct organization, identified by aggregating the accounts that we determine belong to the same organization based on internal records and available data. We do not separately define or internally track a category of “enterprise” customers, and our customers are not segmented or measured internally by reference to whether a given customer is an “enterprise.” Because spending $100,000 or more on our products is generally characteristic of organizational rather than individual usage, we use the number of and revenue from customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis as our measure of enterprise adoption and engagement with Claude throughout this prospectus, including in references to “enterprise customers” and “enterprise adoption.”
paras.zh: “过去十二个月（TTM）收入达到或超过 $100,000 的客户”“过去十二个月（TTM）收入达到或超过 $1 million 的客户”以及“过去十二个月（TTM）收入达到或超过 $10 million 的客户”分别指在截至计量日的过去十二个月（“TTM”）期间贡献收入等于或高于相应金额的客户。就本指标而言，我们将客户定义为一个独立的组织，其识别方式为：根据内部记录和可用数据，将我们认定属于同一组织的账户进行汇总。我们并未单独定义或在内部追踪“企业”客户类别，我们的客户在内部也不以某一客户是否为“企业”为依据进行细分或计量。由于在我们的产品上支出 $100,000 或以上通常属于组织而非个人使用的特征，我们在本招股说明书通篇使用过去十二个月（TTM）收入达到或超过 $100,000 的客户数量及其收入，作为衡量企业采用 Claude 及参与度的指标，包括在提及“企业客户”和“企业采用”时。

paras.en: “frontier AI” refers to AI systems at the current leading edge of capability and safety, performing at or near the highest levels of any existing system across a broad range of tasks.
paras.zh: “前沿 AI”是指在能力与安全方面处于当前最前沿的 AI 系统，在广泛任务上达到或接近任何现有系统的最高水平。

paras.en: “hallucinations” refer to outputs in which an AI model generates factually incorrect or fabricated information with apparent confidence.
paras.zh: “幻觉”是指 AI 模型以看似确信的方式生成事实上不正确或捏造的信息的输出。

paras.en: “inference” refers to the process by which a trained AI model processes an input and generates an output. Inference occurs each time a user or agent interacts with an AI system.
paras.zh: “推理”是指经过训练的 AI 模型处理输入并生成输出的过程。每当用户或智能体与 AI 系统交互时，都会发生推理。

paras.en: “interleaved thinking” refers to a capability whereby an AI model interposes discrete reasoning steps between successive tool calls within a single response, rather than confining its reasoning to a single planning phase at the outset.
paras.zh: “交错思考”指一种能力，即 AI 模型在单次响应中于连续的工具调用之间插入离散的推理步骤，而非将推理局限于开头单一的规划阶段。

paras.en: “interpretability” refers to research into how and why AI models produce specific outputs, with the goal of making model behavior more transparent and verifiable, especially in high-stakes applications.
paras.zh: “可解释性”指研究 AI 模型如何以及为何产生特定输出的研究领域，目标是使模型行为更加透明和可验证，尤其是在高风险应用中。

paras.en: “knowledge work” refers to complex cognitive work and related professional activities, including obtaining, producing, analyzing, and communicating information through tasks such as coding, drafting analyses, synthesizing research, building financial models, and managing and automating documents and workflows.
paras.zh: “知识工作”指复杂的认知工作及相关专业活动，包括通过编码、撰写分析、综合研究、构建财务模型以及管理和自动化文档与工作流等任务来获取、生产、分析和传达信息。

paras.en: “LLMs” refer to large language models, or AI models trained primarily on large datasets to understand and generate natural language and computer code.
paras.zh: “LLM”指大语言模型，即主要基于大型数据集训练、用于理解和生成自然语言及计算机代码的 AI 模型。

paras.en: “mechanistic interpretability” refers to a subfield of interpretability research focused on reverse-engineering the internal computations of neural networks. Rather than inferring model behavior from inputs and outputs alone, mechanistic interpretability seeks to identify the specific features and circuits within a model that give rise to its behavior with the goal of making model reasoning auditable at the mechanism level and detecting failure modes, including deceptive or unsafe behavior, that may not surface in standard testing.
paras.zh: “机制可解释性”指可解释性研究中的一个子领域，专注于逆向工程神经网络的内部计算。机制可解释性并非仅从输入和输出推断模型行为，而是试图识别模型中产生该行为的特定特征和回路，目标是在机制层面使模型推理可审计，并检测可能在标准测试中不会显现的失效模式，包括欺骗性或不安全行为。

paras.en: “model weights” refer to the numerical parameters encoding a trained AI model’s behavior, which are the primary intellectual asset of a frontier AI developer, representing the accumulated investment in compute, data, and research.
paras.zh: “模型权重”指编码已训练 AI 模型行为的数值参数，是前沿 AI 开发者的主要知识产权资产，代表在算力、数据和研究方面累积的投资。

paras.en: “multi-agent orchestration” refers to an architecture in which multiple AI agents collaborate on a shared task, with one coordinating while others execute subtasks in parallel, enabling more complex, long-horizon work than a single agent can complete alone.
paras.zh: “多智能体编排”指一种架构，其中多个 AI 智能体在共享任务上协作，由一个智能体进行协调，其他智能体并行执行子任务，从而实现单个智能体无法独立完成的更复杂、更长周期的工作。

paras.en: “Net Revenue Retention” reflects customer expansion, contraction, and churn as of a measurement date. We calculate Net Revenue Retention by dividing the Qualified Customers’ Current Period revenue by their Base Period revenue. A Qualified Customer is a customer with at least $1 of revenue during the Base Period, excluding subscribers to our Claude Pro and Max plans, whose fixed-price subscriptions do not reflect the expansion and contraction behavior this metric is intended to capture. The Base Period is the three months ending a year prior to the measurement date. The Current Period is the three months ending as of the measurement date.
paras.zh: “净收入留存率”反映截至计量日的客户扩张、收缩和流失情况。我们通过将合格客户的当期收入除以其基期收入来计算净收入留存率。合格客户是指在基期内收入至少为 $1 的客户，不包括我们 Claude Pro 和 Max 计划的订阅用户，其固定价格订阅无法反映该指标旨在捕捉的扩张和收缩行为。基期为截至计量日一年前的三个月。当期指截至计量日的三个月。

paras.en: “open-weight” refers to an AI model whose trained model weights, or the numerical parameters encoding the model’s learned behavior, are publicly released, allowing third parties to download, run, and modify the model, subject to the terms of the model’s license, without necessarily providing access to the underlying training data or code.
paras.zh: “开放权重”指一种 AI 模型，其已训练的模型权重（即编码模型所学行为的数值参数）已公开发布，允许第三方在遵守模型许可条款的前提下下载、运行和修改该模型，而不一定提供对底层训练数据或代码的访问权限。

paras.en: “pay-for-intelligence” or “consumption” refers to our revenue model under which customers pay for their usage of our intelligence service, which is metered in tokens and priced according to the model selected.
paras.zh: “按智能付费”或“消费”指我们的收入模式，即客户为其对我们智能服务的使用付费，该使用以 token 计量，并根据所选模型定价。

paras.en: “persistent,” in the context of AI applications, refers to denoting data, state, or context that is continuously retained beyond the boundary of a single operation, session, or interaction, remaining accessible for reuse across subsequent steps, sessions, or workflows without requiring reinitialization.
paras.zh: “持久化”在 AI 应用语境下，指数据、状态或上下文在单次操作、会话或交互的边界之外被持续保留，无需重新初始化即可在后续步骤、会话或工作流中重复访问使用。

paras.en: “post-training” refers to the collection of techniques applied to a pre-trained model to refine its behavior, including reinforcement learning, supervised refinement methods, and other alignment methods. Post-training is the stage in which much of the work to make a frontier model helpful, accurate, and safe is performed, including the application of safety and alignment techniques.
paras.zh: “后训练”指对预训练模型施加的一系列技术手段的集合，用以优化其行为，包括强化学习、监督式精调方法及其他对齐方法。后训练是使前沿模型变得有用、准确和安全的大量工作所处的阶段，包括安全与对齐技术的应用。

paras.en: “pre-training” refers to the initial stage of training an AI model, in which the model learns general patterns and representations from large-scale datasets of text, code, and other data, typically by predicting the next token in a sequence. The output of pre-training is a base model with broad capabilities that has not yet been adapted for any specific deployment context.
paras.zh: “预训练”指训练 AI 模型的初始阶段，在该阶段模型从大规模文本、代码及其他数据集中学习通用模式与表征，通常通过预测序列中的下一个 token 实现。预训练的输出是一个具备广泛能力、但尚未针对任何特定部署场景进行适配的基础模型。

paras.en: “primitives” refer to the foundational, modular building blocks of a software system from which more complex applications and workflows are constructed.
paras.zh: “原语”指软件系统的基础性、模块化构建单元，更复杂的应用与工作流即由这些单元构建而成。

paras.en: “prompt injection” refers to an adversarial technique in which malicious instructions are embedded in content an AI model is asked to process, such as websites, documents, or tool outputs, with the aim of overriding or manipulating the model’s intended behavior, typically without the user’s knowledge.
paras.zh: “提示注入”指一种对抗性技术，即将恶意指令嵌入 AI 模型被要求处理的内容（如网站、文档或工具输出）之中，目的在于覆盖或操纵模型的预期行为，通常不为用户所知。

paras.en: “prosumers” refer to individual users who subscribe to AI tools to perform knowledge work.
paras.zh: “专业消费者”指订阅 AI 工具以从事知识工作的个人用户。

paras.en: “reinforcement learning” refers to a machine learning approach in which a model learns to perform a task by taking actions, receiving feedback signals called rewards, and adjusting its behavior to maximize the rewards it accrues over time. In contemporary AI development, reinforcement learning is widely used to refine model behavior after pre-training, including to improve helpfulness, accuracy, and adherence to safety guidelines.
paras.zh: “强化学习”指一种机器学习方法，模型通过采取行动、接收称为奖励的反馈信号并调整自身行为以最大化其随时间累积的奖励，从而学会执行某项任务。在当代 AI 开发中，强化学习被广泛用于在预训练之后优化模型行为，包括提升有用性、准确性以及对安全准则的遵循程度。

paras.en: “RLHF” refers to reinforcement learning from human feedback, a specific form of reinforcement learning in which human evaluators rate the model’s responses, and those ratings are used as the reward signal to guide training.
paras.zh: “RLHF”指基于人类反馈的强化学习，是强化学习的一种具体形式，由人类评估者对模型的回复进行评分，这些评分被用作引导训练的奖励信号。

paras.en: “Run-Rate Revenue” is an operating metric that refers to the estimated annualized value of our revenue-generating activity as of a measurement date, calculated as the sum of (i) our consumption-based fees during the trailing 28-day period ended on the measurement date, multiplied by 13, and (ii) our aggregate monthly subscription fees as of the measurement date, multiplied by 12. For purposes of calculating Run-Rate Revenue, consumption-based fees and subscription-based fees are derived from customer usage and active subscriptions.
paras.zh: “Run-Rate Revenue（年化运行收入）”是一项经营指标，指截至某一计量日我们创收活动的估计年化价值，计算方式为以下两项之和：(i) 截至该计量日的过去 28 天期间内我们基于用量的费用乘以 13，以及 (ii) 截至该计量日我们的月度订阅费用总额乘以 12。为计算 Run-Rate Revenue，基于用量的费用和基于订阅的费用均源自客户用量和活跃订阅。

paras.en: “SIs” refer to systems integrators, or third-party technology and professional services firms that design, build, and deploy integrated solutions for customers by combining products and services from multiple technology vendors into unified systems tailored to customer needs.
paras.zh: “SIs”指系统集成商，即第三方技术与专业服务公司，其通过将多个技术供应商的产品与服务整合为契合客户需求的统一系统，为客户设计、构建和部署集成解决方案。

paras.en: “tokens” refer to numeric units into which an AI model converts the data it processes, including text, images, audio, and video, the number of which varies by the model and tokenizer applied. Tokens are the smallest individual units of a language model and can correspond to words, subwords, characters, or bytes. A tokenizer is the component of a model that converts customer inputs into the sequence of tokens the model processes and then converts the processed tokens into the outputs provided to customers.
paras.zh: “token”指 AI 模型将其处理的数据（包括文本、图像、音频和视频）转换成的数值单元，其数量因所应用的模型和分词器而异。token 是语言模型的最小独立单元，可对应单词、子词、字符或字节。分词器是模型的组件，负责将客户输入转换为模型所处理的 token 序列，再将处理后的 token 转换为提供给客户的输出。

paras.en: This summary highlights selected information that is presented in greater detail elsewhere in this prospectus. This summary does not contain all of the information you should consider before investing in our Class A common stock. You should read this entire prospectus carefully, including the sections titled “Risk Factors,” “Special Note Regarding Forward-looking Statements,” “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” “Business,” and “Our Governance Structure and Its Goals,” as well as our consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this prospectus, before making an investment decision. Unless the context otherwise requires, the terms “Anthropic,” “the company,” “we,” “us,” and “our” in this prospectus refer to Anthropic, PBC and its consolidated subsidiaries, and references to our “common stock” refer to our Class A common stock, Class N common stock, and Class F common stock (and, where the context requires, our Class T common stock and our Class E common stock).
paras.zh: 本摘要重点介绍本招股说明书其他部分详细列示的部分信息。本摘要并不包含您在投资我们的 A 类普通股之前应考虑的全部信息。在作出投资决策之前，您应仔细阅读本招股说明书的全部内容，包括标题为“风险因素”“关于前瞻性陈述的特别说明”“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析”“业务”及“我们的治理结构及其目标”的章节，以及本招股说明书其他部分所载的我们的合并财务报表及相关附注。除上下文另有要求外，本招股说明书中的“Anthropic”“公司”“我们”及“我们的”均指 Anthropic, PBC 及其合并子公司，凡提及我们的“普通股”，均指我们的 A 类普通股、N 类普通股及 F 类普通股（并在上下文要求时，指我们的 T 类普通股及 E 类普通股）。

paras.en: For the first time in history, intelligence is something humans can build. The cognitive capability to reason, analyze, synthesize, decide, and create is producible at scale and accessible on demand. We believe this abundance of AI will rapidly transform every sector of the global economy in ways greater than the impact of industrialization, electricity, semiconductors, and the internet. AI that truly delivers on its potential—with the risks well managed—could significantly accelerate global growth and dramatically improve quality of life for people around the world.
paras.zh: 历史上第一次，智能成为人类可以构建的东西。推理、分析、综合、决策和创造的认知能力可以规模化生产并按需获取。我们相信，这种 AI 的充裕将迅速改变全球经济的每一个领域，其影响将超过工业化、电力、半导体和互联网。真正兑现其潜力、且风险得到妥善管理的 AI，可以显著加速全球增长，并大幅改善世界各地人们的生活质量。

paras.en: Anthropic was founded in 2021 by a team of researchers responsible for many of the breakthroughs that define AI. We are first and foremost a research lab—our mission is the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity. This mission directs our focus—along with our talent and culture, our frontier and safety research, our approach to compute, and our enterprise strategy, it is one of the core advantages that set us apart. These advantages enable us to continuously advance frontier AI and shape the standards for its safe and responsible development. Our frontier AI, Claude, is delivered to customers through our models, platform, and applications. Claude has experienced the fastest enterprise adoption of any technology in history, as demonstrated by revenue growing from $0 at commercial launch in the first quarter of 2023 to $ [__] for the three months ended September 30, 2026. This rapid and growing adoption generates two self-reinforcing dynamics—an improvement loop that advances Claude and an investment loop that helps fund our continued research in frontier AI.
paras.zh: Anthropic 成立于 2021 年，由一支曾主导众多定义 AI 的突破性成果的研究人员团队创立。我们首先是一家研究实验室——我们的使命是负责任地开发和维护先进 AI，以造福人类的长期利益。这一使命指引着我们的方向——连同我们的人才与文化、我们的前沿与安全研究、我们的算力策略以及我们的企业战略，它是使我们与众不同的核心优势之一。这些优势使我们能够持续推进前沿 AI，并塑造其安全、负责任开发的标准。我们的前沿 AI——Claude，通过我们的模型、平台和应用程序交付给客户。Claude 经历了历史上任何技术中最快的企业采用速度，其体现是收入从 2023 年第一季度商业发布时的 $0 增长至截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止三个月的 $ [__]。这种快速且不断增长的采用产生了两个自我强化的动态——推动 Claude 进步的改进闭环，以及帮助为我们持续开展前沿 AI 研究提供资金的投资闭环。

paras.en: #### Our Core Advantages
paras.zh: #### 我们的核心优势

paras.en: Mission & Focus. All of our efforts are guided by a singular focus on our mission. This focus enables us to concentrate talent, research, and compute investment on the highest-value work for humanity and to avoid conflicting priorities. Achieving our mission means the world gains the enormous benefits of frontier AI while mitigating the most significant risks, and we believe this requires safety and capability to advance together.
paras.zh: 使命与专注。我们的一切努力都由对使命的单一专注所指引。这种专注使我们能够将人才、研究和算力投资集中于对人类最具价值的工作，并避免相互冲突的优先事项。实现我们的使命意味着世界在获得前沿 AI 巨大益处的同时降低最重大的风险，我们认为这需要安全与能力齐头并进。

paras.en: Talent & Culture. Our mission and focus enable us to attract and retain world-class talent, including researchers and engineers who want their work to shape a better future. We also have a culture that promotes a low-ego, truth-seeking environment, where frontier AI capability and safety are mutually reinforcing. We believe our culture has driven our talent density as we have scaled.
paras.zh: 人才与文化。我们的使命与专注使我们能够吸引并留住世界级人才，包括希望以工作塑造更美好未来的研究人员和工程师。我们还拥有一种倡导低调、求真环境的文化，在其中前沿 AI 能力与安全相互强化。我们相信，随着我们的规模扩张，我们的文化推动了人才密度的提升。

paras.en: Frontier & Safety Research. We believe that sustained, focused research at the frontier of intelligence is required to build the most capable and safest AI systems. Our frontier capabilities and safety research are deeply integrated and directly shape model design, training, and deployment, helping us produce systems that are more reliable, steerable, and well-suited for real-world deployment, particularly in demanding enterprise environments. We translate our research leadership into innovation velocity, and have consistently released better models, platform capabilities, and applications. Each version of a Claude model assists in building the next, helping to compress development timelines and produce compounding improvements in the speed at which we innovate. We refer to this recursive dynamic as “closing the loop,” and we believe it is one of the most significant structural advantages in frontier AI.
paras.zh: 前沿与安全研究。我们认为，要在智能前沿开展持续、专注的研究，才能构建能力最强且最安全的 AI 系统。我们的前沿能力研究与安全研究深度整合，并直接塑造模型设计、训练与部署，帮助我们打造更可靠、更可控、更适合真实世界部署的系统，尤其是在要求严苛的企业环境中。我们将研究领先优势转化为创新速度，并持续发布更优的模型、平台能力与应用。每一代 Claude 模型都助力构建下一代模型，帮助压缩开发周期，并在我们的创新速度上产生复利式改进。我们将这一递归动态称为“闭环”，并认为它是前沿 AI 领域最重要的结构性优势之一。

paras.en: Our Approach to Compute. We manage compute as a single, fungible pool from multiple strategic partners, and we dynamically direct available compute between workloads based on where the marginal unit is expected to be most productive at any given time. We believe that this approach to compute enables us to deliver superior models, serve more customers, and achieve greater productivity from our compute investment. This compute efficiency creates the foundation for us to advance the frontier of AI capabilities through research and model development, meet growing demand from customers, and provide for internal usage of Claude. We have achieved this through our research breakthroughs and our multi-chip compute architecture across AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, and AMD GPUs, enabling us to orchestrate workloads to optimize for price and performance. To support our research, model development, customer demand, and internal usage of Claude, we continue to invest at scale. As of and subsequent to September 30, 2026, we have entered into purchase commitments and lease agreements, including short-term commitments, as well as leases not yet commenced, with an aggregate committed spend of more than $ [__] , substantially all of which is related to compute and infrastructure. These commitments include approximately $ [__] expected to be incurred before December 31, 2030, and substantially all of the remainder is expected to be incurred between 2031 and 2045. Approximately $ [__] of these commitments are due in the next 12 months. See the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Liquidity and Capital Resources—Contractual Obligations” for more information.
paras.zh: 我们的算力策略。我们将来自多个战略合作伙伴的算力作为单一、可互换的资源池进行管理，并根据任一给定时刻边际单位算力预计在何处产出最高，在工作负载之间动态调配可用算力。我们认为，这一算力策略使我们能够交付更优的模型、服务更多客户，并从算力投资中获得更高生产率。这种算力效率为我们奠定基础，使我们能够通过研究与模型开发推进 AI 能力前沿、满足客户不断增长的需求，并为 Claude 的内部使用提供支持。我们通过研究突破以及跨 AWS Trainium、Google TPU、NVIDIA GPU 和 AMD GPU 的多芯片算力架构实现了这一点，使我们能够编排工作负载以优化价格与性能。为支持我们的研究、模型开发、客户需求以及 Claude 的内部使用，我们持续进行大规模投资。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日及之后，我们已签订采购承诺和租赁协议，包括短期承诺以及尚未开始的租赁，合计承诺支出超过 $ [__]，其中绝大部分与算力和基础设施相关。这些承诺包括预计在 2030 年 12 月 31 日之前发生的约 $ [__]，其余绝大部分预计将在 2031 年至 2045 年之间发生。这些承诺中约 $ [__] 将在未来 12 个月内到期。更多信息请参见“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析—流动性与资本资源—合同义务”一节。

paras.en: Enterprise Strategy. Our enterprise strategy is built on the belief that frontier AI is most valuable in real-world settings, as deployment across enterprises is where economic impact is greatest and where the improvement loops from customer feedback are richest. Accordingly, we have organized our research priorities, our product roadmap, and our go-to-market and Applied AI teams around enterprise use cases, which range from routine knowledge work to the most complex problems. The customer feedback we gather directs our research focus and makes Claude more capable over time. This broadens where Claude can be deployed and further expands enterprise adoption, which helps ensure that the benefits of our AI reach people and organizations at scale.
paras.zh: 企业战略。我们的企业战略建立在这样一种信念之上：前沿 AI 在真实场景中最具价值，因为企业级部署是经济影响最大之处，也是客户反馈带来的改进闭环最丰富之处。因此，我们围绕企业用例来组织研究优先级、产品路线图以及市场推广与应用 AI 团队，这些用例涵盖从日常知识工作到最复杂的问题。我们收集的客户反馈指引我们的研究重点，并使 Claude 随时间推移能力更强。这拓宽了 Claude 可部署的范围，并进一步扩大企业采用，有助于确保我们 AI 的益处惠及大规模的人群和组织。

paras.en: #### AI is Transforming Intelligence
paras.zh: #### AI 正在变革智能

paras.en: We believe that Powerful AI, a highly capable and impactful form of frontier AI characterized by the following key attributes, will become widely available within a few years:
paras.zh: 我们相信，强大 AI——一种具有以下关键特征的高度强大且影响深远的前沿 AI 形式——将在几年内广泛可用：

paras.en: - cognitive capabilities matching or exceeding those of top human experts across most professional and scientific disciplines;
paras.zh: - 认知能力在大多数专业和科学学科上达到或超过顶尖人类专家；

paras.en: - the ability to navigate all interfaces available to a human working virtually, including text, audio, video, and direct computer control;
paras.zh: - 能够操作人类在虚拟工作中可用的所有界面，包括文本、音频、视频和直接计算机控制；

paras.en: - the ability to reason through complex tasks autonomously over extended periods—lasting hours, days, or weeks—and seek clarification and feedback when needed;
paras.zh: - 能够在较长时间内（持续数小时、数天或数周）自主推理复杂任务，并在需要时寻求澄清和反馈；

paras.en: - the ability to coordinate across multiple instances and collaborate with both humans and other AI systems; and
paras.zh: - 能够跨多个实例协调，并与人类及其他 AI 系统协作；以及

paras.en: - the ability to interface with the physical world by digitally controlling laboratory equipment, robotic systems, and other machines through digital connections.
paras.zh: - 能够通过数字连接以数字化方式控制实验室设备、机器人系统和其他机器，从而与物理世界交互。

paras.en: If Powerful AI is directed at solving humanity’s hardest problems and the risks are managed responsibly, the potential is extraordinary. The possibilities include compressing decades of scientific progress into years; accelerating drug discovery, disease detection, and the delivery of personalized therapy; providing individually tailored education and expert financial and legal advice; advancing power grids and battery design for greater efficiency and reliability; and extending to the developing world capabilities that took wealthy nations generations to build.
paras.zh: 如果强大 AI 被用于解决人类最艰难的问题，且风险得到负责任的管理，其潜力将是非凡的。这些可能性包括：将数十年的科学进步压缩到数年；加速药物发现、疾病检测和个性化治疗的交付；提供个性化定制的教育以及专业的财务和法律建议；推进电网和电池设计以实现更高的效率和可靠性；并将富裕国家历经数代才建立起来的能力扩展到发展中国家。

paras.en: #### A Near-Term Opportunity to Transform Cognitive Work
paras.zh: #### 变革认知工作的近期机遇

paras.en: Frontier AI is transforming cognitive work—the application of knowledge, reasoning, and judgment to produce economic value. We believe it will make humans far more capable and expand the world’s overall capacity for that work, including accelerating scientific discovery and helping businesses grow. Knowledge workers are the leading edge of this opportunity. As frontier AI advances, more capable models can unlock entirely new use cases while also efficiently serving a wide range of cognitive work at scale across the capability-cost-speed curve. We believe the work that knowledge workers perform represented more than $40 trillion in economic value globally in 2025, [__] 1 and with frontier AI’s potential to make them meaningfully more productive, our near-term opportunity is to expand this value and accelerate economic growth. While it is still early to forecast frontier AI’s full impact across the economy, International Data Corporation (“IDC”) estimates that investment in AI solutions and services will yield a cumulative global economic impact of $22.5 trillion by 2031. [__] 2 We believe the impact could be even greater.
paras.zh: 前沿 AI 正在改变认知型工作——即运用知识、推理和判断来创造经济价值。我们相信，它将使人类的能力大幅提升，并扩大全球从事此类工作的整体能力，包括加速科学发现、助力企业成长。知识工作者是这一机遇的最前沿。随着前沿 AI 不断进步，能力更强的模型可以开辟全新的应用场景，同时沿着能力—成本—速度曲线，高效地大规模服务于广泛的认知型工作。我们相信，2025 年知识工作者所从事的工作在全球范围内代表了超过 $40 trillion 的经济价值，[__] 1 而凭借前沿 AI 让他们显著提高生产率的潜力，我们的近期机遇就是扩大这一价值并加速经济增长。尽管现在预测前沿 AI 对整个经济的全面影响还为时过早，但 International Data Corporation（简称“IDC”）估计，到 2031 年，对 AI 解决方案和服务的投资将带来累计 $22.5 trillion 的全球经济影响。[__] 2 我们相信实际影响可能更大。

paras.en: 1 See the section titled “Industry, Market, and Other Data” for a description of how we calculate annual economic value attributable to knowledge workers globally.
paras.zh: 1 有关我们如何计算全球知识工作者所对应的年度经济价值的说明，请参见标题为“行业、市场及其他数据”的章节。

paras.en: 2 IDC, The Economic Impact of AI: 2026 Edition, doc # US54452226, April 2026. Reflects the annual value created across AI solutions and services, investments in the AI infrastructure supply chain, and enhancements in enterprise productivity and efficiency unlocked by AI.
paras.zh: 2 IDC，《AI 的经济影响：2026 年版》，文档编号 US54452226,2026 年 4 月。反映 AI 解决方案与服务、AI 基础设施供应链投资，以及 AI 释放的企业生产力与效率提升所创造的年度价值。

paras.en: 3 IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science, Global Medicine Use Trends 2026, February 2026.
paras.zh: 3 IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science，《2026 年全球药品使用趋势》，2026 年 2 月。

paras.en: #### Frontier AI May Reshape Entire Sectors and Accelerate Novel Discoveries
paras.zh: #### 前沿 AI 可能重塑整个行业并加速全新发现

paras.en: We believe frontier AI represents a larger opportunity than any prior technology cycle, and Claude is already demonstrating this potential. Claude can now execute complex projects autonomously and turn open-ended tasks into finished, high-quality deliverables. These capabilities enable it to transform the largest sectors of the economy, driving meaningful gains in productivity and output. Frontier AI’s capabilities may extend beyond current markets to open entirely new ones, reaching domains such as robotics, advanced manufacturing, and logistics, and accelerating progress in scientific research, including drug discovery and materials science. For example, in the life sciences sector, where annual global pharmaceutical spend is expected to exceed $2 trillion in 2026,3 Claude is used in drug discovery and development by our customers, our biotechnology partners, and our own researchers. We are also extending Claude into robotics, where our Model Hardware Standard enables AI agents to operate lab and manufacturing equipment such as microscopes, liquid handlers, and off-the-shelf robotic arms. Ultimately, we believe frontier AI will help drive global economic growth. As frontier AI makes workers and organizations more productive, becomes embedded in the products and services they deliver, and unlocks new business models, it creates economic output that did not previously exist. We believe our opportunity is to capture a share not only of today’s economic activity but also of that newly created output as the global economy expands.
paras.zh: 我们相信，前沿 AI 所代表的机会比以往任何技术周期都更大，而 Claude 已经展现出这一潜力。Claude 如今能够自主执行复杂项目，并将开放式任务转化为完成的高质量交付成果。这些能力使其能够变革经济中规模最大的行业，推动生产率和产出实现有意义的提升。前沿 AI 的能力可能超越当前市场，开辟全新的市场，触及机器人、先进制造和物流等领域，并加速科学研究进展，包括药物发现和材料科学。例如，在生命科学领域，预计 2026 年全球年度药品支出将超过 $2 trillion,3 我们的客户、我们的生物技术合作伙伴以及我们自己的研究人员都在药物发现和开发中使用 Claude。我们还在将 Claude 扩展到机器人领域，我们的模型硬件标准（Model Hardware Standard）使 AI 智能体能够操作实验室和制造设备，例如显微镜、液体处理仪和现成的机械臂。最终，我们相信前沿 AI 将有助于推动全球经济增长。随着前沿 AI 使劳动者和组织更具生产力、融入其所交付的产品和服务，并解锁新的商业模式，它创造出此前并不存在的经济产出。我们相信，我们的机会不仅在于获取当今经济活动的一部分，还在于随着全球经济扩张，获取新创造产出的一部分。

paras.en: #### The Importance of Safety and Ethical Behavior
paras.zh: #### 安全与道德行为的重要性

paras.en: While the potential benefits of AI are extraordinary, its rapid advancement will impact the economy and society in ways that could create significant disruption, particularly if the technology is not developed and deployed responsibly. For example, bad actors have already conducted high-profile cyberattacks using AI’s capabilities to discover vulnerabilities, generate malware, and evade detection tools; other risks associated with misuse, including in the domain of biology, could result in even greater harm. AI deployed at scale also has the potential to concentrate power and wealth both within and between countries in ways that could erode trust, harm society, and destabilize the geopolitical order. Misaligned AI systems could corrupt institutional decision-making or cause large-scale harm through autonomous actions that are not visible or understandable to their users and operators. We believe that frontier AI companies must invest in safety and alignment to help ensure the responsible diffusion of this technology. We also believe that safety, alignment, and ethical behavior resonate particularly strongly with enterprises, where rigorous safeguards, predictable model behavior, and demonstrable accountability have become decisive criteria in selecting an AI partner for mission-critical workloads.
paras.zh: 尽管 AI 的潜在益处非同寻常，但其快速发展将以可能造成重大颠覆的方式影响经济和社会，尤其是在该技术未以负责任的方式开发和部署的情况下。例如，恶意行为者已经利用 AI 的能力实施高调的网络安全攻击，发现漏洞、生成恶意软件并规避检测工具；与滥用相关的其他风险，包括在生物学领域，可能造成更大的危害。大规模部署的 AI 还可能以可能侵蚀信任、损害社会并破坏地缘政治秩序的方式，在国家内部和国家之间集中权力和财富。未对齐的 AI 系统可能腐蚀机构决策，或通过其用户和运营者不可见或不理解的自主行动造成大规模危害。我们相信，前沿 AI 公司必须投资于安全和对齐，以帮助确保该技术的负责任传播。我们还相信，安全、对齐和道德行为对企业尤其具有强烈共鸣，在这些企业中，严格的保障措施、可预测的模型行为和可证明的问责制已成为选择 AI 合作伙伴处理关键任务工作负载的决定性标准。

paras.en: #### Claude as a Virtual Collaborator
paras.zh: #### Claude 作为虚拟协作者

paras.en: We believe we have reached an inflection point where AI systems can function as genuine collaborators in professional work. They quickly complete substantive tasks that might otherwise occupy a skilled professional for several hours, a full day, or longer. AI systems are also becoming increasingly capable of performing tasks that were previously too difficult or costly to complete or surfacing original insights and analyses. We refer to these AI systems that work alongside humans to perform complex, multi-step work at professional levels as Virtual Collaborators. Virtual Collaborators carry the access rights, system connections, and context that their organizations grant them, which allows them to function more accurately and reliably. They can navigate and use internal tools and execute workflows that span multiple steps that require sustained reasoning. Virtual Collaborators are AI designed to be embedded where work gets done, and our aim is to continue extending them to knowledge workers globally, a population that is estimated to exceed one billion in 2028. [__] 4
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们已经到达一个拐点：AI 系统能够在专业工作中充当真正的协作者。它们能迅速完成原本可能占用一名熟练专业人员数小时、一整天甚至更长时间的实质性任务。AI 系统也日益能够执行此前过于困难或成本过高而无法完成的任务，或揭示原创性的洞见与分析。我们将这些与人类并肩工作、以专业水准完成复杂多步骤工作的 AI 系统称为虚拟协作者。虚拟协作者拥有其组织授予的访问权限、系统连接和上下文，这使其能够更准确、更可靠地运作。它们能够导航并使用内部工具，执行需要持续推理的多步骤工作流。虚拟协作者是旨在嵌入工作实际发生之处的 AI，我们的目标是继续将其扩展至全球知识工作者，这一群体预计在 2028 年将超过十亿。[__] 4

paras.en: 4 IDC, Worldwide Developer Population Growth Forecast, 2025–2029, doc # US53789825, September 2025.
paras.zh: 4 IDC，《全球开发者人口增长预测，2025–2029》，文档编号 # US53789825，2025 年 9 月。

paras.en: Claude Code. The clearest manifestation of Virtual Collaborators today is Claude Code, our coding agent and the product we believe has most concretely defined what autonomous AI work looks like. Claude Code shifted the market’s understanding of what an AI system could do in collaboration with software developers: the model suggests the next line of code and goes further by planning, writing, testing, and debugging—a process that results in production-grade code. Within months of its release, autonomous coding became the reference point for measuring the progress of frontier AI. For enterprise AI use cases, we believe the launch of Claude Code was comparable in its impact to the introduction of the first widely adopted conversational AI assistants. What makes Claude Code a Virtual Collaborator is its sustained reasoning, a harness that translates intent into actions, an execution environment that maintains a persistent state whether on a developer’s machine or in a sandboxed cloud environment, integration with existing tools and systems, and a user-friendly interface. Its uses are highly varied and often surprising: for example, NASA engineers used Claude Code to plan and write navigation commands for the Mars Perseverance rover, resulting in the first AI-planned drive on Mars.
paras.zh: Claude Code。如今虚拟协作者最清晰的体现是 Claude Code，这是我们的编程智能体，也是我们认为最具体地定义了自主 AI 工作形态的产品。Claude Code 改变了市场对 AI 系统在与软件开发者协作中能做什么的理解：模型会建议下一行代码，并更进一步进行规划、编写、测试和调试——这一过程最终产出生产级代码。在其发布后的数月内，自主编程成为衡量前沿 AI 进展的参照基准。对于企业 AI 用例，我们认为 Claude Code 的发布其影响堪比首个被广泛采用的对话式 AI 助手的推出。使 Claude Code 成为虚拟协作者的是其持续推理能力、将意图转化为行动的运行框架、无论在开发者机器上还是在沙盒云环境中都能保持持久状态的执行环境、与现有工具和系统的集成，以及用户友好的界面。其用途高度多样且常常出人意料：例如，NASA 工程师使用 Claude Code 为火星毅力号漫游车规划并编写导航指令，实现了火星上首次由 AI 规划的行驶。

paras.en: Software developers are powerful advocates for Claude—they understand how systems work, have credibility evaluating technical tools, and often serve as internal champions for adopting new technologies. Winning their trust creates a foundation for broader diffusion of Virtual Collaborators across enterprise workforces. We are already seeing this pattern play out with non-technical teams increasingly adopting Claude Code and Claude Cowork to manage their own workflows.
paras.zh: 软件开发者是 Claude 的有力倡导者——他们理解系统如何运作，在评估技术工具方面具有公信力，并且常常成为采用新技术的内部推动者。赢得他们的信任，为虚拟协作者在企业员工队伍中的更广泛扩散奠定了基础。我们已经看到这一模式正在显现：非技术团队越来越多地采用 Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 来管理自身的工作流。

paras.en: Claude Cowork. All digital work is ultimately an expression of code, and Claude’s mastery of it powers Virtual Collaborators capable of handling complex work far beyond software development. Claude Cowork extends the same agentic architecture of Claude Code to knowledge workers broadly by translating a user’s intent into completed work, autonomously reading files, navigating applications, and executing multi-step workflows on a user’s desktop while the underlying code is abstracted away. By extending beyond Claude Code with applications purpose-built for specific professions and industry verticals, we accelerate Claude’s diffusion into new categories of knowledge work and deepen our presence across the enterprise. As of September 30, 2026, adoption of Claude Cowork, which we made available as a research preview in January 2026, outpaced the adoption Claude Code achieved at the equivalent point following its research preview release in February 2025. In September 2026, we began merging Claude Cowork and Claude.ai, bringing agentic and conversational work into a unified application. Users can now move from a simple question to complex, multi-step tasks in the same conversation.
paras.zh: Claude Cowork。所有数字化工作归根结底都是代码的一种表达，而 Claude 对代码的精通，使虚拟协作者能够处理远超软件开发范畴的复杂工作。Claude Cowork 将 Claude Code 相同的智能体架构延伸至广大知识工作者，把用户的意图转化为已完成的工作，在用户桌面上自主读取文件、操作应用程序并执行多步骤工作流，而底层代码则被抽象隐藏。通过以专为特定职业和行业垂直领域打造的应用超越 Claude Code，我们加速 Claude 向新类别知识工作的扩散，并加深我们在企业中的渗透。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，Claude Cowork（我们于 2026 年 1 月以研究预览形式推出）的采用速度超过了 Claude Code 在其 2025 年 2 月研究预览发布后同等时点所达到的采用速度。2026 年 9 月，我们开始将 Claude Cowork 与 Claude.ai 合并，把智能体工作与对话式工作整合到统一应用中。用户现在可以在同一段对话中，从简单的问题过渡到复杂的多步骤任务。

paras.en: Extending Virtual Collaborators. We believe the trajectory for Virtual Collaborators is clear and accelerating. Each generation of Claude models has expanded along multiple dimensions: the depth and rigor of their reasoning, the duration and autonomy of the work they can sustain, the complexity of tasks they can complete, and the volume of useful output they can produce. Capability evaluations and benchmarking have shown substantial improvements across Claude model versions in the duration and complexity of tasks that can be completed reliably, with more recent model versions demonstrating particularly significant advances.
paras.zh: 扩展虚拟协作者。我们相信虚拟协作者的发展轨迹清晰且正在加速。每一代 Claude 模型都在多个维度上有所拓展：推理的深度与严谨性、所能持续工作的时长与自主性、所能完成任务的复杂度，以及所能产出的有用输出量。能力评估与基准测试显示，各版本 Claude 模型在可可靠完成任务的时长与复杂度方面均有大幅提升，较新的模型版本尤其展现出显著进步。

paras.en: We are building towards a world where Claude can be given open-ended tasks lasting hours, days, or weeks, and then execute them autonomously with the judgment and initiative of a brilliant colleague. Ultimately, million s of Virtual Collaborators can run in parallel, each working independently on unrelated problems or collaborating seamlessly to achieve a shared objective. The result is something without historical precedent: what we refer to as a country of geniuses in a data center, available to every organization and sector of the economy.
paras.zh: 我们正朝着这样一个世界构建：Claude 可以被赋予持续数小时、数天乃至数周的开放式任务，然后以一位才华横溢的同事所具备的判断力和主动性自主执行这些任务。最终，数以百万计的虚拟协作者可以并行运行，各自独立处理互不相关的问题，或无缝协作以实现共同目标。其结果是史无前例的：我们称之为数据中心里的天才之国，可供每一个组织和经济的每一个部门使用。

paras.en: #### Enterprise Adoption of Claude
paras.zh: #### Claude 的企业采用情况

paras.en: The speed and depth of our enterprise customer adoption are powerful evidence of Claude’s position at the frontier of AI. Our customer base as of September 30, 2026 includes:
paras.zh: 我们企业客户采用的速度和深度，有力证明了 Claude 处于 AI 前沿的地位。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们的客户群包括：

paras.en: - More than 11,900 customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis;
paras.zh: - 超过 11,900 家客户在过去十二个月（TTM）基础上的收入达到 $100,000 或以上；

paras.en: - More than 1,900 customers with $1 million or more of revenue on a TTM basis; and
paras.zh: - 超过 1,900 家客户在过去十二个月（TTM）基础上的收入达到 $1 million 或以上；以及

paras.en: - Approximately 250 customers with $10 million or more of revenue on a TTM basis.
paras.zh: - 约 250 家客户在过去十二个月（TTM）基础上的收入达到 $10 million 或以上。

paras.en: We believe customers choose Claude for a wide variety of use cases, from routine knowledge work to their most important problems. They come to us for access to frontier AI across our platform and applications that deliver real-world outcomes. We see this conviction in customer behavior: enterprises consistently utilize our latest and most capable models as soon as they are released, gravitating to the most advanced option for their highest-value work. Our customers see us as a long-term partner for the frontier capabilities we offer today, for the innovation they expect from us in the future, and for our ability to meet their needs across the capability-cost-speed curve.
paras.zh: 我们相信，客户选择 Claude 是出于广泛多样的用例，从日常知识工作到他们最重要的问题。他们来到我们这里，是为了通过我们的平台和应用获取前沿 AI，从而交付真实世界的成果。我们从客户行为中看到了这种信念：企业一旦我们发布最新、最强大的模型，就会持续采用，为他们最高价值的工作倾向于选择最先进的选项。我们的客户将我们视为长期合作伙伴，因为我们今天提供的前沿能力、他们期望我们未来带来的创新，以及我们在能力—成本—速度曲线上满足其需求的能力。

paras.en: Beyond our models, the Claude Platform provides primitives that enable customers to accelerate time-to-value and leverage Claude’s intelligence in a variety of use cases. These primitives are the same ones we use to build our own applications. Our applications, such as Claude Code and Claude Cowork, multiply the impact of employees. Over time, our applications have become more capable and are now frequently being used to conduct long-running autonomous work alongside employees. Improvements to our models, platform, and applications accrue to the benefit of our customers and drive continued adoption.
paras.zh: 在我们的模型之外，Claude Platform 还提供基础构件，使客户能够加速实现价值的时间，并在各种用例中利用 Claude 的智能。这些基础构件与我们构建自身应用所用的构件相同。我们的应用，例如 Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork，放大了员工的影响力。随着时间的推移，我们的应用变得更加强大，如今经常被用于与员工并肩执行长时间运行的自主工作。我们的模型、平台和应用的改进惠及我们的客户，并推动持续采用。

paras.en: Our commitment to our mission instills confidence in our customers to choose Claude as a trusted partner. Our investments in research on AI alignment, interpretability, cybersecurity, and enterprise-grade controls aim to deliver the predictability and dependability that organizations need in customer-facing and regulated contexts. This trust means that enterprises can expand the scope of the work that they delegate to Claude, as well as the systems into which Claude is integrated. Enterprises are aligning their strategies around Claude with the confidence that we are building frontier AI that serves their needs in the long term.
paras.zh: 我们对使命的承诺让客户有信心选择 Claude 作为可信赖的合作伙伴。我们在 AI 对齐、可解释性、网络安全和企业级控制方面的研究投入，旨在提供组织在面向客户和受监管场景中所需要的可预测性和可靠性。这种信任意味着企业可以扩大委托给 Claude 的工作范围，以及将 Claude 集成到的系统范围。企业正围绕 Claude 调整其战略，并确信我们正在构建长期满足其需求的前沿 AI。

paras.en: Today, enterprises rely on Claude to reason, plan, and execute across complex workflows with a level of trustworthiness and judgment that we believe was not previously available from earlier generations of AI. Customers realize value from Claude in three primary ways: more productive employees, faster processes, and embedded intelligence in their products. As Claude’s capabilities grow, our customers benefit and often broaden their adoption of Claude in new workflows. This expanding role reflects a broader shift in how Claude is used inside the enterprise, from a tool that responds to discrete prompts to a Virtual Collaborator.
paras.zh: 如今，企业依赖 Claude 以一定程度的可信度和判断力在复杂工作流中进行推理、规划和执行，我们认为这是早期几代 AI 所不具备的。客户主要通过三种方式从 Claude 获得价值：更高生产力的员工、更快的流程，以及嵌入其产品中的智能。随着 Claude 能力的增长，我们的客户受益，并往往在新工作流中扩大对 Claude 的采用。这种不断扩大的角色反映了 Claude 在企业内部使用方式的更广泛转变，从响应离散提示的工具转变为虚拟协作者。

paras.en: We drive the diffusion of Claude primarily by making it accessible across multiple product surfaces. For example:
paras.zh: 我们主要通过让 Claude 在多个产品界面上可访问来推动其普及。例如：

paras.en: - Claude Platform, our comprehensive agentic development environment, provides customers with direct access to the primitives to build, deploy, and scale their own applications that leverage Claude’s capabilities within their own products and workflows.
paras.zh: - Claude Platform，我们全面的智能体开发环境，为客户提供对基础构件的直接访问，以构建、部署和扩展他们自己的应用，在其自身产品和工作流中利用 Claude 的能力。

paras.en: - Claude Code, our coding agent, works alongside human software developers on end-to-end software development: writing, planning, editing, testing, debugging, and committing code across production-scale codebases.
paras.zh: - Claude Code，我们的编码智能体，与人类软件开发人员并肩进行端到端软件开发：在生产规模代码库中编写、规划、编辑、测试、调试和提交代码。

paras.en: - Claude Cowork, our knowledge work agent, has computer use capability that enables it to work with professionals on end-to-end business tasks: autonomously researching, drafting, analyzing, synthesizing, and executing other knowledge work.
paras.zh: - Claude Cowork 是我们的知识工作智能体，具备计算机使用能力，使其能够与专业人士协作完成端到端的业务任务：自主研究、起草、分析、综合以及执行其他知识工作。

paras.en: Much of the diffusion of Claude has been organic. We amplify this with our go-to-market and Applied AI teams, which extend our reach by meeting customers where they are through distribution partnerships that place Claude inside customers’ existing technology stacks. For example, Claude is accessible on all three major cloud platforms—Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), Google Cloud Platform (“GCP”), and Microsoft Azure (“Azure”). We have a joint go-to-market approach with these CSPs through which we establish direct contractual relationships with our customers while paying a fee to each CSP. This structure allows us to foster stronger commercial alignment with these CSPs, avoid channel conflict, set pricing, and realize the financial benefits of ongoing compute efficiency improvements. Ecosystem partnerships also expand our reach, allowing customers to adopt Claude through SIs, such as Accenture, Deloitte, KPMG, and PwC, consultants, and data platforms, such as Salesforce and Snowflake [__] . [__] We recently launched an AI services company, Ode with Anthropic, in partnership with leading private equity firms to bring Claude’s capabilities to mid-sized companies across sectors, building solutions on the Claude Platform and supporting customers over the long term.
paras.zh: Claude 的普及在很大程度上是有机发生的。我们通过市场推广团队和应用 AI 团队来放大这一效应，这些团队通过分销合作伙伴关系将 Claude 嵌入客户现有的技术栈中，从而在客户所在之处与其接触，扩大我们的覆盖范围。例如，Claude 可在三大主要云平台上使用——Amazon Web Services（“AWS”）、Google Cloud Platform（“GCP”）和 Microsoft Azure（“Azure”）。我们与这些云服务商（CSP）采取联合市场推广方式，通过该方式与客户建立直接的合同关系，同时向各 CSP 支付费用。这一结构使我们能够与这些 CSP 建立更强的商业一致性，避免渠道冲突，设定定价，并实现算力效率持续提升所带来的财务收益。生态系统合作伙伴关系也扩大了我们的覆盖范围，使客户能够通过系统集成商（SI），如 Accenture、Deloitte、KPMG 和 PwC，以及顾问和数据平台，如 Salesforce 和 Snowflake [__]，采用 Claude。[__] 我们近期与领先的私募股权公司合作，推出了一家 AI 服务公司 Ode with Anthropic，旨在将 Claude 的能力带给各行业的中型企业，在 Claude Platform 上构建解决方案，并为客户提供长期支持。

paras.en: #### Strengths of Our Financial Model
paras.zh: #### 我们财务模式的优势

paras.en: Building and scaling frontier AI is one of the most important and capital-intensive endeavors in history. Our financial model provides us with the following strengths that allow us to build and scale efficiently:
paras.zh: 构建和扩展前沿 AI 是历史上最重要、资本最密集的事业之一。我们的财务模式为我们提供了以下优势，使我们能够高效地构建和扩展：

paras.en: - Rapid Revenue Growth. Our enterprise strategy is designed to drive durable customer adoption by embedding Claude directly into business-critical workflows and enabling the development of products built on Claude. We believe that enterprise customers achieve a compelling return on investment from Claude, as agentic workflows can drive both top-line growth and efficiency. This enables us to expand quickly with customers, as demonstrated by our Net Revenue Retention of approximately 900% as of September 30, 2026. Diffusion also accelerates as our models become more capable and efficient, allowing us to lower the cost per task for customers. For example, Claude Opus 5.5 reduced customer costs per task by approximately 40% compared to Claude Opus 5. Lower costs per task drive greater usage, which in turn drives broader diffusion of Claude. Our compute efficiency allows us to deliver these reductions while preserving our margins.
paras.zh: - 收入快速增长。我们的企业战略旨在通过将 Claude 直接嵌入业务关键型工作流程，并支持基于 Claude 构建产品的开发，来推动持久的客户采用。我们相信，企业客户从 Claude 获得了可观的投资回报，因为智能体工作流程既能推动收入增长，又能提升效率。这使我们能够快速扩大客户规模，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们的净收入留存率约为 900%，即为明证。随着我们的模型能力更强、效率更高，普及也会加速，使我们能够降低客户的每任务成本。例如，与 Claude Opus 5 相比，Claude Opus 5.5 将客户的每任务成本降低了约 40%。更低的每任务成本推动更多使用，进而推动 Claude 更广泛的普及。我们的算力效率使我们能够在保持利润率的同时实现这些成本降低。

paras.en: - Compute Efficiency. Our compute efficiency drives more intelligence from research and model development, and we believe this approach can support more customer and internal usage of Claude for the same amount of compute compared to other approaches. Our compute efficiency is demonstrated by revenue that grew [__] 1,368% year over year for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to compute and infrastructure expenses that grew [__] 300% during the same period.
paras.zh: - 算力效率。我们的算力效率使研究和模型开发产生更多智能，我们相信，与其他方法相比，在相同算力下，这一方法能够支持更多客户和内部对 Claude 的使用。我们的算力效率体现在：截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三个月，收入同比增长 [__] 1,368%，而同期算力和基础设施费用增长 [__] 300%。

paras.en: - Operating Efficiency. Our operating efficiency, derived from our high talent density, our efficient go-to-market, and how extensively our teams leverage Claude in their work, enables us to scale with a smaller team relative to other large enterprise technology companies. Our operating efficiency is demonstrated by TTM revenue per employee of over $6.6 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to $1.4 million as of September 30, 2025.
paras.zh: - 运营效率。我们的运营效率源自我们的人才密度、高效的市场推广方式，以及我们的团队在工作中广泛使用 Claude 的程度，这使我们能够以相对于其他大型企业科技公司更小的团队实现规模化。我们的运营效率体现为：截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，过去十二个月（TTM）人均收入超过 $6.6 million，而截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日为 $1.4 million。

paras.en: The demonstrated growth, scale, and efficiency of our financial model help us to continue making significant long-term investments to build frontier AI responsibly. Our business trajectory and financial profile have enabled us to access capital and secure compute from investors and partners. As of June 30, 2026, we had raised an aggregate of $141.1 billion of capital and had cash and cash equivalents of $112.4 billion and short-term investments of $19.3 billion [__] .
paras.zh: 我们财务模型所展现出的增长、规模与效率，帮助我们持续进行重大长期投资，以负责任的方式构建前沿 AI。我们的业务发展轨迹和财务概况使我们能够获取资本，并从投资者和合作伙伴处获得算力。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，我们已累计筹集 $141.1 billion 资本，并拥有 $112.4 billion 的现金及现金等价物以及 $19.3 billion 的短期投资 [__] 。

paras.en: #### Our Self-Reinforcing Loops
paras.zh: #### 我们的自我强化循环

paras.en: Our scale and growth create self-reinforcing loops that make Claude better over time and that we believe create durable competitive advantages.
paras.zh: 我们的规模与增长创造了自我强化循环，使 Claude 随时间推移不断改进，我们相信这创造了持久的竞争优势。

paras.en: - Improvement Loop. Enterprise deployments of Claude deepen our understanding of the hard problems, edge cases, and domain-specific challenges that matter most to our customers. We improve our models, platform, and applications based on feedback from customers using our offerings in production across their businesses. These improvements result in wider deployments and adoption that fuel the next cycle of improvement.
paras.zh: - 改进循环。Claude 的企业部署加深了我们对客户最为关注的难题、边缘情形和特定领域挑战的理解。我们根据客户在其各项业务中生产环境使用我们产品所反馈的意见，改进我们的模型、平台和应用。这些改进带来更广泛的部署和采用，进而推动下一轮改进。

paras.en: - Investment Loop. Revenue from expanding enterprise adoption helps us to fund the compute, research, and talent needed to improve Claude. Claude’s advancing capabilities expand the range of tasks and workflows customers use Claude for, broadening our addressable market and driving deeper deployment, additional revenue, and continued reinvestment in Claude.
paras.zh: - 投资循环。企业采用扩大所带来的收入，帮助我们为改进 Claude 所需的算力、研究和人才提供资金。Claude 不断提升的能力拓展了客户使用 Claude 完成的任务和工作流程范围，扩大了我们的可服务市场，并推动更深入的部署、更多收入以及对 Claude 的持续再投资。

paras.en: Claude is Accelerating Our Ability to Close the Loop
paras.zh: Claude 正在加速我们实现闭环的能力

paras.en: Claude itself has become one of the most powerful drivers of our progress—each new version of a Claude model directly accelerates development of the next. Many aspects of the research, training, and testing of subsequent model generations now involve Claude, including running experiments, generating and processing training data, automating evaluations and safety audits, and writing and reviewing code. We refer to this recursive dynamic as “closing the loop.” A direct expression of this dynamic is our accelerating pace of producing compute multipliers. More capable models help our researchers discover these improvements faster; in turn, more powerful compute multipliers enable us to train even more capable models and deploy them more efficiently.
paras.zh: Claude 本身已成为推动我们进步的最强大动力之一——Claude 模型的每一个新版本都直接加速下一代模型的开发。后续各代模型的研究、训练和测试的许多环节现在都涉及 Claude，包括运行实验、生成和处理训练数据、自动化评估与安全审计，以及编写和审查代码。我们将这种递归动态称为“闭环”。这种动态的一个直接体现，就是我们产出算力乘数的速度不断加快。能力更强的模型帮助我们的研究人员更快发现这些改进；反过来，更强大的算力乘数使我们能够训练能力更强的模型，并更高效地部署它们。

paras.en: #### Our Growth Strategy
paras.zh: #### 我们的增长战略

paras.en: We believe the diffusion of AI through the global economy represents one of the largest opportunities in history to improve how humans live and work, and it is just beginning. In our view, the world has only begun to use the capabilities of today’s frontier models, and the gap between what Claude can do and how broadly it is used represents one of our largest growth opportunities, alongside continued advances at the frontier. Claude’s capabilities have evolved significantly in recent years, and we expect they will continue advancing rapidly. This will lead not only to an expanding addressable market, but also to an expanding scope of impact on the world. We aim to ensure that impact is as positive as possible. Our core advantages, the speed and scale of enterprise adoption of Claude, and our unprecedented financial model enable us to continue investing aggressively to build an AI-enabled future that benefits humanity broadly. Elements of our growth strategy include:
paras.zh: 我们相信，AI 在全球经济中的普及代表着历史上改善人类生活和工作方式的重大机遇之一，而这一切才刚刚开始。在我们看来，世界才刚刚开始使用当今前沿模型的能力，而 Claude 能做什么与其被广泛使用程度之间的差距，是我们最大的增长机遇之一，同时前沿领域的持续进步也是如此。近年来，Claude 的能力已显著演进，我们预计其将继续快速进步。这不仅将带来不断扩大的可服务市场，也将带来对世界不断扩大的影响范围。我们致力于确保这一影响尽可能积极。我们的核心优势、企业采用 Claude 的速度和规模，以及我们前所未有的财务模式，使我们能够继续积极投资，构建一个广泛惠及人类的 AI 赋能未来。我们的增长战略要素包括：

paras.en: - Talent and Culture. To recruit world-class researchers and engineers and retain exceptional people, we intend to continue investing in our low-ego, high-impact, and mission-aligned culture that has driven our talent density as we have scaled.
paras.zh: - 人才与文化。为招募世界级研究人员和工程师并留住杰出人才，我们打算继续投资于我们低自我、高影响、与使命一致的文化，这种文化在我们规模扩大的过程中推动了人才密度的提升。

paras.en: - Compute. We intend to secure further compute beyond our existing commitments, expand our own data center footprint to secure additional long-term compute, improve compute efficiency across our multi-chip compute architecture, and produce further algorithmic advances in model efficiency.
paras.zh: - 算力。我们打算在现有承诺之外确保更多算力，扩大自有数据中心布局以锁定更多长期算力，提升我们多芯片算力架构的算力效率，并在模型效率方面取得进一步的算法进步。

paras.en: - Claude’s Intelligence, Capability, and Safety. We plan to continue advancing Claude’s core intelligence and safety in tandem, expand the frontier of what AI systems can reliably do, and pioneer new ways AI can be applied across professional domains.
paras.zh: - Claude 的智能、能力与安全。我们计划继续同步推进 Claude 的核心智能与安全，拓展 AI 系统能够可靠完成的任务边界，并开创 AI 在各专业领域应用的新方式。

paras.en: - Claude’s Accessibility. We plan to continue making Claude’s intelligence accessible across every surface where work happens, including through our own platform and applications, through AWS, GCP, and Azure, and through embedding in enterprise applications.
paras.zh: - Claude 的可及性。我们计划继续让 Claude 的智能可及于工作发生的每一个界面，包括通过我们自己的平台和应用、通过 AWS、GCP 和 Azure，以及通过嵌入企业应用。

paras.en: - Claude’s Adoption. We intend to grow our direct go-to-market and Applied AI teams, deepen cloud distribution partnerships, invest in brand and marketing, and expand our international presence to drive adoption of Claude as the trusted AI partner for organizations worldwide.
paras.zh: - Claude 的采用。我们打算扩大我们的直销和市场推广团队及 Applied AI 团队，深化云分销合作伙伴关系，投资于品牌和营销，并扩大我们的国际布局，以推动 Claude 成为全球组织值得信赖的 AI 合作伙伴。

paras.en: - Enter New Markets. We intend to extend frontier AI to accelerate novel discoveries, reaching domains from healthcare and life sciences to robotics and physical work, where we believe compounding model capabilities can unlock transformative opportunities.
paras.zh: - 进入新市场。我们打算将前沿 AI 扩展至加速新颖发现，触达从医疗健康和生命科学到机器人和物理工作的各个领域，我们相信在这些领域复合的模型能力可以释放变革性机遇。

paras.en: - Strategic Transactions and Partnerships. We intend to selectively pursue acquisitions, investments, and strategic partnerships, including ecosystem partnerships with SIs, consultants, and data platforms, that accelerate our mission, expand our reach, and strengthen our competitive position.
paras.zh: - 战略交易与合作伙伴关系。我们打算有选择地寻求收购、投资和战略合作伙伴关系，包括与 SIs、咨询公司和数据平台的生态系统合作伙伴关系，以加速我们的使命、扩大我们的触达并强化我们的竞争地位。

paras.en: #### Our Commitment to Public Benefit
paras.zh: #### 我们对公共利益的承诺

paras.en: We founded Anthropic on the belief that the most transformative technology in human history demands an extraordinary level of responsibility, and that responsibility extends far beyond building safe systems. We intend to direct a meaningful portion of our resources toward ensuring that frontier AI is safe and its benefits are broadly distributed, which we refer to as our public benefit initiatives.
paras.zh: 我们创立 Anthropic 的信念是，人类历史上最具变革性的技术需要非同寻常的责任担当，而这种责任远不止于构建安全的系统。我们打算将相当一部分资源用于确保前沿 AI 的安全及其收益的广泛分配，我们将其称为我们的公益倡议。

paras.en: As part of these initiatives, we contributed 846,840,960 shares of our Class N common stock, representing [__] 5% of our fully diluted shares as of June 30, 2026 (assuming full conversion of the Amazon Notes, as defined below), to Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, LLC (the “Anthropic Public Benefit Fund”), our wholly owned subsidiary dedicated to the Company Purpose (as defined below) (such issuance, the “Initial Public Benefit Issuance”). Our board of directors has also approved a framework under which it may, in its discretion, issue shares of our Class N common stock to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund (or other designee) representing up to an additional 2% of our then-outstanding shares (plus any shares subject to options, restricted stock units, and other convertible securities and any shares held by the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund) each time our share price appreciates [__] 50% above the prior share price milestone, beginning with our initial public offering price (the “Public Benefit Issuances”). In addition, our co-founders have each pledged to dedicate 80% of their personal equity in Anthropic to philanthropic causes. For additional information regarding these pledges, including related risks, see the section titled “Risk Factors—Risks Related to Ownership of our Class A Common Stock.” Separate from the co-founders’ pledges, we also maintain a donation matching program through which employees can pledge a meaningful portion of their equity awards toward charitable giving, which we match with shares of our Class N common stock.
paras.zh: 作为这些倡议的一部分，我们向 Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, LLC（“Anthropic 公益基金”）——我们为践行公司宗旨（定义见下文）而设立的全资子公司——出资 846,840,960 股 N 类普通股，占截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日我们完全稀释股份的 [__] 5%(假设亚马逊票据（定义见下文）全部转换)（该等发行称为“初始公益发行”）。我们的董事会还批准了一项框架，据此董事会可酌情向 Anthropic 公益基金（或其他指定对象）发行 N 类普通股，每次在我们股价较上一股价里程碑上涨 [__] 50% 时，发行数量最多可达我们届时已发行股份的额外 2%（加上任何受期权、限制性股票单位及其他可转换证券约束的股份以及 Anthropic 公益基金持有的任何股份），自我们的首次公开发行价格起算（该等发行称为“公益发行”）。此外，我们的每位联合创始人均已承诺将其在 Anthropic 个人持股的 80% 用于慈善事业。有关这些承诺（包括相关风险）的更多信息，请参见“风险因素——与持有我们 A 类普通股相关的风险”一节。除联合创始人的承诺外，我们还设有一项捐赠配捐计划，员工可通过该计划承诺将其股权奖励的相当一部分用于慈善捐赠，我们以 N 类普通股进行配捐。

full.sec: Our Governance Structure and Its Goals
full.secZh: 我们的治理结构及其目标

paras.en: Our novel capital and corporate governance structure has been carefully designed and differs significantly from that of other public companies. We strive to help bring humanity safely into an era where transformative AI exerts tremendous and potentially decisive influence over a broad range of human undertakings. Operating as a public benefit corporation (“PBC”) gives our board of directors the necessary latitude to balance the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and the specific public benefit purpose that we promote. Our specific public benefit purpose is the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity (the “Company Purpose”). In addition, a financially disinterested trust, which we refer to as the Long-Term Benefit Trust (the “LTBT”) and which generally has the power to elect and remove a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors, is designed to supply both the incentives and insights for striking this balance appropriately. We also believe that our seven co-founders are distinctly equipped to be stewards of our mission.
paras.zh: 我们新颖的资本与公司治理结构经过精心设计，与其他上市公司存在显著差异。我们致力于帮助人类安全地迈入一个变革性 AI 对人类广泛活动施加巨大且可能具有决定性影响的时代。作为公益公司（“PBC”）运营，使我们的董事会拥有必要的裁量空间，以平衡股东的金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益，以及我们所促进的特定公共利益宗旨。我们的特定公共利益宗旨是负责任地开发和维护先进 AI，以造福人类的长期利益（“公司宗旨”）。此外，一个财务上无利害关系的信托——我们称之为长期利益信托（“LTBT”），其通常有权选举和罢免我们董事会多数授权成员——旨在为恰当实现这一平衡提供激励与洞见。我们还认为，我们的七位联合创始人具备独特的能力，能够担当我们使命的守护者。

paras.en: #### Public Benefit Corporation Status
paras.zh: #### 公益公司地位

paras.en: Consistent with our long-term commitment to AI safety and responsibility, we are incorporated as a PBC under Delaware law. PBCs are a class of corporations that are intended to produce a public benefit and operate in a responsible and sustainable manner. Under Delaware law, a PBC is required to identify in its certificate of incorporation the public benefit or benefits it will promote, and its directors have a duty to manage the affairs of the corporation in a manner that balances the pecuniary interests of the corporation’s stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by the corporation’s conduct, and the specific public benefit purpose identified in the corporation’s certificate of incorporation. As provided in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, the public benefit that we promote, which we must always consider in the management of our company, is the Company Purpose.
paras.zh: 与我们长期以来对 AI 安全与责任的承诺相一致，我们依据特拉华州法律注册为 PBC。PBC 是一类旨在产生公共利益并以负责任和可持续方式运营的公司。根据特拉华州法律，PBC 须在其公司注册证书中明确其将促进的公共利益，且其董事有义务以平衡公司股东的金钱利益、受公司行为重大影响者的最佳利益以及公司注册证书中明确的特定公共利益宗旨的方式管理公司事务。如我们经修订和重述的公司注册证书所规定，我们所促进的、且在公司管理中必须始终考虑的公共利益，即为公司宗旨。

paras.en: #### Long-Term Benefit Trust
paras.zh: #### 长期利益信托

paras.en: In 2023, we implemented an innovative governance structure featuring the LTBT, which is designed to ensure that we are managed in a manner that responsibly balances our tripartite goals as a PBC: the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and the Company Purpose. The LTBT is intended to operate as an independent body of five financially disinterested voting trustees (“Trustees”) with expertise in AI safety, national security, public policy, and social enterprise. Through a special class of common stock, Class T common stock, the LTBT generally has the authority to elect and remove the Class T directors, who together will constitute a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors. Our Class T common stock does not otherwise have voting rights on matters submitted to stockholders generally.
paras.zh: 2023 年，我们实施了一项以 LTBT 为特色的创新治理结构，旨在确保我们以负责任地平衡我们作为 PBC 的三重目标的方式被管理：股东的金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益，以及公司宗旨。LTBT 旨在作为一个由五名在 AI 安全、国家安全、公共政策和社会企业领域具备专长的、财务上无利害关系的投票受托人（“受托人”）组成的独立机构运作。通过一类特殊类别的普通股——T 类普通股，LTBT 通常有权选举和罢免 T 类董事，这些董事合计将构成我们董事会多数授权成员。我们的 T 类普通股在提交股东一般表决的事项上不另享有投票权。

paras.en: #### Founder Voting Structure
paras.zh: #### 创始人投票结构

paras.en: We believe that our seven co-founders, Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish, and Christopher Olah, as a group, are distinctly equipped to be stewards of our mission. Immediately prior to the completion of this offering, we will issue a single share of Class F common stock, a special class of our common stock, to a limited liability company of which our seven co-founders will initially be the sole members (the “Founder LLC”).
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们的七位联合创始人——Dario Amodei、Daniela Amodei、Tom Brown、Jack Clark、Jared Kaplan、Sam McCandlish 和 Christopher Olah——作为一个整体，具备独特的能力来守护我们的使命。在本次发行完成之前，我们将向一家有限责任公司（“创始人有限责任公司”）发行一股 F 类普通股，这是我们普通股的一个特殊类别，该公司的初始唯一成员将是我们的七位联合创始人。

paras.en: Our Class F common stock will be entitled to an aggregate number of votes that equals 50.1% of the total voting power of our outstanding shares of capital stock with respect to matters submitted to stockholders generally, including the election of our directors other than the Class T directors.
paras.zh: 我们的 F 类普通股将有权就提交股东一般表决的事项（包括选举我们的董事，但 T 类董事除外）享有合计相当于我们已发行股本总投票权 50.1% 的投票权。

paras.en: #### Board Governance
paras.zh: #### 董事会治理

paras.en: Decisions regarding our business and affairs are made by our board of directors. Immediately prior to the completion of this offering, we will enter into a stockholders’ agreement (the “Stockholders’ Agreement”) with the LTBT and the Founder LLC, under which they will agree to vote their shares and take other actions to give effect to the board composition, director nomination, and director removal provisions described in our governing documents. Collectively, the LTBT and the Founder LLC will have the ability to elect all members of our board of directors. Regardless of the class or classes of stock by which a director is elected, there is no limit to the number of terms a director may serve.
paras.zh: 有关我们业务和事务的决策由我们的董事会作出。在本次发行完成之前，我们将与 LTBT 和创始人有限责任公司签订一份股东协议（“股东协议”），根据该协议，他们将同意对其股份进行投票并采取其他行动，以使我们的治理文件中所述的董事会构成、董事提名和董事罢免条款生效。LTBT 和创始人有限责任公司合计将有能力选举我们董事会的全部成员。无论董事是通过哪一类或多类股票选举产生的，董事的任期次数均无限制。

paras.en: While the LTBT has significant influence over our board of directors through its ability to generally elect and remove a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors, neither the LTBT nor the Trustees have decision-making authority in the day-to-day management or strategy setting of the company. The LTBT’s role is to select directors who are well-equipped to make decisions in furtherance of the responsible balancing of the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and the Company Purpose, and to support our management’s decision-making through advice and guidance.
paras.zh: 尽管 LTBT 通过其通常能够选举和罢免我们董事会多数授权成员的能力，对我们的董事会具有重大影响力，但 LTBT 和受托人均无权对公司的日常管理或战略制定作出决策。LTBT 的作用是选出有能力作出决策的董事，以促进对我们股东的金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益以及公司宗旨进行负责任的平衡，并通过建议和指导支持我们管理层的决策。

paras.en: The Founder LLC will also have significant influence over our business and affairs through its ability to vote our Class F common stock, which is entitled to an aggregate number of votes that equals 50.1% of the total voting power of our outstanding shares of capital stock with respect to matters submitted to stockholders generally, including the election of our directors other than the Class T directors.
paras.zh: 创始人有限责任公司还将通过其对我们的 F 类普通股进行投票的能力，对我们的业务和事务具有重大影响力，该类别普通股有权就提交股东一般表决的事项（包括选举我们的董事，但 T 类董事除外）享有合计相当于我们已发行股本总投票权 50.1% 的投票权。

paras.en: #### Controlled Company Status
paras.zh: #### 受控公司地位

paras.en: We are considered a “controlled company” within the meaning of the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements because the LTBT, as the sole holder of our Class T common stock, generally has the power to elect a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors. As such, we are permitted to opt out of compliance with certain Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements. Accordingly, if we elect not to comply with certain requirements, you will not have the same protections afforded to stockholders of companies that are subject to all of the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements. Although we qualify as a “controlled company,” we do not expect to rely on this exemption except with respect to our nominating and corporate governance committee (“NGC”), which will not consist entirely of independent directors. Our board of directors currently consists of a majority of independent directors and our audit and compensation committees currently consist entirely of independent directors. See the sections titled “Risk Factors—Risks Related to our Governance Structure—We are considered a “controlled company” within the meaning of the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements, and, as a result, we qualify for, and currently rely on, exemptions from certain corporate governance requirements,” “Our Governance Structure and Its Goals,” “Management,” and “Description of Capital Stock” for additional information.
paras.zh: 由于长期利益信托（LTBT）作为我们 T 类普通股的唯一持有人，通常有权选举我们董事会授权成员中的多数，因此根据纳斯达克全球精选市场公司治理要求，我们被视为一家“受控公司”。据此，我们被允许选择豁免遵守纳斯达克全球精选市场的某些公司治理要求。因此，如果我们选择不遵守某些要求，您将无法获得那些须遵守纳斯达克全球精选市场全部公司治理要求的公司股东所享有的同等保护。尽管我们符合“受控公司”的资格，但我们预计不会依赖该豁免，惟提名与公司治理委员会（“NGC”）除外，该委员会将不会全部由独立董事组成。我们的董事会目前由多数独立董事组成，且我们的审计委员会和薪酬委员会目前全部由独立董事组成。更多信息请参见“风险因素——与我们的治理结构相关的风险——根据纳斯达克全球精选市场公司治理要求，我们被视为一家‘受控公司’，因此我们符合并目前依赖某些公司治理要求的豁免”、“我们的治理结构及其目标”、“管理层”及“股本说明”等章节。
