paras.en: These employees may have had access to proprietary or confidential information, including trade secrets, of their former employers. Although we require employees to comply with confidentiality and intellectual property obligations, we may nonetheless be subject to claims that we or our employees have misappropriated or improperly used trade secrets or other intellectual property of competitors or other companies. Such claims may be asserted even if we believe they are without merit and even in the absence of any intentional misconduct.
paras.zh: 这些员工可能曾接触其前雇主的专有或保密信息，包括商业秘密。尽管我们要求员工遵守保密和知识产权义务，但我们或我们的员工仍可能被指控盗用或不当使用竞争对手或其他公司的商业秘密或其他知识产权。即使我们认为此类索赔缺乏依据，且即使不存在任何故意不当行为，此类索赔仍可能被提出。

paras.en: Defending against these claims could be costly, time-consuming, and disruptive, and could divert management attention and resources away from our business. In addition, such disputes could result in damages, settlements, injunctive relief, restrictions on our ability to use certain technologies, limitations on the roles of certain employees, or reputational harm. Any of the foregoing could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
paras.zh: 抗辩此类索赔可能代价高昂、耗时且具有干扰性，并可能分散管理层对我们业务的注意力和资源。此外，此类争议可能导致损害赔偿、和解、禁令救济、对我们使用某些技术的能力的限制、对某些员工职务的限制或声誉损害。上述任何一项均可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩造成不利影响。

full.sec: Risks Related to Legal and Regulatory Matters
full.secZh: 与法律和监管事项相关的风险

paras.en: **We are subject to claims, lawsuits, investigations, executive and administrative orders and directives, other regulatory actions, and various actions and proceedings, and face potential liability, expenses for legal claims, and harm to our business.**
paras.zh: **我们可能面临索赔、诉讼、调查、行政命令与指令、其他监管行动以及各类行动与程序，并可能承担潜在责任、法律索赔相关费用，并对我们的业务造成损害。**

paras.en: We are subject to claims, lawsuits, arbitration proceedings, government inquiries and investigations, executive and administrative orders and directives, and other legal, regulatory, and administrative actions and proceedings, including those involving intellectual property disputes, compliance with regulatory requirements, government approvals and authorizations, labor and employment, anti-discrimination, commercial disputes, competition, privacy, consumer protection, customer complaints, advertising, and other matters relating to our technology, models, platform, and applications, and we may become subject to additional types of claims, lawsuits, arbitration proceedings, government inquiries and investigations, executive and administrative orders and directives, and other legal, regulatory, and administrative actions and proceedings as our business grows and as we deploy new technologies, models, platforms, and applications. In particular, as our models, platform, and applications increasingly include agentic AI systems capable of taking autonomous actions with real-world consequences, we may face novel legal theories of liability, including intellectual property infringement, product liability, agency, and negligence claims, that have not been tested in the context of autonomous AI systems and for which the scope of our potential exposure is uncertain. In addition, as we expand our healthcare and life sciences offerings, regulators may conclude that certain of our products, or our customers’ use of them, are subject to healthcare regulation or to other laws governing healthcare and health information, which could require us to obtain authorizations, modify or restrict our offerings, or incur significant compliance costs. Errors or other undesirable outputs from our models in these contexts could contribute to patient harm, compromised research, or regulatory failures by our customers, and could expose us to claims from customers, patients, and other third parties, as well as to regulatory inquiries and enforcement actions.
paras.zh: 我们可能面临索赔、诉讼、仲裁程序、政府问询与调查、行政命令与指令，以及其他法律、监管和行政行动与程序，包括涉及知识产权争议、监管合规、政府批准与授权、劳动与就业、反歧视、商业纠纷、竞争、隐私、消费者保护、客户投诉、广告以及与我们的技术、模型、平台和应用相关的其他事项；随着我们业务增长以及我们部署新技术、模型、平台和应用，我们可能面临更多类型的索赔、诉讼、仲裁程序、政府问询与调查、行政命令与指令，以及其他法律、监管和行政行动与程序。特别是，随着我们的模型、平台和应用日益包含能够采取具有现实后果的自主行动的代理式 AI 系统，我们可能面临尚未在自主 AI 系统背景下经过检验的、新颖的责任法律理论，包括知识产权侵权、产品责任、代理和过失索赔，且我们潜在风险敞口的范围尚不确定。此外，随着我们扩展医疗健康和生命科学产品，监管机构可能认定我们的某些产品或客户对其的使用受医疗健康监管或管辖医疗健康和健康信息的其他法律约束，这可能要求我们取得授权、修改或限制我们的产品，或产生重大合规成本。在这些情境下，我们的模型出现的错误或其他不良输出可能导致患者伤害、研究受损或客户监管违规，并可能使我们面临来自客户、患者和其他第三方的索赔，以及监管问询和执法行动。

paras.en: We are also subject to antitrust and competition law risk arising from our public advocacy regarding AI safety and the responsible pace of AI development and from our participation in industry groups, safety collaborations, and standard-setting initiatives. Communications, advocacy, or collaboration among companies that develop frontier AI models, or conduct alleged to reflect coordination among such companies, may be characterized as concerted action subject to the antitrust and competition laws, including Section 1 of the Sherman Act and analogous state and non-U.S. laws, even where undertaken for safety purposes, conducted publicly, or intended as advocacy for governmental action or industry standards. In September 2026, a putative class action was filed against us and other developers of frontier AI models in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, alleging that we and the other defendants agreed to restrain competition by slowing the pace at which we develop and improve our respective AI models, in purported violation of Section 1 of the Sherman Act. The complaint seeks treble damages, injunctive relief, and other relief on behalf of a purported class of purchasers of the defendants’ paid consumer subscriptions. We disagree with the claims and intend to defend the matter vigorously, but the outcome of this and any similar proceeding is inherently uncertain.
paras.zh: 我们还面临反垄断与竞争法风险，该风险源于我们就 AI 安全及 AI 负责任的发展节奏所作的公开倡导，以及我们参与行业团体、安全合作和标准制定倡议。开发前沿 AI 模型的公司之间的沟通、倡导或合作，或据称反映此类公司之间协调的行为，可能被认定为受反垄断与竞争法（包括《谢尔曼法》第 1 条及类似的州法和非美国法律）规制的协同行为，即使该等行为系出于安全目的、以公开方式进行，或旨在倡导政府行动或行业标准。2026 年 9 月，一项推定集体诉讼在美国加利福尼亚北区联邦地区法院对我们及其他前沿 AI 模型开发者提起，指控我们与其他被告达成协议，通过放缓各自开发和改进 AI 模型的速度来限制竞争，涉嫌违反《谢尔曼法》第 1 条。该起诉状代表由被告付费消费者订阅购买者组成的推定集体，寻求三倍损害赔偿、禁令救济及其他救济。我们不同意上述主张，并打算积极抗辩，但本诉讼及任何类似程序的结果本质上具有不确定性。

paras.en: Antitrust litigation can be complex, protracted, disruptive, and expensive, and an adverse outcome could result in treble damages and injunctive relief. We could also become subject to additional private litigation or to investigations or enforcement actions by the U.S. Department of Justice, the FTC, state attorneys general, or non-U.S. competition authorities. We have proposed public efforts to work with the U.S. government and other developers of frontier AI models to establish safety standards, including with respect to the pace of capability development, and have suggested that such collaboration may warrant a narrow exemption or safe harbor from antitrust laws. These proposals have drawn public opposition from political leaders, some of whom have characterized such efforts as anticompetitive regardless of the purpose of such exemption or safe harbor. There is no assurance that any such exemption or safe harbor will be adopted. Our advocacy for such an exemption, and any safety commitments we pursue with other developers of frontier AI in its absence, could subject us to additional regulatory, litigation, and other risks. These risks may cause us to limit or modify our public advocacy, our participation in industry safety and standard-setting initiatives, and our communications with other developers of frontier AI, which could adversely affect our ability to pursue collaborative approaches to AI safety that we believe are important to our mission.
paras.zh: 反垄断诉讼可能复杂、旷日持久、具有干扰性且成本高昂，不利结果可能导致三倍损害赔偿和禁令救济。我们还可能面临更多私人诉讼，或美国司法部、FTC、州总检察长或非美国竞争主管机构的调查或执法行动。我们已公开提议与美国政府及其他前沿 AI 模型开发者合作制定安全标准，包括在能力发展节奏方面，并表示此类合作可能有必要获得反垄断法的有限豁免或安全港。这些提议已招致政治领导人的公开反对，其中一些人将此类努力定性为反竞争，而不论该等豁免或安全港的目的为何。无法保证任何此类豁免或安全港会获得采纳。我们对此类豁免的倡导，以及在缺乏该等豁免的情况下我们与其他前沿 AI 开发者寻求达成的任何安全承诺，可能使我们面临额外的监管、诉讼及其他风险。这些风险可能导致我们限制或修改我们的公开倡导、我们对行业安全与标准制定倡议的参与，以及我们与其他前沿 AI 开发者的沟通，这可能对我们寻求我们认为对自身使命至关重要的 AI 安全协作方式的能力产生不利影响。

paras.en: The results of any such claims, lawsuits, arbitration proceedings, government inquiries and investigations, executive and administrative orders and directives, or other legal, regulatory, and administrative actions and proceedings cannot be predicted with any degree of certainty. Any claims, lawsuits, investigations, orders, directives, regulatory actions, or proceedings against us, whether meritorious or not, could adversely affect our revenue, cause potential customers to pause sales discussions, cause existing customers to delay, pause or cancel contracts or seek to modify their contracts, undermine our ability to pursue future contracts, damage our relationships with partners and customers, adversely affect our institutional standing, undermine investor confidence, limit our ability to sell our models, platform, and applications in certain industries, result in costly litigation or regulatory or other defense, adversely affect our reputation, require significant management attention, consume significant time, and divert significant resources.
paras.zh: 任何此类索赔、诉讼、仲裁程序、政府问询和调查、行政命令和指令，或其他法律、监管及行政行动和程序的结果，均无法以任何程度的确定性加以预测。任何针对我们的索赔、诉讼、调查、命令、指令、监管行动或程序，无论是否有正当理由，都可能对我们的收入产生不利影响，导致潜在客户暂停销售洽谈，导致现有客户延迟、暂停或取消合同或寻求修改其合同，削弱我们争取未来合同的能力，损害我们与合作伙伴和客户的关系，对我们的机构地位产生不利影响，削弱投资者信心，限制我们在某些行业销售我们的模型、平台和应用程序的能力，导致代价高昂的诉讼或监管或其他抗辩，对我们的声誉产生不利影响，需要管理层投入大量精力，耗费大量时间，并占用大量资源。

paras.en: Determining reserves for our pending litigation or other disputes is a complex and fact-intensive process that requires significant subjective judgment and speculation. It is possible that a resolution of one or more such proceedings could result in substantial damages, settlement costs, fines, and penalties that could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations. Because of the potential risks, expenses, and uncertainties of litigation or other dispute resolution processes, we may, from time to time, settle disputes, even where we have meritorious claims or defenses, by agreeing to settlement agreements, as we did, for example, in Bartz. Moreover, as in Bartz, insurance may not fully cover such claims, provide sufficient payments to cover all the costs to resolve one or more such claims, or continue to be available on terms acceptable to us. A claim brought against us that is uninsured or underinsured could result in unanticipated costs. These proceedings could also result in harm to our reputation and brand, sanctions, consent decrees, injunctions, or other orders requiring a change in our business practices. Further, under certain circumstances, we have contractual and other legal obligations to indemnify and to incur legal expenses on behalf of our business and commercial partners and current and former directors and officers. Any of these consequences could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
paras.zh: 为我们的未决诉讼或其他争议确定准备金是一个复杂且高度依赖事实的过程，需要大量主观判断和推测。一项或多项此类程序的解决可能导致巨额损害赔偿、和解费用、罚款和处罚，从而可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营成果产生不利影响。由于诉讼或其他争议解决程序存在潜在风险、费用和不确定性，我们可能不时通过签订和解协议来解决争议，即使我们拥有正当的索赔或抗辩理由，例如我们在 Bartz 案中所做的那样。此外，如同在 Bartz 案中一样，保险可能无法完全覆盖此类索赔，无法提供足够的赔付以覆盖解决一项或多项此类索赔的全部费用，或无法继续以我们可接受的条款提供。针对我们提出的未投保或投保不足的索赔可能导致意外费用。这些程序还可能导致我们的声誉和品牌受损、制裁、同意令、禁令或其他要求我们改变业务惯例的命令。此外，在某些情况下，我们有合同义务和其他法律义务，需为我们的业务和商业合作伙伴以及现任和前任董事和高级管理人员进行赔偿并承担法律费用。任何此类后果都可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营成果产生不利影响。

paras.en: **We are subject to anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws, anti-money laundering laws, and similar laws.**
paras.zh: **我们受反腐败和反贿赂法律、反洗钱法律及类似法律的约束。**

paras.en: We are required to comply with the United States Foreign Corrupt Practices Act of 1977, the United Kingdom Bribery Act 2010, and other anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws, anti-money laundering laws, and similar laws in the United States and non-U.S. countries where we have operations and conduct business. Anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws, which have been enforced aggressively and are interpreted broadly, prohibit companies and their employees, agents, intermediaries, and other third parties from, among other things, promising, authorizing, making, or offering improper payments or other benefits to government officials and other persons in the public and private sector.
paras.zh: 我们需要遵守 1977 年《美国反海外腐败法》、2010 年《英国反贿赂法》，以及我们开展运营和业务所在美国及非美国国家的其他反腐败和反贿赂法律、反洗钱法律及类似法律。反腐败和反贿赂法律执行力度大且解释宽泛，禁止公司及其员工、代理人、中间人和其他第三方，除其他事项外，向政府官员以及公共和私营部门的其他人员承诺、授权、作出或提供不当付款或其他利益。

paras.en: We leverage third parties, including intermediaries and agents, to conduct our business and to sell our models, platform, and applications, and in connection with lobbying and other activities. We and these third parties have in the past and may in the future have direct or indirect interactions with officials and employees of government agencies, including state-owned or state-affiliated entities, and we potentially could be held liable for the corrupt or other illegal activities of third-party business partners and intermediaries, our employees, representatives, contractors, partners, agents, and other third parties, even if we do not explicitly authorize such parties’ activities.
paras.zh: 我们借助第三方（包括中间人和代理人）开展业务并销售我们的模型、平台和应用程序，以及开展游说和其他活动。我们和这些第三方过去曾、未来也可能与政府机构（包括国有或国有附属实体）的官员和员工有直接或间接往来，我们可能因第三方业务伙伴和中间人、我们的员工、代表、承包商、合作伙伴、代理人和其他第三方的腐败或其他非法活动而被追究责任，即使我们并未明确授权该等方的活动。

paras.en: We cannot ensure that our policies and procedures to address compliance with these anti-corruption and anti-money laundering laws will be effective, or that all of our employees, representatives, contractors, partners, agents, intermediaries, or other third parties have not taken, or will not take, actions that violate these laws, for which we may be ultimately held liable.
paras.zh: 我们无法确保我们为遵守这些反腐败和反洗钱法律而制定的政策和程序有效，也无法确保我们的所有员工、代表、承包商、合作伙伴、代理人、中间人或其他第三方未曾采取、且未来不会采取违反这些法律的行动，而我们可能最终为此承担责任。

paras.en: As we increase our non-U.S. sales and business, our risk of violating these laws may increase. Noncompliance with applicable anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws, anti-money laundering, and similar laws could subject us to criminal or civil sanctions, settlements, prosecution, loss of export privileges, suspension or debarment from U.S. government contracts, other enforcement actions, disgorgement of profits, significant fines, damages, other civil and criminal penalties or injunctions, whistleblower complaints, adverse media coverage, and other consequences. Any investigations, actions, or sanctions could adversely affect our reputation, business, financial condition, and results of operations. Responding to any investigation or action could result in a significant diversion of management’s attention and resources and significant defense costs and other professional fees.
paras.zh: 随着我们非美国销售和业务的增加，我们违反这些法律的风险可能增加。不遵守适用的反腐败和反贿赂法律、反洗钱及类似法律可能使我们面临刑事或民事制裁、和解、起诉、丧失出口特权、暂停或取消美国政府采购合同资格、其他执法行动、没收利润、重大罚款、损害赔偿、其他民事和刑事处罚或禁令、举报人投诉、不利媒体报道及其他后果。任何调查、行动或制裁都可能对我们的声誉、业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。应对任何调查或行动可能导致管理层注意力和资源被大量转移，并产生重大辩护费用和其他专业费用。

paras.en: **Governmental trade controls, including export and import controls, sanctions, customs requirements, and related regimes, could subject us to liability or loss of contracting privileges or limit our ability to compete in certain markets.**
paras.zh: **政府贸易管制，包括出口和进口管制、制裁、海关要求及相关制度，可能使我们承担责任或丧失签约特权，或限制我们在某些市场的竞争能力。**

paras.en: Our models, platform, and applications are subject to U.S. export controls, and our current or future models, platform, and applications may be controlled under the Export Administration Regulations administered by the U.S. Department of Commerce or, in more limited circumstances, under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (the “ITAR”) administered by the U.S. Department of State. Because the capabilities of our AI models are currently evolving rapidly through ongoing training and frequent model development, and because the export control treatment of AI technologies under relevant laws is developing, the classification of, and controls related to, our models, platform, applications, and technologies under these regimes is inherently uncertain and is likely to change over time. Certain of our models, platform, and applications, and the underlying technology and source code associated with our models, platform, and applications, may require authorization for export, re-export, or transfer in-country, and for individuals of certain nationalities to access such technology or source code, including within the United States.
paras.zh: 我们的模型、平台和应用受美国出口管制约束，我们当前或未来的模型、平台和应用可能受美国商务部管理的《出口管理条例》管制，或在更有限的情形下受美国国务院管理的《国际武器贸易条例》（“ITAR”）管制。由于我们 AI 模型的能力目前正通过持续训练和频繁的模型开发而快速演进，且相关法律对 AI 技术的出口管制处理仍在发展中，我们的模型、平台、应用和技术在这些制度下的分类及相关管制本质上具有不确定性，并可能随时间推移而变化。我们的某些模型、平台和应用，以及与我们的模型、平台和应用相关的基础技术和源代码，可能需要获得授权才能出口、再出口或在境内转移，且某些国籍的个人访问此类技术或源代码可能需要获得授权，包括在美国境内。

paras.en: In particular, our core models, platform, and applications leverage encryption for data protection, and some of our future models, platform, and applications may be able to produce export-controlled software, which may subject exports, re-exports, and transfer of such models, platform, and applications to export authorization requirements.
paras.zh: 特别是，我们的核心模型、平台和应用利用加密技术进行数据保护，我们未来的一些模型、平台和应用可能能够生成受出口管制的软件，这可能使此类模型、平台和应用的出口、再出口和转移受到出口授权要求的约束。

paras.en: Our commercially available models, platform, and applications generally can be exported without an export license. However, some exports may require us to obtain authorization from the cognizant government agency. In certain contexts, the provision of our models, platform, and applications may constitute export of defense articles or defense services subject to the ITAR, which can be exported only if we obtain required export licenses or other government authorizations. Compliance with applicable export controls may delay the introduction or sale of our models, platform, and applications outside the United States, restrict our customers’ ability to deploy our models, platform, and applications globally, inhibit our ability to engage in certain research and development activities, limit the performance of our models, platform, and applications, or prohibit exports to certain jurisdictions altogether. Such restrictions have already affected our offerings directly. For example, in June 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce imposed worldwide export restrictions on our Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models. To ensure compliance, we disabled Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all of our customers; access to our other models was not affected. We re-deployed the Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models after we updated our safeguards in coordination with the U.S. government and our industry partners and once the U.S. Department of Commerce lifted its restrictions. Similar export controls could recur, could remain in place longer, or could extend to additional models or capabilities. In addition, future updates to our safeguards or other remedial measures may not be sufficient to obtain relief from such restrictions or relief may not be granted on a similar timeline or at all. The restrictions imposed in June 2026 and potential restrictions in the future may also limit our ability to recruit talent, to fully utilize our existing workforce, to continue to improve our models, and to make our products available internationally. Any such restrictions could adversely affect our financial results; impair the research, compute, and development investment our models represent; and cause us to lose customers, partners, and market share, including to competitors not subject to similar restrictions.
paras.zh: 我们商业上可用的模型、平台和应用程序通常无需出口许可证即可出口。然而，某些出口可能需要我们从相关政府机构获得授权。在某些情况下，提供我们的模型、平台和应用程序可能构成受《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）约束的国防物品或国防服务的出口，只有在获得所需出口许可证或其他政府授权的情况下才能出口。遵守适用的出口管制可能会延迟我们的模型、平台和应用程序在美国境外的推出或销售，限制我们的客户在全球范围内部署我们的模型、平台和应用程序的能力，抑制我们开展某些研发活动的能力，限制我们的模型、平台和应用程序的性能，或完全禁止向某些司法管辖区出口。此类限制已经直接影响了我们的产品供应。例如，2026 年 6 月，美国商务部对我们的 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 模型实施了全球出口限制。为确保合规，我们为所有客户禁用了 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5；对我们其他模型的访问未受影响。在与美国政府和行业合作伙伴协调更新我们的保障措施后，并在美国商务部解除限制后，我们重新部署了 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 模型。类似的出口管制可能会再次出现，可能会持续更长时间，或可能扩展到更多模型或能力。此外，我们保障措施的未来更新或其他补救措施可能不足以获得此类限制的豁免，或者豁免可能不会在类似的时间线上获得，或根本无法获得。2026 年 6 月实施的限制以及未来的潜在限制也可能限制我们招募人才、充分利用现有员工队伍、持续改进我们的模型以及在国际上提供产品的能力。任何此类限制都可能对我们的财务业绩产生不利影响；损害我们的模型所代表的研究、算力和开发投资；并导致我们失去客户、合作伙伴和市场份额，包括流向不受类似限制约束的竞争对手。

paras.en: Further, our activities are subject to economic, financial, and trade sanctions administered by the United States and other countries. Economic, financial, and trade sanctions restrict or prohibit providing certain services and engaging in certain transactions or other activities or dealings with individuals, entities, organizations, governments, territories, and countries targeted by or the subject of these sanctions. These restrictions, as well as other applicable international trade rules, are subject to change with little to no notice. In addition, U.S. law increasingly authorizes the U.S. government to restrict or review the use of hardware, software, and services originating from, or linked to, countries it designates as adversaries, including such technology incorporated into the supply chains for the data centers and compute infrastructure on which we depend. Such restrictions could narrow our choice of suppliers, delay our infrastructure projects, or increase our costs, and any noncompliance could result in penalties, loss of contracting privileges, or reputational harm.
paras.zh: 此外，我们的活动受美国及其他国家实施的经济、金融和贸易制裁约束。经济、金融和贸易制裁限制或禁止向受该等制裁针对或作为该等制裁对象的个人、实体、组织、政府、领土和国家提供特定服务、开展特定交易或其他活动或往来。该等限制以及其他适用的国际贸易规则可能在几乎不发出通知或完全不发出通知的情况下发生变化。此外，美国法律日益授权美国政府限制或审查源自或被其认定为敌对国家的硬件、软件和服务的使用，包括纳入我们所依赖的数据中心和算力基础设施供应链中的此类技术。该等限制可能缩小我们的供应商选择范围、延迟我们的基础设施项目或增加我们的成本，任何不合规行为都可能导致处罚、丧失合同权利或声誉受损。

paras.en: We take various steps to comply with applicable export controls and sanctions, including: maintaining a global trade policy and a supported regions policy, implementing IP-based geo-blocking controls that restrict access from certain jurisdictions to our models, platform, and applications, conducting restricted party screening of certain customers and vendors, and including sanctions and export compliance provisions in our customer terms of service and vendor agreements. However, we cannot guarantee the compliance measures and internal controls we have adopted will prevent violations of applicable export controls and sanctions. Our compliance measures and internal controls have not always been and may not always be fully effective, and we have in the past voluntarily disclosed, and may in the future voluntarily disclose, instances of noncompliance to the relevant authorities. We cannot guarantee that our measures will prevent future violations or keep pace with the changing substance, application, and interpretation of export controls and sanctions. In addition, third parties have in the past and may in the future take action to circumvent our compliance measures and controls in order to gain access to our products and services.
paras.zh: 我们采取多种措施以遵守适用的出口管制和制裁，包括：维护全球贸易政策和支持地区政策，实施基于 IP 的地理封锁控制以限制来自特定司法管辖区对我们模型、平台和应用程序的访问，对特定客户和供应商进行受限方筛查，并在我们的客户服务条款和供应商协议中纳入制裁和出口合规条款。然而，我们无法保证我们所采取的合规措施和内部控制能够防止违反适用的出口管制和制裁。我们的合规措施和内部控制并非始终有效，未来也可能并非始终完全有效，我们过去曾自愿向相关主管部门披露，未来也可能自愿披露不合规情形。我们无法保证我们的措施能够防止未来违规或跟上出口管制和制裁不断变化的实质内容、适用和解释。此外，第三方过去曾采取、未来也可能采取行动规避我们的合规措施和控制，以获取我们的产品和服务。

paras.en: If we misclassify a product or service, export, re-export, transfer, or provide access to a product, or provide services in violation of applicable export controls or sanctions, or otherwise fail to comply with applicable export controls or sanctions, we could be subject to criminal or civil sanctions, settlements, prosecution, loss of export privileges, suspension or debarment from U.S. government contracts, other enforcement actions, disgorgement of profits, significant fines, damages, other civil and criminal penalties or injunctions, whistleblower complaints, adverse media coverage, and other consequences. Any investigations, actions, or sanctions could adversely affect our reputation, business, financial condition, and results of operations. Responding to any investigation or action could result in a significant diversion of management’s attention and resources and significant defense costs and other professional fees.
paras.zh: 如果我们对产品或服务进行错误分类，违反适用的出口管制或制裁规定出口、再出口、转让或提供对产品的访问权限，或提供服务，或以其他方式未能遵守适用的出口管制或制裁规定，我们可能面临刑事或民事制裁、和解、起诉、丧失出口特权、被暂停或取消参与美国政府合同的资格、其他执法行动、利润追缴、巨额罚款、损害赔偿、其他民事和刑事处罚或禁令、举报人投诉、负面媒体报道及其他后果。任何调查、行动或制裁均可能对我们的声誉、业务、财务状况和经营业绩造成不利影响。应对任何调查或行动可能导致管理层注意力和资源被大量转移，并产生巨额辩护费用和其他专业费用。

paras.en: Decreased use of our models, platform, and applications by customers outside the United States or a limitation on our ability to export, provide access to, or sell our models, platform, and applications to customers and other parties outside the United States may cause our revenue from such unsupported jurisdictions to decline and otherwise adversely affect our business and financial condition.
paras.zh: 美国境外客户对我们模型、平台和应用程序的使用减少，或我们向美国境外客户和其他方出口、提供访问权限或销售我们模型、平台和应用程序的能力受到限制，可能导致我们来自该等未获支持司法辖区的收入下降，并以其他方式对我们的业务和财务状况造成不利影响。

paras.en: If we or our business partners or counterparties, including licensors and licensees, prime contractors, subcontractors, sublicensors, vendors, customers, or contractors, violate export controls or sanctions, including by failing to obtain appropriate import, export, or re-export licenses or permits, or if we fail to secure such contractual commitments from such parties, we may also be adversely affected through reputational harm as well as other negative consequences, including government investigations or penalties.
paras.zh: 如果我们或我们的业务合作伙伴或交易对手（包括许可方和被许可方、主承包商、分包商、再许可方、供应商、客户或承包商）违反出口管制或制裁规定，包括未能获得适当的进口、出口或再出口许可证或批准，或如果我们未能从该等方获得此类合同承诺，我们亦可能因声誉受损以及其他负面后果（包括政府调查或处罚）而受到不利影响。

paras.en: Negative consequences stemming from violations or apparent violations of export controls or sanctions may include the loss of the right to sell our models, platform, and applications or services to the U.S. government, or to other U.S. or non-U.S. public bodies, or a reduction in our ability to compete for such sales opportunities involving government agencies or other public bodies. Further, ensuring that we are complying with applicable export controls and sanctions regulations may be time-consuming and could result in the delay or loss of sales opportunities in connection with particular transactions.
paras.zh: 违反或涉嫌违反出口管制或制裁规定所产生的负面后果可能包括丧失向美国政府或其他美国或非美国公共机构销售我们模型、平台和应用程序或服务的权利，或我们竞标涉及政府机构或其他公共机构的此类销售机会的能力下降。此外，确保我们遵守适用的出口管制和制裁法规可能耗时较长，并可能导致特定交易相关的销售机会延迟或丧失。

paras.en: Also, in addition to the United States, various countries regulate the import and export of certain encryption and other technology and have enacted laws that could limit our ability to distribute our models, platform, and applications or could limit our customers’ abilities to implement our models, platform, and applications in those countries. For example, following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, the United States and other countries imposed financial and trade sanctions and export controls against Russia, Belarus, and certain regions of Ukraine, and the United States and other countries could impose wider sanctions and export restrictions and take other actions should the conflict further escalate. Any new export restrictions, new legislation, changes in sanctions, or shifting approaches in the enforcement or scope of existing regulations, or in the individuals, entities, governments, territories, countries, or technologies targeted by or subject to such regulations could result in decreased use of our models, platform, and applications by existing customers outside of the United States, reduced adoption of our models, platform, and applications by new customers with non-U.S. operations, limited expansion into new markets, and decreased revenue.
paras.zh: 此外，除美国之外，多个国家还对某些加密技术及其他技术的进出口实施监管，并已颁布法律，可能限制我们分发模型、平台和应用程序的能力，或限制我们的客户在这些国家部署我们的模型、平台和应用程序的能力。例如，在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰之后，美国及其他国家对俄罗斯、白俄罗斯以及乌克兰某些地区实施了金融和贸易制裁及出口管制，并且如果冲突进一步升级，美国及其他国家可能实施更广泛的制裁和出口限制并采取其他行动。任何新的出口限制、新的立法、制裁的变化，或现行法规在执行方式或适用范围上的转变，或此类法规所针对或约束的个人、实体、政府、地区、国家或技术发生变化，都可能导致美国境外的现有客户减少对我们模型、平台和应用程序的使用，非美国业务的新客户减少对我们模型、平台和应用程序的采用，限制我们向新市场的扩张，并导致收入下降。

paras.en: **To continue to grow our business, we will need to continue to expand internationally, and our non-U.S. operations and sales to customers outside of the United States expose us to risks inherent in international expansion, sales, and operations.**
paras.zh: **为持续增长我们的业务，我们将需要继续在国际上扩张，而我们的非美国业务以及向美国境外客户进行的销售，使我们面临国际扩张、销售和运营所固有的风险。**

paras.en: We are a U.S.-headquartered company with extensive U.S. operations, as well as subsidiaries and operations in several other countries and regions, including the UK, the EU, Canada, and Asia-Pacific, and we expect that our future growth will depend in part on expanding our operations, customer base, and market presence in additional jurisdictions. Operating in non-U.S. markets requires significant resources and management attention and subjects us to regulatory, economic, and political risks that are different from those in the United States. As we continue to expand internationally, we have faced and will continue to face risks in doing business internationally that could adversely affect our business, including:
paras.zh: 我们是一家总部位于美国的公司，在美国拥有广泛的业务，并在其他多个国家和地区（包括英国、欧盟、加拿大和亚太地区）设有子公司和业务，我们预计未来的增长将在一定程度上取决于我们在更多司法管辖区扩展业务、客户群和市场影响力。在美国以外的市场运营需要大量资源和管理层的关注，并使我们必须面对与美国不同的监管、经济和政治风险。随着我们继续在国际上扩张，我们在开展国际业务时已经面临并将继续面临可能对我们的业务造成不利影响的风险，包括：

paras.en: - the need to localize and adapt our models, platform, and applications for specific countries, including translation into foreign languages and associated expenses;
paras.zh: - 需要针对特定国家对我们的模型、平台和应用程序进行本地化和适配，包括翻译成外语及相关费用；

paras.en: - privacy laws, export controls, sanctions, and other national security regulations that impose different and potentially conflicting obligations with respect to how personal data is processed or require that customer data be stored in a designated territory;
paras.zh: - 隐私法、出口管制、制裁及其他国家安全法规，这些法规对个人数据的处理方式施加不同且可能相互冲突的义务，或要求客户数据存储在指定区域内；

paras.en: - laws in certain jurisdictions that may compel our personnel, vendors, or facility operators to provide governmental authorities with access to our systems, data, or other information, in some cases without notice to us and with limited means of recourse;
paras.zh: - 某些司法管辖区的法律可能强制要求我们的人员、供应商或设施运营方为政府当局提供访问我们系统、数据或其他信息的权限，在某些情况下无需通知我们，且救济手段有限；

paras.en: - national security-driven data security regulations. For example, the Department of Justice issued a final rule, effective in April 2025, that places limitations, and in some cases prohibitions, on certain transfers of covered data to partners, service providers, and vendors, employees, and investors located in China or with other specified links to China (and other designated countries). We may be required to re-examine current contracts or engage in new contract negotiations with third parties that aid in processing data on our behalf or otherwise have access to covered data. These rules also may broadly require us to extract promises from other third-party service providers that they will not transfer data we share with them onward to parties linked to countries of concern;
paras.zh: - 国家安全驱动的数据安全法规。例如，司法部发布了一项最终规则，于 2025 年 4 月生效，对向位于中国或与中国（及其他指定国家）有其他特定关联的合作伙伴、服务提供商和供应商、员工及投资者进行某些涵盖数据的传输施加限制，并在某些情况下予以禁止。我们可能被要求重新审查现有合同，或与协助代表我们处理数据或以其他方式访问涵盖数据的第三方进行新的合同谈判。这些规则还可能广泛要求我们从其他第三方服务提供商处取得承诺，即他们不会将我们与其共享的数据进一步传输给与受关注国家有关联的各方；

paras.en: - import regulations, including U.S. and non-U.S. governments’ restrictive trade policies, customs duties and other parallel regulations, tariffs and counter-measures;
paras.zh: - 进口法规，包括美国和非美国政府的限制性贸易政策、关税及其他类似法规、关税和反制措施；

paras.en: - AI, data-related, cybersecurity and digital service laws and regulations (such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, the EU Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act 2023, and the EU Data Act) that are rapidly evolving, require continuous monitoring to ensure constant compliance maturity level, and often provide for substantial penalties in the event of a violation;
paras.zh: - AI、数据相关、网络安全和数字服务法律法规（如欧盟《人工智能法案》、NIS2、欧盟《数字服务法案》、英国《2023 年在线安全法案》和欧盟《数据法案》），这些法律法规快速演变，需要持续监测以确保合规成熟度始终保持，且通常规定违规时的重大处罚；

paras.en: - difficulties in staffing and managing non-U.S. operations, including the complexity of engaging in various employer-of-record arrangements that are geographically dispersed, and the risk that these arrangements, or any failure to establish local employing entities on a timely basis, may not comply with local employment, labor, or tax laws, exposing us to fines, penalties, reclassification or back-payment claims;
paras.zh: - 在非美国运营地进行人员配备和管理的困难，包括参与地理上分散的各种名义雇主安排的复杂性，以及这些安排或任何未能及时设立当地雇佣实体的情况可能不符合当地就业、劳动或税法，从而使我们面临罚款、处罚、重新分类或补缴索赔的风险；

paras.en: - difficulties of maintaining our culture across various jurisdictions;
paras.zh: - 在各司法管辖区维护我们文化的困难；

paras.en: - regulatory and other delays and difficulties in setting up non-U.S. operations, including delays in forming, registering, and obtaining governmental approvals for local subsidiaries, delays in establishing local banking, payroll, and benefits arrangements, and difficulties relating to safety of personnel and information, any of which could delay local hiring efforts;
paras.zh: - 设立非美国运营地的监管及其他延迟和困难，包括设立、注册和获得当地子公司政府批准的延迟，建立当地银行、薪资和福利安排的延迟，以及与人员和信息安全相关的困难，其中任何一项都可能延迟当地招聘工作；

paras.en: - the potential need for reviews by the U.S. government or non-U.S. governments of certain transactions with non-U.S. entities;
paras.zh: - 美国政府或非美国政府可能需要对与非美国实体的某些交易进行审查；

paras.en: - different pricing environments, longer sales cycles, longer accounts receivable payment cycles, and collections issues;
paras.zh: - 不同的定价环境、更长的销售周期、更长的应收账款付款周期和收款问题；

paras.en: - new and different sources of competition;
paras.zh: - 新的和不同的竞争来源；

paras.en: - weaker protection for, and practical difficulties in enforcing, intellectual property and other legal rights outside of the United States compared to protections available domestically;
paras.zh: - 与美国国内可获得的保护相比，美国以外对知识产权和其他法律权利的保护较弱且实际执行困难；

paras.en: - laws and business practices favoring local competitors;
paras.zh: - 有利于当地竞争者的法律和商业惯例；

paras.en: - compliance challenges related to the complexity of multiple, conflicting, and changing governmental laws and regulations, including copyright, employment, tax, privacy, and data protection laws and regulations, export controls, and sanctions;
paras.zh: - 与多重、相互冲突且不断变化的政府法律法规（包括版权、就业、税务、隐私和数据保护法律法规、出口管制和制裁）的复杂性相关的合规挑战；

paras.en: - parties outside the United States seeking to circumvent sanctions and export controls;
paras.zh: - 美国境外试图规避制裁和出口管制的各方；

paras.en: - increased financial accounting and reporting burdens and complexities;
paras.zh: - 财务会计和报告负担及复杂性的增加；

paras.en: - increased costs in establishing infrastructure across various jurisdictions;
paras.zh: - 在不同司法管辖区建立基础设施的成本增加；

paras.en: - declines in the values of foreign currencies relative to the U.S. dollar;
paras.zh: - 外币兑美元贬值；

paras.en: - restrictions on the transfer of funds;
paras.zh: - 资金转移限制；

paras.en: - potentially adverse tax consequences;
paras.zh: - 潜在的不利税务后果；

paras.en: - the cost of and potential outcomes of any claims or litigation;
paras.zh: - 任何索赔或诉讼的成本及潜在结果；

paras.en: - future accounting pronouncements and changes in accounting policies;
paras.zh: - 未来的会计公告和会计政策变更；

paras.en: - changes in tax laws or tax regulations; and
paras.zh: - 税法或税务法规的变化；以及

paras.en: - regional and local economic and political conditions.
paras.zh: - 区域和地方经济及政治状况。

paras.en: Entry into certain transactions with non-U.S. entities or persons may be subject to government regulations and review, including review by U.S. or non-U.S. government entities related to contemplated or past foreign direct investment (“FDI”). In recent years, many countries around the world have adopted FDI regulatory regimes that seek to scrutinize investments into, and acquisitions of, domestic companies by non-domestic parties, granting governments broad discretion to review contemplated and past investment and acquisition transactions. These FDI regimes may restrict our ability to attract investments, invest in or fund partners outside of the United States that build or operate data centers or supply infrastructure for us, or acquire promising new technologies, companies, and talent in countries around the world, potentially limiting our ability to carry out our business strategy.
paras.zh: 与非美国实体或个人进行某些交易可能受到政府法规和审查的约束，包括美国或非美国政府实体对拟议或过往外国直接投资（“FDI”）的审查。近年来，全球许多国家已采用 FDI 监管制度，旨在审查非本国主体对本国公司的投资和收购，赋予政府广泛的自由裁量权以审查拟议和过往的投资及收购交易。这些 FDI 制度可能限制我们吸引投资、投资或资助美国境外为我们建设或运营数据中心或供应基础设施的合作伙伴，或收购世界各地有前景的新技术、公司和人才的能力，从而可能限制我们执行商业战略的能力。

paras.en: More broadly, increasing geopolitical tensions, shifting national security priorities, and evolving technology-focused trade, export control, investment, and data-governance regimes may result in restrictions, heightened scrutiny, or other limitations on our ability to operate, sell products, partner with customers, or deploy our models in certain jurisdictions or with certain counterparties. Governments may adopt or expand policies aimed at protecting domestic technology ecosystems, restricting the cross-border flow of data, or limiting access to AI systems, which could reduce our addressable market, increase compliance costs, or require operational changes. In particular, the U.S. government has increasingly scrutinized AI companies’ exposure to Chinese state actors, and future executive orders, legislation, or regulatory actions could restrict our ability to serve customers or users connected to China, impose new compliance obligations, lead us to implement anti-abuse mechanisms or other technical access restrictions, or limit the deployment of our models in ways that reduce our addressable market. Any escalation of U.S.-China tensions, retaliatory measures by either government, or failure or perceived failure by us to prevent non-U.S. state-actor access to or misuse of our technology could subject us to regulatory action, reputational harm, and adverse effects on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
paras.zh: 更广泛而言，地缘政治紧张局势加剧、国家安全优先事项的转变，以及以技术为重点的贸易、出口管制、投资和数据治理制度的演变，可能导致对我们运营、销售产品、与客户合作或在某些司法管辖区或与某些交易对手部署我们模型的能力施加限制、加强审查或其他限制。政府可能采纳或扩大旨在保护国内技术生态系统、限制数据跨境流动或限制 AI 系统访问的政策，这可能缩小我们的可寻址市场、增加合规成本或要求运营调整。特别是，美国政府日益关注 AI 公司与中国国家行为者的关联，未来的行政命令、立法或监管行动可能限制我们为中国相关客户或用户提供服务的能力，施加新的合规义务，导致我们实施反滥用机制或其他技术访问限制，或以缩小我们可寻址市场的方式限制我们模型的部署。美中紧张局势的任何升级、任何一方政府的报复措施，或我们未能或被认为未能防止非美国国家行为者访问或滥用我们的技术，都可能使我们面临监管行动、声誉损害，并对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。

paras.en: As we continue to expand our business globally, our success will depend, in large part, on our ability to anticipate and effectively manage these risks. These factors and others could adversely affect our ability to increase non-U.S. revenue and, consequently, could materially impact our business. The expansion of our existing non-U.S. operations and entry into additional non-U.S. markets will require significant management attention and financial resources. Our failure to successfully manage our non-U.S. operations and the associated risks effectively could limit the future growth of our business.
paras.zh: 随着我们持续在全球拓展业务，我们的成功将在很大程度上取决于我们预见并有效管理这些风险的能力。这些因素及其他因素可能对我们提升美国以外收入的能力造成不利影响，进而可能对我们的业务产生重大影响。我们现有美国以外业务的扩张以及进入更多美国以外市场，将需要大量的管理层关注和财务资源。若我们未能成功管理美国以外业务及相关风险并对其进行有效管控，可能会限制我们业务的未来增长。

paras.en: **Increasing scrutiny and changing expectations from global regulations, our investors, customers, and employees with respect to ESG may result in additional compliance risk and costs and may impact our reputation and business.**
paras.zh: **全球监管机构、我们的投资者、客户和员工对 ESG 日益严格的审视和不断变化的期望，可能带来额外的合规风险和成本，并可能影响我们的声誉和业务。**

paras.en: Companies across many industries are facing increasing scrutiny related to their environmental, social, and governance (“ESG”) practices and reporting, both in the United States and internationally. For example, new U.S. and non-U.S. laws and regulations relating to ESG matters, including environmental sustainability and climate change, are under consideration, being adopted, or being rolled back or revised, which may impact our necessary disclosures and increase compliance costs. Further, there is particular focus on concerns relating to AI and its impact on society and the environment, including the power-intensive nature of the industry, public concern regarding high consumption of water, and reliance on critical minerals and rare elements in the manufacture of chips. Some investors may use these non-financial performance factors to guide their investment strategies and, in some cases, may choose not to invest in us if they believe our policies and actions relating to ESG are inadequate.
paras.zh: 在美国及国际范围内，许多行业的公司在其环境、社会及治理（“ESG”）实践与报告方面正面临日益严格的审视。例如，与 ESG 事项（包括环境可持续性和气候变化）相关的美国及美国以外的新法律法规正处于审议、通过、或废止或修订之中，这可能影响我们必要的披露并增加合规成本。此外，人们尤其关注与 AI 及其对社会和环境的影响相关的问题，包括该行业的高耗电特性、公众对高耗水量的担忧，以及芯片制造对关键矿物和稀有元素的依赖。部分投资者可能利用这些非财务绩效因素来指导其投资策略，并在某些情况下，若其认为我们与 ESG 相关的政策和行动不足，可能选择不投资我们。

paras.en: Our sustainability initiatives, goals, or commitments could be difficult to achieve or costly to implement. Moreover, compliance with recently adopted and potential upcoming ESG requirements, including California legislation that requires various climate-related disclosures, the EU’s Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive, and the UK’s Streamlined Energy and Carbon Reporting framework will require the dedication of significant time and resources. At the same time, anti-ESG sentiment has gained momentum across the United States, particularly at the federal level, and the federal and certain state governments have enacted or proposed “anti-ESG” policies or legislation or have issued related legal opinions. Such policies, legislation, initiatives, and scrutiny could expose any sustainability, employment, governance, or other corporate practices we adopt to the risk of litigation, antitrust investigations or challenges by federal or state authorities, and result in injunctions, penalties, and reputational harm.
paras.zh: 我们的可持续发展举措、目标或承诺可能难以实现或实施成本高昂。此外，遵守近期通过及潜在即将出台的 ESG 要求，包括要求进行多项气候相关披露的加利福尼亚州立法、欧盟的《企业可持续发展报告指令》和《企业可持续发展尽职调查指令》，以及英国的《简化能源与碳报告》框架，将需要投入大量时间和资源。与此同时，反 ESG 情绪在美国各地、尤其是在联邦层面势头渐增，联邦及某些州政府已颁布或提出“反 ESG”政策或立法，或已发布相关法律意见。此类政策、立法、举措和审视可能使我们采取的任何可持续发展、雇佣、治理或其他公司实践面临诉讼、反垄断调查或联邦或州当局质疑的风险，并可能导致禁令、处罚和声誉损害。

paras.en: Additionally, if our competitors’ corporate social responsibility performance is perceived to be better than ours, potential or current investors may elect to invest with our competitors instead. Our business may face increased scrutiny related to these activities and our related disclosures, including from the investment community and the local communities in which we operate, and our failure to achieve progress or manage the dynamic, and at times conflicting, public sentiment and legal landscape in these areas on a timely basis, or at all, could adversely affect our reputation, business, and financial condition. Further, we may experience backlash from customers, government entities, advocacy groups, employees, or other stakeholders who disagree with our actual or perceived positions, or with our lack of position on social, environmental, governance, political, public policy, economic, geopolitical, or other sensitive issues. Any perceived lack of transparency about these matters could adversely affect our brand and reputation, our employees’ engagement and retention, and the willingness of our customers and partners to do business with us. Both advocates and opponents to ESG-related matters are increasingly resorting to a range of activism forms, including media campaigns and litigation, to advance their perspectives. To the extent we are subject to such activism, it may require us to incur costs or otherwise adversely affect our business, financial condition, or results of operations.
paras.zh: 此外，如果我们的竞争对手在企业社会责任方面的表现被认为优于我们，潜在或现有投资者可能会选择投资我们的竞争对手。我们的业务可能会因这些活动及相关披露而面临更多审视，包括来自投资界和我们开展经营所在当地社区的审视；如果我们未能及时或完全未能取得进展，或未能妥善应对这些领域动态且有时相互冲突的公众情绪和法律环境，可能会对我们的声誉、业务和财务状况造成不利影响。此外，我们可能会遭到客户、政府实体、倡导团体、员工或其他利益相关方的反对，原因是他们不认同我们实际或被认为的立场，或不认同我们在社会、环境、治理、政治、公共政策、经济、地缘政治或其他敏感议题上缺乏立场。如果外界认为我们在这些事项上缺乏透明度，可能会对我们的品牌和声誉、员工的投入度和留任率，以及客户和合作伙伴与我们开展业务的意愿造成不利影响。ESG 相关议题的支持者和反对者都越来越多地诉诸各种形式的行动主义，包括媒体宣传和诉讼，以推进其观点。如果我们受到此类行动主义的影响，可能需要承担成本，或以其他方式对我们的业务、财务状况或经营业绩造成不利影响。

paras.en: **If we or our payment processing partners fail to manage the risks related to our payment processing activities, we could be subject to fines, regulatory scrutiny, disruptions to our business, or reputational harm.**
paras.zh: **如果我们或我们的支付处理合作伙伴未能管理与支付处理活动相关的风险，我们可能会面临罚款、监管审查、业务中断或声誉损害。**

paras.en: A portion of our customers authorize us to bill their credit card accounts through our third-party payment processing partners for our paid subscriptions. We have experienced, and expect to continue to experience, fraudulent activity, including the creation of accounts using false identities and the use of stolen or otherwise unauthorized payment credentials, which has resulted, and may in the future result, in losses, including payment processing fees, chargeback fees, and fines and penalties imposed by our payment processors or card networks, for which we may not be reimbursed. We maintain fraud-detection and identity-verification measures, but these measures have not identified, and may not identify, all such activity. Further, our customers provide us with credit card billing information online, and we do not verify the physical identity of cardholders or conduct additional verification beyond what we collect online, which increases our risk of exposure to fraudulent activity.
paras.zh: 我们的一部分客户授权我们通过第三方支付处理合作伙伴，就其付费订阅向客户的信用卡账户收费。我们曾经遭遇并预计将继续遭遇欺诈活动，包括使用虚假身份创建账户以及使用被盗或其他未经授权的支付凭证；这些活动已经并可能在未来给我们造成损失，包括支付处理费、拒付费用以及支付处理商或卡组织施加的罚款和处罚，且我们可能无法获得补偿。我们设有欺诈检测和身份验证措施，但这些措施未能识别、且可能无法识别所有此类活动。此外，客户在线向我们提供信用卡账单信息，我们不会核实持卡人的真实身份，也不会在我们在线收集的信息之外进行额外验证，这增加了我们暴露于欺诈活动的风险。

paras.en: We also incur chargebacks when customers or card issuers claim that a transaction was unauthorized or otherwise improper. If the volume of chargebacks were to become excessive, we could be subject to higher processing fees, additional fines, fraud mitigation requirements, or the termination or suspension of our ability to accept certain payment methods, including credit cards, through one or more payment processors.
paras.zh: 当客户或发卡机构声称某笔交易未经授权或以其他方式不当，我们也会产生拒付。如果拒付量过大，我们可能会面临更高的处理费、额外罚款、欺诈缓解要求，或通过一家或多家支付处理商接受某些支付方式（包括信用卡）的能力被终止或暂停。

paras.en: In addition, payment processors, card networks, and financial institutions periodically revise their rules, standards, and practices, including data protection and documentation standards, required to utilize their services from time to time. Our compliance with these evolving requirements, and the continued compliance of our third-party payment processing partners, may require additional operational resources and expense. Failure by us or our payment processing partners to comply with applicable standards could result in fines, increased scrutiny, disruptions to our business and our ability to process payments for our intelligence service, or reputational harm.
paras.zh: 此外，支付处理商、卡组织及金融机构会不时修订其规则、标准与做法，包括使用其服务所需的数据保护与文档标准。我们遵守这些不断变化的要求，以及我们第三方支付处理合作伙伴的持续合规，可能需要额外的运营资源和费用。我们或我们的支付处理合作伙伴未能遵守适用标准，可能导致罚款、受到更严格的审查、业务中断以及我们为智能服务处理付款的能力受损，或造成声誉损害。

full.sec: Risks Related to Tax and Accounting Matters
full.secZh: 与税务和会计事项相关的风险

paras.en: **Changes in tax laws or regulations could be enacted, or existing tax laws or regulations could be applied to us or our customers in a manner that could increase the costs of our models, platform, and applications and adversely affect our business.**
paras.zh: **税法或法规的变更可能被颁布，或者现行税法或法规可能以增加我们模型、平台和应用程序成本的方式适用于我们或我们的客户，从而对我们的业务产生不利影响。**

paras.en: We operate in multiple jurisdictions and are subject to tax laws and regulations of U.S. federal, state, and local and non-U.S. governments. Income, sales, use, or other tax laws, statutes, rules, regulations, or ordinances could be enacted or amended at any time (possibly with retroactive effect) and could be applied solely or disproportionately to models, platforms, and applications provided over the internet. These enactments or amendments could reduce our sales activity due to the inherent cost increase the taxes would represent and ultimately harm our results of operations and cash flows. Further, the application of U.S. federal, state, local, and non-U.S. tax laws to services provided electronically is unclear and continuously evolving. Existing tax laws, statutes, rules, regulations, or ordinances could be interpreted or applied adversely to us, possibly with retroactive effect, which could require us or our customers to pay additional tax amounts, as well as fines or penalties, and interest for past amounts. If we are unsuccessful in collecting such taxes due from our customers, we would be held liable for such costs, thereby adversely affecting our results of operations and harming our business.
paras.zh: 我们在多个司法管辖区运营，并受美国联邦、州和地方以及非美国政府税法和法规的约束。所得税、销售税、使用税或其他税法、法规、规则、规章或条例可能随时被颁布或修订（可能具有追溯效力），并可能仅或不成比例地适用于通过互联网提供的模型、平台和应用程序。这些颁布或修订可能因税收所代表的固有成本增加而减少我们的销售活动，并最终损害我们的经营业绩和现金流。此外，美国联邦、州、地方和非美国税法对以电子方式提供的服务的适用尚不明确且不断演变。现行税法、法规、规则、规章或条例可能被解释或适用于对我们不利的情形，可能具有追溯效力，这可能要求我们或我们的客户支付额外税款，以及罚款或处罚，以及过往金额的利息。如果我们未能成功向客户收取该等应缴税款，我们将对此类成本承担责任，从而对我们的经营业绩产生不利影响并损害我们的业务。

paras.en: As we expand the scale of our non-U.S. business activities, any changes in the U.S. or non-U.S. taxation of such activities may increase our worldwide effective tax rate and harm our business, financial condition, and results of operations. We may be subject to taxation in several jurisdictions around the world with increasingly complex tax laws, the application of which can be uncertain. In addition, our hiring of personnel and engagement of third-party employer-of-record providers in non-U.S. jurisdictions, as well as our data center and other infrastructure activities outside the United States, have created, and may in the future create, permanent establishments or other taxable presence in those jurisdictions, which could subject us to additional income, withholding, and indirect taxes, as well as interest, penalties, and additional compliance obligations. In advance of forming and obtaining approvals for local operating entities, we have entered into, and expect to enter into additional letters of intent, leases, and other agreements relating to our international compute and infrastructure activities through interim contracting arrangements with existing entities, and we may be unable to transfer these arrangements to local entities on a timely basis or at all. Any prolonged reliance on these interim arrangements, or any failure to migrate them to local entities, could increase our exposure to permanent establishment or other taxable-presence determinations and could result in non-recoverable value-added or similar indirect taxes, which could be material in certain jurisdictions. Although we have not been required to pay income taxes, other than in immaterial amounts in certain jurisdictions to date, the amount of taxes we pay in these jurisdictions could increase substantially as a result of changes in the applicable tax principles, including increased tax rates, new tax laws, or revised interpretations of existing tax laws and precedents, which could adversely affect our liquidity and results of operations. For example, a number of countries and organizations, such as the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (“OECD”), have proposed changes to existing tax laws or new laws that could impact our tax obligations, including a framework that imposes a 15% global minimum tax, which has been implemented into the domestic laws of some jurisdictions in the EU, among other jurisdictions, and is being considered for implementation by other countries. On January 5, 2026, the OECD announced a “side-by-side” elective safe harbor that exempts electing U.S.-parented multinational entities from certain provisions of the global minimum tax for fiscal years beginning on or after January 1, 2026. In addition, the authorities in these jurisdictions could review our tax returns and impose additional tax, interest, and penalties, and the authorities could claim that various withholding requirements apply to us or our subsidiaries or assert that benefits of tax treaties are not available to us or our subsidiaries, any of which would harm us and our results of operations.
paras.zh: 随着我们非美国业务活动规模的扩大，美国或非美国对此类活动征税方式的任何变化都可能提高我们的全球实际税率，并损害我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩。我们可能在全球多个司法管辖区纳税，这些辖区的税法日益复杂，其适用可能存在不确定性。此外，我们在非美国司法管辖区聘用人员及聘请第三方名义雇主服务提供商，以及我们在美国境外的数据中心和其他基础设施活动，已经并可能在未来在这些司法管辖区构成常设机构或其他应税存在，这可能使我们承担额外的所得税、预提税和间接税，以及利息、罚款和额外的合规义务。在设立当地运营实体并获得批准之前，我们已通过现有实体的临时合同安排，就我们的国际算力和基础设施活动签订了意向书、租赁协议及其他协议，并预计将签订更多此类协议，而我们可能无法及时或根本无法将这些安排转移至当地实体。任何对这些临时安排的长期依赖，或未能将其迁移至当地实体，都可能增加我们被认定为常设机构或其他应税存在的风险，并可能导致无法收回的增值税或类似间接税，这在某些司法管辖区可能具有重大影响。尽管迄今为止我们除在某些司法管辖区缴纳了不重大的金额外无需缴纳所得税，但由于适用税收原则的变化（包括税率提高、新税法或对现有税法和判例的修订解释），我们在这些司法管辖区缴纳的税款金额可能大幅增加，这可能对我们的流动性和经营业绩产生不利影响。例如，多个国家和组织(如经济合作与发展组织（“OECD”）)已提议修改现有税法或制定新法，可能影响我们的纳税义务，包括一项征收 15% 全球最低税的框架，该框架已在欧盟等一些司法管辖区的国内法中实施，其他国家正在考虑实施。2026 年 1 月 5 日，OECD 宣布了一项“并行”可选安全港，对选择适用的美国母公司跨国实体豁免全球最低税的某些条款，适用于 2026 年 1 月 1 日或之后开始的财政年度。此外，这些司法管辖区的税务机关可能审查我们的纳税申报表并征收额外税款、利息和罚款，且税务机关可能主张各种预提税要求适用于我们或我们的子公司，或主张我们或我们的子公司无法享受税收协定优惠，任何此类情况都将损害我们及我们的经营业绩。

paras.en: **Our business, financial condition, and results of operations may be adversely affected if we are required to collect sales or other related taxes for subscriptions to our models, platform, and applications in jurisdictions where we have not historically done so.**
paras.zh: **如果我们被要求在历史上未曾征收销售税或其他相关税费的司法管辖区就我们模型、平台和应用程序的订阅收取销售税或其他相关税费，我们的业务、财务状况和经营成果可能会受到不利影响。**

paras.en: We collect sales tax in a number of jurisdictions. Sales, use, value added, digital service, and similar tax laws and rates vary by jurisdiction. One or more states or countries may seek to impose incremental or new sales, use, or other tax collection obligations on us. A successful assertion by a state, country, or other jurisdiction that we should have been or should be collecting additional sales, use, or other taxes could, among other things, result in substantial tax payments, create significant administrative burdens for us, discourage potential customers from subscribing to our models, platform, and applications due to the incremental cost of any such sales or other related taxes, or otherwise harm our business, financial condition, and results of operations. Further, certain jurisdictions in which we operate have enacted a digital services tax, which is generally a tax on gross revenue generated from users or customers located in those jurisdictions, and other jurisdictions are considering enacting similar laws. Any successful action by taxing authorities to compel us to collect and remit sales, use, value added, digital service, and similar tax laws, either retroactively, prospectively, or both, may adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
paras.zh: 我们在多个司法管辖区征收销售税。销售税、使用税、增值税、数字服务税及类似税法的规定和税率因司法管辖区而异。一个或多个州或国家可能寻求对我们施加增量或新的销售税、使用税或其他税费代收义务。若某一州、国家或其他司法管辖区成功主张我们本应或应当代收额外的销售税、使用税或其他税费，除其他后果外，可能导致我们承担大额税款、给我们带来重大行政负担、因任何此类销售税或其他相关税费带来的增量成本而使潜在客户不愿订阅我们的模型、平台和应用程序，或以其他方式损害我们的业务、财务状况和经营成果。此外，我们开展业务的某些司法管辖区已颁布数字服务税，该税通常针对来自位于这些司法管辖区的用户或客户所产生的总收入征收，其他司法管辖区也正在考虑颁布类似法律。税务机关若成功采取任何行动，强制我们追溯、前瞻或同时追溯和前瞻地代收并缴纳销售税、使用税、增值税、数字服务税及类似税费，可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营成果产生不利影响。

paras.en: **Our ability to use our net operating loss carryforwards and certain other tax attributes may be limited.**
paras.zh: **我们使用净经营亏损结转和某些其他税收属性的能力可能受到限制。**

paras.en: We have incurred substantial net operating losses (“NOLs”) during our history. In general, under Sections 382 and 383 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”), a corporation that undergoes an “ownership change” is subject to annual limitations on its ability to utilize its pre-change U.S. federal NOL carryforwards and certain other tax attributes, including tax credit carryforwards, to offset its future taxable income or tax liabilities. For these purposes, an ownership change generally occurs if the percentage of a corporation’s stock (by value) owned by one or more “5-percent shareholders” increases by more than 50 percentage points over a rolling three-year period. We have experienced ownership changes in the past, and we may experience ownership changes in the future, including as a result of this offering or subsequent shifts in our stock ownership, some of which may be outside our control. NOLs and other tax attributes of companies we have acquired are, and of companies we may acquire may be, subject to similar limitations. Similar provisions of state tax law and the tax laws of non-U.S. jurisdictions may also limit our ability to utilize state and non-U.S. NOL carryforwards and other tax attributes. In addition, certain states, including California, have suspended or otherwise limited the use of NOL carryforwards and other tax attributes, which could accelerate or permanently increase our state income tax liabilities. Separately, under current law, U.S. federal NOLs arising in taxable years beginning after December 31, 2017 may be used to offset only 80% of taxable income in any year, whether or not an ownership change occurs. As a result of the foregoing, even if we attain profitability, we may be unable to use all or a material portion of our NOLs and other tax attributes, which could adversely affect our future cash flows and results of operations.
paras.zh: 我们在历史上已产生大额净经营亏损（“NOL”）。一般而言，根据经修订的 1986 年《国内税收法典》（“《法典》”）第 382 条和第 383 条，发生“所有权变更”的公司，其利用变更前美国联邦 NOL 结转额及某些其他税收属性（包括税收抵免结转额）抵减未来应纳税所得额或纳税义务的能力，须受年度限制。就此而言，若一名或多名“5%股东”所持公司股票（按价值计）的比例在滚动三年期内增加超过 50 个百分点，通常即发生所有权变更。我们过去曾经历所有权变更，未来也可能经历所有权变更，包括因本次发行或其后我们股票所有权的变动所致，其中部分变动可能超出我们的控制范围。我们已收购公司以及我们可能收购公司的 NOL 及其他税收属性，现在及将来可能受到类似限制。州税法及非美国司法辖区税法的类似规定也可能限制我们利用州及非美国 NOL 结转额和其他税收属性的能力。此外，包括加利福尼亚州在内的某些州已暂停或以其他方式限制 NOL 结转额和其他税收属性的使用，这可能加速或永久增加我们的州所得税负债。另外，根据现行法律，2017 年 12 月 31 日之后开始的纳税年度所产生的美国联邦 NOL，无论是否发生所有权变更，在任何年度均仅可用于抵减应纳税所得额的 80%。鉴于上述情况，即使我们实现盈利，我们也可能无法使用全部或重大部分的 NOL 及其他税收属性，这可能对我们的未来现金流量和经营业绩产生不利影响。

paras.en: **Our corporate structure and intercompany arrangements are subject to the tax laws of multiple jurisdictions, and we could be required to pay additional taxes, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.**
paras.zh: **我们的公司架构和公司间安排须受多个司法辖区税法的约束，我们可能被要求缴纳额外税款，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。**

paras.en: As we continue to expand our non-U.S. operations, we are, and may increasingly be, required to report taxable income in various jurisdictions around the world based on our business activities in those jurisdictions. Our corporate structure and associated transfer pricing policies reflect the functions, risks, and assets of the entities involved in our intercompany transactions. However, our tax position is subject to various risks, including increases in tax rates, new or revised tax laws (which may apply retroactively), and new interpretations of existing tax laws and policies by taxing authorities or courts, any of which could increase our overall tax obligations.
paras.zh: 随着我们持续拓展非美国业务，我们目前且可能日益需要根据我们在全球各司法辖区的业务活动，在这些辖区申报应纳税所得额。我们的公司架构及相关转让定价政策反映了参与我们公司间交易各实体的职能、风险和资产。然而，我们的税务状况面临多种风险，包括税率上升、新制定或修订的税法（可能具有追溯效力），以及税务机关或法院对现行税法及政策作出新解释，其中任何一项都可能增加我们的整体纳税义务。

paras.en: Our intercompany transactions are subject to complex transfer pricing rules administered by tax authorities in the jurisdictions in which we operate, many of which apply divergent, and sometimes conflicting, legal standards. Tax authorities may take inconsistent positions regarding the application of the arm’s-length principle, the characterization or valuation of our intellectual property, or the pricing of intercompany services and other transactions. If a tax authority successfully challenges our transfer pricing or the allocation of income and expenses among jurisdictions, we could be required to reallocate income or pay additional taxes, interest, and penalties. If the jurisdiction from which income is reallocated does not agree with the adjustment, we could also be subject to double taxation. In addition, certain of our cross-border contracting arrangements, including infrastructure-related agreements entered into by U.S. entities pending the formation of local subsidiaries, may give rise to non-recoverable value-added or similar indirect taxes or other tax costs, which could be material depending on the jurisdiction.
paras.zh: 我们的公司间交易受我们经营所在司法管辖区的税务机关实施的复杂转让定价规则约束，其中许多税务机关适用不同、有时甚至相互冲突的法律标准。税务机关可能就独立交易原则的适用、我们知识产权的定性或估值，或公司间服务及其他交易的定价采取不一致的立场。如果税务机关成功质疑我们的转让定价或收入与费用在各司法管辖区之间的分配，我们可能被要求重新分配收入或支付额外税款、利息和罚款。如果收入被重新分配的司法管辖区不同意该调整，我们还可能面临双重征税。此外，我们的某些跨境合同安排，包括美国实体在地方子公司设立前签订的基础设施相关协议，可能产生不可抵扣的增值税或类似间接税或其他税务成本，视司法管辖区而定，这些成本可能重大。

paras.en: Although we believe our tax positions are reasonable, our tax reserves are adequate, and our transfer pricing practices reflect arm’s-length terms, tax authorities may disagree with our assumptions, judgments, and estimates. If a tax authority were to prevail in asserting that our intercompany arrangements do not satisfy applicable transfer pricing requirements, we could be required to pay additional taxes, interest, and penalties that exceed our reserves. Such an outcome could increase our effective tax rate, reduce our cash flows, and adversely affect our ability to achieve and sustain profitability.
paras.zh: 尽管我们认为我们的税务立场合理、我们的税务准备金充足，且我们的转让定价实践反映独立交易条款，但税务机关可能不同意我们的假设、判断和估计。如果税务机关成功主张我们的公司间安排不满足适用的转让定价要求，我们可能被要求支付超出我们准备金的额外税款、利息和罚款。此类结果可能提高我们的实际税率、减少我们的现金流，并对我们实现和维持盈利能力的能力产生不利影响。

paras.en: **If our judgments or estimates relating to our critical accounting policies prove to be incorrect, our results of operations may be adversely affected.**
paras.zh: **如果我们与关键会计政策相关的判断或估计被证明不正确，我们的经营业绩可能受到不利影响。**

paras.en: The preparation of financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires management to make judgments in applying our accounting policies and to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported on our consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes. We base our estimates in part on historical experience, market observable inputs, if available, and various other assumptions that we believe to be reasonable under the circumstances, as provided in the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Critical Accounting Estimates.” Significant accounting policies, estimates, and assumptions used in preparing our consolidated financial statements include, but are not limited to, revenue recognition, stock-based compensation, common stock valuations, fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs, leases, income taxes, and loss contingencies. In addition, we engage in complex and novel transactions and may be required to consolidate certain assets or entities on our financial statements, which may involve significant judgment and could result in volatility in our reported results of operations. Our results of operations may be adversely affected if our assumptions change or if actual circumstances differ from those in our assumptions, which may cause our results of operations to fall below the expectations of securities analysts and investors and cause a decline in the market price of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 按照 GAAP 编制财务报表要求管理层在应用我们的会计政策时作出判断，并作出影响我们合并财务报表及附注所报告金额的估计和假设。我们的估计部分基于历史经验、可获取的市场可观察输入值，以及我们认为在相关情况下合理的各项其他假设，详见“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——关键会计估计”一节。编制合并财务报表所采用的重要会计政策、估计和假设包括但不限于：收入确认、股权激励费用、普通股估值、可转换本票的公允价值、衍生负债及未来股权简单协议（SAFE）、租赁、所得税和或有损失。此外，我们会进行复杂且新颖的交易，可能被要求在我们的财务报表中合并某些资产或实体，这可能涉及重大判断，并可能导致我们报告的经营成果出现波动。如果我们的假设发生变化，或实际情况与假设不符，我们的经营成果可能受到不利影响，进而可能导致我们的经营成果低于证券分析师和投资者的预期，并导致我们 A 类普通股的市场价格下跌。

paras.en: **If we fail to maintain an effective system of disclosure controls and internal control over financial reporting, our ability to produce timely and accurate financial statements or comply with applicable regulations may be impaired, which may adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.**
paras.zh: **如果我们未能维持有效的披露控制及财务报告内部控制体系，我们及时、准确编制财务报表或遵守适用法规的能力可能受到损害，进而可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营成果产生不利影响。**

paras.en: As a public company, we will be subject to the reporting requirements of the Exchange Act, the Sarbanes-Oxley Act, and the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market. The Sarbanes-Oxley Act and related Exchange Act rules require, among other things, that we maintain effective disclosure controls and procedures and internal control over financial reporting. We are continuing to develop and refine our disclosure controls and other procedures that are designed to assure that information required to be disclosed by us in the reports that we will file with the SEC is recorded, processed, summarized, and reported within the time periods specified in SEC rules and forms and that information required to be disclosed in reports under the Exchange Act is accumulated and communicated to management, including our principal executive and financial officers, to allow timely decisions regarding disclosure. We are also continuing to improve our internal control over financial reporting. We have expended, and anticipate that we will continue to expend, significant resources to maintain and improve the effectiveness of our disclosure controls and procedures and internal control over financial reporting.
paras.zh: 作为一家上市公司，我们将受《交易法》、《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》以及纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准的报告要求约束。《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》及《交易法》相关规则要求我们（其中包括）维持有效的披露控制与程序以及财务报告内部控制。我们正在持续制定和完善我们的披露控制及其他程序，旨在确保我们向 SEC 提交的报告中要求披露的信息在 SEC 规则和表格规定的期限内被记录、处理、汇总和报告，并确保根据《交易法》在报告中要求披露的信息被积累并传达给管理层（包括我们的主要执行官和财务官），以便及时就披露作出决策。我们也在持续改进财务报告内部控制。我们已投入并将继续投入大量资源，以维持并提高我们的披露控制与程序以及财务报告内部控制的有效性。

paras.en: Our current controls and any new controls that we develop may become inadequate because of changes in the conditions in our business. Further, weaknesses in our disclosure controls, procedures, or internal control over financial reporting may be discovered in the future. Any failure to develop or maintain effective controls, or any difficulties encountered in their implementation or improvement, may adversely affect our results of operations or cause us to fail to meet our reporting obligations and may result in a restatement of our financial statements for prior periods. We also rely on distribution partners and other third-party service providers to process and store data underlying our financial reporting. Our ability to maintain effective internal controls therefore depends in part on the design and operating effectiveness of controls maintained by these third parties, and our ability to audit or remediate deficiencies in such third-party control environments is limited.
paras.zh: 我们现有的控制措施以及我们未来制定的任何新控制措施，都可能因业务状况的变化而变得不充分。此外，未来可能会发现我们的披露控制、程序或财务报告内部控制存在缺陷。任何未能制定或维持有效控制措施的情况，或在其执行或改进过程中遇到的任何困难，都可能对我们的经营业绩产生不利影响，或导致我们未能履行报告义务，并可能导致我们对前期财务报表进行重述。我们还依赖分销合作伙伴和其他第三方服务提供商来处理和存储我们财务报告所依据的数据。因此，我们维持有效内部控制的能力部分取决于这些第三方所维持控制措施的设计和运行有效性，而我们审计或整改此类第三方控制环境中缺陷的能力是有限的。

paras.en: Any failure to implement and maintain effective internal control over financial reporting may also adversely affect the results of periodic management evaluations and annual independent registered public accounting firm attestation reports regarding the effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting that we will eventually be required to include in our periodic reports that will be filed with the SEC. Ineffective disclosure controls and procedures and internal control over financial reporting may also cause investors to lose confidence in our reported financial and other information, which would likely adversely affect the market price of our Class A common stock. In addition, if we are unable to continue to meet these requirements, we may not be able to remain listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market. We are not currently required to comply with the SEC rules that implement Section 404 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and are therefore not required to make a formal assessment of the effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting for that purpose. As a public company, we will be required to provide an annual management report on the effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting commencing with our second annual report on Form 10-K.
paras.zh: 任何未能实施和维持有效的财务报告内部控制的情况，也可能对定期管理层评估以及独立注册会计师事务所关于我们财务报告内部控制有效性的年度鉴证报告产生不利影响，我们最终将被要求将这些内容纳入我们向 SEC 提交的定期报告中。无效的披露控制与程序以及财务报告内部控制也可能导致投资者对我们报告的财务及其他信息失去信心，这很可能对我们的 A 类普通股市场价格产生不利影响。此外，如果我们无法继续满足这些要求，我们可能无法继续在纳斯达克全球精选市场上市。我们目前无需遵守实施《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》第 404 条的 SEC 规则，因此无需为此目的对我们的财务报告内部控制有效性进行正式评估。作为一家上市公司，我们将被要求自第二份 Form 10-K 年度报告起，提供关于我们财务报告内部控制有效性的年度管理层报告。

paras.en: **We are exposed to fluctuations in interest rates and currency exchange rates, which could negatively affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.**
paras.zh: **我们面临利率和汇率波动的风险，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生负面影响。**

paras.en: We hold a significant amount of cash, cash equivalents, and investments, a substantial portion of which is invested in instruments with variable or market-based interest rates. As a result, our investment income is sensitive to changes in prevailing interest rates. A decline in interest rates could reduce the income we earn on these investments, which could adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations. In addition, volatility in interest rates may impact the fair value of our investment portfolio and could affect our overall financial performance.
paras.zh: 我们持有大量现金、现金等价物和投资，其中很大一部分投资于浮动利率或基于市场利率的工具。因此，我们的投资收益对现行利率的变化较为敏感。利率下降可能减少我们从这些投资中获得的收益，这可能对我们的财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。此外，利率波动可能影响我们投资组合的公允价值，并可能影响我们的整体财务表现。

paras.en: Our sales are currently denominated in U.S. dollars, euros, and the pound sterling, and will likely be denominated in other currencies in the future. Because we report our results of operations and revenue in U.S. dollars, we are exposed to foreign currency translation risk and may in the future face additional foreign currency risks. For example, a strengthening of the U.S. dollar compared to these foreign currencies could increase the real cost of our models, platform, and applications to non-U.S. customers, which could reduce demand for our models, platform, and applications and adversely affect our results of operations. In addition, as our non-U.S. operations expand, an increasing portion of our operating expenses may be denominated in foreign currencies and subject to fluctuations due to changes in foreign currency exchange rates. If we are not able to effectively manage these risks, including through any hedging activities, our financial condition and results of operations could be adversely affected.
paras.zh: 我们目前的销售以美元、欧元和英镑计价，未来可能以其他货币计价。由于我们以美元报告经营业绩和收入，我们面临外币折算风险，未来还可能面临额外的外汇风险。例如，美元相对这些外币走强，可能提高我们的模型、平台和应用程序对美国以外客户的实际成本，从而可能降低对我们模型、平台和应用程序的需求，并对我们的经营业绩产生不利影响。此外，随着我们非美国业务的扩张，我们经营费用中可能有越来越大的部分以外币计价，并受外汇汇率变动引起的波动影响。如果我们无法有效管理这些风险（包括通过任何对冲活动），我们的财务状况和经营业绩可能受到不利影响。

full.sec: Risks Related to our Governance Structure
full.secZh: 与我们的治理结构相关的风险

paras.en: **Our capital stock structure features certain provisions that are novel or otherwise not common among other corporations with multiple-class structures, and may effectively eliminate the ability of holders of our Class A common stock to influence important decisions, including a change in control.**
paras.zh: **我们的股本结构具有某些在拥有多类别结构的其他公司中并不常见或属新颖的条款，可能实际上消除我们 A 类普通股持有人影响重要决策（包括控制权变更）的能力。**

paras.en: We have a novel capital and corporate governance structure that has no direct public company precedent. We are incorporated as a PBC under Delaware law. As a PBC, we are required to balance the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and the Company Purpose identified in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation. In addition, the LTBT possesses certain rights that are designed to help ensure that we are managed in a manner that responsibly balances our goals as a PBC. Through a special class of common stock, Class T common stock, the LTBT generally has the authority to elect and remove the Class T directors, who together will constitute a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors. See the section titled “Our Governance Structure and Its Goals—Long-Term Benefit Trust— Election and Removal of Directors” for more information. The LTBT is intended to operate as an independent body of five financially disinterested Trustees, and our Class T common stock has no economic rights. As a result, the LTBT may have interests that differ from yours, and it may exercise its power in a way with which you disagree or in a way that may be adverse to your interests. Immediately prior to the completion of this offering, we will also issue a single share of Class F common stock, a special class of our common stock, to the Founder LLC. Our Class F common stock will be entitled to an aggregate number of votes that equals 50.1% of the total voting power of our outstanding shares of capital stock as of the applicable record date with respect to matters submitted to stockholders generally, including the election of our directors other than the Class T directors. Upon the completion of this offering, we will also authorize a special class of our common stock, Class E common stock, which we will issue to our employees, excluding our co-founders. Our Class E common stock will be entitled to vote only on certain limited matters and will not have any economic rights. Under this governance structure, we expect that the LTBT and the Founder LLC will collectively have the ability to elect all members of our board of directors, and the Founder LLC will have the ability to determine the outcome of all matters submitted to a vote of our stockholders generally for the foreseeable future. Accordingly, holders of our Class A common stock generally will not be able to affect the outcome of any matter submitted to a vote of our stockholders or the election of our directors, regardless of how they vote, unless a majority of the Continuing Founders (as defined below) cannot agree on how our Class F common stock will be voted (in which case our Class F common stock will generally be voted proportionately with the votes of our Class A common stock cast on the matter).
paras.zh: 我们拥有一种在上市公司中没有直接先例的新颖资本与公司治理结构。我们依据特拉华州法律注册为公益公司（PBC）。作为一家 PBC，我们必须平衡股东的金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益，以及我们经修订和重述的公司章程中确定的公司宗旨。此外，LTBT 拥有某些权利，旨在帮助确保我们以负责任地平衡我们作为 PBC 的目标的方式进行管理。通过一个特殊类别的普通股——T 类普通股，LTBT 通常有权选举和罢免 T 类董事，这些董事合计将构成我们董事会授权成员的多数。更多信息请参见标题为“我们的治理结构及其目标——长期利益信托——董事的选举和罢免”的章节。LTBT 旨在作为一个由五名财务上无利害关系的受托人组成的独立机构运作，我们的 T 类普通股不享有任何经济权利。因此，LTBT 可能拥有与您不同的利益，并可能以您不同意的方式或以可能对您的利益不利的方式行使其权力。在本次发行完成之前，我们还将向创始人有限责任公司发行一股 F 类普通股，这是我们普通股的一个特殊类别。我们的 F 类普通股将有权获得相当于截至适用记录日我们已发行股本总投票权 50.1%的合计票数，涉及一般提交给股东的事项，包括选举除 T 类董事以外的我们的董事。在本次发行完成后，我们还将授权一个特殊类别的普通股——E 类普通股，我们将向我们的员工（不包括我们的联合创始人）发行该类别股票。我们的 E 类普通股仅有权就某些有限事项投票，且不享有任何经济权利。根据这一治理结构，我们预计 LTBT 和创始人有限责任公司将共同拥有选举我们董事会所有成员的能力，并且在可预见的未来，创始人有限责任公司将拥有决定所有一般提交给我们股东投票的事项的结果的能力。因此，我们 A 类普通股的持有人通常将无法影响提交给我们股东投票的任何事项的结果或我们董事的选举，无论他们如何投票，除非多数持续创始人（定义见下文）无法就我们的 F 类普通股将如何投票达成一致（在这种情况下，我们的 F 类普通股通常将按就该事项所投的 A 类普通股投票比例进行投票）。

paras.en: Our governance structure is likely to have the effect of limiting the likelihood of an unsolicited merger proposal, unsolicited tender offer, or proxy contest for the removal of directors. As a result, our governance structure may make it more difficult to replace our directors and management and may have the effect of depriving our stockholders of an opportunity to sell their shares at a premium over prevailing market prices.
paras.zh: 我们的治理结构很可能产生限制未经请求的合并提议、未经请求的收购要约或罢免董事的委托书争夺战发生可能性的效果。因此，我们的治理结构可能使更换我们的董事和管理层变得更加困难，并可能产生剥夺我们股东以高于现行市场价格溢价出售其股份机会的效果。

paras.en: We cannot predict whether our structure will result in lower demand for our Class A common stock, increased volatility, adverse publicity, or other adverse consequences. In particular, the absence of judicial precedent interpreting this structure increases the risk and unpredictability of governance-related litigation, and courts may interpret the obligations inherent in our structure in ways that we might not anticipate.
paras.zh: 我们无法预测我们的结构是否会导致对我们 A 类普通股的需求下降、波动性增加、不利的媒体报道或其他不利后果。特别是，缺乏解释这一结构的司法先例增加了治理相关诉讼的风险和不可预测性，法院可能以我们无法预料的方式解释我们结构中固有的义务。

paras.en: **Our capital structure will concentrate voting power with the LTBT and the Founder LLC for the foreseeable future and will result in the LTBT and the Founder LLC having voting power that is not derived from or proportionate to economic interests in our company.**
paras.zh: **在可预见的未来，我们的资本结构将使投票权集中于 LTBT 和创始人有限责任公司，并将导致 LTBT 和创始人有限责任公司拥有并非源自或并不成比例于我们公司经济利益的投票权。**

paras.en: Our Class T common stock will generally entitle the LTBT to elect and remove the Class T directors, who together will constitute a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors. Our Class T common stock will remain outstanding indefinitely, subject to the right of our board of directors and the Trustees or specified majorities of our Class A common stock, Class E common stock, and Class F common stock to amend or terminate the terms of the LTBT or the rights of our Class T common stock or to redeem our Class T common stock (such time as no share of Class T common stock is outstanding, the “Class T Sunset Time”). The Class T common stock may also be transferred without restriction upon the receipt of the same approvals required to amend, terminate, or redeem it. We intentionally structured the Class T common stock in this manner to preserve long-term flexibility if circumstances change. If the Class T common stock were transferred to a person or entity that is not affiliated with the LTBT or is not otherwise required to consider the Company Purpose, for so long as we remain a PBC, all of our directors, regardless of how they are elected, would continue to be obligated to act in accordance with Delaware law and our certificate of incorporation, bylaws, and other governing documents as then in effect, including those provisions relating to our public benefit purpose. The Trust Agreement (as defined below) limits Trustee compensation to a reasonable cash amount fixed annually by the Trustees. Trustee compensation will not vary with or be conditioned upon the profits or any action or inaction of our company. The policies of the LTBT prohibit a Trustee from directly purchasing or holding any of our securities.
paras.zh: 我们的 T 类普通股通常将赋予 LTBT 选举和罢免 T 类董事的权利，这些董事合计将构成我们董事会授权成员的多数。我们的 T 类普通股将无限期存续，但须受我们董事会和受托人，或我们 A 类普通股、E 类普通股和 F 类普通股的特定多数股东修订或终止 LTBT 条款或我们 T 类普通股权利，或赎回我们 T 类普通股的权利的约束（在无 T 类普通股流通在外的时点，即“T 类日落时间”）。T 类普通股在获得修订、终止或赎回其所需的相同批准后，也可不受限制地转让。我们有意以这种方式构建 T 类普通股，以便在情况变化时保持长期灵活性。如果 T 类普通股被转让给与 LTBT 无关联或无需考虑公司宗旨的个人或实体，则只要我们仍为 PBC，我们所有董事，无论其如何当选，都将继续有义务按照特拉华州法律以及我们当时有效的公司注册证书、章程和其他治理文件行事，包括与我们公共利益宗旨相关的条款。《信托协议》（定义见下文）将受托人薪酬限制为受托人每年确定的合理现金金额。受托人薪酬不会随我们公司的利润或任何作为或不作为而变化，也不以其为条件。LTBT 的政策禁止受托人直接购买或持有我们的任何证券。

paras.en: Our Class F common stock will entitle the Founder LLC to an aggregate number of votes that equals 50.1% of the total voting power of our outstanding shares of capital stock as of the applicable record date with respect to matters submitted to stockholders generally, including the election of our directors other than the Class T directors.
