Our Class F common stock will remain outstanding until the earlier of (i) the completion of the Class F Transition Period (as defined below), which will commence when there have been fewer than three Continuing Founders (not including any successor member who is a “Non-Qualifying Member” as defined in the Founder LLC limited liability company agreement) (the “Founder LLC Agreement”) for 90 consecutive calendar days and (ii) the time when there is no Class F common stock outstanding, including as a result of a redemption thereof agreed to by a Supermajority (as defined below) of the Continuing Founders or upon the dissolution of the Founder LLC (the “Class F Sunset Time”). Upon the completion of this offering, our co-founders will collectively hold approximately (i) [__] % of the total voting power of our outstanding capital stock with respect to matters submitted to stockholders generally, excluding through their interests in the Founder LLC, and (ii) [__] % of the total voting power of our outstanding capital stock with respect to matters submitted to stockholders generally, including through their interests in the Founder LLC.
paras.zh: 我们的 F 类普通股将赋予创始人有限责任公司（Founder LLC）一项合计投票权，该投票权等于截至适用股权登记日，就一般提交股东表决的事项（包括选举我们的董事，但 T 类董事除外）而言，我们已发行股本总额总投票权的 50.1%。我们的 F 类普通股将持续存续，直至以下两者中较早发生者：(i) F 类转换期（定义见下文）届满，该转换期将在连续 90 个日历日内持续创始人（Continuing Founders，不包括任何属于创始人有限责任公司有限责任公司协议（“创始人有限责任公司协议”）所定义的“非合格成员”的继任成员）少于三名时开始；及(ii) 不存在任何已发行的 F 类普通股之时，包括因经持续创始人绝对多数（Supermajority，定义见下文）同意对其进行赎回，或创始人有限责任公司解散（“F 类日落时间”）所致。本次发行完成后，我们的联合创始人将合计持有：(i) 就一般提交股东表决的事项而言，我们已发行股本总额总投票权的约[__]%（不包括通过其在创始人有限责任公司中的权益所持有的部分）；及(ii) 就一般提交股东表决的事项而言，我们已发行股本总额总投票权的约[__]%（包括通过其在创始人有限责任公司中的权益所持有的部分）。

paras.en: The voting power of the LTBT and the Founder LLC are not derived from or proportionate to economic interests in our company and will not be subject to dilution or the loss of rights upon the issuance of additional shares of Class A common stock (including upon conversion of any Class N common stock) or any other shares of our capital stock. Moreover, the LTBT, Founder LLC, and our individual co-founders may have interests that differ from yours and may vote in a way with which you disagree and that may be adverse to your interests. For example, while the LTBT, Founder LLC, and our co-founders share a long-term commitment to our mission that may benefit stockholders who share our public benefit goals, the separation between voting power and economic interests may result in such persons exercising their influence in a manner that prioritizes actions or outcomes they believe to be consistent with the Company Purpose and the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct over the pecuniary interests of our other stockholders. This divergence of voting power from economic interests in our company is likely to persist for the foreseeable future and will not be subject to dilution based on additional issuances of our capital stock or reduction for sales or dispositions of our capital stock by our individual co-founders. For additional information about the circumstances in which our Class T common stock and Class F common stock could be redeemed, see the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Common Stock—Redemption.”
paras.zh: LTBT 与创始人有限责任公司的投票权并非源自或按比例对应其在我们公司的经济利益，且不会因增发 A 类普通股（包括因转换任何 N 类普通股而增发）或我们股本的任何其他股份而受到稀释或丧失权利。此外，LTBT、创始人有限责任公司及我们各位联合创始人的利益可能与您的利益不同，其投票方式可能您并不认同，并可能对您的利益不利。例如，尽管 LTBT、创始人有限责任公司及我们的联合创始人共同对我们的使命抱有长期承诺，这可能有利于与我们公共利益目标一致的股东，但投票权与经济利益的分离可能导致该等人士行使影响力时，优先考虑其认为符合公司宗旨（Company Purpose）及受我们行为重大影响者最佳利益的行动或结果，而非我们其他股东的金钱利益。这种投票权与我们公司经济利益的分离在可预见的未来很可能持续存在，且不会因我们增发股本而受到稀释，也不会因我们各位联合创始人出售或处置我们股本而减少。有关我们的 T 类普通股和 F 类普通股可能被赎回的情形的更多信息，请参见标题为“股本说明——普通股——赎回”的章节。

paras.en: **Our governance structure and the adoption of our amended and restated certificate of incorporation may negatively affect the decision by certain institutional investors to purchase or hold shares of our Class A common stock.**
paras.zh: **我们的治理结构以及经修订和重述的公司章程的通过，可能会对某些机构投资者购买或持有我们 A 类普通股的决定产生负面影响。**

paras.en: Certain aspects of our governance structure, such as our multi-class capital structure, may limit the ability of certain institutional investors to invest in us as a result of their investment policies or may make such an investment less attractive to the portfolio managers of certain institutional investors.
paras.zh: 我们治理结构的某些方面，例如我们的多类别资本结构，可能会因某些机构投资者的投资政策而限制其投资于我们的能力，或可能使此类投资对某些机构投资者的投资组合经理而言吸引力降低。

paras.en: In addition, our multi-class capital structure may make us ineligible for inclusion in indices, and as a result, mutual funds, exchange-traded funds, and other investment vehicles that attempt to passively track these indices would not invest in our stock. These policies may depress our valuation compared to those of other similar companies that are able to be included in such indices.
paras.zh: 此外，我们的多类别资本结构可能使我们不符合纳入指数的资格，因此，试图被动跟踪这些指数的共同基金、交易所交易基金和其他投资工具将不会投资于我们的股票。与其他能够被纳入此类指数的类似公司相比，这些政策可能会压低我们的估值。

paras.en: **We are considered a “controlled company” within the meaning of the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements, and, as a result, we qualify for, and currently rely on, exemptions from certain corporate governance requirements.**
paras.zh: **根据纳斯达克全球精选市场公司治理要求，我们被视为“受控公司”，因此，我们符合并目前依赖于某些公司治理要求的豁免。**

paras.en: We are considered a “controlled company” within the meaning of the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements because the LTBT, as the sole holder of our Class T common stock, generally has the power to elect a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors. As a result, we may elect not to comply with certain corporate governance requirements, including:
paras.zh: 根据纳斯达克全球精选市场公司治理要求，我们被视为“受控公司”，因为 LTBT 作为我们 T 类普通股的唯一持有人，通常有权选举我们董事会多数授权成员。因此，我们可能选择不遵守某些公司治理要求，包括：

paras.en: - the requirement that a majority of our board of directors consist of independent directors;
paras.zh: - 要求我们董事会多数成员由独立董事组成；

paras.en: - the requirement that our board of directors have a nominating and corporate governance committee that is comprised entirely of independent directors with a written charter addressing the committee’s purpose and responsibilities; and
paras.zh: - 要求我们董事会设有提名与公司治理委员会，该委员会完全由独立董事组成，并有一份说明委员会目的和职责的书面章程；以及

paras.en: - the requirement that we have a compensation committee that is comprised entirely of independent directors with a written charter addressing the committee’s purpose and responsibilities.
paras.zh: - 要求我们设有薪酬委员会，该委员会完全由独立董事组成，并有一份说明委员会目的和职责的书面章程。

paras.en: If we elect not to comply with certain requirements, you will not have the same protections afforded to stockholders of companies that are subject to all of the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements. Although we qualify as a “controlled company,” we do not expect to rely on this exemption except with respect to our NGC, which will not consist entirely of independent directors. Our board of directors currently consists of a majority of independent directors and our audit and compensation committees currently consist entirely of independent directors. In the event that we cease to be a “controlled company” and our Class A common stock continues to be listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, we will be required to comply with the provision that our NGC be comprised entirely of independent directors within the applicable transition period.
paras.zh: 如果我们选择不遵守某些要求，您将无法获得受所有纳斯达克全球精选市场公司治理要求约束的公司股东所享有的同等保护。尽管我们符合“受控公司”资格，但我们预计不会依赖此豁免，除非涉及我们的提名与公司治理委员会（NGC），该委员会将不会完全由独立董事组成。我们的董事会目前多数由独立董事组成，我们的审计委员会和薪酬委员会目前完全由独立董事组成。如果我们不再是一家“受控公司”且我们的 A 类普通股继续在纳斯达克全球精选市场上市，我们将被要求在适用的过渡期内遵守我们的提名与公司治理委员会完全由独立董事组成的规定。

paras.en: **We operate as a Delaware public benefit corporation. As a public benefit corporation, we cannot provide any assurance that we will achieve our Company Purpose.**
paras.zh: **我们作为特拉华州公益公司运营。作为公益公司，我们无法保证我们将实现我们的公司宗旨。**

paras.en: As a PBC, we are intended to produce a public benefit or benefits and to operate in a responsible and sustainable manner, balancing our stockholders’ pecuniary interests, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and the Company Purpose identified in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation. We cannot assure you that we will achieve our Company Purpose or that the expected positive impact from being a PBC will be realized, which could adversely affect our reputation, business, financial condition, and results of operations. As a PBC, we are required, under Section 366 of the Delaware General Corporation Law (“DGCL”) and pursuant to our amended and restated bylaws, to disclose to stockholders a report at least biennially on our overall performance in promoting the public benefit identified in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct and on our assessment of our success in achieving our Company Purpose and in promoting those interests. If we are not timely or are unable to provide this report, or if the report is not viewed favorably by parties doing business with us, regulators, others reviewing our credentials, or other stakeholders, including holders of our Class A common stock, our reputation as a PBC may be adversely affected.
paras.zh: 作为一家公益公司（PBC），我们的宗旨是创造一项或多项公共利益，并以负责任和可持续的方式运营，在股东的金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响的各方的最佳利益，以及我们经修订和重述的公司章程所载明的公司宗旨之间实现平衡。我们无法向您保证我们将实现公司宗旨，也无法保证作为公益公司（PBC）所预期的积极影响将会实现，这可能对我们的声誉、业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。作为一家公益公司（PBC），根据《特拉华州普通公司法》（“DGCL”）第 366 条以及我们经修订和重述的公司章程细则，我们必须至少每两年向股东披露一份报告，说明我们在促进经修订和重述的公司章程所载明的公共利益、受我们行为重大影响的各方的最佳利益方面的整体表现，以及我们对实现公司宗旨和促进上述利益方面所获成功的评估。如果我们未能及时或无法提供该报告，或者该报告未获得与我们开展业务的各方、监管机构、审查我们资质的其他方或其他利益相关方（包括我们 A 类普通股持有人）的正面评价，我们作为公益公司（PBC）的声誉可能会受到不利影响。

paras.en: **Our focus on the long-term best interests of our company as a PBC, and the duty of our directors to balance the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those stakeholders materially affected by our conduct, and our Company Purpose, may conflict with short-, medium-, or long-term financial interests and business performance, which may negatively impact the value of our Class A common stock.**
paras.zh: **我们作为公益公司（PBC）对公司长期最佳利益的关注，以及我们的董事在平衡股东金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响的利益相关方的最佳利益与公司宗旨方面的职责，可能与短期、中期或长期财务利益及业务表现相冲突，从而可能对我们 A 类普通股的价值产生负面影响。**

paras.en: We have made, and may in the future make, decisions that we believe balance the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and the Company Purpose set forth in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, even if such decisions may negatively impact the short-, medium-, or long-term performance of our business, financial condition, and results of operations or the short-, medium-, or long-term performance of our Class A common stock. This may impact the value of our Class A common stock and make owning our Class A common stock less appealing to investors who are focused on returns. Our decisions and actions in pursuit of long-term success may not result in the long-term benefits we expect, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations, as well as the market price of our Class A common stock. Such decisions and actions may include changes to our models, platform, and applications; limitations on certain uses of our models, platform, and applications; moderating the pace of the development of our models for safety-related reasons; adjustments to the timing of new offerings; changes in how we deliver customer support; investments in our relationships with partners and employees; investments in and introductions of new models, platforms, and applications; investments in social impact initiatives consistent with our public benefit objectives; and changes in our approach to working with local or national jurisdictions on laws and regulations governing our business.
paras.zh: 我们已作出、并可能在未来作出我们认为能够平衡股东经济利益、受我们行为重大影响各方的最佳利益以及我们经修订和重述的公司章程所载公司宗旨的决策，即使此类决策可能对我们业务、财务状况和经营业绩的短期、中期或长期表现，或对我们 A 类普通股的短期、中期或长期表现产生负面影响。这可能影响我们 A 类普通股的价值，并使持有我们 A 类普通股对注重回报的投资者而言吸引力下降。我们为追求长期成功而作出的决策和采取的行动可能不会带来我们预期的长期利益，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩以及我们 A 类普通股的市场价格产生不利影响。此类决策和行动可能包括：变更我们的模型、平台和应用；限制我们的模型、平台和应用的某些用途；出于安全相关原因放缓我们模型的开发节奏；调整新产品的推出时间；变更我们提供客户支持的方式；投资于我们与合作伙伴和员工的关系；投资于并推出新的模型、平台和应用；投资于符合我们公益目标的社會影响倡议；以及变更我们与地方或国家司法管辖区就规范我们业务的法律法规开展合作的方式。

paras.en: Our policies, including those on usage, currently prohibit, or may be revised in the future to prohibit, certain usage or other actions, which may have adverse commercial consequences to us. For example, our usage policy prohibits the use of our models, platform, and applications to develop or operate fully autonomous weapons or to conduct mass surveillance, including mass domestic surveillance, and we have declined to permit such uses based on our Company Purpose, notwithstanding the revenue those or similar uses could generate. Maintaining these limitations has had, and may continue to have, adverse commercial and financial consequences. We have also restricted or delayed the availability of certain capabilities for safety reasons. For example, we initially released our Mythos model only as a gated research preview through Project Glasswing rather than making it broadly available to the public. Similarly, we have chosen not to develop certain commercially attractive offerings, such as image and video generation models, in order to direct our compute toward our research and safety priorities. Our public advocacy, and the decisions we make to moderate the pace of AI development, delay or restrict the release of models or features, or forgo commercial opportunities for safety-related reasons, may not maximize stockholder value, could have a negative impact on the value of our Class A common stock, and could result in litigation. Each of these decisions reflects our directors’ balancing of the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and the Company Purpose.
paras.zh: 我们的政策（包括有关使用方式的政策）目前禁止、或未来可能修订以禁止某些使用方式或其他行为，这可能对我们产生不利的商业后果。例如，我们的使用政策禁止利用我们的模型、平台和应用程序开发或运行完全自主武器，或进行大规模监控（包括大规模国内监控）；基于我们的公司宗旨，我们已拒绝允许此类用途，尽管这些或类似用途本可带来收入。维持这些限制已经并可能继续产生不利的商业和财务后果。我们还出于安全原因限制或延迟了某些能力的可用性。例如，我们最初仅通过 Project Glasswing 以受限研究预览的形式发布 Mythos 模型，而未向公众广泛提供。同样，我们选择不开发某些具有商业吸引力的产品（例如图像和视频生成模型），以便将算力投向我们的研究和安全优先事项。我们的公开倡导，以及我们为调节 AI 发展节奏、延迟或限制模型或功能的发布、或出于安全相关原因放弃商业机会而作出的决定，可能无法实现股东价值最大化，可能对我们 A 类普通股的价值产生负面影响，并可能引发诉讼。上述每一项决定都体现了我们的董事在平衡股东的金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益以及公司宗旨之后所作出的权衡。

paras.en: While we believe these decisions are consistent with the Company Purpose, as a result of these decisions, we may forgo revenue, customers, or growth opportunities that a corporation managed solely to maximize stockholder value might pursue.
paras.zh: 尽管我们认为这些决定符合公司宗旨，但由於这些决定，我们可能会放弃一家仅为实现股东价值最大化而管理的公司本会追求的收入、客户或增长机会。

paras.en: Further, while directors of traditional corporations typically have a fiduciary duty to focus on maximizing stockholder value, directors of a PBC have a duty to consider not only the stockholders’ financial interests but also the company’s specific public benefit purpose and the best interests of those stakeholders materially affected by the company’s actions. Thus, our directors are not merely permitted, but obligated, to consider our Company Purpose and the interests of other stakeholders. Under Delaware law, directors are shielded from liability for breach of these obligations if they make informed and disinterested decisions that serve a rational purpose. In the event of a conflict among the interests of our stockholders, our Company Purpose or the interests of our other stakeholders, our directors must only make informed and disinterested decisions that serve a rational purpose; thus, we cannot guarantee that such a conflict would be resolved in favor of our stockholders’ monetary interests, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations and cause the market price of our Class A common stock to decline. In addition, there is very limited judicial precedent interpreting the balancing requirement applicable to PBCs under Delaware law, particularly for companies with significant scale or visibility, or with a scope of PBC purpose similar to ours. As a result, the scope of directors’ obligations, the standards by which their decisions may be reviewed, and the nature and availability of stockholder remedies in connection with alleged failures to responsibly balance these interests remain uncertain. Future judicial interpretations of these provisions could be more expansive than we currently anticipate and could result in increased litigation risk, greater scrutiny of board decision-making, or outcomes that differ from our expectations.
paras.zh: 此外，传统公司的董事通常负有专注于实现股东价值最大化的信义义务，而公益公司（PBC）的董事不仅有义务考虑股东的财务利益，还有义务考虑公司特定的公共利益宗旨，以及受公司行为重大影响的利益相关方的最佳利益。因此，我们的董事不仅被允许、而且有义务考虑我们的公司宗旨及其他利益相关方的利益。根据特拉华州法律，只要董事作出知情且无利害关系的、服务于合理目的的决定，即可免于因违反上述义务而承担责任。若我们的股东利益、公司宗旨或其他利益相关方利益之间发生冲突，我们的董事只需作出知情且无利害关系的、服务于合理目的的决定；因此，我们无法保证此类冲突会以有利于股东金钱利益的方式解决，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营成果产生不利影响，并导致我们的 A 类普通股市场价格下跌。此外，解释特拉华州法律下适用于公益公司（PBC）的平衡要求的司法先例非常有限，尤其是对于具有显著规模或知名度、或公益公司（PBC）宗旨范围与我们类似的公司。因此，董事义务的范围、其决定所受审查的标准，以及股东就涉嫌未能负责任地平衡上述利益而寻求救济的性质和可获得性，仍存在不确定性。未来对这些条款的司法解释可能比我们目前预期的更为宽泛，并可能导致诉讼风险增加、对董事会决策的审查更为严格，或产生与我们的预期不同的结果。

paras.en: Additionally, as a PBC, we are less vulnerable to an unsolicited takeover effort than a traditional company would be and, therefore, your ability to realize your investment through an acquisition may be limited. We may also not be an attractive target for activists or hedge fund investors because new directors must consider and give appropriate weight to the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and our Company Purpose, and stockholders may be able to enforce this obligation through litigation. Further, by requiring that our board of directors consider additional stakeholders and our Company Purpose, and not just maximizing stockholder value, Delaware law could make it easier for our board of directors to reject a hostile bid, even where the acceptance of such a bid would provide the greatest short-term financial yield to investors.
paras.zh: 此外，作为一家公益公司（PBC），我们相比传统公司更不易受到主动收购的影响，因此，您通过被收购实现投资回报的能力可能受到限制。我们也可能不是激进投资者或对冲基金投资者具有吸引力的目标，因为新任董事必须考虑并适当权衡我们股东的金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益以及我们的公司宗旨，且股东可能通过诉讼强制执行该义务。此外，由于要求我们的董事会考虑其他利益相关方和我们的公司宗旨，而不仅仅是实现股东价值最大化，特拉华州法律可能使我们的董事会更容易拒绝敌意收购要约，即使接受该要约能为投资者带来最大的短期财务收益。

paras.en: In addition, we intend to direct a meaningful portion of our resources toward our public benefit initiatives, which may include contributions to nonprofit organizations, research institutions, underserved communities, and other third parties that may not otherwise have access to frontier AI capabilities. These initiatives, which include the Initial Public Benefit Issuance and the future Public Benefit Issuances, have been, and may continue to be, substantial in scale, and we expect to significantly grow these efforts over time. The benefits of such expenditures may be difficult or impossible to measure in financial terms and may not result in any direct or measurable benefit to our business or our stockholders. The amount of resources directed toward these initiatives may, in any given period, reduce our revenue, increase our expenses, and could otherwise affect our results of operations.
paras.zh: 此外，我们拟将相当一部分资源用于我们的公共利益倡议，其中可能包括向非营利组织、研究机构、弱势群体社区以及其他原本可能无法获得前沿 AI 能力的第三方提供捐赠。这些倡议（包括首次公共利益发行及未来的公共利益发行）过去规模可观，且可能继续如此，我们预计将随着时间推移大幅扩大这些努力。此类支出的收益可能难以或无法以财务指标衡量，且可能不会为我们的业务或股东带来任何直接或可衡量的收益。在任何给定期间，用于这些倡议的资源数量可能减少我们的收入、增加我们的费用，并可能以其他方式影响我们的经营业绩。

paras.en: **As a Delaware public benefit corporation, we may be subject to increased litigation concerning our board of directors’ obligation to balance our stockholders’ pecuniary interests, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct and our Company Purpose, the occurrence of which may have an adverse impact on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.**
paras.zh: **作为特拉华州公益公司，我们可能面临更多诉讼，涉及我们的董事会平衡股东金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益以及我们公司宗旨的义务，此类诉讼的发生可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。**

paras.en: Section 367 of the DGCL provides that stockholders of a Delaware PBC with shares listed on a national securities exchange may only file an action to enforce the statutory balancing requirement imposed on the board of directors by the DGCL if they, individually or collectively, own the lesser of at least two percent of the corporation’s outstanding shares or shares of the corporation with a market value of at least $2,000,000 as of the date the action is instituted and, in the case of a derivative action, such stockholders satisfy any other conditions applicable to filing a derivative action. This potential liability for enforcement of the statutory balancing requirement does not exist for traditional corporations. Therefore, we may be subject to the possibility of increased litigation, which would require the attention of our management, and, as a result, may adversely affect our management’s ability to effectively execute our strategy. There is limited judicial precedent for this type of balancing litigation, which may create uncertainty around the scope of our directors’ obligations or the remedies available to stockholders. Additionally, any such litigation may be costly, which may adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
paras.zh: 《特拉华州普通公司法》第 367 条规定，股票在全国性证券交易所上市的特拉华州公益公司（PBC）的股东，只有在以下情况下才能提起诉讼，以强制执行《特拉华州普通公司法》对董事会施加的法定平衡要求：该等股东单独或合计持有公司已发行股份的至少百分之二，或持有公司股份的市值在提起诉讼之日至少为 $2,000,000（以较低者为准）；且对于派生诉讼，该等股东须满足提起派生诉讼所适用的任何其他条件。传统公司不存在这种强制执行法定平衡要求的潜在责任。因此，我们可能面临更多诉讼的可能性，这将需要我们的管理层予以关注，并因此可能对我们的管理层有效执行战略的能力产生不利影响。此类平衡诉讼的司法先例有限，这可能给我们的董事义务范围或股东可获得的救济带来不确定性。此外，任何此类诉讼可能成本高昂，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。

paras.en: **Our amended and restated bylaws will designate a state or federal court located within the State of Delaware as the exclusive forum for substantially all disputes between us and our stockholders, and also provide that the federal district courts will be the exclusive forum for resolving any complaint asserting a cause of action arising under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, each of which may limit our stockholders’ ability to choose the judicial forum for disputes with us or our directors, officers, stockholders, or employees.**
paras.zh: **我们经修订和重述的章程将指定位于特拉华州境内的州法院或联邦法院作为我们与股东之间几乎所有争议的专属法院，并规定联邦地区法院为解决任何依据经修订的 1933 年《证券法》提出诉讼请求的投诉的专属法院，上述每一项都可能限制我们的股东就与我们或我们的董事、高级职员、股东或员工之间的争议选择司法法院的能力。**

paras.en: Our amended and restated bylaws, which will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering, will provide that, unless we consent in writing to the selection of an alternative forum, the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware (or, if the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware does not have jurisdiction, another State court in Delaware or the federal district court for the District of Delaware) will, to the fullest extent permitted by law, be the sole and exclusive forum for (i) any derivative action or proceeding brought on our behalf, (ii) any action asserting a claim of breach of a fiduciary duty owed by any of our current or former directors, stockholders, or officers or other employees to us or our stockholders, (iii) any action arising pursuant to any provision of the DGCL, or as to which the DGCL confers jurisdiction upon the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware, (iv) any action arising pursuant to or to interpret, apply, enforce or determine the validity of our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, or our amended and restated bylaws, or (v) any action asserting a claim governed by the internal affairs doctrine, except for, in all cases, any claim as to which such court determines that there is an indispensable party not subject to the jurisdiction of such court (and the indispensable party does not consent to the personal jurisdiction of such court within 10 days following such determination).
paras.zh: 我们经修订和重述的公司章程细则将在本次发行完成前立即生效，其中规定，除非我们书面同意选择替代法院，否则在法律允许的最大范围内，特拉华州衡平法院（或，若特拉华州衡平法院无管辖权，则为特拉华州另一州法院或特拉华州联邦地区法院）将是以下事项的唯一专属法院：(i) 代表我们提起的任何派生诉讼或程序；(ii) 主张我们现任或前任董事、股东、高级管理人员或其他员工对我们或我们的股东负有信托义务之违反的任何诉讼；(iii) 依据《特拉华州普通公司法》（DGCL）任何条款提起的任何诉讼，或 DGCL 赋予特拉华州衡平法院管辖权的任何诉讼；(iv) 依据或为解释、适用、执行或判定我们经修订和重述的公司章程或我们经修订和重述的公司章程细则之有效性而提起的任何诉讼；或 (v) 主张受内部事务原则管辖的索赔的任何诉讼，但在所有情况下，除外任何该等法院认定存在不受该法院管辖的不可或缺一方当事人（且该不可或缺一方当事人在该认定后 10 日内不同意该法院的对人管辖权）的索赔。

paras.en: Section 22 of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), establishes concurrent jurisdiction for federal and state courts over Securities Act claims. Accordingly, both state and federal courts have jurisdiction to hear such claims. To prevent having to litigate claims in multiple jurisdictions and the threat of inconsistent or contrary rulings by different courts, among other considerations, our amended and restated bylaws will also provide that, unless we consent in writing to the selection of an alternative forum, the federal district courts of the United States will, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, be the sole and exclusive forum for resolving any complaint asserting a cause or causes of action arising under the Securities Act against any person in connection with any offering of our securities, including, without limitation, any auditor, underwriter, expert, control person, or other defendant. Unless we consent in writing to the selection of an alternative forum, the United States District Court for the District of Delaware will, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, be the sole and exclusive forum for the resolution of any derivative action or proceeding brought to enforce any duty or liability created by the Exchange Act or the rules or regulations thereunder. All other claims arising under the Exchange Act may be brought in any federal court of competent jurisdiction.
paras.zh: 经修订的《1933 年证券法》（“《证券法》”）第 22 条确立了联邦法院和州法院对《证券法》索赔的并行管辖权。因此，州法院和联邦法院均有管辖权审理此类索赔。为避免不得不在多个司法辖区进行诉讼以及不同法院作出不一致或相反裁决的风险，除其他考虑因素外，我们经修订和重述的公司章程细则还将规定，除非我们书面同意选择替代法院，否则在适用法律允许的最大范围内，美国联邦地区法院将是解决任何针对任何人就我们的证券发行而主张《证券法》项下一项或多项诉因的投诉的唯一专属法院，包括但不限于任何审计师、承销商、专家、控制人或其他被告。除非我们书面同意选择替代法院，否则在适用法律允许的最大范围内，美国特拉华州联邦地区法院将是解决为执行《交易法》或其项下规则或条例所创设的任何义务或责任而提起的任何派生诉讼或程序的唯一专属法院。依据《交易法》产生的所有其他索赔可在任何具有管辖权的联邦法院提起。

paras.en: Any person or entity purchasing, holding, or otherwise acquiring any interest in any of our securities shall be deemed to have notice of and consented to the foregoing bylaw provisions. Although we believe these exclusive forum provisions benefit us by providing increased consistency in the application of Delaware law and federal securities laws in the types of lawsuits to which each applies, the exclusive forum provisions may limit a stockholder’s ability to bring a claim in a judicial forum of its choosing for disputes with us or our current or former directors, officers, stockholders, or other employees, which may discourage lawsuits with respect to such claims against us and our current and former directors, officers, stockholders, or other employees. Our stockholders will not be deemed to have waived our compliance with the federal securities laws and the rules and regulations thereunder as a result of our exclusive forum provisions.
paras.zh: 任何购买、持有或以其他方式取得我们任何证券权益的人或实体，均应被视为已注意到前述章程条款并同意受其约束。尽管我们认为，这些排他性管辖条款通过在各类诉讼中提高特拉华州法律和联邦证券法适用的一致性而使我们受益，但排他性管辖条款可能限制股东就其与我们或我们现任或前任董事、高级管理人员、股东或其他员工之间的争议选择其偏好的司法管辖地提起诉讼，这可能抑制股东就针对我们及我们现任和前任董事、高级管理人员、股东或其他员工的此类索赔提起诉讼。我们的股东不会因我们的排他性管辖条款而被视为放弃我们遵守联邦证券法及其项下规则和法规。

paras.en: **Provisions in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and amended and restated bylaws could make a merger, tender offer, proxy contest, or other significant corporate transaction difficult, potentially depressing the market price of our Class A common stock.**
paras.zh: **我们经修订和重述的公司章程以及经修订和重述的章程细则中的条款可能使合并、要约收购、代理权争夺或其他重大公司交易变得困难，并可能压低我们 A 类普通股的市场价格。**

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and amended and restated bylaws, which will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering, will contain a number of provisions that may make the acquisition of our company more difficult. Such provisions will include:
paras.zh: 我们经修订和重述的公司章程以及经修订和重述的章程细则将在本次发行完成前立即生效，其中将包含若干可能使收购我们公司变得更加困难的条款。此类条款将包括：

paras.en: - a multi-class common stock structure, which will provide the LTBT and the Founder LLC with the ability to elect all members of our board of directors, and will provide the Founder LLC with the ability to determine the outcome of all matters submitted to a vote of our stockholders generally (including the approval of any merger, sale of our company, and other significant corporate transaction requiring stockholder approval) for the foreseeable future;
paras.zh: - 多类别普通股结构，这将使 LTBT 和创始人有限责任公司有能力选举我们董事会的全部成员，并将使创始人有限责任公司在可预见的未来有能力决定提交我们股东一般表决的所有事项的结果（包括批准任何合并、出售我们公司以及需要股东批准的其他重大公司交易）；

paras.en: - prior to the Class F Sunset Time, vacant or newly created directorships for any directors who are not Class T directors can be filled by our board of directors in accordance with a notice from the Founder LLC or by the holders of our Class A common stock and Class F common stock, voting together or acting by written consent;
paras.zh: - 在 F 类股份日落时间之前，任何非 T 类董事的空缺或新设董事职位，可由我们的董事会根据创始人有限责任公司的通知予以填补，或由我们 A 类普通股和 F 类普通股的持有人共同表决或通过书面同意方式予以填补；

paras.en: - prior to the Class T Sunset Time, the number of directors constituting our board of directors will be permitted to be set only with the approval of 80% of the authorized members of our board of directors (rounded up or down to the nearest whole number (any exact 0.5 rounding up));
paras.zh: - 在 T 类股份日落时间之前，构成我们董事会的董事人数仅可在获得我们董事会授权成员 80%批准的情况下确定（四舍五入至最接近的整数（任何恰好 0.5 的情形向上取整））；

paras.en: - a special meeting of our stockholders may only be called by (i) our board of directors acting pursuant to a resolution adopted by a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors; (ii) the Chairperson of our board of directors; (iii) our Chief Executive Officer; (iv) our President; (v) following the Class F Sunset Time, a majority of the directors who are not Class T directors; (vi) prior to the Class F Sunset Time and only with respect to a special meeting at which holders of our Class E common stock will be asked to vote on a proposal, the secretary of the company; or (vii) prior to the Class F Sunset Time, the Founder LLC as the holder of our Class F common stock;
paras.zh: - 我们的股东特别会议仅可由以下主体召集：(i) 我们的董事会依据经我们董事会授权成员过半数通过的决议行事；(ii) 我们的董事会主席；(iii) 我们的首席执行官；(iv) 我们的总裁；(v) 在 F 类日落时间之后，由非 T 类董事的过半数董事召集；(vi) 在 F 类日落时间之前，且仅限于将提请我们的 E 类普通股持有人就某项提案进行表决的特别会议，由公司秘书召集；或 (vii) 在 F 类日落时间之前，由作为我们 F 类普通股持有人的创始人有限责任公司召集；

paras.en: - prior to the Class F Sunset Time and the Class T Sunset Time, stockholders may act by written consent only with respect to (i) any action to nominate, elect, or remove directors or appoint a director to fill any vacancy or newly created directorship; (ii) any action to satisfy certain redemption and protective provisions in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation related to our Class F common stock, Class T common stock, and Class E common stock; and (iii) any matter in which stockholders vote together as a single class if such matter is first approved or requested by our board of directors, and following both the Class F Sunset Time and the Class T Sunset Time, any action required or permitted to be taken by our stockholders must be effected at a duly called annual or special meeting of stockholders and may not be effected by any written consent of our stockholders; notwithstanding the foregoing, any action required or permitted to be taken by the holders of our Class E common stock must be effected at a duly called annual or special meeting of stockholders and may not be effected by any consent in writing by such stockholders;
paras.zh: - 在 F 类日落时间和 T 类日落时间之前，股东仅可就以下事项以书面同意方式行事：(i) 任何提名、选举或罢免董事，或任命董事以填补任何空缺或新设董事职位的行动；(ii) 任何为满足我们经修订和重述的公司章程中与我们 F 类普通股、T 类普通股和 E 类普通股相关的某些赎回和保护性条款而采取的行动；以及 (iii) 任何由股东作为单一类别共同表决的事项，前提是该事项首先经我们的董事会批准或应其要求提出；而在 F 类日落时间和 T 类日落时间均之后，要求或允许我们的股东采取的任何行动必须在正式召集的股东年会或特别会议上实施，不得通过我们的股东的任何书面同意实施；尽管有前述规定，要求或允许我们的 E 类普通股持有人采取的任何行动必须在正式召集的股东年会或特别会议上实施，不得通过该等股东的任何书面同意实施；

paras.en: - advance notice procedures required for Class A stockholders to nominate candidates for election as directors or to bring matters before an annual meeting of stockholders;
paras.zh: - A 类股东提名董事候选人或在股东年会上提出事项所需的提前通知程序；

paras.en: - following the Class F Sunset Time, our board of directors will shift to having a classified board of directors consisting of three classes of directors with staggered three-year terms;
paras.zh: - 在 F 类日落时间之后，我们的董事会将转变为分类董事会，由三个类别的董事组成，任期交错，每届三年；

paras.en: - following the Class F Sunset Time, 66 2/3% of the voting power of our Class A common stock will be required to amend certain provisions in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and our amended and restated bylaws;
paras.zh: - 在 F 类日落时间之后，修改我们经修订和重述的公司章程及经修订和重述的章程细则中的某些条款，将需要我们 A 类普通股 66 2/3% 的表决权；

paras.en: - not providing for cumulative voting; and
paras.zh: - 不规定累积投票制；以及

paras.en: - authorizing undesignated preferred stock, the issuance and terms of which may be established by 80% of the authorized members of our board of directors (rounded up or down to the nearest whole number (any exact 0.5 rounding up)) and, prior to the Class F Sunset Time, only with the consent of the Founder LLC as the holder of our Class F common stock.
paras.zh: - 授权发行未指定优先股，其发行及条款可由我们董事会授权成员的 80%(向上或向下取整至最接近的整数（任何恰好 0.5 的向上取整）)确定，且在 F 类日落时间之前，须经作为我们 F 类普通股持有人的创始人有限责任公司同意。

paras.en: These provisions, alone or together, could discourage, delay or prevent a transaction involving a change in control of our company. These provisions could also discourage proxy contests and make it more difficult for stockholders to elect directors of their choosing and to cause us to take other corporate actions they desire, any of which, under certain circumstances, could limit the opportunity for our stockholders to receive a premium for their shares of our Class A common stock, and could also affect the price that some investors are willing to pay for our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 这些条款单独或共同可能阻碍、延迟或阻止涉及本公司控制权变更的交易。这些条款还可能抑制代理权争夺，并使股东更难选举出其属意的董事，以及促使我们采取其希望的其他公司行动，上述任何一项在某些情况下可能限制本公司股东就其 A 类普通股获得溢价的机会，也可能影响部分投资者愿意为本公司 A 类普通股支付的价格。

full.sec: Risks Related to Ownership of our Class A Common Stock
full.secZh: 与我们的 A 类普通股所有权相关的风险

paras.en: **There has been no prior public trading market for our Class A common stock, and an active trading market may not develop or be sustained following this offering.**
paras.zh: **我们的 A 类普通股此前不存在公开交易市场，本次发行后可能不会形成或维持活跃的交易市场。**

paras.en: We have applied to list our Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.” However, prior to this offering, there has been no public trading market for our Class A common stock. We cannot assure you that an active trading market for our Class A common stock will develop on such exchange or elsewhere or, if developed, that any market will be sustained. The initial public offering price of our Class A common stock will be determined through negotiation among us, the selling stockholders, and the underwriters. This price will not necessarily reflect the price at which investors in the market will be willing to buy and sell shares of our Class A common stock following this offering.
paras.zh: 我们已申请将我们的 A 类普通股在纳斯达克全球精选市场上市，股票代码为“ANT”。然而，在本次发行之前，我们的 A 类普通股不存在公开交易市场。我们无法向您保证，我们的 A 类普通股将在该交易所或其他地方形成活跃的交易市场，或者即使形成，任何市场将得以维持。我们 A 类普通股的首次公开发行价格将由我们、出售股东与承销商协商确定。该价格未必反映本次发行后市场投资者愿意买入和卖出我们 A 类普通股的价格。

paras.en: **The market price of our Class A common stock may be volatile, and you may lose all or part of your investment.**
paras.zh: **我们 A 类普通股的市场价格可能波动，您可能损失全部或部分投资。**

paras.en: We cannot predict the prices at which our Class A common stock will trade. The initial public offering price of our Class A common stock will be determined by negotiations among us, the selling stockholders, and the underwriters. This price will not necessarily reflect the price at which investors in the market will be willing to buy and sell shares of our Class A common stock following this offering. The market price of our Class A common stock following this offering may fluctuate substantially, depending on a number of factors, many of which are beyond our control and may not be related to our operating performance. These fluctuations may cause you to lose all or part of your investment in our Class A common stock. Factors that may cause fluctuations in the market price of our Class A common stock include the following:
paras.zh: 我们无法预测我们 A 类普通股的交易价格。我们 A 类普通股的首次公开发行价格将由我们、出售股东与承销商协商确定。该价格未必反映本次发行后市场投资者愿意买入和卖出我们 A 类普通股的价格。本次发行后，我们 A 类普通股的市场价格可能大幅波动，取决于诸多因素，其中许多因素超出我们的控制范围，且可能与我们的经营业绩无关。这些波动可能导致您损失在我们 A 类普通股中的全部或部分投资。可能导致我们 A 类普通股市场价格波动的因素包括以下各项：

paras.en: - price and volume fluctuations in the overall stock market from time to time, including fluctuations due to general economic uncertainty or negative market sentiment;
paras.zh: - 整体股票市场不时出现的价格和成交量波动，包括因总体经济不确定性或负面市场情绪而导致的波动；

paras.en: - volatility in the market and trading volumes of technology stocks;
paras.zh: - 科技股的市场波动性和交易量；

paras.en: - supply chain constraints, particularly those impacting compute, and new and evolving trade regulations and tariffs, and counter-measures;
paras.zh: - 供应链限制，尤其是影响算力的限制，以及新出台和不断演变的贸易法规与关税及反制措施；

paras.en: - changes in the operating performance and stock market valuations of other technology companies generally, or those in our industry in particular;
paras.zh: - 其他科技公司总体上，或特别是我们行业内公司的经营业绩和股票市场估值的变化；

paras.en: - sales of shares of our Class A common stock by us or our stockholders, as well as the anticipation of lock-up releases;
paras.zh: - 我们或我们的股东出售 A 类普通股，以及对锁定期解禁的预期；

paras.en: - rumors and market speculation involving us or other companies in our industry or related industries;
paras.zh: - 涉及我们或我们行业或相关行业其他公司的传闻和市场猜测；

paras.en: - failure of securities analysts to maintain coverage of us, changes in financial estimates by securities analysts who follow our company, or our failure to meet these estimates or the expectations of investors;
paras.zh: - 证券分析师未能维持对我们的覆盖、跟踪本公司的证券分析师财务预测的变化，或我们未能达到这些预测或投资者的预期；

paras.en: - actual or perceived significant data breaches involving our business;
paras.zh: - 涉及我们业务的实际发生或被认为发生的重大数据泄露；

paras.en: - the financial or non-financial projections we may provide to the public, any changes in those projections, or our failure to meet those projections;
paras.zh: - 我们可能向公众提供的财务或非财务预测、该等预测的任何变动，或我们未能实现该等预测；

paras.en: - third-party data published about us or other companies in our industry, whether or not such data is accurate;
paras.zh: - 关于我们或我们行业内其他公司的第三方数据，无论该等数据是否准确；

paras.en: - announcements by us or our competitors of new models, platforms, or applications;
paras.zh: - 我们或竞争对手发布的新模型、平台或应用；

paras.en: - the public’s reaction to our press releases, other public announcements, and filings with the SEC;
paras.zh: - 公众对我们新闻稿、其他公开公告及向 SEC 提交文件的反响；

paras.en: - fluctuations in the trading volume of shares of our Class A common stock or the size of our public float;
paras.zh: - 我们 A 类普通股股票交易量的波动或我们公众流通股规模的波动；

paras.en: - short selling of our Class A common stock or related derivative securities;
paras.zh: - 对我们 A 类普通股或相关衍生证券的卖空；

paras.en: - actual or anticipated changes or fluctuations in our results of operations;
paras.zh: - 我们经营业绩的实际或预期变化或波动；

paras.en: - actual or anticipated developments in our business, our competitors’ businesses, or the competitive landscape generally;
paras.zh: - 我们业务、竞争对手业务或整体竞争格局的实际或预期发展；

paras.en: - changes in the anticipated future size or growth rate of our addressable markets;
paras.zh: - 我们可服务市场预期未来规模或增长率的变化；

paras.en: - our issuance of shares of our Class A common stock, including as a result of the conversion of our Class N common stock in connection with certain transfers;
paras.zh: - 我们发行 A 类普通股股票，包括因某些转让而转换我们 N 类普通股所导致的发行；

paras.en: - litigation or regulatory action involving us, our industry, or both, or investigations by regulators into our operations or those of our competitors;
paras.zh: - 涉及我们、我们行业或两者兼有的诉讼或监管行动，或监管机构对我们或竞争对手运营的调查；

paras.en: - developments or disputes concerning our intellectual property or other proprietary rights;
paras.zh: - 涉及我们知识产权或其他专有权利的发展或争议；

paras.en: - announced or completed acquisitions of businesses or technologies, or similar strategic transactions, by us or our competitors;
paras.zh: - 我们或我们的竞争对手宣布或完成对业务或技术的收购，或类似战略交易；

paras.en: - new laws or regulations or new interpretations of existing laws or regulations applicable to our business;
paras.zh: - 适用于我们业务的新法律或法规，或对现有法律或法规的新解释；

paras.en: - regulatory enforcement actions or other governmental efforts affecting our models, platform, and applications;
paras.zh: - 影响我们模型、平台和应用的监管执法行动或其他政府举措；

paras.en: - changes in accounting standards, policies, guidelines, interpretations, or principles;
paras.zh: - 会计准则、政策、指引、解释或原则的变化；

paras.en: - major catastrophic events such as war, incidents of terrorism, pandemics, or responses to such events;
paras.zh: - 重大灾难性事件，如战争、恐怖主义事件、流行病或对此类事件的应对措施；

paras.en: - any additions or departures of founders, board members, management, or key personnel; and
paras.zh: - 创始人、董事会成员、管理层或关键人员的任何新增或离职；以及

paras.en: - general economic conditions and slow or negative growth of our markets.
paras.zh: - 总体经济状况以及我们市场的缓慢增长或负增长。

paras.en: In addition, if the market for technology stocks or the stock market in general experiences a loss of investor confidence, the market price of our Class A common stock may decline for reasons unrelated to our business, financial condition, or results of operations. The market price of our Class A common stock may also decline in reaction to events that affect other companies in our industry even if these events do not directly affect us. Accordingly, we cannot assure you of the liquidity of any trading market, your ability to sell your shares of our Class A common stock when desired, or the prices that you may obtain for your shares of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 此外，如果科技股市场或整体股票市场出现投资者信心丧失，我们 A 类普通股的市场价格可能因与我们的业务、财务状况或经营业绩无关的原因而下跌。我们 A 类普通股的市场价格也可能因影响我们行业内其他公司的事件而下跌，即使这些事件并不直接影响我们。因此，我们无法向您保证任何交易市场的流动性、您能否在需要时出售您的 A 类普通股，或您出售 A 类普通股可能获得的价格。

paras.en: In the past, stockholders have initiated securities class action lawsuits against companies following periods of stock price volatility. If the market price of our Class A common stock is volatile, we may become the target of securities litigation. Such litigation may subject us to substantial costs, divert resources and management’s attention, and adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
paras.zh: 过去，股东曾在股价波动期后对公司提起证券集体诉讼。如果我们 A 类普通股的市场价格波动，我们可能成为证券诉讼的目标。此类诉讼可能使我们承担巨额成本、分散资源和管理层的注意力，并对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。

paras.en: **The issuance of additional stock in connection with financings, acquisitions, investments, our equity incentive plans, the conversion of our outstanding convertible promissory notes, the conversion of our outstanding Class N common stock, our public benefit initiatives, or otherwise will dilute the interests of the holders of our Class A common stock.**
paras.zh: **就融资、收购、投资、我们的股权激励计划、我们未偿还可转换本票的转换、我们未偿还 N 类普通股的转换、我们的公益倡议或其他事项而增发股票，将稀释我们 A 类普通股持有人的利益。**

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation that will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering authorizes us to issue up to an aggregate of 300,000,000,000 shares of Class A common stock, 100,000,000,000 shares of Class N common stock, one share of Class T common stock, one share of Class F common stock, 30,000,000,000 shares of Class E common stock, and 30,000,000,000 shares of preferred stock, with such rights, powers, and preferences as may be determined by our board of directors (subject to limitations in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, which will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering, or prescribed by Delaware law). Subject to compliance with applicable rules and regulations, we may issue shares of our capital stock or securities convertible into shares of our capital stock from time to time in connection with a financing, an acquisition, an investment, our equity incentive plans, the conversion of our outstanding convertible promissory notes, the conversion of our Class N common stock, our public benefit initiatives, which may include issuances of equity to third parties such as nonprofit organizations, research institutions, or other recipients, or otherwise, including the Public Benefit Issuances. Any such issuances may result in substantial dilution to the holders of our Class A common stock and cause the market price of our Class A common stock to decline. For a discussion of the dilutive impact of our Class N common stock on the holders of our Class A common stock, see the risk factor titled “A substantial number of shares of our Class N common stock will be outstanding upon the completion of this offering, which will dilute the voting power of the holders of our Class A common stock upon conversion.”
paras.zh: 我们将在本次发行完成前立即生效的经修订和重述的公司章程授权我们发行合计最多 300,000,000,000 股 A 类普通股、100,000,000,000 股 N 类普通股、一股 T 类普通股、一股 F 类普通股、30,000,000,000 股 E 类普通股以及 30,000,000,000 股优先股，其权利、权力和优先权可由我们的董事会确定（受限于我们经修订和重述的公司章程中的限制，该章程将在本次发行完成前立即生效，或受特拉华州法律规定的限制）。在遵守适用规则和法规的前提下，我们可能不时就融资、收购、投资、我们的股权激励计划、我们未偿可转换本票的转换、我们 N 类普通股的转换、我们的公益举措（可能包括向非营利组织、研究机构或其他接收方等第三方发行股权）或其他事项（包括公益发行）发行我们的股本股份或可转换为我们的股本股份的证券。任何此类发行可能对 A 类普通股持有人造成重大稀释，并导致我们 A 类普通股的市场价格下跌。关于我们 N 类普通股对 A 类普通股持有人的稀释影响的讨论，请参见题为“本次发行完成后将有大量 N 类普通股流通在外，这将稀释 A 类普通股持有人于转换时的投票权”的风险因素。

paras.en: In addition, registration rights agreements entered into with counterparties to certain of our NPAs provide such counterparties with rights to cause us to register for resale after this offering (i) shares of our common stock underlying such notes, (ii) shares of Class A common stock issuable upon conversion of Class N common stock issued upon conversion of the notes, and (iii) shares of our common stock issued in connection with certain contractual rights to private placements concurrent with this offering. The exercise of such registration rights could facilitate sales of large blocks of our Class A common stock into the public market, which could depress the market price of our Class A common stock or increase its volatility.
paras.zh: 此外，与我们某些 NPA 的交易对手方签订的登记权协议赋予该等交易对手方权利，使其可要求我们在本次发行后登记以下证券以供转售：(i) 该等票据所对应的普通股股份，(ii) 因票据转换而发行的 N 类普通股转换后可发行的 A 类普通股股份，以及 (iii) 就与本次发行同时进行的某些私募配售的合同权利而发行的普通股股份。行使该等登记权可能便利大量 A 类普通股股份在公开市场出售，这可能压低我们 A 类普通股的市场价格或增加其波动性。

paras.en: **A substantial number of shares of our Class N common stock will be outstanding upon the completion of this offering, which will dilute the voting power of the holders of our Class A common stock upon conversion.**
paras.zh: **本次发行完成后将有大量 N 类普通股流通在外，这将稀释 A 类普通股持有人于转换时的投票权。**

paras.en: Immediately prior to the completion of this offering, after giving effect to the Preferred Stock Conversion and the Convertible Notes Conversion, we will have [__] shares of Class N common stock outstanding, representing approximately [__] % of our outstanding capital stock prior to this offering and approximately % of our outstanding capital stock following the completion of this offering (in each case, excluding our Class T common stock, Class F common stock, and Class E common stock). After giving effect to the Preferred Stock Conversion and the Convertible Notes Conversion, Amazon and Google will each hold greater than five percent of our outstanding capital stock. Although our Class N common stock is non-voting, their holdings represent a significant economic interest in our company, and because our Class N common stock converts into Class A common stock upon transfer to an unaffiliated third party, these shares could also become significant to the voting power of our Class A common stock following any such transfer. Immediately prior to the completion of this offering, after giving effect to the Preferred Stock Conversion and the Convertible Notes Conversion, and immediately following the offering, Amazon will hold [__] shares of our Class N common stock and Google will hold [__] shares of our Class N common stock. An aggregate of an additional [__] shares of Class N common stock will be issuable after this offering upon conversion of remaining outstanding convertible promissory notes, all of which are held by Amazon, that could not convert immediately prior to the completion of this offering without exceeding the applicable ownership cap. Additional shares of Class N common stock may also be issued following this offering pursuant to the Public Benefit Issuances, future drawdowns and related issuances or conversions under our note purchase agreements, and certain contractual rights. See the sections titled “Shares Eligible for Future Sale—Class N Common Stock,” “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Liquidity and Capital Resources—Convertible Notes,” and “Business—Our Commitment to Public Benefit.”
paras.zh: 在本发行完成前，在优先股转换和可转换本票转换生效后，我们将有[__]股 N 类普通股流通在外，约占本发行前我们流通在外股本的[__]%，约占本发行完成后我们流通在外股本的[__]%（每种情况下均不包括我们的 T 类普通股、F 类普通股和 E 类普通股）。在优先股转换和可转换本票转换生效后，Amazon 和 Google 将各自持有我们流通在外股本的百分之五以上。尽管我们的 N 类普通股无表决权，但其持股代表了我们公司的重要经济利益，并且由于我们的 N 类普通股在转让给非关联第三方时转换为 A 类普通股，因此在任何此类转让后，这些股份也可能对 A 类普通股的表决权具有重要意义。在本发行完成前，在优先股转换和可转换本票转换生效后，以及在本发行完成后，Amazon 将持有[__]股我们的 N 类普通股，Google 将持有[__]股我们的 N 类普通股。在本发行完成后，在剩余未偿可转换本票（全部由 Amazon 持有）转换时，将可额外发行合计[__]股 N 类普通股，这些本票若在本发行完成前立即转换将超过适用的持股上限而无法转换。在本发行完成后，还可能根据公共利益发行、未来提款及我们票据购买协议项下的相关发行或转换以及某些合同权利发行额外的 N 类普通股。参见标题为“未来可出售股份——N 类普通股”、“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——流动性和资本资源——可转换本票”和“业务——我们对公共利益的承诺”的章节。

paras.en: Although our Class N common stock is not entitled to vote, it is entitled to economic rights equivalent to those of our Class A common stock, including the right to participate ratably with our Class A common stock in any dividends we may declare and in distributions upon a liquidation, dissolution, or winding-up. As a result, the shares of Class N common stock issued in connection with the completion of this offering as a result of the Preferred Stock Conversion and Convertible Notes Conversion will dilute the economic interests, including any dividends and any proceeds available for distribution to stockholders, of the holders of our Class A common stock, and such shares are included together with our Class A common stock in determining net tangible book value per share. See the section titled “Dilution.”
paras.zh: 尽管我们的 N 类普通股没有表决权，但其享有与我们的 A 类普通股同等的经济权利，包括与我们 A 类普通股按比例参与我们可能宣派的任何股息以及清算、解散或清盘时的分配的权利。因此，因优先股转换和可转换本票转换而在本发行完成时发行的 N 类普通股将稀释我们 A 类普通股持有人的经济利益，包括任何股息和可供分配给股东的收益，且该等股份在确定每股有形净资产价值时与我们的 A 类普通股合并计算。参见标题为“稀释”的章节。

paras.en: The shares of Class N common stock will automatically convert into an equal number of shares of Class A common stock upon a transfer effected through: (i) a registered offering or an open market sale of such shares or (ii) a transfer to an unaffiliated third party, subject to certain limitations described in the section titled “Description of Capital Stock.” While held as Class N common stock, these shares are non-voting and therefore do not impact the voting power of the holders of our Class A common stock. Upon the conversion of shares of Class N common stock into Class A common stock, however, the resulting shares of Class A common stock will be entitled to one vote per share and the issuance of such shares will dilute the voting power of the existing holders of our Class A common stock. Any shares of Class N common stock that we issue in the future would have the same effect, diluting the economic interests of the holders of our Class A common stock while outstanding, as well as diluting their voting power upon conversion into Class A common stock.
paras.zh: N 类普通股股份在通过以下方式实现的转让后，将自动转换为等数量的 A 类普通股股份：(i) 经注册发行或在该等股份的公开市场出售中转让，或 (ii) 向非关联第三方转让，但须遵守标题为“股本说明”一节中所述的某些限制。在作为 N 类普通股持有期间，该等股份无表决权，因此不影响我们 A 类普通股持有人的表决权。然而，N 类普通股股份转换为 A 类普通股后，所转换形成的 A 类普通股股份将享有每股一票的表决权，且该等股份的发行将稀释我们 A 类普通股现有持有人的表决权。我们未来发行的任何 N 类普通股股份将产生相同效果，在存续期间稀释我们 A 类普通股持有人的经济利益，并在转换为 A 类普通股后稀释其表决权。

paras.en: **Future issuances of our Class A common stock and Class N common stock will not dilute the voting power of our Class F common stock.**
paras.zh: **我们未来发行 A 类普通股和 N 类普通股不会稀释我们 F 类普通股的表决权。**

paras.en: Future issuances of our Class A common stock, including upon conversion of our Class N common stock, and our Class N common stock will not dilute the voting power of our Class F common stock because our Class F common stock is entitled to a fixed 50.1% of the total voting power of our outstanding shares of capital stock as of the applicable record date with respect to matters submitted to stockholders generally. For example, if we were to issue 1,000,000 additional shares of Class A common stock, our Class F common stock would automatically be entitled to an incremental number of votes sufficient to cause the aggregate voting power of our Class F common stock to equal 50.1% of the total voting power of our outstanding shares of capital stock as of the applicable record date with respect to matters submitted to stockholders generally, or approximately 1,004,008 additional votes. Any future issuances of additional shares of Class A common stock, including upon conversion of our Class N common stock, and Class N common stock will not be subject to approval by our stockholders except as required by the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market.
paras.zh: 我们未来发行 A 类普通股（包括在转换我们 N 类普通股时发行）以及我们 N 类普通股不会稀释我们 F 类普通股的表决权，因为对于一般提交股东表决的事项，我们 F 类普通股在适用记录日有权享有我们已发行股本总表决权中固定的 50.1%。例如，如果我们额外发行 1,000,000 股 A 类普通股，我们 F 类普通股将自动获得额外数量的表决权，足以使我们 F 类普通股的总表决权等于对于一般提交股东表决的事项在适用记录日我们已发行股本总表决权的 50.1%，即约 1,004,008 票额外表决权。未来发行任何额外的 A 类普通股股份（包括在转换我们 N 类普通股时发行）以及 N 类普通股，均无需经我们股东批准，除非纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准另有要求。

paras.en: **Future sales of our Class A common stock in the public market could cause the market price of our Class A common stock to decline.**
paras.zh: **我们 A 类普通股未来在公开市场的出售可能导致我们 A 类普通股的市场价格下跌。**

paras.en: The market price of our Class A common stock may decline due to sales of a large number of shares of our Class A common stock in the market after this offering. The potential for such sales to occur may also depress the market price of our Class A common stock. Following the completion of this offering, based on [__] shares of our Class A common stock outstanding and [__] shares of Class N common stock outstanding as of September 30, 2026 (after giving effect to the Preferred Stock Conversion, Convertible Notes Conversion, Initial Public Benefit Issuance, and RSU Settlement), we will have a total of [__] shares of Class A common stock outstanding and [__] shares of Class N common stock outstanding. Our directors, executive officers, and the holders of substantially all of our capital stock and securities convertible into or exchangeable for our capital stock have entered into market standoff agreements with us or have entered or will enter into lock-up agreements with Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, on behalf of the underwriters, under which they have agreed, subject to specific exceptions including specified early expiration provisions, to certain restrictions on their ability to transfer any shares of our Class A common stock or Class N common stock or securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock or Class N common stock during the period ending (i) in the case of our co-founders and certain of our stockholders holding more than 0.5% of our fully diluted shares prior to this offering, on the earlier of (A) 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the public release of our quarterly financial results for the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2027 and (B) immediately after the close of the trading day on the 365th day after the date of this prospectus, and (ii) in the case of all other such holders, on the earlier of (A) 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the public release of our quarterly financial results for the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2027 and (B) immediately after the close of the trading day on the 180th day after the date of this prospectus. Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC may release stockholders from the lock-up agreements, and we may, generally only with their consent, release stockholders from the market standoff agreements, in each case prior to the end of the applicable period. See the sections titled “Underwriting” and “Shares Eligible for Future Sale—Lock-Up and Market Standoff Agreements” for further information about these agreements, including the specified early expiration provisions.
paras.zh: 本次发行后，若市场大量出售我们的 A 类普通股，可能导致我们 A 类普通股的市场价格下跌。此类潜在出售也可能压低我们 A 类普通股的市场价格。本次发行完成后，基于截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日已发行的[__]股 A 类普通股和[__]股 N 类普通股（在使优先股转换、可转换本票转换、首次公益发行及 RSU 结算生效后），我们将合计拥有[__]股已发行 A 类普通股和[__]股已发行 N 类普通股。我们的董事、高级管理人员以及几乎全部股本和可转换为或可交换为我们股本的证券的持有人已与我们签订市场禁售协议，或已与或将要与代表承销商的高盛有限责任公司和摩根士丹利有限责任公司签订锁定期协议，据此，他们已同意在以下期间内对其转让任何 A 类普通股或 N 类普通股或可直接或间接转换为、可交换为或可行使为我们 A 类普通股或 N 类普通股的证券的能力受到某些限制（但受特定例外情形约束，包括特定的提前到期条款）：(i) 对于我们的联合创始人及在本次发行前持有我们完全稀释股份超过 0.5%的某些股东，该期间截至以下两者中较早者：(A) 在我们公开发布截至 2027 年 9 月 30 日财季的季度财务业绩后第二个完整交易日美国东部时间上午 6:00，以及 (B) 本招股说明书日期后第 365 个交易日收盘后立即；以及 (ii) 对于所有其他此类持有人，该期间截至以下两者中较早者：(A) 在我们公开发布截至 2027 年 3 月 31 日财季的季度财务业绩后第二个完整交易日美国东部时间上午 6:00，以及 (B) 本招股说明书日期后第 180 个交易日收盘后立即。高盛有限责任公司和摩根士丹利有限责任公司可解除股东的锁定期协议，且我们通常仅在征得其同意的情况下可解除股东的市场禁售协议，在每种情况下均可在适用期间结束前进行。有关这些协议（包括特定的提前到期条款）的更多信息，请参见“承销”和“未来可出售股份——锁定期与市场禁售协议”章节。

paras.en: As a result of these agreements and the provisions of our amended and restated investors’ rights agreement, dated as of May 28, 2026 (our “IRA”), as described further in the section titled “Description of Capital Stock— Registration Rights,” and subject to the provisions of Rule 144 or Rule 701 of the Securities Act, additional shares of our Class A common stock (including shares issuable upon conversion of our Class N common stock) will become available for sale in the public market at various times after the date of this offering, beginning on the first trading day following the date of this prospectus. See the section titled “Shares Eligible for Future Sale” for additional information.
paras.zh: 由于这些协议以及我们于 2026 年 5 月 28 日签订并经修订和重述的投资者权利协议（我们的“IRA”）的规定（详见“股本说明——登记权”一节），并在遵守《证券法》第 144 条或第 701 条规定的前提下，额外的 A 类普通股股份（包括在转换我们的 N 类普通股时可发行的股份）将在本次发行之日后的不同时间在公开市场可供出售，自本招股说明书日期后的第一个交易日起开始。更多信息请参见“未来可出售股份”一节。

paras.en: Upon completion of this offering, stockholders owning an aggregate of up to [__] shares of our Class A common stock (including those issuable upon conversion of our Class N common stock) will be entitled, under our IRA, to demand registration rights. In addition, we intend to file a registration statement to register shares reserved for future issuance under our equity compensation plans. Upon effectiveness of that registration statement, subject to the satisfaction of applicable exercise periods and the expiration or waiver of the market standoff agreements and lock-up agreements referred to above, the shares issued upon exercise of outstanding stock options or settlement of RSUs will be available for immediate resale in the United States in the open market.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，合计持有最多 [__] 股 A 类普通股（包括在转换我们的 N 类普通股时可发行的股份）的股东将有权根据我们的 IRA 要求行使登记权。此外，我们拟提交一份登记声明，以登记根据我们的股权激励计划预留供未来发行的股份。该登记声明生效后，在满足适用的行权期以及上述市场禁售协议和锁定期协议到期或获得豁免的前提下，因行使未行使的股票期权或结算 RSU 而发行的股份将可在美国公开市场立即转售。

paras.en: In addition, our co-founders have each pledged to dedicate 80% of their personal equity in Anthropic to philanthropic causes. These commitments are voluntary, revocable expressions of each co-founder’s philanthropic intent and do not constitute legally binding obligations. The timing, amount, recipients, structure, and manner of any donations in furtherance of this pledge are uncertain and will depend on a variety of factors, including each co-founder’s individual circumstances, tax and estate planning considerations, applicable transfer restrictions, market conditions, and philanthropic priorities at the relevant time. The co-founders may satisfy this pledge over time through a variety of means, including donations to donor-advised funds, charitable organizations, private foundations, or other philanthropic vehicles, certain of which have entered into irrevocable proxy agreements with us, as described under the section titled “Certain Relationships and Related Person Transactions—Irrevocable Proxy Agreements.” Donations of shares of our Class A common stock in furtherance of this pledge and any subsequent sales by recipients could, subject to the lock-up and market standoff agreements described above and applicable securities laws, result in the sale of a significant number of shares in the public market. Because the timing and amount of any such donations and sales cannot be predicted, any such sales, or the perception that such sales could occur, could depress the market price of our Class A common stock. These pledges relate to the co-founders’ personal economic interests in shares of our Class A common stock and do not apply to our Class F common stock or alter the Founder LLC voting structure described under the section titled “Our Governance Structure and Its Goals—Founder Voting Structure.” As such, as our co-founders make donations in furtherance of this pledge, their personal economic interests in us will decrease while their voting control through the Founder LLC will remain unchanged for so long as each co-founder continues to satisfy the minimum retained ownership condition for continued membership in the Founder LLC described in the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Founder LLC Agreement,” which may reduce the alignment between the interests of our co-founders and those of our other stockholders, or cause those interests to diverge.
paras.zh: 此外，我们的每位联合创始人均已承诺将其在 Anthropic 个人持股的 80% 用于慈善事业。这些承诺是每位联合创始人慈善意愿的自愿、可撤销表达，不构成具有法律约束力的义务。为履行该承诺而进行的任何捐赠的时间、金额、受赠方、结构及方式均不确定，并将取决于多种因素，包括每位联合创始人的个人情况、税务与遗产规划考量、适用的转让限制、市场状况以及相关时点的慈善优先事项。联合创始人可通过多种方式逐步履行该承诺，包括向捐赠人建议基金、慈善组织、私人基金会或其他慈善载体进行捐赠，其中某些载体已与我们签订不可撤销的代理协议，详见“某些关系及相关人士交易——不可撤销代理协议”一节。为履行该承诺而捐赠我们的 A 类普通股股份，以及受赠方随后进行的任何出售，在遵守上述锁定期与市场禁售协议及适用证券法的前提下，可能导致在公开市场出售大量股份。由于任何此类捐赠和出售的时间与金额无法预测，任何此类出售，或市场对此类出售可能发生的预期，均可能压低我们 A 类普通股的市场价格。这些承诺涉及联合创始人在我们 A 类普通股股份中的个人经济利益，不适用于我们的 F 类普通股，也不改变“我们的治理结构及其目标——创始人投票结构”一节所述的创始人有限责任公司投票结构。因此，随着联合创始人为履行该承诺进行捐赠，其在我们中的个人经济利益将减少，而只要每位联合创始人继续满足“股本说明——创始人有限责任公司协议”一节所述继续作为创始人有限责任公司成员的最低保留持股条件，其通过创始人有限责任公司享有的投票控制权将保持不变，这可能削弱联合创始人利益与我们其他股东利益之间的一致性，或导致这些利益出现分歧。

paras.en: Sales of our Class A common stock by stockholders as lock-up restrictions end or pursuant to registration rights may make it more difficult for us to sell equity securities in the future at a time and at a price that we deem appropriate. These sales may also cause the market price of our Class A common stock to fall and make it more difficult for you to sell shares of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 随着锁定期限制结束或依据登记权，股东出售我们的 A 类普通股，可能使我们在未来以我们认为适当的时间和价格出售股权证券变得更加困难。这些出售还可能导致我们 A 类普通股的市场价格下跌，并使您更难出售我们的 A 类普通股股份。

paras.en: **Because we do not anticipate paying any cash dividends on our capital stock in the foreseeable future, capital appreciation, if any, will be your sole source of gain.**
paras.zh: **由于我们预计在可预见的未来不会就我们的股本支付任何现金股息，因此资本增值（如有）将是您唯一的收益来源。**

paras.en: We do not anticipate paying cash dividends in the foreseeable future. We currently intend to retain future earnings, if any, to fund the development and growth of our business. In addition, the A&R Credit Agreement contains, and any future credit facility or financing we obtain may contain, terms limiting the amount of cash dividends that may be declared or paid on our capital stock. Any future determination to pay cash dividends will be at the discretion of our board of directors and will be dependent upon our financial condition, results of operations, capital requirements, and applicable contractual restrictions. As a result, stockholders should rely on sales of their Class A common stock or Class N common stock after price appreciation, if any, as the only way to realize any future gains on their investment.
paras.zh: 我们预计在可预见的未来不会支付现金股息。我们目前打算保留未来收益（如有），用于为业务的发展和增长提供资金。此外，经修订及重述的信贷协议（即 A&R Credit Agreement）包含、且我们未来获得的任何信贷安排或融资也可能包含限制可就我们的股本宣派或支付的现金股息金额的条款。任何未来支付现金股息的决定将由我们的董事会酌情决定，并将取决于我们的财务状况、经营业绩、资本需求以及适用的合同限制。因此，股东应依赖在股价上涨后出售其 A 类普通股或 N 类普通股（如有）作为实现其投资任何未来收益的唯一途径。

paras.en: **If securities or industry analysts do not publish research or publish inaccurate or unfavorable research about us, our business or our market, or if they change their recommendation regarding our Class A common stock adversely, the market price and trading volume of our Class A common stock could decline.**
paras.zh: **如果证券或行业分析师不发布关于我们、我们的业务或我们市场的研究报告，或发布不准确或不利的研究报告，或者如果他们不利地改变对 A 类普通股的推荐意见，则 A 类普通股的市场价格和交易量可能会下降。**

paras.en: The market price and trading volume for our Class A common stock will depend in part on the research and reports that securities or industry analysts publish about us, our business, our market, or our competitors. The analysts’ estimates are based upon their own opinions and are often different from our estimates or expectations. If any of the analysts who cover us change their recommendation regarding our Class A common stock adversely, provide more favorable relative recommendations about our competitors or publish inaccurate or unfavorable research about our business, the price of our securities would likely decline. If few securities analysts commence coverage of us, or if one or more of these analysts cease coverage of us or fail to publish reports on us regularly, we could lose visibility in the financial markets and demand for our securities could decrease, which could cause the price and trading volume of our Class A common stock to decline.
paras.zh: A 类普通股的市场价格和交易量将部分取决于证券或行业分析师发布的关于我们、我们的业务、我们的市场或我们竞争对手的研究和报告。分析师的估计基于其自身观点，且往往与我们的估计或预期不同。如果任何覆盖我们的分析师不利地改变其对 A 类普通股的推荐意见、对我们竞争对手给出更有利的相对推荐意见，或发布关于我们业务的不准确或不利的研究报告，我们的证券价格可能会下降。如果很少有证券分析师开始覆盖我们，或者如果这些分析师中的一位或多位停止覆盖我们或未能定期发布关于我们的报告，我们可能会在金融市场中失去可见度，对我们证券的需求可能会减少，这可能导致 A 类普通股的价格和交易量下降。

paras.en: This prospectus contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the federal securities laws, which statements involve substantial risks and uncertainties. All statements contained in this prospectus other than statements of historical fact, including statements regarding our future results of operations, financial position, market size and opportunity, our business strategy and plans, the factors affecting our performance, and our objectives for future operations, are forward-looking statements. In some cases, you can identify forward-looking statements because they contain words such as “may,” “will,” “shall,” “should,” “expect,” “plan,” “anticipate,” “could,” “intend,” “target,” “project,” “contemplate,” “believe,” “estimate,” “predict,” “potential,” “goal,” “objective,” “seek,” “forecast,” or “continue,” or the negative of any of these words or other similar terms or expressions that concern our expectations, strategy, plans, or intentions. Forward-looking statements contained in this prospectus include, but are not limited to, statements about:
paras.zh: 本招股说明书包含联邦证券法意义上的前瞻性陈述，该等陈述涉及重大风险和不确定性。本招股说明书中除历史事实陈述外的所有陈述，包括有关我们未来经营业绩、财务状况、市场规模与机会、我们的业务战略与计划、影响我们业绩的因素以及我们未来经营目标的陈述，均为前瞻性陈述。在某些情况下，您可以通过诸如“可能”“将”“应”“应当”“预期”“计划”“预计”“能够”“打算”“目标”“预测”“考虑”“相信”“估计”“预判”“潜在”“目的”“宗旨”“寻求”“展望”或“继续”等词语，或这些词语的否定形式，或其他涉及我们预期、战略、计划或意图的类似术语或表述，来识别前瞻性陈述。本招股说明书所载的前瞻性陈述包括但不限于以下方面的陈述：

paras.en: - our future financial performance, including our expectations regarding our revenue, compute and infrastructure expenses, and operating expenses, and our ability to achieve and maintain future profitability;
paras.zh: - 我们未来的财务表现，包括我们对收入、算力与基础设施费用以及经营费用的预期，以及我们实现并维持未来盈利能力的能力；

paras.en: - the sufficiency of our cash, cash equivalents, and investments and amounts available under our credit facility to meet our working capital and liquidity needs;
paras.zh: - 我们的现金、现金等价物及投资，以及我们信贷安排下可用金额，是否足以满足我们的营运资金和流动性需求；

paras.en: - the amount, nature, and timing of our capital expenditures and other compute and infrastructure commitments, our ability to fund such commitments and achieve expected returns, and our ability to convert compute investments into revenue-generating customer workloads on anticipated timelines;
paras.zh: - 我们的资本支出及其他算力与基础设施承诺的金额、性质和时机，我们为上述承诺提供资金并实现预期回报的能力，以及我们按预期时间表将算力投资转化为可产生收入的客户工作负载的能力；

paras.en: - our ability to successfully execute our business and growth strategy, including scaling our operations and managing costs, timelines, and operational complexity, and pursuing our public benefit initiatives consistent with our public benefit purpose;
paras.zh: - 我们成功执行业务与增长战略的能力，包括扩大运营规模、管理成本、时间表和运营复杂性，以及按照我们的公益宗旨推进公益倡议；

paras.en: - our expectations and management of future growth;
paras.zh: - 我们对未来增长的预期及管理；

paras.en: - our ability to raise additional capital through future debt or equity financing on acceptable terms, and the potential dilutive or restrictive effects of any such financing on our stockholders and operations;
paras.zh: - 我们以可接受的条件通过未来债务或股权融资筹集额外资本的能力，以及任何此类融资对我们的股东和运营可能产生的稀释或限制性影响；

paras.en: - our expectations concerning relationships with third parties and access to compute and infrastructure, including potential conflicts of interest with cloud service providers and chip partners that develop competing AI offerings;

paras.en: - our ability to develop new models, platforms, and applications and bring them to market in a timely manner and make enhancements to our current models, platform, and applications, and to remain at the frontier of AI;

paras.en: Certain estimates in this prospectus regarding global knowledge workers’ wages, which we refer to as the annual economic value represented by global knowledge workers, are our own, derived from third-party data. Based on wage data for U.S. workers by occupation classification from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics in 2025, we calculate the total salary for the subset of workers that we believe to represent knowledge workers. Based on International Labor Organization data for global labor income as a percentage of global GDP, and based on 2025 global GDP, we estimate a 2025 global wages figure. We calculate the ratio of total U.S. wages in 2025 to the 2025 global wages figure, and apply that ratio to the total U.S. knowledge workers’ wages figure to arrive at an estimate of global knowledge workers’ wages.
paras.zh: 本招股说明书中关于全球知识工作者工资的某些估计（我们称之为全球知识工作者所代表的年度经济价值）系我们自行得出，来源于第三方数据。基于美国劳工统计局 2025 年按职业分类划分的美国劳动者工资数据，我们计算了我们认为是知识工作者的那部分劳动者的工资总额。基于国际劳工组织关于全球劳动收入占全球 GDP 比重的数据，并基于 2025 年全球 GDP，我们估算出 2025 年全球工资总额。我们计算 2025 年美国工资总额与 2025 年全球工资总额的比率，并将该比率应用于美国知识工作者工资总额，从而得出对全球知识工作者工资的估计。

paras.en: The principal purposes of this offering are to increase our capitalization and financial flexibility, create a public market for our Class A common stock, facilitate an orderly distribution of shares for the selling stockholders, and enable access to the public equity markets for us and our stockholders.

paras.en: We have never declared or paid any cash dividends on our capital stock. We currently intend to retain all available funds and any future earnings to finance the operation and expansion of our business and do not expect to pay any dividends in the foreseeable future. Any future determination to declare cash dividends will be made at the discretion of our board of directors, subject to applicable laws, and will depend on a number of factors, including our financial condition, results of operations, capital requirements, contractual restrictions, general business conditions, and other factors that our board of directors may deem relevant. In addition, the terms of the A&R Credit Agreement place certain limitations on the amount of cash dividends we can pay, even if no amounts are currently outstanding under the credit facility.
paras.zh: 我们从未就我们的股本宣派或支付任何现金股息。我们目前拟保留所有可用资金及任何未来收益，用于为我们的业务运营和扩张提供资金，并且预计在可预见的未来不会支付任何股息。未来是否宣派现金股息将由我们的董事会酌情决定，并须遵守适用法律，且将取决于多项因素，包括我们的财务状况、经营业绩、资金需求、合同限制、一般商业状况以及我们的董事会可能认为相关的其他因素。此外，A&R 信贷协议的条款对我们可支付的现金股息金额设定了某些限制，即使目前该信贷安排下并无未偿还金额。

full.sec: Financial Condition and Results of Operations

paras.en: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the section titled “Summary Consolidated Financial and Other Data” and the consolidated financial statements and related notes thereto included elsewhere in this prospectus. This discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Factors that could cause or contribute to such differences include those identified below and those discussed elsewhere in this prospectus, particularly in the sections titled “Risk Factors” and “Special Note Regarding Forward-looking Statements.” Financial data as of and for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024, and 2025 have been derived from our audited consolidated financial statements appearing at the end of this prospectus. Our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any period in the future.
paras.zh: 以下关于我们财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析，应与本招股说明书中题为“合并财务及其他数据摘要”的章节以及本招股说明书其他部分所载的合并财务报表及相关附注一并阅读。本讨论包含涉及风险和不确定性的前瞻性陈述。可能导致或促成此类差异的因素包括下文所述因素以及本招股说明书其他部分所讨论的因素，尤其是题为“风险因素”和“关于前瞻性陈述的特别说明”的章节。截至 2023 年、2024 年和 2025 年 12 月 31 日及该等年度的财务数据取自本招股说明书末尾所载的经审计合并财务报表。我们的历史业绩不一定预示未来任何期间可能预期的业绩。

paras.en: Anthropic was founded in 2021 by a team of researchers responsible for many of the breakthroughs that define AI. We are first and foremost a research lab—our mission is the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity. This mission directs our focus—along with our talent and culture, our frontier and safety research, our approach to compute, and our enterprise strategy, it is one of the core advantages that set us apart. These advantages enable us to continuously advance frontier AI and shape the standards for its safe and responsible development. Our frontier AI, Claude, is delivered to customers through our models, platform, and applications. Claude has experienced the fastest enterprise adoption of any technology in history, as demonstrated by revenue growing from $0 at commercial launch in the first quarter of 2023 to $ [__] for the three monthsended September 30, 2026.
paras.zh: Anthropic 由一支研究人员团队于 2021 年创立，该团队曾主导了定义 AI 的诸多突破。我们首先且最重要的是一个研究实验室——我们的使命是负责任地开发和维护先进 AI，以造福人类的长期利益。这一使命指引着我们的重心——连同我们的人才与文化、我们的前沿与安全研究、我们的算力策略以及我们的企业战略，它是使我们脱颖而出的核心优势之一。这些优势使我们能够持续推进前沿 AI，并塑造其安全、负责任开发的标准。我们的前沿 AI——Claude，通过我们的模型、平台和应用程序交付给客户。Claude 经历了历史上任何技术中最快的企业采用速度，其体现是收入从 2023 年第一季度商业发布时的 $0 增长至截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止三个月的 $ [__]。

paras.en: Our financial model is built on four primary drivers that define the trajectory of our results:
paras.zh: 我们的财务模型建立在四个主要驱动因素之上，它们决定了我们业绩的走势：

paras.en: - Adoption of Claude [__] . [__] The advancing intelligence and capabilities of each successive version of a Claude model drive the diffusion of Claude across the global economy. As new customers adopt Claude and existing customers expand their usage into new workflows, our revenue grows.
paras.zh: - Claude 的采用 [__] 。[__] 每一代 Claude 模型不断进步的智能与能力，推动 Claude 在全球经济中的扩散。随着新客户采用 Claude、现有客户将使用范围扩展至新的工作流程，我们的收入随之增长。

paras.en: - Compute Efficiency [__] . [__] We are focused on increasing the intelligence produced and revenue generated per dollar of compute invested and have delivered significant efficiency improvements.
paras.zh: - 算力效率 [__] 。[__] 我们专注于提高每投入一美元算力所产出的智能和所创造的收入，并已实现显著的效率提升。

paras.en: - Operating Efficiency [__] . [__] Our high talent density, efficient go-to-market, and how extensively our teams leverage Claude in their work help to drive improved operating margin, Adjusted Operating Margin, and revenue per employee.
paras.zh: - 运营效率 [__] 。[__] 我们高密度的人才、高效的上市策略，以及各团队在工作中广泛使用 Claude，共同推动经营利润率、调整后经营利润率和人均收入的改善。

paras.en: - Compute Investments [__] . [__] Investing in compute is critical to support our long-term growth, and we intend to continue making substantial investments in compute.
paras.zh: - 算力投资 [__] 。[__] 投资算力对于支撑我们的长期增长至关重要，我们打算继续在算力上进行大规模投资。

paras.en: The drivers of our financial model materialize on different timelines. The adoption of Claude and associated revenue growth, compute efficiency, and operating efficiency have each increased rapidly over time. Compute is procured and committed in advance and the expense is incurred as it is brought online and added to our fungible pool, often in large, discrete steps. The fungible pool can support all workloads dynamically, including research, model development, serving customers, and internal usage of Claude. As a result, there is a lag between when investment is committed and when the full revenue associated with such investment is realized.
paras.zh: 我们财务模型的各项驱动因素在不同时间线上逐步显现。Claude 的采用及相关收入增长、算力效率和运营效率均随时间快速提升。算力是提前采购并承诺的，相关费用在算力上线并加入我们的可互换资源池时确认，且往往以大规模、离散的步骤发生。可互换资源池可动态支持所有工作负载，包括研究、模型开发、客户服务以及 Claude 的内部使用。因此，从承诺投资到实现与该投资相关的全部收入之间存在滞后。

paras.en: This dynamic has produced a financial model in which our operating margin and Adjusted Operating Margin for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 have expanded significantly year over year. As significant incremental compute is brought online in future periods, the associated expense will be recognized in advance of the full revenue that the compute will ultimately support, and we expect operating margin and Adjusted Operating Margin may compress in those periods. At our current stage, this cycle is an inherent aspect of our business and will cause operating margins to fluctuate from period to period, at times meaningfully, even if the underlying economics of the business continue to improve.
paras.zh: 这一动态造就了这样一种财务模型：截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止九个月，我们的经营利润率和调整后经营利润率同比大幅提升。随着未来期间大量新增算力上线，相关费用将在该算力最终支撑的全部收入实现之前确认，我们预计这些期间的经营利润率和调整后经营利润率可能承压。在我们当前阶段，这一周期是我们业务的内在特征，将导致经营利润率在各期间波动，有时波动幅度较大，即便业务的底层经济性持续改善。

paras.en: In addition, the majority of our compute is contracted under multi-year commitments that we typically procure 12 to 18 months in advance of availability. When customer demand or research needs exceed this long-term capacity, we procure short-term compute, which typically carries a higher cost per unit of compute. We expect our use of short-term compute to increase in the near term and to in turn compress our operating margin and Adjusted Operating Margin as a result.
paras.zh: 此外，我们的大部分算力以多年期承诺的形式签约，通常提前 12 至 18 个月采购。当客户需求或研究需求超出这一长期容量时，我们会采购短期算力，其单位算力成本通常更高。我们预计短期内短期算力的使用将会增加，进而使我们的经营利润率和调整后经营利润率承压。

paras.en: Each successive version of a Claude model is designed to advance the frontier with capabilities that customers value most, including coding, agentic workflows, computer use, and complex reasoning, which unlock new categories of use and drive compounding demand from new and existing customers. Claude’s intelligence is a primary driver of its diffusion and our revenue growth: because Claude leads at the AI frontier, customers rapidly adopt it, quickly see real value, and organically expand their use. We complement this intelligence-led growth with direct go-to-market and Applied AI teams and extend our reach through native availability across all three major cloud platforms—AWS, GCP, and Azure—and through partnerships with SIs, consultants, and data platforms [__] .
paras.zh: Claude 模型的每一个后续版本都旨在推进前沿，提供客户最看重的各项能力，包括编程、智能体工作流、计算机使用和复杂推理，这些能力开辟了新的使用类别，并推动新老客户需求持续叠加增长。Claude 的智能是其扩散和我们的收入增长的主要驱动力：由于 Claude 在 AI 前沿处于领先地位，客户迅速采用它，很快看到真实价值，并自发扩大使用。我们以直销市场团队和应用 AI 团队来补充这种以智能驱动的增长，并通过在三大主要云平台——AWS、GCP 和 Azure——上的原生可用性，以及与系统集成商（SI）、咨询公司和数据平台的合作来扩大我们的覆盖范围[__]。
