paras.en: We deliver this intelligence through an integrated approach. Our Claude model family is the foundation, with model classes optimized for different points along the capability-cost-speed curve. On top of our models, Claude Platform gives developers access to the primitives we use ourselves, which they can use to build their own AI solutions. We have also built first-party applications on Claude Platform for customers that prefer a ready-to-deploy option. We believe the value of this integrated approach is reflected in the increasing number of customers that use both Claude Platform and our first-party applications. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, over 50% of our customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis used Claude Platform and at least one of our first-party applications, up from approximately 30% for the three months ended December 31, 2025.
paras.zh: 我们通过一体化方式来交付这种智能。我们的 Claude 模型系列是基础，其中的模型类别针对能力—成本—速度曲线上不同位置进行了优化。在我们的模型之上，Claude Platform 让开发者能够使用我们自己使用的原语，他们可以用这些原语构建自己的 AI 解决方案。我们还为偏好开箱即用方案的客户，在 Claude Platform 上构建了第一方应用。我们相信，这种一体化方式的价值体现在越来越多的客户同时使用 Claude Platform 和我们的第一方应用。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止三个月，在我们按 TTM 计算收入达到 $100,000 或以上的客户中，超过 50% 同时使用了 Claude Platform 和至少一款我们的第一方应用，而截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止三个月这一比例约为 30%。

paras.en: As more customers adopt Claude and expand their usage, we have rapidly grown our base of customers that generate meaningful revenue. We had more than 11,900 customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis as of September 30, 2026, up from more than 950 as of September 30, 2025. In addition, as customers further embed Claude into their most critical workflows and growth initiatives, many rapidly expand their deployments into higher revenue tiers. As of September 30, 2026, we had more than 1,900 customers with $1 million or more of revenue on a TTM basis and approximately 250 customers with $10 million or more of revenue on a TTMbasis [__] .
paras.zh: 随着更多客户采用 Claude 并扩大使用，我们产生可观收入的客户群迅速增长。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们拥有超过 11,900 家按 TTM 计算收入达到 $100,000 或以上的客户，而截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日超过 950 家。此外，随着客户进一步将 Claude 嵌入其最关键的工作流和增长计划，许多客户迅速将部署扩展至更高收入层级。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们拥有超过 1,900 家按 TTM 计算收入达到 $1 million 或以上的客户，以及约 250 家按 TTM 计算收入达到 $10 million 或以上的客户[__]。

paras.en: This customer momentum is driven by significant usage expansion as customers realize the value of deploying Claude across their organizations. The value that Claude delivers to customers has helped drive our Net Revenue Retention of approximately 900% as of September 30, 2026.
paras.zh: 这种客户势头是由显著的使用扩张所驱动的，因为客户认识到在其组织内部署 Claude 的价值。Claude 为客户带来的价值帮助推动我们的净收入留存率截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日达到约 900%。

paras.en: The growth in our business reflects the degree to which enterprises are embedding Claude directly into their business-critical workflows. Despite these trends, adoption across the global economy remains nascent. As Claude’s capabilities continue to advance, we believe the addressable opportunity will expand, and Claude will continue its rapid diffusion across more enterprises.
paras.zh: 我们业务的增长反映了企业将 Claude 直接嵌入其业务关键工作流的程度。尽管有这些趋势，全球经济范围内的采用仍处于早期阶段。随着 Claude 的能力持续进步，我们相信可触达的机会将会扩大，Claude 将继续在更多企业中快速扩散。

paras.en: Compute is the most significant operating cost in our business, and compute efficiency is a critical determinant of our operating efficiency and revenue. Our research-driven algorithmic improvements in training and inference optimization and multi-chip compute architecture have combined to dramatically increase our compute efficiency as our revenue has scaled. The result is that we are able to continue increasing the intelligence our research can produce and the revenue our business can generate per dollar of compute investment.
paras.zh: 算力是我们业务中最重要的运营成本，而算力效率是决定我们运营效率和收入的关键因素。我们在训练与推理优化以及多芯片算力架构方面由研究驱动的算法改进相结合，随着我们收入规模的扩大，大幅提升了我们的算力效率。其结果是，我们能够持续提升研究所能产出的智能水平，以及业务每投入一美元算力所能产生的收入。

paras.en: We define compute efficiency as maximizing the intelligence produced and revenue generated per dollar of compute invested. Three pillars drive our compute efficiency:
paras.zh: 我们将算力效率定义为：每投入一美元算力所产出的智能与所创造的收入的最大化。三大支柱驱动我们的算力效率：

paras.en: - Training Efficiency [__] . [__] Our researchers regularly innovate compute multipliers. Increasingly, Claude itself assists in the research and engineering that produce each successive version of our models, which is a recursive dynamic we refer to as “closing the loop,” with successive versions of our models accelerating the development of the next and compounding these gains across model generations.
paras.zh: - 训练效率 [__] 。 [__] 我们的研究人员定期创新算力乘数。Claude 自身越来越多地协助产生我们每一代后续模型的研究与工程工作，我们将这一递归动态称为“闭环”，即我们模型的后续版本加速下一代模型的开发，并在各代模型之间复合这些收益。

paras.en: - Inference Efficiency [__] . [__] Our researchers have delivered meaningful compute multipliers for inference —reducing the compute required to serve a given level of model performance—while our engineering teams have driven significant optimizations in how efficiently that compute is utilized in production. This allows us to provide greater value for customers and generate greater revenue from our compute base over time, which is critical as we have consistently operated in a compute-constrained environment where customer demand exceeds available compute.
paras.zh: - 推理效率 [__] 。 [__] 我们的研究人员为推理带来了可观的算力乘数——降低了提供给定水平模型性能所需的算力——同时我们的工程团队在生产中如何高效利用算力方面实现了显著优化。这使我们能够为客户提供更大价值，并随着时间推移从我们的算力基础中产生更多收入，这一点至关重要，因为我们一直处于算力受限的环境中运营，客户需求超过可用算力。

paras.en: - Multi-Chip Compute Approach [__] . [__] We train and serve Claude natively across four major chip families (AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, and AMD GPUs) using a proprietary orchestration layer that enables us to optimize workloads for price and performance. This flexibility, which took years and significant investment to build and we believe is difficult to replicate at scale, expands our available compute, reduces dependence on any single vendor, and enables us to continuously route workloads to the most optimal hardware for those workloads [__] . [__] This foundation, paired with Claude’s increasing understanding of chip and model architectures, allows us to onboard new chip platforms in a fraction of the time this once required [__] .
paras.zh: - 多芯片算力方案 [__] 。 [__] 我们通过专有的编排层，在四大芯片系列（AWS Trainium、Google TPU、NVIDIA GPU 和 AMD GPU）上原生训练和提供 Claude 服务，该编排层使我们能够针对价格和性能优化工作负载。这种灵活性历时数年并投入大量资金才得以构建，我们认为难以在规模上复制，它扩大了我们的可用算力，降低了对任何单一供应商的依赖，并使我们能够持续将工作负载路由至最适合这些工作负载的最优硬件 [__] 。 [__] 这一基础，加上 Claude 对芯片和模型架构日益深入的理解，使我们能够以过去所需时间的一小部分完成新芯片平台的上线 [__] 。

paras.en: Revenue per dollar of compute has expanded meaningfully, even as we have accelerated research and product velocity and expanded our internal Claude usage. For example, our revenue grew [__] 1,368% year over year for the three months ended June 30, 2026, compared to our compute and infrastructure expenses that grew [__] 300% during the same period. While serving our growing customer demand, we also made significant research advances to the frontier with new leading models, including Mythos 5, Fable 5, and Opus 5, and launched new products, including Claude Cowork and Claude Design [__] .
paras.zh: 即便我们加快了研究和产品推进速度并扩大了内部 Claude 的使用，每美元算力所产生的收入仍显著扩大。例如，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止三个月，我们的收入同比增长 [__] 1,368%，而同期我们的算力和基础设施费用增长 [__] 300%。在满足我们不断增长的客户需求的同时，我们还凭借包括 Mythos 5、Fable 5 和 Opus 5 在内的新领先模型在前沿领域取得了重大研究进展，并推出了包括 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Design 在内的新产品 [__] 。

paras.en: Our operating efficiency is derived from our high talent density, our efficient go-to-market, and how extensively our teams leverage Claude in their work. Claude is the common thread, amplifying the output of our employees. For example, over 90% of the contributions to our codebase in September 2026 were written by Claude. Additionally, the average daily volume of code contributed to our codebase per engineer in the three months ended September 30, 2026 was over 45 times the average daily volume in the year ended December 31, 2024 [__] .
paras.zh: 我们的运营效率源自我们的人才密度、高效的市场推广方式，以及我们的团队在工作中对 Claude 的广泛运用。Claude 是贯穿其中的共同主线，放大了我们员工的产出。例如，2026 年 9 月，我们代码库中超过 90% 的贡献由 Claude 编写。此外，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的三个月内，每位工程师平均每日向代码库贡献的代码量超过截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度平均每日代码量的 45 倍 [__] 。

paras.en: From September 30, 2025 to September 30, 2026, TTM revenue increased approximately 1,200% while headcount increased approximately 170%, driving TTM revenue per employee from $1.4 million to over $6.6 million, a reflection of extraordinary talent density and a culture built to compound it [__] .
paras.zh: 从 2025 年 9 月 30 日到 2026 年 9 月 30 日，过去十二个月（TTM）收入增长约 1,200%，而员工人数增长约 170%，推动每位员工的 TTM 收入从 $1.4 million 增至超过 $6.6 million，这体现了非凡的人才密度以及为使其持续复利增长而构建的文化 [__] 。

paras.en: Our go-to-market model reflects this as well—intelligence-led growth and broad distribution partnerships enable us to rapidly expand customer adoption and revenue without being limited by the rate at which we can grow our sales and marketing organization, resulting in greater sales efficiency as compared to typical enterprise technology companies.
paras.zh: 我们的市场推广模式也体现了这一点——智能驱动的增长和广泛的渠道合作伙伴关系使我们能够快速扩大客户采用和收入，而不受制于我们销售和营销组织的增长速度，从而相比典型的企业技术公司实现更高的销售效率。

paras.en: Our revenue was $16.3 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026, up from $1.2 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2025. Our operating loss was $693 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026, down from $2.1 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2025. The result of our revenue growth, compute efficiency, and operating efficiency has been a significant improvement in Adjusted Operating Income, which was $1.6 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026, up from Adjusted Operating Loss of $1.8 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2025. We expect operating margin and Adjusted Operating Margin to fluctuate over time, particularly in periods when substantial incremental compute is delivered to us and we incur the associated expenses. See the section titled “—Non-GAAP Financial Measures” for a description of and information about Adjusted Operating Income (Loss) and Adjusted Operating Margin, as well as a reconciliation of these measures to the most directly comparable financial measures calculated in accordance with GAAP.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的六个月，我们的收入为 $16.3 billion，高于截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日的六个月的 $1.2 billion。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的六个月，我们的经营亏损为 $693 million，低于截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日的六个月的 $2.1 billion。我们的收入增长、算力效率和运营效率共同带来了调整后经营利润的显著改善，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的六个月为 $1.6 billion，而截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日的六个月为调整后经营亏损 $1.8 billion。我们预计经营利润率和调整后经营利润率将随时间波动，尤其是在向我们交付大量增量算力并产生相关费用的期间。有关调整后经营利润（亏损）和调整后经营利润率的说明和信息，以及这些指标与按照 GAAP 计算的最直接可比财务指标的调节表，请参见标题为“—非 GAAP 财务指标”的章节。

paras.en: Investing in compute is a prerequisite for long-term growth. We invest in compute for research, model development, serving customers, and internal usage of Claude. Our commercial traction, research progress, and the scale of the opportunity ahead give us the conviction to continue investing aggressively in compute. An increasing portion of these investments relates to building out our own compute and infrastructure and vertically integrating across the compute supply chain to secure long-term compute at the scale required for frontier model development. These investments take the form of capital expenditures and other commitments, including lease obligations, that we incur well in advance of the related compute becoming operational and generating revenue. As a result, we expect this build-out to change the cash flow profile of our business and to be a significant use of net cash in operating and investing activities for the foreseeable future. See the section titled “—Liquidity and Capital Resources” for more information.
paras.zh: 投资算力是实现长期增长的前提条件。我们为研究、模型开发、服务客户以及 Claude 的内部使用而投资算力。我们的商业进展、研究进展以及未来机遇的规模，使我们有信念继续在算力上大举投资。这些投资中越来越大的部分涉及建设我们自己的算力和基础设施，并在算力供应链上进行垂直整合，以确保获得前沿模型开发所需规模的长期算力。这些投资以资本支出和其他承诺的形式体现，包括租赁义务，且我们在相关算力投入运营并产生收入之前很早就已承担这些支出。因此，我们预计这一建设将改变我们业务的现金流特征，并在可预见的未来成为经营活动和投资活动中净现金的重要用途。更多信息请参见标题为“—流动性与资本资源”的章节。

paras.en: In addition, as our compute needs have grown substantially, we are shifting from sourcing compute solely through fixed-term cloud agreements to a hybrid model that also includes leasing chips directly and hosting them in dedicated facilities operated on our behalf. We refer to this additional source of compute as Anthropic Direct, which helps to address our scaling compute requirements and we believe will provide long-term economic advantages. Anthropic Direct represents a more flexible use of capital by allowing us to separate our commitments for data center capacity from our commitments for the compute infrastructure deployed inside them. Because data centers require longer lead times but represent a smaller fraction of total compute costs, this approach enables us to secure data center capacity early while deferring larger accelerator investments until our specific compute needs are more certain.
paras.zh: 此外，随着我们的算力需求大幅增长，我们正从仅通过固定期限云协议获取算力，转向一种混合模式，该模式还包括直接租赁芯片并将其托管在由我们代为运营的专用设施中。我们将这一额外的算力来源称为 Anthropic Direct，它有助于满足我们不断扩大的算力需求，我们相信它将带来长期的经济优势。Anthropic Direct 通过使我们能够将数据中心容量的承诺与部署于其中的算力基础设施的承诺相分离，实现了更灵活的资本运用。由于数据中心需要更长的交付周期，但在总算力成本中所占比例较小，这种方法使我们能够尽早锁定数据中心容量，同时将规模更大的加速器投资推迟到我们的具体算力需求更加明确之时。

paras.en: As of and subsequent to September 30, 2026, we have entered into purchase commitments and lease agreements, including short-term commitments, as well as leases not yet commenced, with an aggregate committed spend of more than $ [__] . These commitments include approximately $ [__] expected to be incurred before December 31, 2030, and substantially all of the remainder is expected to be incurred between 2031 and 2045. Approximately $ [__] of these commitments are due in the next 12 months. A significant portion of this total committed spend relates to Anthropic Direct, and we expect it to represent a growing share of our compute investments over time. The flexibility from Anthropic Direct allows us to backfill the short-term compute we procure during periods of high demand with more cost-effective, long-term compute as our dedicated infrastructure comes online.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日及此后，我们已签订采购承诺和租赁协议，包括短期承诺以及尚未开始的租赁，合计承诺支出超过 $[__]。这些承诺包括预计在 2030 年 12 月 31 日之前发生的约 $[__]，其余绝大部分预计将在 2031 年至 2045 年之间发生。这些承诺中约 $[__] 将在未来 12 个月内到期。这一承诺支出总额的很大一部分与 Anthropic Direct 相关，我们预计其在我们算力投资中的占比将随时间推移而增长。Anthropic Direct 带来的灵活性使我们能够在需求旺盛时期，随着专用基础设施上线，用更具成本效益的长期算力来补充我们采购的短期算力。

paras.en: We intend to fund these investments through the revenue we generate and the capital that we raise. As of September 30, 2026, and prior to taking into account the net proceeds to us from this offering, we had [__] $ of liquidity, comprised of [__] $of cash and cash equivalents, [__] $of short-term investments, and $ [__] of availability under our A&R Credit Facility (as defined below). We also maintain significant funding support from our strategic partners, including up to $ [__] in available financing capacity under our note purchase agreements and up to $ [__] in equity commitments. In addition, we estimate that the net proceeds to us from this offering will be approximately $ [__] , based upon the assumed initial public offering price of $ [__] per share, which is the midpoint of the estimated offering price range set forth on the cover page of this prospectus, and after deducting estimated underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us, or approximately $ [__] if the underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares of our Class A common stock from us is exercised in full.
paras.zh: 我们计划通过我们产生的收入和筹集的资本来为这些投资提供资金。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，在未计入本次发行向我们提供的净收益之前，我们拥有 [__] $ 的流动性，其中包括 [__] $ 的现金及现金等价物、[__] $ 的短期投资，以及根据我们的 A&R 信贷融资（定义见下文）可获得的 $ [__] 额度。我们还从战略合作伙伴处获得了重要的资金支持，包括根据我们的票据购买协议可获得的高达 $ [__] 的融资额度，以及高达 $ [__] 的股权承诺。此外，我们估计本次发行向我们提供的净收益约为 $ [__]，该估算基于每股 $ [__] 的假定首次公开发行价格（即本招股说明书封面所载估计发行价格区间的中点），并扣除我们应付的估计承销折扣和佣金以及估计发行费用；若承销商全额行使向我们购买额外 A 类普通股的选择权，则约为 $ [__] 。

paras.en: At the foundation of our business is our family of four Claude model classes—Mythos (including Fable), Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku—each optimized for a different point on the capability-cost-speed curve. Our frontier models allow customers to match the right model to each use case. Customers typically use higher-capability models for complex reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows where greater model intelligence is required. Customers also frequently adopt our full range of models, routing individual tasks to the models that are most optimized to meet their needs along the capability-cost-speed curve. The model a customer uses and the volume of usage are the primary drivers of customer spend. We establish a direct contractual relationship with the customer and offer customers the flexibility to purchase directly from us or through CSP marketplaces, and many customers utilize both channels.
paras.zh: 我们业务的基础是我们的四类 Claude 模型系列——Mythos（包括 Fable）、Opus、Sonnet 和 Haiku——每一类都针对能力-成本-速度曲线上不同的位置进行了优化。我们的前沿模型使客户能够为每个用例匹配最合适的模型。客户通常将能力更高的模型用于需要更强模型智能的复杂推理、编码和智能体工作流。客户也经常采用我们的全系列模型，将各项任务路由到在能力-成本-速度曲线上最能满足其需求的模型。客户使用的模型和使用量是客户支出的主要驱动因素。我们与客户建立直接的合同关系，并为客户提供直接从我们处购买或通过 CSP 市场购买的灵活性，许多客户同时使用这两种渠道。

paras.en: Pay-for-intelligence, our consumption-based revenue model, is our primary revenue model and currently represents the substantial majority of our total revenue. Under this model, customers pay for usage, which is metered in tokens and priced according to the model selected. Our pay-for-intelligence revenue is primarily generated from customers building applications incorporating Claude or utilizing our first-party applications.
paras.zh: 按智能付费（pay-for-intelligence）是我们基于用量的收入模式，是我们的主要收入模式，目前占我们总收入的绝大部分。在该模式下，客户按用量付费，用量以 token 计量，并根据所选模型定价。我们的按智能付费收入主要来自将 Claude 集成到其应用程序中的客户或使用我们第一方应用程序的客户。

paras.en: In addition, we offer certain of our applications on a subscription basis, serving both enterprises and prosumers. Under this model, customers pay a subscription fee for a specified level of usage and capabilities during the subscription term, which is generally 12 months or less.
paras.zh: 此外，我们以订阅方式提供某些应用程序，服务于企业和专业消费者。在该模式下，客户在订阅期内（通常为 12 个月或更短）支付订阅费，以获得特定水平的用量和能力。

paras.en: Depending on the model, platform, or applications chosen by our customers, they enter into pay-for-intelligence pricing, subscription-based pricing, or both. For example, when subscribers approach or exhaust the usage capacity included in their tier, they may utilize a higher subscription tier or purchase more intelligence directly, creating a seamless bridge from subscription to incremental pay-for-intelligence revenue.
paras.zh: 根据客户所选择的模型、平台或应用程序，他们采用按智能付费定价、基于订阅的定价，或两者兼用。例如，当订阅用户接近或耗尽其所处层级包含的用量容量时，他们可能会使用更高的订阅层级或直接购买更多智能，从而形成从订阅到增量按智能付费收入的无缝衔接。

paras.en: A growing number of enterprise customers agree to non-cancelable annual or multi-year contracts with minimum spend commitments in exchange for a committed price list. These contracts result primarily in consumption-based revenue.
paras.zh: 越来越多的企业客户同意签订不可取消的年度或多年期合同，承诺最低支出，以换取承诺的价格表。这些合同主要产生基于用量的收入。

paras.en: Consumption-based revenue increased from $288 million, or 75% of total revenue, for the year ended
paras.zh: 基于消费的收入从截至该年度的 $288 million（占总收入的 75%）增长

paras.en: December 31, 2024, to $3.8 billion, or 83% of total revenue, for the year ended December 31, 2025, to [__] $13.1 billion, or 80%of total revenue, for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Subscription-based revenue increased from $98 million, or 25% of total revenue, to $789 million, or 17% of total revenue, to $3.2 billion, or [__] 20% of total revenue, over the same periods. The higher increase in consumption-based revenue reflects the growth in customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis. For 2023, our revenue of $41 million was substantially all consumption-based, reflecting our early operations. We expect consumption-based revenue to continue to represent the substantial majority of total revenue for the foreseeable future.
paras.zh: 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度的 $288 million（占总收入的 75%），增至截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度的 $3.8 billion（占总收入的 83%），再增至截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六个月的 [__] $13.1 billion（占总收入的 80%）。基于订阅的收入在相同期间内从 $98 million（占总收入的 25%）增至 $789 million（占总收入的 17%），再增至 $3.2 billion（占总收入的 [__] 20%）。基于用量的收入增幅更高，反映了过去十二个月（TTM）收入达到 $100,000 或以上的客户有所增长。2023 年，我们的收入为 $41 million，几乎全部为基于用量的收入，反映了我们早期的运营情况。我们预计，在可预见的未来，基于用量的收入将继续占总收入的绝大部分。

paras.en: Our recent growth may reflect early-stage adoption dynamics, the nascency of the AI market, and rapid initial customer expansion that may not be sustainable over time. We expect our revenue growth rate to decline over time, and it may decline significantly and more rapidly than we anticipate as our revenue base increases and as the market matures.
paras.zh: 我们近期的增长可能反映了早期阶段的采用动态、AI 市场的初生阶段以及可能无法长期持续的客户快速初期扩张。我们预计我们的收入增长率将随时间推移而下降，并且随着我们收入基数的增加以及市场的成熟，其下降幅度可能显著且快于我们的预期。

full.sec: Our Customers and Approach to Claude Diffusion
full.secZh: 我们的客户及 Claude 推广策略

paras.en: #### Our Customers
paras.zh: #### 我们的客户

paras.en: We serve enterprises of all sizes and across industries, in nearly every region of the world. Organizations that use Claude range from the world’s largest enterprises to AI-native startups, research institutions, and mission-driven organizations working on some of the world’s most consequential problems. Customers realize value from Claude in three primary ways: more productive employees, faster processes, and embedded intelligence in their products. As enterprise customers push Claude into increasingly complex workflows, we engage with them to understand their evolving requirements, which helps shape our product roadmap. This feedback loop deepens customer relationships with each release and makes Claude more capable for all customers.
paras.zh: 我们服务于全球几乎所有地区、各行业、各种规模的企业。使用 Claude 的组织涵盖从全球最大的企业到 AI 原生初创公司、研究机构，以及致力于解决全球一些最重大问题的使命驱动型组织。客户主要通过三种方式从 Claude 中获得价值：提升员工生产力、加快流程速度，以及将智能嵌入其产品之中。随着企业客户将 Claude 应用于日益复杂的工作流程，我们与他们保持沟通以了解其不断变化的需求，这有助于塑造我们的产品路线图。这一反馈闭环在每次发布中加深了客户关系，并使 Claude 对所有客户都更加强大。

paras.en: Software developers have been core to our strategy: they are simultaneously the architects of applications built on our platform, and they encode their workflows and institutional knowledge into Claude-powered agents. Developers have been our earliest adopters and often most discerning users: they apply models to unanticipated use cases quickly and surface the edge cases that sharpen each successive version of a Claude model. Claude Code is now embedded in software development workflows across major organizations, with these relationships often beginning with individual engineers who recognized the value of autonomous coding agents and accelerated adoption across their enterprises [__] .
paras.zh: 软件开发者一直是我们战略的核心：他们既是在我们平台上构建应用的架构师，也将自己的工作流程和机构知识编码进由 Claude 驱动的智能体中。开发者是我们最早的采用者，往往也是最挑剔的用户：他们迅速将模型应用于意想不到的用例，并揭示出边缘情况，从而打磨每一个后续版本的 Claude 模型。Claude Code 现已嵌入各大组织的软件开发工作流程，这些关系往往始于认可自主编程智能体价值的个体工程师，并由他们加速推动其所在企业的采用 [__] 。

paras.en: The same intelligence and capabilities we deliver to enterprises are also valuable to prosumers in their personal endeavors. These users provide strategic value as a top-of-funnel engine for our enterprise business— individuals who utilize Claude for their personal work and then champion it inside their organizations.
paras.zh: 我们为企业提供的智能与能力，对个人专业人士在个人事务中同样具有价值。这些用户作为我们企业业务的漏斗顶端引擎，具有战略价值——他们个人在工作中使用 Claude，随后在其组织内部成为 Claude 的倡导者。

paras.en: We are seeing broad-based growth across customer use cases, from software development to financial analysis, content creation, and complex knowledge work. Claude is extensible: regardless of entry point, enterprises quickly discover that frontier AI applies to a wide and expanding range of tasks across their organizations. As a result, what sometimes begins as a single use case frequently expands into broader adoption spanning coding, legal analysis, financial modeling, customer operations, and other knowledge-intensive work.
paras.zh: 我们看到客户用例呈现广泛增长，从软件开发到财务分析、内容创作和复杂知识工作。Claude 具有可扩展性：无论从哪个切入点开始，企业很快就会发现前沿 AI 适用于其组织内广泛且不断扩展的任务范围。因此，有时始于单一用例的应用，常常扩展为涵盖编程、法律分析、财务建模、客户运营及其他知识密集型工作的更广泛采用。

paras.en: #### Our Approach to Claude Diffusion
paras.zh: #### 我们推动 Claude 普及的方法

paras.en: A core driver of Claude’s diffusion is its intelligence—as Claude’s capabilities advance, value to customers expands, and that value drives greater adoption. Ensuring the accessibility of such intelligence is also critical, and we do that in the following ways: through our composable platform and applications that meet customers where they are, through our go-to-market and Applied AI teams directly, and through partnerships that extend our reach at scale.
paras.zh: Claude 普及的核心驱动力在于其智能——随着 Claude 能力的提升，客户获得的价值不断扩大，而这种价值又推动更广泛的采用。确保这种智能的可及性同样至关重要，我们通过以下方式实现这一点：通过我们的可组合平台和应用，在客户所在之处满足其需求；通过我们的市场推广团队和应用 AI 团队直接对接；以及通过合作伙伴关系在规模上扩展我们的覆盖范围。

paras.en: Intelligence-Led Growth. Our platform and applications are the primary mechanism through which Claude’s intelligence can reach users. As users begin building, brainstorming, and problem-solving with Claude, they quickly come to rely on it as a trusted partner in their work. As Claude becomes part of how people work, they experience firsthand what frontier AI makes possible, and such individual adoption reshapes how entire organizations operate. This pattern repeats across organizations: prosumers become internal champions, teams expand their use of Claude, and what begins as a single workflow grows into something that impacts how an entire organization operates. This pattern has been core to our revenue growth.
paras.zh: 智能驱动的增长。我们的平台和应用是 Claude 的智能触达用户的主要机制。当用户开始借助 Claude 进行构建、头脑风暴和解决问题时，他们很快便将其视为工作中值得信赖的伙伴。随着 Claude 成为人们工作方式的一部分，他们亲身感受到前沿 AI 所能实现的可能性，而这种个体层面的采用会重塑整个组织的运作方式。这一模式在各个组织中反复上演：专业消费者成为内部倡导者，团队扩大对 Claude 的使用，最初单一的工作流程逐渐发展为影响整个组织运作方式的事物。这一模式一直是我们收入增长的核心。

paras.en: Direct Teams. This organic adoption is complemented and enhanced through our direct go-to-market teams who help scale Claude to organizations with complex workflows and business processes. By the time our direct teams engage a customer, Claude is often already in use. Our go-to-market teams use this organic momentum to build executive sponsorship and drive enterprise-wide adoption.
paras.zh: 直销团队。这种自然采用通过我们的直销团队得到补充和增强，他们帮助将 Claude 扩展至拥有复杂工作流程和业务流程的组织。当我们的直销团队接触客户时，Claude 往往已在使用之中。我们的市场推广团队利用这一自然增长势头建立高管支持，并推动全企业范围的采用。

paras.en: Applied AI Teams. Our Applied AI teams embed more deeply with select customers, building solutions that make it easier for organizations to benefit from Claude’s intelligence. They work with enterprises to design and deploy custom solutions, specialized workflows, and domain-specific implementations tailored to the customer’s own requirements. This work drives deeper adoption within individual customers and generates the feedback and information from users that help to shape our platform and product roadmap.
paras.zh: 应用 AI 团队。我们的应用 AI 团队与精选客户进行更深入的协作，构建解决方案，使组织更容易从 Claude 的智能中获益。他们与企业合作，设计并部署定制解决方案、专业化工作流程以及针对客户自身需求量身定制的特定领域实施方案。这项工作推动了单个客户内部的更深层次采用，并产生了来自用户的反馈和信息，帮助塑造我们的平台和产品路线图。

paras.en: Cloud Partnerships. Claude is accessible on all three major cloud platforms, AWS, GCP, and Azure, allowing enterprises to deploy Claude within the infrastructure, security perimeters, and commitment structures they already operate. These CSPs extend our reach through their large combined field teams that are empowered to sell our platform and applications, accelerating market adoption at a scale we believe would be difficult for any single organization to directly replicate. We have a joint go-to-market approach with these CSPs through which we establish direct contractual relationships with our customers while paying a fee to each CSP. This structure allows us to foster stronger commercial alignment with these CSPs, avoid channel conflict, set pricing, and realize the financial benefits of ongoing compute efficiency improvements.
paras.zh: 云合作伙伴关系。Claude 可在全部三大主要云平台 AWS、GCP 和 Azure 上使用，使企业能够在他们已运营的基础设施、安全边界和承诺结构内部署 Claude。这些 CSP 通过其庞大的联合现场团队扩大我们的覆盖范围，这些团队被授权销售我们的平台和应用，以我们认为任何单一组织都难以直接复制的规模加速市场采用。我们与这些 CSP 采取联合市场推广方式，通过这种方式我们与客户建立直接的合同关系，同时向每家 CSP 支付费用。这一结构使我们能够与这些 CSP 建立更强的商业一致性，避免渠道冲突，设定价格，并实现持续算力效率提升所带来的财务收益。

paras.en: Ecosystem Partnerships. Major global SIs have built dedicated Claude practices with teams trained to deploy our platform and applications. Go-to-market alliances with leading data platforms embed Claude into data infrastructure that enterprises already operate, facilitating adoption of Claude within existing workflows and making it easier for enterprises to realize value from Claude.
paras.zh: 生态系统合作伙伴关系。全球主要 SI 已建立专门的 Claude 业务实践，其团队经过培训可部署我们的平台和应用。与领先数据平台的市场推广联盟将 Claude 嵌入企业已运营的数据基础设施中，促进 Claude 在现有工作流程中的采用，并使企业更容易从 Claude 中实现价值。

paras.en: Ode with Anthropic. We recently launched an AI services company in partnership with leading private equity firms to bring Claude’s capabilities to mid-sized companies across sectors, building solutions on the Claude Platform and supporting customers over the long term. Ode with Anthropic will partner closely with our Applied AI and go-to-market teams.
paras.zh: Ode with Anthropic。我们近期与领先的私募股权公司合作成立了一家 AI 服务公司，将 Claude 的能力带给各行业的中型企业，在 Claude 平台上构建解决方案并长期支持客户。Ode with Anthropic 将与我们的应用 AI 团队和市场推广团队紧密合作。

paras.en: Together, these approaches have led to a structurally efficient approach to facilitating the diffusion of Claude in the economy, with our sales, marketing, and partnerships expenses representing [__] 19% of revenue for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
paras.zh: 这些方法共同形成了一种结构性高效的方式，促进 Claude 在经济中的扩散，我们截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六个月的销售、营销和合作费用占收入的 [__] 19%。

full.secZh: 影响我们业绩的关键因素

paras.en: #### Remaining at the Frontier of AI
paras.zh: #### 保持在 AI 前沿

paras.en: We believe enterprises consistently choose the most capable and trustworthy AI systems, making our position at the frontier an important driver of our success. Our ability to rapidly grow our revenue is partially dependent on our continued delivery of more intelligent and capable models. Our experience is that as we deliver models with meaningfully improved capabilities that deliver higher intelligence per dollar spent, customers find new applications for AI across their businesses, accelerating adoption and revenue growth.
paras.zh: 我们相信，企业会始终选择能力最强、最值得信赖的 AI 系统，因此我们处于前沿的地位是我们成功的重要驱动因素。我们快速实现收入增长的能力，部分取决于我们能否持续交付更智能、能力更强的模型。我们的经验是，当我们交付能力显著提升、每美元支出能带来更高智能水平的模型时，客户会在其各项业务中发现 AI 的新应用场景，从而加速采用并推动收入增长。

paras.en: This can be seen in the trajectory of our model family adoption. Successive versions of our most intelligent generally available model have delivered meaningfully greater intelligence and capabilities. With each release, we have seen most customers utilize the latest version of our models, reinforcing the direct relationship between frontier model quality and revenue generation. As we deliver more capable models, customers have expanded their usage into new use cases and increased their spending accordingly.
paras.zh: 这一点可以从我们模型系列采用率的轨迹中看出。我们最智能的通用可用模型的 successive 版本都带来了显著更强的智能和能力。随着每一次发布，我们看到大多数客户都会使用我们模型的最新版本，这进一步印证了前沿模型质量与收入创造之间的直接关系。随着我们交付能力更强的模型，客户已将使用范围扩展到新的用例，并相应增加了支出。

paras.en: We expect our ability to deliver innovation in intelligence and capability at the frontier to remain a key driver of revenue growth in future periods, and maintaining a leading position requires continued investment in research and compute, top technical talent, and access to capital sufficient to support our growth trajectory.
paras.zh: 我们预计，我们在前沿智能和能力方面持续创新的能力，仍将是未来期间收入增长的关键驱动因素，而保持领先地位需要持续投资于研究和算力、顶尖技术人才，以及足以支撑我们增长轨迹的资本获取能力。

paras.en: #### Securing Sufficient Compute and Optimizing its Utilization
paras.zh: #### 确保充足算力并优化其利用率

paras.en: Our ability to continue advancing intelligence at the frontier depends on securing sufficient compute for research, model development, serving customers, and internal usage of Claude. Our ability to leverage heterogeneous compute helps us to secure compute at sufficient scale and optimal price-performance. If any of our chip partners are unable to deliver committed compute or experience delays, or if we need to procure incremental compute, we benefit from having a range of partners as opposed to being overly reliant on any one partner. The availability, timing, and cost of compute are subject to factors largely outside our control, including the concentration of chip and memory manufacturing among a limited number of suppliers and geographies, constraints on the availability of power and data center capacity, and evolving export controls. We have historically operated in a compute-constrained environment in which demand for compute has exceeded the supply available to us. In addition, certain of the CSPs on which we rely for compute are also strategic investors in us, are our customers, and offer AI models and services that compete with ours. These multifaceted relationships could give rise to conflicts of interest or competitive dynamics that adversely affect our access to compute, its cost, or the prioritization of our workloads.
paras.zh: 我们能否继续在前沿推进智能，取决于能否获得充足算力，用于研究、模型开发、客户服务以及 Claude 的内部使用。我们利用异构算力的能力，有助于我们以足够的规模和最优的性价比获得算力。如果我们的任何芯片合作伙伴无法交付承诺的算力或出现延迟，或者如果我们需要采购增量算力，我们受益于拥有多个合作伙伴，而不是过度依赖任何单一合作伙伴。算力的可用性、时间和成本受制于我们基本无法控制的因素，包括芯片和内存制造集中在数量有限的供应商和地区、电力和数据中心容量的可用性限制，以及不断变化的出口管制。我们历史上一直在算力受限的环境中运营，其中算力需求超过了我们可获得的供应。此外，我们依赖其提供算力的某些 CSP 也是我们的战略投资者、我们的客户，并提供与我们竞争的 AI 模型和服务。这些多方面的关系可能引发利益冲突或竞争动态，从而对我们的算力获取、成本或工作负载优先级产生不利影响。

paras.en: As our compute needs have grown substantially, we are shifting from sourcing compute solely through fixed-term cloud agreements to a hybrid model that also includes leasing chips directly and hosting them in dedicated facilities operated on our behalf. We refer to this additional source of compute as Anthropic Direct, which helps to address our scaling compute requirements and provides potential long-term economic advantages of direct hosting. Anthropic Direct provides us with a more flexible use of capital by allowing us to separate our commitments for data center capacity from our commitments for the AI accelerators deployed inside them. Because data centers require longer lead times but represent a smaller fraction of total compute costs, this approach enables us to secure data center capacity early while deferring larger accelerator investments until our specific compute needs are more certain.
paras.zh: 随着我们的算力需求大幅增长，我们正从仅通过固定期限云协议获取算力，转向一种混合模式，该模式还包括直接租赁芯片并将其托管在由我们代为运营的专用设施中。我们将这一额外的算力来源称为 Anthropic Direct，它有助于满足我们不断扩大的算力需求，并带来直接托管潜在的长期经济优势。Anthropic Direct 通过允许我们将数据中心容量的承诺与部署于其中的 AI 加速器的承诺相分离，为我们提供了更灵活的资本运用方式。由于数据中心需要更长的交付周期，但在总算力成本中所占比例较小，这一方式使我们能够提前锁定数据中心容量，同时将规模更大的加速器投资推迟到我们的具体算力需求更加明确之时。

paras.en: Optimizing the utilization of our compute is equally important to our success in satisfying customer demand. We continuously direct compute to its highest-value use case, balancing the need to advance research and model development with the need to serve our customers and support internal usage of Claude. We rely on compute efficiencies, such as the discovery of compute multipliers, to get the most out of the compute that we procure. Our ability to effectively direct compute and drive compute efficiencies will be an important determinant of both our pace of innovation and our financial results over time.
paras.zh: 优化算力利用率对于我们在满足客户需求方面取得成功同样重要。我们持续将算力导向其最高价值的用例，在推进研究与模型开发的需求与服务客户及支持 Claude 内部使用的需求之间取得平衡。我们依靠算力效率（例如发现算力乘数）来最大化所采购算力的效用。我们有效调配算力并提升算力效率的能力，将是我们创新步伐与长期财务业绩的重要决定因素。

paras.en: #### Attracting and Retaining Technical Talent
paras.zh: #### 吸引和留住技术人才

paras.en: Advancing the frontier and maximizing the return on our compute investment require that we attract, hire, and retain top technical talent. Talent attraction and retention start with our seven co-founders, all of whom have remained with the company. We believe our culture and mission alignment enable us to hire and retain the talent required to continuously push the frontier of AI forward in a safe and responsible way. We expect our ability to continue attracting and retaining top technical talent to remain a key determinant of our pace of innovation and our financial results in future periods.
paras.zh: 推进前沿并最大化算力投资回报，要求我们吸引、聘用和留住顶尖技术人才。人才吸引与留任始于我们的七位联合创始人，他们均仍留在公司。我们相信，我们的文化与使命契合度使我们能够聘用并留住所需人才，以安全、负责任的方式持续推动 AI 前沿向前发展。我们预计，持续吸引和留住顶尖技术人才的能力，仍将是我们在未来期间创新步伐与财务业绩的关键决定因素。

paras.en: #### Our Continued Access to Capital
paras.zh: #### 我们持续的资本获取能力

paras.en: We must make significant investments in compute for research, model development, serving customers, and internal usage of Claude. Our compute requires substantial upfront commitments and ongoing payments as the compute becomes available to us. Our compute commitments will continue to grow as we scale our business. Our ability to secure sufficient compute is directly linked to our ability to access capital on favorable terms, such as through equity or debt financing or cash flow from operations.
paras.zh: 我们必须在算力方面进行重大投资，用于研究、模型开发、服务客户以及 Claude 的内部使用。我们的算力需要大量前期承诺，并随着算力可供我们使用而持续付款。随着我们扩大业务规模，我们的算力承诺将继续增长。我们获得充足算力的能力，直接取决于我们能否以有利条件获取资本，例如通过股权或债务融资或经营活动现金流。

paras.en: In order to maintain our access to capital, we must continue to demonstrate that we are able to invest that capital in a highly productive way. The best measures of our progress are Claude’s intelligence and capability, and customer adoption of Claude. Our ability to convert compute investment into frontier model performance, and then increase customer adoption, will be a key determinant of our access to capital.
paras.zh: 为维持我们的资本获取能力，我们必须持续证明我们能够以高度富有成效的方式运用这些资本。衡量我们进展的最佳指标是 Claude 的智能与能力，以及客户对 Claude 的采用情况。我们将算力投资转化为前沿模型性能、进而提升客户采用率的能力，将是我们获取资本的关键决定因素。

paras.en: Our ability to sustain access to capital depends in part on demonstrating a credible trajectory toward profitability. Our revenue growth, compute efficiency, and operating efficiency have significantly improved our operating margin and Adjusted Operating Margin, but we plan to keep investing heavily, which will adversely impact our results of operations. Our compute commitments are substantial and generally must be satisfied regardless of our revenue or utilization, while our access to additional capital depends on a number of conditions, many of which are outside our control, including market conditions and investor demand. In addition, a portion of our compute and infrastructure build-out has been funded or supported by capital or credit support provided or facilitated by certain of our CSPs and chip partners. Our ability to reduce this reliance over time is a function in part of our ability to obtain financing from independent sources on our own credit.
paras.zh: 我们维持资本获取能力的能力部分取决于能否展现出可信的盈利路径。我们的收入增长、算力效率和运营效率已显著改善我们的经营利润率和调整后经营利润率，但我们计划继续大举投资，这将对我们的经营业绩产生不利影响。我们的算力承诺规模庞大，且通常无论我们的收入或利用率如何都必须履行，而我们获取额外资本的能力取决于多项条件，其中许多条件不在我们的控制范围内，包括市场状况和投资者需求。此外，我们算力和基础设施扩建的一部分资金或信用支持，是由我们某些云服务商（CSP）和芯片合作伙伴提供或促成的。我们能否随着时间推移降低这种依赖，部分取决于我们能否凭借自身信用从独立渠道获得融资。

paras.en: #### Our Ability to Diffuse Claude in the Enterprise
paras.zh: #### 我们在企业端推广 Claude 的能力

paras.en: Our financial performance depends on the pace and breadth at which AI, and in particular Claude, is adopted across the global economy. While Claude’s capabilities already address a wide range of enterprise use cases, we believe that enterprise adoption remains nascent. We believe that our ability to capture this opportunity and drive revenue growth in future periods will depend on three dynamics:
paras.zh: 我们的财务表现取决于 AI、尤其是 Claude 在全球经济中的采用速度和广度。尽管 Claude 的能力已覆盖广泛的企业用例，但我们认为企业采用仍处于早期阶段。我们相信，我们能否抓住这一机遇并推动未来各期的收入增长，将取决于三个动态：

paras.en: First, our ability to translate model improvements into accessible products and platform capabilities.
paras.zh: 第一，我们将模型改进转化为可及的产品和平台能力的能力。

paras.en: In the nine months ended September 30, 2026, we launched an aggregate of 250 new model versions, platform features, and applications, including new capabilities in Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and vertical solutions for key industries. Our growth depends on continuing this pace of product innovation and reducing the friction between Claude’s capabilities and customer workflows. Our growth also depends on how quickly new capabilities reach customers, which in turn depends on the steps we take to assess and mitigate the risks of each model during development and before and after release. In the past, these steps have included delaying the release of new models and limiting their initial availability, such as our initial release of Mythos through Project Glasswing and our later release of Fable 5 as a generally-available model with safety restrictions, and in the future, as we learn more about model capabilities and behavior, could include additional measures that affect whether, how, and when we develop or release new models or capabilities. We evaluate whether to delay or restrict a release based on the results of our pre-release capability and safety evaluations and our assessment of whether available safeguards adequately mitigate the identified risks, and we may also take such steps where those evaluations are inconclusive. For more information, see the section titled “Business—Safety Research is Core to Our Business—Our Approach to Model Releases.” These measures, and any laws, regulations, or standards governing frontier AI development that may be adopted, could cause new use cases to emerge more slowly and slow the enterprise adoption and expansion on which our revenue growth depends. We believe that enterprises prefer models that are safe and aligned, and that our continued investment in safety strengthens customer trust and supports long-term adoption.
paras.zh: 在截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的九个月内，我们共推出了 250 个新模型版本、平台功能和应用程序，包括 Claude Code、Claude Cowork 的新功能以及面向关键行业的垂直解决方案。我们的增长取决于能否持续保持这一产品创新节奏，并减少 Claude 的能力与客户工作流程之间的摩擦。我们的增长还取决于新能力触达客户的速度，而这又取决于我们在开发过程中以及发布前后为评估和缓解每个模型的风险所采取的措施。过去，这些措施包括推迟新模型的发布并限制其初始可用范围，例如我们最初通过 Project Glasswing 发布 Mythos，以及随后将 Fable 5 作为带有安全限制的正式可用模型发布；未来，随着我们对模型能力和行为的了解不断深入，这些措施可能包括影响我们是否、如何以及何时开发或发布新模型或新能力的额外举措。我们根据发布前的能力与安全评估结果，以及我们对现有防护措施是否足以缓解已识别风险的评估，来决定是否推迟或限制发布；在评估结果尚无定论时，我们也可能采取此类措施。更多信息请参见“业务——安全研究是我们业务的核心——我们的模型发布方式”一节。这些措施以及未来可能出台的、规范前沿 AI 开发的任何法律、法规或标准，可能导致新用例的出现速度放缓，并拖慢我们收入增长所依赖的企业采用和扩张。我们认为，企业更青睐安全且对齐的模型，而我们在安全方面的持续投入增强了客户信任并支持长期采用。

paras.en: Second, our ability to expand and diversify distribution.
paras.zh: 其次，是我们扩大和多元化分销渠道的能力。

paras.en: A large portion of our growth to date has been self-service and organic. As AI adoption extends further into enterprises and more regulated industries, we are investing in direct go-to-market, Applied AI teams, and partnerships across all three major cloud platforms, SIs, consultants, and data platforms. We are also expanding our ability to serve international customers through the growth of regional offices and partnerships in key markets, and we expect international expansion to be a meaningful driver of revenue growth as global demand for AI accelerates. The effectiveness of these investments, and our ability to hire and retain go-to-market talent, will be a meaningful determinant of growth.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，我们增长的很大一部分来自自助服务和自然增长。随着 AI 的应用进一步深入企业和更多受监管行业，我们正在投资于直销、应用 AI 团队，以及与全部三大云平台、系统集成商（SI）、咨询公司和数据平台的合作。我们还在通过关键市场的区域办公室和合作伙伴关系，扩大服务国际客户的能力；随着全球 AI 需求加速，我们预计国际扩张将成为收入增长的重要驱动力。这些投资的成效，以及我们招聘和留住市场推广人才的能力，将是增长的重要决定因素。

paras.en: Third, our ability to land new customers and expand within existing accounts.
paras.zh: 第三，是我们获取新客户并在现有客户账户内实现扩张的能力。

paras.en: The number of customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis grew from approximately 20 as of December 31, 2023, to approximately 200 as of December 31, 2024, to approximately 1,500 as of December 31, 2025, and to more than 11,900 as of September 30, 2026. Total revenue from these customers grew from approximately $37 million to $220 million to $3.5 billion to $ [__] and represented 90%, 57%, 76%, and % of total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024, and 2025, and the trailing twelve months ended September 30, 2026, respectively. The remaining [__] % of total revenue for the trailing twelve months ended September 30, 2026 was generated by approximately 40 million customers, each with less than $100,000 of revenue on a TTM basis [__] .
paras.zh: 按过去十二个月（TTM）计算，收入达到或超过 $100,000 的客户数量从截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日的约 20 家，增长至截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日的约 200 家，再增长至截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的约 1,500 家，并增长至截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的超过 11,900 家。来自这些客户的总收入从约 $37 million 增长至 $220 million，再增长至 $3.5 billion，并增长至 $ [__]，分别占截至 2023 年、2024 年和 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度以及截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止过去十二个月总收入的 90%、57%、76% 和 %。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止过去十二个月总收入的其余 [__]% 由约 40 million 家客户产生，这些客户按过去十二个月（TTM）计算的收入均低于 $100,000 [__]。

paras.en: In addition, as of September 30, 2026, we had more than 1,900 customers with $1 million or more of revenue on a TTM basis and approximately 250 customers with $10 million or more of revenue on a TTM basis. Despite this growth, our penetration into the largest enterprises remains early. Over 50% of the Fortune 500 and over 30% of the Global 2000 were customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis as of September 30, 2026. We believe we are in the early stages of our expansion within these customers, with our revenue from these Fortune 500 customers representing, on average, less than 0.1% of their total expenses for the three months ended September 30, 2026.
paras.zh: 此外，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们拥有超过 1,900 家按过去十二个月（TTM）计算收入达到或超过 $1 million 的客户，以及约 250 家按过去十二个月（TTM）计算收入达到或超过 $10 million 的客户。尽管实现了这一增长，我们向最大型企业的渗透仍处于早期阶段。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，超过 50% 的《财富》500 强企业和超过 30% 的全球 2000 强企业是按过去十二个月（TTM）计算收入达到或超过 $100,000 的客户。我们相信，我们正处于在这些客户内部扩张的早期阶段，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止三个月，我们来自这些《财富》500 强客户的收入平均占其总费用的不到 0.1%。

paras.en: We compare this measure against our largest Fortune 500 customers, who are further along in their adoption of AI. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from our top 10 Fortune 500 customers represented, on average, less than 1% of their total expenses—still a small fraction of their overall spend, but over eight times the average of our Fortune 500 customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis.
paras.zh: 我们将该指标与我们最大的《财富》500 强客户进行比较，这些客户在采用 AI 方面走得更远。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止三个月，我们来自前 10 大《财富》500 强客户的收入平均占其总费用的不到 1%——这仍仅占其整体支出的一小部分，但已超过我们按过去十二个月（TTM）计算收入达到或超过 $100,000 的《财富》500 强客户平均水平的八倍。

paras.en: 5 For purposes of this measure, we include only Fortune 500 customers that are publicly traded and calculate the measure using total
paras.zh: 5 就本指标而言，我们仅纳入已公开上市的《财富》500 强客户，并使用其公开披露财务报表中报告的总费用计算该指标。

paras.en: expenses as reported in their publicly available financial statements.
paras.zh: 费用计算该指标。

paras.en: We believe the difference reflects the substantial runway we have to deepen adoption, both within our largest customers and within customers earlier in their adoption of Claude. [__] 5
paras.zh: 我们相信，这一差异反映了我们在深化采用方面拥有可观的增长空间，无论是在我们最大的客户内部，还是在采用 Claude 较早阶段的客户内部。[__] 5

paras.en: Claude adoption is broad-based. No single customer represented more than 10% of our revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. Approximately 79% of our revenue came from customers outside of our top five customers for the three months ended September 30, 2026, up from approximately 64% for the three months ended March 31, 2026. At the same time, our largest customers continue to expand. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, our revenue from each of our top five customers reached a record high.
paras.zh: Claude 的采用具有广泛基础。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止九个月，没有任何单一客户占我们收入的 10% 以上。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止三个月，我们约 79% 的收入来自前五大客户以外的客户，高于截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月的约 64%。与此同时，我们最大的客户继续扩张。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止三个月，我们来自前五大客户各自的收入均创下历史新高。

paras.en: #### Customer Usage Patterns
paras.zh: #### 客户使用模式

paras.en: Our revenue is influenced by customer usage patterns, which are impacted by the frequency and capability of new model version releases, as well as seasonal trends, each of which can create variability in our results from period to period. The continuous and overlapping cadence of new model version releases is inherent to remaining at the frontier of AI development. For example, model versions released in the six months ended September 30, 2026 accounted for over 80% of our revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026. As we have released successive versions of Claude models, we have continued to see revenue growth as new capabilities unlock additional use cases, prompting new customers to adopt Claude and existing customers to expand their usage.
paras.zh: 我们的收入受客户使用模式影响，而客户使用模式又受到新模型版本发布的频率与能力以及季节性趋势的影响，上述各项均可能导致我们的各期业绩出现波动。新模型版本持续且相互重叠的发布节奏，是保持在 AI 发展前沿所固有的。例如，在截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的六个月内发布的模型版本，占我们截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止三个月收入的 80% 以上。随着我们陆续发布 Claude 模型的各个后续版本，我们持续看到收入增长，因为新能力解锁了更多使用场景，促使新客户采用 Claude，并推动现有客户扩大使用量。

paras.en: Our customer usage patterns have also typically exhibited seasonality, particularly around holiday and vacation periods in the summer and winter, when certain workflows slow down and overall customer activity declines. For example, developer commits and feature launches are typically slower during the code freezes that many companies schedule over holidays. Consistent with this pattern, for the two weeks ended January 2, 2026, total customer spend declined by approximately 20% compared to the prior two weeks ended December 19, 2025. However, our historical growth rates may mask the impact of seasonal trends on our results. These dynamics are inherent aspects of a pay-for-intelligence revenue model and may be important determinants of our financial results in future periods.
paras.zh: 我们的客户使用模式通常还呈现出季节性，尤其是在夏季和冬季的假期与休假期间，此时某些工作流程放缓，整体客户活动下降。例如，在许多公司于假期期间安排的代码冻结期内，开发者的代码提交和功能发布通常较为缓慢。与这一模式一致，在截至 2026 年 1 月 2 日的两周内，客户总支出较此前截至 2025 年 12 月 19 日的两周下降约 20%。然而，我们的历史增长率可能掩盖季节性趋势对我们业绩的影响。这些动态是按智能付费收入模式所固有的特征，并可能成为我们未来各期财务业绩的重要决定因素。

paras.en: Because of these seasonal patterns, our results of operations have varied, and are expected to continue to vary, from period to period, and our results for any one period may not be indicative of our results for any future period. As our revenue growth rate declines over time, we expect seasonal effects to become more apparent in, and to have a greater effect on, our period-to-period results, and to make it more difficult to forecast our results of operations.
paras.zh: 由于这些季节性模式，我们的经营业绩已经并将继续在各期之间出现波动，我们任何一期的业绩可能无法预示任何未来期间的业绩。随着我们的收入增长率随时间下降，我们预计季节性效应将在我们的各期业绩中更加明显、并产生更大影响，同时使我们的经营业绩更难预测。

paras.en: #### Our Commitment to Public Benefit
paras.zh: #### 我们对公共利益的承诺

paras.en: Our commitment to public benefit extends to how we deploy our resources. We intend to direct a meaningful portion of our resources toward ensuring that frontier AI is safe and its benefits are broadly distributed, which we refer to as our public benefit initiatives. This may include significant contributions to nonprofit organizations, research institutions, and other third parties working on problems where AI can have the greatest positive impact, as well as programs designed to make Claude accessible to underserved communities, educators, and public institutions.
paras.zh: 我们对公共利益的承诺延伸至我们配置资源的方式。我们打算将相当一部分资源用于确保前沿 AI 的安全及其收益得到广泛分配，我们将其称为公共利益倡议。这可能包括向非营利组织、研究机构以及其他致力于解决 AI 能够产生最大积极影响的问题的第三方提供重大捐助，以及旨在让 Claude 惠及服务不足的社区、教育工作者和公共机构的各项计划。

paras.en: As part of these initiatives, we contributed [__] 846,840,960 shares of our Class N common stock, representing [__] 5% of our fully diluted shares as of June 30, 2026 (assuming full conversion of the Amazon Notes), to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, our wholly owned subsidiary dedicated to the Company Purpose, which we refer to as the Initial Public Benefit Issuance. As the value we create grows, we intend for the public benefit to share meaningfully in that growth as well. To that end, our board of directors has approved a framework for additional contributions tied to future increases in our share price. Following this offering, our board of directors, in its discretion, may issue shares of our Class N common stock to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund (or other designee) representing up to an additional [__] 2% of our then-outstanding shares (plus any shares subject to options, RSUs, and other convertible securities and any shares held by the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund) each time our share price appreciates [__] 50% above the prior share price milestone, beginning with our initial public offering price. A share price milestone is reached only when our closing share price has exceeded the applicable threshold on at least 90 of the trailing 120 consecutive trading days, and our average closing share price over the ten trading days prior to such issuance also exceeds that threshold. Although our board of directors has approved this framework, any future contributions will be made at the discretion of our board of directors. The shares that are contributed to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, including the Initial Public Benefit Issuance, may be transferred or donated to a third party, or otherwise sold in a registered public offering or private placement transaction in furtherance of our public benefit initiatives. Our board of directors will determine the allocations and distributions from the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund until it approves a specific governance structure for the entity, at which point decision-making authority is expected to transition to designated managers of the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund operating under that structure. The initial managers are Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei, Jack Clark, and Dr. Neil “Buddy” Shah. The Initial Public Benefit Issuance and the additional share contribution framework represent one of the ways in which we intend to pursue the Company Purpose, but it is not the exclusive means of doing so. We expect to dedicate additional resources, and to make other business and operational decisions, in furtherance of our Company Purpose outside of, and in addition to, these equity contributions.
paras.zh: 作为上述举措的一部分，我们向 Anthropic 公益基金（Anthropic Public Benefit Fund）捐出了 [__] 846,840,960 股 N 类普通股，占截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日我们完全稀释股份的 [__] 5%（假设 Amazon Notes 全部转换）。Anthropic 公益基金是我们的全资子公司，专为践行公司宗旨而设立，我们将此次捐出称为首次公益发行（Initial Public Benefit Issuance）。随着我们创造的价值不断增长，我们希望公益事业也能在这一增长中切实分享到相应份额。为此，我们的董事会已批准一项框架，将额外捐股与未来股价上涨挂钩。本次发行完成后，每当我们的股价较上一股价里程碑上涨 [__] 50%（以我们的首次公开发行价格为起点），我们的董事会可酌情向 Anthropic 公益基金（或其他指定对象）发行最多相当于我们届时已发行股份（加上任何受期权、RSU 及其他可转换证券约束的股份，以及 Anthropic 公益基金持有的任何股份）额外 [__] 2% 的 N 类普通股。只有当我们的收盘价在最近连续 120 个交易日中至少 90 个交易日超过适用门槛，且此次发行前十个交易日的平均收盘价也超过该门槛时，才算达到某一股价里程碑。尽管我们的董事会已批准该框架，但任何未来的捐股都将由我们的董事会酌情决定。捐给 Anthropic 公益基金的股份（包括首次公益发行）可以转让或捐赠给第三方，或以其他方式通过注册公开发行或私募配售交易出售，以推进我们的公益举措。在董事会批准该实体的具体治理结构之前，将由我们的董事会决定 Anthropic 公益基金的分配和派发；此后，决策权预计将移交给在该结构下运作的 Anthropic 公益基金指定管理人。初始管理人为 Dario Amodei、Daniela Amodei、Jack Clark 和 Neil “Buddy”Shah 博士。首次公益发行及额外捐股框架是我们践行公司宗旨的方式之一，但并非唯一方式。我们预计将在这些股权捐出之外并作为其补充，投入更多资源并作出其他业务和运营决策，以推进我们的公司宗旨。

paras.en: In addition, we maintain a donation matching program through which employees can pledge a meaningful portion of their equity awards or equivalent cash proceeds to a donor-advised fund or other nonprofit organization, and we match those donations with shares of our Class N common stock. In the same way the Company Purpose defines how we direct our work as an organization, our donation matching program reflects a parallel commitment by our employees to direct their personal financial value created by that work toward the public good. We view our donation matching program as a meaningful expression of the Company Purpose and a reflection of the values that define our culture. In addition, our co-founders have each pledged to dedicate 80% of their personal equity in Anthropic to philanthropic causes, separate from and not eligible for our donation matching program.
paras.zh: 此外，我们设有一项捐赠配比计划，员工可通过该计划将其股权奖励的相当一部分或等值现金收益承诺捐赠给捐赠人建议基金或其他非营利组织，我们则以 N 类普通股股票对这些捐赠进行配比。正如公司宗旨界定了我们作为组织如何指引我们的工作，我们的捐赠配比计划也体现了员工的一项平行承诺，即将其工作所创造的个人财务价值导向公共利益。我们将捐赠配比计划视为公司宗旨的有意义体现，也是界定我们文化的价值观的反映。此外，我们的联合创始人各自承诺将其在 Anthropic 的个人股权的 80% 用于慈善事业，该承诺独立于我们的捐赠配比计划，且不符合该计划的参与资格。

paras.en: Decisions we make to advance our public benefit initiatives may, in any given period, reduce our revenue, increase our expenses, lower our Adjusted Operating Margin, contribute to dilution, and reduce our profitability on a per share basis relative to what we would otherwise report. Our public benefit-related expenses, which currently consist primarily of charitable donations under our donation matching program, have not historically been significant. For the year ended December 31, 2025, expenses related to our donation matching program were $541 million, representing approximately 4% of our total operating expenses. However, we expect the cadence and magnitude of resources directed toward our public benefit initiatives to increase in future periods and remain a factor affecting our results of operations.
paras.zh: 我们为推进公共利益倡议所作出的决策，在任何给定期间内，都可能相对于我们原本会报告的数据，减少我们的收入、增加我们的费用、降低我们的调整后经营利润率、导致稀释，并降低我们按每股计算的盈利能力。我们与公共利益相关的费用目前主要包括捐赠配比计划下的慈善捐赠，历史上并不重大。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，与捐赠配比计划相关的费用为 $541 million，约占我们总运营费用的 4%。然而，我们预计未来期间投向公共利益倡议的资源节奏和规模将会增加，并将继续成为影响我们经营业绩的一个因素。

paras.en: #### Revenue

We generate revenue as customers use Claude through our platform and applications, including Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and vertical solutions for key industries. Claude is powered by our proprietary Claude model family, a set of frontier models, each with varying levels of capability, cost, and speed. Enterprise customers access our intelligence service directly from us or through CSP marketplaces, where we maintain direct contractual relationships with our customers.
paras.zh: 我们通过平台和应用程序（包括 Claude Code、Claude Cowork 以及面向关键行业的垂直解决方案）为客户提供 Claude 的使用，并由此产生收入。Claude 由我们专有的 Claude 模型系列提供支持，该系列由一组前沿模型组成，各模型在能力、成本和速度上有所不同。企业客户可直接向我们获取我们的智能服务，或通过云服务商（CSP）市场获取，在这些市场中，我们与客户保持直接的合同关系。

paras.en: Depending on the model, platform, or applications chosen by our customers, they enter into pay-for-intelligence pricing, subscription-based pricing, or both. A growing number of enterprise customers agree to annual or multi-year contracts with minimum spend commitments.
paras.zh: 根据客户所选择的模型、平台或应用程序，客户采用按智能用量付费的定价方式、订阅制定价方式，或两者兼用。越来越多的企业客户与我们签订带有最低消费承诺的年度或多年期合同。

paras.en: Revenue is recognized when customers use our intelligence service, based on the quantity of tokens consumed. Subscriptions are generally prepaid on a monthly or annual basis, and are subject to usage limits that reset over short periods, which results in revenue being recognized on a ratable basis over the subscription period, which is generally 12 months or less.
paras.zh: 收入在客户使用我们的智能服务时，根据所消耗的 token 数量确认。订阅费通常按月或按年预付，并受使用量上限约束，该上限在较短周期内重置，因此收入在订阅期内按比例确认，订阅期通常为 12 个月或更短。

paras.en: We expect our revenue growth rate to decline over time and to fluctuate from period to period. Revenue growth in any period may be affected by customer usage patterns, customer adoption, the deployment of our models, platform, and applications, the pricing of our offerings, the timing and success of new model and product releases, measures we decide to implement to safely deploy new capabilities, our ability to continue meeting customer requirements, and other factors affecting demand for our models, platform, and applications, including those described in the section titled “Risk Factors—We are at an early stage of our revenue growth, we have experienced rapid growth in recent periods, and our historical growth rates are not indicative of future performance or our ability to sustain or forecast future revenue growth.”
paras.zh: 我们预计收入增长率将随时间推移而下降，并会因期间不同而波动。任何期间的收入增长都可能受到客户使用模式、客户采用情况、我们模型、平台和应用程序的部署、我们产品的定价、新模型和产品发布的时间与成效、我们为安全部署新能力而决定实施的措施、我们持续满足客户需求的能力，以及影响对我们模型、平台和应用程序需求的其他因素的影响，包括“风险因素——我们正处于收入增长的早期阶段，近年来经历了快速增长，我们的历史增长率并不预示未来业绩或我们维持或预测未来收入增长的能力”一节所述的因素。

paras.en: In addition, our revenue has included, and we expect will continue to include, amounts from customers that we subsequently determine are using our models, platform, and applications in violation of our usage policy or commercial terms. We believe this dynamic is common in our industry. Because detection, investigation, and enforcement take time, we recognize revenue from such customers when the related services are provided, before restricting or terminating their access. Based on our detection and review process, we estimate that revenue from such customers represented approximately 5% to 7% of our revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. This estimate requires judgment and may change as our detection methodologies evolve and we identify previously undetected usage. We expect the percentage of revenue from customers using our models, platform, and applications in violation of our usage policy or commercial terms to decline in future periods as we have enhanced our detection and enforcement efforts, in particular in August and September 2026; however, the timing and magnitude of any resulting adverse effect on our revenue and revenue growth are uncertain.
paras.zh: 此外，我们的收入中已经包含、并且我们预计将继续包含来自客户的金额，而这些客户随后被我们认定在使用我们的模型、平台和应用程序时违反了我们的使用政策或商业条款。我们认为这一动态在我们的行业中很常见。由于检测、调查和执法需要时间，我们在提供相关服务时即确认来自此类客户的收入，之后才限制或终止其访问权限。根据我们的检测和审查流程，我们估计，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的九个月内，来自此类客户的收入约占我们收入的 5% 至 7%。该估计需要判断，并可能随着我们检测方法的演进以及我们识别出此前未检测到的使用情况而发生变化。随着我们加强检测和执法工作（尤其是在 2026 年 8 月和 9 月），我们预计来自违反我们使用政策或商业条款使用我们模型、平台和应用程序的客户的收入占比将在未来期间下降；然而，由此对我们收入和收入增长造成的任何不利影响的时间和幅度尚不确定。

paras.en:
Operating · Expenses
Compute and Infrastructure
paras.zh:
经营 · 费用
算力与基础设施

paras.en: Compute and infrastructure expenses primarily consist of costs attributable to operating our technology infrastructure, which supports the full range of workloads for our models, including research, model development, serving customers, and internal usage of Claude. These costs primarily consist of compute fees paid to CSPs under committed and on-demand arrangements, including storage, networking, and connectivity, and related support costs, infrastructure costs associated with serving customer workloads through partner channels, colocation facility costs, equipment leases and committed power costs associated with our data center operations, and third-party application infrastructure software costs directly related to our compute operations. Beginning in 2026, as our obligations commence under compute and infrastructure leases, these expenses also include operating lease costs, amortization of finance lease assets, variable lease costs, and depreciation and amortization on owned servers, networking equipment, and related data center assets. See Note 8 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus for a functional presentation of our operating expenses, including cost of revenue, and a description of the workloads underlying the compute and infrastructure expenses within each functional caption. Within that functional presentation, substantially all of the cost of revenue consists of compute and infrastructure expenses associated with customer-serving workloads. Additionally, cost of revenue includes certain personnel-related costs and allocated overhead costs.
paras.zh: 算力与基础设施费用主要包括运营我们技术基础设施所产生的成本，该基础设施支持我们模型的全方位工作负载，包括研究、模型开发、服务客户以及 Claude 的内部使用。这些成本主要包括根据承诺安排和按需安排向云服务商（CSP）支付的算力费用（含存储、网络和连接）及相关支持成本、通过合作伙伴渠道服务客户工作负载所产生的基础设施成本、与数据中心运营相关的托管设施成本、设备租赁和承诺电力成本，以及与我们的算力运营直接相关的第三方应用基础设施软件成本。自 2026 年起，随着我们在算力与基础设施租赁项下的义务开始生效，这些费用还包括经营租赁成本、融资租赁资产摊销、可变租赁成本，以及自有服务器、网络设备和相关数据中心资产的折旧与摊销。有关我们经营费用（包括收入成本）的功能性列报，以及各功能科目中算力与基础设施费用所对应工作负载的说明，请参见本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表附注 8。在该功能性列报中，收入成本的绝大部分由与服务客户工作负载相关的算力与基础设施费用构成。此外，收入成本还包括某些人员相关成本和分摊的管理费用。

paras.en: Customers adopt and retain our technology based on whether our models are at the frontier of AI capability and maintaining that frontier position is essential to revenue generation. Each model release represents continuous intelligence improvements, making ongoing model development a critical factor in revenue generation. We operate an iterative cycle in which compute deployed to model development yields more capable and efficient models. Those efficiency gains free compute to serve additional customer workloads. In turn, serving our customers at scale generates feedback that informs research and model development. In this cycle, customer-serving activity and model development are each a direct input that informs the other, and we therefore view compute and infrastructure costs as critical to our ability to generate revenue within a short time of incurring such costs.
paras.zh: 客户是否采用并持续使用我们的技术，取决于我们的模型是否处于 AI 能力的前沿，而保持该前沿地位对创收至关重要。每一次模型发布都代表着智能水平的持续提升，因此持续的模型开发是创收的关键因素。我们运行一个迭代循环：投入模型开发的算力会产出能力更强、效率更高的模型。这些效率提升释放出算力，用于服务更多客户工作负载。反过来，规模化服务客户又会产生反馈，为研究和模型开发提供依据。在这一循环中，服务客户的活动与模型开发互为直接输入，因此我们认为，算力与基础设施成本对于我们能够在产生此类成本后的短时间内实现创收至关重要。

paras.en: We expect compute and infrastructure expenses to increase in absolute dollars and remain our largest operating expense for the foreseeable future as additional committed compute becomes available to us under multi-year arrangements with CSPs, and as we continue to invest in additional compute. These expenses are paid and recognized as compute becomes available to us, rather than when committed, and are generally fixed in the near term given the majority of our compute is contracted under multi-year commitments that we typically procure 12 to 18 months in advance of availability. We deploy this committed compute as a single, shared resource across all workloads, and thus plan, incur, and assess it on a total basis rather than by individual workload. As a result, compute and infrastructure expenses as a percentage of revenue will depend primarily on how our revenue scales relative to our total committed compute cost base. In addition, as part of our public benefit initiatives, we intend to direct a meaningful portion of our resources, which may include compute, toward ensuring that the benefits of frontier AI are broadly accessible, and we expect to significantly scale these efforts over time.
paras.zh: 我们预计，随着我们根据与云服务商（CSP）签订的多年度安排获得更多承诺算力，以及我们继续投资于额外算力，算力和基础设施费用按绝对美元计算将增加，并在可预见的未来仍将是我们的最大运营费用。这些费用在算力可供我们使用时支付并确认，而非在承诺时支付并确认，并且鉴于我们的大部分算力是通过多年度承诺合同采购的（我们通常会在算力可供使用前 12 至 18 个月进行采购），这些费用在短期内通常是固定的。我们将这些承诺算力作为单一共享资源部署于所有工作负载，因此我们按总量而非按单个工作负载进行规划、发生和评估。因此，算力和基础设施费用占收入的百分比将主要取决于我们的收入相对于总承诺算力成本基数的增长情况。此外，作为我们公益计划的一部分，我们打算将相当一部分资源（可能包括算力）用于确保前沿 AI 的益处能够被广泛获取，并且我们预计随着时间的推移将大幅扩大这些努力。

paras.en: Personnel
paras.zh: 人员

paras.en: Personnel expenses primarily consist of stock-based compensation, including expense related to stock options, RSUs, and restricted stock awards (“RSAs”), cash compensation, including base salaries and bonuses, employee benefits, including health and welfare benefits, and employer payroll taxes.
paras.zh: 人员费用主要包括股权激励费用（包括与股票期权、限制性股票单位（RSU）和限制性股票奖励（“RSA”）相关的费用）、现金薪酬（包括基本工资和奖金）、员工福利（包括健康和福利福利）以及雇主工资税。

paras.en: We expect personnel expenses to increase in absolute dollars as we continue to expand our headcount to support the growth of our business. We also expect to incur additional stock-based compensation expense in connection with this offering, including for certain RSUs for which the performance condition will be satisfied upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. We expect that personnel expenses may fluctuate as a percentage of revenue depending on the timing and magnitude of stock-based compensation expense, and the pace of hiring across our organization.
paras.zh: 我们预计，随着我们继续扩大员工人数以支持业务增长，人员费用按绝对美元计算将增加。我们还预计，与此发行相关将产生额外的股权激励费用，包括某些限制性股票单位（RSU），其业绩条件将在本招股说明书所属注册声明生效时得到满足。我们预计，人员费用占收入的百分比可能会因股权激励费用的时间和规模以及我们组织的招聘速度而波动。

paras.en: Bartz settlement
paras.zh: Bartz 和解

paras.en: Bartz settlement consists of the charge we recorded in 2025 to settle the Bartz litigation. See Note 13 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus for additional information.
paras.zh: Bartz 和解包括我们在 2025 年记录的用于和解 Bartz 诉讼的费用。更多信息请参见本招股说明书其他部分包含的我们合并财务报表附注 13。

paras.en: Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships
paras.zh: 销售、营销和合作伙伴关系

paras.en: Sales, marketing, and partnerships expenses primarily consist of fees paid to channel partners and marketing and advertising costs, including media and public relations spend.
paras.zh: 销售、营销和合作伙伴关系费用主要包括支付给渠道合作伙伴的费用以及营销和广告成本，包括媒体和公共关系支出。

paras.en: We expect sales, marketing, and partnerships expenses to increase in absolute dollars as we continue to invest in activities to drive continued adoption and expanded usage of our models. We expect that sales, marketing, and partnerships expenses may fluctuate as a percentage of revenue depending on the timing of and spend on marketing campaigns and changes in the terms of our channel partner distribution arrangements and the cost to deliver our intelligence service.
paras.zh: 我们预计，随着我们继续投资于推动我们模型持续采用和扩大使用的活动，销售、营销和合作伙伴关系费用按绝对美元计算将增加。我们预计，销售、营销和合作伙伴关系费用占收入的百分比可能会因营销活动的时间和支出、渠道合作伙伴分销安排条款的变化以及提供我们智能服务的成本而波动。

paras.en: Other Operating and Administrative
paras.zh: 其他运营和管理

paras.en: Other operating and administrative expenses primarily consist of charitable donations expense related to our donation matching program, vendor costs related to data quality and performance evaluation services, information technology and cloud software costs, payment processing and platform fees, facility and occupancy costs, non-income taxes, professional services costs, bad debt expense, and depreciation and amortization related to non-data center assets.
paras.zh: 其他经营及行政费用主要包括与我们的捐赠配捐计划相关的慈善捐赠费用、与数据质量和绩效评估服务相关的供应商成本、信息技术和云软件成本、支付处理和平台费用、设施和占用成本、非所得税、专业服务成本、坏账费用，以及与数据中心以外资产相关的折旧和摊销。

paras.en: We expect that other operating and administrative expenses will increase in absolute dollars as our business grows and as a result of operating as a public company, including expenses related to compliance with SEC rules and regulations, the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market, additional costs for directors’ and officers’ liability insurance, and professional services. We also expect other operating and administrative expenses to fluctuate as a percentage of our revenue over time as our business grows, in part as we significantly scale our public benefit initiatives, including expanded programs to make Claude accessible to underserved communities, increased charitable donation matching, contributions to philanthropic vehicles or foundations we may establish or support in the future, and other efforts aligned with our mission.
paras.zh: 我们预计，随着业务增长以及作为上市公司运营，其他经营及行政费用将以绝对金额增加，包括与遵守 SEC 规则和法规、纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准相关的费用、董事和高级管理人员责任保险的额外成本以及专业服务费用。我们还预计，随着业务增长，其他经营及行政费用占收入的百分比将随时间波动，部分原因是我们将大幅扩大公益举措，包括扩大使 Claude 可供服务不足社区使用的项目、增加慈善捐赠配捐、向我们未来可能设立或支持的慈善工具或基金会捐款，以及与我们使命一致的其他努力。

paras.en: #### Interest Income
paras.zh: #### 利息收入

paras.en: Interest income consists of interest earned on our cash and cash equivalents and short-term investments which primarily consist of debt securities, including U.S. Treasury and agency securities, corporate debt, and commercial paper.
paras.zh: 利息收入包括我们的现金及现金等价物和短期投资所赚取的利息，短期投资主要包括债务证券，包括美国国债和机构证券、公司债务和商业票据。

paras.en: #### Change in Fair Value of Convertible Notes, Derivative Liabilities, and SAFEs
paras.zh: #### 可转换票据、衍生负债和 SAFE 的公允价值变动

paras.en: Change in fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs consists of gains and losses as a result of recording our convertible promissory notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFE liabilities at fair value at the end of each reporting period. Because these instruments are marked to market, increases in our enterprise valuation drive increases in this expense. We will continue to recognize changes in the fair value of our convertible notes until they are converted into equity, repaid, or otherwise settled. For more information, see Note 4 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus.
paras.zh: 可转换票据、衍生负债和 SAFE 的公允价值变动包括因在每个报告期末按公允价值记录我们的可转换本票、衍生负债和 SAFE 负债而产生的收益和损失。由于这些工具按市值计价，我们企业估值的增加会推动该费用的增加。在可转换票据转换为股权、偿还或以其他方式结算之前，我们将继续确认其公允价值变动。有关更多信息，请参阅本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表附注 4。

paras.en: #### Other Income (Expense), Net
paras.zh: #### 其他收入（费用），净额

paras.en: Other income (expense), net consists primarily of the change in fair value of strategic investments and financial instruments, the change in fair value of certain derivative instruments in connection with an acquisition of a privately-held company in December 2025, interest expense from finance leases, and foreign currency exchange gains and losses. For more information on the acquisition, see Note 15 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus.
paras.zh: 其他收入（费用），净额主要包括战略投资和金融工具的公允价值变动、与 2025 年 12 月收购一家私营公司相关的某些衍生工具的公允价值变动、融资租赁的利息费用以及外币汇兑损益。有关该收购的更多信息，请参阅本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表附注 15。

paras.en: #### Provision for Income Taxes
paras.zh: #### 所得税费用

paras.en: The provision for income taxes primarily consists of income taxes in certain federal, state, local, and foreign jurisdictions in which we conduct business. Our effective tax rates will vary depending on the impact of the valuation allowance and nondeductible fair value adjustments to derivatives, as well as the relative proportion of foreign income to domestic income, generation of tax credits, changes in the valuation of our deferred tax assets and liabilities, and changes in tax laws.
paras.zh: 所得税费用准备主要由我们在开展业务的某些联邦、州、地方及外国司法管辖区缴纳的所得税构成。我们的实际税率将因估值备抵及衍生工具不可抵扣公允价值调整的影响、境外收入与境内收入的相对比例、税收抵免的产生、递延所得税资产和负债估值的变化以及税法的变化而有所不同。

Revenue for the year ended December 31, 2024 increased by [__] $345 million, or [__] 841%, compared to the year ended December 31, 2023. Consumption-based and subscription-based revenue increased by approximately $249 million and $96 million, respectively, for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023. The increase was primarily driven by growth in new customers and reflected the broader commercial availability of our AI platform following the launch of the Claude 3 family of Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku models in 2024, which expanded the range of supported use cases and drove adoption. The number of customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis grew from approximately 20 as of December 31, 2023 to approximately 200 as of December 31, 2024. Total revenue from these customers grew from approximately $37 million to $220 million and represented approximately 90% and 57% of total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, respectively.

paras.en: To supplement our consolidated financial statements prepared and presented in accordance with GAAP, we use certain non-GAAP financial measures, as described below, to facilitate analysis of our operating performance and for internal planning and forecasting purposes.
paras.zh: 为补充我们按照 GAAP 编制和列报的合并财务报表，我们使用下述某些非 GAAP 财务指标，以便于分析我们的经营业绩并用于内部规划和预测目的。

paras.en: We use Adjusted Operating Income (Loss), Adjusted Operating Margin, and Adjusted Net Income (Loss) to evaluate our operating performance, formulate business plans, prepare budgets and forecasts, and make strategic decisions, including those relating to operating expenses and the allocation of internal resources. By excluding certain items that management believes are not directly reflective of the ongoing operating performance of our business, we believe these non-GAAP financial measures provide investors, analysts, and others with meaningful insight and enhance their overall understanding of our business and financial performance by providing a more consistent and comparable overview of our financial performance across periods.
paras.zh: 我们使用调整后经营利润（亏损）、调整后经营利润率和调整后净利润（亏损）来评估我们的经营业绩、制定业务计划、编制预算和预测，并作出战略决策，包括与经营费用和内部资源配置相关的决策。通过剔除管理层认为并不直接反映我们业务持续经营业绩的某些项目，我们认为这些非 GAAP 财务指标为投资者、分析师及其他人士提供了有意义的洞察，并通过提供更具一致性和可比性的跨期财务业绩概览，增强其对我们业务和财务业绩的整体理解。

paras.en: Other companies in our industry, including those with similar business models, may define or calculate similarly titled measures in different ways, which may limit the usefulness of these measures for direct comparison. In addition, other companies may not publish these or similar metrics. Further, these metrics have certain limitations in that they do not include the impact of certain expenses that are reflected on our consolidated statements of operations. Thus, our non-GAAP financial measures should not be viewed in isolation or as a replacement for the most directly comparable measures prepared in accordance with GAAP. We encourage investors and others to review our business, financial condition, and results of operations in their entirety, not to rely on any single financial measure, and to view our non-GAAP financial measures in conjunction with their respective most directly comparable financial measures calculated in accordance with GAAP, as well as our consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes included elsewhere in this prospectus.
paras.zh: 我们行业中的其他公司（包括具有类似商业模式的公司）可能以不同方式定义或计算名称相似的指标，这可能限制这些指标用于直接比较的有用性。此外，其他公司可能不公布这些或类似指标。再者，这些指标存在某些局限性，因为它们不包含反映在我们合并经营报表中的某些费用的影响。因此，我们的非 GAAP 财务指标不应被孤立看待，也不应被视为按照 GAAP 编制的最直接可比指标的替代。我们鼓励投资者及其他人士整体审视我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩，不要依赖任何单一财务指标，并将我们的非 GAAP 财务指标与按照 GAAP 计算的各自最直接可比的财务指标，以及本招股说明书其他部分所载的我们的合并财务报表及附注一并看待。

paras.en: #### Adjusted Operating Income (Loss) and Adjusted Operating Margin

paras.en: We define Adjusted Operating Income (Loss) as operating loss excluding (i) stock-based compensation expense, (ii) non-cash charitable contributions, and (iii) the Bartz settlement. We define Adjusted Operating Margin as Adjusted Operating Income (Loss) divided by revenue.
paras.zh: 我们将调整后经营利润（亏损）定义为经营亏损，剔除(i)股权激励费用、(ii)非现金慈善捐赠以及(iii) Bartz 和解。我们将调整后经营利润率定义为调整后经营利润（亏损）除以收入。

paras.en: #### Adjusted Net Income (Loss)
paras.zh: #### 调整后净利润（亏损）
