paras.en: #### Revenue

Revenue increased sequentially in each of the quarters presented, from $376 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025 to $11.6 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2026. The increases in each quarter were driven by successive model and product releases that drove higher usage, expansion, and broader adoption across our offerings, with both consumption-based and subscription-based revenue contributing. Growth in customers generating meaningful revenue contributed across the periods: customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis grew from approximately [__] 400 as of March 31, 2025 to more than [__] 6,000 as of June 30, 2026 [__] .
paras.zh: 在所列示的各个季度中，收入逐季增长，从截至 2025 年 3 月 31 日止三个月的 $376 million 增至截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止三个月的 $11.6 billion。各季度的增长均得益于相继推出的模型和产品，这些模型和产品推动了更高的使用量、扩张以及我们各项产品的更广泛采用，其中基于消费的收入和基于订阅的收入均有贡献。在所列示的各个期间，能够产生可观收入的客户增长均有贡献：按 TTM 基准收入达到 $100,000 或以上的客户从截至 2025 年 3 月 31 日的约 [__] 400 家增至截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的超过 [__] 6,000 家 [__] 。

paras.en: #### Operating Expenses
paras.zh: #### 经营费用

paras.en: Compute and Infrastructure
paras.zh: 算力和基础设施

paras.en: Compute and infrastructure expenses increased sequentially in each of the quarters presented, from [__] $944 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025 to $5.6 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2026, driven by the delivery of committed compute under our multi-year CSP arrangements. Because we typically procure compute 12 to 18 months in advance of availability, these expenses are generally fixed in the near term and increased as committed compute became available to us rather than in response to in-period demand.
paras.zh: 在所列示的各个季度中，算力和基础设施费用逐季增长，从截至 2025 年 3 月 31 日止三个月的 [__] $944 million 增至截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止三个月的 $5.6 billion，其驱动因素是我们根据多年期 CSP 安排交付的承诺算力。由于我们通常会在算力可供使用前 12 至 18 个月进行采购，因此这些费用在短期内通常是固定的，并且随着承诺算力可供我们使用而增加，而非随当期需求而增加。

paras.en: Compute and infrastructure expenses as a percentage of revenue decreased from [__] 251% to 48% over the same period, as revenue growth outpaced the growth of our committed compute cost base.
paras.zh: 算力和基础设施费用占收入的百分比在同一期间从 [__] 251% 降至 48%，原因是收入增长超过了我们承诺算力成本基数的增长。

paras.en: Personnel
paras.zh: 人员

paras.en: Personnel expenses increased sequentially in each of the quarters presented, driven by headcount growth and the associated increases in compensation, including stock-based compensation.
paras.zh: 在所列示的各个季度中，人员费用逐季增长，其驱动因素是员工人数增长以及相关的薪酬增加，包括股权激励费用。

paras.en: Bartz settlement
paras.zh: Bartz 和解

paras.en: In the three months ended September 30, 2025, we recorded a $1.5 billion charge to settle the Bartz litigation. See Note 13 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus.
paras.zh: 在截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日止三个月，我们计提了 $1.5 billion 的费用以了结 Bartz 诉讼。请参阅本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表附注 13。

paras.en: Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships
paras.zh: 销售、营销和合作

paras.en: Sales, marketing, and partnerships expenses increased sequentially in each of the quarters presented, with the most significant increases observed in the three months ended March 31, 2026 and June 30, 2026. The increases were primarily driven by fees paid to channel partners, reflecting the growth of our business, and increased marketing and advertising expenses, reflecting higher media spend to support product launches.
paras.zh: 在所列示的各个季度中，销售、营销和合作费用逐季增长，其中截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月和截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止三个月的增幅最为显著。该等增长主要驱动因素为支付给渠道合作伙伴的费用（反映我们业务的增长）以及营销和广告费用的增加（反映为支持产品发布而增加的媒体支出）。

paras.en: Other Operating and Administrative
paras.zh: 其他运营及行政费用

paras.en: Other operating and administrative expenses increased over the quarters presented, other than in the three months ended March 31, 2026, which reflected lower donation matching program charges than in the three months ended December 31, 2025. The overall increase reflected vendor costs related to data quality and performance evaluation services, information technology and cloud software costs, payment processing and platform fees, and professional services costs as our business scaled. The increase in the three months ended December 31, 2025 was primarily driven by non-cash charges related to our donation matching program.
paras.zh: 除截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月外，其他运营及行政费用在所呈报的各季度均有所增加；截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月反映的捐赠配捐计划费用低于截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三个月。整体增加反映了随着我们业务规模扩大而产生的与数据质量和绩效评估服务相关的供应商成本、信息技术和云软件成本、支付处理和平台费用以及专业服务成本。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三个月的增加主要受与我们捐赠配捐计划相关的非现金费用推动。

paras.en: #### Operating Income (Loss)
paras.zh: #### 经营利润（亏损）

paras.en: Our operating loss widened in the three months ended June 30, 2025, primarily driven by the delivery of additional committed compute under our CSP arrangements, the associated expenses of which grew faster than our revenue in the period, and in the three months ended September 30, 2025, which included the Bartz settlement. Our operating loss narrowed in the three months ended December 31, 2025 and March 31, 2026, and we generated operating income of $1.0 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2026, as revenue growth outpaced the growth in total operating expenses. We expect our operating results to continue to fluctuate from quarter to quarter, particularly as the amount of incremental compute we receive, and the associated expenses we incur, may vary from period to period.
paras.zh: 我们的经营亏损在截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日的三个月有所扩大，主要原因是根据我们的 CSP 安排交付了额外的承诺算力，相关费用的增长在该期间快于我们的收入增长；截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日的三个月也因计入 Bartz 和解而扩大。我们的经营亏损在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日和 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月有所收窄，并且由于收入增长超过总运营费用的增长，我们在截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三个月实现了 $1.0 billion 的经营利润。我们预计我们的经营业绩将继续逐季度波动，特别是因为我们获得的增量算力金额以及我们产生的相关费用可能因期间而异。

paras.en: #### Interest Income
paras.zh: #### 利息收入

paras.en: Interest income increased sequentially in each of the quarters presented, from $51 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025 to $762 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026, primarily driven by higher average cash and cash equivalents and short-term investments balances.
paras.zh: 利息收入在所呈报的每个季度均环比增长，从截至 2025 年 3 月 31 日的三个月的 $51 million 增至截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三个月的 $762 million，主要受现金及现金等价物和短期投资平均余额增加推动。

paras.en: #### Change in Fair Value of Convertible Notes, Derivative Liabilities, and SAFEs
paras.zh: #### 可转换票据、衍生负债和 SAFE 的公允价值变动

paras.en: Changes in the fair value of our convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs resulted in expense in each of the quarters presented, primarily driven by increases in the fair value of our outstanding convertible promissory notes resulting from increases in our enterprise valuation during each period. The expense was largest in the three months ended June 30, 2026, reflecting the increase in our enterprise valuation in connection with our Series H financing. We will continue to recognize changes in fair value until these instruments are converted into equity, repaid, or otherwise settled. See Note 4 and Note 9 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus.
paras.zh: 我们的可转换票据、衍生负债和 SAFE 的公允价值变动在所呈报的每个季度均产生费用，主要受各期间企业估值上升导致我们未偿还可转换本票公允价值增加推动。该费用在截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三个月最大，反映了与我们 H 轮融资相关的企业估值上升。在这些工具转换为股权、偿还或以其他方式结算之前，我们将继续确认公允价值变动。请参阅本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表的附注 4 和附注 9。

paras.zh: #### 其他收入（费用），净额

paras.en: Other income (expense), net was not material for the quarters presented prior to 2026. Other income (expense), net of $(309) million and $(8.4) billion for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and June 30, 2026, respectively, was primarily driven by the initial fair value recognition and subsequent change in fair value of the assets and liabilities recognized under the note purchase agreements. See Note 4 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus.
paras.zh: 在 2026 年之前的所呈报季度，其他收入（费用），净额并不重大。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三个月，其他收入（费用），净额分别为 $(309) million 和 $(8.4) billion，主要受根据票据购买协议确认的资产和负债的初始公允价值确认及后续公允价值变动推动。请参阅本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表的附注 4。

paras.en: Since inception, we have financed our operations, corporate investments, and capital expenditures primarily through proceeds from the issuance of convertible promissory notes, redeemable convertible preferred stock, cash generated from sales, and SAFEs. To date, we have financed our compute and infrastructure primarily under arrangements with our CSPs, as well as through proceeds from the financing activities described above and cash generated from operations. As of June 30, 2026, we had cash and cash equivalents of $112.4 billion, $19.3 billion of short-term investments, and $3.2 billion available under the Credit Facility, as described below. Cash and cash equivalents consist of cash held in checking and interest-bearing accounts, money market funds, and other highly liquid investments with original maturities of three months or less from the date of purchase.
paras.zh: 自成立以来，我们主要通过发行可转换本票、可赎回可转换优先股所得款项、销售产生的现金以及未来股权简单协议（SAFE）来为我们的运营、公司投资和资本支出提供资金。迄今为止，我们主要根据与云服务商（CSP）的安排，以及通过上述融资活动所得款项和运营产生的现金，为我们的算力和基础设施提供资金。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，我们拥有现金及现金等价物 $112.4 billion、短期投资 $19.3 billion，以及下文所述信贷融资（Credit Facility）项下可用的 $3.2 billion。现金及现金等价物包括存放于支票账户和计息账户的现金、货币市场基金，以及自购买之日起原始到期期限为三个月或更短的其他高流动性投资。

paras.en: We have generated losses from our operations, as reflected in our accumulated deficit of $132.9 billion, which includes $113.2 billion related to changes in the fair value of our convertible notes driven by increases in our enterprise valuation and derivative liabilities since 2023, including $72.4 billion during the six months ended June 30, 2026. Additionally, we have generated negative cash flows from operating and investing activities in 2023, 2024, and 2025, driven by ongoing expenditures to support business growth including investments to secure access to more compute and infrastructure capacity. We continue to invest in our own data center infrastructure and enter into compute and infrastructure capacity arrangements to support anticipated demand for our intelligence service. Given the long lead times between contracting for, purchasing, or leasing compute and that compute becoming available to serve workloads, we secure these arrangements well in advance of anticipated demand. To secure certain data center development projects, which require significant capital commitments in advance of deployment, we have in some cases relied, and expect to continue to rely, on arrangements with financing sources or partners who guarantee the lease obligations to support the development of data center capacity that is expected to host such partner’s chips or computing infrastructure. Our ability to expand compute and infrastructure capacity through these arrangements in the future may depend on the continued willingness and ability of a limited number of CSPs, partners, and financing sources to enter into and perform under such arrangements. In some cases, we may also make payments in advance of the delivery of the equipment or infrastructure. We anticipate making significant and increased investments for the foreseeable future, including for owned or leased compute and infrastructure in advance of delivery. These investments help ensure we have the technological resources to maintain and expand our position at the frontier of AI.
paras.zh: 我们的运营已产生亏损，累计赤字为 $132.9 billion，其中包括与可转换票据公允价值变动相关的 $113.2 billion，该变动由自 2023 年以来我们企业估值和衍生负债的上升所驱动，其中 $72.4 billion 发生于截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的六个月期间。此外，我们在 2023 年、2024 年和 2025 年产生了经营活动和投资活动的负现金流，原因是支持业务增长的持续支出，包括为确保获得更多算力和基础设施容量而进行的投资。我们继续投资于自有数据中心基础设施，并签订算力和基础设施容量安排，以支持对我们智能服务的预期需求。鉴于从签约、购买或租赁算力到该算力可供服务工作负载之间存在较长的前置时间，我们会在预期需求之前提前锁定这些安排。为锁定某些数据中心开发项目（这些项目需要在部署前作出重大资本承诺），我们在某些情况下已依赖、并预计将继续依赖与融资方或合作伙伴的安排，由后者为租赁义务提供担保，以支持预计将承载该等合作伙伴芯片或计算基础设施的数据中心容量的开发。我们未来通过该等安排扩大算力和基础设施容量的能力，可能取决于有限数量的云服务商（CSP）、合作伙伴和融资方是否持续愿意并有能力订立并履行该等安排。在某些情况下，我们还可能在设备或基础设施交付之前付款。我们预计在可预见的未来将进行重大且不断增加的投资，包括在交付之前投资于自有或租赁的算力和基础设施。这些投资有助于确保我们拥有技术资源，以维持并扩大我们在前沿 AI 领域的地位。

paras.en: Our increasing efforts to build out our compute and infrastructure require substantial capital expenditures and are changing the cash flow profile of our business. Whereas the compute purchased through our CSP arrangements is generally paid as the compute becomes available to us, we expect an increasing portion of our compute and infrastructure investment to take the form of capital expenditures and other commitments, including lease obligations, that require significant upfront payments well in advance of the related compute becoming operational. We expect our capital expenditures to increase significantly as we expand our build-out, and we expect these investments to result in significant net cash used in operating and investing activities for the foreseeable future. Our net cash used in these activities may increase regardless of whether our financial performance improves. The magnitude and timing of these investments are inherently uncertain and may change materially over short periods, including as a result of decisions to accelerate or expand our build-out, and such changes could rapidly and significantly affect our cash flows for a given period. In addition, these investments are subject to known trends and uncertainties that could adversely affect our results of operations. The compute and chips necessary for frontier model development are available from a limited number of suppliers and geographies and are subject to intense competition, supply constraints, and evolving export controls, and we have historically operated in a compute-constrained environment in which demand for compute has exceeded the supply available to us. In addition, certain of the CSPs and chip partners on which we rely provide us capital or credit support, serve as our infrastructure vendors, and develop and offer AI models and services that compete with ours. These relationships could give rise to conflicts of interest that affect our access to compute, its cost, the prioritization of our workloads, or the terms on which such capital or credit support is provided. For a discussion of these and other risks, see the section titled “Risk Factors.”
paras.zh: 我们为构建算力和基础设施而不断加大的投入需要大量资本支出，并正在改变我们业务的现金流特征。通过我们的云服务商（CSP）安排购买的算力通常是在算力可供我们使用时支付，但我们预计，我们算力和基础设施投资中越来越大的部分将以资本支出和其他承诺的形式出现，包括租赁义务，这些都需要在相关算力投入运营之前很早就进行大额预付款。随着我们扩大建设规模，我们预计资本支出将大幅增加，并且我们预计这些投资将在可预见的未来导致经营活动和投资活动产生大量净现金流出。无论我们的财务表现是否改善，我们在这些活动中的净现金流出都可能增加。这些投资的规模和时点本身具有不确定性，并可能在短期内发生重大变化，包括由于决定加速或扩大我们的建设规模，而此类变化可能迅速且显著地影响我们在某一期间的现金流。此外，这些投资受到已知趋势和不确定性的影响，可能对我们的经营业绩产生不利影响。前沿模型开发所需的算力和芯片仅可从有限数量的供应商和地区获得，并面临激烈竞争、供应限制和不断演变的出口管制，而我们历来在算力受限的环境中运营，其中算力需求超过了我们可获得的供应。此外，我们所依赖的某些云服务商（CSP）和芯片合作伙伴向我们提供资本或信贷支持，担任我们的基础设施供应商，并开发和提供与我们竞争的 AI 模型和服务。这些关系可能引发利益冲突，影响我们获得算力的渠道、其成本、我们工作负载的优先级，或此类资本或信贷支持提供的条款。有关这些及其他风险的讨论，请参见题为“风险因素”的章节。

paras.en: We believe our existing available cash and cash equivalents, together with cash generated from sales and amounts available under our A&R Credit Facility (as defined below), will be sufficient to support working capital, operating and finance lease payments, and capital expenditure requirements for at least the next 12 months from the date of this prospectus. However, our future capital requirements will depend on many factors, including our revenue growth, the timing and extent of our investments in compute and infrastructure capacity, including additional or expanded CSP, equipment lease, and data center arrangements, the success and expansion of our sales, marketing, and business development strategies, any potential future investment in complementary businesses, products, technologies, assets, and talent, risks associated with the AI industry, and other factors described under “Key Factors Affecting Our Performance.” As a result of these and other factors, we may be required to seek additional financing sooner than we currently anticipate. Even if we determine that additional financing is required, we may not be able to raise it on terms acceptable to us or at all. Any such financing, if completed, may be costly, dilutive, or lead to restrictions on how we operate our business. If we are unable to raise additional capital when required, or if we cannot expand our operations or otherwise capitalize on our business opportunities because we lack sufficient capital, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows would be adversely affected.
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们现有的可用现金及现金等价物，连同销售产生的现金以及我们 A&R 信贷融资（定义见下文）项下的可用金额，将足以支持自本招股说明书日期起至少未来 12 个月的营运资金、经营租赁和融资租赁付款以及资本支出需求。然而，我们未来的资本需求将取决于许多因素，包括我们的收入增长、我们在算力和基础设施能力方面投资的时间和规模（包括额外的或扩大的 CSP、设备租赁和数据中心安排）、我们的销售、营销和业务发展策略的成功与扩展、任何潜在的未来对互补业务、产品、技术、资产和人才的投资、与 AI 行业相关的风险，以及“影响我们业绩的关键因素”中描述的其他因素。由于这些因素和其他因素，我们可能被要求比目前预期更早地寻求额外融资。即使我们确定需要额外融资，我们也可能无法以可接受的条款筹集到融资，或根本无法筹集到。任何此类融资（如果完成）可能成本高昂、具有稀释性，或导致对我们经营业务方式的限制。如果我们无法在需要时筹集额外资本，或者如果我们因缺乏足够资本而无法扩展运营或以其他方式利用我们的商业机会，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和现金流量将受到不利影响。

paras.en: Over the longer term, we expect to have significant cash requirements as we continue to invest in our business, primarily for compute and infrastructure, including our data center infrastructure build-out, as well as for general operating needs. We expect to fund these long-term cash requirements through a combination of cash flows from operations, proceeds from equity financings, including the net proceeds from this offering, proceeds from debt financings and potential future indebtedness, and financing arrangements with our partners, including under our note purchase agreements and our equipment lease and data center arrangements. Our ability to meet these requirements over the long term depends on our ability to grow our revenue and generate cash flows from operations and to access additional capital on acceptable terms. If sufficient funds are not available, we may be required to reduce, defer, or forgo planned investments, which could adversely affect our business, competitive position, and results of operations.
paras.zh: 从长期来看，随着我们继续投资于业务（主要用于算力和基础设施，包括我们的数据中心基础设施建设），以及一般运营需求，我们预计将有重大的现金需求。我们预计将通过以下方式的组合来为这些长期现金需求提供资金：经营活动产生的现金流量、股权融资所得款项（包括本次发行的净收益）、债务融资所得款项和潜在的未来债务，以及与合作伙伴的融资安排（包括根据我们的票据购买协议以及我们的设备租赁和数据中心安排）。我们长期满足这些需求的能力取决于我们增长收入、产生经营活动现金流量以及以可接受条款获得额外资本的能力。如果无法获得足够资金，我们可能被要求减少、推迟或放弃计划中的投资，这可能对我们的业务、竞争地位和经营业绩产生不利影响。

paras.en: #### Revolving Credit Agreement
paras.zh: #### 循环信贷协议

paras.en: In May 2025, we entered into a Credit Agreement (as amended from time to time prior to the A&R Credit Agreement (as defined below), the “Credit Agreement”) with certain lenders from time to time party thereto and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc., as administrative agent and collateral agent for the lenders, which initially provided for a $2.5 billion senior secured revolving credit facility with a $400 million letter of credit sublimit (the “Initial Credit Facility”). In September 2025, we amended the Initial Credit Facility to increase the aggregate revolving commitments to $2.75 billion and in November 2025, we further amended the Initial Credit Facility to increase the aggregate revolving commitments to $3.25 billion (the Initial Credit Facility, as amended, the “Credit Facility”).As of June 30, 2026, we had no borrowings drawn under the Credit Facility and $78 million of standby letters of credit outstanding. As of June 30, 2026, we were in compliance with all covenants under the Credit Agreement.
paras.zh: 2025 年 5 月，我们与不时参与其中的若干贷款方以及作为贷款方行政代理人和担保代理人的 Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc.签订了信贷协议(经不时修订，直至《修订及重述信贷协议》（定义见下文）签署之日，简称“信贷协议”)，该协议最初提供了一笔 25 亿美元的高级担保循环信贷额度，其中包含 4 亿美元的信用证子限额（简称“初始信贷额度”）。2025 年 9 月，我们修订了初始信贷额度，将循环承诺总额增加至 27.5 亿美元；2025 年 11 月，我们进一步修订了初始信贷额度，将循环承诺总额增加至 32.5 亿美元（经修订的初始信贷额度，简称“信贷额度”）。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，我们在信贷额度项下无未偿还借款，并有 78 百万美元的备用信用证未结清。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，我们遵守了信贷协议项下的所有契约。

paras.en: In September 2026, we entered into an Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (the “A&R Credit Agreement”), which amended and restated the Credit Agreement to provide for a $15 billion senior secured revolving credit facility with the full amount thereof available for letters of credit (the “A&R Credit Facility”). The A&R Credit Facility will mature on September 4, 2031, subject to earlier springing maturity if more than $500 million in aggregate scheduled cash principal payments on certain of our indebtedness are required within the 91-day period preceding the date on which any such scheduled principal payment is due, and we do not have sufficient liquidity to make all such payments then due and remain in pro forma compliance with our financial covenant, subject to certain other exceptions and conditions set forth in the A&R Credit Agreement. The proceeds of the A&R Credit Facility may be used for working capital, general corporate purposes, and other lawful purposes. We may request borrowings in U.S. dollars or certain other agreed currencies, subject to the terms of the A&R Credit Agreement.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月，我们签订了《修订及重述信贷协议》（以下简称“A&R 信贷协议”），该协议对原信贷协议进行了修订及重述，以提供一项 150 亿美元的高级担保循环信贷融资，其全部额度均可用于开立信用证（以下简称“A&R 信贷融资”）。A&R 信贷融资将于 2031 年 9 月 4 日到期，但若在我们某些债务项下合计超过 500 百万美元的预定现金本金付款须在任何该等预定本金付款到期日之前的 91 天期间内支付，而我们没有足够的流动性支付届时到期的全部该等款项并保持符合我们的财务契约（按备考基础计算），则可能提前触发到期，但须遵守 A&R 信贷协议中规定的某些其他例外和条件。A&R 信贷融资的所得款项可用于营运资金、一般公司用途及其他合法用途。我们可根据 A&R 信贷协议的条款，请求以美元或某些其他约定货币进行借款。

paras.en: We may borrow, repay, and reborrow amounts under the A&R Credit Facility from time to time. We are required to pay commitment fees on the unused portion of the A&R Credit Facility and fees in connection with letters of credit. On and after the Guarantee and Collateral Release Date (as defined below), such commitment fees will vary depending on our credit ratings, as set forth in the A&R Credit Agreement. Our obligations under the A&R Credit Facility are required to be guaranteed by certain of our material subsidiaries and secured by substantially all of our assets and the assets of such subsidiary guarantors, subject to certain exceptions and exclusions set forth in the A&R Credit Agreement. The A&R Credit Agreement further provides that, on and after the date we have obtained an Investment Grade Rating (as defined in the A&R Credit Agreement) from at least two out of three of Moody’s, S&P, and Fitch, at our election, all guarantees and security interests securing the obligations under the A&R Credit Facility will be released, discharged, and terminated, subject to certain conditions set forth in the A&R Credit Agreement (such date, the “Guarantee and Collateral Release Date”).
paras.zh: 我们可能会不时根据 A&R 信贷安排借入、偿还并再借入款项。我们需要就 A&R 信贷安排未使用的部分支付承诺费，并就信用证支付相关费用。在担保与抵押解除日（定义见下文）及之后，该等承诺费将根据我们的信用评级而有所不同，具体载于 A&R 信贷协议。我们在 A&R 信贷安排项下的义务须由我们的若干重要子公司提供担保，并以我们及该等子公司担保人的实质上全部资产作为抵押，但须受 A&R 信贷协议中规定的若干例外和排除条款的约束。A&R 信贷协议进一步规定，在我们已从 Moody's、S&P 和 Fitch 三家中的至少两家获得投资级评级（定义见 A&R 信贷协议）之日及之后，经我们选择，为 A&R 信贷安排项下义务提供担保的所有担保和担保权益将被解除、清偿并终止，但须受 A&R 信贷协议中规定的若干条件的约束（该日期称为“担保与抵押解除日”）。

paras.en: Borrowings under the A&R Credit Facility bear interest at rates based on either the Alternate Base Rate (as defined in the A&R Credit Agreement), Term SOFR Rate (as defined in the A&R Credit Agreement), or other applicable benchmark rates in the case of foreign currencies, plus an applicable margin. From and after the Guarantee and Collateral Release Date, such applicable margin will vary depending on our credit ratings, as more fully set forth in the A&R Credit Agreement. In addition, the A&R Credit Agreement includes customary affirmative and negative covenants, including, but not limited to, restrictions on additional indebtedness, liens, asset sales, investments, mergers, and restricted payments. On and after the Guarantee and Collateral Release Date, the negative covenants limiting asset sales, investments, restricted payments, and affiliate transactions will cease to apply and the negative covenants restricting additional indebtedness and liens will be modified in certain respects, including to permit additional indebtedness, subject to a cap on certain indebtedness that is secured by assets that do not secure the A&R Credit Facility or that is incurred or guaranteed by restricted subsidiaries that are not guarantors under the A&R Credit Facility. The A&R Credit Agreement includes a financial covenant requiring that we maintain liquidity of at least $5.0 billion as of the last day of each fiscal quarter, beginning with the fiscal quarter ending December 31, 2026. The A&R Credit Agreement also includes customary events of default, which, if triggered, could result in the acceleration of amounts due under the A&R Credit Facility and termination of the commitments thereunder.
paras.zh: A&R 信贷安排项下的借款按基于替代基准利率（定义见 A&R 信贷协议）、期限 SOFR 利率（定义见 A&R 信贷协议）的利率计息，如为外币，则按其他适用基准利率计息，另加适用利差。自担保与抵押解除日及之后，该适用利差将根据我们的信用评级而有所不同，具体详见 A&R 信贷协议。此外，A&R 信贷协议包含惯常的肯定性及否定性承诺，包括但不限于对额外债务、留置权、资产出售、投资、合并和限制性付款的限制。在担保与抵押解除日及之后，限制资产出售、投资、限制性付款和关联方交易的否定性承诺将不再适用，而限制额外债务和留置权的否定性承诺将在某些方面作出修改，包括允许额外债务，但须受限于以不为 A&R 信贷安排提供担保的资产作为担保的某些债务、或由并非 A&R 信贷安排项下担保人的受限子公司发生或担保的某些债务的上限。A&R 信贷协议包含一项财务承诺，要求我们自截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日的财季起，在每个财季的最后一日维持至少 $5.0 billion 的流动性。A&R 信贷协议还包含惯常的违约事件，一旦触发，可能导致 A&R 信贷安排项下到期金额被加速到期，并终止其项下的承诺。

paras.en: #### AMD Agreement
paras.zh: #### AMD 协议

paras.en: In July 2026, we entered into a hardware supply framework agreement (the “Hardware Supply Agreement”) with Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (“AMD”) to purchase, lease, or access AMD-based Helios rack-scale systems featuring AMD Instinct™ MI450 series GPUs. Pursuant to the terms of the Hardware Supply Agreement, AMD has provided a commitment to purchase up to $5.0 billion of our Class N common stock, which becomes available for us to draw on in increments following the achievement of specified AMD GPU delivery and deployment milestones. Based on the deployment schedule contemplated by the Hardware Supply Agreement, we expect the first of such milestones to be achieved in 2027. Following the completion of this offering, any purchases of our Class N common stock will be made at a price per share equal to the volume-weighted average price of our Class A common stock over the 30 trading days immediately preceding the applicable closing date of such purchase, and we must make any draw request within 12 months following the final delivery and deployment of AMD GPU capacity under the Hardware Supply Agreement.
paras.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我们与 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.（“AMD”）签订了硬件供应框架协议（“硬件供应协议”），以购买、租赁或获取搭载 AMD Instinct™ MI450 系列 GPU 的基于 AMD 的 Helios 机架级系统。根据硬件供应协议的条款，AMD 已作出承诺，将购买最多$5.0 billion 的我们的 N 类普通股，该承诺在实现特定的 AMD GPU 交付和部署里程碑后，可供我们按增量提取。根据硬件供应协议所设想的部署时间表，我们预计首个此类里程碑将于 2027 年实现。本次发行完成后，任何对我们 N 类普通股的购买将以等于紧接该购买适用交割日期前 30 个交易日内我们 A 类普通股成交量加权平均价格的价格每股进行，且我们必须在硬件供应协议项下 AMD GPU 产能最终交付和部署后的 12 个月内提出任何提取请求。

paras.en: #### Convertible Notes
paras.zh: #### 可转换票据

paras.en: Overview
paras.zh: 概述

paras.en: We have entered into NPAs with each of Google (through Google LLC), Amazon (through Amazon Web Services, Inc.), and Broadcom that provide for the issuance of convertible promissory notes and, in certain cases, shares of our non-voting capital stock. Our NPAs with Google consist of agreements entered into in September 2023 and August 2024, pursuant to which all convertible promissory notes previously issued thereunder have been fully converted into non-voting redeemable convertible preferred stock and under which no additional notes may be issued, and an agreement entered into in March 2026 (“Google 2026 NPA”), which provides for potential future financing capacity, subject to certain conditions described below. Our NPAs with Amazon consist of the Amazon 2023 NPA and the Amazon 2024 NPA, pursuant to which we previously issued convertible promissory notes, approximately $6.2 billion aggregate principal amount of which remains outstanding as described below under “—Outstanding Notes,” and under which no additional notes may be issued, and the 2026 Stock Purchase and Convertible Note Facility Agreement, dated as of April 20, 2026, by and between us and Amazon (“Amazon 2026 NPA”), which provides for potential future financing capacity, subject to certain conditions described below. The Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA provides for potential future financing capacity, if needed, subject to certain conditions described below. The principal economic terms of the NPAs that relate to our outstanding notes and potential future financing capacity are summarized in the tables below. To the extent an NPA creates an obligation to issue notes in the future, that obligation is accounted for as a derivative liability on our consolidated balance sheets until the related note is issued. For additional information, including the historical issuance and conversion of notes under these agreements, see Notes 9 and 16 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus.
paras.zh: 我们已分别与 Google（通过 Google LLC）、Amazon（通过 Amazon Web Services, Inc.）和 Broadcom 签订了 NPA，规定发行可转换本票，并在某些情况下发行我们的无表决权资本股票。我们与 Google 的 NPA 包括于 2023 年 9 月和 2024 年 8 月签订的协议，根据该等协议，此前据此发行的所有可转换本票已全部转换为无表决权可赎回可转换优先股，且根据该等协议不得再发行额外票据，以及于 2026 年 3 月签订的协议（“Google 2026 NPA”），该协议规定了潜在的未来融资能力，但须满足下文所述的某些条件。我们与 Amazon 的 NPA 包括 Amazon 2023 NPA 和 Amazon 2024 NPA，根据该等协议，我们此前发行了可转换本票，其中约$6.2 billion 的合计本金金额仍未偿还，如下文“——未偿还票据”所述，且根据该等协议不得再发行额外票据，以及我们与 Amazon 于 2026 年 4 月 20 日签订的 2026 年股票购买和可转换票据融资协议（“Amazon 2026 NPA”），该协议规定了潜在的未来融资能力，但须满足下文所述的某些条件。Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA 规定了潜在的未来融资能力（如需要），但须满足下文所述的某些条件。与我们的未偿还票据和潜在未来融资能力相关的 NPA 的主要经济条款概述于下表。若某项 NPA 产生未来发行票据的义务，该义务在我们的合并资产负债表上作为衍生负债核算，直至相关票据发行。有关更多信息，包括这些协议项下票据的历史发行和转换情况，请参阅本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表的附注 9 和 16。

paras.en: Outstanding Notes
paras.zh: 未偿还票据

paras.en: The following table summarizes the notes outstanding under our NPAs as of June 30, 2026, which consist entirely of non-interest-bearing rollover notes issued to Amazon under the Amazon 2023 NPA and the Amazon 2024 NPA, neither of which provides for the issuance of additional notes. Under the terms of the applicable notes, and unless Amazon elects in its sole discretion to waive the limitation, no portion of a note converts to the extent that, immediately following the conversion, Amazon would hold more than 12% of our capitalization, calculated for this purpose to include all of our outstanding capital stock on an as-converted basis together with shares underlying our outstanding equity awards and other outstanding convertible securities. The portion of each note that could not convert without exceeding this ownership cap was reissued as a rollover note in lieu of the shares of our non-voting redeemable convertible preferred stock that would otherwise have been issued to Amazon.
paras.zh: 下表汇总了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日我们 NPAs 项下尚未偿还的票据，这些票据全部为根据 Amazon 2023 NPA 和 Amazon 2024 NPA 向 Amazon 发行的无息展期票据，这两项协议均未规定可发行额外票据。根据适用票据的条款，除非 Amazon 自行决定豁免该限制，否则在转换后 Amazon 立即持有我们超过 12% 的资本化比例（为此目的计算时，应包含我们全部已发行股本（按转换后基准）以及我们已发行股权奖励和其他已发行可转换证券所对应的股份）的情况下，票据的任何部分均不得转换。每张票据中因超过该持股上限而无法转换的部分，已作为展期票据重新发行，以替代原本应发行给 Amazon 的无投票权可赎回可转换优先股股份。

paras.zh: (1) [__] 就本次发行而言，票据将按表中列示的每股固定转换价格与本招股说明书封面所载 A 类普通股初始每股价格（“IPO 价格”）中的较低者转换为 N 类普通股股份，但须遵守 Amazon 的持股上限，该上限可由 Amazon 选择豁免。本次发行后，任何因持有人持股上限而无法在本次发行中转换的票据，将在每个财政季度末按该固定价格、IPO 价格以及我们 A 类普通股 10 日追踪成交量加权平均价格中的最低者进行转换，但须遵守该持续的持股上限。

paras.en: (2) Assumes conversion at the applicable price in the column titled “Conversion Price Per Share” and represents the aggregate number of shares of Class N common stock issuable upon conversion of the notes, without giving effect to the holder’s ownership cap. The principal amount of any notes that cannot convert without exceeding the applicable ownership cap will be re-issued as a non-interest-bearing “rollover note” with substantially identical terms (other than any reduction in principal as a result of any partial conversion up to Amazon’s ownership cap). The remaining rollover notes would remain outstanding following this offering and would automatically convert at the end of each subsequent fiscal quarter as described above, to the extent such conversion would not exceed Amazon’s ownership cap, which may be waived at Amazon’s election. The number of shares of Class N common stock issued upon conversion at the completion of this offering, and the aggregate principal amount of notes remaining outstanding as rollover notes following this offering, will be determined based on the final offering size and Amazon’s election with respect to the ownership cap.

paras.en: In connection with certain liquidation transactions, Amazon may elect to receive cash in lieu of conversion. Upon specified events of default, we may be required to repay the outstanding principal amount of notes and accrued interest in five equal installments.

paras.en: We may issue notes under the Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA, if needed, through the fifth anniversary of the start of the draw period (which has not yet commenced and which will begin upon the serviceability of the infrastructure equipment pursuant to the terms of the 2026 Lease Arrangement), subject to earlier termination in certain circumstances, solely to finance quarterly rent payments under the 2026 Lease Arrangement. Our ability to issue notes under the Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA is subject to various conditions, including certain revenue growth rate conditions that are significantly below our actual revenue growth rates during all quarters of 2025 and thus far in 2026, our continued compliance with the minimum liquidity requirement under the A&R Credit Facility, and our continued performance under the Lease Arrangements (as defined below), and our ability to issue these notes terminates if these conditions are not met for a sustained period. Our obligations under the notes are guaranteed by certain of our subsidiaries and, together with such guarantees, are secured on a junior basis by the collateral securing the 2026 Lease Arrangement.
paras.zh: 如有需要，我们可在提款期开始（该提款期尚未开始，并将在基础设施设备根据 2026 年租赁安排条款达到可使用状态时开始）五周年之前，根据 Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA 发行本票，但在某些情况下可提前终止，且仅用于为 2026 年租赁安排项下的季度租金付款提供融资。我们根据 Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA 发行本票的能力受多种条件约束，包括某些收入增长率条件（该等条件显著低于我们在 2025 年所有季度以及 2026 年迄今的实际收入增长率）、我们持续遵守 A&R 信贷融资项下的最低流动性要求、我们持续履行租赁安排（定义见下文）项下的义务；如果这些条件在持续一段时间内未得到满足，我们发行这些本票的能力即告终止。我们在本票项下的义务由我们的某些子公司提供担保，并与该等担保一起，以 2026 年租赁安排的担保物作为次级担保。

paras.en: Upon an early buy-out of leased equipment at our election or if Broadcom or a designated financial partner demands a stipulated loss payment under the 2026 Lease Arrangement, Broadcom or a designated financial partner may require us to settle a portion of the notes in cash or in shares of our Class N common stock at the conversion price described above. If we experience a change of control or similar liquidation event, Broadcom or a designated financial partner may elect to receive cash equal to 150% of the then-outstanding principal amount of and accrued interest on the notes or to convert such notes immediately prior to the closing of such liquidation transaction.
paras.zh: 如果我们选择提前买断租赁设备，或 Broadcom 或指定财务合作伙伴根据 2026 年租赁安排要求支付约定损失赔偿，Broadcom 或指定财务合作伙伴可要求我们按上述转换价格以现金或我们的 N 类普通股股份结算部分本票。如果我们发生控制权变更或类似清算事件，Broadcom 或指定财务合作伙伴可选择收取相当于本票当时未偿本金金额及应计利息 150% 的现金，或在该清算交易交割前立即转换该等本票。

paras.en: The Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA contains customary events of default, including payment defaults under the Lease Arrangements and cross-defaults to material indebtedness, upon which Broadcom or a designated financial partner that holds the notes may accelerate any outstanding notes and terminate any remaining commitment. In connection with the Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA, we entered into a registration rights agreement with Broadcom with respect to any shares of Class N common stock issued upon conversion of the notes. See “Description of Capital Stock—Registration Rights.”

paras.en: Requests for note issuances under the Google 2026 NPA can be made through December 31, 2030 and are driven by the achievement of certain conditions under certain third-party compute agreements and specified TTM revenue targets, which we have historically surpassed. Each note issuance is funded over five quarterly closings unless Google elects to fund it in a single closing, and Google may elect to defer funding of revenue-linked draws. To the extent shares cannot be issued without exceeding Google’s ownership cap, which limits issuances of shares under the Google 2026 NPA to the extent such issuances would cause Google’s ownership of us to exceed 14.99% of our outstanding capitalization on a post-money, as-converted basis as calculated in accordance with the terms of the Google 2026 NPA, unless Google elects to waive it in its sole discretion, the excess will be funded through a non-interest-bearing rollover note maturing 10 years from issuance and convertible into Class N common stock at the end of each fiscal quarter, with any unconverted balance payable in cash at maturity.
paras.zh: 根据 Google 2026 NPA 提出的票据发行请求可在 2030 年 12 月 31 日之前提出，其触发条件为某些第三方算力协议项下特定条件的达成以及指定的过去十二个月（TTM）收入目标的实现，而我们历史上均已超额完成该等目标。每笔票据发行分五个季度交割完成，除非 Google 选择一次性交割；且 Google 可自行选择推迟与收入挂钩的提款资金的拨付。若发行股份将导致 Google 的所有权上限被突破——该上限规定，根据 Google 2026 NPA 条款计算，若按发行后、转换后基准计算，此类发行将导致 Google 对我们的持股超过我们流通股本的 14.99%，则不得发行股份，除非 Google 自行决定豁免该上限——超出部分将通过无息展期票据提供资金，该票据自发行之日起 10 年到期，并可在每个财季末转换为 N 类普通股，任何未转换余额于到期时以现金支付。

paras.en: In connection with the Google 2026 NPA, we granted Google an option to purchase up to $10.0 billion of our Class N common stock in a private placement concurrent with this offering at the public offering price, which would reduce the amount of notes available for issuance under the Google 2026 NPA by a corresponding amount if exercised. We also entered into a registration rights agreement with Google. See “Description of Capital Stock—Registration Rights.”
paras.zh: 就 Google 2026 NPA 而言，我们授予 Google 一项选择权，可在本次发行的同时以非公开发行方式按公开发行价格购买最多 $10.0 billion 的我们的 N 类普通股；若该选择权被行使，Google 2026 NPA 项下可供发行的票据金额将相应减少。我们还与 Google 签订了登记权协议。参见“股本说明——登记权”。

paras.en: #### Operating Activities
paras.zh: #### 经营活动

paras.en: Net cash used in operating activities for the year ended December 31, 2025 decreased by $3.1 billion compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. The decrease was primarily driven by a decrease in prepaid hosting services reflecting the consumption during 2025 of hosting capacity that had been prepaid in prior periods and an increase in accounts payable, accrued expenses, and other current liabilities due to increased CSP costs and the timing of related payments. The decrease was partially offset by higher cash payments, including a payment related to the Bartz settlement, higher cash compensation costs from headcount growth, and an increase in accounts receivable.
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，经营活动所用净现金较截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度减少 $3.1 billion。该减少主要由于预付托管服务减少（反映 2025 年消耗了前期预付的托管容量）以及因 CSP 成本增加及相关付款时点导致应付账款、应计费用和其他流动负债增加。该减少被较高的现金付款部分抵消，包括与 Bartz 和解相关的付款、因员工人数增长导致的较高现金薪酬成本以及应收账款增加。

paras.en: Net cash used in operating activities for the year ended December 31, 2024 increased by $4.1 billion compared to the year ended December 31, 2023. The increase was primarily driven by an increase in prepaid hosting services due to business expansion requiring additional hosting capacity.
paras.zh: 截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度，经营活动所用净现金较截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度增加 $4.1 billion。该增加主要由于业务扩张需要额外托管容量导致预付托管服务增加。

paras.en: Cash provided by operating activities was $3.9 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to cash used in operating activities of $1.5 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2025. Our operating cash flows result primarily from cash received from our customers, offset by cash payments we make for products and services, employee compensation, operating leases, and interest payments. The increase in operating cash flow was primarily driven by an improvement in net loss adjusted for non-cash items, and changes in working capital, primarily reflecting the timing of payments to vendors and cash receipts from customers. Working capital at any point in time is subject to many variables, including the timing of billings and cash collections, vendor payment terms, and the timing of invoice receipt and payment [__] .
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六个月，经营活动提供的现金为 $3.9 billion，而截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日止六个月经营活动使用的现金为 $1.5 billion。我们的经营现金流主要来自向客户收取的现金，并扣除我们为产品和服务、员工薪酬、经营租赁及利息支付的现金。经营现金流的增加主要得益于经非现金项目调整后的净亏损改善以及营运资金变动，后者主要反映向供应商付款和向客户收取现金的时间安排。任一时点的营运资金受诸多变量影响，包括开票和现金收款的时间安排、供应商付款条件，以及发票收取和付款的时间安排 [__] 。

paras.en: #### Investing Activities
paras.zh: #### 投资活动

paras.en: Net cash used in investing activities for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased by $3.1 billion compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. The increase was primarily driven by increased purchases of new marketable securities, including U.S. Treasury and agency securities and corporate debt securities, as well as higher capital expenditures related to servers, networking and infrastructure equipment, and purchases of intangible assets. These increases were partially offset by proceeds from sales and maturities of marketable securities.
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，投资活动使用的现金净额较截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度增加 $3.1 billion。该增加主要由于购买新的有价证券（包括美国国债及机构证券和公司债务证券）增加，以及与服务器、网络和基础设施设备相关的资本支出增加，以及购买无形资产。上述增加部分被有价证券销售和到期所得款项所抵消。

paras.en: Net cash used in investing activities for the year ended December 31, 2024 increased by $20 million compared to the year ended December 31, 2023. The increase was primarily driven by increased capital investments in leasehold improvements and purchases of intangible assets.
paras.zh: 截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度，投资活动使用的现金净额较截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度增加 $20 million。该增加主要由于对租赁改良的资本投资增加以及购买无形资产。

paras.en: Cash used in investing activities was $17.2 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to cash used in investing activities of $49 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025, which primarily reflects the increased purchases of short-term investments, including commercial paper, U.S. Treasury and agency securities and corporate debt securities, in addition to higher capital expenditures related to servers, networking and infrastructure equipment. This was partially offset by proceeds from sales and maturities of marketable securities.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六个月，投资活动使用的现金为 $17.2 billion，而截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日止六个月投资活动使用的现金为 $49 million，这主要反映购买短期投资（包括商业票据、美国国债及机构证券和公司债务证券）增加，以及与服务器、网络和基础设施设备相关的资本支出增加。该增加部分被有价证券销售和到期所得款项所抵消。

paras.en: Net cash provided by financing activities for the year ended December 31, 2024 increased by $4.9 billion compared to the year ended December 31, 2023. The increase was primarily driven by increased proceeds from the issuance of convertible notes for cash and increased proceeds from the issuance of redeemable convertible preferred stock, net of issuance costs.

paras.en: In November 2025, we entered into an agreement with Microsoft, which was subsequently amended in February and October 2026, pursuant to which we committed to spend an aggregate of at least $44.9 billion between November 2026 and May 2033, regardless of actual usage. Our commitment under such agreement is non-cancelable except in the event of Microsoft’s uncured material breach or, on a per-tranche basis, for undelivered tranches.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月，我们与 Microsoft 签订了一项协议，该协议随后于 2026 年 2 月和 10 月进行了修订。根据该协议，我们承诺在 2026 年 11 月至 2033 年 5 月期间支出总额至少$44.9 billion，无论实际使用情况如何。我们在该协议项下的承诺不可撤销，除非 Microsoft 发生未补救的重大违约，或就未交付的分批而言，按分批基准可撤销。

paras.en: In March 2026, we entered into an agreement with Google, which was subsequently amended between May and August 2026, and pursuant to which we committed to spend at least approximately $114.5 billion between April 2026 and July 2033, regardless of actual usage. If our actual spend falls short, we must pay Google the difference as a true-up subject to certain adjustments and exceptions if available. Our commitments under such agreement are non-cancelable except in the event of Google’s uncured material breach. In addition, we also committed to procure additional TPU compute from TPU providers, including Google, to be delivered between 2028 and 2031. The payment obligations for such additional compute are determined by the capacity made available, the manner in which it is deployed, the pricing mechanics, and the satisfaction of certain deployment conditions. We estimate the aggregate future payments for such additional compute to be approximately $125.0 billion to $150.0 billion, which are not included in the contractual commitments table above.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月，我们与 Google 签订了一项协议，该协议随后于 2026 年 5 月至 8 月期间进行了修订。根据该协议，我们承诺在 2026 年 4 月至 2033 年 7 月期间支出至少约$114.5 billion，无论实际使用情况如何。如果我们的实际支出不足，我们必须向 Google 支付差额作为补足款，但须进行某些调整，并在可用时适用例外情形。我们在该协议项下的承诺不可撤销，除非 Google 发生未补救的重大违约。此外，我们还承诺从包括 Google 在内的 TPU 供应商处采购额外的 TPU 算力，交付时间为 2028 年至 2031 年。该等额外算力的付款义务取决于所提供的容量、部署方式、定价机制以及某些部署条件的满足情况。我们估计该等额外算力的未来付款总额约为$125.0 billion 至$150.0 billion，该等金额未包含在上文的合同承诺表中。

paras.en: In April 2026, we entered into an agreement with Amazon, pursuant to which we committed to spend an aggregate of at least $110.0 billion between May 2026 and April 2036, regardless of actual usage. If our actual spend falls short, we must pay Amazon the difference as a true-up subject to certain adjustments and exceptions if available. Our commitment under such agreement is non-cancelable except in the event of Amazon’s uncured material breach.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月，我们与 Amazon 签订了一项协议。根据该协议，我们承诺在 2026 年 5 月至 2036 年 4 月期间支出总额至少$110.0 billion，无论实际使用情况如何。如果我们的实际支出不足，我们必须向 Amazon 支付差额作为补足款，但须进行某些调整，并在可用时适用例外情形。我们在该协议项下的承诺不可撤销，除非 Amazon 发生未补救的重大违约。

paras.en: Between May and October 2026, we entered into and amended several agreements with SpaceX.AI LLC (formerly known as X.AI LLC) (“SpaceXAI”), a wholly owned subsidiary of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (collectively, the “SpaceXAI Arrangements”), to access compute powered by NVIDIA GPUs. Under the SpaceXAI Arrangements, we agreed to spend an aggregate of up to $120.5 billion over terms extending into 2029, consisting of approximately $3.1 billion in the aggregate per month once all capacity has been delivered, which we expect in December 2026, with different fees during capacity ramping periods. Following initial non-cancelable periods ending in January 2027 and March 2027 under the respective agreements, each agreement may be cancelled by either party upon 90 days’ advance written notice.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 10 月期间，我们与 SpaceX.AI LLC（前身为 X.AI LLC）（“SpaceXAI”）签订并修订了若干协议，以获取由 NVIDIA GPU 驱动的算力。SpaceXAI 是 Space Exploration Technologies Corp.的全资子公司（统称“SpaceXAI 安排”）。根据 SpaceXAI 安排，我们同意在延伸至 2029 年的期限内支出总额最高达$120.5 billion，其中包括在全部容量交付后每月合计约$3.1 billion（我们预计于 2026 年 12 月交付），容量爬坡期间的费用有所不同。在各协议分别于 2027 年 1 月和 2027 年 3 月结束的初始不可撤销期之后，任何一方均可提前 90 天书面通知撤销各协议。

paras.en: Under the Hardware Supply Agreement with AMD, we committed to obtain an initial tranche of compute capacity in calendar year 2027 by purchasing AMD-based Helios rack-scale systems from approved manufacturers or by accessing such systems through third-party service providers, provided certain conditions related to deployment proposals are met. The agreement does not specify a fixed dollar commitment. If we procure the full amount of this initial committed capacity, we expect aggregate expenditures to exceed [__] $20.0 billion over the term of the agreement, which are not included in the contractual commitments table above. The agreement also provides for the potential procurement of additional capacity of up to approximately the amount of our initial commitment. Our agreement with AMD is non-cancelable by us except in the event of AMD’s uncured material breach and will automatically terminate 12 months after both parties fulfill their commitments under the agreement and all ordered AMD GPU capacity has been delivered.
paras.zh: 根据与 AMD 签订的《硬件供应协议》，我们承诺在 2027 日历年获得首批算力容量，方式为向经批准的制造商购买基于 AMD 的 Helios 机架级系统，或通过第三方服务提供商获取此类系统，前提是满足与部署方案相关的特定条件。该协议未规定固定的美元承诺金额。如果我们采购该首批承诺容量的全部金额，我们预计在协议期限内总支出将超过 [__] $20.0 billion，该等支出未包含在上文的合同承诺表中。该协议还规定可能额外采购最多约相当于我们初始承诺金额的容量。我们与 AMD 的协议对我们而言不可撤销，除非 AMD 发生未补救的重大违约，且该协议将在双方履行协议项下承诺且所有已订购的 AMD GPU 容量交付后 12 个月自动终止。

paras.en: In August 2026, we entered into GPU services agreements (collectively, the “Nscale Services Agreements”) with wholly owned subsidiaries of Nscale Global Holdings Limited (together with its affiliates, “Nscale”) to access compute powered by NVIDIA GPUs. Under the Nscale Services Agreements, we agreed to spend an aggregate of up to approximately $44.6 billion over terms extending into 2033, with fees accruing only as capacity is delivered to and accepted by us. Nscale is required to use best efforts to obtain qualifying financing for the NVIDIA GPUs and data center infrastructure within a specified period following the effective date of such agreements (or such later date as may be mutually agreed by the parties and subject to additional negotiation). Otherwise, our commitment under each agreement is non-cancelable except in limited circumstances, including Nscale’s failure to meet specified delivery or service availability requirements or an uncured material breach by the applicable Nscale entity.
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月，我们与 Nscale Global Holdings Limited 的全资子公司（连同其关联方，合称“Nscale”）签订了 GPU 服务协议（合称“Nscale 服务协议”），以获取由 NVIDIA GPU 驱动的算力。根据 Nscale 服务协议，我们同意在延伸至 2033 年的期限内合计支出最高约 $44.6 billion，费用仅在容量交付给我们并经我们验收时计提。Nscale 须尽最大努力在该等协议生效日期后的指定期限内（或双方可能共同商定的更晚日期，并须经进一步协商）为 NVIDIA GPU 和数据中心基础设施获得合格融资。否则，我们在各协议项下的承诺不可撤销，除非在有限情形下，包括 Nscale 未能满足指定的交付或服务可用性要求，或相关 Nscale 实体发生未补救的重大违约。

paras.en: In May, June and August 2026, we entered into agreements (collectively, the “Lambda Agreements”) with Lambda, Inc. (“Lambda”) to access compute powered by NVIDIA GPUs. Under the Lambda Agreements, we agreed to spend an aggregate of approximately $41.3 billion over terms extending into 2034, with fees accruing only as capacity is delivered to and accepted by us. Under our August 2026 agreement, which represents approximately $34.9 billion of the aggregate commitment, either party may terminate if Lambda does not timely secure the facility lease. Otherwise, our commitment under each of the Lambda Agreements is non-cancelable except in the event of Lambda’s uncured material breach or certain other limited circumstances and, for certain of the Lambda Agreements, on a per-tranche basis if Lambda fails to meet specified delivery milestones for that tranche.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月、6 月和 8 月，我们与 Lambda, Inc.（“Lambda”）签订了协议（合称“Lambda 协议”），以获取由 NVIDIA GPU 驱动的算力。根据 Lambda 协议，我们同意在延伸至 2034 年的期限内合计支出约 $41.3 billion，费用仅在容量交付给我们并经我们验收时计提。根据我们 2026 年 8 月的协议（该协议约占承诺总额中的 $34.9 billion），若 Lambda 未能及时取得设施租赁，任何一方均可终止。否则，我们在各 Lambda 协议项下的承诺不可撤销，除非 Lambda 发生未补救的重大违约或某些其他有限情形，且对于某些 Lambda 协议，若 Lambda 未能满足该批次指定的交付里程碑，则可按批次终止。

paras.en: Infrastructure Equipment Leases
paras.zh: 基础设施设备租赁

paras.en: We have entered into five-year master equipment leases with Broadcom, pursuant to which we receive such hardware for deployment in dedicated data center facilities operated by others on our behalf (the “Lease Arrangements”). These Lease Arrangements are accounted for as finance leases. Our rent payments over the life of these leases are equal to an aggregate of approximately $161.2 billion excluding interest, with rent payable in quarterly installments and payment obligations typically commencing upon AI infrastructure equipment becoming “ready for service” at the applicable data center facility. Rent payments may commence earlier in certain circumstances, such as when the readiness of a data center facility is delayed. The Lease Arrangements provide us with access to TPU-based compute capacity, a portion of which began to come online in 2026, with additional capacity expected to come online starting in 2027. The Lease Arrangements are non-cancelable by either party during the applicable lease period except in the case of a default. In connection with the 2026 Lease Arrangement, we deposited cash into a restricted cash account for the benefit of Broadcom and may be required to deposit additional cash under certain circumstances for the benefit of Broadcom. Our two special purpose subsidiaries entered into agreements for the Lease Arrangements, the obligations of which are guaranteed by Anthropic, PBC, and such obligations are secured by the leased equipment. Further, we agreed to customary events of default, including cross-defaults, upon which our obligations may be accelerated. We may, if needed, finance a certain amount of our quarterly rent payments under the 2026 Lease Arrangement through the issuance of convertible promissory notes under the Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA in certain circumstances. See the section titled “—Convertible Notes—Broadcom” for more information. In the second quarter of 2026, Broadcom assigned a portion of its rights under one of the master equipment leases to another third party.
paras.zh: 我们已与 Broadcom 签订五年期主设备租赁协议，据此我们获得该等硬件，用于部署在由他方代表我们在专用数据中心设施中运营的场所（“租赁安排”）。该等租赁安排作为融资租赁进行会计处理。在该等租赁期限内，我们的租金付款总额约为 $161.2 billion（不含利息），租金按季度分期支付，付款义务通常自 AI 基础设施设备在适用数据中心设施“可供服务”时开始。在某些情况下，租金付款可能提前开始，例如数据中心设施的就绪时间延迟时。该等租赁安排为我们提供了基于 TPU 的算力容量，其中一部分已于 2026 年开始上线，预计更多容量将从 2027 年开始上线。除违约情形外，该等租赁安排在适用租赁期内任何一方均不可撤销。就 2026 年租赁安排而言，我们已将现金存入为 Broadcom 利益设立的受限现金账户，并可能在某些情况下被要求为 Broadcom 的利益存入额外现金。我们的两家特殊目的子公司签订了租赁安排协议，其义务由 Anthropic, PBC 提供担保，且该等义务以租赁设备作为担保。此外，我们同意了惯常的违约事件，包括交叉违约，在此情况下我们的义务可能被加速到期。如有需要，我们可能在某些情况下通过根据 Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA 发行可转换本票来为 2026 年租赁安排下的部分季度租金付款提供融资。更多信息请参见标题为“—可转换票据—Broadcom”的章节。2026 年第二季度，Broadcom 将其在一份主设备租赁协议项下的部分权利转让给了另一第三方。

full.sec: Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures about Market Risk
full.secZh: 关于市场风险的定量和定性披露

paras.en: We are exposed to market risks in the ordinary course of our business. Market risk represents the risk of loss that may impact our financial position due to adverse changes in financial market prices and rates. Our market risk exposure is primarily the result of fluctuations in interest rates and foreign currency exchange rates.
paras.zh: 在日常经营过程中，我们面临市场风险。市场风险是指因金融市场价格和利率的不利变动而可能影响我们财务状况的损失风险。我们的市场风险敞口主要源于利率和外汇汇率的波动。

paras.en: #### Interest Rate Risk
paras.zh: #### 利率风险

paras.en: As of June 30, 2026, we had $112.4 billion of cash and cash equivalents and $19.3 billion of short-term investments in a variety of securities, including money market funds, U.S. Treasury and agency securities, corporate debt securities, and commercial paper. In addition, we had $2.5 billion of restricted cash primarily due to amounts held as collateral for our lease and other obligations. Our cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments are held for working capital purposes, and we do not enter into investments for trading or speculative purposes. Due to the relatively short-term nature of our investment portfolio, a hypothetical 100 basis point increase or decrease in interest rates would not have had a material effect on the fair value of our investment portfolio as of June 30, 2026 [__] .
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，我们持有 $112.4 billion 的现金及现金等价物以及 $19.3 billion 的短期投资，投资于多种证券，包括货币市场基金、美国国债及机构证券、公司债务证券和商业票据。此外，我们持有 $2.5 billion 的受限现金，主要系为我们的租赁及其他义务作为抵押品而持有的款项。我们的现金、现金等价物和短期投资系为营运资金目的而持有，我们不会为交易或投机目的进行投资。由于我们的投资组合期限相对较短，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日 [__]，利率假设性上升或下降 100 个基点不会对我们的投资组合公允价值产生重大影响。

paras.en: #### Foreign Currency Exchange Risk
paras.zh: #### 外汇汇率风险

paras.en: We transact business globally in multiple currencies, with the vast majority of our revenue denominated in U.S. dollars and, to a lesser extent, other currencies such as euros and British pounds. Our international revenue, as well as costs and expenses denominated in foreign currencies, and intercompany transactions with our foreign subsidiaries, expose us to the risk of fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates against the U.S. dollar. A hypothetical 10% change in foreign currency exchange rates applicable to our business would not have a material impact on our consolidated financial statements as of June 30, 2026. We have not entered into derivative or hedging transactions, but we may enter into such arrangements in the future if our exposure to foreign currency becomes more significant.
paras.zh: 我们在全球范围内以多种货币开展业务，其中绝大部分收入以美元计价，少部分以欧元和英镑等其他货币计价。我们的国际收入、以外币计价的成本和费用，以及与境外子公司之间的公司间交易，使我们面临外币兑美元汇率波动的风险。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，适用于我们业务的外汇汇率假设性变动 10% 不会对我们的合并财务报表产生重大影响。我们尚未进行衍生品或对冲交易，但若我们的外汇敞口变得更加重大，我们未来可能会进行此类安排。

paras.en: Our discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations are based upon our financial statements, which have been prepared in accordance with GAAP. GAAP requires us to make certain estimates and judgments that affect the amounts reported in our financial statements. We base our estimates on historical experience, anticipated future trends, and other assumptions we believe to be reasonable under the circumstances. Because these accounting policies require significant judgment, our actual results may differ materially from our estimates.
paras.zh: 我们对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析基于我们的财务报表，该等财务报表系按照 GAAP 编制。GAAP 要求我们作出某些估计和判断，这些估计和判断会影响我们财务报表中报告的金额。我们的估计基于历史经验、预期未来趋势以及我们认为在相关情况下合理的其他假设。由于这些会计政策需要作出重大判断，我们的实际结果可能与我们的估计存在重大差异。

paras.en: We believe that of our significant accounting policies, which are described in Note 1 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus, the following accounting policies involve a greater degree of judgment and complexity. Accordingly, these are the policies we believe are the most critical to aid in fully understanding and evaluating our consolidated financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows.
paras.zh: 我们认为，在我们重要的会计政策中（该等政策载于本招股说明书其他部分所包含的合并财务报表附注 1），以下会计政策涉及更高程度的判断和复杂性。因此，我们认为以下政策对于帮助充分理解和评估我们的合并财务状况、经营成果和现金流量最为关键。

paras.en: #### Stock-Based Compensation
paras.zh: #### 股权激励费用

paras.en: We measure compensation expense for all stock-based payment awards, including stock options and RSUs, granted to employees, directors, and other service providers, based on the estimated fair value of the awards on the date of grant. The most significant input in determining the fair value of a stock option is the estimated fair value of our common stock. The estimated fair value of our common stock is also used to measure the grant date fair value of RSUs and RSAs, including those subject to performance-based vesting conditions.
paras.zh: 我们按照授予日奖励的估计公允价值，计量授予员工、董事及其他服务提供者的所有股票支付奖励（包括股票期权和 RSU）的补偿费用。确定股票期权公允价值时最重要的输入值是本公司普通股的估计公允价值。本公司普通股的估计公允价值亦用于计量 RSU 和 RSA（包括受基于业绩的归属条件约束的 RSU 和 RSA）的授予日公允价值。

paras.en: Stock Options
paras.zh: 股票期权

paras.en: We estimate the fair value of stock options granted to employees, consultants, officers, and directors using the Black-Scholes-Merton option pricing model on the date of grant. The fair value of stock options that are expected to vest is recognized as compensation expense on a straight-line basis over the requisite service period. Forfeitures are accounted for when they occur.
paras.zh: 我们于授予日使用 Black-Scholes-Merton 期权定价模型估计授予员工、顾问、高管和董事的股票期权的公允价值。预期将归属的股票期权的公允价值在必要服务期内按直线法确认为补偿费用。没收在实际发生时进行会计处理。

paras.en: The Black-Scholes-Merton model considers several variables and assumptions in estimating the fair value of stock-based awards. These variables include:
paras.zh: Black-Scholes-Merton 模型在估计股票奖励公允价值时考虑若干变量和假设。这些变量包括：

paras.en: ▪ [__] Fair Value of Common Stock. Because our common stock is not yet publicly traded, we must estimate the fair value of our common stock. Our board of directors considers numerous objective and subjective factors to determine the fair value of our common stock as discussed in the section titled “— Common Stock Valuations” below.
paras.zh: ▪ [__] 普通股公允价值。由于我们的普通股尚未公开交易，我们必须估计本公司普通股的公允价值。我们的董事会考虑众多客观和主观因素以确定本公司普通股的公允价值，具体讨论见下文“—普通股估值”一节。

paras.en: ▪ [__] Expected Volatility. Since we have no trading history of our common stock, the expected volatility of our underlying common stock is estimated by taking the weighted-average historical volatility of a group of comparable publicly traded companies over a period equal to the expected life of the options.
paras.zh: ▪ [__] 预期波动率。由于我们的普通股没有交易历史，我们基础普通股的预期波动率系通过取一组可比上市公司在与期权预期期限相等的期间内的加权平均历史波动率来估计。

paras.en: - Expected Term. Expected term represents the period over which we anticipate stock-based awards to be outstanding. We estimate the expected term based on the options’ vesting term and contractual terms, such that the expected life is equal to the average of the stock-based award’s weighted-average vesting period and its contractual term.
paras.zh: - 预期期限。预期期限代表我们预计股票奖励将存续的期间。我们根据期权的归属期限和合同条款估计预期期限，使预期期限等于股票奖励的加权平均归属期与其合同期限的平均值。

paras.en: - Risk-free Rate. The expected risk-free rate assumption is based on the U.S. Treasury instruments whose term is consistent with the expected term of the stock options.
paras.zh: - 无风险利率。预期无风险利率假设基于期限与股票期权预期期限一致的美国国债工具。

paras.en: - Expected Dividend Yield. The expected dividend yield is zero, as we have never declared or paid any dividends and have no current plans to do so.
paras.zh: - 预期股息率。预期股息率为零，因为我们从未宣布或派发任何股息，且目前也没有派发股息的计划。

paras.en: As of June 30, 2026, there was approximately $2.8 billion of total unrecognized compensation cost related to unvested stock options, which is expected to be recognized over a weighted-average period of 1.2 years [__] .
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，与未归属股票期权相关的未确认补偿成本总额约为 $2.8 billion，预计将在 1.2 年的加权平均期间内确认 [__] 。

paras.en: Restricted Stock Units and Restricted Stock Awards
paras.zh: 限制性股票单位与限制性股票奖励

paras.en: We have granted RSUs to our employees and non-employee service providers under our 2021 Plan. RSUs outstanding as of June 30, 2026 have both service-based and performance-based vesting conditions. The service-based vesting period for these awards is typically four years. Upon satisfaction of the performance condition, RSUs for which the service-based vesting condition has also been satisfied will vest immediately, and any remaining unvested RSUs will vest ratably over the remaining service period. The performance condition is generally satisfied upon the occurrence of a change in control event or the effective date of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.
paras.zh: 我们已根据我们的 2021 年计划向员工和非员工服务提供者授予 RSU。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日尚未归属的 RSU 同时具有基于服务和基于业绩的归属条件。该等奖励的基于服务的归属期通常为四年。在业绩条件满足后，已同时满足基于服务归属条件的 RSU 将立即归属，任何剩余未归属的 RSU 将在剩余服务期内按比例归属。业绩条件通常在控制权变更事件发生时或本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之日满足。

paras.en: As of June 30, 2026, no stock-based compensation expense had been recognized for such RSUs because the performance condition was not satisfied. In connection with this offering, we will begin recording stock-based compensation expense based on the grant-date fair value of the RSUs using the accelerated attribution method. As of June 30, 2026, there was approximately $26.6 billion of total unrecognized stock-based compensation expense related to RSUs. Of that amount, $2.9 billion relates to RSUs for which the service-based vesting condition had been satisfied or partially satisfied. Following the completion of this offering, stock-based compensation expense related to our RSUs will result in increases in our expenses in future periods, in particular the quarter in which this offering is completed, as the performance-based vesting condition applicable to a significant portion of our outstanding RSUs will be satisfied upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. Upon the completion of this offering, we will record cumulative stock-based compensation expense of approximately $ [__] related to RSUs outstanding as of the date of this prospectus, for which (i) the service-based vesting condition is fully or partially satisfied as of such date and (ii) the performance-based vesting condition is satisfied upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，由于业绩条件尚未满足，尚未就该等 RSU 确认任何股权激励费用。就本次发行而言，我们将开始采用加速归属法，基于 RSU 的授予日公允价值记录股权激励费用。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，与 RSU 相关的未确认股权激励费用总额约为 $26.6 billion。其中，$2.9 billion 与已满足或部分满足基于服务归属条件的 RSU 相关。本次发行完成后，与我们的 RSU 相关的股权激励费用将导致我们未来期间的费用增加，尤其是本次发行完成所在的季度，因为适用于我们大部分未归属 RSU 的基于业绩的归属条件将在本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效时满足。本次发行完成后，我们将就截至本招股说明书日期尚未归属的 RSU 记录累计股权激励费用约 $ [__] ，该等 RSU (i) 截至该日期已完全或部分满足基于服务的归属条件，且 (ii) 在本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效时满足基于业绩的归属条件。

paras.en: We have granted RSAs to founders, early employees, advisors, and in connection with acquisitions. The RSAs consist of awards with a service-based vesting condition. RSAs are measured at fair value of the underlying common stock on the date of grant. We record compensation cost for these awards using the straight-line method over the requisite service period.
paras.zh: 我们已向创始人、早期员工、顾问授予 RSA，并在收购交易中授予 RSA。RSA 包括具有基于服务归属条件的奖励。RSA 按授予日相关普通股的公允价值计量。我们采用直线法在必要服务期内记录该等奖励的补偿成本。

paras.en: #### Common Stock Valuations
paras.zh: #### 普通股估值

paras.en: Prior to our initial public offering, given the absence of a public trading market of our Class A common stock, and in accordance with the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants Accounting and Valuation Guide, Valuation of Privately-Held Company Equity Securities Issued as Compensation, our board of directors exercised reasonable judgment and considered numerous objective and subjective factors to determine the best estimate of the fair value of our common stock, including:
paras.zh: 在我们首次公开募股之前，鉴于我们的 A 类普通股缺乏公开交易市场，并且根据美国注册会计师协会《会计与估值指南：作为薪酬发行的非上市公司股权证券估值》，我们的董事会行使了合理判断，并考虑了众多客观和主观因素，以确定我们普通股公允价值的最佳估计，包括：

paras.en: - contemporaneous third-party valuations of our common stock;
paras.zh: - 同期第三方对我们普通股的估值；

paras.en: - the prices paid for common or redeemable convertible preferred stock sold to third-party investors by us and prices paid in secondary transactions, including any tender offers;
paras.zh: - 我们向第三方投资者出售的普通股或可赎回可转换优先股的支付价格，以及二级交易（包括任何要约收购）中的支付价格；

paras.en: - the rights, preferences, and privileges of our redeemable convertible preferred stock relative to those of our common stock;
paras.zh: - 我们的可赎回可转换优先股相对于普通股的权利、优先权和特权；

paras.en: - actual and forecasted operating and financial performance;
paras.zh: - 实际和预测的经营和财务业绩；

paras.en: - our stage of development;
paras.zh: - 我们的发展阶段；

paras.en: - the industry outlook;
paras.zh: - 行业前景；

paras.en: - the lack of marketability of our common stock;
paras.zh: - 我们普通股缺乏市场流通性；

paras.en: - the likelihood of achieving a liquidity event, such as an initial public offering or a sale of our company, given prevailing market conditions;
paras.zh: - 鉴于当前市场状况，实现流动性事件（如首次公开募股或出售我们公司）的可能性；

paras.en: - the history and nature of our business, industry trends, and competitive environment; and
paras.zh: - 我们业务的历史和性质、行业趋势和竞争环境；以及

paras.en: - general economic outlook, including economic growth, inflation and unemployment, interest rate environment, and global economic trends.
paras.zh: - 总体经济前景，包括经济增长、通货膨胀和失业、利率环境和全球经济趋势。

paras.en: Our board of directors determined the fair value of our common stock by first determining the enterprise value of our business and then allocating the value among the various classes of our securities to derive a per share value of our common stock. The enterprise value of our business was primarily estimated by reference to the closest round of equity financing to the date of the valuation.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会通过首先确定我们业务的企业价值，然后将价值分配给我们的各类证券，从而得出我们普通股的每股价值，以此确定我们普通股的公允价值。我们业务的企业价值主要参照截至估值日期最近一轮股权融资进行估计。

paras.en: In allocating the enterprise value of our business among the various classes of stock prior to this offering, we used a hybrid method based on a contingent claims analysis (“CCA”) and a common stock equivalent (“CSE”) method. The CCA is based on the Black-Scholes-Merton option pricing model, which models each class of stock as a call option with a unique claim on our assets. The CSE method presumes that all shares of redeemable convertible preferred stock convert into common stock based upon their conversion terms and other differences in the rights and preferences of the shares of redeemable convertible preferred stock are ignored.
paras.zh: 在本次发行前将我们业务的企业价值在各类别股票之间进行分配时，我们采用了一种基于或有权益分析（“CCA”）与普通股等价物（“CSE”）法的混合方法。CCA 基于 Black-Scholes-Merton 期权定价模型，该模型将每一类别股票视为一项对我们资产具有独特索取权的看涨期权。CSE 法假定所有可赎回可转换优先股股份均按其转换条款转换为普通股，并忽略可赎回可转换优先股股份在权利和优先权方面的其他差异。

paras.en: After the allocation of enterprise value to the various classes of stock, a discount for lack of marketability (“DLOM”) is applied to arrive at a fair value of the common stock. A DLOM is meant to account for the lack of opportunity to sell a private company stock that is not traded on public exchanges. In making the final determination of common stock value, consideration is also given to the recent sales and/or expected sales of common stock.
paras.zh: 在企业价值分配至各类别股票之后，再应用缺乏市场流通性折扣（“DLOM”）以得出普通股的公允价值。DLOM 旨在反映无法在公开交易所交易的私营公司股票缺乏出售机会的情况。在最终确定普通股价值时，还会考虑近期的普通股出售和/或预期出售情况。

paras.en: Application of these approaches involves the use of estimates, judgment, and assumptions that are complex and subjective, such as those regarding our expected future revenue, expenses, and future cash flows, discount rates, market multiples, the selection of comparable companies, and the probability of possible future events. Changes in any or all of these estimates and assumptions or the relationships between those assumptions impact our valuations as of each valuation date and may have a material impact on the valuation of our common stock.
paras.zh: 应用这些方法涉及使用复杂且主观的估计、判断和假设，例如有关我们预期未来收入、费用和未来现金流量、折现率、市场倍数、可比公司的选择以及可能发生的未来事件概率的估计、判断和假设。任何或所有这些估计和假设的变化或这些假设之间关系的变化，都会影响我们在各估值日的估值，并可能对我们的普通股估值产生重大影响。

paras.en: Following this offering, it will not be necessary to determine the fair value of our common stock, as the shares of our common stock will be traded in the public market.
paras.zh: 本次发行之后，将无需确定我们普通股的公允价值，因为我们的普通股股份将在公开市场交易。

paras.en: #### Fair Value of Convertible Notes, Derivative Liabilities, and SAFEs
paras.zh: #### 可转换本票、衍生负债和 SAFE 的公允价值

paras.en: We elected to account for our convertible notes at fair value pursuant to Accounting Standards Codification (“ASC”) Topic 825, Financial Instruments. The convertible notes are recognized at their estimated fair value on our consolidated balance sheet, and changes in fair value are recorded in change in fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs in our consolidated statement of operations. We elected the fair value option to eliminate the accounting complexity that would otherwise result from separately accounting for the liability and equity components of the convertible notes under the traditional bifurcation model.
paras.zh: 我们选择根据会计准则汇编（“ASC”）第 825 号主题《金融工具》以公允价值计量我们的可转换本票。可转换本票按其在合并资产负债表上的估计公允价值确认，公允价值变动计入合并经营报表中的可转换本票、衍生负债和 SAFE 公允价值变动。我们选择公允价值选项，以消除原本因在传统分拆模型下单独核算可转换本票的负债和权益组成部分而产生的会计复杂性。

paras.en: In connection with the 2023 and 2024 note purchase agreements with both Amazon and Google, we recognized derivative liabilities representing obligations to issue future convertible notes pursuant to the terms of those agreements. The derivative liabilities were measured at estimated fair value, with changes in fair value recorded in change in fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs in the consolidated statement of operations.
paras.zh: 就与 Amazon 和 Google 签订的 2023 年和 2024 年票据购买协议而言，我们确认了衍生负债，代表根据该等协议条款发行未来可转换本票的义务。衍生负债按估计公允价值计量，公允价值变动计入合并经营报表中的可转换本票、衍生负债和 SAFE 公允价值变动。

paras.en: The estimated fair value of the convertible promissory notes is determined using a hybrid approach comprising a CCA and a CSE method. The analysis estimates the fair value of the convertible promissory notes using a scenario-based analysis that considers the probability-weighted present value of the instruments across the range of possible outcomes available to the note holders, including conversion into redeemable convertible preferred stock, Class N common stock, cash repayment at maturity, and cash settlement at a premium upon a change of control. The scenarios included consider the probability-weighted value of the instruments in the CCA and CSE framework.
paras.zh: 可转换本票的估计公允价值采用由 CCA 与 CSE 方法构成的混合方法确定。该分析采用情景分析法估计可转换本票的公允价值，考虑该等工具在票据持有人可获得的各类可能结果下的概率加权现值，包括转换为可赎回可转换优先股、N 类普通股、到期现金偿还，以及控制权变更时按溢价现金结算。所纳入的情景考虑了该等工具在 CCA 与 CSE 框架下的概率加权价值。

paras.en: The application of this methodology involves the use of complex and subjective estimates, judgments, and assumptions, including the probability and timing of each settlement scenario such as a qualified equity financing, initial public offering, direct listing, or change of control; the estimated fair value of our equity securities into which the notes may convert; the applicable conversion prices, which vary by note series and are contingent on factors such as elapsed time since issuance and contractual caps and percentage discounts; and the ownership thresholds and rollover provisions that determine the extent to which principal balances convert into equity versus being reissued as rollover notes. In particular, the ownership cap and rollover mechanism— whereby conversion is capped at specified ownership thresholds and any unconverted principal balance is re-issued as a non-interest bearing rollover note that remains subject to fair value measurement—requires significant judgment in estimating what proportion of each note financing will convert versus roll over, because this determination depends on the size and structure of future equity financings that are inherently uncertain. Changes in any or all of these estimates and assumptions, or the relationships between those assumptions, impact our valuations as of each measurement date and may have a material impact on the amounts recognized in our consolidated statement of operations.
paras.zh: 该方法的应用涉及使用复杂且主观的估计、判断和假设，包括各结算情景（如合格股权融资、首次公开发行、直接上市或控制权变更）的概率和时点；票据可能转换成的我方权益证券的估计公允价值；适用的转换价格（该价格因票据系列而异，并取决于自发行起经过的时间以及合同上限和百分比折扣等因素）；以及决定本金余额在多大程度上转换为股权而非作为展期票据重新发行的所有权门槛和展期条款。特别是，所有权上限和展期机制——即转换以特定所有权门槛为上限，任何未转换的本金余额将作为无息展期票据重新发行并继续按公允价值计量——在估计每笔票据融资中将有多少比例转换、多少比例展期时需要重大判断，因为该确定取决于本质上不确定的未来股权融资的规模和结构。上述任何或全部估计和假设的变化，或这些假设之间关系的变化，都会影响我们在每个计量日的估值，并可能对我们合并经营报表中确认的金额产生重大影响。

paras.en: The fair value option election described above also applied to the SAFEs that we issued during the year ended December 31, 2023. The SAFEs were measured at estimated fair value using the same scenario-based framework, with the monetary settlement amount fixed at inception and the number of equity shares received upon conversion being variable; consistent with the convertible notes, changes in fair value were recorded in change in fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs in the consolidated statement of operations. All SAFEs were converted into redeemable convertible preferred stock during the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, and no SAFEs remained outstanding as of December 31, 2024 or 2025. No SAFEs were outstanding at any point during the six months ended June 30, 2026. Accordingly, the primary ongoing estimation exposure under the fair value option relates to the convertible notes and rollover notes described above.
paras.zh: 上述公允价值选择权也适用于我们在截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度内发行的 SAFE。SAFE 采用相同的基于情景的框架按估计公允价值计量，其中货币结算金额在初始确认时固定，而转换时获得的股权股份数量可变；与可转换票据一致，公允价值变动计入合并经营报表中的可转换票据、衍生负债和 SAFE 公允价值变动。所有 SAFE 均已在截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度内转换为可赎回可转换优先股，截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日或 2025 年 12 月 31 日，无 SAFE 尚未清偿。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六个月内的任何时点，均无 SAFE 尚未清偿。因此，公允价值选择权下持续存在的主要估计风险涉及上述可转换票据和展期票据。

paras.en: For additional information regarding our convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs, including descriptions of the individual instruments, their key terms, conversion activity, and balances during the periods presented, see Note 9 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus.
paras.zh: 有关我们的可转换票据、衍生负债和未来股权简单协议（SAFE）的更多信息，包括各项工具的说明、其关键条款、转换活动以及所列期间的余额，请参见本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表的附注 9。

paras.en: #### Leases

We lease facilities and equipment, including compute and infrastructure capacity, under operating and finance leases. We determine whether an arrangement is or contains a lease at inception and evaluate the classification of our leases at lease commencement and, as necessary, upon modification. Accounting for leases requires significant judgment, including determining whether an arrangement is or contains a lease, and significant estimates, including the expected lease term, the fair value of the leased property, and our incremental borrowing rate.
paras.zh: 我们通过经营租赁和融资租赁租赁设施和设备，包括算力和基础设施容量。我们在租赁开始时确定一项安排是否为租赁或是否包含租赁，并在租赁开始日评估租赁的分类，必要时在租赁修改时进行评估。租赁会计处理需要重大判断，包括确定一项安排是否为租赁或是否包含租赁，以及重大估计，包括预期租赁期限、租赁财产的公允价值和我们增量借款利率。

paras.en: Given the size and duration of our lease portfolio, changes in our estimate of the fair value of the underlying leased asset, the expected lease term, or the determination of our incremental borrowing rate could result in a different lease classification or a materially different measurement of our right-of-use assets and lease liabilities.
paras.zh: 鉴于我们租赁组合的规模和期限，我们对 underlying 租赁资产公允价值的估计、预期租赁期限或增量借款利率确定的变化，可能导致不同的租赁分类，或对我们使用权资产和租赁负债的计量产生重大不同的结果。

paras.en: #### Income Taxes
paras.zh: #### 所得税

paras.en: We account for income taxes using the asset and liability method, recognizing deferred tax assets and liabilities for temporary differences between the financial reporting and tax bases of assets and liabilities, as well as for net operating loss and credit carryforwards, measured at enacted tax rates applicable in the years of expected reversals. We establish valuation allowances when necessary to reduce deferred tax assets to amounts more-likely-than-not expected to be realized, based on the weighting of positive and negative evidence.
paras.zh: 我们采用资产和负债法核算所得税，就资产和负债的财务报告基础与计税基础之间的暂时性差异，以及净经营亏损和税收抵免结转，确认递延所得税资产和负债，按预期转回年度适用的已颁布税率计量。我们在必要时设立估值备抵，根据正面和负面证据的权重，将递延所得税资产减至更可能实现（more-likely-than-not）的金额。

paras.en: Assessing the realizability of our deferred tax assets is an area of significant management judgment. We evaluate our deferred tax assets for recoverability based on historical taxable income, projected future taxable income, reversal patterns of existing temporary differences, and available tax planning strategies. As an AI company operating in a rapidly evolving market with significant ongoing investment in compute and infrastructure, our projections of future taxable income are inherently uncertain. Should our assessment of the recoverability of deferred tax assets change, our income tax provision would be adjusted in that period, which could materially impact our results of operations.
paras.zh: 评估我们递延所得税资产的可实现性属于管理层重大判断的领域。我们根据历史应税收入、预计未来应税收入、现有暂时性差异的转回模式以及可用的税务筹划策略，评估递延所得税资产的可回收性。作为一家在快速演变的市场中运营、并对算力和基础设施持续进行重大投资的 AI 公司，我们对未来应税收入的预测本质上具有不确定性。如果我们对递延所得税资产可回收性的评估发生变化，我们的所得税费用将在该期间进行调整，这可能对我们的经营业绩产生重大影响。

paras.en: We account for uncertain tax positions in accordance with ASC Topic 740, Income Taxes. Tax benefits from uncertain positions are recognized when it is more likely than not that the position will be sustained on examination based on its technical merits, measured at the amount that is more likely than not to be realized upon settlement. These assessments require judgment, particularly with respect to the qualification and documentation of research and development tax credits, where supporting evidence may be subject to differing interpretations. The actual outcome of these matters may differ materially from our current estimates. We recognize interest and penalties related to unrecognized tax benefits within our provision for income taxes.
paras.zh: 我们按照 ASC 第 740 号主题《所得税》对不确定税务状况进行会计处理。当某项不确定税务状况基于其技术依据在税务检查中更可能维持时，我们确认该状况产生的税收利益，并按结算时更可能实现的金额计量。这些评估需要判断，尤其是在研发税收抵免的资格认定和文档记录方面，相关支持性证据可能存在不同解释。这些事项的实际结果可能与我们的当前估计存在重大差异。我们在所得税准备中确认与未确认税收利益相关的利息和罚款。

paras.en: #### Loss Contingencies
paras.zh: #### 或有损失

paras.en: We are involved in legal claims, proceedings, and other regulatory and administrative matters that arise in the ordinary course of business, certain of which may include speculative claims for substantial or indeterminate amounts of damages.
paras.zh: 我们在日常业务过程中涉及法律索赔、诉讼程序以及其他监管和行政事项，其中某些事项可能包含金额重大或不确定的投机性损害赔偿请求。

paras.en: We routinely assess each significant matter and its potential financial exposure.
