We record a liability when we believe it is both probable that a loss has been incurred and the amount can be reasonably estimated, and we disclose matters for which a loss is reasonably possible and the loss or range of loss can be estimated. These assessments require significant judgment in determining both the likelihood and estimated amount of potential losses. We base our accruals on the best information available at the time, taking into account the specific facts and circumstances of each matter, the merits of our defenses, and the impact of negotiations, settlements, regulatory proceedings, rulings, and advice of legal counsel. Our estimates are subject to change as additional information becomes available and as matters develop, and we have in prior periods revised our assessments based on updated information.
paras.zh: 我们定期评估每项重大事项及其潜在财务风险。当我们认为很可能已发生损失且金额能够合理估计时，我们确认负债；对于损失合理可能发生且损失或损失区间能够估计的事项，我们予以披露。这些评估在确定潜在损失的可能性和估计金额时都需要重大判断。我们的计提基于当时可获得的最佳信息，并考虑每项事项的具体事实和情况、我们抗辩的合理性，以及谈判、和解、监管程序、裁决和法律顾问意见的影响。随着获得更多信息和事项发展，我们的估计可能发生变化，且我们在以往期间曾根据更新后的信息修订评估。

paras.en: See Note 1 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus for a description of recently adopted accounting pronouncements and recently issued accounting pronouncements not yet adopted.
paras.zh: 有关近期已采用的会计公告及近期已发布但尚未采用的会计公告的说明，请参见本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表附注 1。

paras.en: For the first time in history, intelligence is something humans can build. The cognitive capability to reason, analyze, synthesize, decide, and create is producible at scale and accessible on demand. We believe this abundance of AI will rapidly transform every sector of the global economy in ways greater than the impact of industrialization, electricity, semiconductors, and the internet. AI that truly delivers on its potential—with the risks well managed—could significantly accelerate global growth and dramatically improve quality of life for people around the world.
paras.zh: 历史上第一次，智能成为人类可以构建的东西。推理、分析、综合、决策和创造的认知能力可以规模化生产并按需获取。我们相信，这种 AI 的充裕将迅速改变全球经济的每一个领域，其影响将超过工业化、电力、半导体和互联网。真正兑现其潜力、且风险得到妥善管理的 AI，可能显著加速全球增长，并大幅改善世界各地人们的生活质量。

paras.en: Anthropic was founded in 2021 by a team of researchers responsible for many of the breakthroughs that define AI. We are first and foremost a research lab—our mission is the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity. This mission directs our focus—along with our talent and culture, our frontier and safety research, our approach to compute, and our enterprise strategy, it is one of the core advantages that set us apart. These advantages enable us to continuously advance frontier AI and shape the standards for its safe and responsible development. Our frontier AI, Claude, is delivered to customers through our models, platform, and applications. Claude has experienced the fastest enterprise adoption of any technology in history, as demonstrated by revenue growing from $0 at commercial launch in the first quarter of 2023 to [__] $for the three months ended September 30, 2026. This rapid and growing adoption generates two self-reinforcing dynamics—an improvement loop that advances Claude and an investment loop that helps fund our continued research in frontier AI.
paras.zh: Anthropic 成立于 2021 年，由一支研究人员团队创立，他们主导了定义 AI 的诸多突破。我们首先是一家研究实验室——我们的使命是负责任地开发和维护先进 AI，以造福人类的长期利益。这一使命指引着我们的重心——连同我们的人才与文化、我们的前沿与安全研究、我们的算力策略以及我们的企业战略，它是使我们与众不同的核心优势之一。这些优势使我们能够持续推进前沿 AI，并塑造其安全、负责任开发的标准。我们的前沿 AI——Claude，通过我们的模型、平台和应用程序交付给客户。Claude 经历了史上任何技术中最快的企业采用速度，其体现是收入从 2023 年第一季度商业发布时的 $0 增长至截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止三个月的 [__] $。这种快速且不断增长的采用产生了两个自我强化的动态——推动 Claude 进步的改进闭环，以及帮助为我们持续的前沿 AI 研究提供资金的投资闭环。

paras.en: We believe the diffusion of AI through the global economy represents one of the largest opportunities in history to improve how humans live and work, and this process is just beginning. In our view, the world has only begun to use the capabilities of today’s frontier models, and the gap between what Claude can do and how broadly it is used represents one of our largest growth opportunities, alongside continued advances at the frontier. Claude’s capabilities have evolved significantly in recent years, and we expect they will continue advancing rapidly. This will lead not only to an expanding addressable market, but also to an expanding scope of impact on the world. We aim to ensure that impact is as positive as possible.
paras.zh: 我们相信，AI 在全球经济中的扩散代表着历史上改善人类生活与工作方式的重大机遇之一，而这一进程才刚刚开始。我们认为，世界才刚刚开始使用当今前沿模型的能力，Claude 能做什么与其被使用的广泛程度之间的差距，是我们最大的增长机遇之一，同时前沿领域的持续进步也是如此。近年来，Claude 的能力已显著演进，我们预计其将继续快速进步。这不仅将带来可寻址市场的扩大，也将带来对世界影响范围的扩大。我们致力于确保这一影响尽可能积极。

paras.en: #### Our Core Advantages
paras.zh: #### 我们的核心优势

paras.en: Mission & Focus. All of our efforts are guided by a singular focus on our mission. This focus enables us to concentrate talent, research, and compute investment on the highest-value work for humanity and to avoid conflicting priorities. Achieving our mission means the world gains the enormous benefits of frontier AI while mitigating the most significant risks, and we believe this requires safety and capability to advance together.
paras.zh: 使命与专注。我们所有的努力都以对使命的单一专注为指引。这种专注使我们能够将人才、研究和算力投资集中于对人类社会最有价值的工作，并避免相互冲突的优先事项。实现我们的使命意味着世界在获得前沿 AI 巨大益处的同时降低最重大的风险，我们认为这需要安全与能力同步推进。

paras.en: Talent & Culture. Our mission and focus enable us to attract and retain world-class talent, including researchers and engineers who want their work to shape a better future. We also have a culture that promotes a low-ego, truth-seeking environment, where frontier AI capability and safety are mutually reinforcing. We believe our culture has driven our talent density as we have scaled.
paras.zh: 人才与文化。我们的使命与专注使我们能够吸引并留住世界级人才，包括那些希望以自身工作塑造更美好未来的研究人员和工程师。我们还拥有一种倡导低调务实、追求真理的文化，在前沿 AI 能力与安全之间形成相互促进。我们相信，随着公司规模扩大，我们的文化推动了人才密度的提升。

paras.en: Frontier & Safety Research. We believe that sustained, focused research at the frontier of intelligence is required to build the most capable and safest AI systems. Our frontier capabilities and safety research are deeply integrated and directly shape model design, training, and deployment, helping us produce systems that are more reliable, steerable, and well-suited for real-world deployment, particularly in demanding enterprise environments. We translate our research leadership into innovation velocity, and have consistently released better models, platform capabilities, and applications. Each version of a Claude model assists in building the next, helping to compress development timelines and produce compounding improvements in the speed at which we innovate. We refer to this recursive dynamic as “closing the loop,” and we believe it is one of the most significant structural advantages in frontier AI and can greatly accelerate the rate at which capabilities advance. We believe that model capabilities must be advanced together with safety, alignment, and security practices, particularly as the speed of AI development accelerates. We assess the risks of each model during development and before and after release, and take the steps we believe are appropriate to balance model capabilities with safety, alignment, and security, even where doing so may moderate the rate at which we release new capabilities. We view decisions of this kind as deliberate tradeoffs that we make because they serve the Company Purpose, the long-term interests of our mission, and our customers’ demand for safe and aligned models.
paras.zh: 前沿与安全研究。我们相信，要在智能前沿实现持续、专注的研究，才能构建能力最强且最安全的 AI 系统。我们的前沿能力研究与安全研究深度整合，并直接塑造模型设计、训练与部署，帮助我们打造更可靠、更可控、更适合真实世界部署的系统，尤其是在要求严苛的企业环境中。我们将研究领先优势转化为创新速度，并持续发布更优的模型、平台能力与应用。每一代 Claude 模型都协助构建下一代模型，帮助压缩开发周期，并在创新速度上产生复利式改进。我们将这一递归动态称为“闭环”，并相信它是前沿 AI 领域最重要的结构性优势之一，能够大幅加快能力提升的速度。我们相信，模型能力必须与安全、对齐和安全实践同步推进，尤其是在 AI 发展速度加快的背景下。我们在开发过程中以及发布前后评估每一模型的风险，并采取我们认为适当的措施，在模型能力与安全、对齐和安全之间取得平衡，即使这样做可能放缓我们发布新能力的节奏。我们将此类决策视为深思熟虑的取舍，因为这样做符合公司宗旨、我们使命的长期利益，以及客户对安全且对齐模型的需求。

paras.en: Our Approach to Compute. We manage compute as a single, fungible pool from multiple strategic partners, and we dynamically direct available compute between workloads based on where the marginal unit is expected to be most productive at any given time. We believe that this approach to compute enables us to deliver superior models, serve more customers, and achieve greater productivity from our compute investment. This compute efficiency creates the foundation for us to advance the frontier of AI capabilities through research and model development, meet growing demand from customers, and provide for internal usage of Claude. We have achieved this through our research breakthroughs and our multi-chip compute architecture across AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, and AMD GPUs, enabling us to orchestrate workloads to optimize for price and performance. To support our research, model development, customer demand, and internal usage of Claude, we continue to invest at scale. As of and subsequent to September 30, 2026, we have entered into purchase commitments and lease agreements, including short-term commitments, as well as leases not yet commenced, with an aggregate committed spend of more than $ [__] , substantially all of which is related to compute and infrastructure. These commitments include approximately $ [__] expected to be incurred before December 31, 2030, and substantially all of the remainder is expected to be incurred between 2031 and 2045. Approximately $ [__] of these commitments are due in the next 12 months. See the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Liquidity and Capital Resources—Contractual Obligations” for more information.
paras.zh: 我们的算力策略。我们将算力作为来自多个战略合作伙伴的单一可替代资源池进行管理，并根据任一给定时刻边际算力单位预期产出最高的方向，在工作负载之间动态调配可用算力。我们相信，这种算力策略使我们能够交付更卓越的模型、服务更多客户，并从算力投资中获得更高生产率。这种算力效率为我们奠定基础，使我们能够通过研究与模型开发推进 AI 能力的前沿、满足客户不断增长的需求，并支持 Claude 的内部使用。我们通过研究突破以及跨 AWS Trainium、Google TPU、NVIDIA GPU 和 AMD GPU 的多芯片算力架构实现了这一点，使我们能够编排工作负载以优化价格与性能。为支持我们的研究、模型开发、客户需求以及 Claude 的内部使用，我们持续进行大规模投资。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日及之后，我们已签订采购承诺和租赁协议，包括短期承诺以及尚未开始的租赁，合计承诺支出超过 $[__]，其中绝大部分与算力和基础设施相关。这些承诺包括预计在 2030 年 12 月 31 日之前发生的约 $[__]，其余绝大部分预计将在 2031 年至 2045 年之间发生。这些承诺中约 $[__] 将在未来 12 个月内到期。更多信息请参见“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——流动性与资本资源——合同义务”一节。

paras.en: Enterprise Strategy. Our enterprise strategy is built on the belief that frontier AI is most valuable in real-world settings, as deployment across enterprises is where economic impact is greatest and where the improvement loops from customer feedback are richest. Accordingly, we have organized our research priorities, our product roadmap, and our go-to-market and Applied AI teams around enterprise use cases, which range from routine knowledge work to the most complex problems. The customer feedback we gather directs our research focus and makes Claude more capable over time. This broadens where Claude can be deployed and further expands enterprise adoption, which helps ensure that the benefits of our AI reach people and organizations at scale.
paras.zh: 企业战略。我们的企业战略建立在这样一种信念之上：前沿 AI 在真实世界场景中最具价值，因为企业级部署带来的经济影响最大，且来自客户反馈的改进闭环也最为丰富。因此，我们围绕企业用例来组织研究优先级、产品路线图以及市场推广和应用 AI 团队，这些用例涵盖从日常知识工作到最复杂的问题。我们收集的客户反馈指引我们的研究重点，并使 Claude 随时间推移能力更强。这拓宽了 Claude 的部署范围，并进一步扩大企业采用，有助于确保我们的 AI 惠及大规模的人群和组织。

paras.en: #### Enterprise Adoption of Claude
paras.zh: #### Claude 的企业采用

paras.en: The speed and depth of our enterprise customer adoption are powerful evidence of Claude’s position at the frontier of AI. Our customer base as of September 30, 2026 includes:
paras.zh: 我们的企业客户采用速度和深度有力地证明了 Claude 在 AI 前沿的地位。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们的客户群包括：

paras.en: - More than 11,900customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis;
paras.zh: - 超过 11,900 家客户在过去十二个月（TTM）基础上贡献收入达 $100,000 或以上；

paras.en: - More than 1,900 customers with $1 million or more of revenue on a TTM basis; and
paras.zh: - 超过 1,900 家客户在过去十二个月（TTM）基础上贡献收入达 $1 million 或以上；以及

paras.en: - Approximately 250 customers with $10 million or more of revenue on a TTM basis.
paras.zh: - 约 250 家客户在过去十二个月（TTM）基础上贡献收入达 $10 million 或以上。

paras.en: Unlike a static product that serves a single use case, Claude is frontier AI with rapidly advancing capabilities. We build at three layers of the stack: the models themselves, the platform for building on those models, and the applications that place Claude directly in the hands of our users. An advance at any layer compounds across all three layers, accelerating the pace at which we can deliver more capable intelligence. We believe the value of this integrated approach is reflected in the increasing number of customers that use both Claude Platform and our first-party applications. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, over 50% of our customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis used Claude Platform and at least one of our first-party applications, up from approximately 30% for the three months ended December 31, 2025.
paras.zh: 与仅服务于单一用例的静态产品不同，Claude 是能力快速提升的前沿 AI。我们在技术栈的三个层面进行构建：模型本身、基于这些模型进行构建的平台，以及将 Claude 直接交到用户手中的应用。任一层面的进步都会在全部三个层面产生复合效应，加快我们交付更强智能的速度。我们相信，这种一体化方法的价值体现在越来越多的客户同时使用 Claude Platform 和我们的第一方应用。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的三个月，在我们过去十二个月（TTM）收入达到 $100,000 或以上的客户中，超过 50% 同时使用了 Claude Platform 和至少一款我们的第一方应用，而截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三个月这一比例约为 30%。

paras.en: Today, enterprises rely on Claude to reason, plan, and execute across complex workflows with a level of trustworthiness and judgment that we believe was not previously available from earlier generations of AI. Customers realize value from Claude in three primary ways: more productive employees, faster processes, and embedded intelligence in their products. As Claude’s capabilities grow, our customers benefit and often broaden their adoption of Claude in new workflows. This expanding role reflects a broader shift in how Claude is used inside the enterprise, from a tool that responds to discrete prompts to what we call a Virtual Collaborator: an AI system that works alongside humans to perform complex, multi-step work at professional levels.
paras.zh: 如今，企业依赖 Claude 在复杂工作流中进行推理、规划和执行，其可信度和判断力我们认为是以往几代 AI 所不具备的。客户主要通过三种方式从 Claude 中获得价值：更高生产力的员工、更快的流程，以及嵌入其产品中的智能。随着 Claude 能力的增长，我们的客户从中受益，并往往在更多新工作流中扩大对 Claude 的采用。这种不断扩大的角色反映了 Claude 在企业内部使用方式的更广泛转变：从响应离散提示的工具，转变为我们所称的虚拟协作者（Virtual Collaborator）——一种与人类并肩工作、以专业水平执行复杂多步骤工作的 AI 系统。

paras.en: We drive the diffusion of Claude primarily by making it accessible across multiple product surfaces. For example:
paras.zh: 我们主要通过让 Claude 在多个产品界面上可用，来推动 Claude 的普及。例如：

paras.en: - Claude Platform, our comprehensive agentic development environment, provides customers with direct access to the primitives to build, deploy, and scale their own applications that leverage Claude’s capabilities within their own products and workflows.
paras.zh: - Claude Platform，我们全面的智能体开发环境，为客户提供对基础组件的直接访问，使其能够构建、部署和扩展自身应用，并在其自有产品和工作中利用 Claude 的能力。

paras.en: - Claude Code, our coding agent, works alongside human software developers on end-to-end software development: writing, planning, editing, testing, debugging, and committing code across production-scale codebases.
paras.zh: - Claude Code，我们的编程智能体，与人类软件开发者并肩完成端到端软件开发：在生产级代码库中编写、规划、编辑、测试、调试和提交代码。

paras.en: - Claude Cowork, our knowledge work agent, has computer use capability that enables it to work with professionals on end-to-end business tasks: autonomously researching, drafting, analyzing, synthesizing, and executing other knowledge work.
paras.zh: - Claude Cowork，我们的知识工作智能体，具备计算机使用能力，使其能够与专业人士共同完成端到端业务任务：自主研究、起草、分析、综合并执行其他知识工作。

paras.en: Much of the diffusion of Claude has been organic. We amplify this with our go-to-market and Applied AI teams, which extend our reach by meeting customers where they are through distribution partnerships that place Claude inside customers’ existing technology stacks. For example, Claude is accessible on all three major cloud platforms—AWS, GCP, and Azure. We have a joint go-to-market approach with these CSPs through which we establish direct contractual relationships with our customers while paying a fee to each CSP. This structure allows us to foster stronger commercial alignment with these CSPs, avoid channel conflict, set pricing, and realize the financial benefits of ongoing compute efficiency improvements. Ecosystem partnerships also expand our reach, allowing customers to adopt Claude through SIs, such as Accenture, Deloitte, KPMG, and PwC, consultants, and data platforms, such as Salesforce and Snowflake. We recently launched Ode with Anthropic, an AI services company, in partnership with leading private equity firms to bring Claude’s capabilities to mid-sized companies across sectors, building solutions on the Claude Platform and supporting customers over the long term.
paras.zh: Claude 的传播在很大程度上是自然发生的。我们通过市场推广团队和应用 AI 团队来放大这一效应，这些团队通过分销合作伙伴关系将 Claude 嵌入客户现有的技术栈中，在客户所在之处与其对接，从而扩大我们的覆盖范围。例如，Claude 可在三大云平台——AWS、GCP 和 Azure——上使用。我们与这些云服务商（CSP）采取联合市场推广方式，通过该方式与客户建立直接的合同关系，同时向每家 CSP 支付费用。这一结构使我们能够与这些 CSP 建立更强的商业协同，避免渠道冲突，设定定价，并实现算力效率持续提升所带来的财务收益。生态合作伙伴关系也扩大了我们的覆盖范围，使客户能够通过埃森哲、德勤、毕马威和普华永道等系统集成商（SI）、顾问以及 Salesforce 和 Snowflake 等数据平台采用 Claude。我们近期与领先的私募股权公司合作，推出了 AI 服务公司 Ode with Anthropic，将 Claude 的能力带给各行业的中型企业，在 Claude 平台上构建解决方案并长期支持客户。

paras.en: #### Strengths of O ur Financial Model
paras.zh: #### 我们财务模式的优势

paras.en: Building and scaling frontier AI is one of the most important and capital-intensive endeavors in history. Our financial model provides us with the following strengths that allow us to build and scale efficiently:
paras.zh: 构建并扩展前沿 AI 是历史上最重要、资本最密集的事业之一。我们的财务模式为我们提供了以下优势，使我们能够高效地构建和扩展：

paras.en: - Rapid Revenue Growth. Our enterprise strategy is designed to drive durable customer adoption by embedding Claude directly into business-critical workflows and enabling the development of products built on Claude. We believe that enterprise customers achieve a compelling return on investment from Claude, as agentic workflows can drive both top-line growth and efficiency. This enables us to expand quickly with customers, as demonstrated by our Net Revenue Retention of approximately 900% as of September 30, 2026.
paras.zh: - 收入快速增长。我们的企业战略旨在通过将 Claude 直接嵌入业务关键型工作流程，并支持基于 Claude 开发产品，推动客户持久采用。我们相信，企业客户能从 Claude 获得可观的投资回报，因为智能体工作流程既能推动收入增长，又能提升效率。这使我们能够快速扩大客户规模，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们的净收入留存率约为 900%，即体现了这一点。

paras.en: - Compute Efficiency. Our compute efficiency drives more intelligence from research and model development, and we believe this approach can support more customer and internal usage of Claude for the same amount of compute compared to other approaches. Our compute efficiency is demonstrated by revenue that grew [__] 1,368% year over year for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to compute and infrastructure expenses that grew [__] 300% during the same period.
paras.zh: - 算力效率。我们的算力效率使研究和模型开发能够产出更多智能，我们相信，与其他方式相比，这一方式能够在相同算力下支持更多客户和内部对 Claude 的使用。我们的算力效率体现在：截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止三个月，收入同比增长 [__] 1,368%，而同期算力和基础设施费用增长 [__] 300%。

paras.en: - Operating Efficiency. Our operating efficiency, derived from our high talent density, our efficient go-to-market, and how extensively our teams leverage Claude in their work, enables us to scale with a smaller team relative to other large enterprise technology companies. Our operating efficiency is demonstrated by TTM revenue per employee of over $6.6 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to $1.4 million as of September 30, 2025.
paras.zh: - 运营效率。我们的运营效率源自高人才密度、高效的市场推广方式，以及我们团队在工作中广泛使用 Claude，这使我们能够以相对于其他大型企业科技公司更小的团队实现规模化。我们的运营效率体现在：截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，过去十二个月（TTM）人均收入超过 $6.6 million，而截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日为 $1.4 million。

paras.en: Our financial results reflect continued growth alongside ongoing investment in frontier AI as demonstrated below:
paras.zh: 我们的财务业绩反映了持续增长以及对前沿 AI 的持续投入，如下所示：

paras.en: - Our revenue was $11.6 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2026, up from $787 million for the three months ended June 30, 2025.
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止三个月，我们的收入为 $11.6 billion，高于截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日止三个月的 $787 million。

paras.en: - Our operating margin was [__] 8% and operating income was $1.0 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2026, compared to an operating margin of [__] (152)% and operating loss of $1.2 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2025.
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止三个月，我们的经营利润率为 [__] 8%，经营利润为 $1.0 billion，而截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日止三个月的经营利润率为 [__] (152)%，经营亏损为 $1.2 billion。

paras.en: - The combination of our revenue growth, compute efficiency, and operating efficiency has resulted in an Adjusted Operating Margin of [__] 19% and Adjusted Operating Income of $2.2 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to an Adjusted Operating Margin of [__] (129)% and Adjusted Operating Loss of $1.0 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2025.
paras.zh: - 我们的收入增长、算力效率和经营效率相结合，使截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止三个月的调整后经营利润率达到 [__] 19%，调整后经营利润为 $2.2 billion，而截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日止三个月的调整后经营利润率为 [__] (129)%，调整后经营亏损为 $1.0 billion。

paras.en: The demonstrated growth, scale, and efficiency of our financial model help us to continue making significant long-term investments to build frontier AI responsibly. Our business trajectory and financial profile have enabled us to access capital and secure compute from investors and partners. As of June 30, 2026, we had raised an aggregate of $141.1 billion of capital and had cash and cash equivalents of $112.4 billion and short-term investments of $19.3 billion [__] . [__] Long-term investments come with risks, as we must predict compute needs multiple years into the future. However, we believe our compute efficiency positions us to amplify returns if demand is greater than our forecast and can provide financial resilience if demand is lower or arrives later than we anticipate.
paras.zh: 我们财务模型所展现的增长、规模和效率，帮助我们继续做出重大的长期投资，以负责任的方式构建前沿 AI。我们的业务发展轨迹和财务概况使我们能够从投资者和合作伙伴处获取资本和算力。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，我们已累计筹集 $141.1 billion 的资本，并拥有 $112.4 billion 的现金及现金等价物和 $19.3 billion 的短期投资 [__] 。[__] 长期投资伴随风险，因为我们必须预测未来数年的算力需求。然而，我们相信，我们的算力效率使我们在需求高于预期时能够放大回报，并在需求低于预期或晚于预期到来时提供财务韧性。

paras.en: #### Our Self-Reinforcing Loops
paras.zh: #### 我们的自我强化循环

paras.en: Our scale and growth create self-reinforcing loops that make Claude better over time and that we believe create durable competitive advantages.
paras.zh: 我们的规模和增长创造了自我强化循环，使 Claude 随时间推移不断变得更好，我们相信这创造了持久的竞争优势。

paras.en: - Improvement Loop. Enterprise deployments of Claude deepen our understanding of the hard problems, edge cases, and domain-specific challenges that matter most to our customers. We improve our models, platform, and applications based on feedback from customers using our offerings in production across their businesses. These improvements result in wider deployments and adoption that fuel the next cycle of improvement.
paras.zh: - 改进循环。Claude 的企业部署加深了我们对客户最为关注的难题、边缘情形和特定领域挑战的理解。我们根据客户在其业务中生产使用我们产品所反馈的意见，改进我们的模型、平台和应用。这些改进带来更广泛的部署和采用，从而推动下一轮改进。

paras.en: - Investment Loop. Revenue from expanding enterprise adoption helps us to fund the compute, research, and talent needed to improve Claude. Claude’s advancing capabilities expand the range of tasks and workflows customers use Claude for, broadening our addressable market and driving deeper deployment, additional revenue, and continued reinvestment in Claude.
paras.zh: - 投资循环。企业采用不断扩大所带来的收入，帮助我们为改进 Claude 所需的算力、研究和人才提供资金。Claude 不断提升的能力扩大了客户使用 Claude 的任务和工作流程范围，拓宽了我们的可服务市场，并推动更深入的部署、额外的收入以及对 Claude 的持续再投资。

paras.en: #### Claude is Accelerating Our Ability to Close the Loop
paras.zh: #### Claude 正在加速我们实现闭环的能力

paras.en: Claude itself has become one of the most powerful drivers of our progress—each new version of a Claude model directly accelerates development of the next. Many aspects of the research, training, and testing of subsequent model generations now involve Claude, including running experiments, generating and processing training data, automating evaluations and safety audits, and writing and reviewing code. We refer to this recursive dynamic as “closing the loop.” A direct expression of this dynamic is our accelerating pace of producing compute multipliers. More capable models help our researchers discover these improvements faster; in turn, more powerful compute multipliers enable us to train even more capable models and deploy them more efficiently.
paras.zh: Claude 本身已成为我们进步的最强大驱动力之一——每一个新版本的 Claude 模型都直接加速下一代模型的开发。后续几代模型的研究、训练和测试的许多环节现在都涉及 Claude，包括运行实验、生成和处理训练数据、自动化评估和安全审计，以及编写和审查代码。我们将这种递归动态称为“闭环”。这种动态的一个直接体现，就是我们产出算力乘数的速度不断加快。能力更强的模型帮助我们的研究人员更快地发现这些改进；反过来，更强大的算力乘数使我们能够训练能力更强的模型，并更高效地部署它们。

paras.en: A clear example of our ability to close the loop is the deployment of Claude Code, our agentic coding product, across our engineering organization. As our models have advanced, we have seen significant improvement in Claude’s capability on more challenging, open-ended engineering problems that lack a clear specification and have historically depended on experienced human judgment. Claude’s success rate on these problems reached approximately 90% in September 2026, up approximately 50 percentage points in nine months, based on our internal benchmarks. Claude Code has progressed from suggesting code to writing and running it directly and working autonomously over long time horizons on complex, multi-step engineering tasks. This has enabled our engineers to increasingly direct and review its work rather than write code line by line. As a result, the average daily volume of code contributed to our codebase per engineer in the three months ended September 30, 2026 was over 45 times the average daily volume in the year ended December 31, 2024. Over 90% of the contributions to our codebase in September 2026 were written by Claude [__] .
paras.zh: 我们能够实现闭环的一个清晰例证，是在我们的工程组织中部署 Claude Code——我们的智能体编程产品。随着我们的模型不断进步，我们看到 Claude 在应对更具挑战性、开放式且缺乏明确规格、历来依赖经验丰富的人类判断的工程问题上的能力显著提升。根据我们的内部基准测试，Claude 在这类问题上的成功率在 2026 年 9 月达到约 90%，九个月内提升了约 50 个百分点。Claude Code 已从建议代码，发展到直接编写并运行代码，并能在复杂、多步骤的工程任务上长时间自主工作。这使我们的工程师能够越来越多地指导和审阅其工作，而非逐行编写代码。因此，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的三个月内，每位工程师平均每日向我们的代码库贡献的代码量，是截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度平均每日贡献量的 45 倍以上。2026 年 9 月，我们代码库中超过 90% 的贡献由 Claude [__] 编写。

paras.en: The impact of Claude extends beyond research and engineering. From December 31, 2024 to September 30, 2026, our headcount grew over five times, while our revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was86times our revenue for the three months ended December 31, 2024 [__] .
paras.zh: Claude 的影响不仅限于研究和工程领域。从 2024 年 12 月 31 日到 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们的员工人数增长了五倍以上，而截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的三个月收入是截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日的三个月收入的 86 倍 [__] 。

paras.en: We believe this operating leverage has been driven by the use of Claude throughout our organization. Across our research, engineering, go-to-market, and operations teams, Claude allows employees to leverage a team of agents in their daily work, enabling a comparatively small team to take on work that would traditionally require a far larger one by multiplying the impact of each person.
paras.zh: 我们相信，这种经营杠杆得益于 Claude 在整个组织中的使用。在我们的研究、工程、市场推广和运营团队中，Claude 让员工能够在日常工作中借助一支智能体团队，使相对较小的团队能够承担传统上需要大得多的团队才能完成的工作，从而放大每个人的影响力。

paras.en: The expansion of our own use of Claude reflects this leverage directly. The value of our own internal Claude usage at list prices has grown by over 250 times from January 2026 to September 2026, and in April 2026, this monthly value first exceeded our monthly personnel expense, excluding stock-based compensation. Because each version of Claude is used to help build the next and because Claude makes our teams more productive across the company, we believe the compute we devote to internal usage compounds these gains, continuously accelerating our pace of development and further strengthening our leadership position.
paras.zh: 我们自身对 Claude 使用的扩展直接反映了这种杠杆效应。按标价计算，我们内部使用 Claude 的价值从 2026 年 1 月到 2026 年 9 月增长了 250 倍以上，并且在 2026 年 4 月，这一月度价值首次超过了我们的月度人员费用（不包括股权激励费用）。由于每一版 Claude 都被用于帮助构建下一版，并且 Claude 提升了公司各团队的生产力，我们相信我们投入内部使用的算力会复合放大这些收益，持续加快我们的开发步伐，并进一步巩固我们的领先地位。

paras.en: Using AI to help build more capable AI could also pose a considerable safety risk, particularly if it sharply accelerates the pace of progress. This is one of the areas covered by our Responsible Scaling Policy, which sets out our plans to monitor and mitigate the risks as we approach what has been termed “recursive self-improvement.”
paras.zh: 利用 AI 帮助构建能力更强的 AI 也可能带来相当大的安全风险，尤其是在它急剧加快进展速度的情况下。这是我们《负责任扩展政策》所涵盖的领域之一，该政策阐述了我们在接近所谓的“递归自我改进”时监测和缓解风险的计划。

paras.en: We believe that Powerful AI, a highly capable and impactful form of frontier AI characterized by the following key attributes, will become widely available within a few years:
paras.zh: 我们相信，强大 AI——一种具有以下关键特征、能力极强且影响深远的前沿 AI——将在几年内广泛可用：

paras.en: - cognitive capabilities matching or exceeding those of top human experts across most professional and scientific disciplines;
paras.zh: - 在大多数专业和科学学科领域，认知能力达到或超过顶尖人类专家；

paras.en: - the ability to navigate all interfaces available to a human working virtually, including text, audio, video, and direct computer control;
paras.zh: - 能够操作人类在虚拟工作中可用的所有界面，包括文本、音频、视频和直接控制计算机；

paras.en: - the ability to reason through complex tasks autonomously over extended periods—lasting hours, days, or weeks—and seek clarification and feedback when needed;
paras.zh: - 能够在较长时间内（持续数小时、数天或数周）自主推理复杂任务，并在需要时寻求澄清和反馈；

paras.en: - the ability to coordinate across multiple instances and collaborate with both humans and other AI systems; and
paras.zh: - 能够跨多个实例进行协调，并与人类及其他 AI 系统协作；以及

paras.en: - the ability to interface with the physical world by digitally controlling laboratory equipment, robotic systems, and other machines through digital connections.
paras.zh: - 能够通过数字连接以数字化方式控制实验室设备、机器人系统和其他机器，从而与物理世界交互。

paras.en: If Powerful AI is directed at solving humanity’s hardest problems and the risks are managed responsibly, the potential is extraordinary. The possibilities include compressing decades of scientific progress into years; accelerating drug discovery, disease detection, and the delivery of personalized therapy; providing individually tailored education and expert financial and legal advice; advancing power grids and battery design for greater efficiency and reliability; and extending to the developing world capabilities that took wealthy nations generations to build.
paras.zh: 如果强大 AI 被用于解决人类最艰难的问题，且相关风险得到负责任的管理，其潜力将是非凡的。这些可能性包括：将数十年的科学进步压缩到数年之内；加速药物发现、疾病检测和个性化治疗的交付；提供个性化教育和专家级财务与法律建议；推进电网和电池设计，以提高效率和可靠性；以及将富裕国家历经数代才建立起来的能力扩展到发展中国家。

paras.en: #### Scaling Laws and the Predictability of Progress
paras.zh: #### 规模定律与进步的可预测性

paras.en: The intelligence and capabilities of AI systems have advanced dramatically. Tasks that were beyond the reach of AI systems just a few years ago, such as complex mathematical reasoning, designing scientific experiments, and executing substantial portions of software development, are now routinely performed by AI.
paras.zh: AI 系统的智能和能力已取得巨大进步。就在几年前 AI 系统还无法企及的任务，例如复杂的数学推理、设计科学实验以及执行相当一部分软件开发工作，如今已由 AI 常规完成。

paras.en: These advances have followed empirical “Scaling Laws,” the finding that AI model performance improves predictably with increases in model size, training data, and compute. The foundational paper, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models, whose lead authors (including Dario Amodei, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish, and Tom Brown) later co-founded Anthropic, was critical in establishing these relationships and helped guide the wave of modern LLMs.
paras.zh: 这些进步遵循经验性的“规模定律”，即 AI 模型性能随模型规模、训练数据和算力的增加而可预测地提升。奠基性论文《神经语言模型的规模定律》（Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models）的第一作者（包括 Dario Amodei、Jared Kaplan、Sam McCandlish 和 Tom Brown）后来共同创立了 Anthropic，该论文对于确立这些关系至关重要，并帮助引领了现代 LLM 的浪潮。

paras.en: We expect AI capabilities—across language, reasoning, mathematics, coding, scientific analysis, and an expanding range of agentic tasks and knowledge work—to continue advancing for many years. As a result, we believe this will drive demand for AI that outstrips supply for the foreseeable future, limited principally by the availability of compute. We believe that the majority of this demand will be concentrated at the frontier: our experience has been that enterprises gravitate to our most capable models across a wide variety of workloads, including their highest-value work. In addition, we believe that each successive expansion of the frontier will unlock new categories of work that, in turn, will generate the majority of incremental industry demand. We expect the industry to continue increasing investment in compute, research talent, and engineering resources to advance the frontier of AI. Within this framework, research labs with proprietary training methods, strong data quality, and differentiated research talent are well-positioned to outpace what scale alone would predict.
paras.zh: 我们预计，AI 能力——涵盖语言、推理、数学、编程、科学分析以及不断扩展的智能体任务和知识工作——将在未来许多年持续进步。因此，我们认为这将推动 AI 需求在可预见的未来超过供给，而供给主要受限于算力的可获得性。我们相信，这一需求的大部分将集中在前沿：我们的经验是，企业在各类工作负载（包括其最高价值的工作）中都倾向于采用我们能力最强的模型。此外，我们认为，前沿的每一次 successive 扩展都将解锁新的工作类别，而这些新类别反过来将产生行业增量需求的大部分。我们预计行业将持续加大对算力、研究人才和工程资源的投入，以推进 AI 前沿。在这一框架下，拥有专有训练方法、高质量数据和差异化研究人才的研究实验室处于有利位置，能够超越仅凭规模所能预测的表现。

paras.en: 6 See the section titled “Industry, Market, and Other Data” for a description of how we calculate annual economic value attributable to knowledge workers globally.
paras.zh: 6 有关我们如何计算全球知识工作者年度经济价值的说明，请参见标题为“行业、市场及其他数据”的章节。

paras.en: 7 IDC, The Economic Impact of AI: 2026 Edition, doc # US54452226, April 2026. Reflects the annual value created across AI solutions and services, investments in the AI infrastructure supply chain, and enhancements in enterprise productivity and efficiency unlocked by AI.
paras.zh: 7 IDC，《AI 的经济影响：2026 年版》，文档编号 US54452226,2026 年 4 月。该报告反映了 AI 解决方案与服务所创造的年度价值、AI 基础设施供应链投资，以及 AI 所释放的企业生产力与效率提升。

paras.en: 8 IDC, Worldwide Black Book: Live Edition V2 2026 Forecast, July 2026.
paras.zh: 8 IDC，《全球黑皮书：实时版 V2 2026 预测》，2026 年 7 月。

paras.en: #### A Near-Term Opportunity to Transform Cognitive Work
paras.zh: #### 变革认知工作的近期机遇

paras.en: Frontier AI is transforming cognitive work—the application of knowledge, reasoning, and judgment to produce economic value. We believe it will make humans far more capable and expand the world’s overall capacity for that work, including accelerating scientific discovery and helping businesses grow. Knowledge workers are the leading edge of this opportunity. As frontier AI advances, more capable models can unlock entirely new use cases while also efficiently serving a wide range of cognitive work at scale across the capability-cost-speed curve. We believe the work that knowledge workers perform represented more than $40 trillion in economic value globally in 2025, [__] 6 and with frontier AI’s potential to make them meaningfully more productive, our near-term opportunity is to expand this value and accelerate economic growth. While it is still early to forecast frontier AI’s full impact across the economy, IDC estimates that investment in AI solutions and services will yield a cumulative global economic impact of $22.5 trillion by 2031 [__] . [__] 7 We believe the impact could be even greater.
paras.zh: 前沿 AI 正在变革认知工作——即运用知识、推理和判断来创造经济价值。我们相信，它将使人类能力大幅提升，并扩大全球从事此类工作的整体能力，包括加速科学发现和帮助企业成长。知识工作者是这一机遇的最前沿。随着前沿 AI 的进步，能力更强的模型可以解锁全新的用例，同时还能在能力—成本—速度曲线上高效地大规模服务广泛的认知工作。我们相信，2025 年知识工作者所从事的工作在全球代表了超过 $40 trillion 的经济价值，[__] 6 而借助前沿 AI 使其显著提高生产率的潜力，我们的近期机遇就是扩大这一价值并加速经济增长。尽管预测前沿 AI 对整个经济的全面影响还为时过早，但 IDC 估计，对 AI 解决方案和服务的投资到 2031 年将产生累计 $22.5 trillion 的全球经济效益 [__] 。[__] 7 我们相信，实际影响可能更大。

paras.en: History suggests that transformative technologies expand the markets they enter. For example, information technology spend grew from approximately $1.2 trillion in 2006 to $4.3 trillion in 2025, a CAGR of approximately 7%, as cloud computing spend grew from zero to $1.9 trillion over the same period and expanded information technology budgets. [__] 8 We have seen other technologies, including the personal computer, the internet, and the smartphone, grow their markets as well. The companies that built these technologies grew at a far faster rate than the economy as a whole. Global GDP grew from approximately $34 trillion in 2000 to more than $118 trillion in 2025 according to the World Bank, more than tripling. Over that same period, the ten largest publicly traded technology companies by market capitalization as of September 30, 2026 grew their aggregate revenue from $68 billion to more than $2.5 trillion, an increase of approximately 38 times, or approximately 11 times the rate of global GDP growth [__] .
paras.zh: 历史表明，变革性技术会扩大其所进入的市场。例如，信息技术支出从 2006 年的约 $1.2 trillion 增长至 2025 年的 $4.3 trillion，复合年增长率约为 7%，同期云计算支出从零增长至 $1.9 trillion，并扩大了信息技术预算。[__] 8 我们也看到其他技术，包括个人电脑、互联网和智能手机，同样扩大了其市场。构建这些技术的公司增长速度远超整体经济。根据世界银行的数据，全球 GDP 从 2000 年的约 $34 trillion 增长至 2025 年的超过 $118 trillion，增长了两倍多。在同一时期，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日市值最大的十家上市科技公司的合计收入从 $68 billion 增长至超过 $2.5 trillion，增幅约为 38 倍，约为全球 GDP 增速的 11 倍[__]。

paras.en: #### Frontier AI May Reshape Entire Sectors and Accelerate Novel Discoveries
paras.zh: #### 前沿 AI 可能重塑整个行业并加速新发现

paras.en: We believe frontier AI represents a larger opportunity than any prior technology cycle, and Claude is already demonstrating this potential. Claude can now execute complex projects autonomously over hours and days, coordinating thousand s of agents in parallel to carry out sophisticated planning, long-form research, and self-correcting analysis. Claude also turns open-ended tasks into finished, high-quality deliverables—work that was beyond the reach of frontier AI only a short time ago. These capabilities position Claude to transform the largest sectors of the global economy, including software development, business and professional services, cybersecurity, financial services, and healthcare and life sciences, driving meaningful gains in productivity and output for the organizations that deploy it.
paras.zh: 我们相信前沿 AI 代表着比以往任何技术周期都更大的机遇，而 Claude 已经在展现这一潜力。Claude 现在能够自主执行耗时数小时乃至数日的复杂项目，并行协调数千个智能体，以开展复杂的规划、长篇研究和自我纠错分析。Claude 还能将开放式任务转化为完成的高质量交付成果——这类工作在不久前还超出前沿 AI 的能力范围。这些能力使 Claude 有望变革全球经济的最大板块，包括软件开发、商业和专业服务、网络安全、金融服务以及医疗健康与生命科学，为部署它的组织带来生产力和产出的显著提升。

paras.en: Cybersecurity represents one of our most important near-term opportunities. As each new generation of AI models grows more capable of finding and exploiting vulnerabilities, we expect that defending enterprise networks and critical infrastructure will increasingly require frontier AI. At the same time, the diffusion of AI is expanding the threat surface, as organizations deploy agents and autonomous capabilities at an accelerating pace. Our leadership in coding has allowed us to advance Claude’s cybersecurity capabilities and build products that help enterprises secure their most critical infrastructure. For example, Claude Security can continuously scan customers’ codebases, triage vulnerabilities, and write fixes. We also recently launched OSS Scanner, which extends some of these capabilities to the open-source projects that enterprise software is built on. Through our trusted-access programs, vetted cyberdefenders can also use our most capable models for security operations, incident response, and authorized penetration testing, shifting security to a continuous protection model.
paras.zh: 网络安全是我们最重要的近期机遇之一。随着每一代新的 AI 模型在发现和利用漏洞方面的能力日益增强，我们预计，防御企业网络和关键基础设施将越来越需要前沿 AI。与此同时，AI 的普及正在扩大威胁面，因为各组织正以加速的步伐部署智能体和自主能力。我们在编程领域的领先地位使我们得以推进 Claude 的网络安全能力，并打造帮助企业保护其最关键基础设施的产品。例如，Claude Security 可以持续扫描客户的代码库、对漏洞进行分诊并编写修复方案。我们最近还推出了 OSS Scanner，将这些能力中的一部分延伸至企业软件所依赖的开源项目。通过我们的可信访问计划，经过审查的网络防御者还可以使用我们能力最强的模型进行安全运营、事件响应和经授权的渗透测试，将安全转变为持续防护模式。

paras.en: 9 IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science, Global Medicine Use Trends 2026, February 2026.
paras.zh: 9 IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science, Global Medicine Use Trends 2026, February 2026。

paras.en: We expect other sectors to follow as Claude’s frontier capabilities extend beyond current markets to open entirely new ones, reaching domains such as robotics, advanced manufacturing, and logistics, and accelerating progress in scientific research, including drug discovery and materials science.
paras.zh: 我们预计其他行业也将随之跟进，因为 Claude 的前沿能力将超越当前市场，开辟全新的市场，触及机器人、先进制造和物流等领域，并加速科学研究进展，包括药物发现和材料科学。

paras.en: For example, in the life sciences sector, where annual global pharmaceutical spend is expected to exceed $2 trillion in 2026, [__] 9 Claude is used in drug discovery and development by our customers, our biotechnology partners, and our own researchers. We are also extending Claude into robotics, where our Model Hardware Standard enables AI agents to operate lab and manufacturing equipment such as microscopes, liquid handlers, and off-the-shelf robotic arms.
paras.zh: 例如，在生命科学领域，预计 2026 年全球年度药品支出将超过 $2 trillion，[__] 9 Claude 被我们的客户、我们的生物技术合作伙伴以及我们自己的研究人员用于药物发现和开发。我们还在将 Claude 扩展到机器人领域，我们的模型硬件标准使 AI 智能体能够操作实验室和制造设备，例如显微镜、液体处理设备和现成的机械臂。

paras.en: Ultimately, we believe frontier AI will help drive global economic growth. As frontier AI makes workers and organizations more productive, becomes embedded in the products and services they deliver, and unlocks new business models, it creates economic output that did not previously exist. We believe our opportunity is to capture a share not only of today’s economic activity but also of that newly created output as the global economy expands.
paras.zh: 最终，我们相信前沿 AI 将有助于推动全球经济增长。随着前沿 AI 使劳动者和组织更具生产力、融入他们交付的产品和服务，并解锁新的商业模式，它创造了此前不存在的经济产出。我们相信，我们的机会不仅在于获取当今经济活动的一部分，还在于随着全球经济扩张而获取新创造产出的一部分。

paras.en: #### The Importance of Safety and Ethical Behavior
paras.zh: #### 安全与道德行为的重要性

paras.en: While the potential benefits of AI are extraordinary, its rapid advancement will impact the economy and society in ways that could create significant disruption, particularly if the technology is not developed and deployed responsibly. For example, bad actors have already conducted high-profile cyberattacks using AI’s capabilities to discover vulnerabilities, generate malware, and evade detection tools; other risks associated with misuse, including in the domain of biology, could result in even greater harm. AI deployed at scale also has the potential to concentrate power and wealth both within and between countries in ways that could erode trust, harm society, and destabilize the geopolitical order. Misaligned AI systems could corrupt institutional decision-making or cause large-scale harm through autonomous actions that are not visible or understandable to their users and operators. We believe that frontier AI companies must invest in safety and alignment to help ensure the responsible diffusion of this technology. We also believe that safety, alignment, and ethical behavior resonate particularly strongly with enterprises, where rigorous safeguards, predictable model behavior, and demonstrable accountability have become decisive criteria in selecting an AI partner for mission-critical workloads.
paras.zh: 尽管 AI 的潜在益处非凡，但其快速发展将以可能造成重大颠覆的方式影响经济和社会，尤其是在该技术未以负责任的方式开发和部署的情况下。例如，恶意行为者已经利用 AI 的能力实施高调的网络安全攻击，发现漏洞、生成恶意软件并规避检测工具；与滥用相关的其他风险，包括在生物学领域，可能造成更大的危害。大规模部署的 AI 还可能以可能侵蚀信任、损害社会并破坏地缘政治秩序的方式，在国家内部和国家之间集中权力和财富。未对齐的 AI 系统可能腐蚀机构决策，或通过其用户和运营者不可见或不理解的自主行动造成大规模危害。我们相信，前沿 AI 公司必须投资于安全和对齐，以帮助确保该技术的负责任传播。我们还相信，安全、对齐和道德行为对企业尤其具有强烈共鸣，在这些企业中，严格的保障措施、可预测的模型行为和可证明的问责制已成为选择 AI 合作伙伴处理关键任务工作负载的决定性标准。

paras.en: We have five core advantages that define our position at the frontier: our mission and focus, our talent and culture, our frontier and safety research, our approach to compute, and our enterprise strategy.
paras.zh: 我们拥有五大核心优势，界定了我们在前沿领域的地位：我们的使命与专注、我们的人才与文化、我们的前沿与安全研究、我们的算力路径，以及我们的企业战略。

paras.en: #### Mission and Focus
paras.zh: #### 使命与专注

paras.en: Anthropic was founded in 2021 by a team of researchers responsible for many of the consequential breakthroughs that define frontier AI. They share a conviction that safety must be a foundational principle for building Powerful AI. We have a corporate structure consistent with that objective, incorporating as a Delaware PBC and implementing the LTBT with an explicit mandate to advance our mission. Further, we publish safety methodologies, model evaluations, and our Responsible Scaling Policy because we believe transparency is a prerequisite for trust, and trust is a prerequisite for the responsible deployment of frontier AI at scale.
paras.zh: Anthropic 由一支研究团队于 2021 年创立，该团队负责了界定前沿 AI 的诸多重大突破。他们共同坚信，安全必须成为构建强大 AI 的基础性原则。我们拥有与该目标相一致的公司架构，在特拉华州注册为公益公司（PBC），并设立了长期利益信托（LTBT），其明确职责是推进我们的使命。此外，我们公开发布安全方法论、模型评估以及我们的《负责任扩展政策》，因为我们相信透明度是信任的前提，而信任是负责任地大规模部署前沿 AI 的前提。

paras.en: Every employee at Anthropic works towards the same mission, and that mission guides every decision—from model architectures, to product strategy, to partnership terms, and to how we direct research and compute. We do not pursue projects based on commercial opportunity or research novelty alone; our efforts must advance our mission. When difficult tradeoffs arise between commercial gain and safety or trust, we have a clear answer. For example, in April 2026, we initially released our frontier model, Mythos, as a gated research preview through Project Glasswing, available to select organizations for cybersecurity applications, rather than making it broadly available at launch due to its advanced capabilities in cyber vulnerability discovery. We believe this clarity of mission reduces friction, accelerates decision-making, and fosters a culture where safety and capability are pursued in tandem.
paras.zh: Anthropic 的每一位员工都朝着同一使命努力，该使命指引着每一项决策——从模型架构，到产品战略，到合作条款，再到我们如何引导研究与算力。我们不会仅基于商业机会或研究新颖性来开展项目；我们的努力必须推进我们的使命。当商业利益与安全或信任之间出现艰难取舍时，我们有明确的答案。例如，2026 年 4 月，我们最初通过 Project Glasswing 以受限研究预览的形式发布我们的前沿模型 Mythos，仅向特定组织开放用于网络安全应用，而非在发布时广泛提供，原因是其在网络漏洞发现方面具备先进能力。我们相信，这种使命的清晰性减少了摩擦、加快了决策，并培育了一种安全与能力并行追求的文化。

paras.en: #### Talent and Culture
paras.zh: #### 人才与文化

paras.en: Talent is one of our most important advantages, because technology, capital, product, and distribution all flow from superior talent. Talent density matters more than talent mass. Brilliant people are inspired and motivated when surrounded by equally brilliant colleagues, creating an environment that attracts more exceptional people. This talent can leverage Claude to maximize each individual’s impact.
paras.zh: 人才是我们最重要的优势之一，因为技术、资本、产品和分销都源自卓越的人才。人才密度比人才总量更重要。杰出的人在身边都是同样杰出的同事时会受到启发和激励，从而营造出一个吸引更多卓越人才的环境。这些人才可以利用 Claude 最大化每个人的影响力。

paras.en: We believe we have assembled the deepest concentration of AI research talent in the world, including many of the researchers who pioneered the techniques that underlie modern LLMs. Our founding team originated several foundational advances in AI, including Scaling Laws, GPT-2 and GPT-3, RLHF, and mechanistic interpretability. Our conviction that safety and capability must advance together helps us attract and retain world-class talent, including researchers and engineers. For example, we have experienced approximately 1% regrettable attrition of our employee base overall in the TTM period ended September 30, 2026.
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们汇聚了世界上最集中的 AI 研究人才，其中包括许多开创了现代 LLM 背后技术的研究人员。我们的创始团队开创了 AI 领域的若干基础性进展，包括 Scaling Laws、GPT-2 和 GPT-3、RLHF 以及机制可解释性。我们坚信安全与能力必须共同进步，这帮助我们吸引并留住世界级人才，包括研究人员和工程师。例如，在截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的过去十二个月（TTM）期间，我们整体员工队伍的遗憾流失率约为 1%。

paras.en: We maintain a commitment to open internal collaboration and truth seeking, which is underpinned by our low-ego, high-impact, and mission-aligned culture. Researchers share results openly, and colleagues critique and redirect in real time. When multiple teams pursue parallel approaches, the norm is to rigorously evaluate which approach is demonstrating stronger and more aligned results. This collaborative dynamic is difficult to replicate because it requires both the foundation of trust we have built from the earliest days of our organization and a relentless commitment to preserving such trust. That trust manifests in ways that are uncommon at our scale: teams that consistently pull in the same direction rather than at cross-purposes.
paras.zh: 我们坚持对内部开放协作和求真务实的承诺，这一承诺以我们低调、高影响力且与使命一致的文化为支撑。研究人员公开分享成果，同事实时提出批评并调整方向。当多个团队并行推进不同方案时，惯例是严格评估哪种方案展现出更强且更契合目标的结果。这种协作动态难以复制，因为它既需要我们从组织成立之初便建立的信任基础，也需要对维护这种信任的不懈承诺。这种信任以在我们这一规模下并不常见的方式体现：各团队始终朝着同一方向发力，而非相互掣肘。

paras.en: We believe our culture has driven our talent density as we have scaled.
paras.zh: 我们相信，随着规模扩大，我们的文化推动了人才密度的提升。

paras.en: #### Frontier and Safety Research
paras.zh: #### 前沿与安全研究

paras.en: Our frontier model leadership is a direct product of our talent density. We believe our researchers have consistently pushed the boundaries of intelligence, capability, and reliability further than bigger teams or those with larger budgets. Claude is widely recognized for its performance on real-world tasks across industries, including coding, medicine, law, science, and mathematics.
paras.zh: 我们的前沿模型领先地位是我们人才密度的直接产物。我们相信，我们的研究人员在智能、能力和可靠性方面持续突破边界，超越了规模更大或预算更充足的团队。Claude 在编码、医学、法律、科学和数学等各行业真实任务上的表现广受认可。

paras.en: Our approach to research provides key advantages to our business:
paras.zh: 我们的研究方法为业务带来关键优势：

paras.en: - Our Model Research and Compute Performance Are Co-designed from the Start. Architectural decisions are made with compute efficiency in mind from day one. Our model architecture and inference infrastructure are designed in a single unified process. AI researchers and inference infrastructure engineers share planning cycles, reporting lines, and performance targets. This approach enables us to develop model versions that are both more capable and more efficient compared to prior versions.
paras.zh: - 我们的模型研究与算力性能从一开始就协同设计。架构决策从第一天起就将算力效率纳入考量。我们的模型架构与推理基础设施在单一统一流程中设计。AI 研究人员与推理基础设施工程师共享规划周期、汇报关系和绩效目标。这种方法使我们能够开发出相较此前版本既更强大又更高效的模型版本。

paras.en: - Our Pre-training Process Is Engineered for Capital Efficiency. We focus on a clear pipeline for developing model improvements to architecture, training methodology, and data. These are tested at a smaller scale before they consume significant compute. The bar for inclusion in a frontier training run is high and strictly evidence-based: we require demonstration that a given improvement holds as models increase in size, not merely that it performs well at reduced scale. Frontier training runs are planned, scheduled capital deployments with known inputs and rigorous inclusion criteria. The result is a repeatable process for converting research investment into capability gains, while managing the risks inherent to frontier training runs.
paras.zh: - 我们的预训练流程以资本效率为设计目标。我们专注于一条清晰的流水线，用于推进架构、训练方法和数据方面的模型改进。这些改进在消耗大量算力之前先在小规模上测试。纳入前沿训练运行的门槛很高且严格基于证据：我们要求证明某项改进在模型规模增大时依然成立，而不仅仅是其在缩小规模下表现良好。前沿训练运行是有计划、有排期的资本投入，具有已知的输入和严格的纳入标准。其结果是形成一套可重复的流程，将研究投入转化为能力提升，同时管理前沿训练运行固有的风险。

paras.en: - Our Post-training Investment Is Purpose-Built for Agentic Capabilities. Post-training has grown from a finishing step into a major research investment, reflecting the market shift from assistants to agents. This is where our models hone their ability to write code, use tools, follow instructions, and operate software on a user’s behalf. We train against complete, realistic tasks whose complexity reflects real professional work.
paras.zh: - 我们的后训练投入专为智能体能力而打造。后训练已从收尾步骤发展为一项重大研究投入，反映出市场正从助手向智能体转变。我们的模型正是在这一环节磨练编写代码、使用工具、遵循指令以及代用户操作软件的能力。我们针对完整、真实的任务进行训练，这些任务的复杂度反映了真实专业工作。

paras.en: - Our Safety Research Is a Commercial Benefit. As models take on agentic roles with access to critical business systems, trust and reliability are paramount. And as capabilities increase, the ability to operate safely becomes one of the key determining factors for commercial viability. Models that are well-aligned are better at following a user’s instructions—for example, they avoid taking potentially destructive actions without fully understanding user intent. They are also more robust against attacks such as prompt injection, where malicious actors attempt to hijack the model by feeding it illicit instructions. Our work on alignment, interpretability research, safeguards, and red-teaming, as well as the use of external reviewers who can assess our safety practices, helps us create safer, more reliable models, and therefore positions us to meet our customers’ rigorous requirements. Safety and capability research are integrated, which enables us to deliver the trust and performance required for enterprise workflows.
paras.zh: - 我们的安全研究具有商业价值。随着模型承担起可访问关键业务系统的智能体角色，信任与可靠性至关重要。而随着能力提升，安全运行的能力成为决定商业可行性的关键因素之一。对齐良好的模型更能遵循用户指令——例如，它们会避免在未充分理解用户意图的情况下采取可能具有破坏性的操作。它们对提示注入等攻击也更具鲁棒性，此类攻击中恶意行为者试图通过输入非法指令来劫持模型。我们在对齐、可解释性研究、安全防护和红队测试方面的工作，以及引入能够评估我们安全实践的外部审查者，帮助我们打造更安全、更可靠的模型，从而使我们能够满足客户的严格要求。安全研究与能力研究相互融合，这使我们能够交付企业工作流程所需的信任与性能。

paras.en: #### Our Approach to Compute
paras.zh: #### 我们的算力策略

paras.en: Our approach to compute starts with training models that are designed to be more capable and run more efficiently on any given type of compute.
paras.zh: 我们的算力策略始于训练那些被设计为在任意给定类型的算力上能力更强、运行更高效的模型。

paras.en: Our ability to build more capable models and serve them more efficiently reflects the compounding returns of an iterative cycle between our pre-training, post-training, and inference research, all of which is enabled by our fungible compute pool. Pre-and post-training research produces proprietary compute multipliers that make our models more capable. Research and inference engineering drive sustained reductions in the compute required to serve those models.
paras.zh: 我们构建能力更强的模型并更高效地为其提供服务的能力，体现了我们的预训练、后训练与推理研究之间迭代循环所产生的复利回报，而这一切都得益于我们可互换的算力池。预训练与后训练研究产生了专有的算力乘数，使我们的模型能力更强。研究与推理工程则推动持续降低服务这些模型所需的算力。

paras.en: In addition to enabling more capable and efficient models, our multi-chip compute architecture across AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, and AMD GPUs allows us to orchestrate workloads to optimize for price and performance. We have years of experience effectively training and running our models across multiple chip families, which we believe is differentiated and difficult to replicate. This foundation, paired with Claude’s increasing understanding of chip and model architectures, allows us to onboard new chip platforms in a fraction of the time this once required.
paras.zh: 除了实现能力更强、更高效的模型之外，我们跨 AWS Trainium、Google TPU、NVIDIA GPU 和 AMD GPU 的多芯片算力架构，使我们能够编排工作负载，以优化价格与性能。我们拥有多年跨多个芯片系列有效训练和运行模型的经验，我们认为这具有差异化优势且难以复制。这一基础，加上 Claude 对芯片和模型架构日益深入的理解，使我们能够以过去所需时间的一小部分完成新芯片平台的上线。

paras.en: Our compute pool is fungible by design. We have made substantial engineering investments to build the internal orchestration, scheduling, and capacity management systems that allow accelerator capacity, regardless of provider, chip architecture, or physical location, to be directed across workloads. The same infrastructure that serves customer workloads is also directed to research, model development, and internal usage of Claude. These systems manage the underlying hardware as a unified capacity pool, monitor utilization and demand across that pool, and direct compute to wherever it is expected to be most productive at any given time.
paras.zh: 我们的算力池在设计上即可互换。我们进行了大量工程投入，构建内部编排、调度和容量管理系统，使加速器容量无论来自哪家供应商、何种芯片架构或物理位置，都能被调度至各类工作负载。服务于客户工作负载的同一套基础设施，也被用于研究、模型开发以及 Claude 的内部使用。这些系统将底层硬件作为统一容量池进行管理，监控该池的利用率和需求，并将算力调度至任意给定时刻预期产出最高的地方。

paras.en: Our multi-chip compute approach provides us with substantially greater chip access than relying on one platform and enables us to opportunistically capture the price-performance benefits of each chip family and generation. Securing this access requires significant advance commitment. Given the long lead times between contracting for compute and that compute becoming available to serve workloads, we secure compute well in advance of anticipated demand. In some cases, we may also make payments in advance of the delivery of the equipment or infrastructure. We anticipate making significant investments for the foreseeable future, including in compute and infrastructure, to ensure we have the technological resources to maintain and expand our position at the frontier of AI.
paras.zh: 我们的多芯片算力方案使我们获得的芯片资源显著多于依赖单一平台的情形，并使我们能够机会性地获取各芯片系列与代际的价格性能优势。确保此类资源获取需要大量的预先承诺。鉴于从签约采购算力到该算力可供服务工作负载之间存在较长的交付周期，我们会在预期需求到来之前提前较长时间锁定算力。在某些情况下，我们还可能在设备或基础设施交付之前预先付款。我们预计在可预见的未来将进行重大投资，包括在算力和基础设施方面的投资，以确保我们拥有技术资源来维持并扩大我们在前沿 AI 领域的地位。

paras.en: #### Enterprise Strategy
paras.zh: #### 企业战略

paras.en: Our enterprise strategy aligns with our mission. We build our most capable models for the problems that demand the highest intelligence. That same intelligence is also applied efficiently to everyday work—calibrating effort to the difficulty of each task and routing workloads to the models within our model family that are best suited for them. As a result, our customers around the world are adopting Claude across a broad range of work, from routine knowledge tasks to their most important problems. Today, Claude is deployed for knowledge work across major industries, including financial services, insurance, healthcare, life sciences, law, education, retail and commerce, telecommunications, professional services, technology, and cybersecurity. Beyond practical enterprise challenges, Claude is also being applied to pressing global problems in scientific research, drug discovery, education, and climate analysis.
paras.zh: 我们的企业战略与我们的使命相一致。我们针对需要最高智能水平的问题构建我们能力最强的模型。同样的智能也被高效地应用于日常工作——根据每项任务的难度校准投入的算力，并将工作负载路由至我们模型系列中最适合它们的模型。因此，我们在世界各地的客户正在广泛的工作场景中采用 Claude，从日常知识任务到他们最重要的问题。如今，Claude 已被部署用于主要行业的知识工作，包括金融服务、保险、医疗健康、生命科学、法律、教育、零售与商业、电信、专业服务、技术和网络安全。除实际的企业挑战外，Claude 还被应用于科学研究、药物发现、教育和气候分析等紧迫的全球性问题。

paras.en: We have built our models, platform, and applications for usefulness in production environments instead of benchmark performance. This distinction matters, as many AI systems prove difficult to implement and fail to deliver the expected value in complex enterprise environments, where governance and security concerns remain among the top barriers to adoption.
paras.zh: 我们构建模型、平台和应用时，着眼于其在生产环境中的实用性，而非基准测试表现。这一区别至关重要，因为许多 AI 系统难以落地实施，无法在复杂的企业环境中交付预期价值，而在这些环境中，治理和安全方面的顾虑仍是采用的主要障碍之一。

paras.en: Our applications, such as Claude Code and Claude Cowork, multiply the impact of employees. Over time, our applications have become more capable and are now frequently being used to conduct long-running autonomous work alongside employees. Organizations also integrate Claude as the intelligence that powers and transforms internal business processes. In addition, our Claude Platform is used as the foundation for enterprises building AI-native products.
paras.zh: 我们的应用，例如 Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork，能够放大员工的影响力。随着时间推移，我们的应用能力不断增强，如今经常被用于与员工并肩执行长时间运行的自主工作。各组织还将 Claude 作为驱动和改造内部业务流程的智能核心进行集成。此外，我们的 Claude 平台被用作企业构建 AI 原生产品的基础。

paras.en: As enterprise customers integrate Claude into increasingly complex workflows, they surface the use cases and requirements that shape our roadmap. They also provide feedback that allows us to continuously improve our models, platform, and applications as well as develop new solutions to advance their AI adoption.
paras.zh: 随着企业客户将 Claude 集成到日益复杂的工作流程中，他们会提出塑造我们路线图的使用场景和需求。他们还提供反馈，使我们能够持续改进模型、平台和应用，并开发新的解决方案以推进其 AI 采用。

paras.en: With each model and product advancement, Claude is able to address more valuable use cases, deepening its impact for existing customers while lowering the adoption threshold for new ones. When a model crosses the capability, reliability, and trust threshold required for a category of work, adoption in that category generally moves quickly from experimentation into production. Coding was the first such category: within roughly a year, Claude progressed from suggesting individual lines of code to operating fleets of agents working autonomously across production codebases. Cybersecurity is following a similar curve, with Claude’s performance on ExploitBench, a benchmark developed by Carnegie Mellon researchers that evaluates AI models’ ability to exploit software vulnerabilities, increasing from 40% with Opus 4.8, to 78% with Claude Mythos 5, and to 91% with Opus 5.5 over a period of approximately four months. Cyberdefenders are now identifying and patching vulnerabilities at scale. We expect these improvements in model capabilities to unlock additional use cases. Claude Security and our recently launched OSS Scanner are early examples, providing the ability to scan codebases on a continuous basis and propose fixes before attackers find vulnerabilities.
paras.zh: 随着每一次模型和产品的进步，Claude 能够覆盖更有价值的用例，加深其对现有客户的影响，同时降低新客户的采用门槛。当某一模型跨越某一类工作所需的能力、可靠性和信任门槛时，该类工作的采用通常会迅速从试验阶段转入生产阶段。编程是第一个这样的类别：在大约一年内，Claude 从建议单行代码，发展到能够操作多组智能体在生产代码库中自主工作。网络安全正沿着类似的曲线发展：在卡内基梅隆大学研究人员开发的、用于评估 AI 模型利用软件漏洞能力的基准 ExploitBench 上，Claude 的得分在大约四个月内从 Opus 4.8 的 40% 提升至 Claude Mythos 5 的 78%，再提升至 Opus 5.5 的 91%。网络防御者如今能够大规模识别并修补漏洞。我们预计这些模型能力的提升将解锁更多用例。Claude Security 和我们近期推出的 OSS Scanner 是早期的例子，它们能够持续扫描代码库，并在攻击者发现漏洞之前提出修复方案。

paras.en: We believe we have reached an inflection point where AI systems can function as genuine collaborators in professional work. They quickly complete substantive tasks that might otherwise occupy a skilled professional for several hours, a full day, or longer. AI systems are also becoming increasingly capable of performing tasks that were previously too difficult or costly to complete or surfacing original insights and analyses.
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们已经到达一个拐点：AI 系统能够在专业工作中充当真正的协作者。它们能迅速完成实质性任务，而这些任务原本可能占用一名熟练专业人员数小时、一整天甚至更长时间。AI 系统也日益能够执行此前过于困难或成本过高而无法完成的任务，或发掘出独到的洞察与分析。

paras.en: We refer to these AI systems that work alongside humans to perform complex, multi-step work at professional levels as Virtual Collaborators. Virtual Collaborators carry the access rights, system connections, and context that their organizations grant them, which allows them to function more accurately and reliably. They can navigate and use internal tools and execute workflows that span multiple steps that require sustained reasoning. Virtual Collaborators are AI designed to be embedded where work gets done, and our aim is to continue extending them to knowledge workers globally, a population that is estimated to exceed one billion in 2028.10
paras.zh: 我们将这些与人类并肩工作、以专业水平执行复杂多步骤工作的 AI 系统称为虚拟协作者。虚拟协作者拥有其组织授予的访问权限、系统连接和上下文，这使其能够更准确、更可靠地运作。它们能够浏览并使用内部工具，执行需要持续推理的跨多步骤工作流程。虚拟协作者是旨在嵌入实际工作场景的 AI，我们的目标是持续将其扩展至全球知识工作者，预计到 2028 年该群体规模将超过十亿。10

paras.en: 10 IDC, Worldwide Developer Population Growth Forecast, 2025–2029, doc # US53789825, September 2025.
paras.zh: 10 IDC，《全球开发者群体增长预测，2025–2029》，文档编号 # US53789825，2025 年 9 月。

paras.en: #### Claude Code
paras.zh: #### Claude Code

paras.en: The clearest manifestation of Virtual Collaborators today is Claude Code, our coding agent and the product we believe has most concretely defined what autonomous AI work looks like. Claude Code shifted the market’s understanding of what an AI system could do in collaboration with software developers: the model suggests the next line of code and goes further by planning, writing, testing, and debugging—a process that results in production-grade code. Within months of its release, autonomous coding became the reference point for measuring the progress of frontier AI. For enterprise AI use cases, we believe the launch of Claude Code was comparable in its impact to the introduction of the first widely adopted conversational AI assistants. What makes Claude Code a Virtual Collaborator is its sustained reasoning, a harness that translates intent into actions, an execution environment that maintains a persistent state whether on a developer’s machine or in a sandboxed cloud environment, integration with existing tools and systems, and a user-friendly interface. Its uses are highly varied and often surprising: for example, NASA engineers used Claude Code to plan and write navigation commands for the Mars Perseverance rover, resulting in the first AI-planned drive on Mars.
paras.zh: 如今虚拟协作者最清晰的体现是 Claude Code，这是我们的编程智能体，也是我们认为最具体地定义了自主 AI 工作形态的产品。Claude Code 改变了市场对 AI 系统在与软件开发者协作中能做什么的理解：模型会建议下一行代码，并更进一步进行规划、编写、测试和调试——这一过程最终产出生产级代码。在其发布后的数月内，自主编程成为衡量前沿 AI 进展的参照基准。对于企业 AI 应用场景，我们认为 Claude Code 的发布其影响堪比首个被广泛采用的对话式 AI 助手的问世。使 Claude Code 成为虚拟协作者的是其持续推理能力、将意图转化为行动的运行框架、无论在开发者机器上还是在沙盒云环境中都能保持持久状态的执行环境、与现有工具和系统的集成，以及用户友好的界面。其用途高度多样且常常出人意料：例如，NASA 工程师使用 Claude Code 为火星毅力号漫游车规划并编写导航指令，实现了火星上首次由 AI 规划的行驶。

paras.en: Software developers are powerful advocates for Claude—they understand how systems work, have credibility evaluating technical tools, and often serve as internal champions for adopting new technologies. Winning their trust creates a foundation for broader diffusion of Virtual Collaborators across enterprise workforces. We are already seeing this pattern play out with non-technical teams increasingly adopting Claude Code and Claude Cowork to manage their own workflows.
paras.zh: 软件开发者是 Claude 的有力倡导者——他们理解系统如何运作，在评估技术工具方面具有公信力，并且常常成为企业内部采用新技术的推动者。赢得他们的信任，为虚拟协作者在企业员工队伍中的更广泛扩散奠定了基础。我们已看到这一模式正在显现：非技术团队越来越多地采用 Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 来管理自身的工作流。

paras.en: #### Claude Cowork
paras.zh: #### Claude Cowork

paras.en: All digital work is ultimately an expression of code, and Claude’s mastery of it powers Virtual Collaborators capable of handling complex work far beyond software development. Claude Cowork extends the same agentic architecture of Claude Code to knowledge workers broadly by translating a user’s intent into completed work, autonomously reading files, navigating applications, and executing multi-step workflows on a user’s desktop while the underlying code is abstracted away. By extending beyond Claude Code with applications purpose-built for specific professions and industry verticals, we accelerate Claude’s diffusion into new categories of knowledge work and deepen our presence across the enterprise. As of September 30, 2026, adoption of Claude Cowork, which we made available as a research preview in January 2026, outpaced the adoption that Claude Code achieved at the equivalent point following its research preview release in February 2025. In September 2026, we began merging Claude Cowork and Claude.ai, bringing agentic and conversational work into a unified application. Users can now move from a simple question to complex, multi-step tasks in the same conversation.
paras.zh: 所有数字化工作归根结底都是代码的表达，而 Claude 对代码的精通，使其驱动的虚拟协作者能够处理远超软件开发范畴的复杂工作。Claude Cowork 将 Claude Code 相同的智能体架构延伸至广泛的知识工作者，把用户意图转化为已完成的工作，在用户桌面上自主读取文件、操作应用程序并执行多步骤工作流，而底层代码则被抽象隐藏。通过以专为特定职业和行业垂直领域打造的应用超越 Claude Code，我们加速 Claude 向新类别知识工作的扩散，并加深我们在整个企业中的渗透。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，Claude Cowork（我们于 2026 年 1 月以研究预览形式推出）的采用速度超过了 Claude Code 在 2025 年 2 月研究预览发布后同等时点的采用速度。2026 年 9 月，我们开始将 Claude Cowork 与 Claude.ai 合并，把智能体工作与对话式工作整合到统一应用中。用户现在可以在同一段对话中，从简单提问过渡到复杂的多步骤任务。

paras.en: #### Extending Virtual Collaborators
paras.zh: #### 扩展虚拟协作者

paras.en: We believe the trajectory for Virtual Collaborators is clear and accelerating. Each generation of Claude models has expanded along multiple dimensions: the depth and rigor of their reasoning, the duration and autonomy of the work they can sustain, the complexity of tasks they can complete, and the volume of useful output they can produce. Capability evaluations and benchmarking have shown substantial improvements across Claude model versions in the duration and complexity of tasks that can be completed reliably, with more recent model versions demonstrating particularly significant advances.
paras.zh: 我们相信虚拟协作者的发展轨迹清晰且正在加速。每一代 Claude 模型都在多个维度上实现扩展：推理的深度与严谨性、所能持续工作的时长与自主性、所能完成任务的复杂度，以及所能产出的有用输出量。能力评估与基准测试显示，各版本 Claude 模型在可可靠完成任务的时长与复杂度方面均有大幅提升，较新的模型版本更展现出尤为显著的进步。

paras.en: We are building towards a world where Claude can be given open-ended tasks lasting hours, days, or weeks, and then execute them autonomously with the judgment and initiative of a brilliant colleague. Ultimately, million s of Virtual Collaborators can run in parallel, each working independently on unrelated problems or collaborating seamlessly to achieve a shared objective. The result is something without historical precedent: what we refer to as a country of geniuses in a data center, available to every organization and sector of the economy.
paras.zh: 我们正朝着这样一个世界构建：Claude 可以被赋予持续数小时、数天乃至数周的开放式任务，然后以一位杰出同事般的判断力和主动性自主执行这些任务。最终，数百万个虚拟协作者可以并行运行，各自独立处理互不相关的问题，或无缝协作以实现共同目标。其成果是史无前例的：我们称之为数据中心里的天才之国，可供每一个组织和经济部门使用。

full.sec: Claude is the Partner of Choice for Enterprises
full.secZh: Claude 是企业的首选合作伙伴

paras.en: Enterprise customers across different industries rely on Claude to enhance their productivity and transform their businesses. These customers range from AI-native startups to the largest enterprises in the world.
paras.zh: 不同行业的企业客户依赖 Claude 提升生产力并实现业务转型。这些客户既包括 AI 原生初创公司，也包括全球最大的企业。

paras.en: We believe customers choose Claude for a wide variety of use cases, from routine knowledge work to their most important problems. They come to us for access to frontier AI across our platform and applications that deliver real-world outcomes. We see this conviction in customer behavior: enterprises consistently utilize our latest and most capable models as soon as they are released, gravitating to the most advanced option for their highest-value work. Our customers see us as a long-term partner for the frontier capabilities we offer today, for the innovation they expect from us in the future, and for our ability to meet their needs across the capability-cost-speed curve.
paras.zh: 我们相信，客户选择 Claude 是出于广泛多样的用例，从日常知识工作到他们最重要的问题。他们选择我们，是为了通过我们的平台和应用获取前沿 AI，并取得切实成果。我们从客户行为中看到了这种信念：企业一旦我们发布最新、能力最强的模型，就会持续采用，并为其最高价值的工作倾向于选择最先进的选项。我们的客户将我们视为长期合作伙伴，因为我们提供当今的前沿能力、他们期待我们未来带来的创新，以及我们能够在能力—成本—速度曲线上满足其需求。

paras.en: Beyond our models, the Claude Platform provides primitives that enable customers to accelerate time-to-value and leverage Claude’s intelligence in a variety of use cases. These primitives are the same ones we use to build our own applications. Our applications, such as Claude Code and Claude Cowork, multiply the impact of employees. Over time, our applications have become more capable and are now frequently being used to conduct long-running autonomous work alongside employees. Improvements to our models, platform, and applications accrue to the benefit of our customers and drive continued adoption.
paras.zh: 除模型之外，Claude Platform 还提供基础构件，使客户能够加快实现价值的时间，并在各种用例中利用 Claude 的智能。这些基础构件与我们构建自身应用所用的构件相同。我们的应用，例如 Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork，能够放大员工的影响力。随着时间的推移，我们的应用能力不断增强，如今经常被用于与员工并肩执行长时间运行的自主工作。我们模型、平台和应用的改进惠及客户，并推动持续采用。

paras.en: Our commitment to our mission instills confidence in our customers to choose Claude as a trusted partner. Our investments in research on AI alignment, interpretability, cybersecurity, and enterprise-grade controls aim to deliver the predictability and dependability that organizations need in customer-facing and regulated contexts. This trust means that enterprises can expand the scope of the work that they delegate to Claude, as well as the systems into which Claude is integrated. Enterprises are aligning their strategies around Claude with the confidence that we are building frontier AI that serves their needs in the long term.
paras.zh: 我们对使命的承诺让客户有信心选择 Claude 作为可信赖的合作伙伴。我们在 AI 对齐、可解释性、网络安全和企业级控制方面的研究投入，旨在提供组织在面向客户和受监管场景中所需要的可预测性和可靠性。这种信任意味着企业可以扩大委托给 Claude 的工作范围，以及将 Claude 集成到其中的系统范围。企业正在围绕 Claude 调整其战略，并相信我们正在构建能够长期满足其需求的前沿 AI。

paras.en: We deliver this intelligence through an integrated approach. Our Claude model family is the foundation, with model classes optimized for different points along the capability-cost-speed curve. On top of our models, Claude Platform gives developers access to the primitives we use ourselves, which they can use to build their own AI solutions. We have also built first-party applications on Claude Platform for customers that prefer a ready-to-deploy option.
paras.zh: 我们通过一体化方式交付这种智能。我们的 Claude 模型系列是基础，其中的模型类别针对能力—成本—速度曲线上的不同点位进行了优化。在我们的模型之上，Claude Platform 让开发者能够访问我们自己使用的基礎构件，他们可以用这些构件构建自己的 AI 解决方案。我们还为偏好即用型部署选项的客户，在 Claude Platform 上构建了第一方应用。

paras.en: #### Claude Platform—A Composable System for Building AI Solutions
paras.zh: #### Claude Platform——用于构建 AI 解决方案的可组合系统

paras.en: We seek to bring Claude to every corner of the economy at whatever level of autonomy each task demands, from a single suggestion to an agent that runs independently for hours. Achieving this goal requires more than a capable model. The most demanding deployments need intelligence that is reliable, connectable, and deployable within the specific data environments, regulatory constraints, and workflow patterns of each organization. Intelligence is one limiting factor, but so are connectors that do not yet exist, governance frameworks that are not yet written, and orchestration logic that needs to be built from scratch. Our platform seeks to close these gaps, and we believe the breadth and speed with which we have done so is a primary reason customers build on Claude.
paras.zh: 我们力求将 Claude 带入经济的每一个角落，无论每项任务需要何种程度的自主性，从单条建议到可独立运行数小时的智能体。实现这一目标所需的不仅仅是一个能力出众的模型。要求最高的部署需要可靠、可连接、并能在各组织特定的数据环境、监管约束和工作流模式内部署的智能。智能是一个限制因素，但尚不存在的连接器、尚未制定的治理框架，以及需要从零构建的编排逻辑同样是限制因素。我们的平台力求弥合这些差距，我们相信我们实现这一目标的广度和速度是客户基于 Claude 构建应用的主要原因之一。

paras.en: Our platform provides our customers with direct access to the primitives to build, deploy, and scale AI-native applications. At the foundation are model capabilities that make Claude’s autonomy possible: native tool use, computer use for desktop control, memory, and extended thinking. Long context and low-latency model variants make that action sustainable: for example, an agent could hold an entire codebase, a full data room, or hours of accumulated task state in working memory and iterate fast enough that autonomy persists rather than stalls. Above these sit composition primitives such as our Agent Software Development Kit (“SDK”), Claude Managed Agents, agent skills, multi-agent orchestration, and the Model Context Protocol (“MCP”) for universal connectivity to enterprise data and tools. Together, these assemble into complex production workflows.
paras.zh: 我们的平台为客户提供直接访问基础组件的途径，以构建、部署和扩展 AI 原生应用。其基础是使 Claude 的自主性成为可能的模型能力：原生工具使用、用于桌面控制的计算机使用、记忆和扩展思考。长上下文和低延迟模型变体使这种行动得以持续：例如，一个智能体可以在工作记忆中容纳整个代码库、完整的数据室或数小时累积的任务状态，并以足够快的速度迭代，使自主性得以持续而非停滞。在此之上是组合基础组件，例如我们的智能体软件开发工具包（"SDK"）、Claude 托管智能体、智能体技能、多智能体编排，以及用于与企业数据和工具实现通用连接的模型上下文协议（"MCP"）。这些组件共同组合成复杂的生产工作流。

paras.en: These building blocks are composable and interoperable. The same primitives that power a coding agent also power a research agent, a financial analyst agent, or a compliance-review agent. While these agents have different connectors and agent skills, they have the same SDK, protocol, and orchestration framework. That composability is one of the reasons our customer base spans across industries and why customer expansion can happen seamlessly across additional use cases without significant integration work.
paras.zh: 这些构建模块可组合且可互操作。驱动编码智能体的相同基础组件也驱动研究智能体、财务分析师智能体或合规审查智能体。尽管这些智能体具有不同的连接器和智能体技能，但它们拥有相同的 SDK、协议和编排框架。这种可组合性是我们客户群横跨多个行业的原因之一，也是客户扩展能够在更多用例之间无缝进行而无需大量集成工作的原因之一。

paras.en: #### Applications That Meet Users Where They Are
paras.zh: #### 在用户所在之处满足用户的应用

paras.en: Our portfolio of applications sits on top of our platform and is deliberately broad to meet users across a number of key dimensions:
paras.zh: 我们的应用组合构建于平台之上，并且刻意保持广泛，以在多个关键维度上满足用户需求：

paras.en: - In their Work. Claude Code works with software developers in the terminal, while Claude Cowork extends the same agentic paradigm to knowledge workers.
paras.zh: - 在其工作中。Claude Code 在终端中与软件开发人员协作，而 Claude Cowork 将相同的智能体范式扩展至知识工作者。

paras.en: - In their Domain. Claude for Financial Services, Claude for Financial Advisors, Claude for Healthcare, Claude for Life Sciences, Claude for Legal, Claude for Education, and Claude for Government come with domain knowledge, data connectors, skills, and compliance controls pre-loaded.
paras.zh: - 在其领域中。Claude for Financial Services、Claude for Financial Advisors、Claude for Healthcare、Claude for Life Sciences、Claude for Legal、Claude for Education 和 Claude for Government 预置了领域知识、数据连接器、技能和合规控制。

paras.en: - In their Applications. Claude for Microsoft 365 and Claude in Chrome are embedded into the software that knowledge workers use every day.
paras.zh: - 在其应用中。Claude for Microsoft 365 和 Claude in Chrome 嵌入到知识工作者日常使用的软件中。

paras.en: #### A Platform Customers Build Their Businesses On
paras.zh: #### 客户赖以构建其业务的平台

paras.en: Customers of all sizes and across every major industry have adopted Claude. Fortune 500 companies, including American International Group, Inc. and Bristol Myers Squibb, rely on Claude for mission-critical workflows. Research institutions, such as the Garvan Institute of Medical Research, Gladstone Institutes, and the University of California, San Francisco, are applying Claude to some of the world’s hardest scientific problems. In addition, prosumers around the world use Claude as a daily tool.
paras.zh: 各种规模、各个主要行业的客户都已采用 Claude。包括 American International Group, Inc. 和 Bristol Myers Squibb 在内的《财富》500 强企业依赖 Claude 处理关键任务工作流。Garvan Institute of Medical Research、Gladstone Institutes 和 University of California, San Francisco 等研究机构正将 Claude 应用于全球一些最难的科研问题。此外，世界各地的专业消费者也将 Claude 作为日常工具使用。

paras.en: As enterprises adopt our platform and applications, we become deeply embedded in their businesses over time. Software developers build applications and internal tools on our platform, and they encode their workflows and institutional knowledge into Claude-powered agents. Organizations integrate Claude into essential business processes. Each additional integration deepens the relationship and increases the value customers derive from the platform. This dynamic extends beyond our direct customers. Leading companies such as Legora and Salesforce have built AI-powered products on Claude that reach million s of end users. This reach can increase awareness of Claude, which we believe drives adoption far beyond our direct customer base. When such end users experience Claude, it can build preference and familiarity that travel with users across roles and organizations.
paras.zh: 随着企业采用我们的平台和应用，我们随着时间推移深度嵌入其业务之中。软件开发人员在我们的平台上构建应用和内部工具，并将其工作流和机构知识编码进由 Claude 驱动的智能体。各组织将 Claude 集成到关键业务流程中。每一次新增集成都会加深这种关系，并提升客户从平台中获得的价值。这一动态延伸至我们的直接客户之外。Legora 和 Salesforce 等领先企业已在 Claude 之上构建了 AI 驱动的产品，触达数百万终端用户。这种触达可以提升 Claude 的认知度，我们相信这会推动采用范围远远超出我们的直接客户群。当这些终端用户使用 Claude 时，可以建立起偏好和熟悉度，并随用户在不同岗位和组织之间流动而延续。

paras.en: The result is an ecosystem where we build on our own platform and applications, our customers build on us, our partners build on us, and their end users experience Claude across surfaces, creating the kind of deep workflow integration that makes our platform and applications increasingly central to how organizations operate. We believe the revenue we generate today does not reflect the full economic value Claude creates for our customers—not just for the organizations that build on us, but for the people whose work, learning, and creativity are expanded by the intelligence and skills they gain through Claude. We believe that there is substantial opportunity ahead as Claude’s capabilities, adoption, and integration into critical workflows continue to grow.
paras.zh: 由此形成的是一个生态系统：我们在自己的平台和应用之上构建，我们的客户在我们之上构建，我们的合作伙伴在我们之上构建，而其终端用户在各种界面上体验 Claude，从而形成深度的工作流集成，使我们的平台和应用日益成为各组织运营方式的核心。我们相信，我们今天产生的收入并未反映 Claude 为客户创造的全部经济价值——不仅是对在我们之上构建的组织，也包括那些通过 Claude 获得的智能和技能使其工作、学习和创造力得到拓展的人们。我们相信，随着 Claude 的能力、采用程度以及对关键工作流的集成持续增长，未来存在重大机遇。

paras.en: #### Diffusion: Intelligence Available Everywhere
paras.zh: #### 扩散：智能随处可用

paras.en: Our distribution strategy is built around one objective: getting Claude’s intelligence in the hands of every enterprise, team, and individual that can benefit from it. A core driver of Claude’s diffusion is its intelligence— as Claude’s capabilities advance, value to customers expands, and that value drives greater adoption. Our role is also to ensure that intelligence is accessible, and we do that in the following ways: through our composable platform and applications that meet customers where they are, through our go-to-market and Applied AI teams directly, and through partnerships that extend our reach at scale.
