paras.zh: 我们的分发策略围绕一个目标构建：让 Claude 的智能触达每一个能够从中受益的企业、团队和个人。Claude 扩散的核心驱动力是其智能——随着 Claude 能力提升，客户价值扩大，而这种价值又推动更广泛的采用。我们的职责还在于确保这种智能可被获取，我们通过以下方式实现这一点：通过可组合的平台和应用，在客户所在之处满足其需求；通过我们的市场推广团队和应用 AI 团队直接触达；以及通过合作伙伴关系在规模上扩展我们的触达范围。

paras.en: Intelligence-Led Growth. Our platform and applications are the primary mechanism through which Claude’s intelligence reaches users. As users begin building, brainstorming, and problem-solving with Claude, they quickly come to rely on it as a trusted partner in their work. As Claude takes on more of their work, people experience firsthand what frontier AI makes possible and expand their usage significantly. This pattern repeats across organizations: prosumers become internal champions, teams expand their use of Claude, and what begins as a single workflow grows into something that impacts how an entire organization operates.
paras.zh: 智能驱动的增长。我们的平台和应用是 Claude 的智能触达用户的主要机制。当用户开始借助 Claude 进行构建、头脑风暴和解决问题时，他们很快便将其视为工作中值得信赖的伙伴。随着 Claude 承担他们更多的工作，人们得以亲身感受前沿 AI 所能实现的可能性，并显著扩大使用量。这一模式在各类组织中反复出现：专业消费者成为内部倡导者，团队扩大对 Claude 的使用，而最初仅涉及单一工作流程的应用，最终发展为影响整个组织运作方式的事物。

paras.en: Direct Teams. This organic adoption is complemented and enhanced through our direct go-to-market teams who help scale Claude to organizations with complex workflows and business processes. By the time our direct teams engage a customer, Claude is often already in use. Our go-to-market teams use this organic momentum to build executive sponsorship and drive enterprise-wide adoption.
paras.zh: 直销团队。这种自然增长得到了我们直销团队的有力补充与增强，他们帮助将 Claude 推广至拥有复杂工作流程和业务流程的组织。当我们的直销团队接触客户时，Claude 往往已在使用之中。我们的市场推广团队利用这一自然增长势头，建立高管层面的支持，并推动全企业范围的采用。

paras.en: Applied AI Teams. Our Applied AI teams embed more deeply with select customers, building solutions that make it easier for organizations to benefit from Claude’s intelligence. They work with enterprises to design and deploy custom solutions, specialized workflows, and domain-specific implementations tailored to the customer’s own requirements. This work drives deeper adoption within individual customers and generates the feedback and information from users that help to shape our platform and product roadmap. Our direct and Applied AI teams work together as a hybrid sales and engineering function, organized by geography and then by industry so that they bring domain expertise to each customer.
paras.zh: 应用 AI 团队。我们的应用 AI 团队与精选客户进行更深入的协作，构建解决方案，使组织能够更轻松地从 Claude 的智能中获益。他们与企业合作，设计并部署定制解决方案、专用工作流程以及针对客户自身需求量身定制的特定领域实施方案。这项工作推动了单个客户内部的更深层次采用，并产生了来自用户的反馈和信息，帮助我们塑造平台和产品路线图。我们的直销团队与应用 AI 团队作为一个混合型销售与工程职能协同运作，按地域划分，再按行业划分，从而为每位客户带来领域专业知识。

paras.en: Partnerships. We complement our direct efforts through distribution partnerships that place Claude inside customers’ existing technology stacks.
paras.zh: 合作伙伴关系。我们通过分销合作伙伴关系补充直销努力，将 Claude 嵌入客户现有的技术栈中。

paras.en: - Cloud Partnerships [__] . [__] Our cloud partnerships, and the way we structure them, provide three distinct advantages. First, Amazon, Google, and Microsoft each host Claude natively on their respective cloud platforms, AWS, GCP, and Azure, allowing enterprises to deploy Claude within the infrastructure, security perimeters, and commitment structures they already operate. Second, these CSPs extend our reach through their large combined field teams that are empowered to sell our platform and applications, accelerating market penetration at a scale we believe would be difficult for any single organization to directly replicate. Third, we have a joint go-to-market approach with these CSPs through which we establish direct contractual relationships with our customers while paying a fee to each CSP. This structure allows us to foster stronger commercial alignment with these CSPs, avoid channel conflict, set pricing, and realize the financial benefits of ongoing compute efficiency improvements.
paras.zh: - 云合作伙伴关系 [__] 。 [__] 我们的云合作伙伴关系及其构建方式带来三项显著优势。第一，Amazon、Google 和 Microsoft 各自在其云平台 AWS、GCP 和 Azure 上原生托管 Claude，使企业能够在他们已运营的基础设施、安全边界和承诺结构内部署 Claude。第二，这些 CSP 通过其庞大的联合外勤团队扩大我们的覆盖范围，这些团队被授权销售我们的平台和应用，以我们认为任何单一组织都难以直接复制的规模加速市场渗透。第三，我们与这些 CSP 建立了联合市场推广方式，通过该方式我们与客户建立直接合同关系，同时向每个 CSP 支付费用。这一结构使我们能够与这些 CSP 建立更强的商业一致性，避免渠道冲突，设定定价，并实现持续算力效率提升所带来的财务收益。

paras.en: - Ecosystem Partnerships. Major global SIs have built dedicated Claude practices with teams trained to deploy our platform and applications. Go-to-market alliances with leading data platforms embed Claude into data infrastructure that enterprises already operate, facilitating adoption of Claude within existing workflows and making it easier for enterprises to realize value from Claude. To accelerate the growth and capability of this ecosystem, in March 2026, we launched the Claude Partner Network, committing an initial $100 million in 2026 to fund partner training, technical certification, and joint market development with the firms that bring Claude into enterprise environments. As of September 30, 2026, this network comprises over 150,000 practitioners across over 4,000 organizations who have received certifications through our Claude Certification Program. Certifications represent role-specific capabilities validated through proctored examinations designed to give enterprises confidence in the partner they are selecting. In October 2026, we launched the Claude Frontier Academy (the “Academy”), backed by a $100 million commitment, to address a key constraint on enterprise AI adoption: the shortage of engineers who can take AI from an initial use case into production. Drawing on our own experience deploying Claude inside large enterprises, the Academy trains our customers’ and partners’ engineers to the same standard as our own engineers, with each participant leading a Claude deployment at their own organization. We aim to train 10,000 engineers through the Academy by the end of 2027, beginning with cohorts from leading consulting firms and enterprises.
paras.zh: - 生态系统合作伙伴关系。全球主要系统集成商（SI）已建立专门的 Claude 业务团队，其团队经过培训，能够部署我们的平台和应用。与领先数据平台的市场推广联盟将 Claude 嵌入企业已在运营的数据基础设施中，促进 Claude 在现有工作流程中的采用，并使企业更容易从 Claude 中实现价值。为加速该生态系统的增长和能力提升，我们于 2026 年 3 月推出 Claude 合作伙伴网络，承诺在 2026 年初步投入 $100 million，用于资助合作伙伴培训、技术认证，以及与将 Claude 引入企业环境的公司开展联合市场开发。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，该网络涵盖超过 4,000 家组织中的逾 150,000 名从业者，他们已通过我们的 Claude 认证计划获得认证。认证代表通过监考考试验证的特定角色能力，旨在让企业对所选合作伙伴充满信心。2026 年 10 月，我们推出 Claude Frontier Academy（「学院」），并获得 $100 million 承诺支持，以解决企业 AI 采用的一项关键制约因素：能够将 AI 从初始用例推进至生产环境的工程师短缺。学院借鉴我们在大型企业内部署 Claude 的自身经验，以与我们自身工程师相同的标准培训客户和合作伙伴的工程师，每位参与者都在其所在组织主导一项 Claude 部署。我们的目标是在 2027 年底前通过学院培训 10,000 名工程师，首批学员来自领先的咨询公司和企业。

paras.en: 11 Run-Rate Revenue is an operating metric, is not a substitute for revenue prepared in accordance with GAAP, and is not a forecast of future revenue. Because consumption-based revenue represents the substantial majority of our revenue and may fluctuate from period to period, and because our Run-Rate Revenue growth rate is expected to decline over time, our Run-Rate Revenue as of any measurement date may not be indicative of our revenue for future periods. Our Run-Rate Revenue as of any measurement date has included, and we expect will continue to include, amounts from customers that we subsequently determine are using our models, platform, and applications in violation of our usage policy or commercial terms, and whose revenue would not be expected to recur following restriction or termination of their access. See the section titled “Risk Factors— Certain of our operating metrics are subject to assumptions and limitations. As a result, these metrics may not provide an accurate indication of our actual performance or future results” for additional information.
paras.zh: 11 运行率收入是一项经营指标，不能替代按照 GAAP 编制的收入，也不是对未来收入的预测。由于基于消费的收入占我们收入的绝大部分，且可能在各期间波动，并且由于我们的运行率收入增长率预计将随时间下降，我们在任何计量日期的运行率收入可能无法预示未来期间的收入。我们在任何计量日期的运行率收入已经包含、并且我们预计将继续包含来自客户的金额，这些客户随后被我们认定在使用我们的模型、平台和应用时违反了我们的使用政策或商业条款，且其收入在访问被限制或终止后预计不会再次发生。更多信息请参见「风险因素——我们的某些经营指标受假设和限制的影响。因此，这些指标可能无法准确反映我们的实际业绩或未来结果」一节。

paras.en: - Ode with Anthropic. We recently launched an AI services company in partnership with leading private equity firms to bring Claude’s capabilities to mid-sized companies across sectors, building solutions on the Claude Platform and supporting customers over the long term. Ode with Anthropic will partner closely with our Applied AI and go-to-market teams.
paras.zh: - Ode with Anthropic。我们近期与领先的私募股权公司合作成立了一家 AI 服务公司，将 Claude 的能力带给各行业的中型企业，在 Claude 平台上构建解决方案并长期支持客户。Ode with Anthropic 将与我们的应用 AI 团队和市场推广团队紧密合作。

paras.en: Our broad and diverse distribution strategy seeks to maximize customers’ access to our platform and applications regardless of where they work. From there, adoption can scale frictionlessly, and through our Applied AI teams and partnerships, we help enterprises realize more value as their adoption grows.
paras.zh: 我们广泛而多元的分销策略旨在最大化客户对我们平台和应用的获取渠道，无论客户在何处工作。在此基础上，采用可以无摩擦地扩展，并且通过我们的应用 AI 团队和合作伙伴关系，我们帮助企业在采用程度加深时实现更多价值。

full.sec: Unprecedented Financial Model to Support Long-Term Investments
full.secZh: 支持长期投资的前所未有的财务模型

paras.en: We believe the diffusion of AI through the global economy represents one of the largest opportunities in history to improve how humans live and work, and it is just beginning. As of September 30, 2026, our customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis included every company in the Fortune 10, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and over 30% of the Global 2000. Within the Fortune 500, these customers included the 10 largest software and IT services companies, the 10 largest internet companies, nine of the 10 largest pharmaceutical companies, the 10 largest banks, nine of the 10 largest semiconductor companies, and eight of the 10 largest healthcare companies. We believe enterprises are still in early phases of deployment, and we believe most knowledge workers have yet to fully experience what frontier AI can help them accomplish. We believe many industries have barely begun to explore the transformative potential of AI-native workflows. Furthermore, each successive version of a Claude model is designed to unlock new use cases, new customer types, and entirely new categories of economic value and expand our addressable market.
paras.zh: 我们相信，AI 在全球经济中的普及代表着历史上改善人类生活与工作方式的重大机遇之一，而这一切才刚刚开始。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，按过去十二个月（TTM）计算收入达到 $100,000 或以上的客户包括《财富》10 强中的每一家公司、《财富》500 强中超过 50% 的公司，以及全球 2000 强中超过 30% 的公司。在《财富》500 强中，这些客户包括 10 家最大的软件与 IT 服务公司、10 家最大的互联网公司、10 家最大的制药公司中的 9 家、10 家最大的银行、10 家最大的半导体公司中的 9 家，以及 10 家最大的医疗健康公司中的 8 家。我们认为，企业仍处于部署的早期阶段，我们也认为大多数知识工作者尚未充分体验到前沿 AI 能帮助他们实现什么。我们认为，许多行业才刚刚开始探索 AI 原生工作流程的变革潜力。此外，Claude 模型的每一个后续版本都旨在解锁新的用例、新的客户类型和全新的经济价值类别，并扩大我们的可服务市场。

paras.en: We will continue to invest in the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity. Our financial model provides us with competitive advantages to make these investments and advance the frontier.
paras.zh: 我们将继续投资于先进 AI 的负责任开发与维护，以造福人类的长期利益。我们的财务模型为我们提供了竞争优势，使我们能够进行这些投资并推进前沿。

paras.en: #### Significant Revenue Growth
paras.zh: #### 显著的收入增长

paras.en: Rapid Customer Adoption and Revenue Growth
paras.zh: 快速的客户采用与收入增长

paras.en: Our enterprise strategy is designed to drive durable customer adoption by embedding Claude directly into business-critical workflows and enabling the development of products built on Claude. Over the past three years, we have seen rapid customer adoption across companies of every size and industry around the world. From September 30, 2025 to September 30, 2026, we have grown customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis from more than 950 to more than 11,900. Additionally, our Run-Rate Revenue was $ [__] as of October 31, 2026. [__] 11
paras.zh: 我们的企业战略旨在通过将 Claude 直接嵌入业务关键型工作流程，并支持基于 Claude 构建产品的开发，来推动持久的客户采用。过去三年，我们看到全球各种规模和各个行业的公司都在快速采用我们的产品。从 2025 年 9 月 30 日到 2026 年 9 月 30 日，按过去十二个月（TTM）计算收入达到 $100,000 或以上的客户从超过 950 家增长到超过 11,900 家。此外，截至 2026 年 10 月 31 日，我们的年化收入（Run-Rate Revenue）为 $ [__]。[__] 11

paras.en: Significant Customer Expansion Our customers’ journey using Claude often begins with a single use case before expanding across departments, applications, and workflows. As our models become more capable, customers often deepen our partnerships— they find more ways to embed Claude into their workflows, increasing the scope of what Claude can accomplish within their enterprises. This pattern of initial deployment, demonstrated value, and rapid expansion has been replicated across organizations and is reflected in our Net Revenue Retention of approximately 900% as of September 30, 2026.
paras.zh: 显著的客户扩张 我们的客户使用 Claude 的旅程通常始于单一用例，随后扩展到各个部门、应用和工作流程。随着我们的模型能力不断增强，客户往往会深化与我们的合作——他们找到更多将 Claude 嵌入其工作流程的方式，从而扩大 Claude 在其企业内所能实现的范围。这种初始部署、价值显现和快速扩张的模式已在各组织中反复出现，并体现在我们截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日约为 900% 的净收入留存率上。

paras.en: We see this expansion as customers adopt agentic products like Claude Code. For example, in the three months ended September 30, 2026, Claude Enterprise users who did not use Claude Code spent less than $75 per month on average, while the top 5% of Claude Enterprise users who used Claude Code spent approximately 20 times that amount.
paras.zh: 我们看到，随着客户采用 Claude Code 等智能体产品，这种扩张正在发生。例如，在截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的三个月内，未使用 Claude Code 的 Claude Enterprise 用户平均每月支出不到 $75，而使用 Claude Code 的 Claude Enterprise 用户中排名前 5% 的用户支出约为该金额的 20 倍。

paras.en: Diffusion also accelerates as we deliver value to our customers by unlocking new capabilities and by delivering existing capabilities at a lower cost per task. Customers’ cost per task can decrease for two reasons: newer, more capable model versions can complete tasks more efficiently, and we may reduce the prices we charge for our models. For example, with the release of Claude Fable 5.1 in September 2026, we reduced the cost of typical workloads by approximately 25% compared to Fable 5, with savings of up to 45% for complex coding and highly agentic tasks. Similarly, with the release of Opus 5.5 that same month, we reduced customers’ cost per task by approximately 40% compared to Opus 5. In each case, the reduction was a combination of a lower price and improved efficiency, the contributions of which depend on the task. Because of our compute efficiency, we have been able to make these improvements while preserving our margins.
paras.zh: 随着我们通过解锁新能力、并以更低的单任务成本交付现有能力为客户创造价值，扩散效应也会加速。客户单任务成本下降可能有两个原因：更新、能力更强的模型版本可以更高效地完成任务，以及我们可能降低对模型收取的价格。例如，随着 2026 年 9 月 Claude Fable 5.1 的发布，我们将典型工作负载的成本较 Fable 5 降低了约 25%，对于复杂编程和高度智能体化的任务，节省幅度最高可达 45%。同样，随着同月 Opus 5.5 的发布，我们将客户的单任务成本较 Opus 5 降低了约 40%。在每种情况下，成本下降都是更低价格与更高效率共同作用的结果，二者的贡献程度取决于具体任务。得益于我们的算力效率，我们能够在保持利润率的同时实现这些改进。

paras.en: In the past, when we have launched new model versions that deliver a significant increase in capability and a lower cost per task, we have generally seen customers expand their use of our intelligence service. For example, we launched Opus 4.5 in November 2025 with greater capabilities and a lower price and cost per task than its predecessor Opus 4.1. Following that launch, our total quarter-over-quarter revenue growth accelerated from 48% for the three months ended December 31, 2025 to [__] 132% for the three months ended March 31, 2026. This growth reflected the combined effect of several factors. These included lower prices and improved capability that unlocked new use cases, the emergence of new products, and expanded customer adoption. More recently, in September 2026, we launched Opus 5.5, which delivered a significant increase in capability and a lower cost per task compared to previously available models, and many customers have since migrated to it from older models.
paras.zh: 过去，当我们推出能力显著提升且单任务成本更低的新模型版本时，我们通常看到客户扩大对我们智能服务的使用。例如，我们于 2025 年 11 月推出 Opus 4.5，其能力和价格均优于前代 Opus 4.1，单任务成本也更低。在该版本发布后，我们的季度环比总收入增速从截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止三个月的 48% 加速至截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月的 [__] 132%。这一增长反映了多个因素的共同作用，包括更低的价格和更强的能力解锁了新的使用场景、新产品的出现，以及客户采用范围的扩大。最近，我们于 2026 年 9 月推出 Opus 5.5，与先前可用的模型相比，其能力显著提升且单任务成本更低，此后许多客户已从旧模型迁移至该版本。

paras.en: Compu · te Efficiency
paras.zh: 算力 · 效率

paras.en: Premium Value to Enterprise Customers. Claude’s position at the frontier of intelligence enables us to capture value commensurate with the impact, quality, and reliability of our outputs. Enterprise customers embed Claude in business-critical workflows, driving stronger retention and higher monetization than consumer AI. We believe our premium intelligence and focus on high-value customer workloads allow us to generate greater return on our compute investment.
paras.zh: 对企业客户的高价值。Claude 处于智能前沿的地位，使我们能够获取与我们的输出所带来的影响、质量和可靠性相称的价值。企业客户将 Claude 嵌入业务关键型工作流，从而带来比消费级 AI 更强的留存率和更高的变现水平。我们相信，我们的高端智能以及对高价值客户工作负载的专注，使我们能够从算力投资中获得更高的回报。

paras.en: Approach to Compute. We believe that our approach to compute drives more intelligence from research and model development, and that we can support more customer and internal usage of Claude from a given amount of compute investment, compared to other approaches in the industry. This advantage is further reinforced by our single-fleet fungibility through multiple strategic partners, which gives us a diversified compute base, resilience against supply constraints, and the ability to optimize for efficiency in ways that less flexible architectures cannot match.
paras.zh: 算力策略。我们相信，与行业中的其他方式相比，我们的算力策略能够从研究和模型开发中产出更多智能，并且我们能够以给定的算力投资支撑更多客户和内部对 Claude 的使用。这一优势还因我们通过多个战略合作伙伴实现的单一机队可互换性而进一步增强，这为我们提供了多元化的算力基础、抵御供应约束的韧性，以及以灵活性较低的架构无法企及的方式优化效率的能力。

paras.en: Closing the Loop. The practical value of “closing the loop” is enormous for compute efficiency: Claude has helped write and iterate on compute multipliers that are central to efficient inference and has accelerated development and model release timelines.
paras.zh: 闭环。“闭环”对算力效率的实际价值巨大：Claude 帮助编写并迭代了对高效推理至关重要的算力乘数，并加快了开发进度和模型发布节奏。

paras.en: #### Operating Efficiency
paras.zh: #### 运营效率

paras.en: High Talent Density. As of September 30, 2026, with approximately 5,300 employees, our TTM revenue per employee was over $6.6 million—a reflection of what we believe is the deepest concentration of AI research talent in the world. We cultivate a low-ego, high-impact, and mission-aligned culture that minimizes friction, which we believe results in an organization that produces output disproportionate to its headcount.
paras.zh: 高人才密度。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们拥有约 5,300 名员工，过去十二个月（TTM）的人均收入超过 $6.6 million——这反映出我们认为是全球最集中的 AI 研究人才储备。我们培育低自我、高影响、与使命一致的文化，以最大限度减少摩擦，我们相信这造就了一个产出远超其人数的组织。

paras.en: Efficient Go-to-Market. We do not rely exclusively on a traditional enterprise sales force. Our intelligence-led growth and broad distribution partnerships enable us to rapidly grow customer adoption and revenue without being limited by the rate at which we can grow our sales and marketing personnel, resulting in greater sales efficiency compared to typical enterprise technology companies.
paras.zh: 高效的销售模式。我们并不完全依赖传统的企业销售队伍。我们以智能驱动的增长和广泛的渠道合作伙伴关系，使我们能够快速提升客户采用率和收入，而不受销售和营销人员增长速度的限制，从而相比典型的企业科技公司实现更高的销售效率。

paras.en: Internal Usage of Claude. Our operating efficiency reflects the structural advantages of an organization that is one of the most intensive users of its own technology. For example, over 90% of the contributions to our codebase in September 2026 were written by Claude. Additionally, the average daily volume of code contributed to our codebase per engineer in the three months ended September 30, 2026 was over 45 times the average daily volume in the year ended December 31, 2024. Claude is embedded in workflows across all teams, providing a substantial increase in the overall productivity of our organization, with each new model version accelerating this effect.
paras.zh: Claude 的内部使用。我们的运营效率反映了一个组织作为自身技术最密集使用者之一的结构性优势。例如，2026 年 9 月，我们代码库中超过 90% 的贡献由 Claude 编写。此外，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的三个月内，每位工程师平均每日向代码库贡献的代码量超过截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度平均每日代码量的 45 倍。Claude 已嵌入所有团队的工作流程，大幅提升了我们组织的整体生产力，而每一个新模型版本都在加速这一效应。

paras.en: #### Long-Term Investment Philosophy
paras.zh: #### 长期投资理念

paras.en: Building frontier AI requires large-scale investments, and our financial model demonstrates that we can make those investments while generating increasingly attractive returns. This is evidenced when comparing the three months ended June 30, 2026 to the three months ended June 30, 2025:
paras.zh: 构建前沿 AI 需要大规模投资，而我们的财务模型表明，我们能够在进行这些投资的同时产生日益具有吸引力的回报。将截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三个月与截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日的三个月进行比较即可证明这一点：

paras.en: - Revenue increased [__] 1,368%;
- Compute and infrastructure expense increased [__] 300%;
paras.zh: - 算力和基础设施费用增长 [__] 300%;

paras.en: - Other operating expenses increased [__] 741%;
paras.zh: - 其他运营费用增长 [__] 741%;

paras.en: - Operating margin increased from [__] (152)% to 8%; and
paras.zh: - 经营利润率从 [__] (152)% 提升至 8%；以及

paras.en: - Adjusted Operating Margin increased from [__] (129)% to 19% [__] .
This combination of unprecedented revenue growth, compute efficiency, and operating efficiency driving this model gives us the confidence to keep investing at scale, both near-term and long-term.
paras.zh: 这种前所未有的收入增长、算力效率和经营效率的组合推动了这一模式，使我们有信心在短期和长期持续进行规模化投资。

paras.en: To support our research, model development, customer demand, and internal usage of Claude, we continue to invest at scale. As of and subsequent to September 30, 2026, we have entered into purchase commitments and lease agreements, including short-term commitments, as well as leases not yet commenced, with an aggregate committed spend of more than $ [__] . These commitments include approximately $ [__] expected to be incurred before December 31, 2030, and substantially all of the remainder is expected to be incurred between 2031 and 2045. Approximately $ [__] of these commitments are due in the next 12 months. See the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Liquidity and Capital Resources—Contractual Obligations” for more information.
paras.zh: 为支持我们的研究、模型开发、客户需求以及 Claude 的内部使用，我们持续进行规模化投资。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日及之后，我们已签订采购承诺和租赁协议（包括短期承诺），以及尚未开始的租赁，合计承诺支出超过 $[__]。这些承诺包括预计在 2030 年 12 月 31 日之前发生的约 $[__]，其余绝大部分预计将在 2031 年至 2045 年之间发生。其中约 $[__] 的承诺将在未来 12 个月内到期。有关更多信息，请参见标题为“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——流动性与资本资源——合同义务”的章节。

paras.en: As we invest heavily towards the incredible opportunity ahead, our core advantages enable us to generate more from every dollar we invest in scaling our business. The momentum in our financial trajectory increases our conviction to continue investing to build and scale Powerful AI that is safe, beneficial, and understandable, and positions us well for long-term growth.
paras.zh: 在我们为未来的巨大机遇进行大规模投资的同时，我们的核心优势使我们能够从投入规模化业务的每一美元中创造更多回报。我们财务轨迹中的增长势头增强了我们的信念，即继续投资以构建和扩展安全、有益且可理解的强大 AI，并使我们为长期增长奠定良好基础。

paras.en: Our growth strategy reflects our conviction that sustained leadership in frontier AI requires continuous investment in our people and culture, compute and infrastructure, Claude’s intelligence, capability, and safety, the breadth of Claude’s availability, customer adoption and expansion, entering new markets, and strategic transactions and partnerships that accelerate our mission.
paras.zh: 我们的增长战略体现了我们的信念：要在前沿 AI 领域保持持续领先，就必须持续投资于我们的人员与文化、算力与基础设施、Claude 的智能、能力与安全性、Claude 可用范围的广度、客户采用与扩展、进入新市场，以及能够加速我们使命的战略交易与合作。

paras.en: - Invest in our Talent and Culture [__] . [__] Talent is one of our most important advantages, and maintaining our talent density requires retaining exceptional people and recruiting world-class talent, including researchers and engineers, who share our mission. At the same time, we leverage Claude itself to grow our business without growing headcount linearly, resulting in extraordinary contributions per employee. We intend to continue investing in our low-ego, high-impact, and mission-aligned culture that has driven our talent density as we have scaled.
paras.zh: - 投资于我们的人才与文化 [__] 。 [__] 人才是我们最重要的优势之一，而维持我们的人才密度，需要留住杰出人才并招募世界级人才，包括与我们使命一致的研究人员和工程师。与此同时，我们借助 Claude 本身来发展业务，而不必线性增加员工人数，从而实现每位员工的非凡贡献。我们打算继续投资于我们低调务实、高影响力且与使命一致的文化，正是这种文化在我们规模扩张过程中推动了人才密度的提升。

paras.en: 12 IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science, Global Medicine Use Trends 2026, February 2026.
paras.zh: 12 IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science，《2026 年全球药品使用趋势》，2026 年 2 月。

paras.en: - Invest in Compute [__] . [__] Compute is the critical input that enables both our frontier research and our ability to serve growing customer demand. Today, we partner with major hyperscalers and leading chip providers, giving us diversified access to compute and the flexibility to adopt new hardware as it becomes available. We intend to secure further compute beyond our existing commitments, expand our own data center footprint to secure additional long-term compute, and improve the cost profile of our compute investments. We intend to continue improving compute efficiency by expanding our ability to orchestrate workloads across our multi-chip compute architecture and by investing in research that produces further algorithmic advances, compounding the efficiency gains we have already achieved.
paras.zh: - 投资于算力 [__] 。 [__] 算力是支撑我们前沿研究以及满足不断增长的客户需求能力的关键投入。如今，我们与主要超大规模云服务商和领先芯片供应商合作，使我们能够以多元化方式获取算力，并在新硬件可用时灵活采用。我们打算在现有承诺之外锁定更多算力，扩大自有数据中心布局以锁定更多长期算力，并改善我们算力投资的成本结构。我们打算继续提升算力效率，方式是增强我们在多芯片算力架构上编排工作负载的能力，并投资于能够产生进一步算法突破的研究，从而使我们已实现的效率提升不断叠加。

paras.en: - Advance Claude’s Intelligence, Capability, and Safety [__] . [__] Maintaining our leadership in frontier AI requires sustained investment in the research breakthroughs that drive each successive generation of Claude models. We plan to continue advancing Claude’s core intelligence and safety in tandem, expanding the frontier of what AI systems can reliably do—from extending the complexity and duration of autonomous work, to pioneering new ways AI can be applied across professional domains, such as software development, financial services, insurance, healthcare, life sciences, legal, education, retail and commerce, telecommunications, professional services, technology, and cybersecurity. As Claude’s capabilities advance, we believe it will address entirely new categories of use, resulting in deeper adoption and greater demand for our platform.
paras.zh: - 推进 Claude 的智能、能力与安全性 [__] 。 [__] 要保持我们在前沿 AI 领域的领先地位，就必须持续投资于推动每一代 Claude 模型的研究突破。我们计划继续同步推进 Claude 的核心智能与安全性，拓展 AI 系统能够可靠完成的任务边界——从延长自主工作的复杂度和持续时间，到开创 AI 在专业领域中的新应用方式，例如软件开发、金融服务、保险、医疗健康、生命科学、法律、教育、零售与商业、电信、专业服务、技术和网络安全。随着 Claude 能力的提升，我们相信它将覆盖全新的使用类别，从而带来更深入的采用和对我们平台更大的需求。

paras.en: - Make Claude Available Everywhere [__] . [__] We plan to continue our efforts to make Claude’s intelligence accessible across every surface where work happens. Today, customers access Claude through our own platform and applications, including Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude.ai, Claude Security, Claude Design, and Claude Science; through cloud marketplace integrations with AWS, GCP, and Azure; and through embedding in enterprise applications. We plan to expand these channels and reach new customers where they already work. As Claude appears across more of the surfaces where work happens, we expect our brand to strengthen, driving further adoption.
paras.zh: - 让 Claude 随处可用 [__] 。[__] 我们计划继续努力，让 Claude 的智能能够触达工作发生的每一个场景。如今，客户通过我们自己的平台和应用访问 Claude，包括 Claude Code、Claude Cowork、Claude.ai、Claude Security、Claude Design 和 Claude Science；通过与 AWS、GCP 和 Azure 的云市场集成；以及通过嵌入企业应用的方式访问。我们计划扩展这些渠道，在客户已经开展工作的场景中触达新客户。随着 Claude 出现在越来越多工作发生的场景中，我们预计我们的品牌将得到强化，从而推动进一步的应用普及。

paras.en: - Drive Adoption Across Existing and New Customers. We intend to grow our direct go-to-market and Applied AI teams to deepen enterprise relationships, build custom agentic solutions for complex deployments, and help customers expand Claude across their operations. We are focused on building a global brand that is synonymous with frontier AI that enterprises and prosumers trust to be reliable, secure, and steerable. We intend to deepen our cloud distribution partnerships and expand the enablement of partner field teams to sell, deploy, and integrate Claude. We also plan to continue investing in our prosumer channel, where individual users often become internal advocates who pull Claude into their organizations. We are growing our ability to serve international customers through the expansion of regional offices and partnerships, and we expect international expansion to be a meaningful driver of growth as global demand for AI accelerates [__] .
paras.zh: - 推动现有客户和新客户的采用。我们打算扩大我们的直销团队和应用 AI 团队，以深化企业关系、为复杂部署构建定制化的智能体解决方案，并帮助客户在其运营中扩大 Claude 的应用范围。我们专注于打造一个全球品牌，使其成为前沿 AI 的代名词，让企业和专业消费者相信其可靠、安全且可控。我们打算深化我们的云分销合作伙伴关系，并扩大对合作伙伴现场团队的支持，使其能够销售、部署和集成 Claude。我们还计划继续投资于我们的专业消费者渠道，在该渠道中，个人用户往往成为内部倡导者，将 Claude 引入其所在组织。我们正通过扩展区域办事处和合作伙伴关系来增强服务国际客户的能力，随着全球对 AI 的需求加速增长，我们预计国际扩张将成为重要的增长驱动力 [__] 。

paras.en: - Extend the Frontier into New Markets. As frontier AI continues to advance, we see potential for it to accelerate novel discoveries and open entirely new markets, reaching domains from healthcare and life sciences to robotics and the physical world. For example, in the life sciences sector, where annual global pharmaceutical spend is expected to exceed $2 trillion in 2026, Claude is used in drug discovery and development by our customers, our biotechnology partners, and our own researchers [__] . [__] 12 We are building AI agents that support scientists at each stage of that process. To build the best tools for the industry, we have invested in deep life sciences expertise of our own, hiring industry experts, building a molecular biology lab, acquiring Coefficient Bio, and partnering with industry leaders. Beyond knowledge work, we believe frontier AI has the power to transform physical work. Advances in Claude’s general capabilities, together with our Model Hardware Standard, now allow it to operate lab and manufacturing equipment such as microscopes, liquid handlers, and off-the-shelf robotic arms. We believe that compounding model capabilities will continue to unlock transformative opportunities across many other sectors of the global economy.
paras.zh: - 将前沿拓展至新市场。随着前沿 AI 持续进步，我们看到其加速新颖发现并开辟全新市场的潜力，触达从医疗健康和生命科学到机器人技术和物理世界的各个领域。例如，在生命科学领域，全球年度制药支出预计将在 2026 年超过 $2 trillion，我们的客户、我们的生物技术合作伙伴以及我们自己的研究人员正在将 Claude 用于药物发现和开发 [__] 。[__] 12 我们正在构建 AI 智能体，在该过程的每个阶段为科学家提供支持。为打造业界最佳工具，我们投资建设了自身的深厚生命科学专业能力，聘请行业专家、建立分子生物学实验室、收购 Coefficient Bio，并与行业领导者建立合作。除知识工作外，我们相信前沿 AI 有能力变革体力工作。Claude 通用能力的进步，加上我们的模型硬件标准，如今使其能够操作实验室和制造设备，例如显微镜、液体处理设备和现成机械臂。我们相信，模型能力的持续复合提升将继续在全球经济的许多其他领域释放变革性机遇。

paras.en: - Pursue Strategic Transactions and Partnerships. We intend to selectively pursue acquisitions, investments, and strategic partnerships, including ecosystem partnerships with SIs, consultants, and data platforms, that accelerate our mission, expand our reach, and strengthen our competitive position. In a talent-constrained industry, acquisitions can be an efficient path to adding exceptional technical talent that can immediately contribute to advancing Claude’s capabilities. We may also pursue transactions that strengthen our infrastructure position or deepen our capabilities in strategically important domains. For example, in April 2026, we completed the acquisition of Coefficient Bio, Inc., a computational biology company, to accelerate our research in the life sciences. We may also pursue partnerships, such as our recently launched AI services company, Ode with Anthropic, in which we have partnered with leading private equity firms to bring Claude’s capabilities to mid-sized companies across sectors, building solutions on the Claude Platform and supporting customers over the long term. Ecosystem partnerships also expand our reach, allowing customers to adopt Claude through SIs, consultants, and data platforms.
paras.zh: - 推进战略交易与合作。我们计划有选择地开展收购、投资和战略合作，包括与系统集成商（SI）、咨询公司和数据平台建立生态合作，以加速实现我们的使命、扩大我们的覆盖范围并强化我们的竞争地位。在人才稀缺的行业中，收购可以成为引入杰出技术人才的高效途径，这些人才能够立即为推进 Claude 的能力作出贡献。我们还可能开展交易，以强化我们的基础设施地位，或加深我们在具有战略重要性的领域中的能力。例如，2026 年 4 月，我们完成了对计算生物学公司 Coefficient Bio, Inc. 的收购，以加速我们在生命科学领域的研究。我们还可能寻求合作，例如我们近期与 Anthropic 共同推出的 AI 服务公司 Ode，在该公司中，我们与领先的私募股权公司合作，将 Claude 的能力带给各行业的中型企业，在 Claude 平台上构建解决方案并长期支持客户。生态合作还能扩大我们的覆盖范围，使客户能够通过系统集成商、咨询公司和数据平台采用 Claude。

full.secZh: 我们的模型、平台和应用

paras.en: We are building at every layer of frontier AI. Our Claude model family provides the underlying intelligence. Our Claude Platform makes that intelligence available as a set of composable primitives that developers and enterprises can assemble into their own solutions. Our applications draw on those same primitives, packaged into products customers can deploy directly. Because we build these layers cohesively, improvements at any layer compound across the stack and benefit our customers. We believe this integrated approach has made us a partner of choice for customers transforming their business through AI. Customers can adopt, govern, and scale our technology immediately, and each new primitive and application we release expands the range of workflows they can run on Claude.
paras.zh: 我们正在前沿 AI 的每一层进行构建。我们的 Claude 模型系列提供底层智能。我们的 Claude 平台将该智能以一组可组合的基础组件形式提供，开发者和企业可将其组装成自己的解决方案。我们的应用同样依托这些基础组件，将其打包成客户可直接部署的产品。由于我们以协同方式构建这些层级，任何一层的改进都会在整个技术栈中叠加放大，并惠及我们的客户。我们相信，这种一体化方式使我们成为客户借助 AI 实现业务转型时的首选合作伙伴。客户可以立即采用、治理并扩展我们的技术，而我们发布的每一项新基础组件和应用，都会拓展他们可在 Claude 上运行的工作流范围。

paras.en: Our platform unifies frontier intelligence with the harnesses, connectors, governance, and orchestration that are all required to put that intelligence into production. As customers build on the primitives we provide, Claude becomes an integral part of their data, workflows, and institutional knowledge, and the relationship deepens with each integration. We open our platform to all builders because we believe enabling a wide range of companies to build on Claude generates more innovation and value than we could create on our own.
paras.zh: 我们的平台将前沿智能与投入生产所需的运行框架、连接器、治理和编排统一起来。随着客户基于我们提供的基础组件进行构建，Claude 成为其数据、工作流和机构知识中不可或缺的一部分，且每一次集成都使这一关系更加深入。我们向所有构建者开放平台，因为我们相信，让广泛的公司基于 Claude 进行构建，所能产生的创新和价值超过我们独自创造的水平。

paras.en: We build first-party applications to demonstrate where frontier models are heading and to deliver fully integrated solutions where we have a distinct viewpoint on the workflow. Applications like Claude Code and Claude Cowork are early examples of what the future of agentic work might look like; they put our latest AI capabilities directly into the hands of users while accelerating the market’s understanding of AI’s possibilities. Because our research and product teams work side by side, new model capabilities inform our products and customer feedback on those products informs our research priorities. This allows us to build products for where we believe model capabilities are going, not just where they are today. For example, we designed Claude Code around the agentic coding capabilities we expected our models to achieve, which positioned it to scale rapidly as those capabilities arrived. We have taken a similar approach with Claude Cowork.
paras.zh: 我们构建第一方应用，以展示前沿模型的发展方向，并在我们对工作流有独特见解的领域提供完全集成的解决方案。Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 等应用是智能体工作未来形态的早期示例；它们将我们最新的 AI 能力直接交到用户手中，同时加速市场对 AI 可能性的理解。由于我们的研究和产品团队并肩工作，新的模型能力为我们的产品提供指引，而客户对这些产品的反馈又为我们的研究优先级提供指引。这使我们能够面向我们认为模型能力将要达到的方向构建产品，而不仅仅是当前的水平。例如，我们围绕预期模型将实现的智能体编程能力设计了 Claude Code，这使其在这些能力到来时能够快速扩展。我们在 Claude Cowork 上采取了类似的方法。

paras.en: We also design our products to close the gap between what Claude can do and how fully customers use it, which we believe is important to helping customers realize the value of frontier intelligence. Rather than requiring customers to learn how the underlying models work, we build products that allow them to interact with Claude as they would with a colleague, simply and naturally, so they can adopt new capabilities as they become available. We believe that as we extend the frontier and broaden our application surfaces, customers realize value faster, embed Claude more deeply into their operations, and increasingly rely on us as a primary provider for their AI transformation [__] .
paras.zh: 我们还通过产品设计来缩小 Claude 所能做到的事情与客户实际使用程度之间的差距，我们认为这对于帮助客户实现前沿智能的价值十分重要。我们不让客户去学习底层模型如何运作，而是构建产品，使他们能够像与同事交流一样与 Claude 互动，简单而自然，从而能够在新的能力出现时加以采用。我们相信，随着我们拓展前沿并扩大应用覆盖面，客户能更快实现价值，将 Claude 更深入地嵌入其运营，并日益依赖我们作为其 AI 转型的主要提供商 [__] 。

paras.en: The Claude Model · Family
paras.zh: Claude 模型 · 系列

paras.en: The Claude model family is currently composed of four model classes: Mythos (including Fable), Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku. Our model classes can be used individually for certain tasks or in combination with one another. They offer broad flexibility to choose the ideal performance, cost, and speed for each use case. All models support text, code, and multimodal inputs.
paras.zh: Claude 模型系列目前由四个模型类别组成：Mythos（含 Fable）、Opus、Sonnet 和 Haiku。我们的各类模型既可单独用于特定任务，也可相互组合使用。它们提供了广泛的灵活性，可为每种用例选择理想的性能、成本和速度。所有模型均支持文本、代码和多模态输入。

paras.en: - Mythos (including Fable). Our most capable model class, delivering frontier performance across all domains and solving problems AI has not reliably handled before, especially in coding and long-running agentic tasks. Given its advanced capabilities in sensitive areas like software vulnerability discovery and biology, we deploy this underlying model in two distinct configurations. Fable is generally available and runs with our production safeguards, which block or limit performance on certain sensitive topics, including by routing requests to a less capable Claude model. Mythos runs with safeguards calibrated for vetted organizations and individuals doing cybersecurity and life sciences work, and is available through our trusted-access programs, including our Cyber Verification Program. We first made the class available in April 2026 as Claude Mythos Preview through Project Glasswing, made Fable 5 generally available and offered Mythos 5 to Project Glasswing participants in June 2026, and released Mythos 5.1 and Fable 5.1 in September 2026.
paras.zh: - Mythos（含 Fable）。我们能力最强的模型类别，在所有领域均提供前沿性能，并能解决 AI 此前无法可靠处理的问题，尤其是在编程和长时间运行的智能体任务方面。鉴于其在软件漏洞发现和生物学等敏感领域的先进能力，我们以两种不同的配置部署该底层模型。Fable 已全面开放，并在我们的生产防护措施下运行，这些措施会阻止或限制某些敏感话题上的表现，包括将请求路由至能力较弱的 Claude 模型。Mythos 则在针对从事网络安全和生命科学工作的经审查组织和个人所校准的防护措施下运行，并通过我们的可信访问计划（包括我们的网络验证计划）提供。我们于 2026 年 4 月通过 Project Glasswing 以 Claude Mythos Preview 的形式首次推出该类别，于 2026 年 6 月全面开放 Fable 5 并向 Project Glasswing 参与者提供 Mythos 5，并于 2026 年 9 月发布 Mythos 5.1 和 Fable 5.1。

paras.en: - Opus. Our powerful workhorse model class for reasoning-intensive tasks. Our most recent Opus release, Claude Opus 5.5, is designed to serve as the enterprise daily driver, powering agents that run projects end to end and advancing capabilities across agentic coding, computer use, and knowledge work. Opus models consistently rank among leading models on key industry benchmarks.
paras.zh: - Opus。我们用于推理密集型任务的强大主力模型类别。我们最新的 Opus 版本 Claude Opus 5.5 旨在成为企业的日常主力，驱动端到端运行项目的智能体，并在智能体编程、计算机使用和知识工作方面提升能力。Opus 模型在关键行业基准上始终位居领先模型之列。

paras.en: - Sonnet. Our versatile model class for everyday tasks, providing a balance of performance, cost, and speed for the widest set of general-purpose use cases, including high-volume sub-agents in multi-agent orchestration setups.
paras.zh: - Sonnet。我们用于日常任务的多功能模型类别，为最广泛的通用用例在性能、成本和速度之间提供平衡，包括多智能体编排设置中的高并发子智能体。

paras.en: - Haiku. Our lowest-cost and fastest model class. Haiku models are designed for high-volume workloads like customer service agents and large-scale document processing.
paras.zh: - Haiku。我们成本最低、速度最快的模型类别。Haiku 模型专为高并发工作负载而设计，例如客户服务智能体和大规模文档处理。

paras.en: #### The Claude Platform
paras.zh: #### Claude 平台

paras.en: Customers choose Claude for more than the models. The Claude Platform lets developers and businesses build, manage, and deploy agentic AI applications on infrastructure with high reliability, security, and availability.
paras.zh: 客户选择 Claude 不仅仅是因为模型。Claude 平台让开发者和企业能够在高可靠性、安全性和可用性的基础设施上构建、管理和部署智能体 AI 应用。

paras.en: Platform Features
paras.zh: 平台功能

paras.en: Platform features enable developers to customize their usage of Claude, including:
paras.zh: 平台功能使开发者能够自定义其对 Claude 的使用，包括：

paras.en: - Extended Thinking. Claude can perform additional internal reasoning before producing a final response, working through complex, multi-step problems to improve response quality on tasks like analysis, math, and coding.
paras.zh: - 扩展思考。Claude 可在生成最终回复前执行额外的内部推理，逐步处理复杂的多步骤问题，从而提升分析、数学和编程等任务上的回复质量。

paras.en: - Adaptive Thinking. Claude automatically calibrates whether a given request calls for extended reasoning and how much reasoning to apply—so developers get the benefits of extended reasoning without configuring reasoning levels request by request.
paras.zh: - 自适应思考。Claude 会自动校准某一请求是否需要扩展推理以及应应用多少推理——因此开发者无需逐请求配置推理级别，即可获得扩展推理的益处。

paras.en: - Effort Controls. Developers can specify an effort level on each request to guide how much reasoning Claude applies, allowing them to balance response quality against cost and latency.
paras.zh: - 投入程度控制。开发者可为每个请求指定投入程度级别，以引导 Claude 应用的推理量，从而在回复质量与成本和延迟之间取得平衡。

paras.en: - Tool Use. Claude can natively call external functions and APIs throughout a conversation, with support for parallel execution and interleaved thinking between tool calls. The search tool loads only the tools required for a given task on demand, which can reduce token overhead compared to loading full tool libraries upfront.
paras.zh: - 工具使用。Claude 可在整个对话过程中原生调用外部函数和 API，并支持并行执行以及工具调用之间的交错思考。搜索工具按需仅加载给定任务所需的工具，与预先加载完整工具库相比，可减少 token 开销。

paras.en: - Long Context. Claude supports large context windows and maintains its strong performance even as inputs grow, meaning that developers can include entire codebases, large document sets, or long agent histories in a single request.
paras.zh: - 长上下文。Claude 支持大上下文窗口，并且即使输入不断增长也能保持其强劲性能，这意味着开发者可以在单次请求中包含完整代码库、大型文档集或较长的智能体历史记录。

paras.en: - Structured Outputs. Developers can constrain Claude’s responses to a specified schema, such as valid JSON (JavaScript Object Notation), so results integrate reliably with downstream systems and application code with less additional parsing or validation.
paras.zh: - 结构化输出。开发者可以将 Claude 的响应约束为指定模式，例如有效的 JSON（JavaScript 对象表示法），从而使结果能够与下游系统和应用代码可靠集成，减少额外的解析或验证。

paras.en: - Code Execution. A sandboxed execution environment where Claude can write, run, and iterate on code within an agent loop, which is foundational for data analysis and automation workflows. This environment lets Claude call tools and process large volumes of data more efficiently and run the scripts packaged in Agent Skills.
paras.zh: - 代码执行。一个沙盒化执行环境，Claude 可在智能体循环中编写、运行并迭代代码，这是数据分析和自动化工作流的基础。该环境使 Claude 能够更高效地调用工具、处理海量数据，并运行打包在 Agent Skills 中的脚本。

paras.en: - Web Search. A native tool giving Claude access to real-time web information, enabling grounded, citation-aware responses in production applications.
paras.zh: - 网络搜索。一项原生工具，使 Claude 能够访问实时网络信息，从而在生产应用中提供有依据、可感知引用的响应。

paras.en: - Files API. Allows developers to upload documents once and reference them across multiple sessions, simplifying workflows that depend on persistent documents.
paras.zh: - 文件 API。允许开发者一次上传文档，并在多个会话中引用这些文档，从而简化依赖持久文档的工作流。

paras.en: Context Management
paras.zh: 上下文管理

paras.en: Developers can connect context to Claude for their agents and applications using context primitives.
paras.zh: 开发者可以使用上下文原语将上下文连接到其智能体和应用所用的 Claude。

paras.en: - Model Context Protocol. MCP is an open standard we introduced in November 2024 and donated to the Linux Foundation’s Agentic AI Foundation in December 2025. MCP defines a universal interface through which Claude, as well as other AI tools, can connect to enterprise data sources, tools, and workflows. Claude Platform’s native MCP connector handles connection management, tool discovery, and error handling automatically.
paras.zh: - 模型上下文协议。MCP 是我们于 2024 年 11 月推出、并于 2025 年 12 月捐赠给 Linux 基金会 Agentic AI 基金会的开放标准。MCP 定义了一个通用接口，Claude 以及其他 AI 工具可通过该接口连接企业数据源、工具和工作流。Claude Platform 的原生 MCP 连接器会自动处理连接管理、工具发现和错误处理。

paras.en: - Agent Skills. A modular framework that lets organizations encode repeatable tasks, workflows, and domain expertise into reusable packages, or skills, that Claude loads on demand. We provide pre-built skills for common formats like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF, while custom skills can capture anything from engineering standards and regulatory processes to proprietary toolchains. These skills turn institutional knowledge into agent capabilities.
paras.zh: - Agent Skills。一个模块化框架，使组织能够将可重复的任务、工作流和领域专业知识编码为可复用的包（即技能），由 Claude 按需加载。我们为 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 和 PDF 等常见格式提供预构建技能，而自定义技能可以涵盖从工程标准和监管流程到专有工具链的任何内容。这些技能将机构知识转化为智能体能力。

paras.en: - Model Hardware Standard. Currently in research preview, our Model Hardware Standard enables AI agents to find, understand, and safely operate lab and manufacturing equipment such as microscopes, liquid handlers, and off-the-shelf robotic arms. Our Model Hardware Standard is model-agnostic and lets any agent harness reach devices with a programmable interface through standard protocols such as MCP.
paras.zh: - 模型硬件标准。我们的模型硬件标准目前处于研究预览阶段，使 AI 智能体能够发现、理解并安全操作实验室和制造设备，例如显微镜、液体处理设备和现成机械臂。我们的模型硬件标准与模型无关，允许任何智能体运行环境通过 MCP 等标准协议访问具有可编程接口的设备。

paras.en: Infrastructure
paras.zh: 基础设施

paras.en: The Claude Platform offers high reliability and availability for enterprise-grade agentic workloads. Customers building on Claude need the model served dependably wherever they operate, they need it to run efficiently at scale and speed, and they need the tooling that allows a model to work on its own. We operate that infrastructure so our customers do not have to build and maintain it themselves.
paras.zh: Claude 平台为企业级智能体工作负载提供高可靠性和可用性。基于 Claude 构建应用的客户需要模型在其运营的任何环境中都能可靠地提供服务，需要模型能够以规模化、高速度高效运行，还需要能让模型自主工作的工具。我们负责运营该基础设施，因此客户无需自行构建和维护。

paras.en: - Availability. The Claude Platform is available directly from Anthropic and through the major cloud providers, including AWS, GCP, and Azure. Feature availability varies by deployment.
paras.zh: - 可用性。Claude 平台可直接通过 Anthropic 获取，也可通过主要云服务商获取，包括 AWS、GCP 和 Azure。功能可用性因部署方式而异。

paras.en: - Cost, Speed, and Scale. Developers can tune how Claude runs to fit the performance and economics of each workload:
paras.zh: - 成本、速度和规模。开发者可以调整 Claude 的运行方式，以匹配每项工作负载的性能和经济性：

paras.en: - Prompt Caching. Large, reused prompt components can be cached for up to one hour, reducing cost by up to approximately 97% and latency by approximately 60% for long prompts, compared with processing the same requests without caching.
paras.zh: - 提示缓存。大型、重复使用的提示组件可缓存最长一小时，与不进行缓存处理相同请求相比，长提示的成本最高可降低约 97%，延迟可降低约 60%。

paras.en: - Batch Processing. Enables high-volume asynchronous processing at reduced cost.
paras.zh: - 批处理。支持高吞吐量的异步处理，并降低成本。

paras.en: - Fast Mode. Delivers lower-latency responses for latency-sensitive and interactive applications where speed is critical.
paras.zh: - 快速模式。为对延迟敏感且速度至关重要的交互式应用提供更低延迟的响应。

paras.en: Harnesses
paras.zh: 运行框架（Harnesses）

paras.en: A model alone is not an agent. Running one reliably in production is challenging, because agents must survive crashes and interruptions, act on systems with scoped and auditable credentials, and scale across variable workloads. Autonomous operation requires a harness, which provides the secure environment, credentials, memory, and orchestration loop a model needs to plan, call tools, verify its work, and complete a task safely on its own. Building and operating that infrastructure is specialized, continuous work that, until recently, each customer had to take on themselves. We offer two ways to run a harness on the Claude Platform:
paras.zh: 仅靠模型本身并不构成智能体。在生产环境中可靠运行智能体颇具挑战，因为智能体必须能够在崩溃和中断后继续运行，必须使用具有限定范围且可审计的凭证在系统上执行操作，并且必须能够跨可变工作负载进行扩展。自主运行需要一个运行框架，它提供模型自主规划、调用工具、验证工作并安全完成任务所需的安全环境、凭证、记忆和编排循环。构建和运营该基础设施是一项专业化、持续性的工作，直到最近，每位客户都必须自行承担。我们提供两种在 Claude 平台上运行框架的方式：

paras.en: - Agent SDK. This solution makes the same production-grade harness that powers Claude Code available to all developers, to run on their own compute. It provides built-in context management, session handling, multi-agent coordination, and prompt optimization, so customers can build and run sophisticated agents on their own infrastructure in a fraction of the time otherwise required.
paras.zh: - Agent SDK。该方案使驱动 Claude Code 的同一生产级框架可供所有开发者使用，并在其自有算力上运行。它提供内置的上下文管理、会话处理、多智能体协调和提示优化，使客户能够在自有基础设施上以远少于原本所需的时间构建和运行复杂的智能体。

paras.en: - Claude Managed Agents. An out-of-the-box solution in which we operate the harness on our customers’ behalf, on Anthropic-managed compute. We host the sandboxes, store the credentials, maintain the memory, and run the agent loop; customers define their agent’s tasks, tools, and guardrails. When a new model becomes available, customers do not need to rebuild their agent loop.
paras.zh: - Claude 托管智能体。这是一种开箱即用的方案，由我们在 Anthropic 管理的算力上代表客户运营框架。我们托管沙箱、存储凭证、维护记忆并运行智能体循环；客户定义其智能体的任务、工具和护栏。当有新模型可用时，客户无需重建其智能体循环。

paras.en: #### Direct Applications and Integrations
paras.zh: #### 直接应用与集成

paras.en: Our platform primitives and models are the foundation for all of our products and support a wide range of use cases, from coding agents to specialized products in life sciences, finance, security, and more. Paired with our deep understanding of current and future capabilities of our models, this foundation allows us to rapidly deliver products that unlock value across many user types and workflows.
paras.zh: 我们的平台基础组件和模型是所有产品的基础，并支持广泛的使用场景，从编程智能体到生命科学、金融、安全等领域的专业产品。结合我们对模型当前及未来能力的深刻理解，这一基础使我们能够快速交付产品，为众多用户类型和工作流程释放价值。

paras.en: - Claude Code. A coding agent, available as a terminal tool, desktop app, web interface, and mobile app, with native integrations for GitHub and popular IDEs (Integrated Development Environments). Claude Code handles multi-step software development tasks—planning, writing, editing, testing, debugging, and committing code—across large codebases with sustained context and supports parallel agent sessions, so a single developer can keep multiple tasks moving in parallel.
paras.zh: - Claude Code。一款编码智能体，可作为终端工具、桌面应用、网页界面和移动应用使用，并原生集成 GitHub 及主流 IDE（集成开发环境）。Claude Code 可在大型代码库中处理多步骤软件开发任务——规划、编写、编辑、测试、调试和提交代码——并保持持续的上下文，同时支持并行智能体会话，使单个开发者能够并行推进多项任务。

paras.en: - Claude Cowork. A knowledge work agent on desktop, web, and mobile, built on Claude Code’s agentic architecture. Users describe a task in plain language and Claude breaks it into steps and completes them across local files, connected apps, Chrome, and the desktop itself, clicking and typing through native applications when no integration exists. It returns finished documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and organized folders, with no terminal or code required. An open-source plugin system lets users install or build packages bundling skills, data connectors, and workflows.
paras.zh: - Claude Cowork。一款知识工作智能体，可在桌面、网页和移动端使用，基于 Claude Code 的智能体架构构建。用户用自然语言描述任务，Claude 将其拆解为步骤，并在本地文件、已连接的应用、Chrome 以及桌面本身中完成这些步骤；在不存在集成的情况下，它会通过点击和键入操作原生应用。它返回完成的文档、电子表格、演示文稿和整理好的文件夹，无需终端或代码。开源插件系统让用户可以安装或构建打包了技能、数据连接器和工作流的软件包。

paras.en: - Claude.ai. Our flagship conversational product, available on desktop, web, and mobile. Claude.ai is the broadest entry point to Claude, available to enterprises, teams, and individuals, offering access across our Claude model family with support for file uploads, projects for persistent context across conversations, memory, web search, and artifacts for real-time code and document rendering. Claude.ai delivers top-of-funnel demand generation for enterprise adoption. In September 2026, we began merging Claude Cowork and Claude.ai into a unified application, such that any request is automatically handled using the appropriate tools, drawing on Claude Cowork’s capabilities.
paras.zh: - Claude.ai。我们的旗舰对话产品，可在桌面、网页和移动端使用。Claude.ai 是通往 Claude 最广泛的入口，面向企业、团队和个人开放，提供对我们 Claude 模型系列的访问，支持文件上传、用于跨对话持久上下文的项目、记忆、网页搜索，以及用于实时渲染代码和文档的 artifacts。Claude.ai 为企业采用带来漏斗顶部的需求生成。2026 年 9 月，我们开始将 Claude Cowork 和 Claude.ai 合并为一个统一应用，使任何请求都借助 Claude Cowork 的能力、使用适当的工具自动处理。

paras.en: - Claude Security. A defensive cybersecurity product, available in public beta to Claude Enterprise customers, that puts frontier vulnerability detection and patching into the hands of security teams. Claude Security reasons about code the way a security researcher does, tracing data flows and examining how components interact across a codebase to uncover complex, context-dependent vulnerabilities that pattern-based scanners can miss. Each finding is surfaced with a confidence rating, severity assessment, and reproduction steps. Users can move directly into Claude Code to review and apply the proposed patch, compressing the time from scan to fix.
paras.zh: - Claude Security。一款防御性网络安全产品，以公开测试版向 Claude Enterprise 客户提供，将前沿漏洞检测与修补能力交到安全团队手中。Claude Security 像安全研究员一样推理代码，追踪数据流并检查组件在代码库中的交互方式，以发现基于模式的扫描器可能遗漏的复杂、依赖上下文的漏洞。每项发现都会附带置信度评级、严重性评估和复现步骤。用户可以直接进入 Claude Code 审查并应用建议的补丁，从而压缩从扫描到修复的时间。

paras.en: - Claude Tag. A collaborative agent that works alongside teams in productivity tools like Slack where users tag Claude into any channel or thread and delegate work in plain language. With the context of the surrounding conversation, enterprise software tools, shared documents, and channel-scoped memory, Claude returns answers, drafts, analyses, and pull requests directly in-thread, operating as an ambient teammate that knows when to proactively join the conversation. Claude Tag brings Claude into the multiplayer workflows where teams already coordinate, extending adoption from individuals to entire organizations.
paras.zh: - Claude Tag。一款协作智能体，在 Slack 等生产力工具中与团队并肩工作，用户可将 Claude 标记到任何频道或话题串中，并用自然语言委派工作。借助周围对话、企业软件工具、共享文档和频道范围内的记忆所提供的上下文，Claude 直接在话题串中返回答案、草稿、分析和拉取请求，作为一个环境型队友运作，知道何时主动加入对话。Claude Tag 将 Claude 带入团队已经协作的多方工作流，将采用范围从个人扩展到整个组织。

paras.en: - Claude Design. Enables users to create polished designs, prototypes, presentations, and other visual work through natural language conversation and direct editing. Claude Design extends our platform into visual and creative work, broadening the range of professional tasks for which designers, marketers, founders, and go-to-market professionals can utilize Claude.
paras.zh: - Claude Design。使用户能够通过自然语言对话和直接编辑，创建精美的设计、原型、演示文稿及其他视觉作品。Claude Design 将我们的平台延伸至视觉与创意工作领域，拓宽了设计师、营销人员、创始人及市场推广专业人士可借助 Claude 完成的专业任务范围。

paras.en: - Claude Science. An AI workbench for scientific research that brings literature analysis, data processing, and manuscript preparation into a single desktop environment. Researchers describe an analysis in plain language, and Claude Science queries more than 60 scientific databases to complete it end-to-end. Claude Science executes computationally intensive workloads on a lab’s own machines, institutional computing clusters, or on-demand cloud resources, without requiring researchers to manage the underlying infrastructure. It returns publication-ready figures and manuscripts—with natively rendered scientific outputs, fully reproducible code, agent-powered verification, and traceable results. Claude Science extends Claude into scientific research, putting frontier capabilities directly in the hands of researchers working on some of the world’s hardest problems.
paras.zh: - Claude Science。一个用于科学研究的 AI 工作台，将文献分析、数据处理和稿件准备整合到单一的桌面环境中。研究人员用自然语言描述一项分析，Claude Science 便会查询 60 多个科学数据库，端到端地完成该分析。Claude Science 可在实验室自有机器、机构计算集群或按需云资源上执行计算密集型工作负载，无需研究人员管理底层基础设施。它返回可直接发表的图表和稿件——具备原生渲染的科学输出、完全可复现的代码、由智能体驱动的验证以及可追溯的结果。Claude Science 将 Claude 延伸至科学研究领域，把前沿能力直接交到致力于解决全球一些最棘手问题的研究人员手中。

paras.en: Customers can access each of these products through our Claude Enterprise offering. Claude Enterprise provides security and compliance controls, including SAML (Security Assertion Markup Language)-based single sign-on with SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management) provisioning, role-based access controls, audit logging, a Compliance API, and configurations designed to support Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (“HIPAA”) compliance for healthcare and regulated-data workloads—alongside a centralized administrative console for IT oversight, cost visibility, and controls.
paras.zh: 客户可通过我们的 Claude Enterprise 产品访问上述每一项产品。Claude Enterprise 提供安全与合规控制，包括基于 SAML（安全断言标记语言）的单点登录及 SCIM（跨域身份管理系统）配置、基于角色的访问控制、审计日志、合规 API，以及旨在支持医疗保健和受监管数据工作负载符合 1996 年《健康保险流通与责任法案》（“HIPAA”）的配置——同时提供集中式管理控制台，用于 IT 监督、成本可见性和控制。

paras.en: Customers in regulated industries and beyond use our most capable models for sensitive work. These customers must keep their data private, and we must be able to detect misuse. In September 2026, we announced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, which is designed to address both needs. The activity data we use for automated safety monitoring is stored in the customer’s own cloud account, under the customer’s encryption keys and access controls. Our automated systems review recent activity for signs of serious misuse and send alerts of such misuse directly to the customer’s security team. No review by Anthropic employees is required. We developed Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with more than 100 customers in industries including financial services, healthcare, and the public sector. We are rolling out this feature in phases and, until the completion of the rollout, eligible customers receive zero data retention on Fable 5 and Fable 5.1, meaning that, except where needed to comply with applicable law or combat misuse or harm, we do not store their inputs or outputs after we process a request.
paras.zh: 受监管行业及其他行业的客户使用我们能力最强的模型处理敏感工作。这些客户必须对其数据保密，而我们必须能够检测滥用行为。2026 年 9 月，我们发布了 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards，旨在同时满足这两项需求。我们用于自动化安全监控的活动数据存储在客户自己的云账户中，由客户自己的加密密钥和访问控制加以保护。我们的自动化系统会审查近期活动是否存在严重滥用迹象，并将此类滥用警报直接发送给客户的安全团队。无需 Anthropic 员工进行审查。我们与金融服务、医疗保健和公共部门等行业的 100 多家客户共同开发了 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards。我们正分阶段推出该功能，在推出完成之前，符合条件的客户在 Fable 5 和 Fable 5.1 上享有零数据留存，这意味着，除为遵守适用法律或打击滥用或伤害所需外，我们在处理请求后不存储其输入或输出。

paras.en: #### Vertical Solutions
paras.zh: #### 垂直解决方案

paras.en: Beyond our horizontal platform and applications, we are building vertical solutions in industries where domain specificity and regulatory requirements make general-purpose tools insufficient. Our vertical solutions arrive purpose-built and are embedded with domain knowledge, controls designed to support industry-specific compliance requirements, and pre-configured data integrations that reduce time-to-value. Our vertical solutions are delivered through a range of channels, including our Claude Enterprise and Team plans, domain-specific connectors and plugins available on our individual subscription plans, Claude Platform, and, in the case of Claude for Education, institution-wide agreements. To date, we have launched seven vertical solutions:
paras.zh: 除了我们的横向平台和应用之外，我们还在那些领域专业性和监管要求使通用工具不足以胜任的行业中构建垂直解决方案。我们的垂直解决方案是专门构建的，内嵌领域知识、旨在支持行业特定合规要求的控制措施，以及预先配置的数据集成，从而缩短实现价值的时间。我们的垂直解决方案通过一系列渠道交付，包括我们的 Claude Enterprise 和 Team 计划、在我们个人订阅计划上提供的领域特定连接器和插件、Claude Platform，以及就 Claude for Education 而言的机构级协议。迄今为止，我们已推出七款垂直解决方案：

paras.en: - Claude for Financial Services. Provides finance professionals with pre-built, customizable AI agents for common finance workflows, such as drafting pitch books, reviewing earnings, running know-your-customer screenings, and conducting financial analysis. Claude for Financial Services plugs directly into the data sources those firms already use (e.g., market data, data warehouses) and runs inside the tools financial professionals utilize—such as Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Claude’s own apps.
paras.zh: - Claude for Financial Services。为金融专业人士提供预构建、可定制的 AI 智能体，用于常见金融工作流程，例如起草推介材料、审阅财报、执行了解你的客户筛查以及开展财务分析。Claude for Financial Services 可直接接入这些公司已在使用的数据源（例如市场数据、数据仓库），并在金融专业人士所使用的工具内运行——例如 Excel、PowerPoint、Word、Outlook 以及 Claude 自有应用。

paras.en: - Claude for Financial Advisors. Provides financial advisors and wealth management firms with pre-built, customizable workflows for common advisory tasks, such as preparing for client meetings, drafting follow-ups, reviewing portfolio rebalances, and preparing estate and tax briefs. Claude for Financial Advisors plugs directly into the systems advisors already use (e.g., custodial platforms, portfolio management and financial planning tools, and customer relationship management software), with advisor review built into each workflow to help firms meet their compliance requirements.
paras.zh: - Claude for Financial Advisors。为财务顾问和财富管理公司提供预构建、可定制的工作流程，用于常见顾问任务，例如准备客户会议、起草跟进事项、审阅投资组合再平衡以及准备遗产和税务简报。Claude for Financial Advisors 可直接接入顾问已在使用的系统（例如托管平台、投资组合管理和财务规划工具以及客户关系管理软件），并在每个工作流程中内置顾问审核环节，以帮助公司满足其合规要求。

paras.en: - Claude for Healthcare. Gives providers, payers, and health technology companies frontier models with domain intelligence across clinical reasoning, medical coding, and long-horizon agentic operations and tools designed to support HIPAA compliance for medical and operational workflows. Claude for Healthcare also connects to industry systems including the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Coverage Database, ICD-10, and National Provider Identifier (NPI) Registry, with agent skills for Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) development and prior authorization reviews.
paras.zh: - Claude for Healthcare。为医疗服务提供方、支付方和健康科技公司提供前沿模型，具备跨临床推理、医疗编码和长周期智能体运营的领域智能，以及旨在支持医疗和运营工作流程符合 HIPAA 合规要求的工具。Claude for Healthcare 还可连接行业系统，包括 Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Coverage Database、ICD-10 和 National Provider Identifier (NPI) Registry，并具备用于 Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources（FHIR）开发和事前授权审查的智能体技能。

paras.en: - Claude for Life Sciences. Provides computational biologists, bioinformaticians, clinical trial managers, and regulatory affairs specialists with domain intelligence built into frontier models across organic chemistry, structural biology, lab protocols, and bioinformatics pipelines. Claude for Life Sciences supports work across the development chain, from early discovery and preclinical research through clinical trial operations and regulatory submissions. Claude plugs directly into the tools and databases researchers already use, such as electronic lab notebooks, data repositories, and scientific literature.
paras.zh: - Claude for Life Sciences。为计算生物学家、生物信息学家、临床试验管理者和监管事务专家提供前沿模型中内置的领域智能，涵盖有机化学、结构生物学、实验室方案和生物信息学流程。Claude for Life Sciences 支持整个开发链条上的工作，从早期发现和临床前研究到临床试验运营和监管申报。Claude 可直接接入研究人员已在使用的工具和数据库，例如电子实验记录本、数据存储库和科学文献。

paras.en: - Claude for Legal. Provides legal professionals, in-house counsel, law firm attorneys, and legal operations teams with pre-built AI agents for common legal workflows. Claude for Legal plugs directly into the systems and tools legal professionals already rely on. Through MCP connectors, Claude for Legal connects to e-discovery and legal data intelligence platforms like Relativity, AI contracting platforms like Ironclad, legal research databases, deal rooms, and matter management systems. Each agent and workflow is configurable to a team’s own precedents, processes, escalation chains, risk calibration, and house style—with controls designed to support attorney-client privilege, ethical walls, and confidentiality obligations.
paras.zh: - Claude for Legal。为法律专业人士、内部法律顾问、律所律师及法律运营团队提供预置 AI 智能体，用于常见法律工作流程。Claude for Legal 可直接接入法律专业人士日常依赖的系统与工具。通过 MCP 连接器，Claude for Legal 可连接至 Relativity 等电子取证与法律数据智能平台、Ironclad 等 AI 合同平台、法律研究数据库、交易室及案件管理系统。每个智能体和工作流程均可根据团队自身的先例、流程、上报链条、风险校准和内部风格进行配置，并配有旨在支持律师-客户保密特权、信息隔离墙及保密义务的管控措施。

paras.en: - Claude for Education. Provides trusted AI solutions for higher education institutions and K-12 educators. Claude for Higher Education gives faculty, students, researchers, and administrators an AI partner for teaching, learning, research, and operations. This includes a learning mode for students, which is designed to strengthen critical thinking. Claude also helps university faculty across tasks such as research, drafting assignments, and supporting administrative work, all with the security and compliance built for institutional requirements. Claude for Teachers gives verified K-12 educators in the United States free access to premium Claude capabilities, a library of teaching skills, and a direct connection to evidence-based curricula, mapped to academic standards in all 50 states. Claude helps with the paperwork, so teachers can spend more time with their students.
paras.zh: - Claude for Education。为高等教育机构和 K-12 教育工作者提供可信赖的 AI 解决方案。Claude for Higher Education 为教职员工、学生、研究人员和管理人员提供用于教学、学习、研究和运营的 AI 伙伴。其中包括面向学生的学习模式，旨在强化批判性思维。Claude 还可帮助高校教职员工完成研究、起草作业及支持行政工作等任务，并具备为满足机构要求而构建的安全性与合规性。Claude for Teachers 为美国经过验证的 K-12 教育工作者免费提供高级 Claude 功能、教学技能库，以及与循证课程的直接连接，并已映射至全部 50 个州的学术标准。Claude 帮助处理文书工作，让教师能够将更多时间投入到学生身上。

paras.en: - Claude for Government. Brings Claude models to U.S. government agencies for drafting, research, analysis, and coding in a FedRAMP High authorized environment, designed to support the data handling and auditability requirements of government customers. Government customers outside the United States, and customers with workloads in classified environments, can access Claude models through Amazon Bedrock, subject to the authorizations and availability of that platform.
paras.zh: - Claude for Government。在 FedRAMP High 授权环境中，将 Claude 模型引入美国联邦政府机构，用于起草、研究、分析和编码，旨在支持政府客户的数据处理和可审计性要求。美国境外的政府客户以及在涉密环境中运行工作负载的客户，可通过 Amazon Bedrock 访问 Claude 模型，但须遵守该平台的授权和可用性要求。

paras.en: Our infrastructure underpins our ability to train frontier models, serve inference at scale, manage internal usage of Claude, and deliver Claude to our customers with the performance and reliability that enterprise deployments require. We have built a differentiated infrastructure layer that allows us to train and deploy frontier models more efficiently across multiple hardware platforms. This infrastructure advantage compounds over time: as we bring optimizations to each chip family, every layer of our system benefits accordingly.
paras.zh: 我们的基础设施支撑着我们训练前沿模型、大规模提供推理服务、管理 Claude 的内部使用，并以企业级部署所需的性能和可靠性向客户交付 Claude 的能力。我们构建了差异化的基础设施层，使我们能够跨多个硬件平台更高效地训练和部署前沿模型。这一基础设施优势会随时间不断累积：随着我们为每个芯片系列带来优化，我们系统的每一层都会相应受益。

paras.en: #### Multi-Chip Compute Approach
paras.zh: #### 多芯片算力方案

paras.en: We have built a deliberate and diversified compute sourcing strategy across multiple chip platforms that provides the following distinct advantages:
paras.zh: 我们构建了审慎且多元化的算力采购策略，覆盖多个芯片平台，带来以下显著优势：

paras.en: - We can secure compute from multiple providers rather than being constrained by any single provider.
paras.zh: - 我们可以从多个供应商获取算力，而不受任何单一供应商的制约。

paras.en: - We can select chips based on the best price-performance and efficiency characteristics for each workload, benefiting from the differentiated strengths of each platform.
paras.zh: - 我们可以根据每种工作负载的最佳性价比和效率特征选择芯片，受益于各平台的差异化优势。

paras.en: - We maintain collaborative relationships with each of our providers, and we influence roadmaps and features of future chip generations. Our chip platforms include:
paras.zh: - 我们与每一家供应商都保持协作关系，并影响未来几代芯片的路线图和功能。我们的芯片平台包括：

paras.en: - AWS Trainium. Our strategic collaboration with Amazon provides us with access to AI accelerators, including custom-designed Trainium chips, and compute infrastructure, as well as the opportunity to influence future generations of Trainium chips.
paras.zh: - AWS Trainium。我们与 Amazon 的战略协作使我们能够获得 AI 加速器（包括定制设计的 Trainium 芯片）和算力基础设施，并有机会影响未来几代 Trainium 芯片。

paras.en: - Google TPUs. Our partnerships with Google and Broadcom provide us with access to compute capacity powered by Google TPUs across multiple generations of the TPU platform.
paras.zh: - Google TPU。我们与 Google 和 Broadcom 的合作使我们能够获得由 Google TPU 驱动的算力容量，覆盖 TPU 平台的多个世代。

paras.en: - NVIDIA GPUs. Our strategic partnership with NVIDIA Corporation (“NVIDIA”), together with our arrangements with Microsoft, SpaceXAI, Nscale, Lambda, and other cloud providers, provides us with access to compute capacity powered by NVIDIA GPUs, including NVIDIA Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin GPU systems, as well as the opportunity to collaborate directly with NVIDIA on design and engineering to optimize future NVIDIA hardware for our workload profile.
paras.zh: - NVIDIA GPU。我们与 NVIDIA Corporation（「NVIDIA」）的战略合作，连同我们与 Microsoft、SpaceXAI、Nscale、Lambda 及其他云服务商的安排，使我们能够获得由 NVIDIA GPU（包括 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell 和 Vera Rubin GPU 系统）驱动的算力容量，并有机会直接与 NVIDIA 在设计 and 工程方面协作，针对我们的工作负载特征优化未来的 NVIDIA 硬件。

paras.en: - AMD GPUs. Our relationship with AMD, together with our arrangements with approved manufacturers of AMD-based Helios rack-scale systems and third-party service providers, provides us with access to compute capacity powered by AMD Instinct™ GPUs, including AMD Instinct™ MI450 Series GPUs, as well as the opportunity to collaborate directly with AMD through a multi-year engineering collaboration.
paras.zh: - AMD GPU。我们与 AMD 的关系，连同我们与经批准的 AMD 架构 Helios 机架级系统制造商及第三方服务提供商的安排，使我们能够获得由 AMD Instinct™ GPU（包括 AMD Instinct™ MI450 系列 GPU）驱动的算力容量，并有机会通过多年工程协作直接与 AMD 合作。

paras.en: - We can onboard new chip platforms in a fraction of the time it once took. Historically, bringing a new chip platform into production required intense engineering effort over many months. By leveraging Claude, our engineering teams can now bring new chip platforms into production more quickly. This speed and efficiency also relies on the robust foundation we have already built across multiple chip families, including a proprietary orchestration layer designed to seamlessly test and measure performance against our actual workloads. As a result, we are able to adopt new AI accelerators as they become available, expanding our access to compute capacity while reducing our dependence on any single hardware provider.
paras.zh: - 我们接入新芯片平台所需的时间仅为过去的一小部分。历史上，将一个新的芯片平台投入生产需要数月的高强度工程工作。借助 Claude，我们的工程团队如今可以更快地将新芯片平台投入生产。这种速度和效率还依赖于我们已在多个芯片系列上构建的坚实基础，包括一个专有的编排层，旨在针对我们的实际工作负载无缝测试和衡量性能。因此，我们能够在新的 AI 加速器面世时加以采用，扩大算力容量的获取渠道，同时降低对任何单一硬件供应商的依赖。

paras.en: See the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations —Liquidity and Capital Resources—Contractual Obligations—Infrastructure Service Arrangements” for more information regarding the terms of these arrangements.
paras.zh: 有关该等安排条款的更多信息，请参见“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——流动性与资本资源——合同义务——基础设施服务安排”一节。

paras.en: #### Our Data Center Strategy
paras.zh: #### 我们的数据中心战略

paras.en: Historically, we purchased compute under fixed-time agreements. As our compute requirements have scaled, we have transitioned to a hybrid model in which, in addition to purchasing compute as a cloud service, we also procure specialized AI accelerators directly and operate this hardware in dedicated data center facilities leased and operated on our behalf, to our specification. We refer to this additional source of compute as Anthropic Direct. This transition is driven in part by the scale of our compute requirements as well as the potential long-term economic advantages of direct infrastructure leasing and hosting. Our first data center facility became operational this year.
paras.zh: 历史上，我们通过固定期限协议购买算力。随着算力需求规模扩大，我们已转向混合模式：除作为云服务购买算力外，我们还直接采购专用 AI 加速器，并在由他人代表我们租赁和运营、按我们规格配置的专用数据中心设施中运行这些硬件。我们将这一额外算力来源称为 Anthropic Direct。这一转变部分源于我们算力需求的规模，以及直接租赁和托管基础设施可能带来的长期经济优势。我们的首个数据中心设施已于今年投入运营。

paras.en: Anthropic Direct also lets us separate our commitment to data center capacity from our commitment to the AI accelerators deployed inside it. Because data centers require longer lead times but represent a smaller fraction of total compute costs, this approach enables us to secure data center capacity early while deferring larger accelerator investments until our specific compute needs are more certain.
paras.zh: Anthropic Direct 还使我们能够将对数据中心容量的承诺与对部署于其中的 AI 加速器的承诺相分离。由于数据中心需要更长的交付周期，但在总算力成本中所占比例较小，这一方式使我们能够提前锁定数据中心容量，同时将规模更大的加速器投资推迟到我们的具体算力需求更加明确之时。

paras.en: Our data center infrastructure strategy includes several contractual arrangements that, taken together, form a new source of compute to supplement the capacity we procure from our CSPs. Such arrangements include the following:
paras.zh: 我们的数据中心基础设施战略包含多项合同安排，这些安排共同构成新的算力来源，以补充我们从云服务商（CSP）处采购的容量。此类安排包括以下各项：

paras.en: - Compute Infrastructure Equipment. We procure specialized AI accelerators and associated components, including CPUs and high-bandwidth memory, through master equipment leases, including the 2026 Lease Arrangement, pursuant to which we receive such hardware for deployment in dedicated data center facilities operated by others on our behalf. See the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Liquidity and Capital Resources—Contractual Obligations—Infrastructure Equipment Leases” for more information regarding the terms of these leases.
paras.zh: - 算力基础设施设备。我们通过主设备租赁协议采购专用 AI 加速器及相关组件（包括 CPU 和高带宽内存），其中包括 2026 年租赁安排；根据该安排，我们获得此类硬件，用于部署在由他人代表我们运营的专用数据中心设施中。有关该等租赁条款的更多信息，请参见“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——流动性与资本资源——合同义务——基础设施设备租赁”一节。

paras.en: - Data Centers. In certain of our data center infrastructure arrangements, third-party partners procure the underlying real estate, power, and data center facilities, while we lease capacity in those facilities and contract with specialized third-party operators for ongoing facility management. For example, we have entered into a colocation and services agreement with Fluidstack USA I Inc. (“Fluidstack”), under which Fluidstack provides data center development and operations services to us. We have also executed data center leases directly and expect to do so increasingly over time. To secure certain data center development projects, which require significant capital commitments in advance of deployment, we have in some cases relied, and expect to continue to rely, on arrangements with financing sources or partners who guarantee the lease obligations to support the development of data center capacity that is expected to host such partner’s chips or computing infrastructure. Our ability to expand compute and infrastructure capacity through these arrangements in the future may depend on the continued willingness and ability of a limited number of CSPs, partners, and financing sources to enter into and perform under them.
paras.zh: - 数据中心。在我们的某些数据中心基础设施安排中，第三方合作伙伴负责采购底层房地产、电力及数据中心设施，而我们则租赁这些设施中的容量，并与专业第三方运营商签订合同以进行持续的设施管理。例如，我们已与 Fluidstack USA I Inc.（“Fluidstack”）签订了一份托管及服务协议，由 Fluidstack 向我们提供数据中心开发与运营服务。我们还直接签署了数据中心租约，并预计未来会越来越多地采取这种方式。为锁定某些数据中心开发项目（这些项目需要在部署前作出重大资本承诺），我们在某些情况下已依赖、并预计将继续依赖与融资方或合作伙伴的安排，由后者为租赁义务提供担保，以支持预计将承载该合作伙伴芯片或计算基础设施的数据中心容量的开发。我们未来通过此类安排扩大算力及基础设施容量的能力，可能取决于有限数量的云服务商（CSP）、合作伙伴及融资方是否持续愿意并有能力订立并履行相关安排。

paras.en: - Electrical Power. Electrical power procurement requires separate arrangements with utility providers or, in some cases, development of behind-the-meter power generation capacity that supplies electricity directly to the facility rather than through the broader electric grid. Securing adequate power capacity for data center projects, whether through grid-connected or behind-the-meter arrangements, typically requires long lead times and significant financial commitments well in advance of when facilities become operational.
paras.zh: - 电力。电力采购需要与公用事业供应商另行作出安排，或在某些情况下开发表后发电容量，直接向设施供电而非通过更广泛的电网供电。为数据中心项目确保充足的电力容量，无论是通过并网安排还是表后安排，通常都需要较长的前置时间，并须在设施投入运营之前很早就作出重大财务承诺。

paras.en: Our data center infrastructure projects are currently located primarily in the United States. As we continue to expand our global customer base and research operations, we are pursuing additional data center capacity internationally to support our full range of workloads.
paras.zh: 我们的数据中心基础设施项目目前主要位于美国。随着我们持续扩大全球客户群和研究业务，我们正在国际上寻求更多的数据中心容量，以支持我们的各类工作负载。

paras.en: #### Multi-Cloud Distribution
paras.zh: #### 多云分发

paras.en: Claude is available across the three major cloud platforms via their dedicated AI service layers (Amazon Bedrock, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry), ensuring that organizations can deploy our models within the infrastructure they already use and trust, while providing enterprises with deployment flexibility and avoiding vendor lock-in.
paras.zh: Claude 可通过三大云平台的专用 AI 服务层（Amazon Bedrock、Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 和 Microsoft Foundry）获取，确保各组织能够在其已使用且信任的基础设施内部署我们的模型，同时为企业提供部署灵活性并避免供应商锁定。

paras.en: Organizations around the world rely on Claude. We serve a breadth of customers, from the largest enterprises to AI-native companies, government and research institutions, as well as prosumers.
paras.zh: 世界各地的组织都依赖 Claude。我们服务的客户范围广泛，从最大的企业到 AI 原生公司、政府与研究机构，以及专业消费者。

paras.en: As of September 30, 2026, our customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis included every company in the Fortune 10, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and over 30% of the Global 2000. Across industries, enterprises deploy Claude in mission-critical production workflows—for example, underwriting insurance policies, writing clinical reports for life-saving drugs, detecting and remediating cybersecurity threats, and analyzing portfolios for asset managers. Claude has achieved particularly deep adoption in highly regulated sectors where the cost of unreliable AI is prohibitive and trust cannot be retrofitted.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，按过去十二个月（TTM）计算收入达到或超过 $100,000 的客户包括《财富》10 强中的每一家公司、《财富》500 强中超过 50% 的公司，以及全球 2000 强中超过 30% 的公司。在各行各业，企业都将 Claude 部署于关键任务的生产工作流中——例如承保保险保单、为救命药物撰写临床报告、检测并修复网络安全威胁，以及为资产管理人分析投资组合。Claude 在监管严格的行业尤其获得了深度采用，在这些行业中，AI 不可靠的代价高得令人却步，而信任无法事后补足。

paras.en: In addition, leading AI-native companies build next-generation coding tools, design platforms, and productivity applications on Claude. Government and research institutions also apply Claude to work that ranges from materials science to energy security; mission-driven organizations use Claude to compress the expected timeline of scientific research, clinical workflows, and the delivery of public benefits.
paras.zh: 此外，领先的 AI 原生公司在 Claude 之上构建下一代编程工具、设计平台和生产力应用。政府与研究机构也将 Claude 应用于从材料科学到能源安全的工作；使命驱动的组织使用 Claude 来压缩科学研究、临床工作流和公共福利交付的预期时间线。

paras.en: Our customer base has grown rapidly in both the number and scale of customer relationships, with organizations expanding from initial use cases into enterprise-wide production deployments. As of September 30, 2026, we had more than 11,900 customers with $100,000 or more of revenue on a TTM basis, up from more than 950 as of September 30, 2025.
paras.zh: 我们的客户群在客户关系的数量和规模上均快速增长，各组织从初始用例扩展到全企业范围的生产部署。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，按过去十二个月（TTM）计算收入达到或超过 $100,000 的客户超过 11,900 家，而截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日超过 950 家。

paras.en: Our customers fall into two primary categories: enterprises and prosumers.
paras.zh: 我们的客户分为两大类：企业和专业消费者。

paras.en: #### Enterprises

Our enterprise customers include a wide range of organizations deploying AI at scale, from AI-native startups building products to the world’s largest organizations that require enterprise-grade security, governance, and compliance before a single workflow impacts production. We serve this full spectrum from a single composable platform, providing frictionless access to our frontier models as well as the controls customers require, such as single sign-on, audit logging, data retention policies, role-based access controls, and native deployment within their existing cloud infrastructure.
paras.zh: 我们的企业客户包括各类大规模部署 AI 的组织，从构建产品的 AI 原生初创公司，到在任何一个工作流投入生产之前就要求企业级安全性、治理和合规的全球最大型组织。我们通过单一可组合平台服务这一完整谱系，提供对我们前沿模型的无缝访问，以及客户所需的控制措施，例如单点登录、审计日志、数据保留策略、基于角色的访问控制，以及在其现有云基础设施内的原生部署。

paras.en: Software developers remain a critical adoption force within enterprises: they are simultaneously customers, the architects of applications built on our platform, and the internal champions of organization-wide adoption. Software developers use Claude Code and the Claude Platform to write, debug, and ship production-quality code faster—architecting systems, implementing features, building agentic workflows, and resolving complex issues in hours that previously took days. These production deployments surface the governance, reliability, and integration requirements that only emerge under real enterprise load, which creates feedback that flows back into our roadmap and deepens our customer relationships with every release.
paras.zh: 软件开发者仍然是企业内关键的采用推动力量：他们同时是客户、在我们平台上构建的应用的架构师，以及组织范围内采用的内部倡导者。软件开发者使用 Claude Code 和 Claude Platform 更快地编写、调试和交付生产级代码——设计系统架构、实现功能、构建智能体工作流，并在数小时内解决以往需要数天的复杂问题。这些生产部署暴露出只有在真实企业负载下才会出现的治理、可靠性和集成要求，由此产生的反馈回流到我们的路线图中，并在每一次发布中加深我们与客户的关系。

paras.en: #### Prosumers
paras.zh: #### 专业消费者
