paras.en: Knowledge workers, including researchers, developers, analysts, and writers, subscribe to Claude Pro and Claude Max to perform complex cognitive work, including drafting analyses, synthesizing research, writing and reviewing code, building financial models, and automating workflows. With Claude Cowork, non-technical prosumers build agentic workflows across their applications without writing code, accomplishing in minutes what previously required hours of manual effort.
paras.zh: 知识工作者，包括研究人员、开发者、分析师和撰稿人，订阅 Claude Pro 和 Claude Max 以完成复杂的认知工作，包括起草分析、综合研究、编写和审查代码、构建财务模型以及自动化工作流程。借助 Claude Cowork，非技术型专业消费者无需编写代码即可跨其应用程序构建智能体工作流，在几分钟内完成以往需要数小时人工操作才能完成的工作。

paras.en: Prosumers are some of our earliest adopters and often among our most discerning users. They test out capabilities within hours of the release of a model, push the latest version of Claude into use cases we may not have anticipated, and discover edge cases and failures that sharpen each successive version of a Claude model.
paras.zh: 专业消费者是我们最早的一批采用者，也往往是我们最具洞察力的用户之一。他们会在模型发布后数小时内测试各项能力，将最新版本的 Claude 推入我们可能未曾预料的用例，并发现边缘情况和失败案例，从而推动 Claude 模型的每一个后续版本不断完善。

paras.en: The adoption of Claude Code began with individual software developers who noticed the potential of autonomous coding agents before enterprise procurement teams had considered the category; Claude Code is now becoming the default choice inside many enterprise engineering organizations.
paras.zh: Claude Code 的采用始于个体软件开发者，他们在企业采购团队考虑这一品类之前就注意到了自主编程智能体的潜力；如今，Claude Code 正成为许多企业工程组织内部的首选。

paras.en: Prosumers serve as a powerful top-of-funnel engine—we have consistently seen that individuals who experience Claude’s value firsthand become advocates within their organizations, seeding adoption that accelerates from individual use to team-wide and ultimately organization-wide deployment.
paras.zh: 专业消费者充当着强大的漏斗顶端引擎——我们一再看到，亲身体验到 Claude 价值的个人会成为其组织内部的倡导者，播下采用的种子，推动采用从个人使用加速扩展至团队范围，并最终实现全组织部署。

paras.en: #### How Claude Drives Value for Customers
paras.zh: #### Claude 如何为客户创造价值

paras.en: Customers realize value from Claude in three primary ways: more productive employees, faster processes, and embedded intelligence in their products. These outcomes are different expressions of the same intelligence, each drawing on the same models and primitives.
paras.zh: 客户主要通过三种方式从 Claude 获得价值：更高生产力的员工、更快的流程，以及嵌入其产品中的智能。这些成果是同一智能的不同表现形式，各自依托相同的模型和基础构件。

paras.en: More Productive Employees. Adoption most often begins here. An individual experiences the impact that a frontier AI model can have on their own output—for instance, hours of financial analysis or code review completed in minutes—and that conviction spreads from the first user to their team, and from one team to the entire company. This happens for Claude Code in software development; Claude Cowork delivers this for knowledge workers more broadly. Our Claude Enterprise plan provides the governance, security, and administration to support adoption of Claude at organizational scale.
paras.zh: 更高生产力的员工。采用往往从这里开始。个人亲身体验到前沿 AI 模型对自身产出所能产生的影响——例如，数小时的财务分析或代码审查在几分钟内完成——这种信念便从第一位用户传播至其团队，再从一个团队扩展至整个公司。Claude Code 在软件开发领域正是如此；Claude Cowork 则将这一效应更广泛地带给知识工作者。我们的 Claude Enterprise 计划提供治理、安全和管理能力，以支持 Claude 在组织规模上的采用。

paras.en: Faster Processes. As adoption deepens, Claude stops being something employees consult and starts being something the organization runs on. As organizations encode more of their workflows into Claude—their data, systems, conventions, and prior work—the platform becomes more valuable for them. Claude can draw on that accumulated context to suggest the next workflow worth automating, reducing the effort required for each successive deployment.
paras.zh: 更快的流程。随着采用加深，Claude 不再只是员工咨询的对象，而开始成为组织赖以运转的基础。随着组织将其更多工作流程——数据、系统、惯例和既往工作——编码进 Claude，该平台对他们而言变得更有价值。Claude 可以借助这些积累的上下文，建议下一个值得自动化的工作流程，从而降低每一次后续部署所需的工作量。

paras.en: Embedded Intelligence. At the deepest level, Claude moves from an operational advantage to a commercial one. Product teams build on the Claude Platform to embed frontier AI into their own products, including customer-facing agents, AI-native features, and entirely new product lines that were not previously viable without AI capabilities. Claude is both a tool the organization uses and an ingredient in the value it delivers to its own customers.
paras.zh: 嵌入的智能。在最深层次上，Claude 从运营优势转变为商业优势。产品团队基于 Claude Platform 构建，将前沿 AI 嵌入其自身产品，包括面向客户的智能体、AI 原生功能，以及此前在没有 AI 能力的情况下无法成立的的全新产品线。Claude 既是组织使用的工具，也是其向自身客户交付价值中的一个组成部分。

paras.en: Across all three dimensions, a significant share of expansion requires minimal to no new deployment at all. Each new version of a Claude model is designed to improve the performance of existing use cases: employees produce higher-quality work, encoded processes run with greater accuracy and reliability, and embedded products deliver more value to end users. As a result, customers can increase usage, utilize higher subscription tiers, and bring additional workflows onto the platform without a new sales cycle or procurement decision.
paras.zh: 在这三个维度上，相当大比例的扩张几乎不需要甚至完全不需要新的部署。Claude 模型的每一个新版本都旨在提升现有用例的表现：员工产出更高质量的工作成果，已编码的流程以更高的准确性和可靠性运行，嵌入的产品为最终用户带来更多价值。因此，客户可以增加使用量、采用更高的订阅层级，并将更多工作流引入平台，而无需经历新的销售周期或采购决策。

paras.en: Despite the pace of adoption, we believe we are in the earliest stages of penetrating the frontier AI opportunity. Most enterprises that use Claude today have deployed it across a small number of teams and use cases relative to the scope of work Claude can address today, and the scope of work we believe Claude can address in the future. We believe most knowledge workers globally have not yet used frontier AI. As each new version of a Claude model advances in capability, the range of tasks and workflows that become viable on the platform continues to expand. Because we operate the platform and offer applications, model advances reach our customers through several channels simultaneously.
paras.zh: 尽管采用速度很快，我们相信我们仍处于渗透前沿 AI 机遇的最早期阶段。与 Claude 当前能够处理的工作范围以及我们相信 Claude 未来能够处理的工作范围相比，今天使用 Claude 的大多数企业仅将其部署在少数团队和用例中。我们相信全球大多数知识工作者尚未使用过前沿 AI。随着 Claude 模型的每一个新版本在能力上不断进步，平台上可用的任务和工作流范围持续扩大。由于我们既运营平台又提供应用，模型进步通过多个渠道同时触达我们的客户。

full.secZh: 我们的文化、价值观和人才

paras.en: Anthropic was founded by a team of researchers who believe that the most consequential technology in history demands an organization structurally committed to both capability and safety. That conviction reaches every dimension of the organization: how we hire staff, the research we perform, the policy positions we adopt, and the choices we make about the deployment of our models. As a result, we are able to achieve breakthroughs that we believe would be impossible in a culture where safety, model capability, and commercial success are treated as opposing forces.
paras.zh: Anthropic 由一支研究团队创立，他们相信，历史上最具影响力的技术需要一个在结构上同时致力于能力与安全的组织。这一信念贯穿组织的每一个维度：我们如何招聘员工、我们开展何种研究、我们采取何种政策立场，以及我们针对模型部署所做的选择。因此，我们能够实现我们相信在一种将安全、模型能力与商业成功视为对立力量的文化中不可能实现的突破。

paras.en: All seven of Anthropic’s co-founders remain active leaders in the organization. It is uncommon to see this level of continuity among the founding team of a technology company, including other major frontier AI labs. The continuity reflects a genuinely mission-driven and high-trust team.
paras.zh: Anthropic 的全部七位联合创始人目前仍在该组织担任活跃的领导职务。在一家科技公司——包括其他主要前沿 AI 实验室——的创始团队中，这种程度的延续性并不常见。这种延续性反映出一个真正以使命为驱动、高度信任的团队。

paras.en: #### Our Culture
paras.zh: #### 我们的文化

paras.en: Several features of our culture are distinctive and difficult for any organization to replicate:
paras.zh: 我们文化的若干特征独具特色，任何组织都难以复制：

paras.en: - We Use What We Build [__] . [__] We are one of the most intensive users of our own technology. Over 90% of the contributions to our codebase in September 2026 were written by Claude, and Claude is embedded in workflows across all teams at the company. When every team relies on the product daily, the feedback loop between builder and user is compressed: deficiencies can be found rapidly, and improvements are felt company-wide.
paras.zh: - 我们使用我们所构建的产品 [__] 。[__] 我们是我们自身技术最密集的使用者之一。2026 年 9 月，我们代码库中超过 90% 的贡献由 Claude 编写，Claude 已嵌入公司所有团队的工作流程。当每个团队每天都依赖该产品时，构建者与用户之间的反馈闭环被压缩：缺陷可以被迅速发现，改进也能在全公司范围内被感知。

paras.en: - Researching Both Safety and Capability. At the same time we advance frontier AI, we develop the policies and techniques designed to keep our models safe. We were the first frontier AI lab to adopt a formal Responsible Scaling Policy tying safety evaluations to capability thresholds, which was co-developed by the same researchers who build our models. Our alignment and mechanistic interpretability research are examples of active scientific fields that help us understand ever-more-capable versions of Claude.
paras.zh: - 同时研究安全与能力。在推进前沿 AI 的同时，我们制定旨在保障模型安全的政策与技术。我们是首家采用正式《负责任扩展政策》（Responsible Scaling Policy）、将安全评估与能力阈值挂钩的前沿 AI 实验室，该政策由构建我们模型的同一批研究人员共同制定。我们的对齐研究与机制可解释性研究，正是帮助我们理解能力不断增强的 Claude 版本的活跃科学领域示例。

paras.en: - We Optimize for Talent Density. As of September 30, 2026, with approximately 5,300 employees, our TTM revenue per employee was over $6.6 million—a reflection of extraordinary talent density and a culture built to compound it. Our employees are known internally as “Ants”—a nickname that captures the collaborative, ego-light culture of the team. Ants include many of the researchers and developers defining the frontier of AI, alongside proven operators across disciplines. Shared purpose paired with low ego translates directly into less organizational friction and greater impact per employee. Claude compounds that impact further: Ants use Claude across every function to take on work that would otherwise require substantially larger teams—allowing us to remain remarkably lean relative to our output.
paras.zh: - 我们以人才密度为优化目标。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们拥有约 5,300 名员工，过去十二个月（TTM）的人均收入超过 $6.6 million——这反映出非凡的人才密度，以及一种旨在使其复利增长的文化。我们的员工在内部被称为“Ants”——这一昵称体现了团队协作、淡化自我的文化。Ants 中既有定义 AI 前沿的众多研究人员和开发者，也有各领域经验丰富的运营者。共同的目标加上低调的自我，直接转化为更少的组织摩擦和更高的人均影响力。Claude 进一步放大了这种影响力：Ants 在每一个职能中都使用 Claude 来承担原本需要大得多的团队才能完成的工作——使我们相对于产出而言保持极为精简。

paras.en: - Rigor Applied to Every Function. A majority of our workforce works in research, engineering, and product development. But the culture of intellectual rigor extends to non-technical functions as well: our policy team publishes detailed policy frameworks and proposals; our go-to-market team co-develops deployment architectures alongside customers; and our Applied AI engineers sit at the frontier of what is possible with agentic systems. Our teams operate in a truth-seeking environment where the best argument wins, not the loudest voice or the most senior title. The result is a company where the distance between a research insight and a released product is unusually short.
paras.zh: - 严谨应用于每一项职能。我们的大多数员工从事研究、工程和产品开发工作。但严谨思辨的文化同样延伸至非技术职能：我们的政策团队发布详尽的政策框架与提案；我们的市场推广团队与客户共同开发部署架构；我们的应用 AI 工程师则站在智能体系统能力前沿。我们的团队在求真环境中运作，最有说服力的论点胜出，而非最响亮的声音或最高的职级。其结果是，在我们公司，从研究洞见到产品发布之间的距离异常之短。

paras.en: #### Our Values
paras.zh: #### 我们的价值观

paras.en: Our values guide daily decisions across the company—from hiring and research prioritization to product development and customer engagement. We chose them because they reflect how we actually work:
paras.zh: 我们的价值观指导着全公司的日常决策——从招聘和研究优先级排序，到产品开发和客户互动。我们选择这些价值观，是因为它们反映了我们实际的工作方式：

paras.en: - Act for the Global Good. We strive to make decisions that maximize positive outcomes for humanity over the long run and are willing to take bold action to ensure our technology is a positive force.
paras.zh: - 为全球福祉而行。我们努力做出从长远看能最大化人类积极成果的决策，并愿意采取大胆行动，确保我们的技术成为一股积极力量。

paras.en: - Hold Light and Shade. We stay hopeful about what AI can achieve while remaining clear-eyed about what could go wrong. Both perspectives are essential, and neither can be sacrificed for the other.
paras.zh: - 兼顾光明与阴影。我们对 AI 所能实现的目标保持希望，同时对可能出错之处保持清醒。两种视角都不可或缺，任何一方都不能为另一方牺牲。

paras.en: - Be Good to Our Users. We define “users” broadly: customers, policymakers, our team, and anyone affected by the technology we build or the actions we take. Going above and beyond for each of them— not just meeting their immediate needs but considering downstream consequences and societal effects —is our baseline expectation, not an exception.
paras.zh: - 善待我们的用户。我们对“用户”的定义是宽泛的：客户、政策制定者、我们的团队，以及任何受我们所构建的技术或所采取行动影响的人。为他们付出超乎寻常的努力——不仅满足其眼前需求，还考虑下游后果和社会影响——是我们的基线期望，而非例外。

paras.en: - Race to the Top on Safety. We believe building reliable, trustworthy, and secure AI systems is a collective responsibility and that the market will reward it. We work to set the industry bar for AI safety and inspire a dynamic where companiesmust compete on safety.
paras.zh: - 在安全上竞逐最高标准。我们相信，构建可靠、可信且安全的 AI 系统是一项集体责任，市场也将予以回报。我们致力于树立 AI 安全的行业标杆，并激发各公司必须在安全上展开竞争的态势。

paras.en: - Do the Simple Thing That Works. We take an empirical approach to problems and solve for the size of our impact. We try to identify the simplest solutions and iterate from there.
paras.zh: - 做简单有效的事。我们以实证方法对待问题，并围绕影响力的大小来求解。我们尝试找出最简单的解决方案，并在此基础上迭代。

paras.en: - Be Helpful, Honest, and Harmless. These principles guide Claude’s behavior and reflect how we operate as an organization: a high-trust, low-ego team that communicates kindly and directly, assumes good intentions even in disagreement, and pitches in where needed, regardless of role or team.
paras.zh: - 有益、诚实、无害。这些原则指导 Claude 的行为，也反映了我们作为组织的运作方式：一个高信任、低自我的团队，沟通友善而直接，即使在分歧中也假定对方出于善意，并在需要时挺身而出，不论角色或团队。

paras.en: - Put the Mission First. Our mission is the arbiter when trade-offs arise between speed and safety, short-term revenue and long-term trust, competitive pressure and responsible development. Our mission gives us shared purpose, engenders trust and collaboration, and ensures that no one is a bystander in our success.
paras.zh: - 使命至上。当速度与安全、短期收入与长期信任、竞争压力与负责任开发之间出现取舍时，我们的使命是裁决者。我们的使命赋予我们共同的目标，促成信任与协作，并确保没有人在我们的成功中充当旁观者。

paras.en: #### Our Talent
paras.zh: #### 我们的人才

paras.en: As of September 30, 2026, we had approximately 5,300 employees worldwide, a majority of whom work in research, engineering, and product development functions. Our team includes researchers who originated several foundational advances in AI, including RLHF, Constitutional AI, GPT-2 and GPT-3, and mechanistic interpretability, who developed the first Responsible Scaling Policy to be formally adopted by a frontier AI lab tying safety evaluations to model capability thresholds, and who authored the foundational paper on Scaling Laws. Our team draws from a range of disciplines and includes award-winning computer scientists, physicists, neuroscientists, mathematicians, and policy researchers, as well as seasoned engineering and go-to-market leaders, united by the conviction that the most consequential technology in history requires the most talented team building it. We believe our culture and mission alignment enable us to hire and retain the talent required to continuously push the frontier of AI forward in a safe and responsible way.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们在全球拥有约 5,300 名员工，其中大多数从事研究、工程和产品开发职能。我们的团队包括多位研究人员，他们开创了 AI 领域的若干基础性进展，包括 RLHF、Constitutional AI、GPT-2 和 GPT-3 以及机制可解释性；他们制定了首个由前沿 AI 实验室正式采纳的《负责任扩展政策》，将安全评估与模型能力阈值挂钩；他们还撰写了关于 Scaling Laws 的基础性论文。我们的团队汇聚了多个学科的人才，包括获奖的计算机科学家、物理学家、神经科学家、数学家和政策研究人员，以及经验丰富的工程和市场推广领导者，大家共同秉持一个信念：史上最具影响力的技术，需要由最优秀的人才来构建。我们相信，我们的文化和使命契合度使我们能够招聘并留住所需人才，以安全、负责任的方式持续推动 AI 前沿向前发展。

paras.en: We design our human capital programs to attract, retain, and reward top talent through equity incentive plans and other compensation, while supporting employees’ continual growth and reinforcing our culture and values. In certain countries in which we operate, we are subject to, and comply with, local labor law requirements which may automatically make our employees subject to industry-wide collective bargaining agreements.
paras.zh: 我们设计人力资本计划，旨在通过股权激励计划和其他薪酬吸引、留住并奖励顶尖人才，同时支持员工的持续成长，并强化我们的文化和价值观。在我们开展业务的某些国家，我们受当地劳动法要求的约束并予以遵守，这些要求可能自动使我们的员工适用全行业集体谈判协议。

paras.en: We believe that building AI systems that serve all of humanity requires a team that reflects the range of communities we serve. The interdisciplinary nature of our work means we actively seek talent from non-traditional backgrounds for an AI company, such as philosophy, journalism, and education, and we believe this breadth of perspective directly strengthens both the safety and capability of our research. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where employees of all backgrounds can contribute, grow, and thrive.
paras.zh: 我们相信，构建服务于全人类的 AI 系统，需要一支能够反映我们所服务社区多元构成的团队。我们工作的跨学科性质意味着，我们会积极从哲学、新闻和教育等 AI 公司传统上并不侧重的背景中寻找人才，我们相信这种视角的广度直接增强了我们研究的安全性和能力。我们致力于营造包容的工作场所，让各种背景的员工都能贡献、成长并蓬勃发展。

full.sec: Research Lab Identity and the Research-to-Product Pipeline
full.secZh: 研究实验室身份与研究到产品的转化路径

paras.en: We are first and foremost a research lab. We develop the foundational science to train frontier models, perform rigorous research to understand these models’ inner workings, and develop techniques to align these models to human values and make them safe.
paras.zh: 我们首先是一家研究实验室。我们开发用于训练前沿模型的基础科学，开展严谨的研究以理解这些模型的内部运作机制，并开发技术使这些模型与人类价值观对齐并确保其安全。

paras.en: #### Research Philosophy
paras.zh: #### 研究理念

paras.en: Our research culture is organized around a principle we apply across the company: do the simple thing that works. We pursue continuous, empirically validated improvements to data composition, model architecture, and training methodology, all of which must demonstrate measurable gains that hold as models increase in scale. This is why we currently focus on software development and agentic capabilities: these are areas where economic impact is large; where safety concerns manifest, making them a test bed for safety research; and where outputs are largely verifiable.
paras.zh: 我们的研究文化围绕一项在全公司范围内贯彻的原则来组织：做简单且行之有效的事。我们追求对数据构成、模型架构和训练方法的持续、经实证验证的改进，所有这些改进都必须展现出可衡量的收益，并且在模型规模扩大时依然成立。这正是我们目前专注于软件开发和智能体能力的原因：这些领域经济影响巨大；安全问题在这些领域显现，使其成为安全研究的试验场；而且这些领域的输出在很大程度上可验证。

paras.en: Every research project must ultimately advance our mission. This focus also guides what we choose not to pursue. For example, we do not currently focus on developing video and image generation models, despite their commercial appeal. That compute instead goes to coding, agentic skills, and safety research—a research decision that has also aided the capital efficiency of our models.
paras.zh: 每一个研究项目最终都必须推进我们的使命。这一聚焦也指引着我们选择不去追求什么。例如，我们目前并不专注于开发视频和图像生成模型，尽管它们具有商业吸引力。这些算力转而投入编程、智能体技能和安全研究——这一研究决策也提升了我们模型的资本效率。

paras.en: Our research culture is highly collaborative and transparent. When multiple teams pursue parallel approaches, the norm is to consolidate behind the approach with the best empirical results rather than the loudest voice or most senior person in the room. This requires institutional trust we have built since our earliest days, and we believe it is a primary reason our research velocity has scaled significantly faster than headcount.
paras.zh: 我们的研究文化高度协作且透明。当多个团队并行探索不同路径时，惯例是向实证结果最佳的路径靠拢，而不是向房间里声音最大或资历最深的人靠拢。这需要我们从最早时期便建立起来的机构信任，我们相信这是我们研究速度的增长显著快于人员数量增长的主要原因之一。

paras.en: #### How Research Becomes Product
paras.zh: #### 研究如何转化为产品

paras.en: Anthropic was founded on the empirical conviction that Scaling Laws are the primary engine of AI progress. We operate with a sustained rigor in how we allocate research resources, including talent and compute, and measure whether each investment translates into scaled model performance. We believe that sustained and focused research can allow us to advance at an accelerated rate beyond what Scaling Laws alone predict through our compute multiplier advancements that have allowed us to push the frontier of model capability with better compute efficiency.
paras.zh: Anthropic 创立于一个实证信念：规模定律（Scaling Laws）是 AI 进步的主要引擎。我们在研究资源（包括人才和算力）的分配上保持持续的严谨，并衡量每一项投入是否转化为规模化的模型性能。我们相信，持续且专注的研究能够让我们以加速的节奏前进，超越仅凭规模定律所能预测的水平，这得益于我们的算力乘数进步，使我们能够以更高的算力效率推进模型能力的前沿。

paras.en: Pre-training. Our pre-training process operates as a disciplined pipeline. Researchers propose potential improvements to model architecture, training methodology, or data composition, and each candidate is then validated at a smaller scale before we permit it to consume large amounts of compute. We set a high bar for inclusion in a frontier training run; we require evidence that demonstrates a given improvement holds as models increase in size. Frontier training runs are themselves planned capital deployments with defined inputs and strict inclusion criteria. Although not every run performs as our researchers expect, the process is designed to turn research investment into predictable capability gains with greater consistency over time.
paras.zh: 预训练。我们的预训练流程以一套严谨的流水线方式运作。研究人员提出对模型架构、训练方法或数据构成的潜在改进，每个候选方案随后都会在较小规模上得到验证，之后我们才允许其消耗大量算力。我们为纳入前沿训练运行设定了很高的门槛；我们要求有证据表明某项改进在模型规模扩大时依然成立。前沿训练运行本身就是经过规划的资本部署，具有明确的输入和严格的纳入标准。尽管并非每一次运行都能达到研究人员的预期，但该流程旨在将研究投入转化为可预测的能力提升，并随着时间的推移保持更高的一致性。

paras.en: Post-training. Pre-training produces raw model capability. During post-training, that capability is refined into practical utility—the ability to write production-quality code, operate software tools, follow complex multi-step instructions, and act autonomously on a user’s behalf. This phase has evolved from a minor adjustment step into one of the largest areas of our research investment, reflecting evolution in model capability from conversational assistants to autonomous agents that perform tasks independently. Post-training centers on training models against complete, realistic tasks whose complexity reflects the demands of real professional environments. We have made substantial proprietary investments in developing this task portfolio, and its breadth and realism constitute one of our most durable scientific advantages, which we believe is difficult to observe from outside the organization and correspondingly difficult to replicate.
paras.zh: 后训练。预训练产生原始模型能力。在后训练阶段，这种能力被精炼为实用价值——即编写生产级代码、操作软件工具、遵循复杂的多步骤指令，以及代表用户自主行动的能力。这一阶段已从一项小幅调整步骤，演变为我们研究投入最大的领域之一，反映出模型能力从对话式助手向能够独立执行任务的自主智能体的演进。后训练的核心在于针对完整、真实的任务对模型进行训练，这些任务的复杂度反映了真实专业环境的要求。我们已在开发这一任务组合方面进行了大量专有投入，其广度与真实性构成了我们最持久的科学优势之一，我们认为这一优势难以从组织外部观察到，相应地也难以复制。

paras.en: Inference. Our model architecture and inference infrastructure are co-designed. AI researchers and inference infrastructure engineers share planning cycles, reporting lines, and performance targets. Model architecture decisions are made with inference economics as a priority, which is why successive versions of Claude models can deliver both higher capability and greater efficiency than their predecessors.
paras.zh: 推理。我们的模型架构与推理基础设施是协同设计的。AI 研究人员与推理基础设施工程师共享规划周期、汇报关系和绩效目标。模型架构决策以推理经济性为优先考量，这正是为什么 Claude 模型 successive 版本能够同时提供比前代更高的能力和更高的效率。

full.sec: Safety Research is Core to Our Business
full.secZh: 安全研究是我们业务的核心

paras.en: Any technology that is powerful enough to produce the enormous benefits that we believe AI will bring also poses risks. Responding to these risks requires a portfolio of safety research that spans how we train, evaluate, interpret, secure, and monitor our models.
paras.zh: 任何强大到足以产生我们认为 AI 将带来的巨大效益的技术，也同样会带来风险。应对这些风险需要一套安全研究组合，涵盖我们如何训练、评估、解读、保护和监控我们的模型。

paras.en: Anthropic’s Responsible · Scaling Policy
paras.zh: Anthropic 的负责任 · 扩展政策

paras.en: Our Responsible Scaling Policy describes how we approach the catastrophic risks posed by AI. The policy requires us to regularly publish detailed risk reports that reflect our perspectives on the overall level of risk posed by our models and how we are mitigating such risks. Our teams test each model extensively before release, assessing its capabilities in the domains most relevant to catastrophic risk and evaluating the extent to which the model can be misused. Our risk report describes an overall assessment of the results of these evaluations, the mitigations we have implemented to address these risks, and whether, and if so, why, we believe the identified risks are justified by corresponding benefits. As part of the current version of our Responsible Scaling Policy, we publish a Frontier Safety Roadmap, detailing our plans for measurable advances in security, alignment, safeguards, and AI policy. This acts as an internal spur for safety research and development and is externally visible so customers and regulators can use it to gauge our progress. Consistent with this approach, we assess the risks of each model during development and before and after release and we take the steps we believe are appropriate to mitigate those risks. In the past, these steps have included delaying the release of new models and limiting their initial availability, such as our initial release of Mythos through Project Glasswing, and in the future, as we learn more about model capabilities and behavior, could include additional measures that affect how and when we develop or release these new models. We believe these practices also serve our customers, since rigorous safeguards and predictable model behavior have become decisive criteria when selecting an AI partner.
paras.zh: 我们的《负责任扩展政策》阐述了我们对 AI 所构成灾难性风险的应对方式。该政策要求我们定期发布详细的风险报告，反映我们对模型所构成整体风险水平的看法以及我们如何缓解此类风险。我们的团队在发布前对每个模型进行广泛测试，评估其在最易引发灾难性风险的领域中的能力，并评估模型可能被滥用的程度。我们的风险报告对这些评估结果作出整体评估，说明我们为应对这些风险所实施的缓解措施，以及我们是否认为（若认为，则说明理由）已识别的风险可由相应收益予以合理化。作为当前版本《负责任扩展政策》的一部分，我们发布《前沿安全路线图》，详细说明我们在安全、对齐、防护措施和 AI 政策方面实现可衡量进展的计划。这既是推动我们安全研发的内部激励，也具有外部可见性，使客户和监管机构能够据此衡量我们的进展。按照这一方针，我们在开发过程中以及发布前后评估每个模型的风险，并采取我们认为适当的措施来缓解这些风险。过去，这些措施包括推迟新模型的发布并限制其初始可用范围，例如我们通过 Project Glasswing 对 Mythos 的初始发布；未来，随着我们对模型能力和行为了解的加深，可能还包括影响我们如何以及何时开发或发布这些新模型的额外措施。我们认为这些做法同样服务于我们的客户，因为严格的防护措施和可预测的模型行为已成为选择 AI 合作伙伴时的决定性标准。

paras.en: #### Claude’s Constitution
paras.zh: #### Claude 的宪法

paras.en: We have developed a constitution for Claude that describes our vision for how an AI model should be and how it should behave, which is used directly in the model training process. We have used Claude’s constitution to meaningfully advance how frontier models are trained, and it is our attempt to grapple with the most difficult questions regarding the development of this new type of artificially intelligent entity. It is a living document that we intend to revise as we develop further models and learn more about how they work. Our researchers have found that training Claude on high-quality constitutional documents combined with fictional stories portraying an aligned AI contributes to reducing Claude’s misalignment rate. We believe Claude’s constitution has also proven commercially valuable: transparently laying out the values we intend Claude to hold increases customer trust.
paras.zh: 我们为 Claude 制定了一部宪法，阐述我们对 AI 模型应当是什么样以及应当如何行为的愿景，该宪法直接用于模型训练过程。我们已利用 Claude 的宪法切实推进了前沿模型的训练方式，这是我们为应对开发这类新型人工智能实体所面临的最困难问题所做的尝试。它是一份动态文件，我们打算随着开发更多模型并加深对其运作方式的理解而对其进行修订。我们的研究人员发现，用高质量宪法文件结合描绘对齐 AI 的虚构故事对 Claude 进行训练，有助于降低 Claude 的不对齐率。我们认为 Claude 的宪法也已证明具有商业价值：透明地阐明我们希望 Claude 秉持的价值观，能够增强客户信任。

paras.en: This constitution orients Claude around four priorities:
paras.zh: 该宪法引导 Claude 围绕四项优先事项：

paras.en: - Be Broadly Safe. Avoid irreversible actions and support human oversight of AI behavior.
paras.zh: - 广泛安全。避免不可逆的行为，并支持人类对 AI 行为的监督。

paras.en: - Be Broadly Ethical. Maintain honesty and sound moral judgment, and avoid harmful acts.
paras.zh: - 广泛合乎道德。保持诚实和良好的道德判断，避免有害行为。

paras.en: - Be Compliant with our Guidelines. Adhere to our operational standards for user interactions and absolute prohibitions on certain categories of harm.
paras.zh: - 遵守我们的准则。遵守我们关于用户互动的运营标准，以及对某些类别伤害的绝对禁止。

paras.en: - Be Genuinely Helpful. Deliver substantive, expert-level assistance that creates real value for users.
paras.zh: - 真正有帮助。提供实质性、专家级的协助，为用户创造真正的价值。

paras.en: #### Model Validation and Training Data
paras.zh: #### 模型验证与训练数据

paras.en: Beyond the assessments performed under our Responsible Scaling Policy, we evaluate each Claude model prior to its release through a structured, multi-stage evaluation program covering model capabilities, safety behaviors, and societal impacts, including bias and discrimination, and we document the results of these pre-deployment evaluations, and their limitations, in our publicly available model system cards. This testing addresses the reliability and accuracy of model outputs, including through capability and accuracy benchmarking, evaluations focused on factual accuracy and hallucinations, evaluations of whether model outputs are honest and accurately reflect the information on which they are based, reliability testing of agentic performance over long-running tasks, and adversarial red-teaming designed to identify ways in which a model may fail or behave in unintended ways. Where these evaluations identify issues, we address them through additional post-training, adjusted safeguards, and re-evaluation prior to release, and we document residual limitations in the applicable model system card.
paras.zh: 除了根据我们的负责任扩展政策所进行的评估之外，我们还会在每款 Claude 模型发布前，通过一个结构化、多阶段的评估项目对其进行评估，评估范围涵盖模型能力、安全行为和社会影响（包括偏见与歧视），并且我们在公开可获取的模型系统卡中记录这些部署前评估的结果及其局限性。该测试针对模型输出的可靠性和准确性，包括通过能力和准确性基准测试、聚焦事实准确性和幻觉的评估、评估模型输出是否诚实并准确反映其所依据信息的评估、针对长时间运行任务的智能体性能可靠性测试，以及旨在识别模型可能失败或以非预期方式行事之处的对抗性红队测试。当这些评估发现问题时，我们会通过额外的后训练、调整后的防护措施以及发布前的重新评估加以解决，并在适用的模型系统卡中记录残余局限性。

paras.en: Claude models are trained on data drawn from a broad range of sources, modalities, and languages, including publicly available information from the internet, datasets licensed or commissioned from third parties, and other sources, such as synthetic data generated by our own models. We conduct diligence on third-party data sources to assess their quality, provenance, and suitability for our usage, and in many cases include contractual restrictions intended to discourage the inclusion of personal data in sourced datasets. We apply data curation and filtering processes to sourced data, which are designed to improve data quality, deduplicate content, and reduce potential exposure to harmful content.
paras.zh: Claude 模型基于来自广泛来源、模态和语言的数据进行训练，包括互联网上公开可获取的信息、从第三方获得许可或委托第三方提供的数据集，以及其他来源，例如由我们自己的模型生成的合成数据。我们对第三方数据来源进行尽职调查，以评估其质量、来源以及是否适合我们的用途，并且在许多情况下纳入合同限制，旨在阻止将个人数据纳入所获取的数据集中。我们对所获取的数据应用数据整理和过滤流程，这些流程旨在提高数据质量、对内容进行去重，并减少接触有害内容的潜在风险。

paras.en: We address bias and fairness risks at multiple stages of model training and deployment. We manage the representativeness and diversity of our training data through a layered approach in which dataset curation, post-training alignment, pre-deployment evaluation, and deployment safeguards each play a part, rather than through dataset composition alone. When deployed, our usage policy prohibits the use of Claude for discriminatory decision-making and requires human oversight for high-stakes automated decisions, such as those affecting employment, housing, or legal issues. Our validation, safeguards, and monitoring practices continue to evolve as model capabilities advance and as new risks and failure modes are identified.
paras.zh: 我们在模型训练和部署的多个阶段应对偏见与公平性风险。我们通过分层方法来管理训练数据的代表性和多样性，其中数据集整理、后训练对齐、部署前评估和部署防护措施各自发挥作用，而不是仅依靠数据集构成。在部署时，我们的使用政策禁止将 Claude 用于歧视性决策，并要求对高风险自动化决策（例如影响就业、住房或法律问题的决策）进行人工监督。随着模型能力的进步以及新风险和失效模式的发现，我们的验证、防护措施和监控实践也在持续演进。

paras.en: Further, we have obtained ISO/IEC 42001 certification, an international standard established by the International Organization for Standardization (“ISO”) and the International Electrotechnical Commission (“IEC”), following an independent third-party audit of our AI management system, covering risk identification, assessment, and mitigation processes for the responsible development and deployment of AI. Compliance documentation, including our ISO/IEC 42001 certificate and SOC 2 (System and Organization Controls 2) reporting, is available upon request through the trust center page of our website. We also provide pre-deployment model access to external evaluators, including government AI evaluation bodies such as the U.S. Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (the “CAISSI”) and the U.K. AI Security Institute, for recent frontier models, as described in our model system cards.
paras.zh: 此外，我们已获得 ISO/IEC 42001 认证，该认证是由国际标准化组织（“ISO”）和国际电工委员会（“IEC”）制定的国际标准，此前已由独立第三方对我们的 AI 管理体系进行审计，涵盖负责任地开发和部署 AI 的风险识别、评估和缓解流程。合规文件，包括我们的 ISO/IEC 42001 证书和 SOC 2（系统与组织控制 2）报告，可通过我们网站的信任中心页面索取。我们还向外部评估者提供部署前的模型访问权限，包括政府 AI 评估机构，如美国超级智能创新与标准促进中心（“CAISSI”）和英国 AI 安全研究所，针对近期前沿模型，如我们的模型系统卡所述。

paras.en: #### Alignment

As AI models grow more capable, ensuring safe and predictable behavior becomes more challenging. Our Alignment team focuses on whether models behave as intended, and do not take unwanted actions of their own accord. The team evaluates models to surface undesirable behaviors and develops comprehensive safety evaluations, many of which we open source. Misaligned behaviors, whether occurring in testing or real-world deployments, have been observed across the industry and include examples of models circumventing network and sandbox restrictions, granting themselves permissions they had not been given, taking unintended actions in pursuit of assigned goals, interfering with other AI agents, and misrepresenting whether tasks had been completed or verified. As models are granted greater autonomy, permissions, and integration with internal and external systems, the consequences of such misaligned behavior may increase. For more information about the risks related to model misalignment, see the section titled “Risk Factors—Our AI models may behave in unintended, misaligned, or autonomous ways, including by taking harmful actions that no user or third party directed, which could adversely affect our reputation and brand, business, financial condition, and results of operations.” Our own internal alignment evaluation shows that our newly released frontier models have demonstrated improved alignment compared to their predecessors.
paras.zh: 随着 AI 模型能力不断增强，确保安全且可预测的行为变得更具挑战性。我们的对齐团队专注于模型是否按预期行事，以及是否不会自行采取不受欢迎的行动。该团队评估模型以揭示不良行为，并开发全面的安全评估，其中许多评估我们已开源。错位行为，无论是在测试中还是在实际部署中发生，已在全行业范围内被观察到，包括模型规避网络和沙箱限制、授予自己未被给予的权限、为追求既定目标而采取意外行动、干扰其他 AI 代理，以及虚假陈述任务是否已完成或验证。随着模型被授予更大的自主权、权限以及与内部和外部系统的集成，此类错位行为的后果可能会增加。有关模型错位相关风险的更多信息，请参见标题为“风险因素——我们的 AI 模型可能以意外、错位或自主的方式行事，包括采取没有任何用户或第三方指示的有害行动，这可能对我们的声誉和品牌、业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响”的章节。我们自己的内部对齐评估显示，我们新发布的前沿模型与其前代模型相比，已表现出改善的对齐。

paras.en: #### Interpretability
paras.zh: #### 可解释性

paras.en: Unlike traditional software, where unwanted outputs are traceable to specific bugs, the inner workings of LLMs like Claude are more inscrutable. Our researchers describe AI models as “grown, not built”—software developers can set the initial conditions and some constraints, but they cannot fully control any given output or behavior. This makes assurances about safety—and the diagnosis of problems—far more challenging for AI than for standard software. Anthropic is widely recognized as a leader in mechanistic interpretability: the science of how LLMs work. We have developed mathematical techniques to map how models form and connect concepts as they reason through problems; investigated how they reflect constructs analogous to psychological states and thought processes; and tested how their behavior can be steered through direct adjustments to internal representations. We use interpretability research along with other alignment research techniques to test for unwanted behavioral tendencies before a model release.
paras.zh: 与传统软件中不良输出可追溯至特定缺陷不同，像 Claude 这样的大语言模型（LLM）的内部运作机制更难捉摸。我们的研究人员将 AI 模型描述为“培育而成，而非构建而成”——软件开发人员可以设定初始条件和部分约束，但无法完全控制任何给定输出或行为。这使得 AI 的安全性保证——以及问题诊断——远比标准软件更具挑战性。Anthropic 被广泛认为是机制可解释性领域的领导者，该学科研究 LLM 如何运作。我们开发了数学技术，用于描绘模型在推理问题时如何形成和连接概念；研究了模型如何反映类似心理状态和思维过程的构造；并测试了如何通过直接调整内部表征来引导其行为。我们在模型发布前，将可解释性研究与其他对齐研究技术结合使用，以检测不良行为倾向。

paras.en: #### Safeguards
paras.zh: #### 保障措施

paras.en: Our Safeguards team reduces the risk of Claude producing dangerous, harmful, or undesirable content through multiple approaches, including probes and classifiers that monitor inputs and outputs, training against specific attack vectors such as prompt injection, and monitoring for user safety concerns including encouragement of harmful ideation. When we detect potential violations, enforcement actions range from real-time response adjustments to account warnings and, in severe cases, termination of the offending user’s accounts. Findings from ongoing monitoring, external expert stress-testing, and threat intelligence inform our policies, model training, and detection systems. Identified issues may be addressed through measures such as updates to detection classifiers, reward-model adjustments during training, and changes to the instructions provided to our models that guide their behavior (known as system prompts). We also maintain public reporting channels, including a responsible disclosure policy and a bug bounty program for testing our safety defenses.
paras.zh: 我们的保障团队通过多种方式降低 Claude 生成危险、有害或不良内容的风险，包括监测输入和输出的探针与分类器、针对提示注入等特定攻击向量的训练，以及监测用户安全关切（包括鼓励有害意念）。当我们检测到潜在违规行为时，执法措施从实时调整回复，到账户警告，再到严重情况下终止违规用户的账户。持续监测、外部专家压力测试和威胁情报的发现，为我们的政策、模型训练和检测系统提供依据。已识别的问题可通过更新检测分类器、训练期间调整奖励模型，以及更改向模型提供的指导其行为的指令（即系统提示）等措施加以解决。我们还设有公开报告渠道，包括负责任披露政策和用于测试我们安全防御的漏洞赏金计划。

paras.en: We have observed that more capable models are generally better at recognizing and preventing high-stakes misuse. We believe that robust safety measures and model utility are not inherently in tension, and that safety can improve alongside the capability of the models themselves.
paras.zh: 我们观察到，能力更强的模型通常更善于识别和防范高风险滥用。我们认为，稳健的安全措施与模型效用并非天然对立，安全性可以与模型自身能力同步提升。

paras.en: #### Our Approach to Model Releases
paras.zh: #### 我们的模型发布方法

paras.en: Each release is accompanied by a detailed system card covering capability and safety evaluations, external tester reports, and discussion of areas where performance remains limited or where the model shows signs of unwanted behavior. For example, AI poses clear and present risks in the cybersecurity domain as advanced models could assist threat actors in security breaches and exploits. Mitigating these risks is a priority across our research, evaluation, and deployment practices. Before each model release, our Frontier Red Team conducts a detailed analysis to determine whether new models provide meaningful new capabilities to assist potential attackers, and our Safeguards team maintains dedicated classifiers and monitoring systems targeting cyber-related misuse, including prompts related to malware creation, phishing, and infrastructure attacks.
paras.zh: 每次发布均附有详细的系统卡，涵盖能力与安全评估、外部测试者报告，以及对性能仍受限领域或模型表现出不良行为迹象领域的讨论。例如，AI 在网络安全领域构成明确且现实的威胁，因为先进模型可能协助威胁行为者实施安全入侵和漏洞利用。降低这些风险是我们研究、评估和部署实践中的优先事项。在每次模型发布前，我们的前沿红队会进行详细分析，以确定新模型是否为潜在攻击者提供了有意义的新能力，我们的安全防护团队则维护专门针对网络相关滥用的分类器和监控系统，包括与恶意软件创建、网络钓鱼和基础设施攻击相关的提示词。

paras.en: We make decisions about model development and deployment, including whether to begin training a new model, on a case-by-case basis. Before releasing a frontier model, we consider a variety of factors, such as the capabilities and behaviors of the specific model at issue and of our models overall, how well our safeguards and security measures work, and how widely the model would be available. We plan to extend our testing to include more assessments at each stage of model training: pre-training, post-training, and internal deployment. Depending on these assessments, we may delay or suspend training or related research, delay releases, or limit access to models until we have confidence they can be developed and deployed safely. Our assessments are also informed by voluntary pre-deployment evaluation of certain models by the CAISSI and the U.K. AI Security Institute. For certain models that materially advance the capability of the frontier in areas relevant to national security, we also provide designated government partners with expanded early access so that they can independently evaluate model capabilities and safeguards before release.
paras.zh: 我们逐案决定模型开发和部署事宜，包括是否开始训练新模型。在发布前沿模型之前，我们会考虑多种因素，例如特定模型及我们整体模型的能力和行为、我们的安全防护和安全措施的有效程度，以及模型的可用范围。我们计划将测试扩展到在模型训练的每个阶段进行更多评估：预训练、后训练和内部部署。根据这些评估，我们可能推迟或暂停训练或相关研究、推迟发布，或限制对模型的访问，直至我们确信其能够被安全地开发和部署。我们的评估还参考了 CAISSI 和英国 AI 安全研究所对某些模型进行的自愿部署前评估。对于在国家安全相关领域实质性推进前沿能力的某些模型，我们还会向指定的政府合作伙伴提供扩展的提前访问权限，以便他们在发布前独立评估模型能力和安全防护措施。

paras.en: Based on our analyses, we do not release every model we develop for general use; when the model’s capabilities warrant caution, we may restrict availability or decline to release entirely. For example, in April 2026, we initially released our frontier model, Mythos, as a gated research preview through Project Glasswing, available to select organizations for cybersecurity applications, rather than making it broadly available at launch due to its advanced capabilities in cyber vulnerability discovery. We later released Fable 5 for general use, but with safety restrictions on certain cybersecurity, biology, and chemistry capabilities.
paras.zh: 基于我们的分析，我们并非发布所开发的每一个模型供通用。当模型能力需要谨慎对待时，我们可能限制可用性，或完全拒绝发布。例如，2026 年 4 月，我们最初通过 Project Glasswing 以受限研究预览形式发布前沿模型 Mythos，仅向选定组织提供用于网络安全应用，而非在发布时广泛提供，原因是其在网络漏洞发现方面具有先进能力。我们后来发布了 Fable 5 供通用，但对某些网络安全、生物学和化学能力施加了安全限制。

paras.en: #### Race to the Top
paras.zh: #### 争创顶尖

paras.en: Building reliable, trustworthy, and secure AI systems cannot be the task of one AI company alone. Our goal is to foster a race to the top in which AI developers compete on the safety and security of their systems, rather than rushing to release increasingly powerful models without adequate safeguards. In addition to publishing a large volume of research, we open source our evaluations where possible and participate in groups such as the Frontier Model Forum to share safety-critical findings with other AI developers. We have also sought to lead by example in ways that shape industry norms. After we published the first version of our Responsible Scaling Policy in September 2023, two other leading frontier AI labs adopted similar frameworks within months.
paras.zh: 构建可靠、可信且安全的 AI 系统不能仅靠一家 AI 公司独自完成。我们的目标是推动一场“力争上游”的竞赛，让 AI 开发者在各自系统的安全与保障上展开竞争，而不是在缺乏充分防护措施的情况下竞相发布能力越来越强大的模型。除了发布大量研究成果外，我们还在可能的情况下开源我们的评估方法，并加入 Frontier Model Forum 等组织，与其他 AI 开发者分享关乎安全的关键发现。我们还力求以身作则，以塑造行业规范。在我们于 2023 年 9 月发布第一版《负责任扩展政策》后，另外两家领先的前沿 AI 实验室在数月内也采用了类似的框架。

paras.en: Building on this approach, we have publicly called for “pacing the frontier,” by which we mean establishing industry-wide standards primarily related to the use of AI to accelerate AI development, so that AI capabilities do not advance faster than the safety, alignment, and security practices needed to support them. This call to pace the frontier contemplates frontier AI developers collaborating with governments and does not describe our own model development or release timelines, which continue to be informed by our risk assessments. If standards of this kind are adopted industry-wide through government action or regulation, the rate at which AI capabilities advance could be faster or slower than it is today, depending on the extent to which safety, alignment, and security practices advance together with model capabilities. We believe the first step toward “pacing the frontier” is independent verification of compliance with future regulatory standards, and we have begun implementing a program under which independent evaluators work alongside our own risk and safety teams with broad internal access, subject to legal, confidentiality, and security limits. As part of this program, we currently anticipate investing at least $1 billion over the next five years to build external reviewer capacity with Accenture. The terms of this arrangement have not been finalized and are subject to change. We have also called on other frontier AI developers to adopt comparable practices to demonstrate that safety commitments in our industry can be independently verified. We have further supported regulation and oversight of frontier AI, including measures focused on transparency and independent third-party auditing, and international coordination, so these practices apply across frontier developers rather than depend on voluntary adoption alone.
paras.zh: 在这一做法的基础上，我们公开呼吁“为前沿发展设定节奏”，即建立主要涉及利用 AI 加速 AI 开发的行业-wide 标准，使 AI 能力的推进速度不超过支撑这些能力所需的安全、对齐和保障实践的发展速度。这一“为前沿发展设定节奏”的呼吁设想前沿 AI 开发者与政府合作，并不描述我们自身的模型开发或发布时间表，我们的时间表仍以风险评估为依据。如果此类标准通过政府行动或监管在行业-wide 范围内获得采用，AI 能力的推进速度可能快于或慢于当前水平，取决于安全、对齐和保障实践与模型能力同步发展的程度。我们认为，迈向“为前沿发展设定节奏”的第一步是对未来监管标准的合规情况进行独立验证，我们已开始实施一项计划，由独立评估人员与我们的风险与安全团队并肩工作，并拥有广泛的内部访问权限，但须遵守法律、保密和安全方面的限制。作为该计划的一部分，我们目前预计在未来五年内投入至少 $1 billion，与 Accenture 共同建设外部审查能力。该安排的条款尚未最终确定，并可能发生变化。我们还呼吁其他前沿 AI 开发者采用类似做法，以证明我们行业的安全承诺可以得到独立验证。我们进一步支持对前沿 AI 的监管和监督，包括侧重于透明度和独立第三方审计的措施，以及国际协调，使这些做法适用于各前沿开发者，而不是仅依赖自愿采用。

paras.en: We believe frontier AI companies and governments should take action to strengthen the security of critical infrastructure against AI-related and other cyber threats, including by:
paras.zh: 我们认为，前沿 AI 公司和政府应采取行动，加强关键基础设施抵御与 AI 相关及其他网络威胁的安全防护，包括通过以下方式：

paras.en: - providing responsible model access, funding, training, and hands-on support, particularly for under-resourced critical-infrastructure defenders;
paras.zh: - 提供负责任的模型访问、资金、培训和实操支持，尤其是面向资源不足的关键基础设施防御方；

paras.en: - building observability and security tools;
paras.zh: - 构建可观测性和安全工具；

paras.en: - working to ensure agentic identities are traceable and accountable;
paras.zh: - 努力确保智能体身份可追溯、可问责；

paras.en: - sharing best practices in continuous monitoring;
paras.zh: - 分享持续监控方面的最佳实践；

paras.en: - investing in authorized testing, private disclosure, and verified remediation of vulnerabilities; and
paras.zh: - 投资于经授权的测试、非公开披露以及经核实的漏洞修复；以及

paras.en: - sharing tools, playbooks, and threat assessments with governments, security partners, and open-source maintainers.
paras.zh: - 与政府、安全合作伙伴及开源维护者共享工具、操作手册和威胁评估。

paras.en: We believe that by fixing the most dangerous weaknesses, verifying the fixes, and sharing what works, frontier AI companies and governments can turn today’s AI advances into lasting improvements in security that benefit everyone. We have committed up to $100 million in cyberdefense-related initiatives through Project Glasswing, and we expect to devote significant additional resources over time toward strengthening the security of AI systems and the critical infrastructure that depends on them. The scope, timing, and amount of any such future investments have not been finalized and remain subject to change based on business, regulatory, and other considerations, and there can be no assurance that these initiatives will achieve their intended effect.
paras.zh: 我们相信，通过修复最危险的弱点、验证修复效果并分享行之有效的做法，前沿 AI 公司与政府能够将当今的 AI 进步转化为持久的、惠及所有人的安全改善。我们已通过 Project Glasswing 承诺投入最高 $100 million 用于网络防御相关举措，并预计随着时间推移投入大量额外资源，以加强 AI 系统及依赖这些系统的关键基础设施的安全性。任何此类未来投资的范围、时间和金额尚未最终确定，并将根据业务、监管及其他考量而发生变化，且无法保证这些举措能够实现其预期效果。

paras.en: Our own trajectory demonstrates that commercial success and a serious commitment to safety are not in tension. We have built one of the fastest-growing businesses in history while maintaining safety as a core priority at every stage.
paras.zh: 我们自身的发展轨迹表明，商业成功与对安全的严肃承诺并不矛盾。我们打造了历史上增长最快的企业之一，同时在每个阶段都将安全作为核心优先事项。

full.secZh: 我们对公共利益的承诺

paras.en: We founded Anthropic on the belief that the most transformative technology in human history demands an extraordinary level of responsibility, and that responsibility extends far beyond building safe systems. Our public benefit purpose is the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity—a mission in which safety is central to our work. Powerful AI can deliver immense benefits, but only if it is developed and deployed with rigorous attention to its risks. At times, that may require pausing the launch of our own most capable systems if we conclude they cannot yet be deployed safely. It also means actively working to ensure that the benefits of AI reach everyone, that the organizations and communities people depend on are strengthened, and that the hardest problems facing humanity are not left to market forces alone to solve.
paras.zh: 我们创立 Anthropic 的信念是，人类历史上最具变革性的技术需要极高度的责任感，而这种责任远不止于构建安全的系统。我们的公益宗旨是负责任地开发和维护先进 AI，以造福人类的长期利益——在这一使命中，安全是我们工作的核心。强大 AI 能够带来巨大益处，但前提是其开发和部署必须严格关注其风险。有时，如果我们断定自身最强大的系统尚无法安全部署，这可能要求我们暂停发布这些系统。这也意味着要积极努力确保 AI 的益处惠及每一个人，使人们所依赖的组织和社区得到加强，并确保人类面临的最艰难问题不会被单独留给市场力量去解决。

paras.en: Realizing this mission requires understanding how AI is actually being used and how it is reshaping society. Our Societal Impacts team builds privacy-preserving tools to study real-world, large-scale uses of Claude— examining how students, educators, and workers use the model, how its values surface in everyday conversations, and what users hope and fear about the future of AI. This includes what we believe to be the largest multilingual qualitative study of its kind, in which more than 80,000 people shared in depth how they see AI shaping their lives. Our Economics team extends this work to the labor market, publishing recurring data reports and fully open datasets (the Anthropic Economic Index) on how Claude is used across jobs, industries, and regions, as well as modeling potential future economic scenarios, so that workers, employers, policymakers, and independent researchers can ground their decisions in evidence and rigorous modeling. To deepen and broaden the reach of this work, we have established the Anthropic Institute, an effort to share research and internal data from across Anthropic with external partners and the public, working together to address the biggest questions posed by Powerful AI.
paras.zh: 实现这一使命需要理解 AI 实际是如何被使用的，以及它正在如何重塑社会。我们的社会影响团队构建保护隐私的工具，以研究 Claude 在真实世界中的大规模使用情况——考察学生、教育工作者和劳动者如何使用该模型，其价值观如何在日常对话中体现，以及用户对 AI 未来的期望与担忧。这包括我们认为同类研究中规模最大的多语言定性研究，其中超过 80,000 人深入分享了他们眼中 AI 如何塑造其生活。我们的经济学团队将这项工作延伸至劳动力市场，定期发布数据报告和完全开放的数据集（Anthropic 经济指数），说明 Claude 在各类岗位、行业和地区中的使用情况，并对未来潜在的经济情景进行建模，使劳动者、雇主、政策制定者和独立研究人员能够以证据和严谨建模为基础做出决策。为深化和扩大这项工作的影响范围，我们成立了 Anthropic 研究所，致力于与外部合作伙伴和公众分享来自 Anthropic 各部门的研究和内部数据，共同应对强大 AI 带来的最重大问题。

paras.en: Our commitment to public benefit also extends to how we deploy our own resources. As part of our public benefit initiatives, we intend to direct a meaningful portion of our resources toward ensuring that frontier AI is safe and its benefits are broadly distributed. This might include making contributions to nonprofit organizations, research institutions, or other groups working on problems where AI can have the greatest positive impact, as well as programs that are designed to make Claude accessible to communities, educators, and public institutions that would not otherwise have access. We believe that how we distribute our resources is as much an expression of our mission as the details of how we build our models.
paras.zh: 我们对公共利益的承诺也延伸至我们如何部署自身资源。作为公益举措的一部分，我们打算将相当一部分资源用于确保前沿 AI 的安全及其益处的广泛分配。这可能包括向非营利组织、研究机构或其他致力于 AI 能够产生最大积极影响的问题的团体提供捐助，以及旨在让原本无法获得 Claude 的社区、教育工作者和公共机构能够使用 Claude 的项目。我们相信，我们如何分配资源，与如何构建模型的细节一样，都是我们使命的体现。

paras.en: As part of these initiatives, we contributed 846,840,960 shares of our Class N common stock, representing [__] 5% of our fully diluted shares as of June 30, 2026 (assuming full conversion of the Amazon Notes), to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, our wholly owned subsidiary dedicated to the Company Purpose, which we refer to as the Initial Public Benefit Issuance. As the value we create grows, we intend for the public benefit to share meaningfully in that growth as well. To that end, our board of directors has approved a framework for additional contributions tied to future increases in our share price. Following this offering, our board of directors, in its discretion, may issue shares of our Class N common stock to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund (or other designee) representing up to an additional [__] 2% of our then-outstanding shares (plus any shares subject to options, RSUs, and other convertible securities and any shares held by the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund) each time our share price appreciates [__] 50% above the prior share price milestone, beginning with our initial public offering price. A share price milestone is reached only when our closing share price has exceeded the applicable threshold on at least 90 of the trailing 120 consecutive trading days, and our average closing share price over the ten trading days prior to such issuance also exceeds that threshold. Although our board of directors has approved this framework, any future contributions will be made at the discretion of our board of directors. The shares that are contributed to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, including the Initial Public Benefit Issuance, may be transferred or donated to a third party, or otherwise sold in a registered public offering or private placement transaction in furtherance of our public benefit initiatives. Our board of directors will determine the allocations and distributions from the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund until it approves a specific governance structure for the entity, at which point decision-making authority is expected to transition to designated managers of the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund operating under that structure. The initial managers are Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei, Jack Clark, and Dr. Neil “Buddy” Shah [__] . [__] The Initial Public Benefit Issuance and the additional share contribution framework represent one of the ways in which we intend to pursue the Company Purpose, but it is not the exclusive means of doing so. We expect to dedicate additional resources, and to make other business and operational decisions, in furtherance of our Company Purpose outside of, and in addition to, these equity contributions.
paras.zh: 作为上述举措的一部分，我们向 Anthropic 公益基金（Anthropic Public Benefit Fund）——我们为践行公司宗旨而设立的全资子公司——捐出了 846,840,960 股 N 类普通股，占截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日我们完全稀释股份的 [__] 5%（假设 Amazon 票据全部转换），我们称之为首次公益发行（Initial Public Benefit Issuance）。随着我们创造的价值不断增长，我们希望公益事业也能在这一增长中切实分享收益。为此，我们的董事会已批准一项框架，将额外捐股与未来股价上涨挂钩。本次发行完成后，我们的董事会可自行决定，在我们股价较上一股价里程碑上涨 [__] 50% 时（以我们的首次公开发行价格为起点），向 Anthropic 公益基金（或其他指定对象）发行最多相当于我们届时已发行股份（加上任何受期权、RSU 及其他可转换证券约束的股份，以及 Anthropic 公益基金持有的任何股份）额外 [__] 2% 的 N 类普通股。只有当我们的收盘价在连续 120 个交易日中的至少 90 个交易日超过适用门槛，且在该等发行前十个交易日的平均收盘价也超过该门槛时，才算达到某一股价里程碑。尽管我们的董事会已批准该框架，任何未来的捐股都将由我们的董事会自行决定。捐给 Anthropic 公益基金的股份（包括首次公益发行）可转让或捐赠给第三方，或以其他方式通过注册公开发行或私募配售交易出售，以推进我们的公益举措。在我们批准该实体的具体治理结构之前，我们的董事会将决定 Anthropic 公益基金的分配和派发；在该治理结构获批后，决策权预计将移交给在该结构下运作的 Anthropic 公益基金指定管理人。初始管理人为 Dario Amodei、Daniela Amodei、Jack Clark 和 Neil “Buddy”Shah 博士 [__] 。[__] 首次公益发行及额外捐股框架是我们为践行公司宗旨而计划采取的方式之一，但并非唯一方式。我们预计将在这些股权捐股之外并作为其补充，投入额外资源并做出其他业务和运营决策，以推进我们的公司宗旨。

paras.en: In addition, we maintain a donation matching program through which employees can pledge a meaningful portion of their equity awards or equivalent cash proceeds to a donor-advised fund or other nonprofit organization, and we match those donations with shares of our Class N common stock. In the same way the Company Purpose defines how we direct our work as an organization, our donation matching program reflects a parallel commitment by our employees to direct their personal financial value created by that work toward the public good. We view our donation matching program as a meaningful expression of the Company Purpose and a reflection of the values that define our culture.
paras.zh: 此外，我们设有一项捐赠配捐计划，员工可通过该计划将其股权奖励的相当一部分或等值现金收益承诺捐赠给捐赠人建议基金或其他非营利组织，我们则以 N 类普通股股票对这些捐赠进行配捐。正如公司宗旨界定了我们作为组织如何指引自身工作，我们的捐赠配捐计划也体现了员工的一项平行承诺，即将其工作所创造的个人财务价值用于公共利益。我们将捐赠配捐计划视为公司宗旨的有意义体现，也是对我们文化所定义之价值观的反映。

paras.en: Finally, our co-founders have each pledged to dedicate 80% of their personal equity in Anthropic to philanthropic causes, separate from and not eligible for our donation matching program. For additional information regarding these pledges, including related risks, see the section titled “Risk Factors—Risks Related to Ownership of our Class A Common Stock.”
paras.zh: 最后，我们的每位联合创始人均已承诺将其在 Anthropic 持有的个人股权的 80%用于慈善事业，该承诺独立于我们的捐赠配捐计划，且不符合该计划的参与资格。有关这些承诺的更多信息（包括相关风险），请参见“风险因素——与我们的 A 类普通股所有权相关的风险”一节。

paras.en: We face competition across multiple dimensions of our business. These competitors include:
paras.zh: 我们在业务的多个维度上面临竞争。这些竞争对手包括：

paras.en: #### Model Developers
paras.zh: #### 模型开发者

paras.en: We face direct competition from companies building frontier models for third-party software developers and enterprises, including OpenAI and Google, and large, well-capitalized technology companies investing to reach the frontier. These are well-capitalized organizations with significant financial resources, large existing customer bases, and the ability to integrate their models into first-party applications sold directly to businesses. While these competitors have built meaningful market presence, we believe our primary focus on enterprises, our ability to remain at and define the frontier, our research talent, and the efficiency through which we maximize our compute investment position us favorably with customers who prioritize model quality, safety, and reliability.
paras.zh: 我们面临来自为第三方软件开发商和企业构建前沿模型的公司的直接竞争，包括 OpenAI 和 Google，以及投入巨资以抵达前沿的大型、资金雄厚的科技公司。这些组织资金雄厚，拥有大量财务资源、庞大的现有客户群，并能够将其模型集成到直接面向企业销售的第一方应用中。尽管这些竞争对手已建立起可观的市场地位，但我们相信，我们对企业的主要专注、我们保持并定义前沿的能力、我们的研究人才，以及我们最大化算力投资效率的方式，使我们在优先看重模型质量、安全性和可靠性的客户中处于有利地位。

paras.en: We also face competition from a broader set of model providers. These include large companies, specialized AI labs and a growing range of other open-weight or open-source (shared weights, training data, and code) models released by state actors and international and domestic research organizations. While these models seek to prioritize cost efficiency over maximum intelligence, we believe our frontier models are highly effective and efficient across a broad range of workloads, from routine knowledge tasks to customers’ most important problems. We believe we compete favorably based on our ability to deliver the most capable models for the problems that demand the highest intelligence, as well as efficiently applying our models to complete everyday work to deliver high quality results at a lower cost.
paras.zh: 我们还面临来自更广泛模型提供方的竞争。这些提供方包括大型公司、专业 AI 实验室，以及由国家行为体、国际和国内研究组织发布的日益增多的其他开放权重或开源（共享权重、训练数据和代码）模型。尽管这些模型力求将成本效率置于最高智能之上，但我们相信，我们的前沿模型在广泛的工作负载中——从日常知识任务到客户最重要的问题——都极具效果和效率。我们相信，我们之所以能有利竞争，是因为我们能够为需要最高智能的问题提供能力最强的模型，并高效运用我们的模型完成日常工作，以更低的成本交付高质量成果。

paras.en: #### First-Party Application Providers
paras.zh: #### 第一方应用提供方

paras.en: As a platform company, our primary focus is on building the foundation upon which other companies and software developers can create products and services driven by Powerful AI. However, as we continue to develop our own first-party applications, we may from time to time compete with enterprise software and application companies in select categories.
paras.zh: 作为平台公司，我们的主要专注是构建基础，使其他公司和软件开发者能够在此基础上创造由强大 AI 驱动的产品和服务。然而，随着我们继续开发自己的第一方应用，我们可能不时在特定类别中与企业软件和应用公司竞争。

paras.en: #### Status Quo

Beyond direct competition, one obstacle to the diffusion of Claude is the natural resistance to change within organizations. Many enterprises operate with deeply entrenched legacy systems, established workflows, and institutional processes that have been refined over many years. Adopting frontier AI capabilities such as Claude often requires substantial change management, including workforce retraining, process redesign, internal policy development, and shifts in corporate culture. These can introduce friction, cost, and perceived risk that can delay or prevent adoption. Especially in highly regulated or risk-averse industries — where the perceived downside risk of major changes can often outweigh the potential benefits — decision-makers might default to maintaining the status quo.
paras.zh: 除直接竞争外，Claude 普及的一个障碍是组织内部对变革的自然抵触。许多企业运行着根深蒂固的遗留系统、既定工作流程和经过多年完善的制度性流程。采用 Claude 等前沿 AI 能力往往需要大量的变革管理，包括员工再培训、流程重新设计、内部政策制定以及企业文化转变。这些可能带来摩擦、成本和感知风险，从而延迟或阻碍采用。尤其是在高度监管或规避风险的行业中——重大变革的感知下行风险往往超过潜在收益——决策者可能倾向于维持现状。

paras.en: We believe that the principal competitive factors in our market include:
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们市场中的主要竞争因素包括：

paras.en: - Our ability to maintain our singularity of focus and mission as a company;
paras.zh: - 我们作为一家公司保持专注和使命单一性的能力；

paras.en: - Our ability to remain at and continue to expand the frontier of intelligence;
paras.zh: - 我们保持并继续拓展智能前沿的能力；

paras.en: - Our ability to continue hiring and retaining world-class research talent;
paras.zh: - 我们继续招聘和留住世界级研究人才的能力；

paras.en: - Our continued focus on safe, reliable, and trustworthy intelligence;
paras.zh: - 我们持续专注于安全、可靠且值得信赖的智能；

paras.en: - Our access to compute necessary to train and deploy AI models, which may be subject to supply constraints, capacity limitations, or allocation decisions by third-party providers;
paras.zh: - 我们获取训练和部署 AI 模型所需算力的能力，该等算力可能受到供应约束、容量限制或第三方供应商分配决策的影响；

paras.en: - Our ability to improve the efficiency with which our models are trained and deployed;
paras.zh: - 我们提升模型训练和部署效率的能力；

paras.en: - Our ability to secure financing on acceptable terms;
paras.zh: - 我们以可接受的条件获得融资的能力；

paras.en: - Our ability to integrate research, product, and our go-to-market approach to ensure we continue building models and applications that serve our customers and allow us to generate revenue to fund our investments in remaining at the frontier;
paras.zh: - 我们整合研究、产品及市场推广方式的能力，以确保我们持续构建服务客户的模型和应用，并使我们能够产生收入，为我们在保持前沿地位方面的投资提供资金；

paras.en: - Our ability to continue maintaining our partnerships across infrastructure providers and distribution partners;
paras.zh: - 我们持续维护与基础设施提供商及分销合作伙伴之间合作关系的能力；

paras.en: - Our ability to attract and retain customers who are building their products on the Claude Platform;
paras.zh: - 我们吸引并留住正在 Claude 平台上构建其产品的客户的能力；

paras.en: - Our ability to attract new customers and retain and expand sales to existing customers;
paras.zh: - 我们吸引新客户以及留住并扩大对现有客户销售的能力；

paras.en: - Our ability to continue building applications that anticipate the needs of the market; and
paras.zh: - 我们持续构建能够预见市场需求的应用的能力；以及

paras.en: - Our ability to navigate changes in the competitive landscape, including consolidation among competitors or customers and strategic partnerships between competitors.
paras.zh: - 我们应对竞争格局变化的能力，包括竞争对手或客户之间的整合以及竞争对手之间的战略合作。

paras.en: We believe that we compete favorably across these factors and are uniquely positioned at the frontier of AI.
paras.zh: 我们认为，我们在上述各项因素上均具备有利的竞争地位，并在 AI 前沿领域占据独特位置。

paras.en: Our intellectual property is an important aspect of our business and helps us to maintain our competitive position. To establish and protect our rights in our proprietary technology, we rely upon a combination of trade secret, copyright, patent, and trademark laws and contractual restrictions such as confidentiality agreements, licenses, and intellectual property assignment agreements.
paras.zh: 我们的知识产权是我们业务的重要方面，有助于我们维持竞争地位。为确立并保护我们对专有技术的权利，我们依赖商业秘密法、著作权法、专利法和商标法的组合，以及保密协议、许可协议和知识产权转让协议等合同限制。

paras.en: We control access to our intellectual property and confidential information through internal and external controls. Access to our most critical intellectual property is tightly controlled, with only a subset of our workforce able to view or modify these systems. We maintain a policy requiring our employees, contractors, consultants, and other third parties to enter into confidentiality and proprietary rights agreements to control access to and maintain non-disclosure of our proprietary information and to protect our property rights.
paras.zh: 我们通过内部和外部控制措施管控对知识产权和机密信息的访问。对我们最关键知识产权的访问受到严格控制，仅少数员工能够查看或修改这些系统。我们制定了一项政策，要求员工、承包商、顾问及其他第三方签署保密协议和专有权利协议，以控制对我们专有信息的访问、维持其非披露状态并保护我们的财产权利。

paras.en: As part of our broader intellectual property strategy, we have invested in a patent program covering certain technologies relevant to our business. As of September 30, 2026, we held 40 issued U.S. patents, with an additional 67 U.S. patent applications pending (including 32 nonprovisional and 35 provisional), and 26 issued patents in foreign jurisdictions, with an additional 12 patent applications pending. We continually review our development efforts to assess the existence and patentability of new intellectual property.
paras.zh: 作为我们更广泛知识产权战略的一部分，我们已投入一项专利计划，涵盖与业务相关的某些技术。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们持有 40 项已授权的美国专利，另有 67 项美国专利申请待审（包括 32 项非临时申请和 35 项临时申请），并在境外司法辖区持有 26 项已授权专利，另有 12 项专利申请待审。我们持续审查研发工作，以评估新知识产权的存在及其可专利性。

paras.en: In addition to our patent program, we have an ongoing trademark and service mark registration program pursuant to which we register our brand names and product names, taglines, and logos in the United States and other countries, to the extent we determine appropriate and cost-effective. As of September 30, 2026, we held 29 registered trademarks in the United States, with an additional 11 applications pending, and 237 registered trademarks in foreign jurisdictions, with an additional 261 applications pending.
paras.zh: 除专利计划外，我们还实施持续的商标和服务商标注册计划，据此在我们认为适当且具有成本效益的范围内，在美国和其他国家注册我们的品牌名称、产品名称、宣传语和标识。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，我们在美国持有 29 项注册商标，另有 11 项申请待审；在境外司法辖区持有 237 项注册商标，另有 261 项申请待审。

paras.en: We intend to pursue additional intellectual property protection to the extent we believe it would be beneficial and cost-effective. Intellectual property laws and our procedures and restrictions provide only limited protection, and any of our intellectual property rights may be challenged, invalidated, circumvented, infringed, misappropriated, or violated. For more information, see the section titled “Risk Factors—If we fail to adequately protect our intellectual property rights, our competitive position may be impaired, and we may lose valuable assets, generate reduced revenue, and incur costly litigation to protect our rights, which may adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.”
paras.zh: 我们打算在认为有益且具有成本效益的范围内寻求额外的知识产权保护。知识产权法以及我们的程序和限制仅提供有限保护，我们的任何知识产权均可能受到质疑、被宣告无效、被规避、被侵权、被侵占或被侵害。更多信息请参见标题为“风险因素——如果我们未能充分保护我们的知识产权，我们的竞争地位可能受损，我们可能失去宝贵资产、收入减少，并因保护自身权利而产生高昂诉讼费用，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。”的章节。

paras.en: We are subject to laws and regulations of various jurisdictions and government agencies affecting our operations and the provision of our models, platform, and applications, and we have been, and expect to continue to be, subject to inquiries, investigations, and subpoenas by governmental authorities relating to such laws and regulations. We believe that the responsible development of AI requires thoughtful governance, and we actively support efforts by governments and regulatory bodies to establish frameworks that promote safe, beneficial AI. We were founded on the premise that AI systems must be developed with safety and societal benefit as central priorities, and we believe that well-designed regulation can reinforce those values across the industry. Because AI development at the frontier is a relatively nascent and rapidly evolving field, the laws, regulations, and standards in place today were not necessarily designed with these technologies in mind. We have proactively engaged with legislators, regulators, and other stakeholders in the United States and internationally to promote the development of regulatory frameworks that we believe are good for society, our customers, and the long-term health of the economy, and we intend to continue doing so. For example, we entered into an agreement with the CAISSI whereby we committed to provide access to our models for testing and evaluation before and after their public release, agreed to provide model access to the U.K. AI Security Institute for pre-deployment testing consistent with our agreement with the CAISSI, and publicly endorsed California’s Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act (SB 53).
paras.zh: 我们受多个司法管辖区和政府机构的法律法规约束，这些法律法规影响我们的运营以及我们模型、平台和应用的提供，并且我们一直并预计将继续受到政府主管部门就此类法律法规提出的问询、调查和传票。我们认为，负责任地开发 AI 需要审慎的治理，我们积极支持政府和监管机构建立促进安全、有益 AI 的框架的努力。我们创立的前提是，AI 系统的开发必须以安全和社会效益为核心优先事项，我们相信，设计良好的监管能够在整个行业强化这些价值观。由于前沿 AI 开发是一个相对新兴且快速演变的领域，现行法律、法规和标准未必是针对这些技术而设计的。我们已主动与美国及国际的立法者、监管机构和其他利益相关方接触，以推动制定我们认为对社会、我们的客户以及经济长期健康有益的监管框架，并且我们打算继续这样做。例如，我们与 CAISSI 签订了一项协议，承诺在其模型公开发布前后提供模型访问以供测试和评估，同意根据我们与 CAISSI 的协议向英国 AI 安全研究所提供模型访问以供部署前测试，并公开支持加利福尼亚州的《前沿人工智能透明度法案》（SB 53）。

paras.en: As an AI technology company, we are subject to rapidly evolving and increasingly complex laws, regulations, and governmental review across multiple jurisdictions. New laws, rules, regulations, and changes to existing laws and regulations are continuously being adopted, implemented, and interpreted as governments worldwide develop frameworks to address AI development, deployment, and safety. The primary areas of regulation that affect our business include AI-related regulations, data privacy and security, export controls and trade regulations, and other matters such as intellectual property, employment and labor, competition and antitrust, consumer protection, and tax.
paras.zh: 作为一家 AI 技术公司，我们受制于多个司法管辖区快速演变且日益复杂的法律、法规和政府审查。随着世界各国政府制定框架以应对 AI 的开发、部署和安全，新的法律、规则、法规以及对现有法律法规的修改正在不断被通过、实施和解释。影响我们业务的主要监管领域包括 AI 相关法规、数据隐私与安全、出口管制与贸易法规，以及知识产权、雇佣与劳动、竞争与反垄断、消费者保护和税务等其他事项。

paras.en: The following discussion addresses the most significant regulatory areas affecting our business.
paras.zh: 以下讨论涉及影响我们业务的最重要监管领域。

paras.en: #### AI-Related Regulation
paras.zh: #### AI 相关监管

paras.en: Various governments and regulatory authorities in the United States and other countries have proposed, enacted, or are considering legislation, regulations, and guidance relating to AI model development and deployment, data usage, privacy, data protection, transparency, safety, consumer protection, content generation, intellectual property, cybersecurity, export controls, and competition. For example, in the United States, AI regulation is developing at both federal and state levels. The National Institute of Standards and Technology has developed the AI Risk Management Framework, which is currently voluntary but could potentially inform or shape future mandatory requirements. The FTC and many state attorneys general are interpreting federal and state consumer protection and privacy and security laws to impose standards for the online collection, use, dissemination, other processing, and security of data. Various states have enacted or are considering enacting AI-related legislation. For example, on September 24, 2026, state attorneys general in New York and New Jersey, together with a coalition of other state and territorial attorneys general, sent a letter to U.S. Senate and House of Representatives leadership to urge Congress to establish comprehensive federal legislation and safety protocols for frontier AI. In the EU, the EU AI Act establishes a risk-based framework categorizing AI systems by potential risk level. General-purpose AI models face obligations including transparency requirements, technical documentation, EU copyright compliance, and publication of training data summaries, and those with systemic risk face additional obligations, including model evaluation, systemic risk mitigation, serious incident reporting, and cybersecurity protection. High-risk systems must meet requirements for risk management, data governance, documentation, transparency, human oversight, accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity. Any actual or perceived non-compliance could result in regulatory investigations, enforcement actions and other actions, significant fines, litigation, reputational harm, loss of customer trust, and interruptions in the availability or performance of our products or services; require unfavorable changes to existing products or services; and delay the introduction of future products or services, which could have an adverse effect on our business.
paras.zh: 美国及其他国家的各类政府和监管机构已提出、颁布或正在考虑与 AI 模型开发和部署、数据使用、隐私、数据保护、透明度、安全、消费者保护、内容生成、知识产权、网络安全、出口管制和竞争相关的立法、法规和指引。例如，在美国，AI 监管正在联邦和州两个层面发展。美国国家标准与技术研究院已制定《AI 风险管理框架》，该框架目前为自愿性质，但可能为未来的强制性要求提供参考或产生影响。美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）和许多州总检察长正在解释联邦和州的消费者保护以及隐私和安全法律，以对数据的在线收集、使用、传播、其他处理和安全施加标准。多个州已颁布或正在考虑颁布与 AI 相关的立法。例如，2026 年 9 月 24 日，纽约州和新泽西州的总检察长与其他州及领地的总检察长组成的联盟共同致函美国参议院和众议院领导层，敦促国会为前沿 AI 制定全面的联邦立法和安全协议。在欧盟，《欧盟 AI 法案》建立了一个基于风险的框架，按潜在风险水平对 AI 系统进行分类。通用 AI 模型承担包括透明度要求、技术文档、欧盟版权合规以及发布训练数据摘要在内的义务，而具有系统性风险的模型还承担额外义务，包括模型评估、系统性风险缓解、严重事件报告和网络安全保护。高风险系统必须满足风险管理、数据治理、文档、透明度、人工监督、准确性、稳健性和网络安全方面的要求。任何实际或被认为的不合规行为都可能导致监管调查、执法行动及其他行动、重大罚款、诉讼、声誉损害、客户信任丧失以及我们产品或服务的可用性或性能中断；要求对现有产品或服务作出不利变更；并延迟未来产品或服务的推出，这可能对我们的业务产生不利影响。

paras.en: We have called for regulation and oversight of frontier AI development, including standards primarily relevant to the use of AI to accelerate AI development, so that safety, alignment, and security practices advance in proportion with capabilities. We have also proposed working with the U.S. government and other frontier AI developers to establish safety and evaluation standards. Certain of the approaches we support, if adopted, could increase our compliance burdens, limit our product development or deployment flexibility, affect how and when we develop or release new models, or otherwise slow our growth.
paras.zh: 我们已呼吁对前沿 AI 开发进行监管和监督，包括制定主要与利用 AI 加速 AI 开发相关的标准，以使安全、对齐和安全实践与能力同步推进。我们还提议与美国政府及其他前沿 AI 开发者合作，建立安全和评估标准。我们支持的某些做法若被采纳，可能增加我们的合规负担、限制我们的产品开发或部署灵活性、影响我们开发和发布新模型的方式和时间，或以其他方式减缓我们的增长。

paras.en: #### Data Privacy and Security
paras.zh: #### 数据隐私与安全

paras.en: We collect, store, transfer, and otherwise process various types of data, including personal information, and are subject to numerous federal, state, local, and foreign laws and regulations addressing privacy, data protection, security, data localization, and the collection, use, transfer, and other processing of data. In the United States, these include comprehensive state privacy laws such as the California Consumer Privacy Act, which imposes obligations on us to, among other things, provide specific privacy disclosures, afford privacy rights such as abilities to opt out of certain processing, selling, or sharing of personal information, and expand consumer rights to personal information. On the federal level, the FTC and many state attorneys general are interpreting federal and state consumer protection and privacy and security laws to impose standards for the online collection, use, dissemination, other processing, and security of data, some of which may be inconsistent. Outside of the United States, numerous foreign jurisdictions, including the EU, United Kingdom, and other jurisdictions in which we operate our business, have enacted similar laws and regulations that affect our business. For example, the EU General Data Protection Regulation and the United Kingdom General Data Protection Regulation impose stringent requirements upon the processing of personal data. The EU’s Digital Services Act imposes requirements on online platforms, while the EU’s Data Act introduces rules on data switching and data sharing. With respect to security, the EU’s Network and Information Security Directive requires risk management and incident reporting. These laws and regulations may be subject to differing interpretations or conflict with the obligations imposed by other legal regimes, such as laws of the United States concerning government access to data. Compliance with these laws and regulations requires significant investment in technical and organizational measures, and these laws and regulations are subject to frequent changes and evolving interpretations. Any actual or perceived non-compliance could result in regulatory investigations, enforcement actions, significant fines, litigation, reputational harm, loss of customer trust, interruptions in the availability or performance of our models, platform, and applications, requirements for unfavorable changes to existing models, platform, and applications, and delays in the introduction of future offerings, which could adversely affect our business.
paras.zh: 我们收集、存储、传输并以其他方式处理各类数据（包括个人信息），并须遵守众多联邦、州、地方及外国法律法规，这些法律法规涉及隐私、数据保护、安全、数据本地化以及数据的收集、使用、传输和其他处理。在美国，这些法律包括《加州消费者隐私法》等综合性州隐私法，该法对我们施加义务，要求我们（除其他事项外）提供特定的隐私披露、赋予隐私权（例如能够选择退出某些个人信息的处理、出售或共享），并扩大消费者对个人信息的权利。在联邦层面，FTC 和许多州总检察长正在解释联邦及州的消费者保护、隐私和安全法律，以对数据的在线收集、使用、传播、其他处理及安全施加标准，其中一些标准可能并不一致。在美国以外，包括欧盟、英国以及我们开展业务的其他司法管辖区在内的众多外国司法管辖区，已颁布影响我们业务的类似法律法规。例如，欧盟《通用数据保护条例》和英国《通用数据保护条例》对个人数据的处理提出了严格要求。欧盟《数字服务法》对在线平台提出要求，而欧盟《数据法》则引入了关于数据迁移和数据共享的规则。在安全方面，欧盟《网络与信息安全指令》要求进行风险管理和事件报告。这些法律法规可能受到不同解释，或与其他法律体系（例如美国关于政府获取数据的法律）所施加的义务相冲突。遵守这些法律法规需要在技术和组织措施上进行大量投资，且这些法律法规频繁变化且解释不断演变。任何实际或被认为的不合规行为都可能导致监管调查、执法行动、重大罚款、诉讼、声誉损害、客户信任丧失、我们的模型、平台和应用程序的可用性或性能中断、对现有模型、平台和应用程序进行不利变更的要求，以及未来产品推出的延迟，从而可能对我们的业务产生不利影响。

paras.en: #### Export Controls and Trade Regulations
paras.zh: #### 出口管制与贸易法规

paras.en: As a global company, the provision of our models, platform, and applications across borders is subject to laws and regulations including international treaties, export controls, economic and trade sanctions laws, customs regulations, and local trade rules around the world. The scope, nature, and severity of such controls vary widely across different countries and may change frequently over time. Such laws, rules, and regulations may delay the introduction of our models, platform, and applications or impact our competitiveness through restricting our ability to do business in certain places or with certain entities and individuals. For example, the U.S. Department of Commerce continues to tighten export controls and add firms to the Entity List, which identifies foreign parties that are subject to specific license requirements for the receipt of certain items. Obtaining the licenses needed to serve or otherwise do business with such parties could limit our ability to conduct business with certain potential customers.
paras.zh: 作为一家全球性公司，我们跨境提供模型、平台和应用程序须遵守各项法律法规，包括国际条约、出口管制、经济和贸易制裁法律、海关法规以及世界各地的当地贸易规则。此类管制的范围、性质和严厉程度在不同国家差异很大，且可能随时间频繁变化。此类法律、规则和法规可能延迟我们模型、平台和应用程序的推出，或通过限制我们在某些地方或与某些实体和个人开展业务的能力而影响我们的竞争力。例如，美国商务部持续收紧出口管制并将企业列入实体清单，该清单列明了在接收某些物项时须遵守特定许可要求的外国方。为向此类方提供服务或以其他方式与其开展业务而获取所需许可，可能限制我们与某些潜在客户开展业务的能力。

paras.en: Such restrictions have already affected our offerings directly. For example, in June 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce imposed worldwide export restrictions on our Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models. In collaboration with the U.S. government and industry partners, we updated our safeguards, and we re-deployed our Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models once the U.S. government lifted its restrictions. If similar restrictions were to be imposed in the future, they may limit our ability to recruit talent, to fully utilize our existing workforce, to continue to improve our models, and to make our products available internationally. For more information, see the section titled “Risk Factors—Governmental trade controls, including export and import controls, sanctions, customs requirements, and related regimes, could subject us to liability or loss of contracting privileges or limit our ability to compete in certain markets.” Additionally, changes in the scope or application of export controls or other trade restrictions on AI accelerators and compute could impact our access to the infrastructure necessary to develop and deploy our models, platform, and applications. As this is an emerging technology area, governments are continuing to refine and could potentially expand the export controls and other trade restrictions applicable to AI models and related technologies. These restrictive governmental actions and any similar measures that may be imposed on U.S. companies by other governments could limit our ability to conduct business globally.
paras.zh: 此类限制已经直接影响了我们的产品。例如，2026 年 6 月，美国商务部对我们的 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 模型实施了全球出口限制。我们与美国政府及行业伙伴合作，更新了我们的防护措施，并在美国政府解除限制后重新部署了 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 模型。如果未来实施类似限制，可能限制我们招募人才、充分利用现有员工队伍、持续改进我们的模型以及在国际上提供产品的能力。更多信息，请参见标题为“风险因素——政府贸易管制，包括进出口管制、制裁、海关要求及相关制度，可能使我们承担责任或丧失合同权利，或限制我们在某些市场的竞争能力”的章节。此外，出口管制或其他针对 AI 加速器和算力的贸易限制在范围或适用上的变化，可能影响我们获取开发和部署模型、平台和应用程序所需的基础设施。由于这是一个新兴技术领域，各国政府正在持续完善并可能扩大适用于 AI 模型及相关技术的出口管制和其他贸易限制。这些限制性政府行为以及其他政府可能对美国公司实施的任何类似措施，可能限制我们在全球开展业务的能力。

paras.en: #### Other Regulations
paras.zh: #### 其他法规

paras.en: In addition to the specific regulatory areas discussed above, we are subject to various other laws and regulations that affect our business. These include intellectual property laws governing patents, trademarks, and trade secrets.
