The evolving patent landscape for AI technologies creates risks of infringement claims and uncertain patent protection for our innovations. We may also be subject to evolving copyright regimes. Additionally, we are subject to employment and labor laws governing wages, employee classification, working conditions, benefits, non-discrimination, workplace safety, and termination, with worker misclassification and evolving standards potentially creating significant liabilities and increased labor costs. We are also subject to competition and antitrust laws in the United States, the EU, and other jurisdictions which prohibit anticompetitive conduct, and increased regulatory scrutiny of technology companies regarding market dominance, acquisitions, and AI systems could result in investigations, enforcement actions, significant fines, or requirements to modify business practices. We may also be subject to consumer protection laws which prohibit unfair or deceptive practices and may require disclosures about our AI systems, quality and safety standards, and protection from unfair practices, with violations resulting in enforcement actions and fines. We also face complex and evolving tax obligations across multiple jurisdictions, including income, sales, value-added, and other taxes, with tax authorities potentially disagreeing with our positions and international tax developments affecting our effective tax rate. We are also subject to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, anti-money-laundering, environmental, accessibility, advertising, and government procurement regulations. Our healthcare and life sciences offerings, and our customers’ use of our models, platform, and applications in those sectors, may also be subject to laws and regulations governing drugs, biologics, and medical devices, including those administered by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and comparable non-U.S. authorities, as well as healthcare fraud and abuse laws, laws governing the privacy and security of health information, including HIPAA, and laws governing the practice of medicine and the use of AI in healthcare. Failure to comply with these laws could result in enforcement actions, fines, penalties, litigation, reputational harm, and restrictions on our operations that could adversely affect our business, and the evolving regulatory landscape creates significant uncertainty regarding future compliance requirements.
paras.zh: 除上文讨论的特定监管领域外，我们还受制于影响我们业务的各种其他法律和法规。这些法律包括规范专利、商标和商业秘密的知识产权法。AI 技术不断演变的专利格局带来了侵权索赔的风险，也使我们的创新面临专利保护的不确定性。我们还可能受制于不断演变的版权制度。此外，我们受制于规范工资、员工分类、工作条件、福利、反歧视、工作场所安全和解雇的就业与劳动法，工人分类错误和不断演变的标准可能产生重大责任并增加劳动力成本。我们还受制于美国、欧盟和其他司法管辖区的竞争法和反垄断法，这些法律禁止反竞争行为，而监管机构对科技公司在市场支配地位、收购和 AI 系统方面日益加强的审查，可能导致调查、执法行动、重大罚款或要求修改业务实践。我们还可能受制于消费者保护法，这些法律禁止不公平或欺骗性行为，并可能要求我们就 AI 系统、质量和安全标准进行披露，以及提供免受不公平行为侵害的保护，违反这些法律将导致执法行动和罚款。我们还面临多个司法管辖区复杂且不断演变的税务义务，包括所得税、销售税、增值税和其他税费，税务机关可能不同意我们的立场，国际税务发展也可能影响我们的实际税率。我们还受制于反腐败、反贿赂、反洗钱、环境、无障碍、广告和政府采购法规。我们的医疗健康和生命科学产品，以及我们的客户在这些领域使用我们的模型、平台和应用程序，也可能受制于规范药品、生物制品和医疗器械的法律法规，包括由美国食品药品监督管理局及类似非美国机构执行的法律法规，以及医疗保健欺诈和滥用法律、规范健康信息隐私和安全的法律（包括 HIPAA），以及规范医疗执业和 AI 在医疗保健中使用的法律。未能遵守这些法律可能导致执法行动、罚款、处罚、诉讼、声誉损害以及对我们的运营限制，从而可能对我们的业务产生不利影响，而不断演变的监管格局给未来的合规要求带来了重大不确定性。

paras.en: See the sections titled “Risk Factors—Our business is subject to an evolving and uncertain regulatory and political environment, which could increase our costs, restrict our operations, or adversely affect demand for our models, platform, and applications,” “Risk Factors—We are subject to complex and evolving laws, regulations, and other legal obligations related to privacy and data protection, and any actual or perceived failure to comply with such obligations could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations,” “Risk Factors—Governmental trade controls, including export and import controls, sanctions, customs requirements, and related regimes, could subject us to liability or loss of contracting privileges or limit our ability to compete in certain markets” and “Business—Legal Proceedings—Other Matters” for more information regarding risks we face related to government regulation.
paras.zh: 请参阅标题为“风险因素——我们的业务受制于不断演变且不确定的监管和政治环境，这可能增加我们的成本、限制我们的运营，或对我们模型、平台和应用程序的需求产生不利影响”、“风险因素——我们受制于与隐私和数据保护相关的复杂且不断演变的法律、法规及其他法律义务，任何实际或被认为未能遵守此类义务的情况都可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响”、“风险因素——政府贸易管制，包括出口和进口管制、制裁、海关要求及相关制度，可能使我们承担责任或丧失合同特权，或限制我们在某些市场的竞争能力”以及“业务——法律诉讼——其他事项”等章节，以了解更多关于我们面临的与政府监管相关的风险的信息。

paras.en: Our headquarters is located in San Francisco, California. We also maintain international offices in Europe and Asia-Pacific. We believe that our current office facilities are adequate to meet our current needs and that, should it be needed, suitable additional or alternative space will be available to accommodate our operations.
paras.zh: 我们的总部位于加利福尼亚州旧金山。我们还在欧洲和亚太地区设有国际办事处。我们认为，我们目前的办公设施足以满足当前需求，并且如果需要，将可获得合适的额外或替代空间以容纳我们的运营。

paras.en: We also lease data centers in the United States and have committed billion s towards expanding U.S. computing infrastructure. We have also entered into leases for data center capacity in Australia and Canada, and we are pursuing data center capacity in additional jurisdictions outside the United States. We continue to evaluate new locations for future data centers, including in the United States and abroad.
paras.zh: 我们还在美国租赁数据中心，并已承诺投入数十亿美元用于扩展美国的算力基础设施。我们还就澳大利亚和加拿大的数据中心容量签订了租约，并正在美国以外的其他司法管辖区寻求数据中心容量。我们继续评估未来数据中心的新选址，包括美国境内和境外。

paras.en: We are currently involved in, or may in the future be involved in, legal proceedings and claims that arise in the ordinary course of business, including those involving intellectual property disputes, compliance with legal or regulatory regimes, government approvals and authorizations, labor and employment, anti-discrimination, commercial disputes, competition, data privacy, customer complaints, and other matters relating to our technology, products, and services. In addition, third parties may from time to time assert claims against us in the form of letters and other communications. For more information regarding legal proceedings and other claims in which we are involved, see the section titled “Legal Matters” in Note 13 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus.
paras.zh: 我们目前涉及、或未来可能涉及在正常业务过程中产生的法律诉讼和索赔，包括涉及知识产权纠纷、遵守法律或监管制度、政府批准和授权、劳动与雇佣、反歧视、商业纠纷、竞争、数据隐私、客户投诉以及与我们技术、产品和服务相关的其他事项。此外，第三方可能不时通过函件和其他通讯方式向我们提出索赔。有关我们涉及的法律诉讼和其他索赔的更多信息，请参见本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表附注 13 中标题为“法律事项”的章节。

paras.en: Future litigation may be necessary or warranted to defend ourselves or our partners or to establish or assert our rights. The results of any current or future legal proceedings or litigation cannot be predicted with certainty, and regardless of the outcome, legal proceedings or litigation can have an adverse impact on us because of defense and settlement costs, diversion of management resources, and other factors.
paras.zh: 未来可能有必要或需要提起诉讼以为我们自身或我们的合作伙伴进行抗辩，或确立或主张我们的权利。任何当前或未来的法律诉讼或诉讼结果均无法确定地预测，且无论结果如何，法律诉讼或诉讼都可能因抗辩和和解费用、管理层资源被分散以及其他因素而对我们产生不利影响。

paras.en: #### Intellectual Property Matters
paras.zh: #### 知识产权事项

paras.en: We have in the past been, are currently, and may in the future be involved in legal proceedings related to alleged violation and infringement of copyrights and other intellectual property, and in the ordinary course of business, we also receive correspondence from other purported rightsholders of intellectual property asserting potential claims of violation and infringement of such intellectual property.
paras.zh: 我们过去曾涉及、目前正在涉及、且未来可能涉及与涉嫌侵犯版权和其他知识产权相关的法律诉讼，并且在正常业务过程中，我们也会收到其他声称的知识产权权利人发来的函件，主张我们可能侵犯该等知识产权。

paras.en: A series of lawsuits has been filed against us in federal and international courts by plaintiffs asserting copyright infringement based on the use of copyrighted material to train our models. For example, in August 2024, a group of authors filed suit against us claiming infringement of copyrighted books in Bartz. Specifically, the class action plaintiffs alleged that in the process of building and operating our models, we unlawfully copied copyrighted works controlled by the authors. Though we dispute any allegation of wrongdoing, in September 2025, we entered into a settlement agreement with the plaintiffs to settle the case for $1.5 billion, which was approved by the district court in July 2026.
paras.zh: 原告已在美国联邦法院和国际法院对我们提起一系列诉讼，主张基于使用受版权保护的材料训练我们的模型而构成版权侵权。例如，2024 年 8 月，一群作者在 Bartz 案中对我们提起诉讼，主张侵犯受版权保护的书籍。具体而言，集体诉讼原告指控称，在构建和运营我们模型的过程中，我们非法复制了作者控制的受版权保护作品。尽管我们对任何不当行为的指控均予以否认，但 2025 年 9 月，我们与原告签订了和解协议，以$1.5 billion 了结该案，该和解协议于 2026 年 7 月获得地区法院批准。

paras.en: In each of the actions, we believe we have meritorious defenses and dispute any allegation of wrongdoing. Legal proceedings related to these matters can have an adverse effect on us because of defense and settlement costs individually and in the aggregate, diversion of management resources, and other factors.
paras.zh: 在每项诉讼中，我们相信我们拥有有力的抗辩理由，并对任何不当行为的指控均予以否认。与这些事项相关的法律诉讼可能因单独及合计的抗辩和和解费用、管理层资源被分散以及其他因素而对我们产生不利影响。

paras.en: #### Other Matters
paras.zh: #### 其他事项

paras.en: In February 2026, in response to our publicly stated position that our technology should not be used for mass domestic surveillance or fully autonomous weapons, the President of the United States stated that he had directed that all federal executive agencies cease using our technology. At the same time, the Secretary of War directed the Department of War to designate Anthropic as a “supply-chain risk to national security” and stated that “effective immediately, no contractor, supplier, or partner that does business with the United States military may conduct any commercial activity” with us. On March 4, 2026, the Department of War sent us two letters—one pursuant to 10 U.S.C. § 3252 and the other pursuant to Section 4713 of the FASCSA—asserting that our models, platform, and applications present a supply-chain risk. These actions referenced above are defined herein as “Challenged Actions.” We vigorously challenged the Challenged Actions in Anthropic PBC v. Department of War, et al. (N.D. Cal.) and Anthropic PBC v. Department of War, et al. (D.C. Cir.). After first obtaining an order from the United States District Court for the Northern District of California that preliminarily enjoined the Department of War’s directive and Section 3252 supply-chain risk designation of us and preliminarily enjoined the other defendant agencies from implementing the Presidential directive until final resolution of the lawsuit, we subsequently, on August 27, 2026, obtained an order from the United States District Court for the Northern District of California that largely granted summary judgment in our favor. The court ruled that the Challenged Actions were retaliatory acts meant to punish us for speech protected under the First Amendment to the United States Constitution and violated our rights under the Due Process Clause of the Fifth Amendment to the United States Constitution. The court also held that the Secretary of War’s actions, particularly with respect to 10 U.S.C. § 3252, violated the Administrative Procedure Act because they were in excess of statutory authority, contrary to law, and arbitrary and capricious. The court entered final judgment largely in our favor. The defendants filed a notice of appeal of the preliminary injunction. The D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals, however, denied our motion to stay the Secretary of War’s Section 4713 designation of us as a supply-chain risk pending review on the merits. On September 25, 2026, in a 2-1 split decision, the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals denied our petition for review, ruling that the Department of War’s Section 4713 supply-chain risk designation was proper, and that our rights under the First Amendment and Due Process Clause of the Fifth Amendment were not violated. We filed a petition for rehearing en banc asking the full D.C. Circuit to review the panel’s decision. We cannot predict the ultimate outcome of these lawsuits. While we continue to work with government agencies, we cannot be certain that the resolution of these lawsuits will not adversely affect our ability to sell to government agencies and other customers that sell products and services to the U.S. government, and thus on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月，针对我们公开表明的立场——即我们的技术不应用于大规模国内监控或完全自主武器——美国总统表示，他已指示所有联邦行政机构停止使用我们的技术。与此同时，战争部长指示战争部将 Anthropic 认定为“国家安全供应链风险”，并表示“即刻生效，任何与美国军方有业务往来的承包商、供应商或合作伙伴均不得与[我们]开展任何商业活动”。2026 年 3 月 4 日，战争部向我们发送了两封信函——一封依据《美国法典》第 10 编第 3252 条，另一封依据 FASCSA 第 4713 条——声称我们的模型、平台和应用程序构成供应链风险。上述行为在本文件中定义为“被质疑行为”。我们在 Anthropic PBC 诉战争部等案（N.D. Cal.）及 Anthropic PBC 诉战争部等案（D.C. Cir.）中对被质疑行为提出了强烈质疑。在首先获得美国加利福尼亚北区联邦地区法院的命令，初步禁止战争部的指令及依据第 3252 条对我们作出的供应链风险认定，并初步禁止其他被告机构在诉讼最终解决前执行总统指令之后，我们随后于 2026 年 8 月 27 日获得美国加利福尼亚北区联邦地区法院的命令，该命令基本支持了我们的简易判决请求。法院裁定，被质疑行为系报复行为，旨在因我们受《美国宪法第一修正案》保护的言论而惩罚我们，并侵犯了我们依据《美国宪法第五修正案》正当程序条款享有的权利。法院还认定，战争部长的行为，特别是涉及《美国法典》第 10 编第 3252 条的行为，因超越法定权限、违反法律以及任意专断，违反了《行政程序法》。法院作出了基本支持我们的最终判决。被告就初步禁令提交了上诉通知。然而，哥伦比亚特区联邦巡回上诉法院驳回了我们要求在实质审查前中止战争部长依据第 4713 条将我们认定为供应链风险的请求。2026 年 9 月 25 日，哥伦比亚特区联邦巡回上诉法院以 2 比 1 的分歧裁决驳回了我们的复审申请，裁定战争部依据第 4713 条作出的供应链风险认定适当，且我们依据《第一修正案》和《第五修正案》正当程序条款享有的权利未受侵犯。我们提交了全席重审申请，请求哥伦比亚特区联邦巡回上诉法院全体法官审查合议庭的裁决。我们无法预测这些诉讼的最终结果。尽管我们继续与政府机构合作，但我们无法确定这些诉讼的解决不会对我们向政府机构以及向美国政府销售产品和服务的其他客户进行销售的能力产生不利影响，进而对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。

full.sec: Our Governance Structure and Its Goals
full.secZh: 我们的治理结构及其目标

paras.en: Our novel capital and corporate governance structure has been carefully designed and differs significantly from that of other public companies. We strive to help bring humanity safely into an era where transformative AI exerts tremendous and potentially decisive influence over a broad range of human undertakings. Operating as a PBC gives our board of directors the necessary latitude to balance the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and our Company Purpose. In addition, a financially disinterested LTBT, which generally has the power to elect and remove a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors, is designed to supply both the incentives and insights for striking this balance appropriately. We also believe that our seven co-founders are distinctly equipped to be stewards of our mission.
paras.zh: 我们新颖的资本与公司治理结构经过精心设计，与其他上市公司存在显著差异。我们致力于帮助人类安全地迈入一个变革性 AI 对广泛人类事业施加巨大且可能具有决定性影响的时代。作为公益公司（PBC）运营，使我们的董事会拥有必要的空间，以平衡股东的金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益以及我们的公司宗旨。此外，一个财务上无利害关系的长期利益信托（LTBT）——其通常有权选举和罢免我们董事会多数授权成员——旨在为恰当实现这一平衡提供激励与洞见。我们还相信，我们的七位联合创始人具备独特的能力，能够担当我们使命的守护者。

paras.en: We are incorporated as a PBC under Delaware law, a structure that enables our commitment to AI safety and responsibility. PBCs are a class of corporations that are intended to produce a public benefit and to operate in a responsible and sustainable manner. As a PBC, we are required to balance (i) the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, (ii) the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and (iii) the Company Purpose. This requires our board of directors to weigh multiple factors, including relevant long-and short-term externalities of decisions, alongside the pecuniary interests of our stockholders. To date, we have found that the safety and societal benefit of AI and consideration of the best interests of all key stakeholder groups have generally aligned with our long-term commercial success and stockholders’ long-term monetary interests. However, as a PBC, we may make decisions that we believe appropriately balance the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and the Company Purpose, but that negatively impact the short-, medium-, or long-term performance of our business or the market price of our Class A common stock. There is limited judicial precedent interpreting the balancing requirement applicable to PBCs under Delaware law, and there is therefore uncertainty as to how a court would view our directors’ balancing of these potentially competing interests. For a discussion of these risks, see “Risk Factors—Our focus on the long-term best interests of our company as a PBC, and the duty of our directors to balance the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those stakeholders materially affected by our conduct, and our Company Purpose, may conflict with short-, medium-, or long-term financial interests and business performance, which may negatively impact the value of our Class A common stock” and “Risk Factors—As a Delaware public benefit corporation, we may be subject to increased litigation concerning our board of directors’ obligation to balance our stockholders’ pecuniary interests, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct and our Company Purpose, the occurrence of which may have an adverse impact on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.”
paras.zh: 我们依据特拉华州法律注册为公益公司（PBC），这一架构使我们得以践行对 AI 安全与责任的承诺。PBC 是一类旨在创造公共利益并以负责任和可持续方式运营的公司。作为 PBC，我们必须平衡(i)股东的金钱利益、(ii)受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益，以及(iii)公司宗旨。这要求我们的董事会权衡多重因素，包括决策相关的长期和短期外部性，同时兼顾股东的金钱利益。迄今为止，我们发现 AI 的安全与社会效益以及对所有关键利益相关群体最佳利益的考量，总体上与我们的长期商业成功和股东的长期金钱利益相一致。然而，作为 PBC，我们可能做出我们认为能够适当平衡股东金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益与公司宗旨的决策，但这些决策可能对我们业务的短期、中期或长期表现或我们 A 类普通股的市场价格产生负面影响。对于适用于特拉华州法律下 PBC 的平衡要求，可资参考的司法先例有限，因此法院将如何看待董事会对这些潜在相互竞争利益的平衡存在不确定性。有关这些风险的讨论，请参见“风险因素——作为 PBC，我们对公司长期最佳利益的关注，以及董事平衡股东金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响的相关利益方最佳利益与公司宗旨的义务，可能与短期、中期或长期财务利益及业务表现相冲突，从而可能对我们 A 类普通股的价值产生负面影响”以及“风险因素——作为特拉华州公益公司，我们可能面临更多关于董事会平衡股东金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益与公司宗旨之义务的诉讼，此类诉讼的发生可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。”

paras.en: In measuring our public benefit performance, our board of directors will consider the objectives set forth in our five mission pillars: that the technical problems of AI safety are solved, that AI safety is a universal practice backstopped by law, that AI strengthens democracy and global stability, that AI expands prosperity and human flourishing, and that AI’s benefits are shared by everyone. We may also address the additional interests of our customers, partners, employees, and other stakeholder constituencies that we may identify from time to time. Neither our amended and restated certificate of incorporation nor our amended and restated bylaws will require that we measure our public benefit performance against an objective third-party standard, and our board of directors will be responsible for establishing and overseeing the standards by which to measure our public benefit performance against these objectives. We currently expect that our objectives and standards will be qualitative in nature and may evolve over time as our business grows and as our understanding of our public benefit impact develops.
paras.zh: 在衡量我们的公益绩效时，我们的董事会将考虑我们五大使命支柱中提出的目标：AI 安全的技术问题得到解决、AI 安全成为由法律作为后盾的普遍实践、AI 增强民主与全球稳定、AI 扩大繁荣与人类福祉，以及 AI 的益处由所有人共享。我们还可能处理我们不时识别的客户、合作伙伴、员工及其他利益相关方群体的额外利益。我们经修订和重述的公司章程以及经修订和重述的章程细则均不会要求我们按照客观的第三方标准衡量我们的公益绩效，我们的董事会将负责建立并监督用于对照这些目标衡量我们公益绩效的标准。我们目前预计，我们的目标和标准在性质上将是定性的，并可能随着我们业务的增长以及我们对自身公益影响认识的深化而随时间演变。

paras.en: As required by Section 366(b) of the DGCL, we will provide our stockholders no less than biennially with a statement assessing our promotion of the Company Purpose and of the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct. The statement will set out our objectives and standards and describe the actions we have taken. We intend to make the statement available to stockholders and the public through our website. We also expect to demonstrate our progress towards these goals by continuing to publish evidence-based research on our website regarding our work and its impact.
paras.zh: 根据《特拉华州普通公司法》第 366(b) 条的要求，我们将至少每两年向股东提供一份声明，评估我们对公司宗旨的促进以及对受我们行为重大影响者最佳利益的促进。该声明将列明我们的目标和标准，并描述我们已采取的行动。我们打算通过我们的网站向股东和公众提供该声明。我们还预计，将通过继续在我们的网站上发布关于我们的工作及其影响的循证研究，来展示我们在实现这些目标方面的进展。

paras.en: We created the LTBT, which was designed to ensure that we are managed in a manner that responsibly balances our tripartite goals as a PBC: (i) the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, (ii) the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and (iii) the Company Purpose. The LTBT is organized as a common law “noncharitable purpose trust” under Delaware law and governed by the Long-Term Benefit Trust Amended and Restated Trust Agreement (the “Trust Agreement”). The LTBT is intended to operate as an independent body of Trustees with expertise in AI safety, national security, public policy, and social enterprise. The LTBT’s arrangements are designed to minimize the LTBT’s and the Trustees’ exposure to our financial performance and grant the Trustees sufficient independence to ensure we are striking this balance appropriately.
paras.zh: 我们设立了长期利益信托（LTBT），其旨在确保我们以负责任的方式平衡我们作为公益公司（PBC）的三重目标进行管理：(i) 我们股东的金钱利益，(ii) 受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益，以及 (iii) 公司宗旨。LTBT 依据特拉华州法律组建为普通法下的“非慈善目的信托”，并受《长期利益信托修订与重述信托协议》（“信托协议”）管辖。LTBT 旨在作为一个由在 AI 安全、国家安全、公共政策和社会企业领域具备专业知识的受托人组成的独立机构运作。LTBT 的安排旨在最大限度地减少 LTBT 及受托人受我们财务业绩的影响，并赋予受托人充分的独立性，以确保我们恰当地实现这一平衡。

paras.en: Through a special class of common stock, Class T common stock, the LTBT generally has the authority to elect and remove the Class T directors, who together will constitute a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors. Class T common stock has no economic rights.
paras.zh: 通过一类特殊的普通股，即 T 类普通股，LTBT 通常有权选举和罢免 T 类董事，这些董事合计将构成我们董事会授权成员的多数。T 类普通股不享有经济权利。

paras.en: Decisions regarding our business and affairs are made by our board of directors. While the LTBT has significant influence over our board of directors through its ability to generally elect and remove Class T directors, neither the LTBT nor the Trustees have decision-making authority in the day-to-day management or strategy setting of the company. The LTBT’s role is to select directors who are well-equipped to responsibly balance our tripartite goals as a PBC, and to support our management’s decision-making through advice and guidance. Certain actions, such as a merger, consolidation, or sale of all or substantially all of our assets, will require the approval of our board of directors pursuant to Delaware law, a majority of whom are elected by the LTBT.
paras.zh: 有关我们业务和事务的决策由我们的董事会作出。尽管 LTBT 通过其通常选举和罢免 T 类董事的能力对我们董事会具有重大影响，但 LTBT 和受托人均不拥有对公司日常管理或战略制定的决策权。LTBT 的作用是选出有能力负责任地平衡我们作为 PBC 的三重目标的董事，并通过建议和指导支持我们管理层的决策。某些行动，例如合并、整合或出售我们全部或绝大部分资产，将需要根据特拉华州法律获得我们董事会的批准，而董事会多数成员由 LTBT 选举产生。

paras.en: #### Election and Removal of Directors
paras.zh: #### 董事的选举和罢免

paras.en: As the sole holder of Class T common stock, the LTBT generally has the authority to elect and remove the Class T directors, who together will constitute a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors. Our Class T common stock will not vote on the election or removal of directors elected by the holders of our Class A common stock and Class F common stock, who will be elected or removed solely by the holders of Class A common stock and Class F common stock, voting together. For a discussion of the members of our board of directors who are currently Class T directors and those that will be Class T directors upon the completion of this offering, see the section titled “Management—Board of Directors.”
paras.zh: 作为 T 类普通股的唯一持有人，LTBT 通常有权选举和罢免 T 类董事，这些董事合计将构成我们董事会授权成员的多数。我们的 T 类普通股将不会就由 A 类普通股和 F 类普通股持有人选举的董事的选举或罢免进行投票，该等董事将仅由 A 类普通股和 F 类普通股持有人共同投票选举或罢免。关于目前担任 T 类董事以及本次发行完成后将担任 T 类董事的董事会成员的讨论，请参见“管理层——董事会”一节。

paras.en: Prior to nominating or removing a director, the nominating party must provide at least 30 days’ notice to our NGC, which notice period is waivable by our NGC in its discretion. Following the completion of this offering, our NGC will be composed of one Class T director and two directors who are not Class T directors and will act by majority vote.
paras.zh: 在提名或罢免董事之前，提名方必须至少提前 30 天通知我们的提名与治理委员会（NGC），该通知期可由我们的 NGC 酌情豁免。本次发行完成后，我们的 NGC 将由一名 T 类董事和两名非 T 类董事组成，并以多数票行事。

paras.en: With respect to one of the Class T director seats (the “Specified Class T Director”), the LTBT’s ability to nominate that director, to remove that director without cause, or to change the director designated as the Specified Class T Director is subject to the concurrence of our NGC. If our NGC does not concur with such nomination, removal, or change in designation within 15 days of receiving notice, the matter will be submitted to a vote of the holders of our Class E common stock unless the LTBT elects to withdraw the notice. If submitted to a vote of the holders of Class E common stock, approval of the LTBT’s proposal will require a majority of the votes cast by our Class E common stock (subject to a quorum of a majority of our outstanding Class E common stock). The LTBT may withdraw any notice of nomination, removal, or change in designation at any time before the taking of such a vote. Any Class T director, including the Specified Class T Director, may be removed for cause, which will be determined in accordance with Delaware law, without the concurrence of our NGC or the approval of the holders of our Class E common stock; provided, however, that each of the LTBT and the Founder LLC has agreed to provide 30 calendar days’ notice to the other stockholder and the NGC prior to effecting a removal of any director for cause.
paras.zh: 就其中一个 T 类董事席位（即“特定 T 类董事”）而言，LTBT 提名该董事、无因罢免该董事或变更被指定为特定 T 类董事的人选的能力，须经我们的 NGC 同意。如果我们的 NGC 在收到通知后 15 天内不同意该等提名、罢免或指定变更，则该事项将提交我们的 E 类普通股持有人表决，除非 LTBT 选择撤回通知。如果提交我们的 E 类普通股持有人表决，LTBT 的提案须经我们的 E 类普通股所投票数的多数通过（须满足我们的已发行 E 类普通股多数的法定人数）。LTBT 可在进行该等表决之前的任何时间撤回任何提名、罢免或指定变更通知。任何 T 类董事（包括特定 T 类董事）均可因故罢免，该等事由将依据特拉华州法律确定，无需我们的 NGC 同意或我们的 E 类普通股持有人批准；但前提是，LTBT 和创始人有限责任公司均已同意，在实施任何董事因故罢免之前，向另一方股东和 NGC 提供 30 个日历日的通知。

paras.en: #### Changes to the LTBT and Class T Common Stock
paras.zh: #### LTBT 和 T 类普通股的变更

paras.en: The terms of the LTBT and the rights of our Class T common stock may be amended as follows (any of which, the “Trust Amendment Threshold”):
paras.zh: LTBT 的条款和我们的 T 类普通股的权利可按如下方式修订（以下任一情形，即“信托修订门槛”）:

paras.en: - if the Trustees are voting in favor of such amendments, upon approval of 80% of the authorized members of our board of directors and 80% of the Trustees then in office (in each case, rounded up or down to the nearest whole number (any exact 0.5 rounding up));
paras.zh: - 如果受托人投票赞成该等修订，则须经我们董事会授权成员的 80% 和当时在任受托人的 80% 批准(在每种情况下，四舍五入至最接近的整数（任何恰好 0.5 的数值向上取整）);

paras.en: - if our Class F common stock remains outstanding and the Trustees are not voting in favor of such amendments:
paras.zh: - 如果我们的 F 类普通股仍未流通在外且受托人未投票赞成该等修订：

paras.en: - until the third anniversary of the completion of this offering, upon approval by (i) our Class F common stock acting pursuant to the unanimous approval of the Continuing Founders, (ii) a majority of the votes cast by our Class E common stock (subject to a quorum of 40% of the outstanding Class E common stock), and (iii) a majority of the votes cast by our outstanding Class A common stock (subject to a quorum of a majority of outstanding Class A common stock); or
paras.zh: - 在本次发行完成三周年之前，须经以下批准：(i) 我们的 F 类普通股根据持续创始人的一致批准行事，(ii) 我们的 E 类普通股所投票数的多数（须满足已发行 E 类普通股 40% 的法定人数），以及 (iii) 我们的已发行 A 类普通股所投票数的多数（须满足已发行 A 类普通股多数的法定人数）；或

paras.en: - at any time, upon approval by (i) our Class F common stock acting by decision of 66 2/3% of the Continuing Founders (rounded up to the nearest whole number), (ii) 75% of the votes cast by our Class E common stock (subject to a quorum of a majority of outstanding Class E common stock), and (iii) a majority of the votes cast by our Class A common stock (subject to a quorum of a majority of outstanding Class A common stock); or
paras.zh: - 在任何时候，须经以下批准：(i) 我们的 F 类普通股根据持续创始人 66 2/3% 的决定行事（向上取整至最接近的整数）,(ii) 我们的 E 类普通股所投票数的 75%（须满足已发行 E 类普通股多数的法定人数），以及 (iii) 我们的 A 类普通股所投票数的多数（须满足已发行 A 类普通股多数的法定人数）；或

paras.en: - if no Class F common stock remains outstanding and the Trustees are not voting in favor of such amendments, upon approval of 85% of our outstanding shares of Class A common stock.
paras.zh: - 如果没有 F 类普通股仍流通在外且受托人未投票赞成该等修订，则须经我们的已发行 A 类普通股 85% 批准。

paras.en: In addition, our Class T common stock may be redeemed by us for no consideration upon approval of persons comprising the above thresholds for amendments of the terms of the LTBT or the rights of our Class T common stock.
paras.zh: 此外，经上述构成修订 LTBT 条款或本公司 T 类普通股权利所需门槛的人士批准，本公司可无偿赎回本公司的 T 类普通股。

paras.en: #### Trustees of the LTBT
paras.zh: #### LTBT 的受托人

paras.en: The LTBT is governed by five Trustees. The Trustees have the authority to appoint the Trustees by majority vote of the Trustees then in office and to remove the Trustees by majority vote of the total number of authorized Trustees or by the unanimous approval of the other Trustees then in office and the approval of the NGC, provided that the LTBT must provide at least 30 days’ prior written notice to our NGC before effecting any such appointment or removal. The notice period is waivable by our NGC in its discretion. Trustees may also be removed by order of the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware upon petition by a person designated by the Trust Agreement as having the power to enforce the agreement if a Trustee has engaged in disqualifying conduct and removal would best serve the purpose of the LTBT. Trustees will serve annual terms, and there is no limit to the number of terms a Trustee may serve. Trustees are selected based on their expertise in areas relevant to the LTBT’s purpose, including AI safety, national security, public policy, social enterprise, and related fields. In practice to date, the Trustees and company executives have collaborated closely on sourcing, interviewing, and selecting Trustees. Of the five authorized seats for Trustees, one is currently vacant.
paras.zh: LTBT 由五名受托人管理。受托人有权经在任受托人多数票任命受托人，并有权经授权受托人总数多数票或经在任其他受托人一致批准并经 NGC 批准罢免受托人，但 LTBT 在实施任何此类任命或罢免前，必须至少提前 30 天向本公司 NGC 发出书面通知。该通知期可由本公司 NGC 自行决定豁免。此外，若受托人存在丧失资格的行为，且罢免最符合 LTBT 的宗旨，则经信托协议指定有权执行该协议的人士提出申请，特拉华州衡平法院可下令罢免受托人。受托人任期一年，连任次数不限。受托人系根据其在 LTBT 宗旨相关领域的专业知识遴选，包括 AI 安全、国家安全、公共政策、社会企业及相关领域。迄今为止的实践中，受托人与公司高管在受托人的寻访、面试和遴选方面密切合作。五名授权受托人席位中，目前有一个空缺。

paras.en: Dr. Neil “Buddy” Shah has served as a Trustee and Chair of the LTBT since June 2023. Dr. Shah will also serve as an initial manager of the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund. Dr. Shah has served as Chief Executive Officer of the Clinton Health Access Initiative (“CHAI”), a global health organization focused on improving access to health services in low-and middle-income countries, since June 2022. Prior to joining CHAI, Dr. Shah served as Managing Director of GiveWell, a nonprofit organization focused on directing charitable capital to cost-effective global health and development programs, and, before that, as co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of IDinsight, a global advisory, data analytics, and research organization. He holds an A.B. in Economics from Harvard University, an M.D. with an emphasis in global health policy from Albert Einstein College of Medicine, and an M.P.A. in International Development from Harvard Kennedy School of Government.
paras.zh: Neil “Buddy”Shah 博士自 2023 年 6 月起担任 LTBT 受托人兼主席。Shah 博士还将担任 Anthropic Public Benefit Fund 的初始管理人。Shah 博士自 2022 年 6 月起担任 Clinton Health Access Initiative（“CHAI”）首席执行官，该机构是一家全球卫生组织，专注于改善中低收入国家的卫生服务可及性。在加入 CHAI 之前，Shah 博士曾担任 GiveWell 的董事总经理，该机构是一家非营利组织，专注于将慈善资金引导至具有成本效益的全球卫生与发展项目；再之前，他曾担任 IDinsight 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该机构是一家全球咨询、数据分析与研究组织。他拥有哈佛大学经济学 A.B. 学位、阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦医学院全球卫生政策方向医学博士学位，以及哈佛大学肯尼迪政府学院国际发展 M.P.A. 学位。

paras.en: Dr. Shah was selected to serve as a Trustee because of his expertise in global health, impact measurement, and social enterprise, and his experience evaluating the long-term societal effects of large-scale programs.
paras.zh: Shah 博士之所以被选为受托人，是因为其在全球卫生、影响力衡量和社会企业方面的专业知识，以及其在评估大规模项目的长期社会影响方面的经验。

paras.en: Richard Fontaine has served as a Trustee since April 2025. Mr. Fontaine has served as Chief Executive Officer of the Center for a New American Security (“CNAS”), a bipartisan national security research institution, since February 2019, having previously served as President of CNAS from 2012 to 2019 and as Senior Fellow from 2009 to 2012. Mr. Fontaine serves concurrently as Executive Director of the Trilateral Commission’s North America group, a position he has held since July 2019. Prior to joining CNAS and the Trilateral Commission, Mr. Fontaine served as foreign policy advisor to Senator John McCain, including as advisor to the McCain 2008 presidential campaign and subsequently as Minority Deputy Staff Director of the Senate Armed Services Committee. He has also served as Associate Director for Near Eastern Affairs at the National Security Council, and he has held positions at the U.S. Department of State and on the staff of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee. Mr. Fontaine holds a B.A. in International Relations from Tulane University and an M.A. in International Affairs from the Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies.
paras.zh: Richard Fontaine 自 2025 年 4 月起担任受托人。Fontaine 先生自 2019 年 2 月起担任新美国安全中心（“CNAS”）的首席执行官，该中心是一家两党国家安全研究机构；此前，他于 2012 年至 2019 年担任 CNAS 总裁，并于 2009 年至 2012 年担任高级研究员。Fontaine 先生同时自 2019 年 7 月起担任三边委员会北美组的执行董事。在加入 CNAS 和三边委员会之前，Fontaine 先生曾担任参议员 John McCain 的外交政策顾问，包括担任 McCain 2008 年总统竞选活动的顾问，随后担任参议院军事委员会少数党副幕僚长。他还曾担任国家安全委员会近东事务副主任，并曾在美国国务院和参议院外交关系委员会任职。Fontaine 先生拥有杜兰大学国际关系学士学位和约翰斯·霍普金斯大学高级国际研究学院国际事务硕士学位。

paras.en: Mr. Fontaine was selected to serve as a Trustee because of his extensive background in foreign policy and national security, and he will address the growing intersection between AI capabilities and geopolitical risks.
paras.zh: Fontaine 先生被选为受托人，是因为他在外交政策和国家安全方面拥有广泛背景，他将应对 AI 能力与地缘政治风险之间日益增长的交叉领域。

paras.en: Dr. Ben S. Bernanke has served as a Trustee since June 2026. Since 2014, Dr. Bernanke has been a Distinguished Fellow in Economic Studies at the Brookings Institution, a public policy research organization. Dr. Bernanke served as Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System from February 2006 to January 2014, having been appointed to that position by Presidents George W. Bush and Barack Obama. Prior to serving as Federal Reserve Chairman, Dr. Bernanke served as chairman of the President’s Council of Economic Advisers and as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System. Before his government service, Dr. Bernanke was a professor of economics and public affairs at Princeton University, where he also chaired the Economics Department. Subsequent to his government service, Dr. Bernanke served as chair of the Global Advisory Board of and senior advisor to Pacific Investment Management Company, a global fixed income investment management firm. Dr. Bernanke holds an A.B. in Economics from Harvard University and a Ph.D. in Economics from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Dr. Bernanke was awarded the Nobel Prize in Economics in 2022.
paras.zh: Ben S. Bernanke 博士自 2026 年 6 月起担任受托人。自 2014 年以来，Bernanke 博士一直担任布鲁金斯学会（一家公共政策研究组织）经济研究杰出研究员。Bernanke 博士于 2006 年 2 月至 2014 年 1 月担任美国联邦储备系统理事会主席，该职位由 George W. Bush 总统和 Barack Obama 总统任命。在担任美联储主席之前，Bernanke 博士曾担任总统经济顾问委员会主席以及美国联邦储备系统理事会成员。在政府任职之前，Bernanke 博士是普林斯顿大学经济学和公共事务教授，并曾担任该校经济系主任。政府任职结束后，Bernanke 博士曾担任全球固定收益投资管理公司 Pacific Investment Management Company 全球顾问委员会主席兼高级顾问。Bernanke 博士拥有哈佛大学经济学学士学位和麻省理工学院经济学博士学位。Bernanke 博士于 2022 年被授予诺贝尔经济学奖。

paras.en: Dr. Bernanke was selected to serve as a Trustee because of his expertise in macroeconomics, financial systems, and institutional governance, and his experience overseeing large, consequential institutions during periods of systemic risk and uncertainty.
paras.zh: Bernanke 博士被选为受托人，是因为他在宏观经济学、金融体系和机构治理方面的专业知识，以及他在系统性风险和不确定性时期监督大型、重要机构的经验。

paras.en: Dr. Christopher Stubbs has served as a Trustee since October 2026. Dr. Stubbs is the Samuel C. Moncher Professor of Physics and of Astronomy at Harvard University, where he has been a member of the faculty since 2003. At Harvard, he served as Senior Advisor for AI to the Faculty of Arts and Sciences from 2024 to 2026, as Dean of Science in the Faculty of Arts and Sciences from 2018 to 2024, and as Chair of the Department of Physics from 2007 to 2010. Prior to joining Harvard, he held faculty positions at the University of California, Santa Barbara and the University of Washington. As a member of the High-Z Supernova Search Team, Dr. Stubbs shared in the discovery of the accelerating expansion of the universe, work for which he and his colleagues received the Gruber Prize in Cosmology and the Breakthrough Prize in Fundamental Physics. He also served as the inaugural project scientist of the Vera C. Rubin Observatory. Dr. Stubbs is a member of JASON, an independent group of scientists that advises the U.S. government on matters of national security. He holds a B.Sc. in physics from the University of Virginia and a Ph.D. in physics from the University of Washington.
paras.zh: Christopher Stubbs 博士自 2026 年 10 月起担任受托人。Stubbs 博士是哈佛大学 Samuel C. Moncher 物理学与天文学教授，自 2003 年起在该校任教。在哈佛大学，他于 2024 年至 2026 年担任文理学院人工智能高级顾问，于 2018 年至 2024 年担任文理学院理学院院长，并于 2007 年至 2010 年担任物理系主任。加入哈佛大学之前，他曾在加利福尼亚大学圣塔芭芭拉分校和华盛顿大学担任教职。作为 High-Z Supernova Search Team 的成员，Stubbs 博士参与了宇宙加速膨胀的发现，他及其同事因这项工作获得了格鲁伯宇宙学奖和基础物理学突破奖。他还曾担任 Vera C. Rubin 天文台的首任项目科学家。Stubbs 博士是 JASON 的成员，该组织是一个独立的科学家团体，就国家安全事务向美国政府提供建议。他拥有弗吉尼亚大学物理学学士学位和华盛顿大学物理学博士学位。

paras.en: Dr. Stubbs was selected to serve as a Trustee because of his expertise in experimental physics and the application of AI to science and education, and his experience leading scientific projects across academia, government, and the national laboratories.
paras.zh: Stubbs 博士被选为受托人，是因为他在实验物理学以及人工智能在科学与教育中的应用方面的专业知识，以及他在学术界、政府和国家实验室领导科学项目的经验。

paras.en: #### Certain Relationships and Transactions with the LTBT and its Trustees
paras.zh: #### 与 LTBT 及其受托人的特定关系与交易

paras.en: We provide funding to the LTBT, which holds all of our Class T common stock, to support its operations and the compensation of its Trustees. In the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024, and 2025, we paid [__] $2,716,750, $0, and $906,089, respectively, to the LTBT. During the nine months ended September 30, 2026, we paid $8,425,213 to the LTBT. The LTBT is accounted for as a consolidated variable interest entity (“VIE”) on our balance sheet (see Note 1 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus).
paras.zh: 我们向 LTBT 提供资金，LTBT 持有我们全部 T 类普通股，以支持其运营及其受托人的薪酬。在截至 2023 年、2024 年和 2025 年 12 月 31 日的年度中，我们分别向 LTBT 支付了 [__] $2,716,750、$0 和 $906,089。在截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的九个月中，我们向 LTBT 支付了 $8,425,213。LTBT 在我们的资产负债表上作为合并可变利益实体（“VIE”）核算（见本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表的附注 1）。

paras.en: The Trust Agreement limits Trustee compensation to a reasonable cash amount fixed annually by the Trustees. Each Trustee receives annual cash compensation of $400,000 for their service as a Trustee. In addition, Dr.
paras.zh: 信托协议将受托人薪酬限制为由受托人每年确定的合理现金金额。每位受托人因其作为受托人的服务每年获得 $400,000 的现金薪酬。此外，Dr.

paras.en: Shah receives annual cash compensation of $25,000 for his service as the Chair of the LTBT. Trustee compensation will not vary with or be conditioned upon the profits or any action or inaction of our company. The policies of the LTBT prohibit a Trustee from directly purchasing or holding any of our securities.
paras.zh: Shah 因其作为 LTBT 主席的服务每年获得 $25,000 的现金薪酬。受托人薪酬不会随我们公司的利润或任何作为或不作为而变化，也不以其为条件。LTBT 的政策禁止受托人直接购买或持有我们的任何证券。

paras.en: In addition, in August 2026, we made a $450,000 charitable donation to CNAS, of which Mr. Fontaine is the Chief Executive Officer. The donation will be used to support CNAS research examining how AI is reshaping global competition, national security, international security, democratic governance, and other issues related to emerging technology and security.
paras.zh: 此外，2026 年 8 月，我们向 CNAS 捐赠了 $450,000，Mr. Fontaine 是该机构的首席执行官。该捐赠将用于支持 CNAS 的研究，考察人工智能如何重塑全球竞争、国家安全、国际安全、民主治理以及与新兴技术和安全相关的其他问题。

paras.en: We believe that our seven co-founders, Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish, and Christopher Olah, as a group, are distinctly equipped to be stewards of our mission. Our co-founders have been instrumental in building our leadership position and establishing the mission-driven values that define our company. In addition, Dr. Amodei serves as our Chief Executive Officer and a member of our board of directors and Ms. Amodei serves as our President and Chairperson of our board of directors. Their long-term strategic vision has been critical to our success and will continue to guide our future. In our highly competitive industry, success requires visionary leadership, strong direction, and the kind of decisiveness necessary to make bold investments, pursue transformative opportunities, and compete effectively against formidable competitors, while also balancing the pecuniary interests of our stockholders with the Company Purpose and the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct.
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们的七位联合创始人 Dario Amodei、Daniela Amodei、Tom Brown、Jack Clark、Jared Kaplan、Sam McCandlish 和 Christopher Olah 作为一个整体，具备独特的能力来守护我们的使命。我们的联合创始人在建立我们的领导地位以及确立定义我们公司的使命驱动价值观方面发挥了关键作用。此外，Amodei 博士担任我们的首席执行官兼董事会成员，Amodei 女士担任我们的总裁兼董事会主席。他们的长期战略愿景对我们的成功至关重要，并将继续指引我们的未来。在我们这个竞争高度激烈的行业中，成功需要富有远见的领导力、强有力的方向指引，以及做出大胆投资、把握变革性机遇、有效应对强大竞争对手所必需的那种果断，同时还要在股东的经济利益与公司宗旨以及受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益之间取得平衡。

paras.en: We believe that our success depends in part on establishing a capital structure that enables our co-founders, management, and board of directors to focus on strategic initiatives that create lasting value for our stakeholders, rather than facing pressure to prioritize short-term results or purely pecuniary objectives at the expense of our long-term vision and mission. Immediately prior to the completion of this offering, we will issue a single share of Class F common stock, a special class of our common stock, to the Founder LLC, a limited liability company of which our seven co-founders will initially be the sole members and that will be managed by its members. Our Class F common stock will be entitled to an aggregate number of votes that equals 50.1% of the total voting power of our outstanding shares of capital stock as of the applicable record date with respect to matters submitted to stockholders generally, including the election of our directors other than the Class T directors.
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们的成功部分取决于建立一种资本结构，使我们的联合创始人、管理层和董事会能够专注于为利益相关者创造持久价值的战略举措，而不必面临优先考虑短期业绩或纯粹经济目标、牺牲我们长期愿景和使命的压力。在本次发行完成之前，我们将向创始人有限责任公司（Founder LLC）发行一股 F 类普通股（我们普通股的一个特殊类别），该公司是一家有限责任公司，我们的七位联合创始人将初始为其唯一成员，并将由其成员管理。就提交股东一般表决的事项（包括选举我们的董事，但 T 类董事除外）而言，我们的 F 类普通股将享有合计等于截至适用记录日我们已发行股本总表决权 50.1% 的表决权。

paras.en: Our Class F common stock will be voted by the Founder LLC in a manner determined in accordance with the Founder LLC Agreement. Generally, the Founder LLC will vote as determined by a majority of the members of the Founder LLC entitled to vote thereunder. Our seven co-founders will initially be the sole members. Upon the incapacity or death of any of our co-founders, a successor member may be admitted to the Founder LLC until the tenth anniversary of the completion of this offering. We refer to our seven co-founders and any successors in the Founder LLC as “Continuing Founders.”
paras.zh: 我们的 F 类普通股将由创始人有限责任公司按照《创始人有限责任公司协议》确定的方式进行表决。一般而言，创始人有限责任公司将按照有权据此表决的多数成员的决定进行表决。我们的七位联合创始人将初始为唯一成员。若我们的任何一位联合创始人丧失行为能力或去世，可接纳一名继任成员加入创始人有限责任公司，直至本次发行完成十周年之日。我们将我们的七位联合创始人及创始人有限责任公司中的任何继任者称为“持续创始人”。

paras.en: When there have been fewer than three Continuing Founders (not including any successor member who is a “Non-Qualifying Member” as defined in the Founder LLC Agreement) for 90 consecutive calendar days, a 450-day transition period will commence (the “Class F Transition Period”). Upon completion of the Class F Transition Period, all of our Class F common stock and Class E common stock then issued and outstanding will be redeemed by us for no consideration and certain other governance changes will take effect.
paras.zh: 当持续创始人人数连续 90 个日历日少于三人（不包括《创始人有限责任公司协议》所定义的“非合格成员”的任何继任成员）时，将启动 450 天的过渡期（“F 类过渡期”）。F 类过渡期完成后，我们届时已发行在外的全部 F 类普通股和 E 类普通股将由我们无偿赎回，并将生效若干其他治理变更。

paras.en: Regardless of the length of time that has elapsed since the completion of this offering or the circumstances that resulted in the removal of a Continuing Founder, one or more successor members may be admitted to the Founder LLC during the Class F Transition Period as needed to ensure that there are three Continuing Founders serving until completion of the Class F Transition Period. The admission of any successor member during the Class F Transition Period will not cure the event that commenced the Class F Transition Period or extend the Class F Transition Period. For additional information, see the section titled “Description of Capital Stock.”
paras.zh: 无论自本次发行完成以来已经过去多长时间，也无论导致某一持续创始人被移除的情形如何，在 F 类转换期内，可根据需要向创始人有限责任公司接纳一名或多名继任成员，以确保在 F 类转换期结束前有三名持续创始人任职。在 F 类转换期内接纳任何继任成员，均不会弥补导致 F 类转换期开始的事件，也不会延长 F 类转换期。有关更多信息，请参见标题为“股本说明”的章节。

paras.en: A Continuing Founder will be removed from the Founder LLC upon the earliest to occur of (i) such Continuing Founder’s resignation as a member of the Founder LLC; (ii) such Continuing Founder’s death or incapacity; (iii) with respect to each of our seven original co-founders, such original co-founder’s ceasing to hold (together with such original co-founder’s related holders) on any record date for a vote of our stockholders a number of shares of Class A common stock (including shares subject to options, RSUs, and other convertible securities) equal to at least 2% of the shares of Class A common stock held by such original co-founder and their related holders as of the completion of this offering; (iv) such Continuing Founder’s removal for “cause” (as defined in the Founder LLC Agreement), which includes specified competitive activities described in the Founder LLC Agreement; (v) with respect to any successor member admitted to the Founder LLC prior to the commencement of the Class F Transition Period, other than a successor member who is a member during the Class F Transition Period, the tenth anniversary of the completion of this offering; or (vi) with respect to each of our seven original co-founders, the commencement of a leave of absence approved by a Supermajority of the other Continuing Founders, which may not be approved during the Class F Transition Period or if the grant of the leave of absence would itself cause the Class F Transition Period to commence.
paras.zh: 持续创始人将在以下最早发生的情形下被从创始人有限责任公司移除：(i) 该持续创始人辞去创始人有限责任公司成员身份；(ii) 该持续创始人死亡或丧失行为能力；(iii) 就我们的七名原始联合创始人中的每一位而言，该原始联合创始人（连同该原始联合创始人的相关持有人）在任何股东投票的登记日不再持有至少相当于该原始联合创始人及其相关持有人于本次发行完成时持有的 A 类普通股股数 2% 的 A 类普通股股份（包括受期权、RSU 和其他可转换证券约束的股份）；(iv) 该持续创始人因“正当理由”（定义见创始人有限责任公司协议）被移除，其中包括创始人有限责任公司协议中所述的特定竞争活动；(v) 就任何在 F 类转换期开始前被接纳为创始人有限责任公司成员的继任成员而言（F 类转换期内作为成员的继任成员除外），为本次发行完成十周年之日；或 (vi) 就我们的七名原始联合创始人中的每一位而言，经其他持续创始人绝对多数批准开始休假，但该休假不得在 F 类转换期内批准，也不得在批准该休假本身会导致 F 类转换期开始的情况下批准。

paras.en: 13 Benjamin Mann has been an integral part of Anthropic since its founding in January 2021 and, given his role in establishing Anthropic, is often referred to as a co-founder. However, Mr. Mann is not a member of the Founder LLC nor a Continuing Founder upon the completion of this offering, and accordingly will not participate in determining how our Class F common stock is voted. Except as set forth in this paragraph, references to our “co-founders” elsewhere in this prospectus do not include Mr. Mann.
paras.zh: 13 Benjamin Mann 自 Anthropic 于 2021 年 1 月成立以来一直是其不可或缺的一员，鉴于其在创立 Anthropic 过程中所发挥的作用，他常被称为联合创始人。然而，Mann 先生并非创始人有限责任公司的成员，在本次发行完成后亦非持续创始人，因此将不参与决定我们的 F 类普通股如何投票。除本段所述外，本招股说明书其他部分提及我们的“联合创始人”时不包括 Mann 先生。

paras.en: Each Continuing Founder will be entitled to one vote when determining how our Class F common stock will be voted. If a majority of the Continuing Founders cannot agree on how our Class F common stock will be voted, then our Class F common stock will generally be voted proportionately with the votes of our Class A common stock cast on the matter (subject to a quorum of a majority of outstanding Class A common stock). With respect to certain matters, our Class F common stock will be voted “for” the proposal only if a greater threshold of Continuing Founders agree, and if the greater threshold is not met, our Class F common stock will be voted “against” the proposal. See the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Class F Common Stock Voting Mechanics.”
paras.zh: 每位持续创始人都有权在决定我们 F 类普通股如何投票时投一票。如果持续创始人的多数无法就我们 F 类普通股如何投票达成一致，则我们 F 类普通股通常将按就该事项所投的 A 类普通股投票比例进行投票（受已发行 A 类普通股多数法定人数的限制）。对于某些事项，只有在更高比例的持续创始人达成一致时，我们 F 类普通股才会对该提案投“赞成”票；如果未达到该更高比例，我们 F 类普通股将对该提案投“反对”票。参见标题为“股本说明——F 类普通股投票机制”的章节。

paras.en: The Founder LLC Agreement will not govern the voting of any shares of our Class A common stock held by the co-founders or their related holders. Each co-founder (or their related holders) will be able to vote shares of our Class A common stock held by them in their discretion, regardless of the manner in which the Founder LLC will vote our Class F common stock.
paras.zh: 创始人有限责任公司协议将不约束联合创始人或其关联持有人所持有的任何 A 类普通股的投票。每位联合创始人（或其关联持有人）将能够自行决定如何投票其持有的 A 类普通股，无论创始人有限责任公司将如何投票我们的 F 类普通股。

paras.en: The voting power of our Class F common stock will not be impacted by future issuances of our capital stock that may cause economic or voting dilution to stockholders, such as issuances for capital raising purposes, acquisitions, or employee compensation. This structure will allow the Founder LLC to determine the outcome of matters submitted to a vote of our stockholders generally, including the election of those directors not elected by the LTBT, certain amendments to our organizational documents, and the approval by our stockholders of any merger, consolidation, sale of substantially all our assets, or other major corporate transaction requiring stockholder approval.
paras.zh: 我们 F 类普通股的投票权将不受未来可能对股东造成经济或投票稀释的股本发行的影响，例如为融资、收购或员工薪酬目的而进行的发行。该结构将使创始人有限责任公司能够决定一般性提交我们股东投票的事项的结果，包括选举非由 LTBT 选举的董事、对我们组织文件的某些修订，以及我们股东对任何合并、整合、出售我们绝大部分资产或其他需要股东批准的重大公司交易的批准。

paras.en: #### Our Co-Founders
paras.zh: #### 我们的联合创始人

paras.en: Our seven co-founders co-founded Anthropic in January [__] 2021. Each co-founder will initially be a member of the Founder LLC and a Continuing Founder for purposes of the Class F common stock structure described above. Brief biographical information about each co-founder is set forth below. [__] 13
paras.zh: 我们的七位联合创始人于 2021 年 1 月[__]共同创立了 Anthropic。就上述 F 类普通股结构而言，每位联合创始人最初将成为创始人有限责任公司的成员及持续创始人。每位联合创始人的简要履历信息载于下文。[__] 13

paras.en: Dario Amodei has served as our Chief Executive Officer and a member of our board of directors since co-founding Anthropic in January 2021. See “Management—Executive Officers” for Dr. Amodei’s full biographical information.
paras.zh: Dario Amodei 自 2021 年 1 月共同创立 Anthropic 以来一直担任我们的首席执行官及董事会成员。有关 Amodei 博士的完整履历信息，参见“管理层——执行官”。

paras.en: Daniela Amodei has served as our President and a member of our board of directors since co-founding Anthropic in January 2021. Ms. Amodei also currently serves as the Chairperson of our board of directors. See “Management—Executive Officers” for Ms. Amodei’s full biographical information.
paras.zh: Daniela Amodei 自 2021 年 1 月共同创立 Anthropic 以来一直担任我们的总裁及董事会成员。Amodei 女士目前还担任我们的董事会主席。有关 Amodei 女士的完整履历信息，参见“管理层——执行官”。

paras.en: Tom Brown co-founded Anthropic in January 2021 and serves as our Chief Compute Officer, leading the technical organization responsible for securing, scaling, and effectively using our compute resources. Prior to co-founding Anthropic, Mr. Brown led the engineering of GPT-3 at OpenAI and, along with Dario Amodei, co-invented deep RLHF, which was central to converting base LLMs into modern conversational assistants such as Claude. He holds an M.Eng. in Computer Science from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
paras.zh: Tom Brown 于 2021 年 1 月共同创立 Anthropic，并担任我们的首席算力官，领导负责获取、扩展和有效利用我们算力资源的技术组织。在共同创立 Anthropic 之前，Brown 先生曾在 OpenAI 领导 GPT-3 的工程工作，并与 Dario Amodei 共同发明了深度 RLHF，该技术对于将基础大语言模型转化为 Claude 等现代对话助手至关重要。他拥有麻省理工学院计算机科学工程硕士学位。

paras.en: Jack Clark co-founded Anthropic in January 2021 and leads the Anthropic Institute, an effort to share research from across Anthropic with external partners and the public, working together to address the biggest questions posed by powerful AI systems. Prior to co-founding Anthropic, Mr. Clark served as Policy Director at OpenAI, where he was responsible for OpenAI’s engagement with governments and regulators on questions related to AI development. Before joining OpenAI, Mr. Clark was a technology journalist covering supercomputers, neural networks, and advanced technology, writing for publications including The Register and BusinessWeek. Mr. Clark also authors “Import AI,” a widely read newsletter on AI research developments.
paras.zh: Jack Clark 于 2021 年 1 月联合创立 Anthropic，并领导 Anthropic Institute，该机构致力于将 Anthropic 各项研究成果与外部合作伙伴及公众分享，共同应对强大 AI 系统带来的重大问题。在联合创立 Anthropic 之前，Clark 先生曾担任 OpenAI 政策总监，负责 OpenAI 与政府和监管机构就 AI 开发相关问题的沟通。加入 OpenAI 之前，Clark 先生是一名科技记者，报道超级计算机、神经网络和先进技术，曾为 The Register 和 BusinessWeek 等刊物撰稿。Clark 先生还撰写了“Import AI”，这是一份广受阅读的 AI 研究进展通讯。

paras.en: Jared Kaplan co-founded Anthropic in January 2021 and serves as our Chief Science Officer. Dr. Kaplan is a theoretical physicist and AI researcher and is one of the principal authors of the neural scaling laws that have shaped modern LLM development, which identify power-law relationships governing the performance of AI systems as a function of model size, dataset size, and compute; he also helped pioneer Constitutional AI. Prior to co-founding Anthropic, Dr. Kaplan was a researcher at OpenAI and an associate professor of physics at Johns Hopkins University, where he taught courses on the foundations of deep learning. He holds a Ph.D. in Physics from Harvard University and a bachelor’s degree in Physics and Mathematics from Stanford University.
paras.zh: Jared Kaplan 于 2021 年 1 月联合创立 Anthropic，并担任我们的首席科学官。Kaplan 博士是一位理论物理学家和 AI 研究员，是塑造现代 LLM 发展的神经缩放定律的主要作者之一，该定律揭示了 AI 系统性能随模型规模、数据集规模和算力变化的幂律关系；他还协助开创了 Constitutional AI。在联合创立 Anthropic 之前，Kaplan 博士曾是 OpenAI 的研究员，并担任约翰斯·霍普金斯大学物理学副教授，讲授深度学习基础课程。他拥有哈佛大学物理学博士学位和斯坦福大学物理学与数学学士学位。

paras.en: Sam McCandlish co-founded Anthropic in January 2021 and serves as our Chief Architect. Dr. McCandlish is a theoretical physicist and machine learning researcher specializing in large-scale model training and AI systems architecture. Prior to co-founding Anthropic, Dr. McCandlish made significant contributions to AI safety research at OpenAI, where he built and led a team focused on the science and scaling of machine learning; his work on scaling laws helped pave the way for large-scale advancements in AI, including the development of GPT-3. He holds a Ph.D. in Physics from Stanford University and a bachelor’s degree in Mathematics and Physics from Brandeis University.
paras.zh: Sam McCandlish 于 2021 年 1 月联合创立 Anthropic，并担任我们的首席架构师。McCandlish 博士是一位理论物理学家和机器学习研究员，专长于大规模模型训练和 AI 系统架构。在联合创立 Anthropic 之前，McCandlish 博士在 OpenAI 的 AI 安全研究方面做出了重要贡献，他在那里组建并领导了一支专注于机器学习科学与规模化的团队；他在缩放定律方面的工作为 AI 的大规模进步铺平了道路，包括 GPT-3 的开发。他拥有斯坦福大学物理学博士学位和布兰迪斯大学数学与物理学学士学位。

paras.en: Christopher Olah co-founded Anthropic in January 2021 and leads our interpretability research efforts. Prior to co-founding Anthropic, Mr. Olah led interpretability research at OpenAI and, before that, was a research scientist at Google Brain (now part of Google DeepMind). Mr. Olah is widely recognized as a foundational figure in the field of mechanistic interpretability. More broadly, his work has been widely cited across a range of topics in AI.
paras.zh: Christopher Olah 于 2021 年 1 月联合创立 Anthropic，并领导我们的可解释性研究工作。在联合创立 Anthropic 之前，Olah 先生领导了 OpenAI 的可解释性研究，在此之前，他是 Google Brain（现为 Google DeepMind 的一部分）的研究科学家。Olah 先生被广泛认为是机制可解释性领域的奠基性人物。更广泛地说，他的工作在 AI 的多个主题上被广泛引用。

paras.en: #### Philanthropy
paras.zh: #### 慈善事业

paras.en: We founded Anthropic on the belief that the most transformative technology in human history demands an extraordinary level of responsibility, and that responsibility extends far beyond building safe systems. We intend to direct a meaningful portion of our resources toward ensuring that frontier AI is safe and its benefits are broadly distributed, which we refer to as our public benefit initiatives. These initiatives include the Initial Public Benefit Issuance and the future Public Benefit Issuances. In addition, our co-founders have each pledged to dedicate 80% of their personal equity in Anthropic to philanthropic causes. For additional information regarding these pledges, including related risks, see the section titled “Risk Factors—Risks Related to Ownership of our Class A Common Stock.” Separate from the co-founders’ pledges, we also maintain a donation matching program through which employees can pledge a meaningful portion of their equity awards toward charitable giving, which we match with shares of our Class N common stock. Further, certain donor-advised funds may from time to time receive donations of shares directly from us or from one or more of our stockholders, and we are party to certain irrevocable proxy agreements with such donor-advised funds, as described under “Certain Relationships and Related Person Transactions—Irrevocable Proxy Agreements.”
paras.zh: 我们创立 Anthropic 的信念是，人类历史上最具变革性的技术需要极高程度的责任担当，而这种责任远不止于构建安全的系统。我们打算将相当一部分资源用于确保前沿 AI 的安全及其收益的广泛分配，我们将其称为我们的公益倡议。这些倡议包括首次公益发行及未来的公益发行。此外，我们的联合创始人已各自承诺将其在 Anthropic 个人股权的 80% 用于慈善事业。有关这些承诺的更多信息（包括相关风险），请参见标题为“风险因素——与我们的 A 类普通股所有权相关的风险”一节。除联合创始人的承诺外，我们还设有一项捐赠配比计划，员工可通过该计划承诺将其股权奖励的相当一部分用于慈善捐赠，我们以 N 类普通股股票进行配比。此外，某些捐赠人建议基金可能不时直接收到我们或我们一名或多名股东捐赠的股份，且我们与这些捐赠人建议基金签订了若干不可撤销的委托代理协议，详见“某些关系及相关人士交易——不可撤销的委托代理协议”。

paras.en: Our Class E common stock will not have any right to vote except on certain specified matters (or as otherwise required by law): the nomination or proposed removal of the Specified Class T Director or a change in the director designated as the Specified Class T Director (in circumstances where our NGC does not concur with the LTBT’s proposed action) and certain proposals to amend the terms of the LTBT and the rights of our Class T common stock or to redeem our Class T common stock.
paras.zh: 我们的 E 类普通股将不享有任何投票权，但以下特定事项除外（或法律另有要求时）：指定 T 类董事的提名或提议罢免，或指定 T 类董事的变更（在我们 NGC 不同意 LTBT 提议行动的情形下），以及某些修订 LTBT 条款和我们 T 类普通股权利或赎回我们 T 类普通股的提案。

paras.en: When voting upon a proposal to nominate or remove the Specified Class T Director or a change in the director designated as the Specified Class T Director (in circumstances where our NGC does not concur with the LTBT’s proposed action), the requisite approval of our Class E common stock will require a majority of votes cast by our Class E common stock and quorum will require the presence, in person or by proxy, of a majority of outstanding shares of Class E common stock.
paras.zh: 在对提名或罢免指定 T 类董事或变更指定 T 类董事的提案（在我们 NGC 不同意 LTBT 提议行动的情形下）进行投票时，我们 E 类普通股的必要批准将要求我们 E 类普通股所投票数的多数，且法定人数将要求我们 E 类普通股已发行股份的多数亲自或通过代理人出席。

paras.en: When voting on a proposal to amend the terms of the LTBT or the rights of our Class T common stock or to redeem our Class T common stock, in addition to the requisite approval of our Class A common stock as described more fully in the section titled “—Changes to the LTBT and Class T Common Stock,” the requisite approval of our Class E common stock will require:
paras.zh: 在对修订 LTBT 条款或我们 T 类普通股权利或赎回我们 T 类普通股的提案进行投票时，除如标题为“——对 LTBT 和 T 类普通股的变更”一节中更全面描述的我们 A 类普通股的必要批准外，我们 E 类普通股的必要批准将要求：

paras.en: - until the third anniversary of the completion of this offering, if our Class F common stock is acting pursuant to the unanimous approval of the Continuing Founders, a majority of the votes cast by our Class E common stock (subject to a quorum of 40% of our outstanding Class E common stock); or
paras.zh: - 在本次发行完成三周年之前，如果我们 F 类普通股根据持续创始人的一致批准行事，则为我们 E 类普通股所投票数的多数（须达到我们已发行 E 类普通股 40%的法定人数）；或

paras.en: - at any time when our Class F common stock remains outstanding, 75% of the votes cast by our Class E common stock (subject to a quorum of a majority of outstanding Class E common stock).
paras.zh: - 在我们 F 类普通股仍为已发行的任何时间，为我们 E 类普通股所投票数的 75%（须达到已发行 E 类普通股多数的法定人数）。

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, which will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering, will authorize Class E common stock, which will be issued to our employees as follows: (i) one share of Class E common stock for each six months of employment completed with us and (ii) one share of Class E common stock for each share of Class A common stock that such employee has pledged to donate through our donation matching program, or any similar program we may establish in the future. The timing for issuing Class E common stock will be determined after the closing of this offering. Our co-founders will not receive any shares of Class E common stock, and to the extent that a holder of Class E common stock later serves as a successor to any co-founder’s interest in the Founder LLC, they will not be able to vote any Class E common stock they hold during the period of such service.
paras.zh: 我们经修订和重述的公司章程将在本次发行完成前立即生效，将授权 E 类普通股，该等股份将按如下方式发行给我们员工：(i) 在我们处每完成六个月雇佣发行一股 E 类普通股，以及 (ii) 该员工已承诺通过我们的捐赠匹配计划或我们未来可能设立的任何类似计划捐赠的每一股 A 类普通股发行一股 E 类普通股。发行 E 类普通股的时间将在本次发行结束后确定。我们的联合创始人将不会获得任何 E 类普通股，且如果 E 类普通股持有人后来担任创始人有限责任公司中任何联合创始人权益的继任者，其在该等服务期间将无法对其持有的任何 E 类普通股进行投票。

paras.en: Following an employee’s separation from employment with us other than for cause, one-half of such employee’s then-outstanding shares of Class E common stock will be automatically redeemed by us annually, and all of such employee’s shares will be automatically redeemed upon such employee’s death, incapacity, termination for cause, or commencement of service with a direct competitor. All shares of Class E common stock will also be automatically redeemed at such time as no Class F common stock remains outstanding. Any redemption of Class E common stock will be made for no consideration.
paras.zh: 在员工与我们终止雇佣关系（非因过错）后，该员工当时持有的 E 类普通股中有一半将由我们每年自动赎回，且该员工的全部股份将在其死亡、丧失行为能力、因过错被解雇或开始为直接竞争对手服务时自动赎回。所有 E 类普通股也将在不再有任何 F 类普通股流通在外时自动赎回。任何 E 类普通股的赎回均无需支付对价。

paras.en: Decisions regarding our business and affairs are made by our board of directors. Immediately prior to the completion of this offering, we will enter into the Stockholders’ Agreement with the LTBT and the Founder LLC, under which they will agree to vote their shares and take other actions to give effect to the board composition, director nomination, and director removal provisions described in our governing documents. Collectively, the LTBT and the Founder LLC will have the ability to elect all members of our board of directors. Regardless of the class or classes of stock by which a director is elected, there is no limit to the number of terms a director may serve.
paras.zh: 我们的业务和事务决策由董事会作出。本次发行完成前，我们将与 LTBT 和创始人有限责任公司签订《股东协议》，据此，二者同意对其股份进行投票并采取其他行动，以使公司治理文件中所述的董事会构成、董事提名和董事罢免条款生效。LTBT 和创始人有限责任公司合计将有能力选举我们董事会的全部成员。无论董事是通过哪一类或哪几类股票选举产生的，董事的任期届数均不受限制。

paras.en: While the LTBT has significant influence over our board of directors through its ability to generally elect and remove a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors, neither the LTBT nor the Trustees have decision-making authority in the day-to-day management or strategy setting of the company. The LTBT’s role is to select directors who are well-equipped to make decisions in furtherance of the responsible balancing of the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and the Company Purpose, and to support our management’s decision-making through advice and guidance. The Trustees aim to choose directors who have the necessary business skills, experience, and expertise to oversee the management of our business effectively and in a manner that responsibly balances (i) the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, (ii) the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and (iii) the Company Purpose.
paras.zh: 尽管 LTBT 通过其通常能够选举和罢免我们董事会多数授权成员的能力，对我们的董事会具有重大影响，但 LTBT 和受托人均无权对公司的日常管理或战略制定作出决策。LTBT 的职责是遴选有能力作出决策的董事，以负责任地平衡我们股东的金钱利益、受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益以及公司宗旨，并通过建议和指导支持我们管理层的决策。受托人旨在选择具备必要商业技能、经验和专业知识的董事，以有效监督我们业务的管理，并以负责任地平衡 (i) 我们股东的金钱利益、(ii) 受我们行为重大影响者的最佳利益以及 (iii) 公司宗旨的方式行事。

paras.en: The Founder LLC will also have significant influence over our business and affairs through its ability to vote our Class F common stock, which is entitled to an aggregate number of votes that equals 50.1% of the total voting power of our outstanding shares of capital stock as of the applicable record date with respect to matters submitted to stockholders generally. The Founder LLC will be able to elect and remove the directors who are not Class T directors and determine the outcome of all matters submitted to a vote of our stockholders generally (including the approval of any merger, sale of our company, or other significant corporate transaction requiring stockholder approval) for the foreseeable future.
paras.zh: 创始人有限责任公司还将通过其对我们的 F 类普通股的投票能力，对我们的业务和事务具有重大影响；就提交股东一般表决的事项而言，在适用记录日期，F 类普通股合计享有的投票权相当于我们已发行股本总投票权的 50.1%。在可预见的未来，创始人有限责任公司将能够选举和罢免非 T 类董事的董事，并决定提交我们股东一般表决的所有事项的结果（包括批准任何合并、出售我们公司或其他需要股东批准的重大公司交易）。

paras.en: We are considered a “controlled company” within the meaning of the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements because the LTBT, as the sole holder of our Class T common stock, generally has the power to elect a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors. As such, we are permitted to opt out of compliance with certain Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements. Accordingly, if we elect not to comply with certain requirements, you will not have the same protections afforded to stockholders of companies that are subject to all of the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements. Although we qualify as a “controlled company,” we do not expect to rely on this exemption except with respect to our NGC, which will not consist entirely of independent directors. Our board of directors currently consists of a majority of independent directors and our audit and compensation committees currently consist entirely of independent directors.
paras.zh: 由于 LTBT 作为我们 T 类普通股的唯一持有人，通常有权选举我们董事会授权成员中的多数，因此根据纳斯达克全球精选市场公司治理要求，我们被视为一家“受控公司”。因此，我们被允许选择豁免遵守纳斯达克全球精选市场的某些公司治理要求。相应地，如果我们选择不遵守某些要求，您将无法获得那些受全部纳斯达克全球精选市场公司治理要求约束的公司的股东所享有的同等保护。尽管我们符合“受控公司”的资格，但我们预计不会依赖这一豁免，惟我们的 NGC 除外，该委员会将不会完全由独立董事组成。我们的董事会目前由多数独立董事组成，我们的审计委员会和薪酬委员会目前完全由独立董事组成。

Removals due to incapacity, cause or the failure to maintain the minimum ownership threshold require prior written notice from the Founder LLC by action of a majority of the other Continuing Founders.
If a Continuing Founder is removed due to death or incapacity during the first ten years following the completion of this offering, a successor member may be admitted to the
Founder LLC and will count toward the three
Continuing Founders required to avoid triggering the Class F Transition Period until the tenth anniversary of the completion of this offering.
The Class F Sunset Time, once triggered, is not subject to extension, delay or waiver.

因辞职、死亡或本次发行完成而发生的移除自动生效，无需任何其他人的决定。因丧失行为能力而发生的移除，需由受影响持续创始人共同选定的一名合格医生作出判定（针对身体或精神损伤情形），或由其他持续创始人的绝对多数作出判定（针对错误监禁、非法拘禁、囚禁或人身限制情形），但受影响持续创始人有权对该判定提出异议。因事由而发生的移除，需由其他持续创始人的绝对多数作出肯定性判定，但受影响持续创始人有权对该判定提出异议，或在特定类别的事由情形下，有权消除该移除的依据。
因丧失行为能力、事由或未能维持最低持股门槛而发生的移除，需由创始人有限责任公司经其他持续创始人多数表决通过后发出事先书面通知。
如某持续创始人在本次发行完成后的前十年内因死亡或丧失行为能力而被移除，可接纳一名继任成员加入创始人有限责任公司，且在本次发行完成十周年之前，该继任成员将计入为避免触发 F 类转换期所必需的三名持续创始人之列。

paras.zh: 在 T 类日落时间之前，长期利益信托（LTBT）作为 T 类普通股的唯一持有人，通常将有权选举和移除 T 类董事，T 类董事构成我们董事会授权成员的多数。我们的 T 类普通股股份对一般提交股东表决的事项不享有投票权，但我们的经修订和重述的公司章程所规定的情形除外，包括就选举我们董事会的多数成员或法律要求的情形。

paras.en: Following the Class T Sunset Time, if our Class F common stock remains outstanding, our Class A common stock and Class F common stock, voting together as a single class, will elect all of our directors. Because our Class F common stock is entitled to an aggregate number of votes equal to 50.1% of the total voting power of our outstanding shares of capital stock, the Founder LLC would have the ability to determine the outcome of all matters submitted to a vote of stockholders generally, including the election of all directors.
paras.zh: 在 T 类日落时间之后，如我们的 F 类普通股仍为流通在外，我们的 A 类普通股和 F 类普通股将作为单一类别共同投票，选举我们的全部董事。由于我们的 F 类普通股合计享有相当于我们流通在外股本总投票权 50.1%的投票权，创始人有限责任公司将有能力决定一般提交股东表决的所有事项的结果，包括选举全部董事。

paras.en: If neither our Class T common stock nor Class F common stock remains outstanding, our Class A common stock would have the ability to determine the outcome of all matters submitted to a vote of stockholders generally, including the election of all directors.
