paras.en: Dario Amodei [__] . [__] Dr. Amodei has served as our Chief Executive Officer and a member of our board of directors since co-founding Anthropic in January 2021. Prior to co-founding Anthropic, Dr. Amodei served as Vice President of Research, among other positions, at OpenAI, an AI research lab, from July 2016 to December 2020. Before joining OpenAI, Dr. Amodei served as a Senior Research Scientist at Google Brain, an AI research team at Google, from October 2015 to June 2016. Dr. Amodei completed a postdoctoral fellowship at Stanford University School of Medicine. Dr. Amodei holds a Ph.D. in Biophysics from Princeton University and a B.S. in Physics from Stanford University. We believe that Dr. Amodei is qualified to serve on our board of directors because of the perspective and experience he brings from his deep expertise in the AI industry and as our Chief Executive Officer and as a co-founder.
paras.zh: Dario Amodei [__] 。[__] Amodei 博士自 2021 年 1 月联合创立 Anthropic 以来，一直担任我们的首席执行官兼董事会成员。在联合创立 Anthropic 之前，Amodei 博士于 2016 年 7 月至 2020 年 12 月期间在 AI 研究实验室 OpenAI 担任研究副总裁及其他职务。在加入 OpenAI 之前，Amodei 博士于 2015 年 10 月至 2016 年 6 月期间在 Google 旗下 AI 研究团队 Google Brain 担任高级研究科学家。Amodei 博士曾在斯坦福大学医学院完成博士后研究。Amodei 博士持有普林斯顿大学生物物理学博士学位及斯坦福大学物理学学士学位。我们相信，Amodei 博士具备担任我们董事会成员的资格，原因在于他凭借其在 AI 行业的深厚专业积累，以及作为我们的首席执行官和联合创始人，为我们带来了独特的视角与经验。

paras.en: Daniela Amodei. Ms. Amodei has served as our President and a member of our board of directors since co-founding Anthropic in January 2021. Ms. Amodei also currently serves as the Chairperson of our board of directors. Prior to co-founding Anthropic, Ms. Amodei held several positions at OpenAI, an AI research lab, including Vice President of Safety and Policy, Vice President of People, and Engineering Manager, between October 2018 and December 2020. Before joining OpenAI, Ms. Amodei was a Risk Manager, among other positions, at Stripe, a financial technology and payment processing company, from May 2013 to July 2018. Ms. Amodei holds a B.A. in English Literature from the University of California, Santa Cruz. We believe that Ms. Amodei is qualified to serve on our board of directors because of the perspective and experience she brings through her deep expertise in the AI industry and as our President and as a co-founder.
paras.zh: Daniela Amodei。Amodei 女士自 2021 年 1 月联合创立 Anthropic 以来，一直担任我们的总裁兼董事会成员。Amodei 女士目前还担任我们董事会主席。在联合创立 Anthropic 之前，Amodei 女士于 2018 年 10 月至 2020 年 12 月期间在 AI 研究实验室 OpenAI 担任多个职务，包括安全与政策副总裁、人事副总裁及工程经理。在加入 OpenAI 之前，Amodei 女士于 2013 年 5 月至 2018 年 7 月期间在金融科技与支付处理公司 Stripe 担任风险经理及其他职务。Amodei 女士持有加州大学圣克鲁兹分校英国文学学士学位。我们相信，Amodei 女士具备担任我们董事会成员的资格，原因在于她凭借其在 AI 行业的深厚专业积累，以及作为我们的总裁和联合创始人，为我们带来了独特的视角与经验。

paras.en: Krishna Rao. Mr. Rao has served as our Chief Financial Officer since April 2024. Prior to joining Anthropic, Mr. Rao served as Chief Financial Officer at Fanatics Commerce, an online sports merchandise and retail platform, from May 2023 to April 2024. Before that, he served as the Chief Financial Officer of Cedar, a healthcare technology company, from July 2021 to May 2023. From October 2015 to July 2021, Mr. Rao held several key positions at Airbnb, a global vacation rental and hospitality platform, including Global Head of Corporate & Business Development and Director of Financial Planning & Analysis. Prior to Airbnb, Mr. Rao was a Principal in the Private Equity Group at Blackstone, a global investment firm, from September 2011 to September 2015. Mr. Rao began his career as a strategy consultant at Bain, a global management consulting firm, from September 2005 to July 2008. Mr. Rao holds a J.D. from Yale Law School and an A.B. in Economics from Harvard College.
paras.zh: Krishna Rao。Rao 先生自 2024 年 4 月起担任我们的首席财务官。在加入 Anthropic 之前，Rao 先生于 2023 年 5 月至 2024 年 4 月期间在在线体育商品与零售平台 Fanatics Commerce 担任首席财务官。在此之前，他于 2021 年 7 月至 2023 年 5 月期间在医疗科技公司 Cedar 担任首席财务官。2015 年 10 月至 2021 年 7 月期间，Rao 先生在全球度假租赁与酒店服务平台 Airbnb 担任多个关键职务，包括全球企业与业务发展负责人及财务规划与分析总监。在加入 Airbnb 之前，Rao 先生于 2011 年 9 月至 2015 年 9 月期间在全球投资公司 Blackstone 的私募股权集团担任 Principal。Rao 先生的职业生涯始于全球管理咨询公司 Bain，于 2005 年 9 月至 2008 年 7 月期间担任战略咨询顾问。Rao 先生持有耶鲁法学院法学博士学位及哈佛学院经济学学士学位。

paras.en: Reed Hastings. Mr. Hastings has served as a member of our board of directors since May 2025. Mr. Hastings co-founded Netflix, a global streaming service, and served as Netflix’s Chief Executive Officer and President from 1999 to January 2023, Executive Chairman from January 2023 to April 2025, and Chairman of the board from April 2025 to June 2026. Prior to Netflix, Mr. Hastings founded Pure Software, a software development tools company, in 1991 and served as its Chief Executive Officer until its acquisition by Rational Software in 1997. Mr. Hastings currently serves on the board of Bloomberg, a financial data and media company. Mr. Hastings holds an M.S.C.S. in Artificial Intelligence from Stanford University and a B.A. in Mathematics from Bowdoin College. We believe that Mr. Hastings is qualified to serve as a member of our board of directors because of his extensive board experience at major technology companies, his demonstrated commitment to responsible innovation and its societal impact, his deep understanding of technology’s transformative potential, and his philanthropic focus on education and AI’s impact on humanity.
paras.zh: Reed Hastings。Hastings 先生自 2025 年 5 月起担任本公司董事会成员。Hastings 先生联合创立了全球流媒体服务公司 Netflix，并于 1999 年至 2023 年 1 月担任 Netflix 首席执行官兼总裁，2023 年 1 月至 2025 年 4 月担任执行董事长，2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 6 月担任董事会主席。在 Netflix 之前，Hastings 先生于 1991 年创立了软件开发工具公司 Pure Software，并担任其首席执行官直至该公司于 1997 年被 Rational Software 收购。Hastings 先生目前担任金融数据和媒体公司 Bloomberg 的董事会成员。Hastings 先生持有斯坦福大学人工智能专业计算机科学硕士学位（M.S.C.S.）以及鲍登学院数学学士学位。我们认为，Hastings 先生具备担任本公司董事会成员的资格，原因在于他在大型科技公司拥有丰富的董事会经验、其在负责任创新及其社会影响方面展现出的坚定承诺、其对技术变革潜力的深刻理解，以及其在教育及 AI 对人类影响方面的慈善关注。

paras.en: Christopher Liddell. Mr. Liddell has served as a member of our board of directors since February 2026. In the private sector, Mr. Liddell has served as the Chief Financial Officer of several public companies, including Microsoft and International Paper, and served as Vice Chairman and Chief Financial Officer at General Motors. Mr. Liddell has served as a Director of Commonwealth Fusion Systems, a fusion power company, since March 2025, and as a Director of the Council on Foreign Relations, a nonpartisan U.S. think tank focused on foreign policy and international affairs, since July 2025. He has also held positions with the U.S. government from January 2017 to January 2021, including serving at the White House as the Deputy Chief of Staff, Director of Strategic Initiatives, and as a member of the American Technology Council. Mr. Liddell holds a Master of Philosophy from the University of Oxford and a Bachelor of Engineering from the University of Auckland. We believe that Mr. Liddell is qualified to serve as a member of our board of directors because of his wide range of experience from his corporate and public service career and his deep expertise in the financial management of publicly listed companies.
paras.zh: Christopher Liddell。Liddell 先生自 2026 年 2 月起担任本公司董事会成员。在私营部门，Liddell 先生曾担任多家上市公司的首席财务官，包括 Microsoft 和 International Paper，并曾担任 General Motors 的副董事长兼首席财务官。Liddell 先生自 2025 年 3 月起担任聚变能源公司 Commonwealth Fusion Systems 的董事，并自 2025 年 7 月起担任美国无党派智库外交关系委员会（Council on Foreign Relations）的董事，该智库专注于外交政策和国际事务。他还曾于 2017 年 1 月至 2021 年 1 月在美国政府任职，包括在白宫担任副幕僚长、战略倡议主任以及美国技术委员会（American Technology Council）成员。Liddell 先生持有牛津大学哲学硕士学位以及奥克兰大学工程学士学位。我们认为，Liddell 先生具备担任本公司董事会成员的资格，原因在于其在企业及公共服务职业生涯中积累的广泛经验，以及其在上市公司财务管理方面的深厚专业能力。

paras.en: Vasant “Vas” Narasimhan. Dr. Narasimhan has served as a member of our board of directors since April 2026. Dr. Narasimhan has served as the Chief Executive Officer of Novartis AG, a global medicine company, since February 2018. He joined Novartis in April 2005 and has held numerous leadership roles across the organization, including Global Head of Drug Development and Chief Medical Officer from February 2016 to January 2018 and Global Head of Development from September 2014 to February 2016. Dr. Narasimhan holds an M.D. from Harvard Medical School, an M.P.P. from the Harvard Kennedy School, and a B.A. in Biology from the University of Chicago. We believe that Dr. Narasimhan is qualified to serve as a member of our board of directors because of his extensive experience leading a large global public company in a highly regulated industry and his track record of responsibly stewarding breakthrough science at scale.
paras.zh: Vasant “Vas”Narasimhan。Narasimhan 博士自 2026 年 4 月起担任我们董事会成员。Narasimhan 博士自 2018 年 2 月起担任全球制药公司 Novartis AG 的首席执行官。他于 2005 年 4 月加入 Novartis，并在该组织内担任过多个领导职务，包括 2016 年 2 月至 2018 年 1 月担任全球药物开发负责人兼首席医疗官，以及 2014 年 9 月至 2016 年 2 月担任全球开发负责人。Narasimhan 博士拥有哈佛医学院医学博士学位、哈佛肯尼迪学院公共政策硕士学位，以及芝加哥大学生物学学士学位。我们认为，Narasimhan 博士具备担任我们董事会成员的资格，因为他在高度监管的行业中领导一家大型全球上市公司的丰富经验，以及在规模化负责任地推动突破性科学方面的过往业绩。

paras.en: Yasmin Razavi [__] . [__] Ms. Razavi has served as a member of our board of directors since March 2023. Ms. Razavi joined Spark Capital, a venture capital firm, in July 2017 and has served as a General Partner since March 2020. Prior to joining Spark Capital, Ms. Razavi served as an investor at Index Ventures, a venture capital firm, from August 2014 to August 2015, and as a consultant at McKinsey & Company, a business management consulting firm, from August 2012 to August 2014. Ms. Razavi holds an M.B.A. from Harvard Business School and a Bachelor of Applied Science and Engineering from the University of Toronto. We believe that Ms. Razavi is qualified to serve as a member of our board of directors because of her experience in venture capital and growth-stage investing, her deep expertise in enterprise go-to-market strategies, and her understanding of the technology sector and scaling high-growth companies.
paras.zh: Yasmin Razavi [__] 。[__] Razavi 女士自 2023 年 3 月起担任我们董事会成员。Razavi 女士于 2017 年 7 月加入风险投资公司 Spark Capital，并自 2020 年 3 月起担任普通合伙人。在加入 Spark Capital 之前，Razavi 女士于 2014 年 8 月至 2015 年 8 月担任风险投资公司 Index Ventures 的投资人，并于 2012 年 8 月至 2014 年 8 月担任企业管理咨询公司 McKinsey & Company 的顾问。Razavi 女士拥有哈佛商学院工商管理硕士学位，以及多伦多大学应用科学与工程学士学位。我们认为，Razavi 女士具备担任我们董事会成员的资格，因为她在风险投资和成长期投资方面的经验、在企业市场进入策略方面的深厚专业知识，以及她对技术行业和规模化高增长公司的理解。

paras.en: Dario Amodei, our Chief Executive Officer and a member of our board of directors, and Daniela Amodei, our President and Chairperson of our board of directors, are siblings. There are no other family relationships among any of our executive officers or directors.
paras.zh: 我们的首席执行官兼董事会成员 Dario Amodei 与我们的总裁兼董事会主席 Daniela Amodei 系兄弟姐妹关系。我们的任何其他高管或董事之间不存在其他亲属关系。

paras.en: Our board of directors has adopted a code of conduct that applies to all of our employees, officers, and directors, including our Chief Executive Officer, President, Chief Financial Officer, and other executive and senior financial officers. The full text of our code of conduct will be posted on the investor relations page of our website. We intend to disclose any amendments to our code of conduct, or waivers of its requirements, on our website or in filings under the Exchange Act.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会已通过一项适用于全体员工、高管和董事（包括我们的首席执行官、总裁、首席财务官及其他高管和高级财务官）的行为准则。我们的行为准则全文将发布在我们网站的投资者关系页面上。我们拟在我们网站上或根据《交易法》提交的文件中披露对我们行为准则的任何修订或对其要求的任何豁免。

paras.en: Our business and affairs are managed under the direction of our board of directors. Our board of directors currently consists of six directors. Pursuant to our current certificate of incorporation and amended and restated voting agreement, our current directors were elected as follows:
paras.zh: 我们的业务和事务在董事会的指导下管理。我们的董事会目前由六名董事组成。根据我们现行的公司章程以及经修订和重述的表决协议，我们现任董事的选举方式如下：

paras.en: - Dr. Amodei, as our Chief Executive Officer, was elected by holders of our Voting Common Stock (as defined in our current certificate of incorporation) (excluding shares of Voting Common Stock issued or issuable upon conversion of the shares of our redeemable convertible preferred stock);
paras.zh: - Amodei 博士作为我们的首席执行官，由我们具有表决权普通股（定义见我们现行的公司章程）的持有人（不包括因可赎回可转换优先股转换而发行或可发行的具有表决权普通股股份）选举产生；

paras.en: - Mr. Liddell was elected as the designee nominated by holders of our Voting Common Stock (excluding shares of Voting Common Stock issued or issuable upon conversion of the shares of our redeemable convertible preferred stock);
paras.zh: - Liddell 先生由我们具有表决权普通股的持有人（不包括因可赎回可转换优先股转换而发行或可发行的具有表决权普通股股份）提名并选举为指定董事；

paras.en: - Ms. Razavi was elected by holders of our Senior Voting Preferred Stock (as defined in our current certificate of incorporation); and
paras.zh: - Razavi 女士由我们高级表决权优先股（定义见我们现行的公司章程）的持有人选举产生；以及

paras.en: - Ms. Amodei, Mr. Hastings, and Dr. Narasimhan were elected as the designees nominated by the LTBT as the holder of our Class T common stock.
paras.zh: - Amodei 女士、Hastings 先生和 Narasimhan 博士由长期利益信托（LTBT）作为我们 T 类普通股持有人提名并选举为指定董事。

paras.en: Our amended and restated voting agreement will terminate and the provisions of our current certificate of incorporation by which our directors were elected will be amended and restated in connection with this offering. Each of our current directors will continue to serve as a director until the next annual meeting and until the election and qualification of their successor, or until their earlier death, resignation, or removal.
paras.zh: 我们的经修订和重述的表决协议将终止，我们现行公司章程中关于董事选举的条款将与本发行相关进行修订和重述。我们每位现任董事将继续担任董事直至下一届年度股东大会，并直至其继任者经选举并符合资格，或直至其提前去世、辞职或被免职。

paras.en: Upon the completion of this offering, our board of directors will consist of seven authorized directors, elected as follows:
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，我们的董事会将由七名授权董事组成，选举方式如下：

paras.en: - The holder of our Class T common stock, the LTBT, will generally have the authority to elect and remove the four Class T directors, subject to the procedures described in the section titled “Our Governance Structure and Its Goals—Long-Term Benefit Trust—Election and Removal of Directors.” The initial Class T directors will be Mr. Hastings, Dr. Narasimhan, Mr. Liddell, and one vacancy. Mr. Liddell will serve as the Specified Class T Director.
paras.zh: - 我们 T 类普通股的持有人，即长期利益信托（LTBT），通常有权选举和罢免四名 T 类董事，但须遵守标题为“我们的治理结构及其目标——长期利益信托——董事的选举和罢免”一节中所述的程序。初始 T 类董事将为 Hastings 先生、Narasimhan 博士、Liddell 先生以及一个空缺。Liddell 先生将担任指定 T 类董事。

paras.en: - The holders of our Class F common stock and Class A common stock, voting together as a single class, will have the authority to elect and remove the remaining three directors, who will initially be Dr. Amodei, Ms. Amodei, and Ms. Razavi [__] .
paras.zh: - 我们 F 类普通股和 A 类普通股的持有人，作为单一类别共同投票，将有权选举和罢免其余三名董事，初始将为 Amodei 博士、Amodei 女士和 Razavi 女士 [__]。

paras.en: For additional information, see the sections titled “Description of Capital Stock” and “Our Governance Structure and Its Goals.”
paras.zh: 有关更多信息，请参见标题为“股本说明”和“我们的治理结构及其目标”的章节。

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation that will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering will provide that prior to the Class F Sunset Time, we will not have a classified board of directors, and all directors will be elected for annual terms. Each director’s term will continue until the next annual meeting and until the election and qualification of their successor, or their earlier death, resignation, or removal.
paras.zh: 我们经修订和重述的公司章程将在本次发行完成前立即生效，其中规定，在 F 类股日落时间之前，我们将不设分类董事会，所有董事均按年度任期选举产生。每位董事的任期将持续至下一届年度股东大会，并直至其继任者经选举并符合任职资格为止，或直至其提前身故、辞职或被免职。

paras.en: Following the Class F Sunset Time, our board of directors will shift to having a classified board of directors consisting of three classes of approximately equal size, each serving staggered three-year terms. At such time, each of our directors would be assigned by the then-current board of directors to a class. If our Class T common stock remains outstanding, the Class T directors and the remaining directors shall be allocated among the classes so that each class includes a proportionate number of Class T directors and other directors. Upon expiration of the term of a class of directors, directors for that class would each be elected for a three-year term at the annual meeting of stockholders in the year in which that term expires. As a result, only one class of directors would be elected at each annual meeting of our stockholders, with the other classes continuing for the remainder of their respective three-year terms. Each director’s term would continue until the third annual meeting of stockholders following their election and until his or her successor has been elected and qualified, or until his or her earlier death, resignation, or removal. Any increase or decrease in the number of directors would be distributed among the three classes so that, as nearly as practicable, each class would consist of one-third of our directors.
paras.zh: 在 F 类股日落时间之后，我们的董事会将转为分类董事会，由三个规模大致相当的类别组成，每类董事的任期 staggered 为三年。届时，每位董事将由当时的董事会分配至某一类别。如果我们的 T 类普通股仍未注销，则 T 类董事和其余董事应在各类别之间进行分配，使每个类别均包含相应比例的 T 类董事和其他董事。某一类别董事的任期届满后，该类别董事将在该任期届满当年的年度股东大会上各自经选举产生，任期三年。因此，每次年度股东大会仅选举一个类别的董事，其他类别则在其各自三年任期的剩余时间内继续任职。每位董事的任期将持续至其当选后的第三届年度股东大会，并直至其继任者经选举并符合任职资格为止，或直至其提前身故、辞职或被免职。董事人数的任何增加或减少应在三个类别之间分配，以使每个类别尽可能由三分之一的董事组成。

paras.en: Regardless of the class or classes of stock by which a director is elected, there is no limit to the number of terms a director may serve.
paras.zh: 无论董事由哪一类或哪几类股票选举产生，董事可连任的届数均无限制。

full.sec: Stockholder Meetings and Actions by Written Consent
full.secZh: 股东会议及书面同意行动

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation that will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering will provide that, for so long as our Class F common stock or Class T common stock remains outstanding, our stockholders may act by written consent with respect to certain actions, including any action to elect or remove directors. Although stockholders will have the ability to take these actions by written consent, we value the perspectives of all of our stockholders and, in accordance with the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market, we expect to hold an annual meeting of stockholders and to solicit the votes of holders of our Class A common stock in respect of relevant matters to be considered at such meeting, including the election of our directors who are not Class T directors.
paras.zh: 我们经修订和重述的公司章程将在本次发行完成前立即生效，其中规定，只要我们的 F 类普通股或 T 类普通股仍为流通在外，我们的股东可就某些事项（包括任何选举或罢免董事的事项）以书面同意方式行事。尽管股东将有能力以书面同意方式采取该等行动，我们仍重视全体股东的观点，并且根据纳斯达克全球精选市场的上市标准，我们预计将召开年度股东大会，并就拟在该会议上审议的相关事项（包括选举非 T 类董事的董事）征求我们 A 类普通股持有人的投票。

paras.en: Our board of directors has appointed Daniela Amodei to serve as Chairperson of the Board. As Chairperson, Ms. Amodei will preside over meetings of our board of directors and stockholders, advise the Chief Executive Officer, and perform such other duties as specified in our amended and restated bylaws or as determined by our board of directors from time to time.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会已任命 Daniela Amodei 担任董事会主席。作为主席，Amodei 女士将主持我们的董事会和股东会议，向首席执行官提供建议，并履行我们经修订和重述的章程中规定的或由我们的董事会不时确定的其他职责。

paras.en: Our board of directors has appointed Reed Hastings to serve as Lead Independent Director. As Lead Independent Director, Mr. Hastings will, among other things, preside over meetings of our independent directors, advise the Chairperson on the scheduling and agenda for board meetings and any other matters of concern to the independent directors, serve as a liaison between the Chairperson and the independent directors, and perform such other duties as specified in our amended and restated bylaws or as determined by the independent directors from time to time. Our board of directors believes that having a Lead Independent Director is an important component of sound corporate governance and provides an effective check and balance to ensure that our board of directors can operate independently of management where appropriate, including with respect to performance evaluation and compensation matters.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会已任命 Reed Hastings 担任首席独立董事。作为首席独立董事，Hastings 先生将（除其他事项外）主持我们的独立董事会议，就董事会会议的日程安排和议程以及独立董事关注的任何其他事项向主席提供建议，担任主席与独立董事之间的联络人，并履行我们经修订和重述的章程中规定的或由独立董事不时确定的其他职责。我们的董事会认为，设立首席独立董事是健全公司治理的重要组成部分，并提供了有效的制衡机制，以确保我们的董事会能够在适当情况下独立于管理层运作，包括在绩效评估和薪酬事项方面。

full.sec: Director Independence and Controlled Company Exemption
full.secZh: 董事独立性及受控公司豁免

paras.en: Our board of directors has undertaken a review of the independence of each director. Based on information provided by each director concerning their background, employment, and affiliations, our board of directors has determined that Mr. Hastings, Mr. Liddell, Dr. Narasimhan and Ms. Razavi do not have a relationship that would interfere with the exercise of independent judgment in carrying out the responsibilities of a director and that each of these directors is “independent” as that term is defined under the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market. In making these determinations, our board of directors considered the current and prior relationships that each non-employee director has with our company and all other facts and circumstances our board of directors deemed relevant in determining their independence, including the beneficial ownership of our capital stock by each non-employee director, and the transactions involving them described in the section titled “Certain Relationships and Related Person Transactions.”
paras.zh: 我们的董事会已就每位董事的独立性进行了审查。根据每位董事就其背景、任职及关联关系所提供的信息，我们的董事会已认定，Hastings 先生、Liddell 先生、Narasimhan 博士和 Razavi 女士不存在会妨碍其在履行董事职责时行使独立判断的关系，且上述每位董事均符合纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准所定义的“独立”标准。在作出上述认定时，我们的董事会考虑了每位非雇员董事目前及以往与本公司的关系，以及董事会在认定其独立性时认为相关的所有其他事实和情形，包括每位非雇员董事对我们股本的实益持股情况，以及标题为“特定关系及关联人士交易”一节中所述的涉及他们的交易。

paras.en: We are considered a “controlled company” within the meaning of the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements because the LTBT, as the sole holder of our Class T common stock, generally has the power to elect a majority of the authorized members of our board of directors. As a result, we may elect not to comply with certain corporate governance requirements, including:
paras.zh: 由于 LTBT 作为我们 T 类普通股的唯一持有人，通常有权选举我们董事会授权成员的多数，因此我们被视为纳斯达克全球精选市场公司治理要求所指的“受控公司”。因此，我们可能选择不遵守某些公司治理要求，包括：

paras.en: - the requirement that a majority of our board of directors consist of independent directors;
paras.zh: - 我们的董事会多数成员应由独立董事组成的要求；

paras.en: - the requirement that our board of directors have a nominating and corporate governance committee that is comprised entirely of independent directors with a written charter addressing the committee’s purpose and responsibilities; and
paras.zh: - 我们的董事会应设有提名与公司治理委员会，该委员会应全部由独立董事组成，并制定书面章程载明该委员会的宗旨和职责的要求；以及

paras.en: - the requirement that our board of directors have a compensation committee that is comprised entirely of independent directors with a written charter addressing the committee’s purpose and responsibilities.
paras.zh: - 我们的董事会应设有薪酬委员会，该委员会应全部由独立董事组成，并制定书面章程载明该委员会的宗旨和职责的要求。

paras.en: If we elect not to comply with certain requirements, you will not have the same protections afforded to stockholders of companies that are subject to all of the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements. Although we qualify as a “controlled company,” we do not expect to rely on this exemption except with respect to our NGC, which will not consist entirely of independent directors. Our board of directors currently consists of a majority of independent directors and our audit and compensation committees currently consist entirely of independent directors. In the event that we cease to be a “controlled company” and our Class A common stock continues to be listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, we will be required to comply with the provision that our NGC be comprised entirely of independent directors within the applicable transition period.
paras.zh: 如果我们选择不遵守某些要求，您将无法获得受纳斯达克全球精选市场全部公司治理要求约束的公司的股东所享有的同等保护。尽管我们符合“受控公司”的条件，但我们预计不会依赖这一豁免，惟我们的提名与公司治理委员会（NGC）除外，该委员会将不会全部由独立董事组成。我们的董事会目前多数成员为独立董事，我们的审计委员会和薪酬委员会目前全部由独立董事组成。倘若我们不再属于“受控公司”，且我们的 A 类普通股继续在纳斯达克全球精选市场上市，我们将被要求在适用的过渡期内遵守我们的 NGC 应全部由独立董事组成的规定。

full.sec: Committees of the Board of Directors

paras.en: Our board of directors has established an audit committee, a compensation committee, an NGC, and a safety and risk committee. The composition and responsibilities of each of the committees of our board of directors are described below. Members will serve on these committees until their resignation or as otherwise determined by our board of directors.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会已设立审计委员会、薪酬委员会、提名与治理委员会（NGC）以及安全与风险委员会。我们董事会各委员会的组成和职责如下所述。成员将在这些委员会任职，直至其辞职或董事会另有决定。

paras.en: #### Audit Committee
paras.zh: #### 审计委员会

paras.en: Our audit committee consists of Mr. Liddell, Mr. Hastings and one vacancy, with Mr. Liddell serving as Chairperson. We expect to take advantage of a phase-in period under the Nasdaq Global Select Market corporate governance requirements that allows us to have at least one member on the audit committee upon the listing date of our Class A common stock, at least two members within 90 days of the listing date and at least three members within one year of the listing date. Our audit committee will consist of three members within one year of the listing date. In addition, each member of the audit committee will meet the requirements for independence under the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market and Rule 10A-3 under the Exchange Act. Each member of our audit committee will also meet the financial literacy and sophistication requirements of the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market. We believe that the composition and functioning of our audit committee complies with all applicable requirements of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and all applicable SEC rules and regulations. Our board of directors has determined that each of Mr. Liddell and Mr. Hastings meets the requirements for independence under the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market and Rule 10A-3 under the Exchange Act, and each is an audit committee financial expert within the meaning of Item 407(d) of Regulation S-K under the Securities Act. Following the completion of this offering, our audit committee will, among other things:
paras.zh: 我们的审计委员会由 Liddell 先生、Hastings 先生和一名空缺组成，Liddell 先生担任主席。我们预计将利用纳斯达克全球精选市场公司治理要求下的过渡期，该过渡期允许我们在 A 类普通股上市之日审计委员会至少有一名成员，在上市之日起 90 天内至少有两名成员，在上市之日起一年内至少有三名成员。我们的审计委员会将在上市之日起一年内由三名成员组成。此外，审计委员会的每位成员都将符合纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准以及《交易法》第 10A-3 条规定的独立性要求。我们审计委员会的每位成员还将符合纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准的财务知识和专业能力要求。我们认为，我们审计委员会的组成和运作符合《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》的所有适用要求以及 SEC 的所有适用规则和法规。我们的董事会已确定，Liddell 先生和 Hastings 先生均符合纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准以及《交易法》第 10A-3 条规定的独立性要求，且各自均为《证券法》下 S-K 条例第 407(d) 条所指的审计委员会财务专家。本次发行完成后，我们的审计委员会将（其中包括）：

paras.en: - select a qualified firm to serve as the independent registered public accounting firm to audit our financial statements;
paras.zh: - 选择一家合格的事务所担任独立注册公共会计师事务所，以审计我们的财务报表；

paras.en: - help to ensure the independence and performance of the independent registered public accounting firm;
paras.zh: - 帮助确保独立注册公共会计师事务所的独立性和履职表现；

paras.en: - discuss the scope and results of the audit with the independent registered public accounting firm, and review, with management and the independent registered public accounting firm, our interim and year-end results of operations;
paras.zh: - 与独立注册公共会计师事务所讨论审计的范围和结果，并与管理层和独立注册公共会计师事务所一起审阅我们的中期和年度经营业绩；

paras.en: - prepare the report of the audit committee for inclusion in our proxy statements to be filed with the SEC;
paras.zh: - 编制审计委员会报告，以纳入我们向 SEC 提交的委托书；

paras.en: - develop procedures for employees to submit concerns anonymously about questionable accounting or audit matters;
paras.zh: - 制定程序，供员工匿名提交对可疑会计或审计事项的关切；

paras.en: - review our policies on risk assessment and risk management;
paras.zh: - 审阅我们的风险评估和风险管理政策；

paras.en: - review related person transactions; and
paras.zh: - 审阅关联方交易；以及

paras.en: - approve or, as required, pre-approve, all audit and all permissible non-audit services, other than de minimis non-audit services, to be performed by the independent registered public accounting firm.
paras.zh: - 批准或（按要求）预先批准由独立注册公共会计师事务所执行的所有审计服务和所有允许的非审计服务（微量非审计服务除外）。

paras.en: Our audit committee will operate under a written charter, to be effective prior to the completion of this offering, that satisfies the applicable rules and regulations of the SEC and the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market.
paras.zh: 我们的审计委员会将依据一份书面章程运作，该章程将在本次发行完成前生效，并符合 SEC 的适用规则和法规以及纳斯达克全球精选市场的上市标准。

paras.en: #### Compensation Committee
paras.zh: #### 薪酬委员会

paras.en: Our compensation committee consists of Dr. Narasimhan and Ms. Razavi, with Dr. Narasimhan serving as Chairperson. Each member of the compensation committee will meet the requirements for independence under the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market and will be a non-employee director, as defined pursuant to Rule 16b-3 promulgated under the Exchange Act. Our board of directors has determined that each of Dr. Narasimhan and Ms. Razavi meets the requirements for independence under the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market and is a non-employee director, as defined pursuant to Rule 16b-3 promulgated under the Exchange Act. We believe that the composition and functioning of our compensation committee complies with all applicable requirements of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and all applicable SEC rules and regulations. Following the completion of this offering, our compensation committee will, among other things:
paras.zh: 我们的薪酬委员会由 Narasimhan 博士和 Razavi 女士组成，Narasimhan 博士担任主席。薪酬委员会的每位成员都将符合纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准下的独立性要求，并且将是《交易法》下颁布的第 16b-3 条规则所定义的非雇员董事。我们的董事会已确定，Narasimhan 博士和 Razavi 女士均符合纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准下的独立性要求，并且是《交易法》下颁布的第 16b-3 条规则所定义的非雇员董事。我们认为，我们薪酬委员会的组成和运作符合《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》的所有适用要求以及所有适用的 SEC 规则和法规。本次发行完成后，我们的薪酬委员会将（其中包括）：

paras.en: - review, approve, and determine, or make recommendations to our board of directors regarding, the compensation of our executive officers;
paras.zh: - 审查、批准并确定我们高管的薪酬，或就此向我们的董事会提出建议；

paras.en: - review and approve, or make recommendations to our board of directors regarding, our compensation strategy and practices with respect to our executive officers;
paras.zh: - 审查并批准我们针对高管的薪酬战略和做法，或就此向我们的董事会提出建议；

paras.en: - administer our equity-based and other compensation plans, except with respect to non-employee members of our board of directors;
paras.zh: - 管理我们的股权激励及其他薪酬计划，但涉及董事会非雇员成员的计划除外；

paras.en: - review and adopt, or make recommendations to our board of directors regarding, new, or amendments to existing, compensation plans, including any equity-based plans;
paras.zh: - 审查并采纳新的薪酬计划或对现有薪酬计划的修订（包括任何股权激励计划），或就此向我们的董事会提出建议；

paras.en: - review and approve, or make recommendations to our board of directors regarding, any employment agreements, severance agreements, change in control protections, indemnification agreements, and other similar arrangements, policies, and plans for any of our executive officers;
paras.zh: - 审查并批准我们任何高管的雇佣协议、离职协议、控制权变更保护、赔偿协议及其他类似安排、政策和计划，或就此向我们的董事会提出建议；

paras.en: - to the extent it determines it is necessary or appropriate, retain any compensation consultants, outside legal counsel, or other advisors;
paras.zh: - 在其认为必要或适当时，聘请任何薪酬顾问、外部法律顾问或其他顾问；

paras.en: - review and discuss with management the “Compensation Discussion and Analysis” required to be included in our proxy statement and annual report on Form 10-K to be filed with the SEC; and
paras.zh: - 与管理层审查并讨论我们需纳入委托书和将向 SEC 提交的 10-K 表格年度报告的“薪酬讨论与分析”；以及

paras.en: - take any action that our compensation committee determines is necessary or appropriate with respect to our broad-based employee benefit plans, policies, and programs [__] .
paras.zh: - 就我们广泛的员工福利计划、政策和项目采取我们的薪酬委员会认为必要或适当的任何行动 [__] 。

paras.en: Our compensation committee will operate under a written charter, to be effective prior to the completion of this offering, that satisfies the applicable rules and regulations of the SEC and the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market.
paras.zh: 我们的薪酬委员会将根据一份书面章程运作，该章程将在本次发行完成前生效，并满足 SEC 的适用规则和法规以及纳斯达克全球精选市场的上市标准。

paras.en: #### Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee
paras.zh: #### 提名与公司治理委员会

paras.en: Our NGC consists of Ms. Amodei, Mr. Hastings, and Ms. Razavi, with Ms. Amodei serving as Chairperson. Our board of directors has determined that each of Mr. Hastings and Ms. Razavi meets the requirements for independence under the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market. We will utilize the “controlled company” exemption from having an NGC composed entirely of independent directors, and our NGC will be composed of one Class T director and two directors who are not Class T directors. We believe that the composition and functioning of our NGC complies with all applicable requirements of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and all applicable SEC rules and regulations. Following the completion of this offering, our NGC will, among other things:
paras.zh: 我们的 NGC 由 Amodei 女士、Hastings 先生和 Razavi 女士组成，Amodei 女士担任主席。我们的董事会已确定，Hastings 先生和 Razavi 女士均符合纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准下的独立性要求。我们将利用“受控公司”豁免，即无需由全部独立董事组成 NGC，我们的 NGC 将由一名 T 类董事和两名非 T 类董事组成。我们认为，我们 NGC 的组成和运作符合《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》的所有适用要求以及 SEC 的所有适用规则和法规。本次发行完成后，我们的 NGC 将（其中包括）：

paras.en: - assist the board of directors in evaluating individuals to become members of our board of directors, including through the exercise of governance rights conferred upon the NGC pursuant to our governing documents;
paras.zh: - 协助董事会评估成为我们董事会成员的人选，包括通过行使我们治理文件赋予 NGC 的治理权利；

paras.en: - evaluate the performance of our board of directors and its committees;
paras.zh: - 评估我们董事会及其各委员会的表现；

paras.en: - consider and make recommendations to our board of directors regarding the skills, experience, characteristics, and other criteria for evaluating directors;
paras.zh: - 就评估董事的技能、经验、特质及其他标准进行考量并向我们的董事会提出建议；

paras.en: - evaluate the adequacy of our corporate governance practices; and
paras.zh: - 评估我们公司治理实践的充分性；以及

paras.en: - develop and make recommendations to our board of directors regarding corporate governance guidelines and matters.
paras.zh: - 就公司治理准则及相关事项制定并向我们的董事会提出建议。

paras.en: In connection with our novel corporate governance structure, our NGC will also have the right to receive 30 days’ prior written notice of any nomination of persons to serve as a director by the LTBT or the Founder LLC or the proposed removal of such directors, as well as appointments and removals of the Trustees of the LTBT. Our NGC may waive such notice periods in its discretion. With respect to the Specified Class T Director, the LTBT’s ability to nominate or remove that director or change the director designated as the Specified Class T Director is subject to the concurrence of our NGC. These procedural requirements are intended to promote collaboration between the LTBT Trustees and our leadership in identifying and sourcing candidates to serve as LTBT Trustees or members of our board of directors, and do not give our board of directors the substantive ability to limit the LTBT’s freedom to elect directors of its choosing. However, with respect to the Specified Class T Director, if our NGC does not concur with such nomination, removal, or change within 15 days of receiving notice, the matter may be submitted to a vote of the holders of our Class E common stock. When voting upon a proposal to nominate, remove, or change the Specified Class T Director, the requisite approval of our Class E common stock will require a majority of votes cast by our Class E common stock and quorum will require the presence, in person or by proxy, of a majority of the outstanding shares of Class E common stock. The LTBT may withdraw any notice of nomination or removal at any time before the taking of such a vote.
paras.zh: 与我们新颖的公司治理结构相关，我们的 NGC 还将有权就 LTBT 或创始人有限责任公司对任何人士的董事提名或拟议罢免该等董事，以及 LTBT 受托人的任命和罢免，获得 30 天的事先书面通知。我们的 NGC 可自行决定放弃该等通知期。就特定 T 类董事而言，LTBT 提名或罢免该董事或变更被指定为特定 T 类董事的人选的能力，须经我们的 NGC 同意。这些程序性要求旨在促进 LTBT 受托人与我们的领导层在物色和寻找 LTBT 受托人或我们董事会成员候选人方面的协作，并不赋予我们的董事会限制 LTBT 自由选举其选定董事的实质性权力。然而，就特定 T 类董事而言，如果我们的 NGC 在收到通知后 15 天内不同意该等提名、罢免或变更，该事项可提交我们的 E 类普通股持有人表决。在就提名、罢免或变更特定 T 类董事的提案进行表决时，E 类普通股的必要批准将要求 E 类普通股所投票数的多数，且法定人数将要求 E 类普通股已发行股份的多数亲自或通过委托代理人出席。LTBT 可在进行该等表决前的任何时间撤回任何提名或罢免通知。

paras.en: Our NGC will operate under a written charter, to be effective prior to the completion of this offering, that satisfies the applicable listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market.
paras.zh: 我们的 NGC 将依据一份书面章程运作，该章程将在本次发行完成前生效，并满足纳斯达克全球精选市场的适用上市标准。

paras.en: #### Safety and Risk Committee
paras.zh: #### 安全与风险委员会

paras.en: Our safety and risk committee consists of two independent directors, currently Mr. Liddell and Dr. Narasimhan, with Dr. Narasimhan serving as Chairperson. Our safety and risk committee assists our board in overseeing, among other things:
paras.zh: 我们的安全与风险委员会由两名独立董事组成，目前为 Liddell 先生和 Narasimhan 博士，由 Narasimhan 博士担任主席。我们的安全与风险委员会协助董事会监督（其中包括）：

paras.en: - the safety and security of our AI models, including the policies, processes, controls, and other measures we maintain to identify, assess, and manage significant model safety and security risks; and
paras.zh: - 我们 AI 模型的安全与保障，包括我们为识别、评估和管理重大模型安全与保障风险而维持的政策、流程、控制措施及其他措施；以及

paras.en: - the other material risks we face, including legal, regulatory, cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance risks.
paras.zh: - 我们面临的其他重大风险，包括法律、监管、网络安全、隐私和合规风险。

paras.en: Our safety and risk committee operates under a written charter approved by our board of directors.
paras.zh: 我们的安全与风险委员会依据董事会批准的书面章程运作。

paras.en: #### Non-Employee Director Compensation Policy
paras.zh: #### 非雇员董事薪酬政策

paras.en: In September 2026, our board of directors adopted, and our stockholders approved, a formal compensation policy for our non-employee directors (the “Director Compensation Policy”), which will become effective the day immediately prior to the date of effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月，我们的董事会通过并经我们的股东批准了一项针对非雇员董事的正式薪酬政策（“董事薪酬政策”），该政策将于本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效日期前一日生效。

paras.en: Following the effectiveness of our Director Compensation Policy, each non-employee director will receive cash and equity compensation for board services as described below. We also will reimburse our non-employee directors for reasonable, customary, and properly documented expenses for travel to board and committee meetings.
paras.zh: 在我们的董事薪酬政策生效后，每位非雇员董事将就董事会服务获得如下现金和股权薪酬。我们还将向非雇员董事报销前往董事会及委员会会议的合理、惯常且有适当凭证的差旅费用。

paras.en: Cash Compensation

All cash payments to non-employee directors will be paid quarterly in arrears on a prorated basis.
paras.zh: 每位担任委员会主席的非雇员董事仅领取作为委员会主席的额外年度费用，不再同时领取作为委员会成员的额外年度费用。向非雇员董事支付的所有现金报酬将按季度于期末按比例支付。

paras.en: Equity Compensation
paras.zh: 股权激励

paras.en: Annual Award. Each non-employee director automatically will be granted, on the date of each annual meeting of stockholders beginning in 2027, an award of RSUs (the “Annual Award”) with a value of $325,000 (the “Annual Award Grant Value”), which value will be converted to a number of shares of our Class A common stock in accordance with then-current standard company practices using the same methodology applied to employee equity awards pursuant to the company’s equity grant policy, as most recently approved by our board of directors or a board committee that has been designated appropriate authority (the “Conversion Methodology”). An Annual Award will vest in four equal quarterly installments on each Quarterly Vesting Date (as defined below) that occurs following the grant date of the Annual Award provided that, in any event, the Annual Award will vest in full on the day immediately before the date of our next annual meeting of stockholders that follows the grant date of the Annual Award, subject to the non-employee director continuing to be a service provider to us through the applicable vesting date. “Quarterly Vesting Date” means February 20, May 20, August 20, and November 20 of a given year.
paras.zh: 年度授予。自 2027 年起，在每次年度股东大会召开之日，每位非雇员董事将自动获授价值为 $325,000 的 RSU 授予（“年度授予”）（该价值为“年度授予价值”），该价值将按照届时公司标准做法，采用公司股权授予政策下适用于员工股权激励的相同方法（该方法经我们的董事会或经指定适当权限的董事会委员会最近批准，简称“转换方法”）转换为我们的 A 类普通股股数。年度授予将在授予日之后发生的每个季度归属日（定义见下文）分四个等额季度分期归属，但在任何情况下，年度授予均应在授予日之后的下一次年度股东大会召开日的前一日全部归属，前提是该非雇员董事在适用的归属日之前持续作为我们的服务提供者。“季度归属日”指特定年份的 2 月 20 日、5 月 20 日、8 月 20 日和 11 月 20 日。

paras.en: Initial Award and Pro-Rated Annual Award. Each person who first becomes a non-employee director following the effective date of the Director Compensation Policy will be automatically granted:
paras.zh: 首次授予及按比例折算的年度授予。在董事薪酬政策生效日期之后首次成为非雇员董事的每个人将自动获授：

paras.en: - An award of RSUs with a value of $400,000, which value will be converted to a number of shares of our Class A common stock subject to such award using the Conversion Methodology (an “Initial Award”); and
paras.zh: - 价值为 $400,000 的 RSU 授予，该价值将使用转换方法转换为受该授予约束的我们的 A 类普通股股数（“首次授予”）；以及

paras.en: - An award of RSUs with a value equal to the Annual Award Grant Value multiplied by the fraction obtained by dividing (A) the number of full months during the period beginning on the date the individual first becomes a non-employee director and ending on the one-year anniversary of the date of our then-most recent annual meeting of stockholders by (B) 12, which will be converted to a number of shares of our Class A common stock subject to such award using the Conversion Methodology (a “Pro-Rated Annual Award”).
paras.zh: - 价值等于年度授予价值乘以一个分数的 RSU 授予，该分数的分子为（A）自该个人首次成为非雇员董事之日起至我们当时最近一次年度股东大会召开日一周年之日止期间内的完整月数，分母为（B）12，该价值将使用转换方法转换为受该授予约束的我们的 A 类普通股股数（“按比例折算的年度授予”）。

paras.en: The grant of each Initial Award and Pro-Rated Annual Award will be made effective on the first trading date on or after the date on which such individual first becomes a non-employee director (such date, the “Initial Start Date”). If an individual is a member of our board of directors and also an employee, becoming a non‑employee director due to termination of employment will not entitle the non-employee director to an Initial Award or a Pro-Rated Annual Award.
paras.zh: 每项首次授予和按比例折算的年度授予的授予将于该个人首次成为非雇员董事之日或之后的首个交易日（该日期为“首次起始日”）生效。如果某个人是我们的董事会成员且同时是我们的员工，因雇佣关系终止而成为非雇员董事，将不会使该非雇员董事有权获得首次授予或按比例折算的年度授予。

paras.en: The Initial Award will vest as follows: 12.5% of the RSUs will vest on the six-month anniversary of the Vesting Commencement Date (as defined below) and the balance of the RSUs will vest in 14 successive equal quarterly installments on each Quarterly Vesting Date thereafter, subject to the non-employee director remaining a service provider to us through the applicable vesting date. “Vesting Commencement Date” means the first Quarterly Vesting Date that occurs on or following the Initial Start Date. The Pro-Rated Annual Award will vest in equal installments on each Quarterly Vesting Date that occurs between the Initial Start Date and the earlier of (i) our next annual meeting of stockholders that occurs after the Pro-Rated Annual Award’s grant date or (ii) the one-year anniversary of our most recent annual meeting of stockholders, provided that, in any event, the Pro-Rated Annual Award will vest in full on the day immediately before the date of our next annual meeting of stockholders that occurs after the Pro-Rated Annual Award’s grant date (for purposes of clarity, each such Quarterly Vesting Date and the final vest date that occurs on the date immediately before our next annual meeting of stockholders or one-year anniversary of our most recent annual meeting of stockholders, as applicable, will be counted as one installment such that, if there are two such Quarterly Vesting Dates, the Pro-Rated Annual Award shall vest in three equal installments), subject to the non-employee director remaining a service provider to us through the applicable vesting date.
paras.zh: 首次授予的归属安排如下：12.5% 的 RSU 将于归属起算日（定义见下文）满六个月之日归属，其余 RSU 将于此后每个季度归属日分 14 期等额按季归属，前提是该非雇员董事在相应归属日之前持续为我们提供服务。“归属起算日”指在首次起始日当日或之后发生的首个季度归属日。按比例年度授予将于首次起始日与以下两者中较早者之间发生的每个季度归属日等额分期归属：(i) 按比例年度授予授予日之后我们下一次年度股东大会，或 (ii) 我们最近一次年度股东大会满一周年之日；但在任何情况下，按比例年度授予均将于按比例年度授予授予日之后我们下一次年度股东大会日期前一日全部归属（为明确起见，每个该等季度归属日以及在我们下一次年度股东大会或我们最近一次年度股东大会满一周年之日（视情况而定）前一日发生的最终归属日，均计为一期，因此，若存在两个该等季度归属日，则按比例年度授予应分三期等额归属），前提是该非雇员董事在相应归属日之前持续为我们提供服务。

paras.en: Change in Control
paras.zh: 控制权变更

paras.en: In the event of a “change in control” (as defined in our 2026 Plan), each non-employee director will fully vest in their outstanding equity awards granted pursuant to the Director Compensation Policy under our 2026 Plan, including any Initial Award and Pro-Rated Annual Award or Annual Award, provided that the non-employee director continues to be a non-employee director through such date.
paras.zh: 若发生“控制权变更”（定义见我们的 2026 年计划），每位非雇员董事根据我们的 2026 年计划下董事薪酬政策授予的未归属股权激励将全部归属，包括任何首次授予、按比例年度授予或年度授予，前提是该非雇员董事在该日期之前持续担任非雇员董事。

paras.en: The purpose of this Compensation Discussion and Analysis (“CD&A”) section is to discuss our compensation philosophy, our executive compensation program, and the compensation for our named executive officers (“NEOs”).
paras.zh: 本薪酬讨论与分析（“CD&A”）章节旨在讨论我们的薪酬理念、我们的高管薪酬计划以及我们指定高管的薪酬（“NEOs”）。

paras.en: Our NEOs for the year ended December 31, 2025 were:
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，我们的指定高管为：

paras.en: - Dario Amodei, our Chief Executive Officer, Co-Founder, and Director;
paras.zh: - Dario Amodei，我们的首席执行官、联合创始人兼董事；

paras.en: - Daniela Amodei, our President, Co-Founder, and Director; and
paras.zh: - Daniela Amodei，我们的总裁、联合创始人兼董事；以及

paras.en: - Krishna Rao, our Chief Financial Officer.
paras.zh: - Krishna Rao，我们的首席财务官。

paras.en: This discussion contains forward-looking statements that are based on our current plans, considerations, expectations, and determinations regarding future compensation programs. See also the section titled “Special Note Regarding Forward-looking Statements.” Actual compensation programs that we adopt in the future may differ materially from the currently planned programs summarized in this discussion. For additional information regarding the compensation programs for, and compensation provided to, our NEOs, see the section titled “—Post-Fiscal Year End Compensation Changes and Equity Awards.”
paras.zh: 本讨论包含前瞻性陈述，这些陈述基于我们当前对未来薪酬计划的计划、考虑、预期和决定。另请参阅标题为“关于前瞻性陈述的特别说明”的章节。我们未来实际采用的薪酬计划可能与本讨论中概述的当前计划存在重大差异。有关我们指定高管的薪酬计划以及向其提供的薪酬的更多信息，请参阅标题为“—财年结束后薪酬变动及股权奖励”的章节。

paras.en: At Anthropic, we strive to build a team that is aligned with our mission and values. Executive compensation reflects our overall compensation philosophy, which prioritizes competitive pay that targets the 90th percentile of the AI development market, consistent pay for the same role, level, and location, and simplicity of plan design. In 2025, we offered a competitive mix of base salary, long-term equity incentive awards (including stock options and RSUs), and other benefits to attract and retain top talent in a competitive market environment.
paras.zh: 在 Anthropic，我们致力于打造一支与我们的使命和价值观保持一致的团队。高管薪酬体现了我们的整体薪酬理念，该理念优先考虑具有竞争力的薪酬，目标定位于 AI 开发市场的第 90 百分位，同一职位、职级和地点实行一致薪酬，以及计划设计的简洁性。2025 年，我们提供了由基本工资、长期股权激励奖励（包括股票期权和 RSU）及其他福利构成的具有竞争力的薪酬组合，以在竞争激烈的市场环境中吸引和留住顶尖人才。

paras.en: #### Compensation Philosophy and Objectives
paras.zh: #### 薪酬理念与目标

paras.en: Our executive compensation philosophy is to provide our executive officers with consistent cash and equity compensation for the same role, level, and location. When determining executive compensation, we review each executive’s current compensation against role-and level-specific market data. We do this bi-annually as part of our performance and compensation cycle where we review proposed market-based and promotion-based cash and equity increases for executives. We plan to continue to regularly review, and potentially adjust, our executive compensation programs to ensure they are consistent with our compensation philosophy as a public company.
paras.zh: 我们的高管薪酬理念是为同一职位、职级和地点的高管提供一致的现金和股权薪酬。在确定高管薪酬时，我们会将每位高管的当前薪酬与特定职位和职级的市场数据进行比对。我们每半年在绩效与薪酬周期中开展一次此项工作，届时我们会审议针对高管拟议的基于市场和基于晋升的现金及股权加薪。我们计划继续定期审查并可能调整我们的高管薪酬计划，以确保其作为一家上市公司与我们的薪酬理念保持一致。

paras.en: In determining compensation for our senior leaders, we distinguish between our seven co-founders (among whom only Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei are executive officers) and our other senior leaders who are not co-founders (among whom only Mr. Rao is an executive officer). Each co-founder is paid equal compensation. As a non-co-founder senior leader, Mr. Rao received base salary and equity compensation based on market data for his role and level.
paras.zh: 在确定高级管理人员的薪酬时，我们将七位联合创始人（其中仅 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士为高管）与并非联合创始人的其他高级管理人员（其中仅 Rao 先生为高管）加以区分。每位联合创始人获得同等薪酬。作为非联合创始人的高级管理人员，Rao 先生根据其职位和职级的市场数据获得基本工资和股权薪酬。

paras.en: Our executive compensation program is structured to achieve the objectives described below. We regularly review our executive compensation program to assess whether it meets these objectives and adapts to evolving economic conditions.
paras.zh: 我们的高管薪酬计划旨在实现下述目标。我们定期审查高管薪酬计划，以评估其是否实现这些目标并适应不断变化的经济状况。

paras.en: - Competitive Pay to Attract and Retain Top Talent. We provide our executives with competitive cash and equity pay for each role, location, and level to attract mission-aligned, top executive talent.
paras.zh: - 具有竞争力的薪酬以吸引和留住顶尖人才。我们为每位高管按其职位、地点和职级提供具有竞争力的现金和股权薪酬，以吸引与使命一致的顶尖高管人才。

paras.en: - Internal Parity. We take internal parity into account when determining executive compensation. As co-founders, Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei are awarded equal compensation, including any annual cash or equity increases. As a non-co-founder senior leader, Mr. Rao is compensated based on the market data from our peer group for his role, level, and location. We review market data twice a year and make adjustments to our compensation benchmarks as needed.
paras.zh: - 内部公平性。在确定高管薪酬时，我们会考虑内部公平性。作为联合创始人，Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士获得同等薪酬，包括任何年度现金或股权加薪。作为非联合创始人的高级管理人员，Rao 先生根据我们同行群体针对其职位、职级和地点的市场数据获得薪酬。我们每年审查两次市场数据，并根据需要调整我们的薪酬基准。

paras.en: - Aligning Executive Interests with Our Stockholders. We provide incentives that seek to align our executives’ interests with those of our stockholders through long-term equity awards, which vest over time.
paras.zh: - 使高管利益与股东利益保持一致。我们通过随时间归属的长期股权奖励提供激励，力求使高管的利益与股东的利益保持一致。

paras.en: #### Compensation Governance Highlights
paras.zh: #### 薪酬治理要点

paras.en: **What We Do:**
paras.zh: **我们的做法：**

paras.en:
☑ · Maintain a competitive, consistent, and simple compensation philosophy to attract, retain, and motivate top executive talent.
☒ · Enter into employment agreements that provide for fixed terms, automatic compensation increases, or guaranteed equity grants.
☑ · Focus our executive compensation program on at- risk compensation, which aligns stockholder and executive interests.
☒ · Provide single-trigger change of control benefits or excessive cash severance.
☑ · Deliver a majority of our NEOs’ compensation opportunities in the form of long-term equity awards.
☒ · Provide our NEOs with golden parachute excise tax reimbursement or “gross-ups.”
☑ · Conduct regular compensation reviews to ensure alignment with competitive market practices.
☒ · Provide perquisites as a meaningful component of our executive compensation.
☑ · Provide for double-trigger change of control severance provisions for only our Chief Financial
Officer, and none of our other NEOs.
☒ · Maintain any executive pension plans, or any retirement programs that are not generally available to all employees.
☒ · Award option grants at discounted stock prices.
paras.zh:
☑ · 维持具有竞争力、一致且简洁的薪酬理念，以吸引、留住并激励高层管理人才。
☒ · 签订规定固定任期、自动加薪或保证股权授予的雇佣协议。
☑ · 将我们的高管薪酬计划聚焦于风险性薪酬，使股东与高管的利益保持一致。
☒ · 提供单触发控制权变更福利或过高的现金遣散费。
☑ · 以长期股权奖励的形式提供我们 NEO 的大部分薪酬机会。
☒ · 为我们的 NEO 提供黄金降落伞消费税补偿或“补足款（gross-ups）”。
☑ · 定期进行薪酬审查，以确保与竞争性市场惯例保持一致。
☒ · 将附加福利作为我们高管薪酬的重要组成部分。
☑ · 仅为我们首席财务官提供双触发控制权变更遣散条款，其他 NEO 均不提供。
☒ · 维持任何高管养老金计划，或任何并非普遍向所有员工提供的退休计划。
☒ · 以折扣股价授予期权。

paras.en: #### Executive Compensation Process
paras.zh: #### 高管薪酬流程

paras.en: Role of the Board of Directors and Compensation Committee
paras.zh: 董事会与薪酬委员会的角色

paras.en: Our executive compensation program has historically been overseen by the non-employee members of our board of directors, which, as a group, has made decisions regarding the compensation for our NEOs after considering recommendations from management, as further discussed below.
paras.zh: 我们的高管薪酬计划历来由董事会的非雇员成员监督，该群体在考虑管理层建议后，作为一个整体就我们 NEO 的薪酬作出决策，具体如下文所述。

paras.en: Following the completion of this offering, the compensation committee of our board of directors will oversee our executive compensation program and provide recommendations to our board of directors on compensation decisions for our executive officers. The compensation committee will work closely with its independent compensation consultant (engaged in connection with this offering, as described below) and meet regularly to make decisions on our executive compensation program. We expect that our compensation committee will review a variety of market data and information, including survey data, and consider the recommendations of its independent compensation consultant when making compensation decisions. Following the completion of this offering, the compensation committee’s responsibilities will include, among other things, reviewing and approving (or making recommendations to our board of directors, as applicable): overall compensation strategy; amounts and form of executive compensation; goals and objectives to be considered in determining the compensation of our Chief Executive Officer and other executive officers; annual and long-term incentive plans and benefit plans; board of directors compensation; whether such compensation policies and practices create risks that are reasonably likely to have a material adverse effect on the company; annual say-on-pay vote results; annual proxy and CD&A disclosure; and compensation peer group.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，我们董事会的薪酬委员会将监督我们的高管薪酬计划，并就我们执行官的薪酬决策向董事会提供建议。薪酬委员会将与其独立薪酬顾问（就本次发行聘用，如下文所述）密切合作，并定期开会就我们的高管薪酬计划作出决策。我们预计，薪酬委员会在作出薪酬决策时将审阅各种市场数据和信息（包括调查数据），并考虑其独立薪酬顾问的建议。本次发行完成后，薪酬委员会的职责将包括（除其他事项外）审阅并批准（或视情况向董事会提出建议）：整体薪酬战略；高管薪酬的金额和形式；在确定我们首席执行官和其他执行官薪酬时考虑的目标和目的；年度和长期激励计划及福利计划；董事会薪酬；该等薪酬政策和惯例是否会产生合理可能对公司造成重大不利影响的风险；年度薪酬话语权投票结果；年度委托书和 CD&A 披露；以及薪酬同行组。

paras.en: Role of Management
paras.zh: 管理层的角色

paras.en: Our Chief Executive Officer and our other executive officers do not set their own compensation, nor are they present when our board of directors sets their individual compensation. Our President reviews and advises on compensation for the seven co-founders but does not make specific recommendations on or participate in decisions related to her compensation or our Chief Executive Officer’s compensation. Our President also provides her evaluation and makes recommendations with respect to base salary and equity awards for each other executive officer, which are considered by our board of directors as it ultimately makes its determinations. Our people team provides further analysis and feedback as requested by our board of directors with regard to the compensation of our executives.
paras.zh: 我们的首席执行官及其他高管并不自行设定薪酬，在我们董事会设定其个人薪酬时也不在场。我们的总裁审阅并就七位联合创始人的薪酬提供建议，但不会就她本人或我们首席执行官的薪酬提出具体建议或参与相关决策。我们的总裁还就其他每位高管的基本工资和股权奖励提供她的评估和建议，由我们的董事会在最终作出决定时予以考虑。我们的人员团队应董事会要求，就高管的薪酬提供进一步分析和反馈。

paras.en: Role of Independent Compensation Consultant
paras.zh: 独立薪酬顾问的角色

paras.en: In connection with this offering, we have engaged Semler Brossy Consulting Group LLC as an independent compensation consultant to formalize our post-offering compensation programs and implement compensation arrangements that reflect our compensation philosophy described above.
paras.zh: 就本次发行，我们已聘请 Semler Brossy Consulting Group LLC 作为独立薪酬顾问，以正式确立我们发行后的薪酬计划，并实施体现上述薪酬理念的薪酬安排。

paras.en: The key elements of our 2025 executive compensation program are summarized in the table below.
paras.zh: 我们 2025 年高管薪酬计划的关键要素汇总于下表。

paras.en: **Compensation**
Element Compensation At-Risk
paras.zh: 要素 薪酬 风险性

paras.en: Base Salary · Cash · Guaranteed · Provide market-competitive fixed compensation to attract and retain key executives.
paras.zh: 基本工资 · 现金 · 保证发放 · 提供具有市场竞争力的固定薪酬，以吸引和留住关键高管。

paras.en: Long-Term Equity Incentive Program
paras.zh: 长期股权激励计划

paras.en: Service-Based Options; RSUs with Service-Based and Performance-Based Vesting Conditions
paras.zh: 基于服务期的期权；附带基于服务期及基于业绩归属条件的限制性股票单位（RSU）

paras.en: At-Risk · The value of option and RSU awards is correlated to our stock price, promoting sustainable long-term value creation.
paras.zh: 风险性 · 期权和 RSU 奖励的价值与我们的股价挂钩，促进可持续的长期价值创造。

paras.en: Multi-year service vesting schedule promotes retention, long-term ownership, and continuity of leadership.
paras.zh: 多年服务期归属安排有助于留住人才、促进长期持股及领导层的连续性。

paras.en: Other Benefits · Other · N/A · Aligned with market practices and serve to attract, motivate, and retain key talent. Intended to ensure the safety of our NEOs, enhance productivity, and minimize distractions.
paras.zh: 其他福利 · 其他 · 不适用 · 与市场惯例保持一致，旨在吸引、激励和留住关键人才。旨在确保我们 NEO 的安全、提高生产力并尽量减少干扰。

paras.en: #### Base Salary
paras.zh: #### 基本工资

paras.en: Our board of directors generally reviews the base salaries of our NEOs twice a year. The factors used to determine base salary for our executives include market data for the role, level, and location, as well as internal parity (which, for our co-founder NEOs, includes considerations related to parity with our technical leadership).
paras.zh: 我们的董事会通常每年两次审议我们 NEO 的基本工资。用于确定高管基本工资的因素包括该职位、职级和所在地的市场数据，以及内部薪酬对等性（对于我们身为联合创始人的 NEO，还包括与我们的技术领导层薪酬对等性相关的考量）。

paras.en: From January 1, 2025 to June 15, 2025, the annual base salary for each of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei was $600,000. Effective June 16, 2025, the annual base salary for each of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei was increased to $700,000. The increase in the executives’ cash compensation was intended to ensure competitive and equitable compensation for our leaders. In particular, the salary increases recognized their ongoing leadership roles, while considering relative parity across executives, including our technical leadership.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 6 月 15 日，Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士各自的年度基本工资为 $600,000。自 2025 年 6 月 16 日起，Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士各自的年度基本工资提高至 $700,000。提高高管现金薪酬旨在确保为我们的领导者提供具有竞争力和公平的薪酬。具体而言，此次加薪认可了他们持续担任的领导职务，同时考虑了高管之间的相对对等性，包括我们的技术领导层。

paras.en: From January 1, 2025 to December 15, 2025, the annual base salary for Mr. Rao was $700,000, which was increased to $850,000 effective December 16, 2025. The salary increase was based on market data for Mr. Rao’s role and level, as well as internal parity for non-co-founder senior leaders who are not executive officers.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 12 月 15 日，Rao 先生的年度基本薪酬为$700,000，并自 2025 年 12 月 16 日起提高至$850,000。此次薪酬上调系基于 Rao 先生所任职位及职级的市场数据，以及非创始人、且非高管的资深领导者之间的内部薪酬平衡。

paras.en: #### Long-Term Equity Incentive Program
paras.zh: #### 长期股权激励计划

paras.en: Each year, our NEOs are eligible to receive equity awards under our 2021 Plan. By structuring the majority of our NEOs’ target total direct compensation payable in the form of equity that vests over a number of years, we create incentives for our NEOs to remain employed with Anthropic and pursue actions that will benefit our company and stockholders over the long term.
paras.zh: 每年，我们的 NEO 均有资格根据我们的 2021 年计划获得股权奖励。通过将 NEO 目标直接薪酬总额的大部分设计为分多年归属的股权形式，我们激励 NEO 继续在 Anthropic 任职，并采取有利于我们公司及股东长期利益的行动。

paras.en: On June 12, 2025, our board of directors granted [__] 992,500options (“2025 Options”) and [__] 1,717,000 RSUs (“2025 RSUs”) to each of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei, after carefully considering several factors, including each executive’s experience, skills, responsibilities, and impact to the company; individual and company performance; and internal parity.
paras.zh: 2025 年 6 月 12 日，在审慎考虑多项因素（包括每位高管的经验、技能、职责及对公司的贡献；个人及公司业绩；以及内部薪酬平衡）后，我们的董事会向 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士各自授予[__] 992,500 份期权（“2025 年期权”）及[__] 1,717,000 份 RSU（“2025 年 RSU”）。

paras.en: The 2025 Options vested in equal monthly installments over a one-year period beginning on January 1, 2025, subject to the executive’s continuous service with the company through each vest date. The 2025 Options were granted with an exercise price equal to [__] $2.38 per share. The 2025 RSUs vest on the first date upon which both a service-based condition and a performance-based condition are satisfied. The service-based condition is satisfied as to 1/12th of the total 2025 RSUs on February 20, 2026, and on each quarterly anniversary thereafter, subject to the executive’s continuous service with the company through each vest date. The performance-based vesting condition of the 2025 RSUs will be satisfied upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.
paras.zh: 2025 年期权自 2025 年 1 月 1 日起在一年期内按月等额归属，前提是该高管在每个归属日之前持续在公司任职。2025 年期权的行权价等于[__]每股$2.38。2025 年 RSU 在服务条件与业绩条件均满足之日首次归属。服务条件方面，在 2026 年 2 月 20 日满足 2025 年 RSU 总数的 1/12，此后每个季度周年日满足相应部分，前提是该高管在每个归属日之前持续在公司任职。2025 年 RSU 的业绩归属条件将在本招股说明书所构成部分的注册声明生效时满足。

paras.en: Perquisites and Other Executive · Benefits
paras.zh: 附加福利及其他高管 · 福利

paras.en: We generally provide the same benefits to all of our employees, including our NEOs, and generally do not maintain benefit plans that cover only executive officers or provide perquisites or personal benefits to our NEOs. However, we do provide certain travel and security benefits to some of our NEOs. These benefits are described in more detail below. Our board of directors believes these benefits are reasonable and necessary, and for the benefit of our company. These benefits are intended to promote the productivity of our executives, in addition to ensuring their personal health, safety, and security. The aggregate incremental cost of providing these benefits to our NEOs is disclosed in the “All Other Compensation” column of the Summary Compensation Table.
paras.zh: 我们通常向包括 NEO 在内的所有员工提供相同的福利，且通常不维持仅覆盖高管的福利计划，也不向 NEO 提供附加福利或个人福利。但是，我们确实向部分 NEO 提供特定的差旅及安保福利。该等福利在下文中有更详细的描述。我们的董事会认为该等福利合理且必要，并有利于我们的公司。该等福利旨在提升我们高管的工作效率，同时确保其个人健康、安全与保障。向 NEO 提供该等福利的增量成本总额在薪酬汇总表的“所有其他薪酬”一栏中披露。

paras.en: Travel
paras.zh: 差旅

paras.en: We maintain a Travel and Expense Policy (the “Travel Policy”), which outlines guidelines and allowances for executive travel and expenses, recognizing the needs and responsibilities of our senior leadership team. The Travel Policy governs all business-related travel and expenses for our executives, except to the extent benefits are provided through a security program authorized and/or approved by our board of directors. Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei are entitled to certain enhanced travel benefits recommended by the security studies on which their security program is based (discussed in the section below titled “Security Services”). The Travel Policy is reviewed annually by our management team to ensure it remains appropriate and aligned with company objectives and industry standards. To the extent required by the relevant tax laws, the value of any personal use, including any personal elements of business trips, will be treated as taxable compensation to the executive, and we do not cover, reimburse, or otherwise “gross-up” any income tax due from any applicable executive on such compensation.
paras.zh: 我们制定了《差旅与费用政策》（以下简称“差旅政策”），其中规定了高管差旅与费用的指导原则及额度，以认可我们高级领导团队的需求与职责。差旅政策管辖我们高管的所有与业务相关的差旅与费用，但通过经我们董事会授权和/或批准的安全计划所提供的福利除外。Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士有权享受某些增强型差旅福利，该等福利系根据其安全计划所依据的安全研究建议（见下文“安全服务”一节的讨论）。差旅政策由我们的管理团队每年审阅一次，以确保其保持适当并与公司目标和行业标准保持一致。在相关税法要求的范围内，任何个人用途的价值（包括商务差旅中的任何个人成分）将被视为对高管的应税薪酬，我们不会承担、报销或以其他方式“补足”任何适用高管就该等薪酬应缴纳的任何所得税。

paras.en: Except as noted in the subsection below titled “Security Services,” none of our NEOs were provided with private aviation services for personal travel in 2025.
paras.zh: 除下文“安全服务”小节所述外，我们的任何 NEO 在 2025 年均未获得用于个人出行的私人航空服务。

paras.en: Security Services
paras.zh: 安全服务

paras.en: The protection of our senior leadership is a critical priority for our company and our stockholders. In connection with our security program and our evaluation of security threats, we offer security services to certain of our NEOs and may provide security services to other NEOs in the future. Such security services may include: (i) individual protection services (including the protection of family members) and home security systems and monitoring, (ii) private aviation, and (iii) private car and driver services. These safeguards are implemented due to the variety of business-related security concerns faced by our senior leaders, and they are comparable to those provided to senior leaders of comparable high-profile companies in the technology industry.
paras.zh: 保护我们的高级领导层是我们公司及我们股东的一项关键优先事项。结合我们的安全计划及我们对安全威胁的评估，我们向某些 NEO 提供安全服务，并可能在未来向其他 NEO 提供安全服务。该等安全服务可能包括：(i) 个人保护服务（包括对家庭成员的保护）及家庭安全系统与监控，(ii) 私人航空，以及 (iii) 私人汽车及司机服务。实施这些保障措施是由于我们的高级领导层面临各种与业务相关的安全顾虑，且其与科技行业同类高知名度公司向其高级领导层提供的保障措施相当。

paras.en: In 2025, a leading security consulting firm conducted independent, third-party security studies regarding the personal and security risks of our Chief Executive Officer and our President. Based on these security studies, increased media attention for Anthropic, and the identification of bona fide business-related, heightened security concerns arising as a result of the respective positions of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei within the company, our board of directors determined that enhanced personal security services were necessary to increase the safety and protection of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei, and to avoid an impact to our business continuity if a security incident occurred. Our board of directors regularly assesses security concerns and reviews the security services provided to Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei and the cost of such services in light of such concerns, and other benefits to our company. The security measures for Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei in 2025 included (i) individual protection services (including during personal travel), which included the protection of family members, as well as enhanced home security systems and surveillance, (ii) private car and driver services for ground transportation, and (iii) in the case of Dr. Amodei, the use of private aircraft for both business and personal travel.
paras.zh: 2025 年，一家领先的安全咨询公司就我们首席执行官和总裁的个人及安全风险开展了独立的第三方安全研究。基于这些安全研究、媒体对 Anthropic 日益增加的关注，以及因 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士在公司内各自职位而产生的、与业务相关的真实且加剧的安全顾虑，我们的董事会认定，有必要加强个人安全服务，以提升 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士的安全与保护，并避免一旦发生安全事件对我们业务连续性造成影响。我们的董事会定期评估安全顾虑，并结合这些顾虑及对我们公司的其他益处，审查向 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士提供的安全服务及该等服务成本。2025 年针对 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士的安全措施包括：(i) 个人保护服务（包括在个人出行期间），其中涵盖对家庭成员的防护，以及加强的家庭安全系统和监控；(ii) 用于地面交通的专车及司机服务；以及 (iii) 就 Amodei 博士而言，在商务和个人出行中使用私人飞机。

paras.en: Given the importance of the roles of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei at Anthropic, our board of directors required the security measures described above for the benefit of our company, and we view the costs of these services as necessary and appropriate. In the “All Other Compensation” column of the Summary Compensation Table, we have disclosed the aggregate incremental cost of the security benefits that may be deemed to be perquisites under current relevant disclosure rules. We did not pay expenses for personal security for any other NEOs in 2025, except in connection with business-related travel.
paras.zh: 鉴于 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士在 Anthropic 所担任角色的重要性，我们的董事会为公司的利益要求采取上述安全措施，我们认为这些服务的成本是必要且适当的。在薪酬汇总表的“所有其他薪酬”一栏中，我们披露了根据现行相关披露规则可能被视为附加福利的安全福利的增量成本总额。2025 年，我们未为任何其他 NEO 支付个人安全费用，但与业务相关出行有关的除外。

paras.en: Health and Welfare Benefits
paras.zh: 健康与福利福利

paras.en: During 2025, we provided the following benefits to our NEOs on the same basis as our other eligible employees: medical; dental; vision; flexible spending account; health savings account; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; fertility benefits; mental well-being benefits; health and wellness timesaver stipend; work from home stipend; education assistance program; commuting allowance; and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match.
paras.zh: 2025 年期间，我们与其他符合条件的员工一样，向我们的 NEO 提供了以下福利：医疗；牙科；视力；灵活支出账户；健康储蓄账户；人寿保险；短期和长期伤残保险；生育福利；心理健康福利；健康与保健省时津贴；居家办公津贴；教育援助计划；通勤津贴；以及由雇主匹配缴费的 401(k) 退休计划。

paras.en: We entered into an offer letter with Mr. Rao dated March 2, 2024 (“Rao Offer Letter”), which offer letter was in effect during 2025 and was terminated in October 2026. The Rao Offer Letter provided for “at-will” employment and set forth Mr. Rao’s initial annual base salary, his eligibility to participate in our benefit plans generally, and a new hire stock option grant to purchase [__] 14,000,000 shares of our Class A common stock under our 2021 Plan (“Rao Options”). The Rao Options vested with respect to 1/4th of the shares on the 12-month anniversary of Mr. Rao’s first day of employment with the company and 1/48th of the shares in equal monthly installments thereafter, subject to Mr. Rao’s continuous service with the company through each vest date. The Rao Offer Letter also provided for certain severance and change of control benefits. For information regarding the severance and change of control benefits for Mr. Rao during 2025, please refer to the sections below titled “Termination and Change of Control Benefits” and “Potential Payments upon Termination or Change of Control.” Upon the termination of the Rao Offer Letter, we entered into a letter agreement with Mr. Rao as described below.
paras.zh: 我们与 Rao 先生于 2024 年 3 月 2 日签订了录用通知书（“Rao 录用通知书”），该录用通知书在 2025 年期间有效，并于 2026 年 10 月终止。Rao 录用通知书规定为“随意”雇佣，并列明了 Rao 先生的初始年度基本工资、其参与我们一般福利计划的资格，以及根据我们的 2021 年计划购买 [__] 14,000,000 股我们 A 类普通股的新员工股票期权授予（“Rao 期权”）。Rao 期权在 Rao 先生在公司入职首日起满 12 个月时归属 1/4 的股份，此后按等额月度分期归属 1/48 的股份，前提是 Rao 先生在每一归属日之前持续在公司服务。Rao 录用通知书还规定了某些遣散和变更控制权福利。有关 Rao 先生在 2025 年期间的遣散和变更控制权福利的信息，请参阅下文标题为“终止和变更控制权福利”和“终止或变更控制权时的潜在付款”的章节。在 Rao 录用通知书终止后，我们与 Rao 先生签订了一份函件协议，如下所述。

paras.en: In addition, each NEO is subject to our standard confidential information and invention assignment agreement which provides for restrictions on employee non-solicitation (during employment and for 12 months post-termination), customer non-solicitation (during employment), confidentiality (perpetual), and assignment of intellectual property rights.
paras.zh: 此外，每位 NEO 均受我们的标准保密信息和发明转让协议的约束，该协议规定了员工禁止招揽（在职期间及终止后 12 个月内）、客户禁止招揽（在职期间）、保密（永久）以及知识产权转让方面的限制。

full.sec: Termination and Change of Control Benefits
full.secZh: 终止及控制权变更福利

paras.en: The employment of our NEOs is “at-will,” meaning we can terminate them at any time, and they can terminate their employment with us at any time. Other than Mr. Rao, our NEOs were not entitled to any severance or change of control benefits during 2025.
paras.zh: 我们高管的雇佣关系为“随意雇佣”，这意味着我们可以随时终止他们的雇佣关系，他们也可以随时终止与我们的雇佣关系。除 Rao 先生外，我们的高管在 2025 年期间无权获得任何遣散费或控制权变更福利。

paras.en: During 2025, the Rao Offer Letter provided that if, at any time, his employment was terminated by the company without “cause” or he resigned for “good reason” (as such terms were defined in the Rao Offer Letter), then, subject to his execution of a release of claims in favor of the company and other conditions, he would be entitled to the following severance payments and benefits: (i) an amount equal to six months of his then-current base salary, (ii) payment of monthly premiums for coverage under the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (“COBRA”) for up to six months, and (iii) accelerated vesting as to 1/8th of the Rao Options.
paras.zh: 2025 年期间，Rao 录用函规定，如果公司随时以“非正当理由”终止其雇佣关系，或他因“正当理由”辞职（该等术语在 Rao 录用函中定义），则在其签署有利于公司的索赔豁免书及其他条件满足的前提下，他有权获得以下遣散费和福利：(i) 相当于其当时基本工资六个月的金额，(ii) 最多六个月的《综合预算调节法案》（“COBRA”）下保险的月度保费支付，以及 (iii) Rao 期权中 1/8 的加速归属。

paras.en: The Rao Offer Letter further provided that if, within 30 days prior to, upon, or at any time following a “change of control” (as defined in our 2021 Plan), his employment was terminated by the company without cause or he resigned for good reason, then, subject to his execution of a release of claims in favor of the company and other conditions, 100% of any then unvested shares subject to his then outstanding equity awards, including the Rao Options, would accelerate and vest. If, in the change of control, his then-outstanding equity awards would otherwise have been terminated for no consideration at the closing of the change of control event, then those awards would instead have become fully vested as of immediately prior to such closing. Upon the termination of the Rao Offer Letter in October 2026, we entered into a letter agreement with Mr. Rao continuing the change of control vesting acceleration benefit described herein on the same terms, without alteration.
paras.zh: Rao 录用函进一步规定，如果在“控制权变更”（定义见我们的 2021 年计划）之前 30 天内、之时或之后的任何时间，公司以非正当理由终止其雇佣关系，或他因正当理由辞职，则在其签署有利于公司的索赔豁免书及其他条件满足的前提下，其当时未归属股权奖励（包括 Rao 期权）所涉股份的 100% 将加速归属。如果在控制权变更中，其当时未归属的股权奖励原本会在控制权变更事件交割时被无对价终止，则这些奖励将在该交割前立即全部归属。在 Rao 录用函于 2026 年 10 月终止后，我们与 Rao 先生签订了一份函件协议，以相同条款继续提供本文所述的控制权变更归属加速福利，未作任何更改。

paras.en: For additional information regarding the severance and change of control benefits for our NEOs, see the sections titled “—Post-Fiscal Year End Compensation Changes and Equity Awards” and “—Potential Payments upon Termination or Change of Control.”
paras.zh: 有关我们高管遣散费和控制权变更福利的更多信息，请参见标题为“—财年结束后薪酬变更和股权奖励”和“—终止或控制权变更时的潜在付款”的章节。

paras.en: #### Compensation Recovery Policy
paras.zh: #### 薪酬追回政策

paras.en: We have adopted an executive compensation recoupment policy intended to comply with the requirements of Rule 10D-1 under the Exchange Act and the rules of the stock exchange on which our securities are listed (“Clawback Policy”) that will be effective upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. The Clawback Policy will generally require us to recover erroneously awarded incentive-based compensation that was received by covered executive officers in the event we are required to prepare an accounting restatement due to any material noncompliance with any financial reporting requirement under the securities laws (including any required accounting restatement to correct an error in previously issued financial statements that is material to the previously issued financial statements), or that would result in a material misstatement if the error were corrected in the current period or left uncorrected in the current period. The Clawback Policy generally covers incentive-based compensation received on or after the effective date of the Clawback Policy and during the three-year period prior to the date we are required to prepare the financial restatement. The amount required to be recovered is the excess of the amount of incentive-based compensation received over the amount that otherwise would have been received based on the restated financial measure.
paras.zh: 我们已采纳一项高管薪酬追回政策，旨在符合《交易法》第 10D-1 条的要求以及我们证券上市所在证券交易所的规则（“追回政策”），该政策将在本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效时生效。追回政策通常要求我们在因任何重大不符合证券法项下任何财务报告要求而需要编制会计重述（包括为更正先前已发布财务报表中的错误而需要进行的任何会计重述，且该错误对先前已发布的财务报表具有重大性），或该错误若在本期更正或在本期未予更正将导致重大错报的情况下，追回受涵盖高管所收到的错误授予的基于激励的薪酬。追回政策通常涵盖在追回政策生效日或之后以及在我们被要求编制财务重述之日前的三年期间内收到的基于激励的薪酬。要求追回的金额为所收到的基于激励的薪酬金额超出根据重述后财务指标本应收到的金额的部分。

paras.en: #### Hedging, Pledging, and Insider Trading
paras.zh: #### 对冲、质押与内幕交易

paras.en: We are dedicated to fostering high standards of ethical business conduct and adherence to applicable laws, rules, and regulations. Accordingly, we maintain our Insider Trading Policy, which we believe is appropriately designed to foster compliance with insider trading laws, rules, and regulations, and the listing standards of the Nasdaq Global Select Market that will be applicable to us. Our Insider Trading Policy applies to all of our officers, directors, and employees, as well as designated consultants, and specifically prohibits ownership of financial instruments or participation in investment strategies that hedge the economic risk of owning our equity securities, such as prepaid variable forwards, equity swaps, and collars. Directors, officers, and other employees are prohibited from maintaining company securities in a margin account or otherwise pledging company securities as collateral for a loan, provided that certain limited exceptions may be permitted. In addition, we prohibit our executive officers, directors, and employees from purchasing or selling our securities while in possession of material, non-public information or otherwise utilizing such information for their personal benefit. We maintain a quarterly blackout window where applicable individuals may not trade.
paras.zh: 我们致力于培育高标准的商业道德行为并遵守适用的法律、规则和法规。因此，我们维持我们的《内幕交易政策》，我们认为该政策经过适当设计，以促进遵守内幕交易法律、规则和法规以及将适用于我们的纳斯达克全球精选市场上市标准。我们的《内幕交易政策》适用于我们所有的管理人员、董事和员工，以及指定的顾问，并明确禁止持有对冲我们股权证券经济风险的金融工具或参与相关投资策略，例如预付可变远期合约、股权互换和领口期权。董事、管理人员和其他员工被禁止将公司证券存入保证金账户或以其他方式将公司证券质押作为贷款担保，但可能允许某些有限的例外情形。此外，我们禁止我们的高管、董事和员工在持有重大非公开信息时购买或出售我们的证券，或以其他方式利用该等信息为其个人谋利。我们设有季度禁售窗口，适用个人在此期间不得进行交易。

paras.en: #### Policies and Practices Related to the Grant of Certain Equity Awards Close in Time to the Release of Material Nonpublic Information
paras.zh: #### 与重大非公开信息发布时间相近授予某些股权奖励相关的政策与实践

paras.en: We periodically grant stock options to our NEOs, employees, and other service providers. We have historically granted options on or shortly after a newly hired employee’s start date. We have historically granted refresh, promotion, or market adjustment options when and as determined by our board of directors. We have no specific policy or practice regarding the timing of options or other equity grants in relation to the public disclosure of material nonpublic information by the company.
paras.zh: 我们定期向我们的 NEO、员工及其他服务提供商授予股票期权。我们历来在新员工入职之日或入职后不久授予期权。我们历来在董事会决定时授予 refresh、晋升或市场调整期权。对于与公司公开披露重大非公开信息相关的期权或其他股权授予时点，我们并无具体政策或做法。

paras.en: #### Tax Considerations
paras.zh: #### 税务考量

paras.en: Section 162(m) of the Code imposes a $1 million limit on the amount of compensation that we may deduct as a business expense in any year with regard to certain of our most highly paid executive officers. While our board of directors considers the deductibility of compensation as one factor in determining executive compensation, our board of directors retains the discretion to award compensation that is not deductible as it believes that it is in our best interests to maintain flexibility in our approach to executive compensation in order to design a program that we deem to be the most effective in attracting, motivating, and retaining key executives and aligning pay with performance.
paras.zh: 《美国国内税收法典》第 162(m) 条对我们在任何年度就某些薪酬最高的高级管理人员可作为业务费用扣除的薪酬金额设定了 $1 million 的上限。尽管我们的董事会将薪酬的可扣除性作为确定高管薪酬的一项考量因素，但董事会仍保留授予不可扣除薪酬的自由裁量权，因为其认为，为使我们能够设计出在吸引、激励和留住关键高管以及使薪酬与业绩挂钩方面最有效的计划，保持高管薪酬方案设计的灵活性符合我们的最佳利益。

paras.en: #### Accounting Considerations
paras.zh: #### 会计考量

paras.en: Our board of directors takes accounting considerations into account in designing compensation plans and arrangements for our NEOs and other employees. We follow the Financial Accounting Standards Board’s Accounting Standards Codification Topic 718 (“FASB ASC Topic 718”) for our stock-based compensation awards. FASB ASC Topic 718 requires us to measure the compensation expense for all share-based payment awards based on the grant date “fair value” of these awards.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会在为我们的 NEO 及其他员工设计薪酬计划和安排时会考虑会计因素。我们针对股权激励奖励遵循财务会计准则委员会会计准则汇编第 718 主题（“FASB ASC Topic 718”）。FASB ASC Topic 718 要求我们根据所有股份支付奖励在授予日的“公允价值”计量其薪酬费用。
