full.sec: Post-Fiscal Year End Compensation Changes and Equity Awards
full.secZh: 财年结束后薪酬变动及股权奖励

paras.en: Subsequent to the year ended December 31, 2025, we approved an adjustment to the base salaries of, granted new RSUs to, and entered into agreements providing certain severance benefits for, Dr. Amodei, Ms. Amodei, and Mr. Rao. We also paid the HSR Filing Fees (as defined below) for Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei. In addition, we began offering certain security services to Mr. Rao. These adjustments, awards, and benefits were made in consideration of the ongoing leadership roles of each of our NEOs and internal parity.
paras.zh: 在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的年度之后，我们批准调整了 Amodei 博士、Amodei 女士和 Rao 先生的基本工资，向其授予了新的 RSU，并与其签订了提供若干遣散福利的协议。我们还为 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士支付了 HSR 申报费（定义见下文）。此外，我们开始向 Rao 先生提供若干安保服务。上述调整、授予和福利是考虑到我们每位 NEO 持续担任领导职务以及内部公平性而作出的。

paras.en: **Base Salary**
paras.zh: **基本工资**

paras.en: Effective January 16, 2026, the annual base salary for each of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei was increased to $915,000. Effective February 1, 2026, the annual base salary for Mr. Rao was increased to $1,250,000. Effective July 1, 2026, the annual base salary for each of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei was further increased to $1,380,000.
paras.zh: 自 2026 年 1 月 16 日起，Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士各自的年度基本工资提高至 $915,000。自 2026 月 2 月 1 日起，Rao 先生的年度基本工资提高至 $1,250,000。自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起，Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士各自的年度基本工资进一步提高至 $1,380,000。

paras.en: #### Long-Term Equity Incentive Program
paras.zh: #### 长期股权激励计划

paras.en: On February 20, 2026, our board of directors granted [__] 1,431,490 options to each of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei and 1,122,840 options to Mr. Rao (together, the “2026 NEO Options”) and [__] 2,374,010 RSUs to each of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei and [__] 1,862,140 RSUs to Mr. Rao (together, the “2026 NEO RSUs”). The 2026 NEO Options vest in equal monthly installments over a one-year period beginning on January 16, 2026 for each of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei and on January 30, 2026 for Mr. Rao, subject to the executive’s continuous service with the company through each vest date. The 2026 NEO Options were granted with an exercise price equal to $17.66 per share. The 2026 NEO RSUs vest on the first date upon which both a service-based condition and a performance-based condition are satisfied. The service-based condition is satisfied as to 1/12th of the total 2026 NEO RSUs on May 20, 2027, and on each quarterly anniversary thereafter, subject to the executive’s continuous service with the company through each vest date. The performance-based vesting condition of the 2026 NEO RSUs will be satisfied upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月 20 日，我们的董事会向 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士各授予 [__] 1,431,490 份期权，向 Rao 先生授予 1,122,840 份期权（合称“2026 年 NEO 期权”），并向 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士各授予 [__] 2,374,010 份 RSU，向 Rao 先生授予 [__] 1,862,140 份 RSU（合称“2026 年 NEO RSU”）。2026 年 NEO 期权自 2026 年 1 月 16 日（就 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士而言）及 2026 年 1 月 30 日（就 Rao 先生而言）起，在一年期内按月等额分期归属，前提是高管在每个归属日之前持续在公司任职。2026 年 NEO 期权的行权价等于每股 $17.66。2026 年 NEO RSU 在服务条件与业绩条件均满足的首个日期归属。服务条件就 2026 年 NEO RSU 总数的 1/12 于 2027 年 5 月 20 日满足，此后在每个季度周年日满足，前提是高管在每个归属日之前持续在公司任职。2026 年 NEO RSU 的业绩归属条件将在本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效时满足。

paras.en: On July 15, 2026, our board of directors granted [__] 537,430 RSUs (“2026 Co-Founder RSUs”) to each of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei. The 2026 Co-Founder RSUs vest on the first date upon which both a service-based condition and a performance-based condition are satisfied. The service-based condition is satisfied as to 1/16th of the total 2026 Co-Founder RSUs on August 20, 2026, and on each quarterly anniversary thereafter, subject to the executive’s continuous service with the company through each vest date. The performance-based vesting condition of the 2026 Co-Founder RSUs will be satisfied upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.
paras.zh: 2026 年 7 月 15 日，我们的董事会向 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士各授予 [__] 537,430 份 RSU（“2026 年联合创始人 RSU”）。2026 年联合创始人 RSU 在服务条件与业绩条件均满足的首个日期归属。服务条件就 2026 年联合创始人 RSU 总数的 1/16 于 2026 年 8 月 20 日满足，此后在每个季度周年日满足，前提是高管在每个归属日之前持续在公司任职。2026 年联合创始人 RSU 的业绩归属条件将在本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效时满足。

paras.en: #### Severance Benefits
paras.zh: #### 遣散福利

paras.en: In October 2026, we entered into an Executive Severance Agreement (“Executive Severance Agreement”) with each of our NEOs that provides that, if the NEO’s employment is terminated by the company without “cause” or the NEO resigns for “good reason” (as such terms are defined in the form of Executive Severance Agreement), then, subject to their execution of a release of claims in favor of the company and other conditions, they will be entitled to the following severance payments and benefits: (i) an amount equal to 24 months of their then-current base salary for Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei and 12 months of his then-current base salary for Mr. Rao, (ii) an amount equal to 12 months of COBRA premium payments, and (iii) acceleration of 12 months of equity vesting for all outstanding equity awards subject to time-based vesting. We also entered into a letter agreement with Mr. Rao continuing the change of control vesting acceleration benefit previously included in the Rao Offer Letter on the same terms, without alteration.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月，我们与各位 NEO 分别签订了《高管离职补偿协议》（“高管离职补偿协议”），该协议约定：若 NEO 的雇佣关系被公司以“正当理由”（该等术语在高管离职补偿协议格式文本中定义）之外的原因终止，或 NEO 以“合理理由”（该等术语在高管离职补偿协议格式文本中定义）辞职，则在其签署有利于公司的索赔豁免书并满足其他条件的前提下，其将有权获得以下离职补偿金和福利：(i) 对于 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士，相当于其当时当前基本工资 24 个月的金额；对于 Rao 先生，相当于其当时当前基本工资 12 个月的金额；(ii) 相当于 12 个月 COBRA 保费支付的金额；以及 (iii) 对所有受时间归属条件约束的未兑现股权奖励加速归属 12 个月。我们还与 Rao 先生签订了一份函件协议，以相同条款、不作任何变更地延续此前载于 Rao 录用通知函中的控制权变更归属加速福利。

paras.en: The changes described above will be reflected in our executive compensation disclosure for the year ending December 31, 2026.
paras.zh: 上述变更将反映在我们截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日止年度的高管薪酬披露中。

paras.en: #### Perquisites and Other Executive Benefits
paras.zh: #### 附加福利及其他高管福利

paras.en: HSR Filing Fees
paras.zh: HSR 申报费

paras.en: In October 2026, we paid directly to the FTC, on behalf of Dr. Amodei and Ms. Amodei, the filing fees that they were required to pay in connection with the filing of a notice under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended, each in the amount of $2.5 million (the “HSR Filing Fees”). The HSR Filing Fees were required in connection with the NEO’s acquisition and holding of our securities. Our board of directors determined that paying the HSR Filing Fees served the best interest of us and our stockholders by ensuring compliance with antitrust regulations and promoting each NEO’s retention and long-term stockholder value alignment by providing incentives for each NEO to participate in our long-term equity incentive program and work to increase the value of our securities.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月，我们代表 Amodei 博士和 Amodei 女士直接向 FTC 支付了其根据经修订的《1976 年哈特-斯科特-罗迪诺反垄断改进法》提交通知所需支付的申报费，每人金额为 $2.5 million（“HSR 申报费”）。该等 HSR 申报费系 NEO 收购及持有我们证券所需支付。我们的董事会认定，支付 HSR 申报费符合我们及我们股东的最佳利益，因为此举可确保遵守反垄断法规，并通过激励各 NEO 参与我们的长期股权激励计划并致力于提升我们证券的价值，促进各 NEO 的留任及其与长期股东价值的对齐。

paras.en: Security Services
paras.zh: 安保服务

paras.en: In 2026, we began offering certain security services to Mr. Rao and engaged a leading security consulting firm to conduct an independent, third-party security study regarding the personal and security risks of Mr. Rao. Given the importance of the role of Mr. Rao at Anthropic, we view the cost of these services as necessary and appropriate.
paras.zh: 2026 年，我们开始向 Rao 先生提供若干安保服务，并聘请了一家领先的安保咨询公司就 Rao 先生的个人及安全风险开展独立的第三方安全研究。鉴于 Rao 先生在 Anthropic 所担任职务的重要性，我们认为该等服务的成本是必要且适当的。

paras.en: (4) 1/4th of the total shares subject to the option vested on the first anniversary of the vesting commencement date (April 18, 2024), and 1/48th of the total shares will vest in equal monthly installments thereafter, subject to the NEO’s continued service with the company through each applicable vest date.

paras.en: (5) The RSUs vest on the first date upon which both a service-based condition and a performance-based condition are satisfied. The service-based condition is satisfied as to 1/12th of the RSUs on the 15-month anniversary of the vesting commencement date (November 20, 2024) and on each three-month anniversary thereafter, subject to the NEO’s continued service with the company through each applicable service-based vest date. The performance-based condition will be satisfied upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.

full.sec: Employment, Severance, and Change of Control Arrangements with Our NEOs
full.secZh: 与我们 NEO 的雇佣、遣散及控制权变更安排

paras.en: We entered into an offer letter with Mr. Rao dated March 2, 2024, which provided for “at-will” employment and included his initial base salary, a new hire stock option grant, and severance and change of control benefits. The Rao Offer Letter was in effect during 2025 and was terminated in October 2026.
paras.zh: 我们与 Rao 先生于 2024 年 3 月 2 日签订了聘用函，其中规定“随意”雇佣关系，并载明其初始基本工资、新员工股票期权授予以及遣散和控制权变更福利。Rao 聘用函在 2025 年期间有效，并于 2026 年 10 月终止。

paras.en: Specifically, the Rao Offer Letter provided that if, at any time, his employment was terminated by the company without “cause” or he resigned for “good reason” (as such terms are defined in the Rao Offer Letter), then, subject to his execution of a release of claims in favor of the company, his compliance with his confidential information and invention assignment agreement and all material company policies, and his return of company property, he would be eligible to receive the following severance payments and benefits: (i) an amount equal to six months of his then-current base salary, (ii) payment of monthly premiums for coverage under COBRA for up to six months, and (iii) accelerated vesting as to 1/8th of the Rao Options.
paras.zh: 具体而言，Rao 聘用函规定，如果在其任职期间的任何时间，公司以“非正当理由”（该等术语在 Rao 聘用函中定义）终止其雇佣关系，或其以“正当理由”辞职，则在其签署有利于公司的索赔豁免书、遵守其保密信息和发明转让协议及所有重大公司政策并归还公司财产的前提下，其将有资格获得以下遣散费和福利：(i) 相当于其当时基本工资六个月的金额，(ii) 最多六个月的 COBRA 保险月度保费支付，以及 (iii) Rao 期权中 1/8 的加速归属。

paras.en: The Rao Offer Letter further provided that if, within 30 days prior to, upon or at any time following a “change of control” (as defined in our 2021 Plan), his employment was terminated by the company without cause or he resigns for good reason, then, subject to his execution of a release of claims in favor of the company and his return of company property, 100% of any then-unvested shares subject to his then-outstanding equity awards, including the Rao Options, would accelerate and vest. If, in the change of control, his then-outstanding equity awards would otherwise have been terminated for no consideration at the closing of the change of control event, then those awards would instead become fully vested as of immediately prior to such closing. Upon the termination of the Rao Offer Letter in October 2026, we entered into a letter agreement with Mr. Rao continuing the change of control vesting acceleration benefit described herein on the same terms, without alteration.
paras.zh: Rao 聘用函进一步规定，如果在“控制权变更”（定义见我们的 2021 年计划）之前 30 天内、之时或之后的任何时间，公司以非正当理由终止其雇佣关系，或其以正当理由辞职，则在其签署有利于公司的索赔豁免书并归还公司财产的前提下，其当时未归属的股权奖励（包括 Rao 期权）所涉股份的 100% 将加速归属。如果在控制权变更中，其当时未归属的股权奖励原本会在控制权变更事件交割时被无对价终止，则这些奖励将在该交割前立即全部归属。在 Rao 聘用函于 2026 年 10 月终止后，我们与 Rao 先生签订了一份函件协议，以相同条款继续提供本文所述的控制权变更归属加速福利，未作任何更改。

paras.en: For additional information regarding the terms of the Rao Offer Letter, see the section titled “—Executive Employment Agreements.” For additional information regarding severance benefits for our NEOs, see the section titled “—Post-Fiscal Year End Compensation Changes and Equity Awards.”
paras.zh: 有关 Rao 聘用函条款的更多信息，请参见标题为“—高管雇佣协议”的章节。有关我们 NEO 遣散福利的更多信息，请参见标题为“—财年结束后薪酬变动和股权奖励”的章节。

paras.en: #### 2026 Equity Incentive Plan
paras.zh: #### 2026 年股权激励计划

paras.en: General. Our 2026 Plan was adopted by our board of directors on September 1, 2026, and approved by our stockholders on October 22, 2026. Our 2026 Plan will become effective as of the day immediately prior to the day the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part is effective.
paras.zh: 概述。我们的 2026 年计划由董事会于 2026 年 9 月 1 日通过，并经股东于 2026 年 10 月 22 日批准。我们的 2026 年计划将自本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之日的前一日起生效。

paras.en: Share Reserve. The maximum aggregate number of shares that may be issued under our 2026 Plan is: (i) shares of our Class A common stock; plus (ii) the number of shares of our Class A common stock equal to the total shares of Voting Common Stock available for issuance pursuant to our 2021 Plan immediately prior to the termination of our 2021 Plan on the effective date of our 2026 Plan; plus (iii) the number of shares of our Class A common stock equal to the total shares of Voting Common Stock subject to awards previously granted under our 2021 Plan that, after the effective date of our 2026 Plan, would have returned to our 2021 Plan and become available for issuance pursuant to future awards under our 2021 Plan had our 2021 Plan not terminated on the effective date of our 2026 Plan (provided that the maximum number of shares pursuant to (ii) plus (iii) is shares).
paras.zh: 股份储备。根据我们的 2026 年计划可发行的最大股份总数为：(i) 我们的 A 类普通股股份；加上 (ii) 相当于在我们 2026 年计划生效日我们的 2021 年计划终止前，根据我们的 2021 年计划可供发行的有表决权普通股总股数的我们的 A 类普通股股份数；加上 (iii) 相当于在 2026 年计划生效日之后，根据我们的 2021 年计划先前授予的奖励所涉及的有表决权普通股总股数的我们的 A 类普通股股份数，若我们的 2021 年计划未在 2026 年计划生效日终止，该等股份本应返还至我们的 2021 年计划并根据我们的 2021 年计划下的未来奖励可供发行（前提是 (ii) 加 (iii) 项下的最大股份数为 [__] 股）。

paras.en: In addition, the number of shares that may be issued under our 2026 Plan will be increased on the first day of each fiscal year beginning with our 2027 fiscal year and ending on (and including) the first day of our 2036 fiscal year, in an amount equal to the lesser of: (i) 5% of the total number of shares of our common stock (including only all classes of common stock issued by the company that carry economic rights) outstanding on the last day of the calendar month prior to the date of such automatic increase (calculated on an as-converted basis); and (ii) such number of shares determined by our board of directors.
paras.zh: 此外，自我们的 2027 财年起至我们的 2036 财年首日（含）止，我们的 2026 年计划下可发行的股份数将于每个财年的首日增加，增加数量等于以下两者中的较低者：(i) 在该等自动增加之日的前一个日历月最后一日我们普通股总股数（仅包括公司发行的所有具有经济权利的各类普通股）的 5%（按转换后基准计算）；及 (ii) 由我们的董事会确定的该等股份数。

paras.en: To the extent an award should expire or be forfeited or become unexercisable for any reason without having been exercised in full, or is surrendered pursuant to an exchange program, the unissued shares that were subject thereto shall continue to be available under our 2026 Plan for issuance pursuant to future awards. In addition, any shares which are retained by us to satisfy exercise or purchase price or any withholding taxes shall be treated as not issued and shall continue to be available under our 2026 Plan for issuance pursuant to future awards. Shares issued under our 2026 Plan and later forfeited to us due to the failure to vest or repurchased by us at a price no greater than the original purchase price paid to us for the shares shall again be available for future grant under our 2026 Plan. To the extent an award under our 2026 Plan is paid out in cash rather than shares, such cash payment will not reduce the number of shares available for issuance under our 2026 Plan.
paras.zh: 若某项奖励因任何原因到期、被没收或变得不可行使而未获全额行使，或根据交换计划被交回，则其项下未发行的股份应继续根据我们的 2026 年计划可供未来奖励发行。此外，我们为满足行权价或购买价或任何预扣税而保留的任何股份应被视为未发行，并应继续根据我们的 2026 年计划可供未来奖励发行。根据我们的 2026 年计划发行且随后因未归属而被没收或由我们以不高于就该等股份向我们支付的原始购买价的价格回购的股份，应再次可根据我们的 2026 年计划供未来授予。若我们的 2026 年计划下的某项奖励以现金而非股份支付，该等现金支付不会减少我们的 2026 年计划下可供发行的股份数。

paras.en: Plan Administration. Our board of directors has delegated its authority to administer our 2026 Plan to our compensation committee. Subject to the provisions of our 2026 Plan, the administrator has the power to determine the terms of awards, including the recipients, the exercise price, if any, the number of shares subject to each award, the fair market value of a share of our Class A common stock, the vesting schedule applicable to the awards, together with any vesting acceleration, the form of consideration, if any, payable upon exercise of the award and the terms of the award agreement for use under our 2026 Plan. The administrator also has the authority, subject to the terms of our 2026 Plan, to amend existing awards, to prescribe rules and to construe and interpret our 2026 Plan and awards granted thereunder and to institute an exchange program by which outstanding awards are amended to provide for a lower exercise price or surrendered or cancelled in exchange for awards with a lower exercise price, a different type of award under our 2026 Plan or a different equity incentive plan, cash, or a combination thereof.
paras.zh: 计划管理。我们的董事会已将其管理 2026 年计划的权力授予我们的薪酬委员会。在符合我们 2026 年计划规定的前提下，管理人有权决定奖励条款，包括获授人、行权价格（如有）、每项奖励所涉股份数量、我们 A 类普通股每股的公允市场价值、适用于奖励的归属时间表以及任何归属加速、行权时应付的对价形式（如有），以及根据我们 2026 年计划使用的奖励协议条款。管理人还有权在符合我们 2026 年计划条款的前提下，修订现有奖励、制定规则、解释和阐释我们 2026 年计划及据此授予的奖励，并设立交换计划，据此将未兑现奖励修订为较低的行权价格，或交回或注销以换取行权价格较低的奖励、我们 2026 年计划下不同类型的奖励或不同的股权激励计划、现金或其组合。

paras.en: Eligibility. Employees, members of our board of directors who are not employees, and consultants (including, without limitation, employees of a staffing agency, professional employer organization, employer of record, and similar workers) are eligible to participate in our 2026 Plan.
paras.zh: 参与资格。员工、非员工的董事会成员以及顾问（包括但不限于 staffing agency、professional employer organization、employer of record 及类似工作人员的雇员）均有资格参与我们 2026 年计划。

paras.en: Types of Awards. Our 2026 Plan provides for the grant of stock options, stock appreciation rights, restricted stock, restricted stock units, and stock bonus awards to our employees, directors, and consultants and the employees and consultants of our subsidiaries.
paras.zh: 奖励类型。我们 2026 年计划规定可向我们及我们子公司的员工、董事和顾问授予股票期权、股票增值权、限制性股票、限制性股票单位和股票奖金奖励。

paras.en: Stock Options. The administrator may grant incentive stock options (within the meaning of Section 422 of the Code) and/or nonstatutory stock options under our 2026 Plan, provided that incentive stock options may only be granted to our employees and the employees of our subsidiaries. The exercise price applicable to such options must generally be equal to at least the fair market value of our Class A common stock on the date of grant. The term of an incentive stock option may not exceed 10 years; provided, however, that an incentive stock option held by a participant who owns more than 10% of the total combined voting power of all classes of our stock, or of certain of our subsidiary corporations, may not have a term in excess of five years and must have an exercise price equal to at least 110% of the fair market value of our Class A common stock on the grant date.
paras.zh: 股票期权。管理人可根据我们 2026 年计划授予激励性股票期权（《税法》第 422 条含义内）和/或非法定股票期权，但激励性股票期权仅可授予我们及我们子公司的员工。此类期权适用的行权价格通常必须至少等于授予日我们 A 类普通股的公允市场价值。激励性股票期权的期限不得超过 10 年；但是，若参与者持有我们全部类别股票或我们某些子公司合计总投票权超过 10%，则该参与者持有的激励性股票期权期限不得超过五年，且行权价格必须至少等于授予日我们 A 类普通股公允市场价值的 110%。

paras.en: The administrator will determine the methods of payment of the exercise price applicable to an option, which may include cash, shares, or other property acceptable to the administrator. Subject to the provisions of our 2026 Plan, the administrator determines the remaining terms of the options. Such terms may include, among other things, vesting upon the achievement of specific performance goals determined by the administrator and/ or continued service. After the termination of service, the participant may exercise their option, to the extent vested, for the period of time stated in their option agreement. Except in the event of a termination for cause, options generally remain outstanding to the extent exercisable for the full term of the options. In no event may an option be exercised later than the expiration of its term. The specific terms will be set forth in an award agreement.
paras.zh: 管理人将确定适用于期权的行权价支付方式，其中可包括现金、股份或管理人可以接受的其他财产。在符合我们 2026 年计划规定的前提下，管理人确定期权的其余条款。该等条款可包括（除其他事项外）在实现管理人所确定的特定业绩目标和/或持续服务时归属。服务终止后，参与方可在其期权协议所载明的期间内，在其已归属的范围内行使其期权。除因正当理由终止的情形外，期权通常在其整个期限内可行使的范围内保持有效。任何期权均不得在其期限届满后行使。具体条款将在授予协议中载明。

paras.en: Stock Appreciation Rights. Stock appreciation rights may be granted under our 2026 Plan. Stock appreciation rights allow the recipient to receive the appreciation in the fair market value of our Class A common stock between the date of grant and the exercise date. Subject to the provisions of our 2026 Plan, the administrator determines the terms of stock appreciation rights, including when such rights vest and become exercisable and whether to settle such awards in cash or with shares of our Class A common stock, or a combination thereof, except that the per share exercise price for the shares to be issued pursuant to the exercise of a stock appreciation right will be no less than 100% of the fair market value per share on the date of grant. The specific terms will be set forth in an award agreement.
paras.zh: 股票增值权。我们 2026 年计划项下可授予股票增值权。股票增值权使接受方有权获得我们 A 类普通股在授予日至行权日之间公允市场价值的增值。在符合我们 2026 年计划规定的前提下，管理人确定股票增值权的条款，包括该等权利何时归属及可行使，以及是以现金还是以我们 A 类普通股股份或其组合方式结算该等奖励，但根据股票增值权的行使而将发行的股份的每股行权价不得低于授予日每股公允市场价值的 100%。具体条款将在授予协议中载明。

paras.en: Restricted Stock. Restricted stock may be granted under our 2026 Plan. RSAs are grants of shares of our Class A common stock that are subject to various restrictions, including restrictions on transferability and forfeiture provisions. Shares of restricted stock will vest and the restrictions on such shares will lapse, in accordance with terms and conditions established by the administrator. Such terms may include, among other things, vesting upon the achievement of specific performance goals determined by the administrator and/or continued service. The administrator, in its sole discretion, may accelerate the time at which any restrictions will lapse or be removed. Recipients of RSAs generally will have voting and dividend rights with respect to such shares upon grant without regard to vesting, unless the administrator provides otherwise. Shares of restricted stock that do not vest for any reason will be subject to our right of repurchase or forfeited by the recipient. The specific terms will be set forth in an award agreement.
paras.zh: 限制性股票。我们 2026 年计划项下可授予限制性股票。限制性股票奖励（RSA）是授予我们 A 类普通股股份，但须受各种限制，包括转让限制和没收条款。限制性股票股份将按照管理人所确立的条款和条件归属，且该等股份上的限制将失效。该等条款可包括（除其他事项外）在实现管理人所确定的特定业绩目标和/或持续服务时归属。管理人可自行决定加速任何限制失效或解除的时间。限制性股票奖励的接受方通常在授予时即对该等股份享有投票权和股息权，而不论是否归属，除非管理人另有规定。因任何原因未归属的限制性股票股份将受制于我们的回购权或被接受方没收。具体条款将在授予协议中载明。

paras.en: Restricted Stock Units. RSUs may be granted under our 2026 Plan and may include the right to dividend equivalents, as determined in the discretion of the administrator. Each RSU granted is a bookkeeping entry representing an amount equal to the fair market value of one share of our Class A common stock. The administrator determines the terms and conditions of RSUs, including the vesting criteria, which may include achievement of specified performance criteria and/or continued service. The administrator, in its sole discretion, may accelerate the time at which any restrictions will lapse or be removed. The administrator determines, in its sole discretion, the timing of payment and whether an award will be settled in stock, cash, or a combination thereof. The specific terms will be set forth in an award agreement.
paras.zh: 限制性股票单位。RSU 可根据我们的 2026 年计划授予，并可能包含获得股息等价物的权利，具体由管理人在其自由裁量权范围内决定。每份已授予的 RSU 均为一项记账记录，代表等于我们 A 类普通股一股公平市场价值的金额。管理人决定 RSU 的条款和条件，包括归属标准，该等标准可能包括实现特定业绩标准和/或持续服务。管理人可自行决定加速任何限制失效或被移除的时间。管理人自行决定支付的时间以及奖励将以股票、现金或其组合方式结算。具体条款将在奖励协议中列明。

paras.en: Stock Bonus Awards. Stock bonus awards may be granted under our 2026 Plan. The administrator may grant stock bonus awards in such amounts, and subject to such terms, as the administrator, in its sole discretion, will determine. A stock bonus award is an award of shares of our Class A common stock without a purchase price. All stock bonus awards may be made, but are not required to be made, pursuant to an award agreement. Payment of a stock bonus award may be made in the form of cash, shares, or a combination thereof, based on the fair market value of the shares subject to the stock bonus award on the date of payment, as determined in the sole discretion of the administrator.
paras.zh: 股票奖金奖励。股票奖金奖励可根据我们的 2026 年计划授予。管理人可授予股票奖金奖励，其金额及条款由管理人自行决定。股票奖金奖励是无需购买价格的我们 A 类普通股股份奖励。所有股票奖金奖励均可（但并非必须）根据奖励协议作出。股票奖金奖励的支付可以现金、股份或其组合形式进行，基于股票奖金奖励所涉股份在支付日的公平市场价值，由管理人自行决定。

paras.en: Outside Director Limitations. Stock awards granted during a single fiscal year under our 2026 Plan or otherwise, taken together with any cash fees paid during such fiscal year for services on our board of directors, shall not exceed $1,000,000 in total value for any non-employee director, except with respect to the first year of service in which case any stock awards granted and cash fees paid will not exceed $2,000,000 in total value (calculating the value of any such stock awards, in each case, based on the grant date fair value of such stock awards for financial reporting purposes). Such applicable limit includes the value of any stock awards that are granted in lieu of all or a portion of any annual committee cash retainers or other similar cash-based payments. Stock awards granted to an individual while they were serving in the capacity as an employee or while they were an independent contractor but not a non-employee director will not count for purposes of the limitations described above.
paras.zh: 外部董事限制。在单一财政年度内根据我们的 2026 年计划或其他方式授予的股票奖励，连同该财政年度内因在我们董事会提供服务而支付的任何现金费用，对于任何非雇员董事而言，总价值不得超过 $1,000,000，但就任职第一年而言，任何已授予的股票奖励和已支付的现金费用总价值不得超过 $2,000,000（在每种情况下，任何该等股票奖励的价值均基于该等股票奖励用于财务报告目的的授予日公平价值计算）。该等适用限制包括代替全部或部分年度委员会现金聘金或其他类似现金支付而授予的任何股票奖励的价值。个人在担任雇员或独立承包商（但非非雇员董事）期间授予的股票奖励，不纳入上述限制的计算。

paras.en: Non-Transferability of Awards. Unless the administrator provides otherwise, our 2026 Plan generally does not allow for the transfer of awards other than by will or the laws of descent and distribution and only the recipient of an option or stock appreciation right may exercise such an award during their lifetime.
paras.zh: 奖励的不可转让性。除非管理人另有规定，我们的 2026 年计划通常不允许转让奖励，但通过遗嘱或继承与分配法律进行的转让除外，且只有期权或股票增值权的接受方可在其有生之年行使该等奖励。

paras.en: Certain Adjustments. In the event of a stock split, reverse stock split, stock dividend, combination, consolidation, recapitalization (including a recapitalization through a large nonrecurring cash dividend or distribution of property, including shares of a subsidiary) or reclassification of the shares, subdivision of the shares, a rights offering, a reorganization, merger, spin-off, split-up, repurchase, or exchange of common stock or other securities of the company or other significant corporate transaction, or other change affecting the common stock occurs, the administrator, in order to prevent dilution, diminution, or enlargement of the benefits or potential benefits intended to be made available under our 2026 Plan, will, in such manner as it may deem equitable, adjust the number, kind, and class of securities that may be delivered under our 2026 Plan and/or the number, class, kind, and price of securities covered by each outstanding award, and the terms and conditions of any outstanding award (including, without limitation, any applicable performance targets or criteria with respect thereto).
paras.zh: 特定调整。若发生股票拆分、反向股票拆分、股票股息、股份合并、整合、资本重组（包括通过大额非经常性现金股息或财产分配（包括子公司股份）进行的资本重组）或股份重新分类、股份细分、供股、重组、合并、分拆、拆分、回购或交换公司普通股或其他证券或其他重大公司交易，或发生其他影响普通股的变化，管理人为了防止稀释、减少或扩大根据我们 2026 年计划拟提供的利益或潜在利益，将以其认为公平的方式，调整根据我们 2026 年计划可交付的证券的数量、种类和类别，和/或每项未决奖励所涵盖证券的数量、类别、种类和价格，以及任何未决奖励的条款和条件（包括但不限于与此相关的任何适用绩效目标或标准）。

paras.en: Dissolution or Liquidation. In the event of a proposed winding up, dissolution, or liquidation of the company, the administrator will notify participants as soon as practicable prior to the effective date of such proposed transaction and all awards will terminate immediately prior to the consummation of such proposed transaction, to the extent not previously exercised or settled.
paras.zh: 解散或清算。若公司拟进行停业清算、解散或清算，管理人将在该拟议交易生效日期之前尽快通知参与者，所有奖励将在该拟议交易完成之前立即终止，前提是此前未行使或结算。

paras.en: Corporate Transaction. Our 2026 Plan provides that, in the event of certain significant corporate transactions, including: (1) a transfer of all or substantially all of our assets; (2) a merger, consolidation or other capital reorganization or business combination transaction of the company with or into another corporation, entity or person; or (3) the consummation of a transaction, or series of related transactions, in which any person becomes the beneficial owner, directly or indirectly, of more than 50% of the company’s then outstanding capital stock, each outstanding award will be treated as the administrator determines. Such determination, without the consent of any participant, may provide that such awards will be (i) continued if we are the surviving corporation; (ii) assumed by the surviving corporation or its parent; (iii) substituted by the surviving corporation or its parent for a new award; (iv) cancelled in exchange for a payment equal to the excess of the fair market value of our shares subject to such award over the exercise price or purchase price paid for such shares; (v) subject to full or partial acceleration of vesting, settlement, payment, and/or expiration as of immediately prior to the corporate transaction; (vi) subject to full or partial lapse of forfeiture, repurchase or reacquisition rights with respect to shares previously acquired pursuant to any awards as of immediately prior to the corporate transaction; (vii) in the case of outstanding options and/or stock appreciation rights, allowed to be exercised prior to the occurrence of the corporate transaction and terminated (for no consideration) upon the consummation of such corporate transaction if not exercised prior thereto; or (viii) cancelled in exchange for no consideration.
paras.zh: 公司交易。我们的 2026 年计划规定，在发生某些重大公司交易时，包括：(1) 转让我们的全部或绝大部分资产；(2) 公司与另一家公司、实体或个人进行合并、整合或其他资本重组或业务合并交易；或 (3) 完成一项交易或一系列关联交易，其中任何人士直接或间接成为公司届时已发行股本超过 50% 的实益拥有人，则每一项未兑现的奖励将按管理人的决定处理。该等决定无需任何参与人同意，可规定该等奖励将 (i) 在我们为存续公司的情况下继续存续；(ii) 由存续公司或其母公司承继；(iii) 由存续公司或其母公司以新奖励替换；(iv) 被注销，以换取相当于该奖励所涉我们股份的公允市场价值超过就该等股份支付的行使价或购买价的差额的付款；(v) 在公司交易发生前立即全部或部分加速归属、结算、付款和/或到期；(vi) 在公司交易发生前立即全部或部分失效，涉及此前根据任何奖励所收购股份的没收、回购或重新收购权；(vii) 对于未兑现的期权和/或股票增值权，允许在公司交易发生前行使，且若未在此之前行使，则在公司交易完成时终止（无对价）；或 (viii) 无对价注销。

paras.en: Change in Control. The administrator may provide, in an individual award agreement or in any other written agreement between a participant and us, that the stock award will be subject to additional acceleration of vesting, settlement, payment, and/or expiration in the event of a change in control.
paras.zh: 控制权变更。管理人可在单项奖励协议或参与人与我们之间的任何其他书面协议中规定，在发生控制权变更时，该股票奖励将受到额外的归属、结算、付款和/或到期加速。

paras.en: Under our 2026 Plan, a “change in control” is generally (1) a merger, consolidation, or any other corporate reorganization in which the shares of capital stock of the company immediately before the transaction cease to represent immediately after such transaction at least a majority of the voting power of the continuing or surviving entity in substantially the same proportions immediately after such transaction as in effect before such transaction; (2) with certain limited exceptions, the consummation of the sale, transfer or other disposition of all or substantially all of our assets; (3) a change in the effective control of the company which occurs on the date that a majority of our board members are replaced during any 12-month period by directors whose appointment or election is not endorsed by a majority of the members of our board of directors prior to the date of the appointment or election; or (4) the consummation of any transaction as a result of which any person or company becomes the beneficial owner, directly or indirectly, of at least 50% of the total voting power represented by our then outstanding voting securities. No transaction shall constitute a change in control (i) as the result of the initial effectiveness of the company’s amended and restated certificate of incorporation that will become effective immediately prior to the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part, (ii) pursuant to Section (3) above until after the time at which both the Class F Sunset Time and the Class T Sunset Time have occurred, as such terms are defined in the company’s amended and restated certificate of incorporation that will become effective immediately prior to the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part, (iii) if its primary purpose is to change the jurisdiction of the company’s incorporation or to create a holding company owned in substantially the same proportions by the persons who held company securities immediately before such transactions, or (iv) if required for compliance with Section 409A of the Code, a transaction will not be a change in control unless it is also a “change in the ownership or effective control of” the company or “a change in the ownership of a substantial portion of the assets of” the company as determined under applicable Treasury regulations.
paras.zh: 根据我们的 2026 年计划，“控制权变更”一般指：(1) 合并、整合或任何其他公司重组，且在该交易完成前公司股本在交易完成后不再立即代表存续或承继实体至少多数投票权，且该等投票权在交易完成后的比例与交易前基本一致；(2) 除某些有限例外情况外，完成对我们全部或几乎全部资产的出售、转让或其他处置；(3) 公司有效控制权发生变更，即在我们董事会多数成员于任何 12 个月期间被替换之日发生，且该等董事的任命或选举未获得任命或选举日期之前我们董事会多数成员的认可；或 (4) 完成任何交易，致使任何个人或公司直接或间接成为我们当时已发行有表决权证券所代表总投票权至少 50% 的受益所有人。任何交易均不构成控制权变更：(i) 因公司经修订和重述的公司章程初始生效所致，该章程将在本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之前立即生效；(ii) 根据上文第 (3) 款，直至 F 类日落时间和 T 类日落时间均发生之后（该等术语在公司经修订和重述的公司章程中定义，该章程将在本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之前立即生效）；(iii) 如果其主要目的是变更公司的注册司法管辖区，或设立一家由紧接该等交易之前持有公司证券的人员按基本相同的比例拥有的控股公司；或 (iv) 如果为遵守《税法》第 409A 条而需要，则交易不构成控制权变更，除非根据适用财政部法规确定，该交易同时构成公司的“所有权或有效控制权变更”或“公司大部分资产所有权变更”。

paras.en: Compensation Recovery Policy. Awards granted under our 2026 Plan will be subject to reduction, cancellation, forfeiture, and/or recoupment in accordance with any compensation recovery policy as may be in effect as of the date of grant of such award, or as such policy is amended or another policy is adopted to comply with applicable laws. In addition, the administrator may impose such other compensation recovery or recoupment provisions in any award agreement as it determines necessary or appropriate.
paras.zh: 薪酬追回政策。根据我们的 2026 年计划授予的奖励将受制于在该奖励授予之日可能生效的任何薪酬追回政策，或该政策经修订或为遵守适用法律而采用其他政策后的规定，并可能据此被减少、取消、没收和/或追回。此外，管理人可在任何奖励协议中施加其认为必要或适当的其他薪酬追回或收回条款。

paras.en: Amendment or Termination. Our administrator has the authority to amend, alter, suspend, or terminate our 2026 Plan, provided such action does not materially impair the existing rights of any participant unless otherwise provided in our 2026 Plan or mutually agreed otherwise. Our 2026 Plan will continue in effect until terminated by the administrator, but no options that qualify as incentive stock options may be granted after 10 years from the earlier of the board or stockholder approval of our 2026 Plan. We will obtain stockholder approval of any amendment to our 2026 Plan as required by applicable law or listing requirements.
paras.zh: 修订或终止。我们的管理人有权修订、变更、暂停或终止我们的 2026 年计划，但除非我们的 2026 年计划另有规定或经双方另行约定，否则该等行动不得实质性损害任何参与者的既有权利。我们的 2026 年计划将持续有效，直至管理人终止，但在董事会或股东批准我们的 2026 年计划之日（以较早者为准）起 10 年后，不得再授予符合激励性股票期权条件的期权。我们将根据适用法律或上市要求的规定，就我们的 2026 年计划的任何修订取得股东批准。

paras.en: #### Amended & Restated 2021 Stock Plan
paras.zh: #### 经修订及重述的 2021 年股票计划

paras.en: General. Our board of directors adopted our 2021 Plan on January 28, 2021 and last amended our 2021 Plan effective as of May 28, 2026. Our 2021 Plan will be terminated effective as of the day immediately prior to the day the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part becomes effective, and no new awards will be granted under our 2021 Plan following this offering, but previously granted awards will continue to be subject to the terms and conditions of our 2021 Plan and the award agreements evidencing such awards.
paras.zh: 一般事项。我们的董事会于 2021 年 1 月 28 日通过了我们的 2021 年计划，并最后一次修订我们的 2021 年计划，自 2026 年 5 月 28 日起生效。我们的 2021 年计划将于本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之日的前一日起终止，本次发行后我们的 2021 年计划下将不再授予新的奖励，但先前已授予的奖励将继续受我们的 2021 年计划条款和条件以及证明该等奖励的奖励协议的约束。

paras.en: Share Reserve. We have reserved for issuance pursuant to our 2021 Plan an aggregate of [__] 3,864,826,090 shares of our Class A common stock. In general, if an award granted under our 2021 Plan (i) expires or is terminated, cancelled, or otherwise forfeited by a participant, (ii) a share subject to an award is withheld in satisfaction of the exercise price and/or tax withholding due in connection with such award, or (iii) a share previously issued pursuant to an award is forfeited or repurchased at the original purchase price paid for the share, then the number of unissued shares subject to any such award, and any such withheld, forfeited, or repurchased shares, will again become available for awards under our 2021 Plan. Following the effectiveness of our 2026 Plan, such shares will again become available for awards under our 2026 Plan.
paras.zh: 股份储备。我们已预留合计 [__] 3,864,826,090 股 A 类普通股，以供根据我们的 2021 年计划发行。一般而言，如果我们的 2021 年计划下授予的奖励 (i) 到期或被终止、取消，或由参与者以其他方式没收，(ii) 奖励所涉股份被扣留以抵偿与该奖励相关的行权价和/或应缴税款，或 (iii) 先前根据奖励发行的股份被没收或按该股份原购买价回购，则任何该等奖励所涉的未发行股份数量，以及任何该等被扣留、没收或回购的股份，将再次可用于我们的 2021 年计划下的奖励。在我们的 2026 年计划生效后，该等股份将再次可用于我们的 2026 年计划下的奖励。

paras.en: Plan Administration. Our board of directors has administered our 2021 Plan before this offering. Our board of directors has delegated its authority to administer our 2021 Plan to our compensation committee following this offering.
paras.zh: 计划管理。在本次发行之前，我们的董事会管理我们的 2021 年计划。本次发行后，我们的董事会已将其管理我们的 2021 年计划的权力授予我们的薪酬委员会。

paras.en: Types of Awards. Our 2021 Plan provides for incentive and non-statutory stock options to purchase shares of our Class A common stock, RSAs, and RSUs. As of the date of this prospectus, we have issued stock options, restricted stock, and RSUs pursuant to our 2021 Plan.
paras.zh: 奖励类型。我们的 2021 年计划规定可授予购买我们 A 类普通股的激励性股票期权和非法定股票期权、限制性股票奖励（RSA）以及限制性股票单位（RSU）。截至本招股说明书日期，我们已根据我们的 2021 年计划发行了股票期权、限制性股票和限制性股票单位。

paras.en: Non-transferability of Awards. Unless the administrator provides otherwise, our 2021 Plan generally does not allow for the transfer of awards other than by will or the laws of descent and distribution and only the recipient of an option right may exercise such an award during their lifetime.
paras.zh: 奖励的不可转让性。除非管理人另有规定，我们的 2021 年计划通常不允许转让奖励，但通过遗嘱或继承与分配法律进行的转让除外，且只有期权权利的接受方可在其有生之年行使该奖励。

paras.en: Certain Adjustments. In the event of certain corporate events or changes in our capitalization, to prevent diminution or enlargement of the benefits or potential benefits available under our 2021 Plan, the administrator will make adjustments to one or more of the number, kind, and class of securities that may be delivered under our 2021 Plan and/or the number, kind, class, and price of securities covered by each outstanding award.
paras.zh: 特定调整。若发生特定公司事件或我们的资本结构发生变化，为防止减少或扩大根据我们 2021 年计划可获得的利益或潜在利益，管理人将对根据我们 2021 年计划可交付的证券的数量、种类和类别，和/或每项未兑现奖励所涵盖证券的数量、种类、类别和价格中的一项或多项作出调整。

paras.en: Corporate Transaction. Our 2021 Plan provides that in the event of (i) a transfer of all or substantially all of our assets, (ii) a merger, consolidation, or other capital reorganization or business combination transaction of us with or into another corporation, entity, or person, or (iii) the consummation of a transaction, or series of related transactions, in which any “person” becomes the “beneficial owner,” directly or indirectly, of more than 50% of our then outstanding capital stock (each, a “Corporate Transaction”), the administrator may, in its sole and absolute discretion and without the need for the consent of any participant, take one or more of the following actions contingent upon the occurrence of that Corporate Transaction with respect to outstanding awards granted under our 2021 Plan which provide for: (A) the continuation of such awards by us (if we are the surviving corporation); (B) the assumption of such awards by the surviving corporation or its parent; (C) the substitution by the surviving corporation or its parent of new options or equity awards for such awards; (D) the cancellation of such awards in exchange for a payment to the participants equal to the excess of (1) the fair market value of the shares or units subject to such awards as of the closing date of such Corporate Transaction over (2) the exercise price or purchase price paid or to be paid for the shares or units representing shares subject to the awards, as applicable; or (E) the cancellation of any outstanding awards or an outstanding right to purchase restricted stock, in either case, for no consideration.
paras.zh: 公司交易。我们 2021 年计划规定，若发生以下情形：(i) 转让我们的全部或绝大部分资产，(ii) 我们与另一家公司、实体或个人合并、兼并，或进行其他资本重组或业务合并交易，或(iii) 完成一项交易或一系列关联交易，致使任何“人士”直接或间接成为我们届时已发行股本超过 50% 的“受益所有人”（每一项均称为“公司交易”），则管理人可自行全权决定，且无需征得任何参与人同意，在发生该等公司交易的前提下，就我们 2021 年计划项下已授予的未兑现奖励采取以下一项或多项行动：(A) 由我们（若我们为存续公司）继续维持该等奖励；(B) 由存续公司或其母公司承继该等奖励；(C) 由存续公司或其母公司以新的期权或股权奖励替代该等奖励；(D) 注销该等奖励，以向参与人支付相当于以下差额的款项：(1) 截至该等公司交易交割日，该等奖励所涉股份或单位的公允市场价值，减去 (2) 为奖励所涉股份所代表的股份已支付或应支付的行使价或购买价（如适用）；或 (E) 注销任何未兑现奖励或购买限制性股票的未兑现权利，在任一情况下均无需支付任何对价。

paras.en: Amendment or Termination. Our board of directors may amend or terminate our 2021 Plan at any time. If our board of directors amends our 2021 Plan, we will ask our stockholders to approve the amendment if such approval is necessary or desirable to comply with applicable law. No further awards will be made under our 2021 Plan after this offering.
paras.zh: 修订或终止。我们的董事会可随时修订或终止我们 2021 年计划。若我们的董事会修订我们 2021 年计划，如该等批准为遵守适用法律所必需或适宜，我们将提请股东批准该等修订。本次发行后，我们 2021 年计划项下将不再授予新的奖励。

paras.en: #### 2026 Employee Stock Purchase Plan
paras.zh: #### 2026 年员工购股计划

paras.en: General. Our ESPP was adopted by our board of directors on September 1, 2026, and approved by our stockholders on October 22, 2026. Our ESPP will become effective as of the day immediately prior to the day the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part is effective.
paras.zh: 概述。我们的 ESPP 由我们的董事会于 2026 年 9 月 1 日通过，并于 2026 年 10 月 22 日经我们的股东批准。我们的 ESPP 将自本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之日前一日生效。

paras.en: Our ESPP includes two components: a 423 component and a non‑423 component. We intend the 423 component to qualify as an “employee stock purchase plan” within the meaning of Section 423 of the Code. The non-423 component authorizes grants of purchase rights that do not comply with Section 423 of the Code.
paras.zh: 我们的 ESPP 包含两个组成部分：423 组成部分和非 423 组成部分。我们拟使 423 组成部分符合《税法》第 423 条所指的“员工购股计划”。非 423 组成部分授权授予不符合《税法》第 423 条的购买权。

paras.en: Share Reserve. The maximum aggregate number of shares that may be issued under our ESPP is [__] shares of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 股份储备。根据我们的 ESPP 可发行的股份最大合计数量为 [__] 股我们的 A 类普通股。

paras.en: In addition, the number of shares that may be issued under our ESPP will be increased on the first day of each fiscal year beginning with our 2027 fiscal year and ending on (and including) the first day of our 2036 fiscal year, in an amount equal to the lesser of: (i) 1% of the total number of shares of our common stock (including only all classes of common stock issued by the company that carry economic rights) outstanding on the last day of the calendar month prior to the date of such automatic increase (calculated on an as-converted basis); and (ii) such number of shares determined by our board of directors.
paras.zh: 此外，自 2027 财年起至 2036 财年首日（含当日）止，每个财年首日，根据我们的 ESPP 可发行的股份数量将增加，增加数量等于以下两者中的较小者：(i) 在该等自动增加之日的前一个日历月最后一日已发行的我们普通股总数（仅包括公司发行的、具有经济权利的所有类别普通股）的 1%（按转换后基准计算）；以及 (ii) 由我们的董事会确定的股份数量。

paras.en: Plan Administration. Our ESPP is administered by our board of directors or a committee designated by our board of directors. Our board of directors has delegated its authority to administer our ESPP to our compensation committee.
paras.zh: 计划管理。我们的 ESPP 由我们的董事会或董事会指定的委员会管理。我们的董事会已将其管理 ESPP 的权力授予我们的薪酬委员会。

paras.en: Eligibility. Generally, all regular employees, including executive officers, employed by us or by any of our designated affiliates and specified service providers (including non-U.S. service providers) of the company or our designated affiliates may participate in our ESPP.
paras.zh: 资格。一般而言，由我们或我们的任何指定关联方雇用的所有正式员工（包括高管）以及公司或我们指定关联方的特定服务提供者（包括非美国服务提供者）均可参与我们的 ESPP。

paras.en: Employees may have to satisfy one or more of the following service requirements before participating in the 423 components of our ESPP, as determined by the administrator, including: (1) continuous service with us or one of our affiliates for at least two years (or such lesser period of time as may be determined by our board of directors), (2) being customarily employed for more than 20 hours per week (or such lesser period of time as may be determined by our board of directors), (3) being customarily employed for more than five months per calendar year (or such lesser period of time as may be determined by our board of directors), (4) is not a highly compensated employee within the meaning of Section 423(b)(4)(D) of the Code, or (5) such other criteria as our board of directors may determine to be consistent with Section 423 of the Code. No employee may purchase shares under the 423 component of our ESPP at a rate in excess of $25,000 worth of our Class A common stock based on the fair market value per share of our Class A common stock at the beginning of an offering for each year such a purchase right is outstanding. Finally, no employee will be eligible for the grant of any purchase rights under the 423 component of our ESPP if immediately after such rights are granted, such employee has voting power over 5% or more of our outstanding capital stock measured by vote or value under Section 424(d) of the Code.
paras.zh: 员工在参与我们 ESPP 的 423 组成部分之前，可能需要满足以下一项或多项服务要求（由管理人确定），包括：(1) 在我们或我们的一家关联方连续服务至少两年（或董事会可能确定的更短期限），(2) 通常每周工作超过 20 小时（或董事会可能确定的更短期限），(3) 通常每个日历年工作超过五个月（或董事会可能确定的更短期限），(4) 不属于《税法》第 423(b)(4)(D) 条所指的高薪员工，或 (5) 董事会可能确定的其他符合《税法》第 423 条的标准。任何员工不得根据我们 ESPP 的 423 组成部分，以超过 $25,000 的我们 A 类普通股（按该购买权存续期间每年发售开始时我们 A 类普通股每股公平市场价值计算）的速率购买股份。最后，如果在授予任何购买权后，该员工立即根据《税法》第 424(d) 条按投票权或价值衡量拥有我们已发行股本 5% 或以上的投票权，则该员工将没有资格根据我们 ESPP 的 423 组成部分获得任何购买权的授予。

paras.en: Offerings. Our ESPP is implemented through offerings pursuant to which participants are granted rights to purchase shares of our Class A common stock on specified dates during such offerings. Under our ESPP, we may specify offerings with durations of not more than 27 months and may specify shorter purchase periods within each offering. Each offering will have one or more purchase dates on which shares of our Class A common stock will be purchased by participants in the offering. An offering under our ESPP may be terminated under certain circumstances. The administrator will have the discretion to structure an offering so that if the fair market value of a share of our Class A common stock on the first trading day of a new purchase period within that offering is less than or equal to the fair market value of a share of our Class A common stock on the offering date for that offering, then that offering will terminate immediately as of that first trading day, and the participants in such terminated offering will be automatically enrolled in a new offering beginning on the first trading day of such new offering.
paras.zh: 发行期。我们的 ESPP 通过发行期实施，参与者在发行期内的特定日期获得购买我们 A 类普通股股份的权利。根据我们的 ESPP，我们可以指定期限不超过 27 个月的发行期，并可在每个发行期内指定更短的购买期。每个发行期将有一个或多个购买日期，参与者在发行期内于该等购买日期购买我们 A 类普通股的股份。我们的 ESPP 项下的发行期可在特定情况下终止。管理人将有权自行决定发行期的结构，使得如果在该发行期内新购买期首个交易日的我们 A 类普通股每股公允市场价值低于或等于该发行期发行日的我们 A 类普通股每股公允市场价值，则该发行期将于该首个交易日立即终止，且该终止发行期的参与者将自动加入自该新发行期首个交易日起开始的新发行期。

paras.en: Payroll Deductions. Participants who are employees may generally make contributions through payroll deductions (unless otherwise required by law or provided for in an offering). In the case of an offering under the 423 component, such percentage or maximum dollar amount of contributions may not exceed 15% of their earnings for the applicable offering. Contributions pursuant to the non-423 component will generally be made on an after-tax basis in a manner determined by the administrator.
paras.zh: 工资扣款。作为员工的参与者通常可通过工资扣款进行缴款（除非法律另有要求或发行期另有规定）。对于 423 组成部分项下的发行期，该等缴款比例或最高美元金额不得超过其在适用发行期内收入的 15%。非 423 组成部分项下的缴款通常将在税后基础上按管理人确定的方式进行。

paras.en: Shares of our Class A common stock will be purchased for the accounts of participants in our ESPP at a price per share that is not less than the lesser of (1) 85% of the fair market value of a share of our Class A common stock on the first date of an offering, or (2) 85% of the fair market value of a share of our Class A common stock on the date of purchase.
paras.zh: 我们 ESPP 参与者的账户将按不低于以下两者中较低者的每股价格购买我们 A 类普通股股份：(1) 发行期首日我们 A 类普通股每股公允市场价值的 85%，或 (2) 购买日我们 A 类普通股每股公允市场价值的 85%。

paras.en: Certain Adjustments. In the event of any change that is made in, or other events that occur with respect to, our Class A common stock subject to our ESPP or subject to any purchase right without the receipt of consideration by the company through merger, consolidation, reorganization, recapitalization, reincorporation, stock dividend, dividend in property other than cash, large nonrecurring cash dividend, stock split, liquidating dividend, combination of shares, exchange of shares, change in corporate structure, or other similar equity restructuring transaction, our board of directors will make appropriate and proportionate adjustments to: (1) the class(es) and maximum number of shares reserved under our ESPP, (2) the class(es) and maximum number of shares by which the share reserve may increase automatically each year, (3) the class(es) and number of shares subject to, and purchase price applicable to, all outstanding offerings and purchase rights, and (4) the class(es) and number of shares that are subject to purchase limits under ongoing offerings.
paras.zh: 特定调整。如发生对我们 A 类普通股（受我们的 ESPP 或任何购买权约束）的任何变更或其他事件，且公司未因合并、整合、重组、资本重组、重新注册成立、股票股息、非现金财产股息、大额非经常性现金股息、股票拆分、清算股息、股份合并、股份交换、公司结构变更或其他类似股权重组交易而收到对价，我们的董事会将作出适当且成比例的调整，涉及：(1) 我们 ESPP 项下预留的股份类别和最高股份数量，(2) 股份储备每年可自动增加的股份类别和最高股份数量，(3) 所有未完成发行期和购买权所涉股份的类别和数量以及适用的购买价格，以及 (4) 持续发行期项下受购买限额约束的股份类别和数量。

paras.en: Dissolution or Liquidation. In the event of a dissolution or liquidation of the company, any offering then in progress will be shortened by setting a new purchase date prior to the consummation of such proposed dissolution or liquidation. The board of directors will notify each participant that the purchase date has been changed and that the participant’s purchase right will be exercised automatically on the new purchase date unless prior to such date the participant has withdrawn from the offering.
paras.zh: 解散或清算。若公司解散或清算，则当时正在进行的任何发售将通过在该拟议解散或清算完成之前设定新的购买日而予以缩短。董事会将通知每位参与者购买日已变更，且参与者的购买权将在新购买日自动行使，除非参与者在上述日期之前已退出该发售。

paras.en: Corporate Transactions. Our ESPP provides that in the event of certain significant corporate transactions, including: (1) a transfer of all or substantially all of our assets; (2) a merger, consolidation, or other capital, reorganization or business combination transaction of the company with or into another corporation, entity, or person; or (3) the consummation of a transaction, or series of related transactions, in which any person becomes the beneficial owner, directly or indirectly, of more than 50% of our then outstanding capital stock, a successor corporation may assume, continue, or substitute each outstanding purchase right. If the successor corporation does not assume, continue, or substitute the purchase right, the participants’ accumulated contributions will be used to purchase shares prior to the corporate transaction and the purchase rights will terminate immediately after such purchase. The administrator will notify each participant that the purchase date has been changed and that the participant’s purchase right will be exercised automatically on the new purchase date unless prior to such date the participant has withdrawn from the offering.
paras.zh: 公司交易。我们的员工购股计划（ESPP）规定，在发生某些重大公司交易时，包括：(1) 转让我们的全部或绝大部分资产；(2) 公司与另一家公司、实体或个人进行合并、整合或其他资本、重组或业务合并交易；或 (3) 完成一项交易或一系列相关交易，其中任何人士直接或间接成为我们当时已发行股本超过 50% 的实益拥有人，承继公司可承接、延续或替代每项未行使的购买权。若承继公司不承接、延续或替代该购买权，则参与者的累计缴款将用于在公司交易之前购买股份，且购买权将在该购买完成后立即终止。管理人将通知每位参与者购买日已变更，且参与者的购买权将在新购买日自动行使，除非参与者在上述日期之前已退出该发售。

paras.en: Spin-Off. In the event of a spin-off or similar transaction, our board of directors may take actions deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with any ongoing offering, subject to compliance with applicable laws. In the absence of any such action, if an entity ceases to qualify as a related company under our ESPP, any participant in an ongoing offering employed by, or providing services to, such entity will be treated in the same manner as if the participant had terminated employment or service.
paras.zh: 分拆。若发生分拆或类似交易，我们的董事会可采取其认为与任何进行中的发售相关的必要或适当行动，但须遵守适用法律。若未采取任何此类行动，且某实体不再符合我们 ESPP 项下关联公司的资格，则受雇于该实体或向其提供服务的进行中发售的任何参与者，将按如同该参与者已终止雇佣或服务的方式处理。

paras.en: Amendment or Termination. Our board of directors has the authority to amend, suspend, or terminate our ESPP at any time, except that, subject to certain exceptions described in our ESPP, no such action may materially impair outstanding rights under our ESPP. We will obtain stockholder approval of any amendment to our ESPP as required by applicable law or listing requirements.
paras.zh: 修订或终止。我们的董事会有权随时修订、暂停或终止我们的 ESPP，但除我们 ESPP 中所述的某些例外情况外，任何此类行动不得实质性损害我们 ESPP 项下未行使的权利。我们将根据适用法律或上市要求，就对我们 ESPP 的任何修订取得股东批准。

paras.en: In addition to the compensation arrangements, including employment, termination of employment, and change in control arrangements, discussed in the sections titled “Management” and “Executive Compensation,” the following is a description of each transaction since January 1, 2023 and each currently proposed transaction in which:
paras.zh: 除标题为“管理层”和“高管薪酬”的章节中讨论的薪酬安排（包括雇佣、雇佣终止及控制权变更安排）外，以下描述的是自 2023 年 1 月 1 日以来的每项交易以及目前拟议的每项交易，其中：

paras.en: - we have been or are to be a participant;
paras.zh: - 我们曾经或将要作为参与方；

paras.en: - the amount involved exceeded or exceeds $120,000; and
paras.zh: - 所涉金额已超过或超过 $120,000；以及

paras.en: - any of our directors, executive officers, or holders of more than 5% of any class of our outstanding voting securities, or any immediate family member of, or person sharing the household with, any of these individuals or entities, had or will have a direct or indirect material interest.
paras.zh: - 我们的任何董事、高管，或我们任何类别已发行有表决权证券 5% 以上的持有人，或任何该等个人或实体的直系亲属或与其同住的人，已经或将会拥有直接或间接的重大利益。

paras.en: #### Series H Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock Financing
paras.zh: #### H 系列可赎回可转换优先股融资

paras.en: We are party to certain irrevocable proxy agreements with Daffy Charitable Fund and Dechomai Asset Trust (such entities, “DAFs”), dated as of October 6, 2025 and December 20, 2024, respectively (together, “Voting Proxy Agreements”). Each of the DAFs has entered into a master donation agreement with us pursuant to which the DAFs may from time to time receive donations of shares directly from us or from one or more of our stockholders. Neither of the DAFs holds 5% or more of the outstanding shares of any class of our voting securities.
paras.zh: 我们与 Daffy Charitable Fund 和 Dechomai Asset Trust（该等实体，合称“DAF”）分别于 2025 年 10 月 6 日和 2024 年 12 月 20 日签订了若干不可撤销的代理协议（合称“投票代理协议”）。各 DAF 均已与我们签订主捐赠协议，据此，DAF 可不时直接从我方或从我方一名或多名股东处接受股份捐赠。各 DAF 均未持有我方任何类别有表决权证券已发行股份的 5% 或以上。

paras.en: Dario Amodei, our Chief Executive Officer and a member of our board of directors, is party to the Voting Proxy Agreements as the proxyholder thereunder, pursuant to which he has the right to vote shares of our voting securities currently owned or subsequently acquired by the DAFs (any such votable securities, “Voting Shares”) in his sole and absolute discretion; provided, however, that any shares of our voting securities held by the DAFs as a result of a stock transfer or donation by our Chief Executive Officer or any of such officer’s family members or affiliates will not be considered Voting Shares for purposes of the Voting Proxy Agreements. Our board of directors may, from time to time, designate certain other individuals as the proxyholder subject to the terms set forth in the Voting Proxy Agreements.
paras.zh: 我方首席执行官兼董事会成员 Dario Amodei 是投票代理协议项下的代理人，据此，其有权自行全权决定对 DAF 目前拥有或后续取得的有表决权证券（任何该等可投票证券，“投票股份”）进行投票；但前提是，DAF 因我方首席执行官或该等高管任何家庭成员或关联方转让或捐赠股份而持有的我方任何有表决权证券，就投票代理协议而言不视为投票股份。我方董事会可不时根据投票代理协议所载条款指定若干其他个人为代理人。

paras.en: #### Voting Agreement
paras.zh: #### 表决协议

paras.en: Under the Stockholders’ Agreement, the Founder LLC and the LTBT will agree to vote their shares and take other actions to give effect to the board composition, and director nomination and removal, provisions described under the sections titled “Management—Board of Directors,” “Management—Committees of the Board of Directors—Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee,” and “Our Governance Structure and Its Goals—Long-Term Benefit Trust—Election and Removal of Directors.”
paras.zh: 根据《股东协议》，创始人有限责任公司和 LTBT 将同意对其股份进行表决并采取其他行动，以落实“管理层——董事会”“管理层——董事会各委员会——提名与公司治理委员会”以及“我们的治理结构及其目标——长期利益信托——董事的选举与罢免”各节所述有关董事会组成以及董事提名和罢免的规定。

paras.en: #### Notice Rights
paras.zh: #### 通知权

paras.en: Under the Stockholders’ Agreement, for so long as our Class T common stock remains outstanding, we have agreed not to take specified actions, including a liquidation event, a transfer of control of an AI model exceeding capabilities thresholds established by our board of directors, a sale of 50% or more of our outstanding voting power or economic interests represented by our capital stock, or the commencement of a bankruptcy, insolvency, or similar proceeding with respect to the company, without providing advance written notice to the LTBT, which notice period may be waived.
paras.zh: 根据《股东协议》，只要我们的 T 类普通股仍未注销，我们已同意不采取特定行动，包括清算事件、转让对 AI 模型的控制权且该模型的能力超过我们董事会设定的能力阈值、出售我们已发行表决权或我们股本所代表经济权益的 50% 或以上，或就公司启动破产、资不抵债或类似程序，除非事先向 LTBT 提供书面通知，且该通知期可予豁免。

paras.en: #### Expense Reimbursement and Indemnification
paras.zh: #### 费用报销与赔偿

paras.en: We have agreed to reimburse or advance to the Founder LLC and the LTBT their reasonable and documented out-of-pocket expenses, including legal fees, incurred in connection with specified matters relating to, among other things, their ownership of our capital stock and the exercise of their rights and obligations under our governance documents. We have also agreed to enter into indemnification agreements with the Founder LLC and the LTBT providing for indemnification, to the fullest extent permitted by law, of those entities and their related persons in connection with those same matters, without limitation of other indemnification agreements to which we may be a party.
paras.zh: 我们已同意报销或预付创始人有限责任公司和 LTBT 因特定事项而产生的合理且有据可查的自付费用（包括律师费），这些事项除其他外涉及它们对我们资本的所有权以及行使我们治理文件项下的权利和义务。我们还已同意与创始人有限责任公司和 LTBT 签订赔偿协议，在法律允许的最大范围内，就该等相同事项对该等实体及其关联人员进行赔偿，且不限制我们可能作为一方的其他赔偿协议。

paras.zh: 我们向长期利益信托（LTBT）提供资金，该信托持有我们全部 T 类普通股，用于支持其运营及受托人的薪酬。在截至 2023 年、2024 年和 2025 年 12 月 31 日的各年度，我们分别向 LTBT 支付了 [__]、$2,716,750、$0 和 $906,089。在截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的九个月内，我们向 LTBT 支付了 $8,425,213。LTBT 在我们的资产负债表上作为合并 VIE 核算（参见本招股说明书其他部分所载我们合并财务报表的附注 1）。

paras.en: We have granted stock options and RSUs to our executive officers and certain of our directors. See the section titled “Executive Compensation—Outstanding Equity Awards at 2025 Year-End” for a description of these stock options and RSUs.
paras.zh: 我们已向我们的高级管理人员及部分董事授予股票期权和 RSU。有关该等股票期权和 RSU 的说明，请参见“高管薪酬——2025 年末未兑现的股权奖励”一节。

paras.en: Other than as described above under this section titled “Certain Relationships and Related Person Transactions,” since January 1, 2023, we have not entered into any transactions, nor are there any currently proposed transactions, between us and a related person where the amount involved exceeds, or would exceed, $120,000, and in which any related person had or will have a direct or indirect material interest. We believe the terms of the transactions described above were comparable to terms we could have obtained in arm’s-length dealings with unrelated third parties.
paras.zh: 除本节“特定关系及关联人士交易”中所述情况外，自 2023 年 1 月 1 日起，我们与关联人士之间未发生任何交易，目前亦无任何拟议交易，且该等交易的涉及金额超过或将会超过 $120,000，且任何关联人士在其中拥有或将会拥有直接或间接的重大利益。我们认为，上述交易的条款与我们同无关第三方进行公平交易时可获得的条款相当。

full.sec: Limitation of Liability and Indemnification of Officers and Directors
full.secZh: 高级管理人员与董事的责任限制及补偿

paras.en: We expect to adopt an amended and restated certificate of incorporation, which will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering, and which will contain provisions that limit the liability of our directors and certain officers for monetary damages to the fullest extent permitted by the DGCL. Consequently, our directors and certain officers will not be personally liable to us or our stockholders for monetary damages for any breach of fiduciary duties as directors and officers, except liability for the following:
paras.zh: 我们预计将通过一份经修订和重述的公司章程，该章程将在本次发行完成前立即生效，并将包含相关条款，在《特拉华州普通公司法》（DGCL）允许的最大范围内，免除我们的董事及某些高级管理人员因金钱损害赔偿而承担的责任。因此，我们的董事及某些高级管理人员不会因其作为董事和高级管理人员违反信义义务而对我们或我们的股东承担金钱损害赔偿责任，但以下责任除外：

paras.en: - any breach of the director’s or officer’s duty of loyalty to our company or our stockholders;
paras.zh: - 董事或高级管理人员违反其对我们公司或我们股东所负的忠实义务；

paras.en: - any act or omission not in good faith or that involves intentional misconduct or a knowing violation of law;
paras.zh: - 任何非善意的作为或不作为，或涉及故意不当行为或明知违反法律的作为或不作为；

paras.en: - for our directors, unlawful payments of dividends or unlawful stock repurchases or redemptions as provided in Section 174 of the DGCL;
paras.zh: - 就我们的董事而言，DGCL 第 174 条所规定的非法支付股息或非法回购或赎回股票；

paras.en: - any transaction from which they derived an improper personal benefit; or
paras.zh: - 其从中获取不当个人利益的任何交易；或

paras.en: - for our officers, any action by or in the right of the corporation.
paras.zh: - 就我们的高级管理人员而言，由公司提起或代表公司提起的任何诉讼。

paras.en: Any amendment to, or repeal of, these provisions will not eliminate or reduce the effect of these provisions in respect of any act, omission, or claim that occurred or arose prior to that amendment or repeal. If the DGCL is amended to provide for further limitations on the personal liability of directors and officers of corporations, then the personal liability of our directors and officers will be further limited to the greatest extent permitted by the DGCL.
paras.zh: 对上述条款的任何修订或废止，均不会消除或减少该等条款对在该等修订或废止之前发生或产生的任何作为、不作为或索赔的效力。如果 DGCL 被修订以对公司的董事和高级管理人员的个人责任作出进一步限制，则我们的董事和高级管理人员的个人责任将在 DGCL 允许的最大范围内进一步受到限制。

paras.en: In addition, we expect to adopt amended and restated bylaws, which will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering, and which will provide that we will indemnify, to the fullest extent permitted by law, any person who is or was a party or is threatened to be made a party to any action, suit, or proceeding by reason of the fact that they are or were one of our directors or officers or are or were serving at our request as a director or officer of another corporation, partnership, joint venture, trust, or other enterprise. Our amended and restated bylaws are expected to provide that we may indemnify to the fullest extent permitted by law any person who is or was a party or is threatened to be made a party to any action, suit, or proceeding by reason of the fact that they are or were one of our employees or agents or are or were serving at our request as an employee or agent of another corporation, partnership, joint venture, trust, or other enterprise. Our amended and restated bylaws will also provide that we must advance expenses incurred by or on behalf of a director or officer in advance of the final disposition of any action or proceeding, subject to limited exceptions.
paras.zh: 此外，我们预计将通过经修订和重述的公司章程细则，该细则将在本次发行完成前立即生效，并将规定：我们将依法在最大范围内，对任何因担任或曾担任我们的董事或高级管理人员，或因应我们的请求担任或曾担任另一公司、合伙企业、合资企业、信托或其他企业的董事或高级管理人员，而成为或 threatened to be made 任何诉讼、起诉或程序一方或受到该等威胁的人士，予以赔偿。我们经修订和重述的公司章程细则预计将规定，我们可以依法在最大范围内，对任何因担任或曾担任我们的员工或代理人，或因应我们的请求担任或曾担任另一公司、合伙企业、合资企业、信托或其他企业的员工或代理人，而成为或受到威胁将成为任何诉讼、起诉或程序一方的人士，予以赔偿。我们经修订和重述的公司章程细则还将规定，我们必须在任何诉讼或程序最终处置之前，先行支付董事或高级管理人员所发生或代表其发生的费用，但有限的例外情形除外。

paras.en: Further, we have entered into or will enter into indemnification agreements with each of our directors and executive officers that may be broader than the specific indemnification provisions contained in the DGCL. These indemnification agreements require us, among other things, to indemnify our directors and executive officers against liabilities that may arise by reason of their status or service. These indemnification agreements also require us to advance all expenses incurred by the directors and executive officers in investigating or defending any such action, suit, or proceeding. We believe that these agreements are necessary to attract and retain qualified individuals to serve as directors and executive officers.
paras.zh: 此外，我们已与或将与每位董事和高级管理人员签订赔偿协议，其范围可能比《特拉华州普通公司法》（DGCL）所载的具体赔偿条款更为宽泛。该等赔偿协议要求我们（除其他事项外）就董事和高级管理人员因其身份或服务而可能产生的责任向其作出赔偿。该等赔偿协议还要求我们预先支付董事和高级管理人员在调查或抗辩任何该等诉讼、起诉或程序中所发生的全部费用。我们认为，该等协议对于吸引和留住合格人士担任董事和高级管理人员是必要的。

paras.en: The limitation of liability and indemnification provisions that are expected to be included in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, amended and restated bylaws, and indemnification agreements that we have entered into or will enter into with our directors and executive officers may discourage stockholders from bringing a lawsuit against our directors and executive officers for breach of their fiduciary duties. They may also reduce the likelihood of derivative litigation against our directors and executive officers, even though an action, if successful, might benefit us and other stockholders. Further, a stockholder’s investment may be adversely affected to the extent that we pay the costs of settlement and damage awards against directors and executive officers as required by these indemnification provisions. We cannot predict whether, when, or the amount of any future claims for indemnification in connection with any settlement or judgment. Under Delaware law and our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, in the absence of a conflict of interest, no failure to satisfy the balancing obligations associated with our status as a PBC shall, for purposes of the exculpation, advancement, and indemnification rights of our directors and officers, constitute an act or omission not in good faith, or a breach of the duty of loyalty.
paras.zh: 我们经修订并重述的公司章程、经修订并重述的公司细则以及我们已与或将与董事和高级管理人员签订的赔偿协议中预计将包含的责任限制和赔偿条款，可能会阻碍股东就违反信义义务对我们的董事和高级管理人员提起诉讼。该等条款还可能降低针对我们的董事和高级管理人员提起派生诉讼的可能性，即使该等诉讼若胜诉可能使我们及其他股东受益。此外，在我们根据该等赔偿条款的要求支付针对董事和高级管理人员的和解费用和损害赔偿金的情况下，股东的投资可能会受到不利影响。我们无法预测未来是否会就任何和解或判决提出任何赔偿请求、何时提出以及请求金额。根据特拉华州法律和我们经修订并重述的公司章程，在不存在利益冲突的情况下，就我们的董事和高级管理人员的免责、费用预付和赔偿权利而言，未能履行与我们作为公益公司（PBC）身份相关的平衡义务，不构成非善意的作为或不作为，也不构成对忠实义务的违反。

paras.en: We have obtained insurance policies under which, subject to the limitations of the policies, coverage is provided to our directors and executive officers against loss arising from claims made by reason of breach of fiduciary duty or other wrongful acts as a director or executive officer, including claims relating to public company securities matters, and to us with respect to payments that may be made by us to these directors and executive officers pursuant to our indemnification obligations or otherwise as a matter of law.
paras.zh: 我们已获得保险保单，根据该等保单的限制，为我们的董事和高级管理人员就其因违反信义义务或作为董事或高级管理人员的其他不当行为而被提出的索赔（包括与上市公司证券事项相关的索赔）所产生的损失提供保障，并就我们根据赔偿义务或以其他方式依法可能向该等董事和高级管理人员支付的款项向我们提供保障。

paras.en: Certain of our non-employee directors may, through their relationships with their employers, be insured or indemnified against certain liabilities incurred in their capacity as members of our board of directors.
paras.zh: 我们的某些非雇员董事可能通过其与雇主的关联关系，就其以董事会成员身份产生的某些责任获得保险或赔偿。

paras.en: The underwriting agreement will provide for indemnification by the underwriters of us and our officers and directors for certain liabilities.
paras.zh: 承销协议将规定承销商就某些责任向我们及我们的高级管理人员和董事作出赔偿。

paras.en: Insofar as indemnification for liabilities arising under the Securities Act may be permitted to directors, officers, or persons controlling our company pursuant to the foregoing provisions, we have been informed that, in the opinion of the SEC, such indemnification is against public policy as expressed in the Securities Act and is therefore unenforceable.
paras.zh: 就前述条款允许董事、高级管理人员或控制我们公司的人士获得《证券法》项下责任的赔偿而言，我们已被告知，SEC 认为此类赔偿违反《证券法》所体现的公共政策，因此不可执行。

full.sec: Policies and Procedures for Related Person Transactions
full.secZh: 关联方交易的政策与程序

paras.en: Following the completion of this offering, our audit committee will have the primary responsibility for reviewing and approving or disapproving “related person transactions,” which are transactions between us and related persons in which the aggregate amount involved exceeds or may be expected to exceed $120,000 and in which a related person has or will have a direct or indirect material interest. Upon completion of this offering, our policy regarding transactions between us and related persons will provide that a related person is defined as a director, executive officer, nominee for director, or greater than 5% beneficial owner of any class of our outstanding voting securities, in each case since the beginning of the most recently completed year, and any of their immediate family members. Our audit committee charter that will be in effect upon completion of this offering will provide that our audit committee shall review and approve or disapprove any related person transactions.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，我们的审计委员会将主要负责审查并批准或不批准“关联人士交易”，即我们与关联人士之间涉及的合计金额超过或预计可能超过 $120,000 且关联人士在其中拥有或将拥有直接或间接重大利益的交易。本次发行完成后，我们关于我们与关联人士之间交易的政策将规定，关联人士是指自最近一个完整年度开始以来的董事、高级管理人员、董事候选人，或我们任何类别已发行有表决权证券的 5% 以上受益所有人，以及上述任何人士的直系亲属。本次发行完成后生效的审计委员会章程将规定，我们的审计委员会应审查并批准或不批准任何关联人士交易。

paras.zh: - 300,000,000,000 股被指定为 A 类普通股（“A 类普通股”）；

paras.en: - 100,000,000,000 shares are designated as Class N common stock (the “Class N common stock”);
paras.zh: - 100,000,000,000 股被指定为 N 类普通股（“N 类普通股”）；

paras.en: - one share is designated as Class T common stock (the “Class T common stock”);
paras.zh: - 一股被指定为 T 类普通股（“T 类普通股”）；

paras.en: - one share is designated as Class F common stock (the “Class F common stock”);
paras.zh: - 一股被指定为 F 类普通股（“F 类普通股”）；

paras.en: - 30,000,000,000 shares are designated as Class E common stock (the “Class E common stock”); and
paras.zh: - 30,000,000,000 股被指定为 E 类普通股（“E 类普通股”）；以及

paras.en: - 30,000,000,000 shares are designated as preferred stock.
