full.secZh: 锁定期与市场禁售协议

paras.en: All of our directors and officers and substantially all of our stockholders are subject to lock-up agreements with the underwriters or market standoff agreements with us that restrict their ability to transfer shares of our Class A common stock and Class N common stock and securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for such shares for:
paras.zh: 我们所有董事和高级管理人员以及绝大多数股东均受与承销商签订的锁定期协议或与我们签订的市场禁售协议约束，这些协议限制其转让我们的 A 类普通股和 N 类普通股以及可转换为该等股份或可行使或可交换为该等股份的证券的能力，限制期间如下：

paras.en: (1) Our non-founder directors, officers, and certain of our current and former employees and consultants, during the period ending upon the earlier to occur of (x) 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the Q1 Earnings Release Date or (y) immediately after the close of the trading day on the 180th day after the date of this prospectus or, if the 180th day is not a trading day, immediately after the close of the last trading day immediately preceding the 180th day;
paras.zh: (1) 我们的非创始人董事、高管以及部分现任和前任员工及顾问，在截至以下两者中较早发生者之时止的期间内：(x) 第一季度财报发布日之后第二个完整交易日的美国东部时间上午 6:00，或 (y) 本招股说明书日期后第 180 天交易日收盘后立即（若第 180 天不是交易日，则为第 180 天之前最后一个交易日收盘后立即）；

paras.en: (2) For certain stockholders holding approximately [__] % of our fully diluted shares immediately prior to this offering, during the period ending upon the earlier to occur of (x) 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the Q1 Earnings Release Date or (y) immediately after the close of the trading day on the 180th day after the date of this prospectus or, if the 180th day is not a trading day, immediately after the close of the last trading day immediately preceding the 180th day;
paras.zh: (2) 对于在本招股说明书发布前立即持有我们约 [__]% 完全稀释股份的若干股东，在截至以下两者中较早发生之日止的期间内：(x) 第一季度财报发布日之后第二个完整交易日美国东部时间上午 6:00，或 (y) 本招股说明书日期后第 180 天交易日收盘后立即（若第 180 天不是交易日，则为第 180 天之前最后一个交易日收盘后立即）；

paras.en: (3) For certain stockholders holding approximately [__] % of our fully diluted shares immediately prior to this offering, during the period ending upon the earlier to occur of (x) 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the Q3 Earnings Release Date or (y) immediately after the close of the trading day on the 365th day after the date of this prospectus or, if the 365th day is not a trading day, immediately after the close of the last trading day immediately preceding the 365th day; and
paras.zh: (3) 对于在本招股说明书日期紧接本次发行前持有我们约 [__]% 完全稀释股份的若干股东，在截至以下较早发生之日止的期间内：(x) 第三季度业绩发布日之后第二个完整交易日的美国东部时间上午 6:00，或 (y) 本招股说明书日期后第 365 天当日交易收盘后立即（若第 365 天不是交易日，则为第 365 天之前最后一个交易日收盘后立即）；以及

paras.en: (4) Our seven co-founders, during the period ending upon the earlier to occur of (x) 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the Q3 Earnings Release Date or (y) immediately after the close of the trading day on the 365th day after the date of this prospectus or, if the 365th day is not a trading day, immediately after the close of the last trading day immediately preceding the 365th day,
paras.zh: (4) 我们的七位联合创始人，在截至以下两者中较早发生之日止的期间内：(x) 第三季度财报发布日之后第二个完整交易日东部时间上午 6:00，或 (y) 本招股说明书日期后第 365 天交易日收盘后立即（若第 365 天不是交易日，则为第 365 天之前最后一个交易日收盘后立即），

paras.en: subject to timed automatic expirations described in the “Underwriting—Lock-up and Market Standoff Agreements” section of this prospectus.
paras.zh: 但须遵守本招股说明书“承销—锁定期与市场禁售协议”一节所述定时自动到期安排。

paras.en: The lock-up agreements and market standoff agreements described above are subject to a number of exceptions.
paras.zh: 上述锁定期协议和市场禁售协议受若干例外情形约束。

paras.en: See the section titled “Underwriting—Lock-up and Market Standoff Agreements” for more information about these transfer restrictions and related expirations and exceptions.
paras.zh: 有关该等转让限制及相关到期和例外情形的更多信息，请参见标题为“承销—锁定期与市场禁售协议”的章节。

paras.en: Shares of our Class N common stock are not listed on a stock exchange and are not registered under the Securities Act. Shares of our Class N common stock will automatically convert into shares of Class A common stock upon a qualifying transfer, which shares would be subject to the resale restrictions and registration rights described in this section. See the section titled “Description of Capital Stock” for a complete description of the conversion mechanics applicable to our Class N common stock.
paras.zh: 我们的 N 类普通股股份未在任何证券交易所上市，且未根据《证券法》进行注册。我们的 N 类普通股股份在符合资格的转让后将自动转换为 A 类普通股股份，该等股份将受到本节所述转售限制和注册权的约束。有关适用于我们 N 类普通股的转换机制的完整说明，请参见标题为“股本说明”的章节。

paras.en: Following the completion of this offering, shares of Class N common stock will consist of:
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，N 类普通股股份将包括：

paras.en: - shares, representing shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026 and shares to be issued immediately prior to the completion of this offering pursuant to the Preferred Stock Conversion with respect to all outstanding shares of our non-voting redeemable convertible preferred stock;
paras.zh: - 股份，代表截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的已发行股份，以及根据优先股转换就我们全部已发行的无表决权可赎回可转换优先股在本次发行完成前立即发行的股份；

paras.en: - shares to be issued immediately prior to the completion of this offering pursuant to the conversion of outstanding convertible promissory notes at the applicable fixed conversion prices, representing shares issuable upon the completion of this offering without causing the holder to exceed any applicable ownership cap;
paras.zh: - 根据未偿还可转换本票按适用固定转换价格进行转换而在本次发行完成前立即发行的股份，代表在本次发行完成后可发行且不会导致持有人超过任何适用持股上限的股份；

paras.en: - shares issuable at certain intervals following the completion of this offering pursuant to the conversion of any remaining outstanding convertible promissory notes at the applicable fixed conversion prices that could not be converted immediately prior to the completion of this offering without exceeding such ownership cap; and
paras.zh: - 在本次发行完成后按特定间隔可发行的股份，系根据任何剩余未偿还可转换本票按适用固定转换价格进行转换而发行，该等本票在本次发行完成前立即转换将超过该等持股上限而无法转换；以及

paras.en: - any shares issuable in connection with (i) the conversion of any convertible promissory notes that may be issued under our NPAs following the completion of this offering, (ii) draws under our NPAs that are settled directly in shares of Class N common stock following the completion of this offering, (iii) donations that we match under our Donation Matching Plan, and (iv) certain contractual rights to private placements, whether concurrent with or following the completion of this offering.
paras.zh: - 与以下事项相关而可发行的任何股份：(i) 本次发行完成后根据我们的 NPA 可能发行的任何可转换本票的转换，(ii) 本次发行完成后根据我们的 NPA 直接以 N 类普通股股份结算的提款，(iii) 我们在捐赠配捐计划下进行配捐的捐赠，以及 (iv) 某些私募配售的合同权利，无论该等事项与本次发行完成同时发生还是在其后发生。

paras.en: For a description of the conversion mechanics of the outstanding notes and the rights to future issuances of notes and Class N common stock, see the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Liquidity and Capital Resources—Convertible Notes.”
paras.zh: 有关未偿还可转换本票的转换机制以及未来发行本票和 N 类普通股的权利的说明，请参见标题为“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——流动性与资本资源——可转换本票”的章节。

paras.en: Additionally, certain holders of our Class N common stock are entitled to registration rights with respect to their shares, the exercise of which could facilitate sales of large blocks of our shares into the public market following any applicable lock-up period. See the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Registration Rights” for a description of these registration rights.
paras.zh: 此外，我们 N 类普通股的某些持有人就其股份享有注册权，行使该等权利可能有助于在任何适用的锁定期后向公开市场出售我们的大宗股份。有关该等注册权的说明，请参见标题为“股本说明——注册权”的章节。

paras.en: In general, Rule 144 provides that once we have been subject to the public company reporting requirements of Section 13 or Section 15(d) of the Exchange Act for at least 90 days, a person who is not deemed to have been one of our affiliates for purposes of the Securities Act at any time during the 90 days preceding a sale and who has beneficially owned the shares of our Class A common stock proposed to be sold for at least six months is entitled to sell those shares without complying with the manner of sale, volume limitation, or notice provisions of Rule 144, subject to compliance with the public information requirements of Rule 144. If such a person has beneficially owned the shares proposed to be sold for at least one year, including the holding period of any prior owner other than our affiliates, then that person would be entitled to sell those shares without complying with any of the requirements of Rule 144.
paras.zh: 一般而言，Rule 144 规定，一旦我们已受《交易法》第 13 条或第 15(d) 条规定的上市公司报告要求约束至少 90 天，则任何在出售前 90 天内任何时候均不被视为《证券法》所指我们关联方的人士，且其已实益持有拟出售的 A 类普通股至少六个月，即有权出售该等股份，而无需遵守 Rule 144 关于出售方式、成交量限制或通知的规定，但须遵守 Rule 144 的公开信息要求。若该人士已实益持有拟出售股份至少一年（包括任何非我们关联方的前手持有人的持有期），则该人士将有权出售该等股份，而无需遵守 Rule 144 的任何要求。

paras.en: In general, Rule 144 provides that our affiliates or persons selling shares of our Class A common stock on behalf of our affiliates are entitled to sell upon expiration of the market standoff agreements and lock-up agreements described above, within any three-month period, a number of shares of our Class A common stock that does not exceed the greater of:
paras.zh: 一般而言，Rule 144 规定，我们的关联方或代表我们关联方出售 A 类普通股的人士，有权在上述市场禁售协议和锁定期协议到期后，在任何三个月期间内出售不超过以下两者中较大者的 A 类普通股数量：

paras.en: - 1% of the number of shares of our capital stock then outstanding, which will equal [__] shares immediately after the completion of this offering; or
paras.zh: - 当时已发行股本股数的 1%，即本次发行完成后立即为 [__] 股；或

paras.en: - the average weekly trading volume of our Class A common stock during the four calendar weeks preceding the filing of a notice on Form 144 with respect to that sale.
paras.zh: - 在就该项出售向 SEC 提交 Form 144 通知之前的四个日历周内，我们 A 类普通股的周平均交易量。

paras.en: Sales of our Class A common stock made in reliance upon Rule 144 by our affiliates or persons selling shares of our Class A common stock on behalf of our affiliates are also subject to certain manner of sale provisions and notice requirements and to the availability of current public information about us.
paras.zh: 我们的关联方或代表我们关联方出售 A 类普通股的人士依据 Rule 144 进行的 A 类普通股出售，还须遵守某些出售方式规定和通知要求，以及关于我们的当前公开信息的可获得性要求。

paras.en: Rule 701 generally allows a stockholder who purchased shares of our capital stock pursuant to a written compensatory plan or contract and who is not deemed to have been an affiliate of our company during the immediately preceding 90 days to sell these shares in reliance upon Rule 144, but without being required to comply with the public information, holding period, volume limitation, or notice provisions of Rule 144. Rule 701 also permits affiliates of our company to sell their Rule 701 shares under Rule 144 without complying with the holding period requirements of Rule 144. All holders of Rule 701 shares, however, are required to wait until 90 days after the date of this prospectus before selling those shares pursuant to Rule 701.
paras.zh: 规则 701 通常允许依据书面补偿计划或合同购买我们股本股份、且在紧接前 90 天内不被视为我们公司关联方的股东，依据规则 144 出售该等股份，但无需遵守规则 144 的公开信息、持有期限、数量限制或通知规定。规则 701 亦允许我们公司的关联方依据规则 144 出售其规则 701 股份，而无需遵守规则 144 的持有期限要求。然而，所有规则 701 股份持有人均须等待至本招股说明书日期后 90 天，方可依据规则 701 出售该等股份。

paras.en: Pursuant to our IRA and the Google RRA, after the completion of this offering, the holders of up to [__] shares of our Class A common stock, or certain transferees, will be entitled to certain rights with respect to the registration of the offer and sale of those shares under the Securities Act. See the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Registration Rights” for a description of these registration rights. If the offer and sale of these shares of our Class A common stock are registered, the shares will be freely tradable without restriction under the Securities Act, subject to the Rule 144 limitations applicable to affiliates, and a large number of shares may be sold into the public market.
paras.zh: 根据我们的 IRA 和 Google RRA，本次发行完成后，最多 [__] 股 A 类普通股的持有人或某些受让人将有权就该等股份根据《证券法》进行要约和出售的登记享有某些权利。有关该等登记权的说明，请参见“股本说明——登记权”一节。如果该等 A 类普通股的要约和出售已登记，则该等股份将可在《证券法》下不受限制地自由交易，但须遵守适用于关联方的 Rule 144 限制，且大量股份可能被出售至公开市场。

paras.en: We intend to file one or more registration statements on Form S-8 under the Securities Act promptly after the effectiveness of this offering to register shares of our Class A common stock subject to RSUs and options outstanding, as well as reserved for future issuance, under our 2021 Plan, 2026 Plan, and ESPP, as well as the resale of certain shares of our Class A common stock previously issued under our 2021 Plan. Such registration statements on Form S-8 are expected to become effective immediately upon filing, and shares of our Class A common stock covered by such registration statements will then become eligible for sale in the public market, subject to applicable limitations under Rule 144, vesting restrictions, and any applicable market standoff agreements and lock-up agreements. See the section titled “Executive Compensation—Equity Plans” for a description of our equity compensation plans.
paras.zh: 我们拟于本次发行生效后尽快根据《证券法》提交一份或多份 S-8 表格注册声明，以登记根据我们 2021 年计划、2026 年计划和 ESPP 项下已发行在外的 RSU 和期权所对应的、以及预留供未来发行的 A 类普通股股份，并登记此前根据我们 2021 年计划发行的部分 A 类普通股股份的转售。该等 S-8 表格注册声明预计将在提交后立即生效，届时该等注册声明所涵盖的 A 类普通股股份将可在公开市场出售，但须遵守《144 规则》的适用限制、归属限制以及任何适用的市场禁售协议和锁定期协议。有关我们股权激励计划的说明，请参见“高管薪酬——股权计划”一节。

paras.en: The following is a summary of the material U.S. federal income tax consequences to certain non-U.S. holders (as defined below) of the ownership and disposition of our Class A common stock acquired in this offering but does not purport to be a complete analysis of all the potential tax considerations relating thereto. This summary is based upon the provisions of the Code, the Treasury regulations promulgated thereunder, administrative rulings, and judicial decisions, all as of the date hereof. These authorities may be changed, possibly retroactively, so as to result in U.S. federal income tax consequences different from those set forth below.
paras.zh: 以下概述了某些非美国持有人（定义见下文）就本招股说明书中购买的 A 类普通股的所有权和处置所涉及的重大美国联邦所得税后果，但并非旨在完整分析与此相关的所有潜在税务考量。本概述基于截至本文件日期有效的《税法》、据此颁布的财政部条例、行政裁定和司法判决。这些权威依据可能发生变化，且可能具有追溯效力，从而导致美国联邦所得税后果与下文所述不同。

paras.en: This summary does not address the tax considerations arising under the laws of any state, local, or non-U.S. jurisdiction, or under U.S. federal non-income tax laws (such as gift and estate tax laws), except to the limited extent set forth below. In addition, this discussion does not address tax considerations applicable to a non-U.S. holder’s particular circumstances or non-U.S. holders that may be subject to special tax rules, including, without limitation:
paras.zh: 本概述不涉及任何州、地方或非美国司法管辖区法律项下产生的税务考量，也不涉及美国联邦非所得税法律（如赠与税和遗产税法）项下产生的税务考量，但下文所述有限范围除外。此外，本讨论不涉及适用于非美国持有人特定情形或可能适用特殊税务规则的非美国持有人的税务考量，包括但不限于：

paras.en: - banks, insurance companies, or other financial institutions (except to the extent specifically set forth below), regulated investment companies, or real estate investment trusts;
paras.zh: - 银行、保险公司或其他金融机构（下文特别述及的范围除外）、受监管投资公司或房地产投资信托；

paras.en: - persons subject to the alternative minimum tax or Medicare contribution tax on net investment income;
paras.zh: - 需缴纳替代性最低税或净投资收入医疗保险税的人士；

paras.en: - tax-exempt organizations or governmental organizations;
paras.zh: - 免税组织或政府组织；

paras.en: - pension plans or tax-exempt retirement plans;
paras.zh: - 养老金计划或免税退休计划；

paras.en: - controlled foreign corporations, foreign controlled foreign corporations, passive foreign investment companies, and corporations that accumulate earnings to avoid U.S. federal income tax;
paras.zh: - 受控外国公司、外国受控外国公司、被动外国投资公司，以及为规避美国联邦所得税而累积收益的公司；

paras.en: - brokers or dealers in securities;
paras.zh: - 证券经纪商或交易商；

paras.en: - traders in securities or other persons that elect to use a mark-to-market method of accounting for their holdings in our stock;
paras.zh: - 证券交易商或选择对其持有的本公司股票采用按市值计价会计方法的其他人士；

paras.en: - persons that own, or are deemed to own, more than five percent of our capital stock (except to the extent specifically set forth below);
paras.zh: - 拥有或被视为拥有本公司股本超过百分之五的人士（下文特别述及的范围除外）;

paras.en: - certain former citizens or long-term residents of the United States;
paras.zh: - 某些美国前公民或长期居民；

paras.en: - partnerships or entities classified as partnerships for U.S. federal income tax purposes or other pass-through entities (and investors therein);
paras.zh: - 合伙企业或为美国联邦所得税目的被归类为合伙企业的实体或其他穿透实体（及其投资者）;

paras.en: - persons who hold our Class A common stock as a position in a hedging transaction, “straddle,” “conversion transaction,” or other risk reduction transaction or integrated investment;
paras.zh: - 通过套期保值交易、“跨式”交易、“转换交易”或其他风险降低交易或综合投资而持有我们 A 类普通股的人士；

paras.en: - persons who hold or receive our Class A common stock pursuant to the exercise of any employee stock option or otherwise as compensation;
paras.zh: - 因行使任何员工股票期权或以其他方式作为薪酬而持有或获得我们 A 类普通股的人士；

paras.en: - persons subject to special tax accounting rules as a result of any item of gross income with respect to our Class A common stock being taken into account in an “applicable financial statement” (as defined in Section 451(b) of the Code);
paras.zh: - 因与我们 A 类普通股相关的任何总收入项目在“适用财务报表”（定义见《税法》第 451(b)条）中予以确认而适用特殊税务会计规则的人士；

paras.en: - persons who do not hold our Class A common stock as a capital asset within the meaning of Section 1221 of the Code (generally, property held for investment); or
paras.zh: - 未将我们 A 类普通股作为《税法》第 1221 条所指资本资产（一般为持有用于投资的财产）持有的人士；或

paras.en: - persons deemed to sell our Class A common stock under the constructive sale provisions of the Code.
paras.zh: - 根据《税法》的推定出售条款被视为出售我们 A 类普通股的人士。

paras.en: In addition, if a partnership, arrangement, or entity classified as a partnership or other pass-through entity for U.S. federal income tax purposes holds our Class A common stock, the tax treatment of a partner in such partnership or owner in such pass-through entity generally will depend on the status of the partner or owner and upon the activities of the partnership or other pass-through entity. Accordingly, partnerships and other pass-through entities that hold our Class A common stock, and partners in such partnerships and owners in such other pass-through entities, should consult their tax advisors.
paras.zh: 此外，如果出于美国联邦所得税目的被归类为合伙企业或其它穿透实体的合伙企业、安排或实体持有我们 A 类普通股，则该合伙企业中的合伙人或该穿透实体中的权益持有人的税务处理通常将取决于该合伙人或权益持有人的身份以及该合伙企业或其它穿透实体的活动。因此，持有我们 A 类普通股的合伙企业和其他穿透实体，以及此类合伙企业中的合伙人和此类其他穿透实体中的权益持有人，应咨询其税务顾问。

paras.en: **This discussion is for informational purposes only and is not tax advice. You are urged to consult your tax advisor with respect to the application of the U.S. federal income tax laws to your particular situation, as well as any tax consequences of the purchase, ownership and disposition of our Class A common stock arising under the U.S. federal non-income tax laws (such as gift or estate tax laws) or under the laws of any state, local, non-U.S., or other taxing jurisdiction or under any applicable tax treaty.**
paras.zh: **本讨论仅供参考，不构成税务建议。我们敦促您就美国联邦所得税法对您特定情况的适用，以及购买、持有和处置我们 A 类普通股在美国联邦非所得税法（如赠与税或遗产税法）下、或在任何州、地方、非美国或其他征税管辖区法律下、或在任何适用税收协定下产生的任何税务后果，咨询您的税务顾问。**

paras.en: For purposes of this discussion, you are a non-U.S. holder if you are a beneficial owner of our Class A common stock that is not a partnership, arrangement, or entity classified as a partnership or other pass-through entity for U.S. federal income tax purposes and are not, for U.S. federal income tax purposes, treated as any of the following:
paras.zh: 就本讨论而言，如果您是我们 A 类普通股的受益所有人，且该受益所有人并非合伙企业、安排，或就美国联邦所得税目的被归类为合伙企业或其他穿透实体的实体，并且就美国联邦所得税目的未被视作以下任何一类，则您属于非美国持有人：

paras.en: - an individual who is a citizen or resident of the United States;
paras.zh: - 身为美国公民或居民的个人；

paras.en: - a corporation (or any other entity treated as a corporation for U.S. federal income tax purposes) created or organized in the United States or under the laws of the United States, any state thereof or the District of Columbia;
paras.zh: - 在美国或根据美国、其任何州或哥伦比亚特区法律设立或组织的公司（或就美国联邦所得税目的被视作公司的任何其他实体）；

paras.en: - an estate whose income is subject to U.S. federal income tax regardless of its source; or
paras.zh: - 其收入无论来源如何均须缴纳美国联邦所得税的遗产；或

paras.en: - a trust (x) whose administration is subject to the primary supervision of a U.S. court and which has one or more “United States persons” (within the meaning of Section 7701(a)(30) of the Code) (“U.S. persons”) who have the authority to control all substantial decisions of the trust or (y) which has made a valid election to be treated as a U.S. person.
paras.zh: - 一项信托：(x) 其管理受美国法院的主要监督，且有一名或多名“美国人”（定义见《税法》第 7701(a)(30) 条）（“美国人”）有权控制该信托的所有重大决策；或 (y) 已作出有效选择被视为美国人。

paras.en: Distributions on our Class A common stock will constitute dividends for U.S. federal income tax purposes to the extent paid from our current or accumulated earnings and profits, as determined under U.S. federal income tax principles. To the extent those distributions exceed both our current and our accumulated earnings and profits, the excess will constitute a return of capital and will first reduce your basis in our Class A common stock, but not below zero, and then will be treated as gain from the sale or other disposition of stock as described below under the section titled “—Gain on Disposition of Our Class A Common Stock.”
paras.zh: 我们 A 类普通股的分配，凡从我们根据美国联邦所得税原则确定的当期或累计收益及利润中支付的，将构成美国联邦所得税意义上的股息。若该等分配超过我们当期及累计收益及利润之和，超出部分将构成资本返还，首先冲减您在我们 A 类普通股中的计税基础，但不得低于零，其后将视为出售或以其他方式处置股票的收益，具体如下文“——我们 A 类普通股的处置收益”一节所述。

paras.en: Except as otherwise described below in the paragraph on effectively connected income and the sections titled “—Backup Withholding and Information Reporting” and “—FATCA,” any dividend paid to you will generally be subject to U.S. federal withholding tax either at a rate of 30% of the gross amount of the dividend or such lower rate as may be specified by an applicable income tax treaty between the United States and your country of residence. Under applicable Treasury regulations, the applicable withholding agent may withhold up to 30% of the gross amount of the entire distribution even if the amount constituting a dividend, as described above, is less than such amount. If we or another withholding agent over-withhold or if you do not timely provide us with the required certification, you may be entitled to a refund or credit of any excess amounts withheld by timely filing an appropriate claim with the Internal Revenue Service (“IRS”).
paras.zh: 除下文关于有效关联收入的段落以及“——备用预扣税与信息申报”和“——FATCA”两节另有规定外，向您支付的任何股息一般须缴纳美国联邦预扣税，税率为股息总额的 30%，或美国与您居住国之间适用的所得税条约所规定的较低税率。根据适用的财政部法规，适用的预扣义务人可就全部分配总额预扣最高 30%，即使如上所述构成股息的金额低于该数额。若我们或其他预扣义务人超额预扣，或您未及时向我们提供所需的证明，您可能有权就超额预扣的金额获得退税或抵免，前提是您及时向美国国税局（"IRS"）提交适当的申请。

paras.en: In order to receive a reduced treaty rate, you must provide the applicable withholding agent with an IRS Form W-8BEN, IRS Form W-8BEN-E, or other appropriate version of IRS Form W-8, including any required attachments and your taxpayer identification number, certifying qualification for the reduced rate. Additionally, you will be required to update such forms and certifications from time to time as required by law. If you are eligible for a reduced rate of U.S. withholding tax pursuant to an income tax treaty, you may obtain a refund of any excess amounts withheld by timely filing an appropriate claim for refund with the IRS. If you hold our stock through a financial institution or other agent acting on your behalf, you will be required to provide appropriate documentation to the agent, which then will be required to provide certification to us or our paying agent, either directly or through other intermediaries. You should consult your tax advisor regarding entitlement to benefits under any applicable income tax treaties.
paras.zh: 为享受条约规定的较低税率，您必须向适用的预扣义务人提供 IRS Form W-8BEN、IRS Form W-8BEN-E 或其他适当版本的 IRS Form W-8，包括任何所需附件及您的纳税人识别号，以证明符合较低税率的资格。此外，您须按法律要求不时更新该等表格和证明。若您根据所得税条约有资格享受较低的美国预扣税税率，您可通过及时向 IRS 提交适当的退税申请，就任何超额预扣的金额获得退税。若您通过金融机构或其他代表您的代理人持有我们的股票，您须向该代理人提供适当的文件，该代理人随后须直接或通过其他中介向我们或我们的付款代理人提供证明。您应就享受任何适用所得税条约项下优惠的资格咨询您的税务顾问。

paras.en: Dividends received by you that are effectively connected with your conduct of a U.S. trade or business (and, if required by an applicable income tax treaty, that are attributable to a permanent establishment or fixed base maintained by you in the United States) are generally exempt from such withholding tax, subject to the discussions below on backup withholding and FATCA (as defined below) withholding. To obtain this exemption, you must provide us with an IRS Form W-8ECI, including any required attachments and your taxpayer identification number, certifying qualification for the exemption. Additionally, you will be required to update such forms and certifications from time to time as required by law. Such effectively connected dividends, although not subject to U.S. federal withholding tax, are includable on your U.S. federal income tax return and taxed to you at the same rates applicable to U.S. persons, net of certain deductions and credits. If you are a corporate non-U.S. holder, dividends you receive that are effectively connected with your conduct of a U.S. trade or business may also be subject to a branch profits tax at a rate of 30% or such lower rate as may be specified by an applicable income tax treaty between the United States and your country of residence. You should consult your tax advisor regarding the application of tax treaties in light of your particular circumstances.
paras.zh: 您收到的、与您在美国开展贸易或业务有实际关联的股息（且若适用的所得税条约要求，归属于您在美国的常设机构或固定基地的股息）通常免于该预扣税，但须受下文关于备用预扣税和 FATCA（定义见下文）预扣税的讨论约束。为获得此项豁免，您必须向我们提供 IRS W-8ECI 表格，包括任何所需附件及您的纳税人识别号，以证明符合豁免资格。此外，您须按法律要求不时更新该等表格和证明。该等有实际关联的股息虽无需缴纳美国联邦预扣税，但须计入您的美国联邦所得税申报表，并按适用于美国人的相同税率向您征税，扣除某些扣除项和抵免额。若您为公司类非美国持有人，您收到的与您在美国开展贸易或业务有实际关联的股息还可能须缴纳分支机构利润税，税率为 30% 或美国与您居住国之间适用的所得税条约可能规定的较低税率。您应结合自身具体情况，就税收条约的适用咨询您的税务顾问。

full.sec: Gain on Disposition of Our Class A Common Stock
full.secZh: 处置本公司 A 类普通股的收益

paras.en: Except as otherwise described below in the sections titled “—Backup Withholding and Information Reporting,” and “—FATCA,” you will generally not be subject to U.S. federal income tax on any gain realized upon the sale or other disposition of our Class A common stock unless:
paras.zh: 除下文“—备用预扣税与信息申报”及“—FATCA”各节另有说明外，您就出售或以其他方式处置我们 A 类普通股所实现的任何收益，通常无需缴纳美国联邦所得税，除非：

paras.en: - the gain is effectively connected with your conduct of a U.S. trade or business (and, if required by an applicable income tax treaty, the gain is attributable to a permanent establishment or fixed base maintained by you in the United States);
paras.zh: - 该收益与您在美国开展的贸易或业务存在有效关联（且如适用所得税条约有要求，该收益归属于您在美国维持的常设机构或固定基地）；

paras.en: - you are a non-resident alien individual who is present in the United States for a period or periods aggregating 183 days or more during the calendar year in which the sale or other disposition occurs and certain other conditions are met; or
paras.zh: - 您为非居民外籍个人，在发生出售或其他处置的日历年内，在美国停留的期间累计达到 183 天或以上，且满足某些其他条件；或

paras.en: - our Class A common stock constitutes a United States real property interest by reason of our status as a “United States real property holding corporation” (“USRPHC”) for U.S. federal income tax purposes at any time within the shorter of the five-year period preceding your disposition of, or your holding period for, our Class A common stock, and, in the case where shares of our Class A common stock are regularly traded on an established securities market, you own, or are treated as owning, more than 5% of our Class A common stock at any time during the foregoing period.
paras.zh: - 由于我们在美国联邦所得税目的下属于“美国不动产控股公司”（“USRPHC”），我们的 A 类普通股构成美国不动产权益，且该认定发生在您处置我们 A 类普通股之前的五年期间或您持有我们 A 类普通股的持有期（以较短者为准）内的任何时点，并且，在我们 A 类普通股于成熟证券市场定期交易的情况下，您在上述期间内的任何时点拥有或被视同拥有超过 5%的我们 A 类普通股。

paras.en: Generally, a corporation is a USRPHC if the fair market value of its U.S. real property interests equals or exceeds 50% of the sum of the fair market value of its worldwide property interests and its other assets used or held for use in a trade or business (all as determined for U.S. federal income tax purposes). We believe that we are not currently and will not become a USRPHC for U.S. federal income tax purposes, and the remainder of this discussion so assumes, although, there can be no assurance in this regard. You are encouraged to consult your own tax advisor regarding the possible consequences to you if we are, or were to become, a USRPHC.
paras.zh: 一般而言，如果一家公司的美国不动产权益的公允市场价值等于或超过其全球财产权益的公允市场价值与其用于或持有用于贸易或业务的其他资产之和的 50%（均按美国联邦所得税目的确定），则该公司为 USRPHC。我们认为，我们目前不是、将来也不会成为美国联邦所得税目的下的 USRPHC，本讨论的其余部分亦作此假设，但对此无法作出保证。如果我们是或将成为 USRPHC，建议您就由此可能对您产生的后果咨询您自己的税务顾问。

paras.en: If you are a non-U.S. holder described in the first bullet above, you will generally be subject to U.S. federal income tax on the net gain derived from the sale under regular graduated U.S. federal income tax rates, and if you are a corporate non-U.S. holder described in the first bullet above, you also may be subject to the branch profits tax at a 30% rate, in each case unless otherwise provided by an applicable income tax treaty between the United States and your country of residence. If you are a non-U.S. holder described in the second bullet above, you will generally be subject to U.S. federal income tax at a 30% rate (or such lower rate specified by an applicable income tax treaty between the United States and your country of residence) on the gain derived from the sale or other disposition of our stock, which gain may be offset by certain U.S. source capital losses (provided you have timely filed U.S. federal income tax returns with respect to such losses). You should consult your tax advisor regarding the application of tax treaties in light of your particular circumstances.
paras.zh: 如果您属于上述第一项所述的非美国持有人，您通常需按美国联邦所得税常规累进税率就出售所得净收益缴纳美国联邦所得税；如果您属于上述第一项所述的公司型非美国持有人，您还可能需按 30%的税率缴纳分支机构利润税，除非美国与您居住国之间的适用所得税条约另有规定。如果您属于上述第二项所述的非美国持有人，您通常需就出售或以其他方式处置我们股票所实现的收益按 30%的税率（或美国与您居住国之间的适用所得税条约规定的较低税率）缴纳美国联邦所得税，该收益可用某些美国来源的资本损失予以抵销（前提是您已就此类损失及时申报美国联邦所得税申报表）。您应根据自身具体情况就税收条约的适用问题咨询您的税务顾问。

full.secZh: 备用预扣税与信息申报

paras.en: Generally, we must report annually to the IRS the amount of dividends paid to you, your name and address, and the amount of tax withheld, if any. A similar report will be sent to you. Pursuant to applicable income tax treaties or other agreements, the IRS may make these reports available to tax authorities in your country of residence.
paras.zh: 一般而言，我们必须每年向 IRS 报告向您支付的股息金额、您的姓名和地址以及预扣税款金额（如有）。类似报告也将发送给您。根据适用的所得税条约或其他协议，IRS 可能会向您居住国的税务机关提供这些报告。

paras.en: Payments of dividends on or of proceeds from the sale or other disposition of our Class A common stock made to you may be subject to information reporting and backup withholding (currently at a rate of 24%) unless you establish an exemption, for example, by properly certifying your non-U.S. status on an IRS Form W-8BEN, IRS Form W-8BEN-E, or another appropriate version of IRS Form W-8. Any documentation provided to an applicable withholding agent may need to be updated in certain circumstances.
paras.zh: 向您支付的 A 类普通股股息，或出售或以其他方式处置 A 类普通股所得款项，可能须遵守信息申报和备用预扣（目前税率为 24%），除非您确立豁免，例如通过在 IRS Form W-8BEN、IRS Form W-8BEN-E 或其他适当版本的 IRS Form W-8 上正确证明您的非美国身份。在某些情况下，向适用预扣代理人提供的任何文件可能需要更新。

paras.en: Information reporting and backup withholding will generally apply to the proceeds of a sale or other disposition by you of our Class A common stock effected by or through the U.S. office of any broker, U.S. or foreign, unless you certify your status as a non-U.S. holder and satisfy certain other requirements, or otherwise establish an exemption. Generally, information reporting and backup withholding will not apply to a payment of the proceeds from a sale or other disposition of our stock to you where the transaction is effected outside the United States through a foreign broker. However, for information reporting purposes, sales or other dispositions effected through a non-U.S. office of a broker with substantial U.S. ownership or operations will generally be treated in a manner similar to sales or other dispositions effected through a U.S. office of a broker. Notwithstanding the foregoing, backup withholding and information reporting may apply if either we or our paying agent has actual knowledge, or reason to know, that you are a U.S. person. You should consult your own tax advisors regarding the application of the information reporting and backup withholding rules in light of your particular circumstances.
paras.zh: 信息申报和备用预扣通常适用于由任何经纪商（美国或外国）的美国办事处或通过其美国办事处进行的、您出售或以其他方式处置我们 A 类普通股的所得款项，除非您证明您作为非美国持有人的身份并满足某些其他要求，或以其他方式确立豁免。一般而言，如果交易是通过外国经纪商在美国境外进行的，信息申报和备用预扣将不适用于向您支付的出售或以其他方式处置我们股票的所得款项。然而，就信息申报而言，通过拥有大量美国所有权或业务运营的经纪商的非美国办事处进行的销售或其他处置，通常将以类似于通过经纪商美国办事处进行的销售或其他处置的方式处理。尽管有上述规定，如果我们或我们的付款代理人实际知悉或有理由知悉您是美国人，则备用预扣和信息申报可能适用。您应根据您的具体情况，就信息申报和备用预扣规则的适用咨询您自己的税务顾问。

paras.en: Backup withholding is not an additional tax. Rather, the U.S. federal income tax liability of persons subject to backup withholding will be reduced by the amount of tax withheld. If withholding results in an overpayment of taxes, a refund or credit may generally be obtained from the IRS, provided that the required information is furnished to the IRS in a timely manner.
paras.zh: 备用预扣不是额外税款。相反，须遵守备用预扣的个人的美国联邦所得税负债将减去预扣的税款金额。如果预扣导致税款多缴，通常可以从 IRS 获得退款或抵免，前提是及时向 IRS 提供所需信息。

paras.en: Sections 1471 through 1474 of the Code, and the Treasury regulations and administrative guidance issued thereunder (collectively, “FATCA”), generally impose a U.S. federal withholding tax at a rate of 30% on dividends on and, subject to certain proposed Treasury regulations discussed below, the gross proceeds from a sale or other disposition of our Class A common stock if paid to a “foreign financial institution” (as defined in the Code), unless otherwise provided by the Treasury Secretary or such institution enters into an agreement with the U.S. government to withhold on certain payments and to collect and provide to the U.S. tax authorities substantial information regarding the U.S. account holders of such institution (which includes certain equity and debt holders of such institution, as well as certain account holders that are non-U.S. entities with U.S. owners) or otherwise establishes an exemption. FATCA also generally imposes a U.S. federal withholding tax of 30% on dividends paid on and, subject to certain proposed Treasury regulations discussed below, the gross proceeds from a sale or other disposition of our Class A common stock if paid to a “non-financial foreign entity” (as defined in the Code) unless otherwise provided by the Treasury Secretary or such entity provides the withholding agent with a certification identifying, and information with respect to certain direct and indirect “substantial United States owners” (as defined in the Code) of the entity, certifies that it does not have any such substantial United States owners or otherwise establishes and certifies to an exemption. The withholding provisions under FATCA generally apply to dividends on our Class A common stock. The Treasury Secretary has issued proposed regulations providing that the withholding provisions under FATCA do not apply with respect to the gross proceeds from a sale or other disposition of our Class A common stock, which may be relied upon by taxpayers until final regulations are issued. An intergovernmental agreement between the United States and your country of tax residence may modify the requirements described in this paragraph. You should consult your own tax advisors regarding the possible implications of FATCA on your investment in our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 《税法》第 1471 条至第 1474 条以及据此发布的财政部条例和行政指引（统称“FATCA”）通常对向我们 A 类普通股支付的股息，以及（在受限于下文讨论的某些拟议财政部条例的前提下）出售或以其他方式处置我们 A 类普通股所得的毛收入，按 30%的税率征收美国联邦预提税，前提是收款方为“外国金融机构”（《税法》所定义），除非财政部长另有规定，或该机构与美国政府签订协议，约定对某些付款进行预提，并向美国税务机关收集和提供有关该机构美国账户持有人的大量信息（该等持有人包括该机构的某些股权和债务持有人，以及某些由美国所有者拥有的非美国实体账户持有人），或另行确立豁免。FATCA 通常还对向我们 A 类普通股支付的股息，以及（在受限于下文讨论的某些拟议财政部条例的前提下）出售或以其他方式处置我们 A 类普通股所得的毛收入，按 30%的税率征收美国联邦预提税，前提是收款方为“非金融外国实体”（《税法》所定义），除非财政部长另有规定，或该实体向预提代理人提供证明，列明该实体某些直接和间接“美国重大所有者”（《税法》所定义）的身份及相关信息，证明其没有任何该等美国重大所有者，或另行确立并证明豁免。FATCA 项下的预提规定通常适用于我们 A 类普通股的股息。财政部长已发布拟议条例，规定 FATCA 项下的预提规定不适用于出售或以其他方式处置我们 A 类普通股所得的毛收入，纳税人在最终条例发布前可依赖该拟议条例。美国与您税务居民所在国之间的政府间协议可能会修改本段所述的要求。您应就 FATCA 对您投资我们 A 类普通股可能产生的影响咨询您自己的税务顾问。

paras.en: **This preceding discussion is for informational purposes only and is not tax advice. Each prospective investor should consult its own tax advisor regarding the particular U.S. federal, state, and local and non-U.S. tax consequences of purchasing, holding, and disposing of our Class A common stock, including the consequences of any proposed change in applicable laws.**
paras.zh: **上述讨论仅供参考，不构成税务建议。每位潜在投资者应就购买、持有和处置我们 A 类普通股所涉及的特定美国联邦、州和地方及非美国税务后果，包括适用法律任何拟议变更的后果，咨询其自己的税务顾问。**

paras.en: Our directors, officers, and the holders of substantially all of our capital stock and securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our capital stock have entered into market standoff agreements with us under which they have agreed that, subject to certain exceptions, for a period of 180 days after the date of this prospectus, they will not, without our prior written consent, sell, make any short sale of, loan, grant any option for the purchase of, or otherwise dispose of any of our securities, including securities issued or issuable upon the conversion, exercise, exchange, reclassification, or replacement of such securities. The underwriters have requested that these market standoff provisions apply in connection with this offering, and we have agreed in the underwriting agreement with the underwriters to enforce these market standoff provisions and similar restrictions during the period of up to 180 days after the date of this prospectus and not amend or waive any such restrictions without the prior written consent of the representatives, except any amendment or waiver of such restrictions to permit a Transfer (as defined below) of securities that would be permissible under the terms of a lock-up agreement as described below. This agreement to enforce these market standoff provisions does not apply to shares that would be subject to a lock-up period extending beyond 180 days after the date of this prospectus.
paras.zh: 我们的董事、高级管理人员以及几乎全部股本和可转换为股本或可行使或可交换为股本的证券的持有人已与我们签订市场禁售协议，根据该协议，除某些例外情况外，在本招股说明书日期后的 180 天内，未经我们事先书面同意，他们不会出售、进行任何卖空、出借、授予任何购买期权或以其他方式处置我们的任何证券，包括因该等证券的转换、行使、交换、重新分类或替换而发行或可发行的证券。承销商已要求这些市场禁售条款适用于本次发行，我们已在与承销商签订的承销协议中同意，在本招股说明书日期后最长 180 天的期间内执行这些市场禁售条款及类似限制，且未经代表事先书面同意，不会修改或豁免任何此类限制，但为允许以下所述锁定期协议条款下允许的证券转让（定义见下文）而对该等限制进行的任何修改或豁免除外。该等执行市场禁售条款的协议不适用于将受限于本招股说明书日期后超过 180 天锁定期的股份。

pursuant to our employee benefit plans described herein or the issuance by us of our common stock pursuant to our employee stock purchase plan described herein, (d) the filing by us of one or more registration statements with the SEC on Form S-8 or any successor form thereto with respect to securities granted or to be granted pursuant to any of our employee benefit plans or the employee stock purchase plan described herein, (e) facilitating the establishment or amendment of a trading plan on behalf of our stockholders, employees, officers, or directors pursuant to Rule 10b5-1 under the Exchange Act for the transfer of shares of our common stock; provided that (i) such plan does not provide for the transfer of our common stock during the company lock-up period (except to the extent otherwise allowed pursuant to the terms of a lock-up agreement) and (ii) to the extent a public announcement or filing under the Exchange Act, if any, is required of, or voluntarily made by, us regarding the establishment or amendment of such plan, such announcement or filing shall include a statement to the effect that no transfer of our common stock may be made under such plan during any lock-up period to which such stockholder, employee, officer, or director is bound, (f) facilitating sales of our common stock on behalf of our employees to satisfy the withholding taxes payable upon the vesting, exercise, or settlement of such employee’s equity awards pursuant to our employee benefit plans described herein, (g) the exchange or conversion (or other means by which shares of one class or series become another class or series) of any class or series of our capital stock for any other class or series of our capital stock, (h) the issuance by us of convertible notes or shares of common stock upon the conversion of convertible notes or Class N common stock issued or issuable under the note purchase agreements described herein, (i) the issuance by us of shares of common stock in connection with charitable donations or pursuant to our donation matching program as described herein, (j) the submission of a confidential registration statement in connection with the exercise of any registration rights described herein and any preparations related thereto, provided that such submission or preparations do not require or result in the public filing of a registration statement with the SEC or any other public announcement of such proposed registration by us or any third party during the company lock-up period (and no such filing, public announcement, or activity shall be voluntarily made or taken by us or any third party during the company lock-up period), and provided further that we must notify the underwriters in this offering prior to making any such submission, (k) the issuance of shares of Class F common stock and Class E common stock as described herein, (l) the issuance by us of shares of common stock in any private placement concurrent with this offering as described herein, and (m) the sale, exchange, or issuance of, or entry into an agreement to sell, exchange, or issue, our common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our common stock (including, without limitation, options, restricted stock, restricted stock units, or warrants) in connection with any acquisition of the equity interests or assets of any person, the acquisition by us or our subsidiaries by any means of any license, right to use, business, properties, assets, products, technologies, or person, in one or a series of transactions (whether by means of merger, stock or equity purchase, asset purchase, or otherwise), including pursuant to an employee benefit plan assumed by us in connection with such transaction, or in connection with joint ventures, commercial relationships or other strategic or collaborative corporate transactions or alliances, or any announcement or filing of a registration statement related thereto.
paras.zh: 上述限制不适用于：(a) 本次发行中出售的股份；(b) 我们因行使（包括任何净额行使）本招股说明书日期已发行并在本招股说明书中列明的期权或认股权证、限制性股票单位或类似股权奖励的归属与结算（包括任何净额结算），或证券的重分类、交换或转换而发行普通股；(c) 我们根据本招股说明书所述员工福利计划向员工、高级管理人员、董事、顾问或咨询人授予或发行，或由其行使或结算（以现金、我们普通股股份或其他方式）期权、股票增值权、限制性股票奖励、限制性股票单位、业绩股票奖励或任何其他类型的股权奖励或安排，或我们根据本招股说明书所述员工购股计划发行普通股；(d) 我们就根据本招股说明书所述任何员工福利计划或员工购股计划已授予或拟授予的证券向 SEC 提交一份或多份 S-8 表格注册声明或任何后续表格；(e) 代表我们的股东、员工、高级管理人员或董事，根据《交易法》第 10b5-1 条规则，为转让我们的普通股股份而协助设立或修订交易计划；但前提是 (i) 该计划未规定在公司锁定期内转让我们的普通股（除非锁定期协议条款另有允许），且 (ii) 若我们就该计划的设立或修订须根据《交易法》进行公告或备案（如有），或我们自愿作出该等公告或备案，则该公告或备案应包含一项声明，说明在该股东、员工、高级管理人员或董事受约束的任何锁定期内，不得根据该计划转让我们的普通股；(f) 代表我们的员工协助出售我们的普通股，以支付该员工股权奖励根据本招股说明书所述员工福利计划归属、行使或结算时应缴纳的预扣税；(g) 我们任何类别或系列股本交换或转换为任何其他类别或系列股本（或某一类别或系列股份成为另一类别或系列股份的其他方式）；(h) 我们发行可转换票据，或在转换根据本招股说明书所述票据购买协议已发行或可发行的可转换票据或 N 类普通股时发行普通股股份；(i) 我们因慈善捐赠或根据本招股说明书所述捐赠配捐计划发行普通股股份；(j) 就本招股说明书所述任何注册权的行使提交保密注册声明及任何相关准备工作，但前提是该等提交或准备工作不要求或不会导致在公司锁定期内由我们或任何第三方公开向 SEC 提交注册声明或就该拟议注册作出任何其他公开公告（且我们或任何第三方不得在公司锁定期内自愿作出或采取任何该等提交、公开公告或活动），并进一步前提是我们在作出任何该等提交前必须通知本次发行的承销商；(k) 发行本招股说明书所述 F 类普通股和 E 类普通股股份；(l) 我们在与本招股说明书所述本次发行同时进行的任何私募中发行普通股股份；以及 (m) 就收购任何人的股权或资产、我们或我们的子公司以任何方式收购任何许可、使用权、业务、财产、资产、产品、技术或人员（通过一项或一系列交易，无论是通过合并、股份或股权购买、资产购买或其他方式），包括根据我们就该交易承接的员工福利计划，或就合资企业、商业关系或其他战略或合作公司交易或联盟，出售、交换或发行我们的普通股或可转换为我们的普通股或可行使或可交换为我们的普通股的任何证券（包括但不限于期权、限制性股票、限制性股票单位或认股权证），或就此签订出售、交换或发行协议，或就此作出任何公告或提交注册声明。

paras.en: In addition to the market standoff agreements, our founders, directors, and officers, certain of our current and former employees and consultants, and certain of our other stockholders (including certain stockholders holding more than 0.5% of our fully diluted shares prior to this offering) have executed lock-up agreements that subject them to restrictions on Transfer (as defined below) in connection with this offering. The holders that executed lock-up agreements held approximately [__] % of our fully diluted shares immediately prior to this offering. For purposes of this description of the lock-up agreements, references to our “common stock” refer to our Class A common stock and Class N common stock. Pursuant to these lock-up agreements, such lock-up parties may not (and may not cause or direct any of their affiliates to), without the prior written consent of the representatives, on behalf of the underwriters: (a) offer, sell, contract to sell, pledge, grant any option, right, or warrant to purchase, purchase any option or contract to sell, lend, or otherwise transfer or dispose of any shares of our common stock, any options or warrants to purchase any shares of our common stock, or any securities convertible into, exchangeable for, or that represent the right to receive shares of our common stock (such shares of our common stock, options, rights, warrants, or other securities, and any shares of common stock issuable upon exercise, conversion, or exchange of any of the foregoing, collectively, the “lock-up securities”), including without limitation any such lock-up securities now owned or hereafter acquired by such lock-up party, (b) engage in any hedging or other transaction or arrangement (including, without limitation, any short sale, or the purchase or sale of, or entry into, any put or call option, or any combination thereof, forward, swap, or any other derivative transaction or instrument, however described or defined) which is designed to or which reasonably could be expected to lead to or result in a sale, loan, pledge, or other disposition (whether by such lock-up party or someone other than such lock-up party) or transfer of any of the economic consequences of ownership, in whole or in part, directly or indirectly, of any lock-up securities, whether any such transaction or arrangement (or instrument provided for thereunder) would be settled by delivery of our common stock or such other securities, in cash, or otherwise (for purposes of this section, any such sale, loan, pledge, or other disposition or transfer of economic consequences, a “Transfer”), (c) make any demand for or exercise any right with respect to the registration of any lock-up securities, or (d) otherwise publicly announce any intention to engage in or cause any action, activity, transaction, or arrangement described in clauses (a), (b), or (c) above; provided, however, in the case where the lock-up party is a founder, if such action, activity, transaction, or arrangement is otherwise permitted under the lock-up agreement, such founder may publicly announce such action, activity, transaction, or arrangement upon three business days prior written notice to the representatives and us. The restrictions on Transfer of the lock-up securities do not apply to the:
paras.zh: 除市场禁售协议外，我们的创始人、董事和高级管理人员、部分现任和前任员工及顾问，以及部分其他股东（包括在本发行前持有我们完全稀释股份超过 0.5% 的部分股东）已签署锁定期协议，使其在本发行中受到转让限制（定义见下文）。签署锁定期协议的持有人在本发行前立即持有我们约 [__]% 的完全稀释股份。就本锁定期协议描述而言，凡提及我们的“普通股”，均指我们的 A 类普通股和 N 类普通股。根据该等锁定期协议，未经承销商代表事先书面同意，该等锁定方不得（亦不得促使其任何关联方或指示其任何关联方）：(a) 要约、出售、订立出售合同、质押、授予任何购买期权、权利或认股权证、购买任何出售期权或合同、出借或以其他方式转让或处置我们普通股的任何股份、购买我们普通股任何股份的任何期权或认股权证，或任何可转换为、可交换为或代表有权收取我们普通股股份的证券（该等普通股股份、期权、权利、认股权证或其他证券，以及因行使、转换或交换前述任何证券而可发行的任何普通股股份，统称“锁定证券”），包括但不限于该锁定方目前拥有或此后获得的任何该等锁定证券；(b) 进行任何对冲或其他交易或安排（包括但不限于任何卖空，或购买或出售、或订立任何看跌或看涨期权，或其任何组合、远期、掉期或任何其他衍生交易或工具，无论其如何描述或定义），该等交易或安排旨在或合理预期会导致或产生对任何锁定证券的全部或部分所有权经济权益的出售、借贷、质押或其他处置（无论由该锁定方或该锁定方以外的他人进行）或转让，无论任何该等交易或安排（或其项下规定的工具）是否将通过交付我们普通股或该等其他证券、现金或其他方式结算（就本节而言，任何该等出售、借贷、质押或其他处置或经济权益转让，均称为“转让”）；(c) 就任何锁定证券的登记提出任何要求或行使任何权利；或 (d) 以其他方式公开宣布任何从事或促使采取上述 (a)、(b) 或 (c) 项所述任何行动、活动、交易或安排的意图；但若锁定方为创始人，且该等行动、活动、交易或安排根据锁定期协议另行获准，则该创始人可在向承销商代表和我们发出三个营业日事先书面通知后公开宣布该等行动、活动、交易或安排。对锁定证券的转让限制不适用于：

[__] 锁定期方转让锁定证券：(i) 因遗嘱、遗嘱文件或无遗嘱继承而在死亡时转让；(ii) 若锁定期方为自然人，可转让给锁定期方的任何直系亲属、其他受抚养人，或为锁定期方或锁定期方直系亲属或其他受抚养人的直接或间接利益而设立的信托、公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司或其他实体，或就我们的创始人而言，可转让给任何慈善组织，或者，若锁定期方为信托，可转让给该信托的委托人、受托人或受益人，或该信托的委托人、受托人或受益人的遗产；(iii) 转让给锁定期方及锁定期方直系亲属为全部已发行股权证券或类似权益的法定和实益拥有人的公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司或其他实体；(iv) 转让给根据上文第 (a)(i) 至 (iii) 条允许进行处置或转让的人或实体的代名人或托管人；(v) 若锁定期方为公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司、信托或其他商业实体，(A) 转让给作为锁定期方关联方的另一公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司、信托或其他商业实体，或转让给任何投资基金或其他实体，该基金或实体控制、受控于、管理、受管理于、提供咨询或接受咨询、提供次级咨询或接受次级咨询，或以其他方式与锁定期方或锁定期方的关联方处于共同控制之下，或 (B) 作为锁定期方向其股东、现任或前任合伙人、成员、经理、受益人或其他股权持有人，或向其关联方的该等股东、合伙人、成员、经理、受益人或其他股权持有人的遗产进行分配、转让或其他处置的一部分；(vi) 依法律运作而转让，例如依据合格家庭关系令、离婚和解协议、离婚判决、分居协议或法院或监管机构的其他命令；(vii) 在我们或我们任何直接或间接子公司的任何员工或服务提供者死亡、丧失工作能力或终止雇佣（包括主动辞职）时，由该员工或服务提供者向我们转让；(viii) 若锁定期方并非我们的高级管理人员或董事，则与转让锁定期方通过以下方式取得的普通股股份有关：(A) 在本发行中从承销商处取得，或 (B) 在本发行交割日之后在公开市场交易中取得；(ix) 与锁定期方依据就本发行拟订立的承销协议向承销商出售 A 类普通股股份有关；(x) 向我们转让，以配合限制性股票单位、期权、认股权证、交换权、转换权或其他购买或以其他方式取得普通股股份的权利的归属、结算或行使（在每种情况下包括通过“净额”或“无现金”行使、结算或类似程序），该等权利已归属、将归属或计划在适用的锁定期内到期或自动归属，包括为履行因该等限制性股票单位、期权、认股权证、交换权、转换权或其他权利的授予、归属、结算或行使而产生的任何纳税义务（包括预扣税和预估纳税义务）或应缴汇款而向我们进行的任何转让，或与可转换证券的转换有关的转让，本第 (x) 条的所有此类情形均依据股票激励计划、长期激励计划或其他股权奖励计划或安排授予的股权奖励，或依据可转换或可交换证券的条款（如适用），均如本文所述，但锁定期方在此类归属、结算、行使或转换时收到的任何证券必须受锁定期协议条款的约束；(xi) 在锁定期方为创始人、董事、高级管理人员或现任或前任员工或顾问的情况下，通过“卖出补足”或类似的公开市场交易产生该等金额的现金，以履行因限制性股票单位、期权、认股权证、交换权、转换权或其他权利的授予、归属、结算或行使，或与可转换证券或其他权利的转换有关的任何行权价或纳税义务（包括预扣税和预估纳税义务）或应付款项（包括预付款项），本第 (xi) 条的所有此类情形均依据股票激励计划、长期激励计划或其他股权奖励计划或安排授予的股权奖励，均如本文所述，但锁定期方在实施本条规定后保留的任何证券必须受锁定期协议条款的约束；(xii) 转让给任何第三方质权人，作为善意交易中的抵押品，以担保该第三方（或其关联方或指定人）与锁定期方和/或其关联方之间的贷款或类似融资安排项下的义务，或者在锁定期方为创始人的情况下，转让给其遗产规划工具，或在其他情况下与锁定期方和/或其关联方或遗产规划工具（如适用）为允许该质权人通过出售、转让、挪用或以其他方式处置锁定证券来强制执行其在该安排项下的担保权益而采取的任何行动有关，但该安排不得是为导致或合理预期会导致对锁定证券所有权的任何经济后果进行处置或转让而设计的对冲交易或安排（包括任何卖空、看跌期权、看涨期权、远期、互换、预付可变远期或其他衍生工具，无论其如何描述或定义），且不得是实施此类对冲的计划的一部分；或 (xiii) 作为一项或多项善意赠与或慈善捐赠（锁定期方为并非创始人、董事或高级管理人员的现任或前任员工或顾问的情形除外），或者在锁定期方为创始人的情况下，为善意的遗产规划目的而转让；

paras.en: provided that (A) in the case of clauses (a)(i), (ii), (iii), (iv), (v), and, solely with respect to bona fide gifts or charitable contributions, (xiii) above, such transfer or distribution must not involve a disposition for value, (B) in the case of clauses (a)(i), (ii), (iii), (iv), (v), (vi), (xii), and (xiii) above, it is a condition to the transfer or distribution that the donee, devisee, transferee, pledgee, or distributee, as the case may be, must sign and deliver a lock-up agreement, (C) where the lock-up party is not a founder, in the case of clauses (a)(ii), (iii), (iv), and (v) above, no filing by any party (including, without limitation, any donor, donee, devisee, transferor, transferee, distributor, or distributee) under the Exchange Act or other public filing, report, or announcement reporting a reduction in beneficial ownership of lock-up securities must be required or must be voluntarily made in connection with such transfer or distribution (other than any required Form 5 filing), and (D) in the case of clauses (a)(i), (vi), (vii), (viii), (ix), (x), (xi), (xii), and (xiii), or in the case where the lock-up party is a founder, clauses (a)(i), (ii), (iii), (iv), (v), (vi), (vii), (viii), (ix), (x), (xi), (xii), and (xiii), above, no filing under the Exchange Act or other public filing, report, or announcement reporting a reduction in beneficial ownership of lock-up securities must be voluntarily made in connection with such transfer, and if any such filing, report, or announcement reporting a reduction in beneficial ownership of lock-up securities is legally required in connection with such transfer during the applicable lock-up period, such filing, report, or announcement must clearly indicate in the footnotes thereto (x) the circumstances of such transfer or distribution, and (y) in the case of a transfer or distribution pursuant to clauses (a)(i), (vi), or (xiii), or in the case where the lock-up party is a founder, clauses (a)(i), (ii), (iii), (iv), (v), (vi), or (xiii), above, that the donee, devisee, transferee, or distributee has agreed to be bound by a lock-up agreement;
paras.zh: 前提是：(A) 就第(a)(i)、(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)项以及仅就善意赠与或慈善捐赠而言的第(xiii)项而言，该等转让或分配不得涉及有偿处置；(B) 就第(a)(i)、(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)、(vi)、(xii)和(xiii)项而言，受赠人、受遗赠人、受让人、质权人或受分配人（视情况而定）必须签署并交付锁定期协议，此为转让或分配的一项条件；(C) 若锁定期一方并非创始人，则就第(a)(ii)、(iii)、(iv)和(v)项而言，任何一方（包括但不限于任何赠与人、受赠人、受遗赠人、转让人、受让人、分配人或受分配人）不得被要求根据《交易法》提交任何文件或其他公开备案、报告或公告以报告锁定期证券实益所有权的减少，也不得就该等转让或分配自愿作出该等备案、报告或公告（任何必需的 Form 5 备案除外）；以及(D) 就第(a)(i)、(vi)、(vii)、(viii)、(ix)、(x)、(xi)、(xii)和(xiii)项而言，或若锁定期一方为创始人，则就第(a)(i)、(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)、(vi)、(vii)、(viii)、(ix)、(x)、(xi)、(xii)和(xiii)项而言，不得根据《交易法》提交任何文件或其他公开备案、报告或公告以报告锁定期证券实益所有权的减少，也不得就该等转让自愿作出该等备案、报告或公告；且若在适用的锁定期内就该等转让依法须提交任何报告锁定期证券实益所有权减少的备案、报告或公告，则该等备案、报告或公告必须在其脚注中明确说明：(x) 该等转让或分配的情形，以及(y) 就依据第(a)(i)、(vi)或(xiii)项进行的转让或分配而言，或若锁定期一方为创始人，则就第(a)(i)、(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)、(vi)或(xiii)项而言，受赠人、受遗赠人、受让人或受分配人已同意受锁定期协议约束。

paras.en: b. [__] entry into or amendment of a written plan meeting the requirements of Rule 10b5-1 under the Exchange Act relating to the Transfer of the lock-up securities of the lock-up party, if then permitted by us, provided that none of the securities subject to such plan may be Transferred until after the expiration of the applicable lock-up period, except, in the case of our founders, non-founder directors and officers, and current and former employees and consultants, as otherwise permitted by the applicable lock-up agreement, and no public filing, report, or announcement under the Exchange Act, or any other public filing, report, or announcement, must be voluntarily made (whether by or on behalf of the lock-up party, us, or any other party) regarding, or that otherwise discloses, the establishment or amendment of such plan during the applicable lock-up period, and if any such filing, report, or announcement is legally required during the applicable lock-up period, such filing, report, or announcement must clearly indicate that none of the securities subject to such plan may be Transferred pursuant to such plan until after the expiration of the applicable lock-up period, except, in the case of our founders, non-founder directors and officers, and current and former employees and consultants, as otherwise permitted by the applicable lock-up agreement;
paras.zh: b. [__] 订立或修订符合《交易法》第 10b5-1 规则要求的书面计划，涉及锁定期一方转让锁定期证券，前提是当时经我们允许，但该计划所涉证券在适用的锁定期届满前不得转让，惟就我们的创始人、非创始人董事及高级管理人员以及现任和前任员工及顾问而言，适用锁定期协议另有允许的除外，且锁定期一方、我们或任何其他方均不得在适用锁定期内就该计划的设立或修订自愿作出任何《交易法》项下的公开申报、报告或公告，或任何其他公开申报、报告或公告，或以其他方式披露该计划的设立或修订，且若在适用锁定期内法律要求作出任何该等申报、报告或公告，该等申报、报告或公告必须明确表明该计划所涉证券在适用锁定期届满前不得依据该计划转让，惟就我们的创始人、非创始人董事及高级管理人员以及现任和前任员工及顾问而言，适用锁定期协议另有允许的除外；

paras.en: c. [__] (i) Transfer by the lock-up party of the lock-up securities pursuant to a bona fide third-party tender offer, merger, consolidation, or other similar transaction that is approved by our board of directors and made to all our holders of capital stock involving a change of control, provided that in the event that such tender offer, merger, consolidation, or other similar transaction is not completed, the lock-up securities must remain subject to the lock-up restrictions, and (ii) entry into any lock-up, voting, or similar agreement pursuant to which the lock-up party may agree to transfer, sell, tender, or otherwise dispose of shares of common stock or such other securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for common stock in connection with a transaction described in clause (i) above;
paras.zh: c. [__] (i) 锁定期一方依据经我们董事会批准、向我们全体股本持有人作出且涉及控制权变更的善意第三方要约收购、合并、兼并或其他类似交易转让锁定期证券，惟若该要约收购、合并、兼并或其他类似交易未能完成，锁定期证券仍须受锁定期限制约束，以及 (ii) 订立任何锁定期、投票或类似协议，据此锁定期一方可同意就上述第 (i) 项所述交易转让、出售、要约出售或以其他方式处置普通股股份或可转换为普通股或可行使或可交换为普通股的其他证券；

paras.en: d. [__] Transfer by the lock-up party of the lock-up securities to us in connection with (i) the conversion of our outstanding shares of preferred stock into shares of common stock in connection with the consummation of this offering, or (ii) the conversion, reclassification, redemption, or exchange of any shares of any class of common stock or lock-up securities into shares of another class of common stock or lock-up securities, provided that any such shares of common stock or lock-up securities received upon such conversion, reclassification, redemption, or exchange pursuant to clause (i) or (ii) must be subject to the terms of a lock-up agreement; and
paras.zh: d. [__] 锁定期一方向我们转让锁定期证券，涉及 (i) 与本发售完成相关的我们已发行优先股股份转换为普通股股份，或 (ii) 任何类别的普通股或锁定期证券的任何股份转换、重分类、赎回或交换为另一类别的普通股或锁定期证券的股份，惟依据第 (i) 或 (ii) 项在该等转换、重分类、赎回或交换时收到的任何该等普通股股份或锁定期证券须受锁定期协议条款约束；以及

paras.en: e. [__] exercise of any option to purchase any lock-up securities pursuant to any of our or our subsidiaries’ stock incentive plan, long-term incentive plan, stock purchase plan, or other equity award plan or arrangement, each as described herein, on a cash basis, and the receipt by the lock-up party from us of lock-up securities upon such exercise, provided that the underlying lock-up securities must be subject to the terms of a lock-up agreement.
paras.zh: e. [__] 以现金方式行使根据我们或我们子公司的任何股权激励计划、长期激励计划、股票购买计划或其他股权奖励计划或安排（均如本文所述）购买任何锁定期证券的任何期权，且锁定期方在该等行使后从我们处收到锁定期证券，前提是该等基础锁定期证券须受锁定期协议条款的约束。

paras.en: Our non-founder directors, officers, and certain current or former employees or consultants of ours have agreed with the underwriters, or are bound by market standoff agreements with us for the benefit of the underwriters, such that all of the lock-up securities owned by them are subject to the restrictions described above until the earlier to occur of (x) 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the Q1 Earnings Release Date or (y) immediately after the close of the trading day on the 180th Day, subject to specified early expiration provisions as follows:
paras.zh: 我们的非创始人董事、高管以及本公司若干现任或前任员工或顾问已与承销商达成协议，或受其与本公司为承销商利益签订的市场禁售协议约束，以致其持有的全部锁定期证券均受上述限制约束，直至以下较早发生者：(x) 第一季度财报发布日之后第二个完整交易日的美国东部时间上午 6:00，或 (y) 第 180 日交易日收盘后立即生效，但须遵守下述特定提前到期条款：

paras.en: a. [__] on or after the commencement of trading of our Class A common stock on the first trading day following the date of this prospectus, up to 10% of the aggregate number of lock-up securities held by such lock-up parties as of the last day of the month preceding the month of the date of this prospectus may be Transferred; and
paras.zh: a. [__] 在本招股说明书日期之后第一个交易日我们的 A 类普通股开始交易之时或之后，该等锁定期方截至本招股说明书日期所在月份前一个月最后一日所持锁定期证券总数的至多 10% 可被转让；以及

paras.en: b. [__] on or after 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the public release of our annual financial results (which for this purpose does not include “flash” numbers or preliminary, partial earnings) for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 (the date of such public release, the “FY26 Earnings Release Date”), up to an additional 35% of lock-up securities held by such lock-up parties as of the last day of the month preceding the month of the date of this prospectus may be Transferred.
paras.zh: b. [__] 在截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日止财政年度的年度财务业绩（就此目的而言不包括“快报”数字或初步、部分业绩）公开发布之后第二个完整交易日的美国东部时间上午 6:00 或之后（该公开发布日期，即“FY26 财报发布日”），该等锁定期方截至本招股说明书日期所在月份前一个月最后一日所持锁定期证券的至多额外 35% 可被转让。

paras.en: Certain of our stockholders have agreed with the underwriters, or are bound by market standoff agreements with us for the benefit of the underwriters, such that all of the lock-up securities owned by them are subject to the restrictions described above until the earlier to occur of (x) 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the Q1 Earnings Release Date or (y) immediately after the close of the trading day on the 180th Day, subject to specified early expiration provisions as follows:
paras.zh: 我们的若干股东已与承销商达成协议，或受其为承销商利益而与我们签订的市场禁售协议约束，以致其拥有的全部锁定期证券均受上述限制约束，直至以下两者中较早发生者：(x) 第一季度财报发布日之后第二个完整交易日的东部时间上午 6:00，或 (y) 第 180 日交易日收盘后立即生效，但须遵守下述特定的提前到期条款：

[__] on or after 6:00 AM Eastern Time on each of the dates that are 27 and 48 days, respectively, after the date of this prospectus, up to 6% of the aggregate number of lock-up securities held by such lock-up parties as of the date that is seven days prior to the date of this prospectus may be Transferred;
paras.zh: a. [__] 在本招股说明书日期之后第 27 日和 48 日（分别）的美国东部时间上午 6:00 或之后，该等锁定期方截至本招股说明书日期前七日所持锁定期证券总数的至多 6% 可被转让；

paras.en: b. [__] on or after 6:00 AM Eastern Time on each of the dates that are 62 and 76 days, respectively, after the date of this prospectus, up to an additional 7% of the aggregate number of lock-up securities held by such lock-up parties as of the date that is seven days prior to the date of this prospectus may be Transferred;
paras.zh: b. [__] 在本招股说明书日期之后第 62 日和 76 日（分别）的美国东部时间上午 6:00 或之后，该等锁定期方截至本招股说明书日期前七日所持锁定期证券总数的至多额外 7% 可被转让；

paras.en: c. [__] on or after 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the FY26 Earnings Release Date, up to an additional 12.5% of the aggregate number of lock-up securities held by such lock-up parties as of the date that is seven days prior to the date of this prospectus may be Transferred; and
paras.zh: c. [__] 在 FY26 财报发布日之后第二个完整交易日上午 6:00（美国东部时间）或之后，该等锁定方截至本招股说明书日期前七日所持锁定证券总数中最多可额外转让 12.5%；以及

paras.en: d. [__] on or after 6:00 AM Eastern Time on each of the dates that are 13, 27, 41, 55, and 69 days, respectively, after the FY26 Earnings Release Date, up to an additional 9.5% of the aggregate number of lock-up securities held by such lock-up parties as of the date that is seven days prior to the date of this prospectus may be Transferred.

Among the factors to be considered in determining the initial public offering price, in addition to prevailing market conditions, will be our historical performance, estimates of our and our industry’s business potential and earnings prospects, an assessment of our management, and the consideration of the above factors in relation to market valuation of companies in related businesses.

paras.en: In order to facilitate the offering of our Class A common stock, Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, acting as stabilization agent on behalf of the underwriters, may engage in transactions that stabilize, maintain, or otherwise affect the price of our Class A common stock. Specifically, the underwriter may sell more shares of Class A common stock than the underwriters are obligated to purchase under the underwriting agreement, creating a short position. A short sale is covered if the short position is no greater than the number of shares available for purchase under the over-allotment option. The underwriter can close out a covered short sale by exercising the over-allotment option or purchasing shares in the open market. In determining the source of shares to close out a covered short sale, the underwriter will consider, among other things, the open market price of our Class A common stock compared to the price available under the over-allotment option. The underwriter may also sell shares of Class A common stock in excess of the over-allotment option, creating a naked short position. The underwriter must close out any naked short position by purchasing shares of Class A common stock in the open market. A naked short position is more likely to be created if the underwriter is concerned that there may be downward pressure on the price of our Class A common stock in the open market after pricing that could adversely affect investors who purchase shares of Class A common stock in this offering.
paras.zh: 为便利我们 A 类普通股的发行，Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC 作为承销商的稳定市场代理人，可能从事稳定、维持或以其他方式影响我们 A 类普通股价格的交易。具体而言，承销商可能出售超过其在承销协议项下有义务购买的 A 类普通股数量，从而形成空头头寸。如果空头头寸不超过超额配售选择权项下可供购买的股份数量，则该卖空为补平卖空。承销商可通过行使超额配售选择权或在公开市场购买股份来平仓补平卖空。在确定平仓补平卖空的股份来源时，承销商将考虑（其中包括）我们 A 类普通股的公开市场价格与超额配售选择权项下可用的价格之间的比较。承销商还可能出售超过超额配售选择权数量的 A 类普通股，形成裸空头头寸。承销商必须通过在公开市场购买 A 类普通股来平仓任何裸空头头寸。如果承销商担心定价后我们 A 类普通股在公开市场可能面临下行压力，从而可能对在本次发行中购买 A 类普通股的投资者产生不利影响，则更可能形成裸空头头寸。

paras.en: As an additional means of facilitating this offering, the underwriter may bid for, and purchase, shares of Class A common stock in the open market to stabilize the price of our Class A common stock. These activities may raise or maintain the market price of our Class A common stock above independent market levels or prevent or slow a decline in the market price of our Class A common stock. The underwriter is not required to engage in these activities and may end any of these activities at any time.
paras.zh: 作为促进本次发行的额外手段，承销商可在公开市场竞购并买入 A 类普通股，以稳定我们 A 类普通股的价格。该等活动可能使我们的 A 类普通股的市场价格高于独立市场水平，或阻止或减缓我们 A 类普通股市场价格的下跌。承销商无义务从事该等活动，并可随时终止任何该等活动。

paras.en: The underwriters and their respective affiliates are full service financial institutions engaged in various activities, which may include sales and trading, commercial and investment banking, advisory, investment management, investment research, principal investment, hedging, market making, brokerage, and other financial and non-financial activities and services. Certain of the underwriters and their respective affiliates have provided, and may in the future provide, a variety of these services to us and to persons and entities with relationships with us, such as our executive officers, co-founders, and directors, for which they received or will receive customary fees and expenses. paras.en: In addition, in the ordinary course of their various business activities, the underwriters and their respective affiliates, officers, directors, and employees may purchase, sell, or hold a broad array of investments and actively trade securities, derivatives, loans, commodities, currencies, credit default swaps, and other financial instruments for their own account and for the accounts of their customers, and such investment and trading activities may involve or relate to assets, securities, and/or instruments of us or our affiliates (directly, as collateral securing other obligations or otherwise). The underwriters and their respective affiliates may also make independent investment recommendations, market color or trading ideas, and/or publish or express independent research views in respect of such assets, securities, or instruments, and may at any time hold, or recommend to clients that they should acquire, long and/or short positions in such assets, securities, and instruments.
paras.zh: 此外，在其各项业务活动的日常过程中，承销商及其各自的关联方、高级管理人员、董事和员工可能为其自身账户及客户账户购买、出售或持有种类广泛的投资，并积极交易证券、衍生品、贷款、大宗商品、货币、信用违约互换及其他金融工具，且该等投资和交易活动可能涉及或关联到我们或我们关联方的资产、证券和/或工具（直接持有、作为其他义务的担保或其他方式）。承销商及其各自的关联方还可能就该等资产、证券或工具作出独立的投资建议、提供市场观点或交易思路，和/或发布或表达独立的研究观点，并可能随时持有或建议客户获取该等资产、证券和工具的多头和/或空头头寸。

paras.en: #### Brazil

The trading of the shares of Class A common stock on regulated securities markets in Brazil is prohibited.

paras.zh: 本招股说明书发售的 A 类普通股股份未在证券登记处（Registro de Valores）登记，亦不受智利证券和保险监管局（Superintendencia de Valores y Seguros de Chile）的监管。本招股说明书及与 A 类普通股股份发售相关的其他发售材料，不构成在智利共和国对 A 类普通股股份的公开发售或认购或购买邀请，但依据《智利证券市场法》（Ley de Mercado de Valores）第 4 条含义范围内的私募发行向个别确定的购买人作出的除外（即并非“面向公众整体或公众某一行业或特定群体”的要约）。

paras.en: The shares of Class A common stock have not been and will not be registered with the Colombian National Registry of Securities and Issuers (Registro Nacional de Valores y Emisores - RNVE) maintained by the Financial Superintendence of Colombia (Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; the “SFC”) and, therefore, the shares of Class A common stock may not be publicly offered or delivered in Colombia. However, the shares of Class A common stock may be offered in Colombia under Colombian law pursuant to the private placement exemption set forth in the Colombian regulation (Decree 2555 of 2010), in accordance with which an offering shall be deemed a private placement if it is addressed to fewer than one hundred (100) specific persons (article 6.1.1.1.1, Decree 2555 of 2010). These materials are solely our responsibility and have not been reviewed or authorized by the SFC and may not be publicly distributed in Colombia. In making an investment decision, all investors, including any Colombian investor who may acquire shares of our Class A common stock from time to time, must rely on their own examination of the terms of the offering and shares of our Class A common stock, including the merits and risks involved.
paras.zh: A 类普通股股份未曾且将不会在哥伦比亚金融监管局（Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia，简称“SFC”）维护的哥伦比亚国家证券与发行人登记处（Registro Nacional de Valores y Emisores - RNVE）登记，因此，A 类普通股股份不得在哥伦比亚公开发行或交付。但是，依据哥伦比亚法规（2010 年第 2555 号法令）规定的私募豁免，A 类普通股股份可依哥伦比亚法律在哥伦比亚发行，根据该规定，若发行对象少于一百(100)名特定人士，则该发行应被视为私募（2010 年第 2555 号法令第 6.1.1.1.1 条）。本材料仅由我们承担责任，未经 SFC 审阅或批准，且不得在哥伦比亚公开分发。在作出投资决策时，所有投资者，包括可能不时购买我们 A 类普通股股份的任何哥伦比亚投资者，必须依赖其自身对本次发行条款及我们 A 类普通股股份的审查，包括其中的优点和风险。

paras.en: (a) to any person which is a qualified investor as defined under Article 2 of the Prospectus Regulation;
paras.zh: (a) 向《招股说明书条例》第 2 条所定义的任何合格投资者发售；

paras.en: (b) to fewer than 150 natural or legal persons (other than qualified investors as defined in the Prospectus Regulation), subject to obtaining the prior consent of the underwriters for any such offer; or

paras.zh: (c) 属于《招股说明书条例》第 1(4)条规定的任何其他情形，前提是任何该等 A 类普通股发售均不要求本公司或任何承销商依据《招股说明书条例》第 3 条发布招股说明书或依据《招股说明书条例》第 23 条补充招股说明书，且每位初始取得任何股份或获邀参与任何发售的人士将被视为已向各代表及本公司陈述、确认并同意，其属于《招股说明书条例》所定义的“合格投资者”。

paras.en: In the case of any shares of Class A common stock being offered to a financial intermediary as that term is used in Article 5 of the Prospectus Regulation, each such financial intermediary will be deemed to have represented, acknowledged, and agreed that the shares acquired by it in the offer have not been acquired on a nondiscretionary basis on behalf of, nor have they been acquired with a view to their offer or resale to, persons in circumstances which may give rise to an offer of any shares of Class A common stock to the public other than their offer or resale in a Member State to qualified investors as so defined or in circumstances in which the prior consent of the representatives has been obtained to each such proposed offer or resale. The company, the underwriters and their affiliates, and others will rely upon the truth and accuracy of the foregoing representation, warranty, and agreement.
paras.zh: 就向《招股说明书条例》第 5 条所指的金融中介机构发售任何 A 类普通股的情形而言，各该等金融中介机构将被视为已陈述、确认并同意，其在发售中取得的股份并非以非自主方式代表他人取得，亦非以向可能致使任何 A 类普通股向公众发售的情形下的人士发售或转售为目的而取得，但其在成员国向上述定义的合格投资者发售或转售，或已就每项该等拟议发售或转售取得各代表事先同意的情形除外。本公司、承销商及其关联方以及其他人士将依赖上述陈述、保证及协议的属实与准确。

paras.en: For the purposes of this provision, the expression an “offer to the public” in relation to any shares of Class A common stock in any Member State means the communication in any form and by means of sufficient information on the terms of the offer and the shares of Class A common stock to be offered so as to enable an investor to decide to purchase shares of Class A common stock, and the expression “Prospectus Regulation” means Regulation (EU) 2017/1129 (as amended).
paras.zh: 就本条款而言，在任何成员国与任何 A 类普通股相关的“向公众发售”一词，指以任何形式并通过提供有关发售条款及拟发售 A 类普通股的充分信息进行沟通，以使投资者能够决定购买 A 类普通股；“《招股说明书条例》”一词指经修订的（EU）2017/1129 号条例。

paras.en: #### Israel
paras.zh: #### 以色列

paras.en: In the State of Israel this prospectus shall not be regarded as an offer to the public to purchase shares of Class A common stock under the Israeli Securities Law, 5728-1968, which requires a prospectus to be published and authorized by the Israel Securities Authority, if it complies with certain provisions of Section 15 of the Israeli Securities Law, 5728-1968, including, inter alia, if: (i) the offer is made, distributed or directed to not more than 35 investors, subject to certain conditions (the “Addressed Investors”), or (ii) the offer is made, distributed or directed to certain qualified investors defined in the First Addendum of the Israeli Securities Law, 5728-1968, subject to certain conditions (the “Qualified Investors”). The Qualified Investors shall not be taken into account in the count of the Addressed Investors and may be offered to purchase securities in addition to the 35 Addressed Investors. We have not and will not take any action that would require it to publish a prospectus in accordance with and subject to the Israeli Securities Law, 5728-1968. We have not and will not distribute this prospectus or make, distribute or direct an offer to subscribe for our Class A common stock to any person within the State of Israel, other than to Qualified Investors and up to 35 Addressed Investors.
paras.zh: 在以色列国，本招股说明书不应被视为根据《以色列证券法》（5728-1968）向公众发出的购买 A 类普通股的要约；该法要求，若符合《以色列证券法》（5728-1968）第 15 条的某些规定，则须发布招股说明书并经以色列证券管理局授权，其中包括：(i) 该要约仅向不超过 35 名投资者作出、分发或定向发出，且须满足特定条件（“定向投资者”）；或 (ii) 该要约仅向《以色列证券法》（5728-1968）第一附录所界定的特定合格投资者作出、分发或定向发出，且须满足特定条件（“合格投资者”）。合格投资者不计入定向投资者的人数，并可在 35 名定向投资者之外另行获邀购买证券。我们未曾且将不会采取任何行动，以致需要根据《以色列证券法》（5728-1968）并受其约束发布招股说明书。除向合格投资者及最多 35 名定向投资者外，我们未曾且将不会在以色列国境内向任何人分发本招股说明书，或作出、分发或定向发出认购我们 A 类普通股的要约。

paras.en: Qualified Investors may have to submit written evidence that they meet the definitions set out in the First Addendum to the Israeli Securities Law, 5728-1968. In particular, we may request, as a condition to be offered shares of Class A common stock, that Qualified Investors will each represent, warrant and certify to us and/or to anyone acting on our behalf: (i) that it is an investor falling within one of the categories listed in the First Addendum to the Israeli Securities Law, 5728-1968; (ii) which of the categories listed in the First Addendum to the Israeli Securities Law, 5728-1968 regarding Qualified Investors is applicable to it; (iii) that it will abide by all provisions set forth in the Israeli Securities Law, 5728-1968 and the regulations promulgated thereunder in connection with the offer to be issued shares of Class A common stock; (iv) that the shares of Class A common stock that it will be issued are, subject to exemptions available under the Israeli Securities Law, 5728-1968: (a) for its own account; (b) for investment purposes only; and (c) not issued with a view to resale within the State of Israel, other than in accordance with the provisions of the Israeli Securities Law, 5728-1968; and (v) that it is willing to provide further evidence of its Qualified Investor status. Addressed Investors may have to submit written evidence in respect of their identity and may have to sign and submit a declaration containing, inter alia, the Addressed Investor’s name, address and passport number or Israeli identification number.
paras.zh: 合格投资者可能须提交书面证据，证明其符合《以色列证券法》（5728-1968）第一附录所载的定义。特别是，作为向其发出 A 类普通股要约的一项条件，我们可能要求每位合格投资者向我们和/或代表我们行事的任何人作出陈述、保证并证明：(i) 其属于《以色列证券法》（5728-1968）第一附录所列类别之一的投资者；(ii) 其适用《以色列证券法》（5728-1968）第一附录中关于合格投资者的哪一类别；(iii) 其将遵守《以色列证券法》（5728-1968）及其下颁布的法规中与本次发行 A 类普通股有关的全部规定；(iv) 在《以色列证券法》（5728-1968）所规定的豁免适用的情况下，其将获发行的 A 类普通股：(a) 为其自身账户持有；(b) 仅用于投资目的；且 (c) 并非为在以色列国境内转售而发行，但依照《以色列证券法》（5728-1968）的规定进行的除外；以及 (v) 其愿意提供其合格投资者身份的进一步证据。定向投资者可能须提交关于其身份的书面证据，并可能须签署和提交一份声明，其中除其他事项外，载明该定向投资者的姓名、地址及护照号码或以色列身份证号码。

paras.en: #### Malaysia
paras.zh: #### 马来西亚

paras.en: No prospectus or other offering material or document in connection with the offer and sale of shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus has been or will be registered with the Securities Commission of Malaysia (the “Malaysian Commission”) for the Malaysian Commission’s approval pursuant to the Capital Markets and Services Act 2007. Accordingly, this prospectus and any other document or material in connection with the offer or sale, or invitation for subscription or purchase, of the shares of Class A common stock may not be circulated or distributed, nor may the shares of Class A common stock be offered or sold, or be made the subject of an invitation for subscription or purchase, whether directly or indirectly, to persons in Malaysia other than (i) a closed-end fund approved by the Malaysian Commission; (ii) a holder of a Capital Markets Services License; (iii) a person who acquires shares of Class A common stock, as principal, if the offer is on terms that the shares of Class A common stock may only be acquired at a consideration of not less than RM250,000 (or its equivalent in foreign currencies) for each transaction; (iv) an individual whose total net personal assets or total net joint assets with his or her spouse exceeds RM3 million (or its equivalent in foreign currencies), excluding the value of the primary residence of the individual; (v) an individual who has a gross annual income exceeding RM300,000 (or its equivalent in foreign currencies) per annum in the preceding twelve months; (vi) an individual who, jointly with his or her spouse, has a gross annual income of RM400,000 (or its equivalent in foreign currencies), per annum in the preceding twelve months; (vii) a corporation with total net assets exceeding RM10 million (or its equivalent in foreign currencies) based on the last audited accounts; (viii) a partnership with total net assets exceeding RM10 million (or its equivalent in foreign currencies); (ix) a bank licensee or insurance licensee as defined in the Labuan Financial Services and Securities Act 2010; (x) an Islamic bank licensee or takaful licensee as defined in the Labuan Financial Services and Securities Act 2010; and (xi) any other person as may be specified by the Malaysian Commission; provided that, in each of the preceding categories (i) to (xi), the distribution of the shares of Class A common stock is made by a holder of a Capital Markets Services License who carries on the business of dealing in securities. The distribution in Malaysia of this prospectus is subject to Malaysian laws. This prospectus does not constitute and may not be used for the purpose of a public offering or an issue, offer for subscription or purchase, or invitation to subscribe for or purchase any securities requiring the registration of a prospectus with the Malaysian Commission under the Capital Markets and Services Act 2007.
paras.zh: 与本招股说明书所发售 A 类普通股股份的要约和出售相关的任何招股说明书或其他发售材料或文件，均未曾且不会依据《2007 年资本市场与服务法》提交马来西亚证券委员会（下称“马来西亚委员会”）登记以取得其批准。因此，本招股说明书及与 A 类普通股股份的要约或出售、或认购或购买邀请相关的任何其他文件或材料，不得向马来西亚境内人士传播或分发，A 类普通股股份亦不得直接或间接向马来西亚境内人士要约或出售，或作为认购或购买邀请的标的，但以下情形除外：(i) 经马来西亚委员会批准的封闭式基金；(ii) 资本市场服务牌照持有人；(iii) 以本人身份取得 A 类普通股股份的人士，且该要约的条款规定每笔交易取得 A 类普通股股份的对价不低于 RM250,000（或等值外币）;(iv) 个人净资产总额或与其配偶的联合净资产总额超过 RM3 million（或等值外币）的个人，但不包括该个人主要居所的价值；(v) 在前十二个月内年毛收入超过 RM300,000（或等值外币）的个人；(vi) 与其配偶在前十二个月内合计年毛收入为 RM400,000（或等值外币）的个人；(vii) 根据最近经审计账目，净资产总额超过 RM10 million（或等值外币）的公司；(viii) 净资产总额超过 RM10 million（或等值外币）的合伙企业；(ix) 《2010 年纳闽金融服务与证券法》所定义的银行持牌人或保险持牌人；(x) 《2010 年纳闽金融服务与证券法》所定义的伊斯兰银行持牌人或回教保险（takaful）持牌人；以及(xi) 马来西亚委员会可能指定的任何其他人士；但前提是，在上述(i)至(xi)各类别中，A 类普通股股份的分发须由从事证券交易业务的资本市场服务牌照持有人进行。本招股说明书在马来西亚的分发受马来西亚法律约束。本招股说明书不构成、亦不得用于需要依据《2007 年资本市场与服务法》向马来西亚委员会登记招股说明书的公开发行，或任何证券的发行、认购或购买要约、或认购或购买邀请。

paras.zh: 因此，本招股说明书及与 A 类普通股股份的要约或出售、或认购或购买邀请相关的任何其他文件或材料，不得在菲律宾境内传阅或分发，且 A 类普通股股份不得向菲律宾境内人士要约或出售，或作为认购或购买邀请的标的，但以下情形除外：(i) 向合格投资者进行豁免 SRC 注册要求的交易；及 (ii) 由在菲律宾获准进行该等要约或出售的人士进行。
